Wayesiti kubo u‐Yakobi uyise wabo: Mna ke nindihlutile abantwana bam; u‐Josefe akaseko, no‐Simone akaseko, no‐Benjamine niya kumsusa: zonke ezizinto zi nzima pezu kwam.
Waza watsho u‐Rubene kuyise ukuti: Onyana bam bobabini ubabulale, ukuba andimzisi kuwe; mnikele esandleni sam, ndandiya kumbuyisela kuwe.

Wayesiti: Unyana wam akayi kuhla nani; ngokuba umkuluwe wake efile, waye yena esele yedwa: naxeshekweni ahlelwa sisenzakalo endleleni enihamba ngayo, niya kwandula nihlise izimvi zam ngosizi ngasencw̔abeni.
KEKALOKU indlala ibinzima kwelozwe.
Kwaza kwati, nxa babegqibele ukutya inqolowa abebevele nayo e‐Jipete, wati uyise kubo: Buyani, niye nisitengele intwana yokudla.
Waza watsho u‐Juda kuye ukuti: Yanqi̔nisa kakulu kuti indoda leyo, isiti: Anisayi kubona ubuso bam, engeko nani umninawe wenu.
Ukuba uya kutuma umninawe wetu nati, sohla ukuya kukutengela ukutya.
Ukuba kodwa akuyi kumtuma, asiyi kuhla; ngokuba indoda leyo ibisiti kuti: Anisayi kubona ubuso bam, engeko nani umninawe wenu.
Waza wati u‐Sirayeli: Ibiyinina ukuba nindipete kakubi kangakanana, nada natyela londoda ukuti kuseko kuni umninawe?

Bati: Yazingisa indoda leyo ukusibuza okwetu, nokwesalamane setu, isiti: Uyihlo usahleli na? kuseko kuni umninawe na? saza sayityela kwa ngokuteta kwalamazwi: saka sakwazi na ukuba woti: Yihlani nomninawe wenu?
Wandula wati u‐Juda ku‐Sirayeli uyise: Tuma umfana nam, sasiya kusuka sihambe; size sidle ubomi, singafi nokufa, kwa tina, nawe wena, nabantwana betu kanjalo.
Ndoti mna ndimbambisele; kwa sesandleni sam uya kumbiza: ukuba andimzisi kuwe, ndimbeke pambi kwako, mandandule ukunikwa ityala nguwe yonke imihla yam.
Ngokuba kekaloku ukuba sasingazilazilanga, ngesiba okunene kaloku nje sise sibuyile ngokwesibini.

Waza wati kubo u‐Sirayeli uyise wabo: Ukuba kunje nje ke, kanenze oku: tabatani kwezinconyiweyo iziqa̔mo zelilizwe ezityeni zenu, nihlisele londoda ibaso, intwana yetsori, nentwana yencindi, inekote nelote, ibotene nezamonde.
Tabatani nemali yokupindisa esandleni senu; nemali eyayibuyiswa emlonyeni wenxowa zenu, nibuye niyipate esandleni senu; kungati sisiposo.
Tabatani nomninawe wenu, nisuke, nibuye niye endodeni leyo.
Aze utixo onamandla onke ange anganinika ububele ebusweni bendoda, ukuba indulule nani umzalwana wenu omnye no‐Benjamine! Okwam, nxa ndihlutwa abantwana, ndiyahlutwa.
Aza amadoda lawo atabata elobaso, nemali epindiweyo ayitabata esandleni sawo, kwa no‐Benjamine; esuka ke, ehlela e‐Jipete, ema ebusweni bake u‐Josefe.
Wandula u‐Josefe, akumbona u‐Benjamine enawo, wati kopezu kwendlu yake: Ngenisa lamadoda endlwini, uxe̔le isixe̔lo, uze ulungise; ngokuba lamadoda eya kudlelana nam emini enkulu.
Yenje njalo indoda leyo njengokuba ebetshilo u‐Josefe; yaye indoda yangenisa amadoda lawo endlwini ka‐Josefe.

Andu ukwoyika amadoda lawo, ngokuba engenisiwe endlwini ka‐Josefe, ati: Kungenxa yemali ebibuyiswa ezinxoweni zetu ngokwokuqala, lento singenisiweyo, ukuze agaleleke pezu kwetu, asiwele, asibambe sibe ngamakoboka, kwa namaqwaṙashe etu.
Aza asondela kulondoda ipezu kwendlu ka‐Josefe, ateta nayo ngasemnyango wendlu,
ati: Au, nkosi! sasibe ngokwenene sisihla ngokwokuqala ukuza kutenga ukutya.

Kwaza kwati, sakufika endaweni yokulalisa, savula inxowa zetu, kekaloku nantsi ke imali yabanye ngabanye isemlonyeni wenxowa zabo, imali yetu ngokulinganiswa kwayo; saye sibuyisile yona esandleni setu.
Nemali yimbi siyihlisile esandleni setu, yokuba sitenge ukutya: asimazi ungubanina obefaka imali yetu ezinxoweni zetu.
Yayisiti: Uxolo lube kuni, ningoyiki! Utixo wenu, notixo woyihlo, unipile indyebo ezinxoweni zenu; imali yenu yabisiza kum. Yaza yamkupela kuwo u‐Simone.
Yandula indoda yangenisa amadoda lawo endlwini ka‐Josefe, ya wa bekela amanzi; aza ahlamba inyawo zawo; yanikela namaqwaṙashe awo into yokutya.
Aza alungisa ibaso, engekafiki u‐Josefe emini enkulu; ngokuba ebevile kusitwa aya kutya isonka kona.
Ati akuba efikile ekaya u‐Josefe, andula azisa kuye ibaso elisesandleni sawo endlwini, aziqubuda pambi kwake ngasemhlabeni.
Waza wawabuza ukupila kwawo, wati: Uyihlo wenu upilile na, ixego enibe niteta ngalo? Usahleli na?
Ati: Sipilile isicaka sako ubawo wetu, usahleli yena. Aza atoba ngapantsi, aziqubuda.

Wada wapakamisa amehlo ake, wambona u‐Benjamine umninawe wake, unyana wowake unina, wati: Ngulo̔ na umninawe wenu omncinane, enibe ninditetela ngaye? Waza wati: Wanga utixo angaba nofefe kuwe, nyana wam!
Waselenxama u‐Josefe; ngokuba umbilini wake wauvuta pezu kwomninawe wake: wada wafuna indawo yokulila; waya wangena enkambilini yapakati, walila apo ke.
Wasuka wahlamba ubuso bake, wapuma, wazinyanzela, wati: Bekani isonka.

Bandula ukubeka pambi kwake eyedwa, napambi kwawo ekwa wodwa, napambi kwama‐Jipete abesitya naye ewodwa nawo; ngokuba ekohliwe ama‐Jipete kukutya isonka nama‐Hebere, oko kuyintshontsho nje kuma‐Jipete.
Aya ahlala pantsi ebusweni bake, eyamazibulo njengobuzibulo bayo, nentsha kwa njengobutsha bayo: ati amadoda lawo akangelana ngokuti nqa.
Waza wawabela izabelwa zokutya zivela pambi kwake; kodwa isabelwa sika‐Benjamine sibe sikulu kwizabelwa zabanye bonke ngokuhlanu. Baye besela, bagcoba naye.
Wada wamyalela opezu kwendlu yake, esiti: Zalisa inxowa zalamadoda ngokutya, njengoko anamandla okukutwala, uyifake imali yamanye ngamanye emlonyeni wenxowa zawo.
Nebekile yam, eyesilivere ibekile, uyifake emlonyeni wenxowa yomncinane, kwa nemali yenqolowa yake. Waza wenza njengelizwi lika‐Josefe, elo wabetetile lona.
Kwakuti qip’ ukusa, andululwa lomadoda, wona namaqwaṙashe awo.
Xa abepumile esixekweni, engekabi kude, wati u‐Josefe kopezu kwendlu yake: Suka, uputume amadoda lawo; uze, wakuwafumana, uti kuwo: Yinina ukuba nipindezele okulungileyo ngokukohlakeleyo?
Asi yiyo na le, inkosi yam isela ngayo, inyanise nokulaula ngayo? Nikohlakalisile oko nikwenzileyo.
Wada wawafumana, wateta kuwo kwa lamazwi.
Aza ati kuye: Kunganina ukuba inkosi yam itete amazwi anjalo? Makube le ezicakeni zako, okokuba zenze njengalento.
Bona ke, imali esasiyifumene emlonyeni wenxowa zetu, sayibuyisela kuwe sakubuya ezweni le‐Kanane: sabesiya kuti nina ke ukuba̔ endlwini yenkosi yako isilivere negolide?
Lowo ifunyanwa kuye pakati kwezicaka zako, makafe yena; kanjalo nati soba ngamakoboka enkosini yam.
Wayesiti: Makube njalo ke, kwa njengamazwi enu: lowo ifunyanwa kuye woba likoboka lam; nina kodwa noba ningenatyala.
Andula anxama azitulela emhlabeni amanye ngamanye inxowa zawo, avula amanye ngamanye inxowa zawo kanjako.
Waza wafunisa ke, eqala ngomkulu, egqiba ngomncinane; yada ibekile leyo yafunyanwa enxoweni ka‐Benjamine.
Basuka baṙazula izivato zabo, batwesa amaqwaṙashe abo abanye ngabanye, babuyela esixekweni.
Wayesiza u‐Juda nabazalwana bake endlwini ka‐Josefe; ngokuba ebesekona yena; bawa pantsi ke ebusweni bake ngasemhlabeni.
Waza wati kubo u‐Josefe: Sesinina isenzo esi, enisenzileyo? anazi na ukuba inganyanisa ukulaula indoda enjengam?

Wati u‐Juda: Siya kuti nina enkosini yam? siya kuteta nto nina? soti nina ukuzilungisa? Utixo nyifumene inkohlakalo yezicaka zako; bona ke, singamakoboka enkosi yam, kwa tina, nalowo yayifunyenwe ibekile esandleni sake.
Wayesiti: Makube lé kum ukwenje njalo! indoda, ibekile ifunyenwe esandleni sayo, yiyo eya kuba likoboka lam; kodwa nina, nyukani ngoxolo niye kuyihlo.
Waza u‐Juda wasondela kuye, wati: Ke, nkosi yam! makesitete isicaka sako ilizwi ezindlebeni zenkosi yam, ize ingavuti ingqumbo yako ngakuso isicaka sako; ngokuba ukwa ngango‐Faro wena.
Inkosi yam yaka yabuza izicaka zayo, isiti: Kuko kuni uyihlo na, ninomninawe na?
Saza sati enkosini yam: Kuko kuti ubawo, olixego, kwa nomntwana wobuxego bake, omncinane; umkuluwe wake ufile, ukukupela kwoshiyiweyo ngunina yena, kanjalo uyise uyamtanda.
Wandul, ukuti kwizicaka zako: Mhliseni eze kum, ukuba ndibeke amehlo am pezu kwake.
Saza sati enkosini yam: Ukohliwe umfana lowo kukumshiya uyise; nxa ashiya uyise, anga uyise eya kufa.
Waye ubusiti ezicakeni zako: Ukuba umninawe wenu omncinane akehli nani, anisayi kupinda ukubona ubuso bam.
Kwaza kwati, nxa sibe sinyukele esicakeni sako ubawo, samtyela amazwi enkosi yam.
Wada wati ubawo: Buyani niye kusitengela intwana yokutya.
Saza sati: Sikohliwe kukuhla: ukuba umninawe wetu omncinane uko nati, siya kwandula sihle; ngokuba singebe nakubona ubuso bendoda leyo, nxa umninawe wetu omncinane angenati.
Saye sisiti isicaka sako, ubawo, kuti: Niyazi nina okokuba umfazi wam wabazala kum onyana ababini.
Waye omnye wapuma kum’; ndaza ndati: Okunene uqwengiwe kanye; ndaye ndingabuyanga ndimbone kwada kwakaloku.
Ukuba niyamsusa naló kwa sebusweni bam, aze ahlelwe sisenzakalo, izimvi zam niya kuzihlisa ngosizi ngasencw̔abeni.
Ngako oko ke, ndakufika kwisicaka sako ubawo, umfana engeko nati nje, (ngokuba umpefumlo wake ubotshelwa empefumlweni walowo,)
kuya kuti, akubona ukuba umfana akako, andule afe; zaye izicaka zako ziya kuhlisa izimvi zesicaka sako, ubawo wetu, ngosizi ngasencw̔abeni.
Ngokuba isicaka sako sabambisela umfana lowo kubawo, ndisiti: Ukuba andimzisi kuwe, mandandule ukunikwa ityala ngubawo yonke imihla yam.
Ngako oko ke, makesihlale isicaka sako esikundleni somfana sibe likoboka enkosini yam, aze umfana enyuke nabakuluwe bake.
Ngokuba ndiya kuti nina ukunyuka ndiye kubawo, nxa umfana angenam? hlezibe ndibone ubunzima obuya kumhlela ubawo.
Waza wakohlwa u‐Josefe kukuzinyanzela pambi kwabo bonke abebemi ngakuye, wadanduluka esiti: Yenzani bapume bonke abantu kum. Kwaye kungeko mntu emi ngakuye, ekuzaziseni kuka‐Josefe kubakuluwe bake.
Wandula ukukupa ilizwi lake ngokulila; ada eva ama‐Jipete, yeva nendlu ka‐Faro.
Waza u‐Josefe wati kubakuluwe bake: Mna ndingu‐Josefe; ubawo usahleli na? Koko abakuluwe bake bebekohlwa kukumpendula; ngokuba bebetuswa ebusweni bake.
Waza u‐Josefe wati kubakuluwe bake: Kanisondele kum. Basondela ke. Waza wati: Mna ndingu‐Josefe, umninawe wenu, enanimtengisele e‐Jipete.
Kodwa kaloku maningadandateki, makungaqumbiseki emehlweni enu kanjako, ukuba nibe ninditengisela apa: ngokuba utixo enditumile pambi kwenu, ndize kulondoloza ubomi.
Ngokuba ngoku isel’ iyiminyaka mibini indlala ipakati kwelizwe; kanjalo iseko iminyaka mihlanu ekungayi kubako kulima nokuvuna ngayo.
Waye utixo wandituma pambi kwenu, ukuba ndinigcinele isisalela emhlabeni, nokuba ndilondoloze ubomi benu ngosindiso olukulu.
Ngako kaloku asi nini abanditumileyo ukuza apa, koko ngutixo; owayendenzile uyise ku‐Faro, nenkosi pezu kwayo yonke indlu yake, nompati kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Nxamani, ninyuke ukuya kubawo, niti kuye: Utsho unyana wako u‐Josefe ukuti: Utixo undenzile inkosi pezu kwayo yonke i‐Jipete; yihla uze kum, ungalibali:
wauya kuhlala ezweni le‐Goshene, ube kufupi kum, wena nonyana bako, nonyana bonyana bako, negusha zako, nenkomo zako, nako konke onako.
Ndaye ndiya kukufunzela kwa lapo; ngokuba kusaya kubako emihlanu iminyaka yendlala; ukuze ungangeni ebuhlwentshini, wena nendlu yako, nako konke onako.
Kangelani, amehlo enu ayabona, kwa namehlo omninawe wam u‐Benjamine, ukuba ngumlomo wam otetayo kuni.
Naniya kumshumayeza ubawo bonke ubungcwalisa bam e‐Jipete, nako konke enikubonileyo; nize ninxame ukumhlisa ubawo eze apa.
Waza wamwela umninawe wake u‐Benjamine entanyeni, walila; no‐Benjamine walila entanyeni yake.
Wasuka wanga bonke abakuluwe bake, walila pezu kwabo; nasemveni kwoko abakuluwe bake bateta naye.
Kwati kwakuvakala iṙeto endlwini ka‐Faro, lisiti: Bafikile abakuluwe baka‐Josefe; kwakulungile emehlweni ka‐Faro, nasemehlweni azo izicaka zake.
Waza wati u‐Faro ku‐Josefe: Uti kubakuluwe bako: Kwenzeni oku; twesani amaqegu enu, nihambe, niye ezweni le‐Kanane;
nitabate uyihlo nabezindlu zenu, nize kum; ndiya kunipa ubumnandi belizwe le‐Jipete, naniya kutya ubunqata belilizwe.
Kekaloku wena uyayalelwa: yenzani oku; zitabateleni kwa sezweni le‐Jipete inqwelo zibe zezabantwana benu, nezabafazi benu, nimtwale uyihlo, nize ke.
Kanjalo ningakataleli impahla yenu; ngokuba ubumnandi balo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete bubobenu bona.
Benje njalo ke onyana baka‐Sirayeli: waye u‐Josefe wabanika inqwelo ngezwi lika‐Faro; wabanika nompako wendlela.
Bonke wabanika, abanye ngabanye, izivato zokuguqulelana; kodwa u‐Benjamine wamnika ishekele ezimakulu matatu zesilivere, nezivato zokuguqulelana ezihlanu.
Noyise watuma kuye njengokunje; kwa ishumi lamaqwaṙashe etwele okwobumnandi base‐Jipete, neshumi lamaqwaṙashekazi etwele inqolowa, nesonka, nokutya kube kokwoyise endleleni.
Waza wabandulula abakuluwe bake; basuka bemka; wayesiti kubo: Ningabi navuso endleleni.
Baye benyuka e‐Jipete, beza ezweni le‐Kanane ku‐Yakobi uyise wabo;
bashumayela kuye, besiti: U‐Josefe usahleli, kanjalo nguye ongumpati pezu kwalo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete. Yaza intliziyo yake yawa, ngokuba engakolwanga ngabo.
Kodwa bakuba bemtetele onke amazwi ka‐Josefe, abewatetile kubo, nokuba wabona inqwelo u‐Josefe wabezitumele ukumtwala, wandula umoyaka‐Yakobi uyise wabo wabuya wapila.
Waza wati u‐Sirayeli: Kwanele; u‐Josefe unyana wam usahleli; ndoya ndimbone ndingekabubi.
WAYE u‐Sirayeli wafuduka nako konke abenako, weza e‐Beresheba, wabingelela imibingelelo kuye utixo woyise u‐Yisake.
Waza wateta utixo ku‐Sirayeli emibonisweni yobusuku, wati: Yakobi, Yakobi! Wati yena: Nanku, ndi lapa.
Wayesiti: Mna ndi ngutixo, utixo woyihlo wako; ungoyiki ukuya kuhlela e‐Jipete; ngokuba isizwe esikulu ndiya kusenza ngawe apo.
Ndiya kuhla nawe ukuya e‐Jipete; ndobuya ndikunyuse ngenyaniso: woti u‐Josefe abeke isandla sake pezu kwamehlo ako.
Wandula u‐Yakobi wesuka e‐Beresheba; baza onyana baka‐Sirayeli bamtwala u‐Yakobi uyise wabo, nabantwana babo, nabafazi babo, ezinqwelweni abezitumile u‐Faro ukuza kumtwala.
Batabata inkomo zabo, nempahla yabo ababeyiqwebile elizweni le‐Kanane, beza e‐Jipete, u‐Yakobi nayo yonke inzalo yake kunye naye:
onyana bake, nonyana bonyana bake kunye naye; intombi zake, nentombi zonyana bake; nayo yonke inzalo yake wayizisa naye e‐Jipete.
Kekaloku ngawo la amagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli, abezayo e‐Jipete: u‐Yakobi nonyana bake. Owamazibulo ka‐Yakobi, ngu‐Rubene.
Nonyana baka‐Rubene; ngu‐Hanoki, no‐Palu, no‐Hetserone, no‐Kami.
Nonyana baka‐Simone; ngu‐Jemuweli, no‐Yamine, no‐Ohadi, no‐Yakine, no‐Tsohare, no‐Saule unyana wom‐Kananekazi.
Nonyana baka‐Levi; ngu‐Gereshone, n o‐Kohati, no‐Merari.
Nonyana baka‐Juda; ngu‐Here, no‐Onane, no‐Shela, no‐Faretse, no‐Zera; kodwa babuba u‐Here no‐Onane elizweni le‐Kanane: nonyana baka‐Faretse bebengu‐Hetserone no‐Hamule.
Nonyana baka‐Yisakare; ngu‐Tola, no‐Puwa, no‐Jobi, no‐Shimrone.
Nonyana baka‐Zebulone; ngu‐Serede, no‐Eloni, no‐Yaheleli.
Aba bangonyana baka‐Leya, abebazala ku‐Yakobi e‐Padane‐arame, kwa no‐Dina intombi yake: yonke imipefumlo yonyana bake neyentombi zake ibingamashumi matatu anesitatu.
Nonyana baka‐Gadi; ngu‐Tsifiyone, no‐Hagi, n o‐Shuni, no‐Tseboni, n o‐Heri, no‐Arodi, no‐Areli.
Nonyana baka‐Ashere; ngu‐Yimna, no‐Yisheva, no‐Yishevi, no‐Beriha, no‐Sera udade wabo: nonyana baka‐Beriha; ngu‐Kebere no‐Makiyeli.
Aba bangonyana baka‐Zilipa, lowo u‐Labane wamnikayo ku‐Leya intombi yake; aba ke wabazala ku‐Yakobi, beyimipefumlo elishumi linesitandatu.
Nonyana baka‐Rakele umfazi ka‐Yakobi; ngu‐Josefe no‐Benjamine.
Kwaye kuzalwa ku‐Josefe elizweni le‐Jipete u‐Manase no‐Frayime, abete u‐Asenate, intombi ka‐Potifera, umperisite we‐One, wamzalela bona.
Nonyana baka‐Benjamine; ngu‐Bela, no‐Bekere, no‐Ashebele, n o‐Gera, no‐Nahamane, n o‐Eki, no‐Roshe, n o‐Mupime, no‐Hupime, no‐Aredi.
Aba bangonyana baka‐Rakele, ababemzalelwa u‐Yakobi; yonke imipefumlo ibilishumi elinesine.
Nonyana baka‐Dane; ngu‐Hushime.
Nonyana baka‐Nefatali; ngu‐Yatsiyeli, no‐Guni, no‐Yetsere, no‐Shileme.
Aba bangonyana baka‐Bileha, lowo u‐Labane wamnikayo ku‐Rakele intombi yake; aba ke wabazala ku‐Yakobi: yonke imipefumlo ibisixe̔nxe.
Yonke imipefumlo ebisiza no‐Yakobi e‐Jipete, eyabipumile esinqeni sake, ngapandle kwabo abafazi bonyana baka‐Yakobi, yonke imipefumlo ibingamashumi matandatu anesitandatu;
nonyana baka‐Josefe, ababezalwa kuye e‐Jipete, bebeyimipefumlo mibini: yonke imipefumlo yendlu ka‐Yakobi, ebisiza e‐Jipete, ibingamashumi asixe̔nxe.
WAZA wamsusa u‐Juda andulele kuye ukuya ku‐Josefe, ukuze abalatise ubuso bake ngase‐Goshene; bada bafika ezweni le‐Goshene.
Waye u‐Josefe wabopa inqwelo yake, wenyuka ukuya kumkaulela u‐Sirayeli uyise e‐Goshene, wazibonakalisa kuye, wamwela intamo, walila entanyeni yake kwa kade.
Waza u‐Sirayeli wati ku‐Josefe: Makendibube kaloku, sendibubonile nje ubuso bako, ukuba usahleli.
Wandula wati u‐Josefe kubakuluwe bake, nakwabendlu kayise: Ndonyuka ndiye kushumayela ku‐Faro, nditi kuye: Abakuluwe bam, nabendlu kabawo, ababesezweni le‐Kanane, bafikile kum;
kekaloku amadoda lawo angabalusi begusha, ngokuba engabafuyi benkomo; kanjalo azisile igusha zawo, nenkomo zawo, nako konke anako.
Kwakuya kuti, xeshekweni aya kunibiza u‐Faro, ati: Yinto nina umsebenzi wenu?

nandule ukuti: Izicaka zako zingabafuyi benkomo kwa sebutsheni betu kwada kwakaloku, kwa tina nobawo betu nabo: ukuze nibe nokuhlala elizweni le‐Goshene; ngokuba beyintshontsho kuma‐Jipete bonke abalusi begusha.
Wandula ukuza u‐Josefe washumayela ku‐Faro, wati: Bafikile ubawo nabakuluwe bam, negusha zabo, nenkomo zabo, nako konke abanako, bevela elizweni le‐Kanane; bona ke, basezweni le‐Goshene.
Waya watabata kubo bonke abazalwana bake amadoda amahlanu, wawamisa ebusweni buka‐Faro.
Waza u‐Faro wati kubazalwana bake: Yinto nina umsebenzi wenu? Bati ku‐Faro: Izicaka zako zingabalusi begusha, kwa tina, nobawo betu nabo.

Babuya bati ku‐Faro: Size ukuza kupambukela kwelilizwe; ngokuba kungeko dlelo legusha ezinalo izicaka zako, indlala inzima nje elizweni le‐Kanane: maziti ke ngoko izicaka zako zihlale ezweni le‐Goshene.
Wayesitsho u‐Faro ku‐Josefe ukuti: Uyihlo nabazalwana bako bafikile kuwe;

ilizwe le‐Jipete lipambi kwako lona; kwelungileyo indawo yelizwe bahlalise uyihlo nabazalwana bako: mabahlale ezweni le‐Goshene: kanjalo ukuba uyazi okokuba kuko pakati kwabo amadoda omeleleyo, wandule uwenze abe ngabapati pezu kwenkomo zam.
Waye u‐Josefe wamngenisa u‐Yakobi uyise, wammisa ebusweni buka‐Faro; waza u‐Yakobi wamtamsanqela u‐Faro.
Wayesiti u‐Faro ku‐Yakobi: Mingapina imihla yeminyaka yokudla kwako ubomi?

Wati u‐Yakobi ku‐Faro: Imihla yeminyaka yokupambukela kwam yiminyaka elikulu linamashumi matatu; ibe yemincinane nebububi imihla yeminyaka yokudla kwam ubomi, ndandingafikelelanga kuyo imihla yeminyaka yokudla ubomi kwobawo emihleni yokupambukela kwabo.
Waza u‐Yakobi wamtamsanqela u‐Faro, wapuma ebusweni buka‐Faro.
Waye u‐Josefe wahlalisa uyise nabazalwana bake, wabanika imfuyo yomhlaba elizweni le‐Jipete, kwelungileyo indawo yelizwe, elizweni le‐Ramesese, njengokuxela kuka‐Faro.
Waza u‐Josefe wabafunzela uyise, nabazalwana bake, nabo bonke abendlu kayise, ngesonka esilingene nentsapo.
KWAYE kungeko sonka kulo lonke ilizwe; ngokuba indlala ibinzima kakulu, lada lacubuka ilizwe le‐Jipete nelizwe le‐Kanane ngenxa yendlala.
Waza u‐Josefe wabuta yonke imali ebifunyanwa elizweni le‐Jipete, naselizweni le‐Kanane, ngenxa yenqolowa abayitengayo; waye u‐Josefe wangenisa imali leyo endlwini ka‐Faro.
Kekaloku yakugqibeka imali elizweni le‐Jipete, naselizweni le‐Kanane, andula eza onke ama‐Jipete ku‐Josefe, esiti: Sipe isonka; kunganina ke ukuba sibube ebusweni bako? ngokuba ipelile imali.
Wayesiti u‐Josefe: Yipani inkomo zenu, ndandiya kuninika ngenxa yenkomo zenu, ukuba imali ipelile.

Aza azisa inkomo zawo ku‐Josefe; wati u‐Josefe wawanika isonka ngenxa yamahashe, nangenxa yenkomo ezincinane, nangenxa yenkomo ezinkulu, nangenxa yamaqwaṙashe: wandula wawaxasa ngesonka ngenxa yazo zonke inkomo zawo ngalomnyaka.

Kwati kwakugqitywa umnyaka lowo, abuya eza kuye ngowesibini umnyaka, ati kuye: Asiyi kukufihla enkosini yam, okokuba isel’ igqibekile imali; kanjalo imfuyo yetu yenkomo ibohlele enkosini yam: akuko nto eseleyo ebusweni benkosi yam, kupela yimizimba yetu, nemihlaba yetu:

kunganina ukuba sibube pambi kwamehlo ako, kwa tina nomhlaba wetu? sitenge tina nawo umhlaba wetu ngesonka; sasiya kuti tina, nomhlaba wetu, sibe zizicaka ku‐Faro; uze unike imbewu, ukuba sidle ubomi, singafi nokufa, nokuba umhlaba ungatshabalali.
Waza u‐Josefe wamtengela u‐Faro wonke umhlaba wase‐Jipete: ngokuba ama‐Jipete ebetengisile ngamasimi awo amanye ngamanye, ngokokuba indlala ibinamandla pezu kwawo; wada umhlaba lowo waba ngoka‐Faro.
Nabo abantu, wabafudusela ezixekweni, kwa kwenye incam yemida yase‐Jipete kwada kwakwenye incam yayo.
Kupela umhlaba wabaperisite ebengawutengi: ngokuba abaperisite bebenesahlulelwa sivela ku‐Faro, abatyayo isahlulelwa sabo ababesipiwe ngu‐Faro; kukona babengatengisi ngomhlaba wabo.
Wandula wati u‐Josefe ebantwini: Bona ke, senditengele u‐Faro namhla nje nina nomhlaba wenu: kekaloku nantsi imbewu kuni, ukuba nihlwayele umhlaba.
Kwakuya kuti ekuveliseni, esesihlanu isahlulo niya kusinikela u‐Faro, nezahlulo zizine zoba zezenu, zibe zezembewu yentsimi, nezokutya kwenu, nezokwabo basezindlwini zenu, nezokutya kwentsapo zenu.
Baye besiti: Ulondolozile ubomi betu; makesifumane ufefe emehlweni enkosi yam, sasiya kuba zizicaka ku‐Faro.
Waza u‐Josefe wamisa oku kube ngumteto kwada kwanamhla pezu kwomhlaba wase‐Jipete, ukuba u‐Faro abe nesesihlanu isahlulo; kupela ngumhlaba wabaperisite bodwa obe ungengoka‐Faro.
KWA njalo wahlala u‐Sirayeli elizweni le‐Jipete, elizweni le‐Goshene: bada bazuza imfuyo kulo, bacuma, banda nokwanda kakulu.
Waye u‐Yakobi wahlala ezweni le‐Jipete iminyaka yalishumi linesixe̔nxe; yaza imihla ka‐Yakobi, iminyaka yokudla kwake ubomi, yaba likulu leminyaka linamashumi mane anesixe̔nxe.

Yada yasondela imihla ka‐Sirayeli yokuba abube; waza wabiza unyana wake u‐Josefe, wati kuye: Ukuba ke sendifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, kaubeke isandla sako ngapantsi kwetanga lam, undenzele ububele nenyaniso: zungandincw̔abi e‐Jipete;
koko ndiya kulala nobawo bam, wauya kundisusa e‐Jipete, undincw̔abe encw̔abeni labo. Wayesiti: Ndiya kwenza njengelizwi lako.
Waza wati: Ndifungele. Wamfungela ke. Waza u‐Sirayeli wazitoba pezu kwentloko yawo umandlalo.
Kwaye kute emveni kwezizinto, kwatiwa ku‐Josefe: Bona ke, uyihlo uyafa. Wasuka watabata naye onyana bake bobabini, u‐Manase no‐Frayime.
Kwaza kwaxelwa ku‐Yakobi, kwatiwa: Bona ke, unyana wako u‐Josefe uyeza kuwe. Waye u‐Sirayeli wazomeleza, wahlala pezu kwawo umandlalo.
Wandula u‐Yakobi wati ku‐Josefe: Utixo onamandla onke wabonakala kum e‐Luze, elizweni le‐Kanane, wanditamsanqela,
wati kum: Bona ke, ndokucumisa, ndikwandise, ndenze ngawe umhlambi wabantu; ndandiya kunika elilizwe kwinzalo yako emva kwako libe yimfuyo engunapakade.
Nakaloku, onyana bako bobabini, abebezelwe kuwe ezweni le‐Jipete, ndingekafiki kuwe e‐Jipete, ngabam: u‐Frayime no‐Manase boba ngabam, njengo‐Rubene no‐Simone.
Kodwa abantwana bako, oya kubazala emva kwabo, boba ngabako; baya kubizwa ngegama labazalwana babo elifeni labo.

Mna ke, ekuveleni kwam e‐Padane, wabubela kum u‐Rakele ezweni le‐Kanane, endleleni, nxa ibiseko indawana yomhlaba ukuba kufikwe e‐Eferata; ndaye ndimncw̔aba kona endleleni yase‐Eferata, ekwa yiyo i‐Beteleheme.
Waye u‐Sirayeli ebona onyana baka‐Josefe, wati: Bangobanina aba?
Wati u‐Josefe kuyise: Bangonyana bam, endibapiweyo ngutixo kule ndawo. Wayesiti: Zubazise kum, ukuba ndibatamsanqele.
Koko amehlo ka‐Sirayeli ebenzima ngobudala, wada wakohlwa kukubona. Waza wabasondeza kuye; wandu ukubanga, wabasingata.
Wayesiti u‐Sirayeli ku‐Josefe: Bendingabanga ndiya kubona ubuso bako; kanti, bona ke, utixo undibonisile nenzalo yako.
Waza u‐Josefe wabapumisa emadolweni ake, waziqubuda ebusweni bake ngasemhlabeni.

Waye u‐Josefe wabatabata bobabini, u‐Frayime ngesokunene isandla sake ngakuso esokohlo isandla sika‐Sirayeli, no‐Manase ngesokohlo isandla sake ngakuso esokunene isandla sika‐Sirayeli, wabasondeza kuye.

Waza u‐Sirayeli wolula isandla sake sokunene, wasibeka pezu kwentloko ka‐Frayime, obenguye omncinane, nesandla sake sokohlo pezu kwentloko ka‐Manase, ezibeka izandla zake ngokutelekelela; ngokuba u‐Manase ebengowamazibulo.
Wandula wamtamsanqela u‐Josefe, wati: Wanga angati utixo, lowo bahambile pambi kwake obawo bam, u‐Abrahame no‐Yisake, utixo ondidlisileyo kwa sekuzalweni kwam kwada kwanamhla,
kwa ingelosi endikululeyo kubo bonke ububi, atamsanqele abafana aba; malibizwe pezu kwabo igama lam, negama lobawo bam, u‐Abrahame no‐Yisake; mabakolise ukwanda kakulu pakati kwelizwe!

Wati u‐Josefe akubona okokuba uyise ubekile isandla sake sokunene pezu kwentloko ka‐Frayime, kwakubi emehlweni ake; waza wabamba isandla sikayise, ukuba asikwelelise entlokweni ka‐Frayime asibeke pezu kwentloko ka‐Manase.
Waye u‐Josefe esiti kuyise: Makungabi njalo, bawo! ngokuba nguló owamazibulo; beka isandla sako sokunene pezu kwentloko yake.

Koko walayo uyise, wati: Ndiyakwazi, nyana wam! ndiyakwazi; yena naye woba ngabantu, yena naye woba mkulu; kodwa umninawe wake omncinane uya kumgqita ngobukulu noko, nenzalo yake yoba yinto eninzi yezizwe.
Waza wabatamsanqela ngaleyomini, esiti: Kwa ngawe o‐Sirayeli baya kutamsanqela, besiti: Wanga utixo angakwenza njengo‐Frayime nanjengo‐Manase! Wayebeka u‐Frayime pambi kwo‐Manase.
Wandula wati u‐Sirayeli ku‐Josefe: Bona ke, ndiyabuba; koko utixo eya kuba nani, anibuyisele elizweni loyihlo benu.
Kanjalo ndikunikile isahlulo sinye ngapezu kwabazalwana bako, endasisusayo esandleni saba‐Amori ngesiṙele sam nangesipeta sam.
WAYE u‐Yakobi ebiza onyana bake, wati: Zibuteni, ndandiya kunixelela oko niya kuhlelwa kuko emihleni yasemva.
Zihlanganiseni, nipulapule, bonyana baka‐Yakobi! pulapulani ku‐Sirayeli uyihlo wenu.
Rubene! ungowamazibulo wam wena, amandla am, nokuqala kwokwomelela kwam; indluliselo yobungangamsha, nendluliselo yobukulu;
upupuma nje njengamanzi, akuyi kudlulisela; ngokuba ubunyukela esililini soyihlo wako; wandula ukusinco̔lisa: wenyuka yena pezu kwomandlalo wam.
U‐Simone no‐Levi ngabazalwana; zizixo̔bo zobudlwengu iziṙele zabo.
Ungangeni esihlelweni sabo, mpefumlo wam! ungazibandakanyi entlanganisweni yabo, bungcwalisa bam! ngokuba engqunjeni yabo babulala amadoda, nangenkani yabo basika inkabi umbotshwa.
Mauqalekiswe ingqumbo yabo, ngokuba ibujoṙa; kwa nomsindo wabo, ngokuba ulukuni: ndiya kubahlulahlula kwa‐Yakobi, ndibati sa kwa‐Sirayeli.
Juda! wena abazalwana bako bokudumisa; isandla sako soba sentanyeni sentshaba zako; baya kuziqubuda pambi kwako onyana boyihlo.
U‐Juda ulitole lengonyama; unyukile ekuqwengeni, nyana wam! Watoba, wati butu njengengonyama, nanjengengonyamakazi; ngubanina oya kumvusa?
Intonga yobukumkani ayiyi kumka ku‐Juda, nomnikamteto pakati kwenyawo zake, ade afike u‐Shilo: kwa yena izizwe ziya kumlulamela.
Uyanxibelela emtini weveyine iqwaṙashana lake, nasemtini weveyine odumileyo itole leqwaṙashekazi lake; uyahlanza kuyo iveyine isivato sake, nasegazini ledreyive ingubo yake:
amehlo ake abomvu ngayo iveyine, namazinyo ake amhlope ngawo amasi.
U‐Zebulone wohlala ngaselunxwemeni lwelwandle; woba ngaselunxwemeni lwasezinqanaweni: icala lake lofikelela e‐Tsidone.
U‐Yisakare liqwaṙashe elomeleleyo, lite butu pakati kwezibaya.
Waebona indawo yokupumla ukuba ilungile, nelizwe ukuba limnandi; wandula watoba igxalaba lake ekutwaleni, wanikela ngenkonzo.
U‐Dane uya kugweba abantu bake, njengesinye sezizwe zakwa‐Sirayeli.
U‐Dane woba yinyoka endleleni, iṙamba emendweni, elilumayo izitende zehashe, aze awe ngomva okwele kulo.
Usindiso lwako ndilutembele, Yehova!
U‐Gadi iqela liya kumwela; kanti uya kuwela abasemva yena.
Kwa‐Ashere isonka sake siya kutyeba; waeya kunika izimnandi zokumkani.
U‐Nefatali libadikazi elindululweyo; uyanika amazwi amahle.
U‐Josefe lisebe eliqa̔mileyo, lisebe eliqa̔mileyo ngasemtonjeni, eli magatya anabelayo pezu kwodonga.
Abatoli bamcapukisile, batola, bamzonda;
koko isipeta sake sahlala sisebunqobeni, nengalo zezandla zake zazomelele. Kuzo izandla zosomandla ka‐Yakobi, kwa kona apo, kuye umalusi, ilitye lika‐Sirayeli,
kutixo woyihlo wako, oya kukunceda, nakonamandla onke, oya kukutamsanqela, makuvele amatamsanqa asezulwini evela pezulu, namatamsanqa asenzulwini ilele ngapantsi, amatamsanqa amabele, nawesizalo.
Amatamsanqa oyihlo wako anamandla pezu kwamatamsanqa omakulu bam, kude kube semdeni wenduli ezingunapakade: oba sentloko ka‐Josefe, naselukakayini lwalowo ube wahlukene nabazalwana bake.
U‐Benjamine uya kuqwenga njeng encu̔ka: kusasa wodla okubanjiweyo, nangokuhlwa uya kwaba okutinjiweyo.
Bonke aba bazizizwe zo‐Sirayeli zilishumi linazibini: kuko oku wabekuteta kubo uyise wabo, akubatamsanqela; abanye ngabanye wabatamsanqela njengawabo amatamsanqa.
Waza wabayolela, wati kubo: Ndiza kubutelwa ebantwini bam; ndincw̔abeni nobawo bam emqolombeni osentsimini ka‐Hefrone um‐Hete;
emqolombeni osentsimini yase‐Makapela, epambi kwe‐Mamre, elizweni le‐Kanane, lowo wawutengayo u‐Abrahame kunye nentsimi ka‐Hefrone um‐Hete, ube yimfuyo yendawo yokuncw̔aba.
Kwa lapo bamncw̔aba u‐Abrahame, no‐Sara umfazi wake: apo bamncw̔aba u‐Yisake, no‐Rebeka umfazi wake; nalapo ndamncw̔aba u‐Leya.
Bekutengwa intsimi leyo, nomqolomba okuyo, elusatsheni luka‐Hete.
Wandula u‐Yakobi, akuba egqibile ukuyolela onyana bake, wafinyeza inyawo zake emandlalweni, wapuma umpefumlo, wabutelwa ebantwini bake.
Waza u‐Josefe wawela ubuso boyise, walila pezu kwake, wamanga.
Wayeyalela u‐Josefe izicaka zake incibi zamayeza, ukuba zimnyange uyise; zaza incibi zamayeza zamnyanga u‐Sirayeli.
Kwamzalisekiselwa imihla yamashumi mane; ngokuba bekunjalo ukuzalisekiswa kwemihla yabanyangwayo: aye ama‐Jipete amlilela imihla yamashumi asixe̔nxe.
Kwati kwakuba kudlulile imihla yokulilelwa kwake, wandula wateta u‐Josefe kwabendlu ka‐Faro, esiti: Ukuba ndike ndafumana ufefe emehlweni enu, zenitete ezindlebeni zika‐Faro, nisiti:
Ubawo wandifungisa, esiti: Bona ke, ndiza kububa; encw̔abeni lam endizimbele lona elizweni le‐Kanane, kwa kona apo uya kundincw̔aba. Kaloku makendinyuke ukuya kumncw̔aba ubawo, ndandule ukubuya.
Wati u‐Faro: Nyuka, uye umncw̔abe uyihlo, njengokukufungisa kwake.
Waza wenyuka u‐Josefe ukuya kumncw̔aba uyise: kwenyuka naye zonke izicaka zika‐Faro, abadala bendlu yake, nabo bonke abadala belizwe le‐Jipete;
kwa nayo yonke indlu ka‐Josefe, nabazalwana bake, nendlu kayise: kupela intsatshana zabo, negusha zabo, nenkomo zabo, bazishiya elizweni le‐Goshene.
Kwaye kunyuka naye nenqwelo nabakweli bamahashe; lalilibandla elikulu kakulu.
Bada bafika esibayeni sokubula sika‐Atade, esipesheya kwe‐Yoredane; baza balila kona ngesililo esikulu nesinzima kunene; wayemenzela uyise isijwili imihla yasixe̔nxe.

Bandula abemi belozwe, aba‐Kanane, bakubona isijwili eso esibayeni sika‐Atade, bati: Sisijwili esinzima esi kuma‐Jipete; ngako oko kwabizwa igama laso ngokuti, yi‐Abele‐mitsarime, epesheya kwe‐Yoredane.
Benje njalo ke onyana bake kuye, njengokuba ebebayalele:

ngokuba onyana bake bamtwalela elizweni le‐Kanane, baza bamncw̔aba emqolombeni wentsimi yase‐Makapela, lowo u‐Abrahame wabewutengile kunye nentsimi, ube yimfuyo yendawo yokuncw̔aba, ku‐Hefrone um‐Hete, ngapambi kwe‐Mamre.
Wandula u‐Josefe wabuyela e‐Jipete, kwa yena, nabazalwana bake, nabo bonke abebenyukile naye ukuya kumncw̔aba uyise, emveni kwokumncw̔aba kwake uyise.
KEKALOKU bakubona abakuluwe baka‐Josefe ukuba ufile uyise wabo, bandula bati: Angaba u‐Josefe uya kusitiya, abuyekeze kuti ngokwenyaniso bonke ububi esasimenzela bona.
Baza bayaleza ku‐Josefe, besiti: Uyihlo wayolela engekabubi ngokuti:

Niya kutsho ku‐Josefe ukuti: Uze uke uxolele isilandu sabakuluwe bako, nesono sabo; ngokuba bekwenzele inkohlakalo: ngako kaloku, uze uxolele isilandu sezicaka zake utixo woyihlo wako. Walila ke u‐Josefe kwakutetwa kuye.
Basuka baya nabakuluwe bake, bawa pantsi ebusweni bake, bati: Nanku sizizicaka zako!
Waza wati u‐Josefe kubo: Ningoyiki; ngokuba ndisendaweni katixo yinina?
Nina okunene nibe nicinga ngakum inkohlakalo; oko kodwa utixo wakucingela okulungileyo, kuze kuti, njengokuba kunjalo kwa namhla nje, kulondolozwe abantu abaninzi ebomini.
Ngako kaloku, ningoyiki; ndonifunzela nina, kwa nentsapo zenu. Waza wabatutuzela, wateta ezintliziyweni zabo.
Waye u‐Josefe wema e‐Jipete, yena nendlu kayise: wati u‐Josefe wahlala iminyaka yalikulu lineshumi nye.
Wabona u‐Josefe abaka‐Frayime abantwana besesitatu isizukulwana; kanjalo abantwana baka‐Makire, unyana ka‐Manase, babezelwe pezu kwamadolo ka‐Josefe.
Wandula wati u‐Josefe kubazalwana bake: Bona ke, ndiza kububa mna; koko utixo eya kunikumbula ngenyaniso, aninyuse kwelilizwe ukuya ezweni wabefunga ngalo ku‐Abrahame, ku‐Yisake, naku‐Yakobi.
Waza u‐Josefe wafungisa usapo luka‐Sirayeli, esiti: Utixo wonikumbula ngenyaniso, naniya kunyusa amatambo am kule ndawo.
Wada wabuba u‐Josefe, eyiminyaka ilikulu lineshumi nye ubudala bake: baye bemnyanga ke, waza wafakwa etyeyeni e‐Jipete.
KEKALOKU ngawo la amagama abo onyana baka‐Sirayeli, abezayo e‐Jipete no‐Yakobi; abanye ngabanye beza nabendlu zabo:
u‐Rubene, u‐Simone, u‐Levi, no‐Juda;
u‐Yisakare, u‐Zebulone, no‐Benjamine;
u‐Dane no‐Nefatali, u‐Gadi no‐Ashere.
Yonke imipefumlo eyabipumile esinqeni sika‐Yakobi ibiyimipefumlo imashumi asixe̔nxe: kodwa u‐Josefe ebesel’ eko e‐Jipete.
Wada wafa u‐Josefe, kwa nabo bonke abazalwana bake, naso sonke isizukulwana eso.
Lwandula lwacuma usapo luka‐Sirayeli, lwakolisa ukwanda, lwaba luninzi, lwazuza amandla ngento enkulu kakulu; laza ilizwe lazaliswa lulo.
Kwada kwavuka ukumkani omtsha pezu kwe‐Jipete, obengamazanga u‐Josefe.
Wati yena ebantwini bake: Bona ke, abantu abalusapo luka‐Sirayeli basigqitile ngokuba baninzi nangokuba namandla.
Yizani kesenze ngobuqinga kubo; hlezibe babe nokwanda, kude kuti, nxa sukuba isihla imfazwe, batelele kwintshaba zetu nabo, balwe nati, benyuke elizweni.
Ngako bamisa pezu kwabo abapati benkonzo, ukuze bababandezele ngemitwalo yabo. Baye besakela u‐Faro izixeko zokubekela, i‐Pitome ne‐Ramesese.
Kodwa njengoko bababandezelayo, kwa ngokunjalo baba baninzi, nangokunjalo babesanda; baba boyika kakulu ngenxa yosapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Aza ama‐Jipete akonzisa usapo luka‐Sirayeli ngobulukuni:
nobomi balo abenza buṙaṙa ngenkonzo elukuni, eludongweni, naseziteneni, nakuzo zonke inkonzo zasendle: yonke inkonzo yalo, abelukonzisa ngayo, ibingobulukuni.
Waye ukumkani we‐Jipete eteta kubo abazalisikazi bama‐Heberekazi, elalibe igama lomnye lingu‐Shifera, negama lomnye lingu‐Puha;
wati: Ekuzaliseni kwenu ama‐Heberekazi, niya kwandula nikangele ni pezu kwezitulo; ukuba ngunyana, niya kumbulala; ukuba kodwa yintombi, yona iya kudla ubomi.
Koko abazalisikazi bamoyika utixo; ngako abenza njengokutetiweyo kubo ngukumkani we‐Jipete, kodwa balondoloza amakwenkwe ebomini.
Waza ukumkani we‐Jipete wabiza abazalisikazi, wati kubo: Niyenzele nina lento, yokuba nilondolozile amakwenkwe ebomini?
Bati abazalisikazi ku‐Faro: Ngokuba ama‐Heberekazi engenjengabafazi abangama‐Jipetekazi: ngokuba omelele wona; kwa engekangeni kuwo umzalisikazi, asel’ ezele.
Ngako utixo wenzela abazalisikazi okulungileyo; bati abantu abo baba baninzi, bazuza amandla ngento enkulu.
Kwaye kute, ngokokuba abazalisikazi bamoyika utixo, waza wabenzela izindlu.
Wandula u‐Faro wayalela bonke abantu bake, esiti: Bonke onyana abazelweyo niya kubaposa emlanjeni, kodwa zonke intombi niya kuzilondoloza ebomini.
KWAYE kusuka indoda yendlu ka‐Levi, yaya yazeka intombi ka‐Levi.
Waye umfazi lo wamita, wazala unyana; wati akumbona ukuba umhle, wamfihla inyanga zantatu.
Koko xeshekweni ebengasenako ukumfihla, wamtabatela umkombe wengcongolo, wawusinda ngodaka nangetywina, waza wabeka umntwana kuwo, wabeka wona pakati kwemikanzi ngaselugudwini lwomlambo.
Waya udade wake wazimisa ekude, ukuze azi into aya kwenziwa yona.
Kekaloku yehla intombi ka‐Faro ukuya kuhlamba emlanjeni; wati umtinjana wayo wahamba ngasecaleni lomlambo; yaza yabona umkombe pakati kwemikanzi, yatuma isicakazana sayo siye siwuzeke.
Yati yakuba ivulile, yambona umntwana lowo; kekaloku bona ke, yinkwenkwana ilila; yaza yabetwa lusizi pezu kwayo, yati: Ngowakubo abantwana bama‐Hebere lo.
Wandul’ ukuti udade wake kwintombi ka‐Faro: Ndoka ndiye na ndikubizele umanyisikazi kuwo ama‐Heberekazi, aze akwanyisele umntwana lo?
Yaselisiti kuye intombi ka‐Faro: Hamba uye. Yasuka intombazana leyo yaya yabiza unina womntwana.
Yaza intombi ka‐Faro yati kuye: Susa lomntwana, undanyisele yena, ndandiya kunika umvuzo wako. Waza umfazi lowo watabata umntwana, wamanyisa.
Wandula wati, akuba mkulu umntwana, wamsa kwintombi ka‐Faro, waza waba ngunyana wayo; eyambiza ngegama elingu‐Mosesi, yati: Ngokuba ndimr̔olile emanzini.
Kwaye kute ngezontsuku, nxa selekulile u‐Mosesi, wapuma waya kubo abazalwana bake, wabonela imitwalo yabo; wada wabona um‐Jipete ebeta um‐Hebere, owasebazalwaneni bake.
Waza wabeka apa napaya, wati, akubona ukuba akuko mntu, wambulala um‐Jipete, wamselela entlabatini.
Wabuya wapuma ngomhla wesibini, kekaloku nanga amadoda mabini engama‐Hebere engxolisana; waza wati kweyonileyo: Umbeta nganina ummelwane wako?
Yati yona: Umiselwe ngubanina ukuba ube yinkosi nomgwebi pezu kwetu? Unga ungandibulala na, njengokuba ubulele um‐Jipete? Wandu ukwoyika u‐Mosesi, wati: Ngenyaniso lento yazekile.
Wati u‐Faro akuba evile lendawo, wafuna ukumbulala u‐Mosesi. Koko wesaba u‐Mosesi ebusweni buka‐Faro, waya wema elizweni le‐Midiyane: wada wahlala pantsi ngasequleni.
Kekaloku umperisite wase‐Midiyane wanentombi zasixe̔nxe; ezezayo zaka amanzi, zazalisa imijelo, ukuze kusezwe izimvu zoyise.
Bandula ukuza abalusi, bazigxota; koko wesuka u‐Mosesi wazisiza, waseza izimvu zazo.
Nxa zibe zifika ku‐Rehule uyise, wati yena: Kunganina ukuba nikaulezile kangaka ukubuya namhla?
Zati zona: Indoda engum‐Jipete yasihlangula esandleni sabalusi; kanjako yakolisa ukusikelela, yaseza izimvu.
Waza wati ezintombini zake: Ipina pofu? Iyinina lento niyishiyile indoda leyo? Yibizeni, ize itye isonka.
Wabe u‐Mosesi evuma ukuhlala nalondoda: yaza yanika u‐Mosesi u‐Tsipora intombi yayo.
Owazala unyana ke; waye u‐Mosesi ebiza igama lake ngo‐Gereshome; ngokuba ebesiti: Ndingowasemzini ezweni lasemzini.
KWAYE kute pakati kwezontsuku zininzi, wafa ukumkani we‐Jipete; lwaye usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwagula ngenxa yenkonzo, lwakala nokukala; kwaza ukubongoza kwalo kwenyukela kutixo ngenxa yenkonzo.
Weva utixo ukutswina kwalo, wayekumbula utixo ucebano lwake kunye no‐Abrahame, no‐Yisake, no‐Yakobi.
Waza utixo wabona usapo luka‐Sirayeli, waye utixo enokulwazi.
Kekaloku u‐Mosesi ebesalusa izimvu zika‐Yetero, usomfazi wake, umperisite wase‐Midiyane: wasuka waqu̔ba izimvu ngasele kwentlango, wada wafika entabeni katixo, e‐Horebe.
Yandula yabonakala ingelosi kayehova kuye elangatyeni lomlilo pakati kwetyolo; waza wakangela, kekaloku nali ityolo lisitsha ngomlilo, lingenakugqityelwa noko.
Wayesiti u‐Mosesi: Ndoka ndipambuke ndiye kubona esisibonakalo sikulu, kunganina ukuba lingatshisekanga ityolo.
Wati akubona uyehova ukuba upambukile ukuza kubona, wandula utixo wabiza kuye kwa pakati kwetyolo, wati: Mosesi, Mosesi! Wati yena: Nanku, ndi lapa.
Wayesiti: Ungasondeli apa; susa izihlangu zako ezinyaweni zako, ngokuba indawo umi kuyo ingumhlaba ongcwele.
Wabuya wati: Mna ndi ngutixo woyihlo, utixo ka‐Abrahame, utixo ka‐Yisake, notixo ka‐Yakobi. Waza u‐Mosesi wagqubutela ubuso bake; ngokuba ebesoyika ukukangela ngakutixo.
Wati kanjalo uyehova: Ndikolisile ukubona ubunzima babantu bam abase‐Jipete, nokukala kwabo ndikuvile ngenxa yenkosi zabo zomsebenzi; ngokuba intsizi zabo ndizazile.

Ndihlile ngoko, ukuba ndibahlangule esandleni sama‐Jipete, nokuba ndibanyuse kwelilizwe baye ezweni elilungileyo nelibanzi, ezweni elela ubisi nobusi; endaweni yabo aba‐Kanane, nama‐Hete, naba‐Amori, nama‐Perizi, nama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi.
Nakaloku, nanku ukukala kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli kufikile kum; kanjako ndibonile imbandezelo ama‐Jipete alubandezela ngayo.
Uze ke ngoku, ndandiya kukutuma ukuya ku‐Faro, ukuba upumise abantu bam, usapo luka‐Sirayeli, e‐Jipete.
Waza wati u‐Mosesi kutixo: Ndingubanina mna, ukuba ndiye ku‐Faro, nokuba ndipumise usapo luka‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete?
Wayesiti: Ngenyaniso ndiya kubako nawe; kanjako oku kwoba ngumqondiso kuwe, wokuba ndikutumile mna: nxa ubakupileyo ababantu e‐Jipete, niya kumkonza utixo pezu kwalentaba.
Wati u‐Mosesi kutixo: Bona ke, ndakuza kufika elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, nditi kulo: Utixo woyihlo benu unditumile kuni; lwandule luti kum: Ngubanina igama lake? ndoti nina kulo?
Waye utixo esiti ku‐Mosesi: Ndikoko endikuko. Wati kanjalo: Uya kutsho elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli ukuti: Undingokoyo unditumile kuni.

Walekela wati utixo ku‐Mosesi: Uya kutsho elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli ukuti: Uyehova, utixo woyihlo benu, utixo ka‐Abrahame, utixo ka‐Yisake, notixo ka‐Yakobi, unditumile kuni; leli igama lam kude kube ngunapakade, sesi nesikumbuzo sam kwisizukulwana ngesizukulwana.

Hamba, uye uhlanganise abadala bo‐Sirayeli, uti kubo: Uyehova, utixo woyihlo benu, ubonakele kum, kwa utixo ka‐Abrahame, ka‐Yisake, noka‐Yakobi, esiti: Sendinikumbule ngokwenene, noko enenzelwe kona e‐Jipete.
Ndite ngoko: Ndoninyusa ebunzimeni base‐Jipete niye elizweni laba‐Kanane, nama‐Hete, naba‐Amori, nama‐Perizi, nama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi, elizweni elela ubisi nobusi.

Bopulapula ke ilizwi lako; wauya kuza wena, kwa nabadala bo‐Sirayeli, kukumkani we‐Jipete, naniya kuti kuye: Uyehova, utixo wama‐Hebere, uhlangene nati; uz’ uti ke kaloku, makesiye ihambo yemihla ibe mitatu entlango, ukuya kubingela uyehova, utixo wetu.
Sendikwazi kodwa, okokuba akayi kuvuma ukumkani we‐Jipete ukuba niye, kupela ngesandla esinamandla.
Ngokuba ndiya kwolula isandla sam, ndibete i‐Jipete ngayo yonke imimangaliso yam, endiya kuyenza pakati kwayo; woti emveni kwoko anindulule.
Ndandiya kunika ababantu ufefe emehlweni ama‐Jipete; kwakuya kuti, nakumka, aniyi kumka zé:

koko abafazi beya kubiza kwabamelwanekazi babo, nakwabapambukelikazi abasezindlwini zabo, impahla zesilivere, nempahla zegolide, nezivato: eniya kuzibeka pezu kwonyana benu, napezu kwentombi zenu; naniya kupanga ama‐Jipete.
Wapendula u‐Mosesi wati: Kodwa, bona ke, abayi kukolwa ndim, abayi kupulapula ilizwi lam kanjalo: ngokuba beya kuti: Akabonakalanga kuwe uyehova.
Waza wati uyehova kuye: Yinto nina leyo isesandleni sako? Wati: Yintonga.
Wayesiti: Yipose emhlabeni. Wayiposa ke emhlabeni, yaza yaba yinyoka; wasuka u‐Mosesi wabaleka ebusweni bayo.
Wandul’ ukuti uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yolula isandla sako, uyinqakule ngomsila wayo. Waza wasolula isandla sake, wayibamba; yabuya yaba yintonga esandleni sake.
Uya kwenje njalo ke, ukuze bakolwe ukuba ubonakele kuwe uyehova, utixo woyise babo, utixo ka‐Abrahame, utixo ka‐Yisake, notixo ka‐Yakobi.
Wabuya wati uyehova kuye: Uze kaloku ufake isandla sako esifubeni sako. Waza wafaka isandla sake esifubeni sake; kekaloku akusikupa, nasi isandla sake sinesilepero simhlope njengengqweqwe.
Wayesiti: Sibuyisele esifubeni sako isandla sako. Waza wabuyisela esifubeni sake isandla sake; kekaloku akusikupa esifubeni sake, nasi ke siguqulwe saba njengenyama yake enye.
Kwakuya kuti, ukuba abakolwa nguwe, nokuba abapulapuli ilizwi lowokuqala umqondiso, bokolwa lilizwi lomqondiso wasemva.

Kwoti kodwa, ukuba abakolwa yiyo nalemiqondiso yomibini, nokuba abapulapuli ilizwi lako, wandule ucapule emanzini omlambo, uwagalele emhlabeni; aeya kuti amanzi lawo uwacapula emlanjeni abe ligazi pezu kwomhlaba.
Waza wati u‐Mosesi kuyehova: Ke, Nkosi! andinguye oliciko, kwa nexesha lapambili, nakuseloko utetileyo nesicaka sako; ngokuba ndingomlomo unzima, nolulwimi lukwa nzima.
Waye uyehova esiti kuye: Ngubanina omenzele umntu umlomo? ngubanina owenza isidenge, nesitulu, nobonayo, nemfama? asi ndim Yehova yinina?
Ize uhambe ke, ndandiya kuba nawo umlomo wako, ndikufundise into uya kuteta yona.
Koko wati: Ke, Nkosi! mauke utume ngesandla salowo uya kumtuma.

Yaza yavuta ingqumbo kayehova ngakuye u‐Mosesi, wati: u‐Arone um‐Levi asi nguye umkuluwe wako na? Ndiyazi ukuba uyacikoza ukuteta yena. Kananjalo, bona ke, seleya kupuma ukuza kukukaulela; ati akukubona, avuye intliziyo yake.
Wauya kuteta kuye, ubeke amazwi emlonyeni wake; ndoti mna ndibe kunye nomlomo wako, nakunye nomlomo wake, ndinifundise oko niya kwenza kona.
Waye yena eya kukutetela ebantwini; kuze kuti ke, abe yena enjengomlomo kuwe, ube wena unjengo tixo kuye.
Nalentonga uyitabate esandleni sako, oya kuyenza ngayo imiqondiso.

Usuke wahamba u‐Mosesi, wabuyela ku‐Yetero usomfazi wake, wati kuye: Makendihambe ke, ndibuye ndiye kubazalwana bam abase‐Jipete, ndize ndibone ukuba basahleli na. Waza wati u‐Yetero ku‐Mosesi: Hamba ke ngoxolo.
Wabuya wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi e‐Midiyane: Hamba, ubuyele e‐Jipete; ngokuba selefile onke lomadoda abefuna ubomi bako.
Waza u‐Mosesi watabata umfazi wake, nonyana bake, wabakwelisa eqwaṙasheni, wabuyela ezweni le‐Jipete; wayitabata u‐Mosesi nentonga katixo esandleni sake.

Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Ekuhambeni kwako ukuya kubuyela e‐Jipete, lumka ke ukuba yonke imimangaliso endiyibekileyo esandleni sako uyenze ebusweni buka‐Faro; koko ndiya kugwenxisa intliziyo yake, ukuba akayi kubandulula abantu.
Wauya kuti ku‐Faro: Utsho uyehova ukuti: Unyana wam, owamazibulo wam, ngu‐Sirayeli.
Enditi kuwe: Mndulule unyana wam, ukuze andikonze: ukuba kanti uyala ukumndulula, bona ke, ndiya kubulala unyana wako, kwa owamazibulo wako.
Kwaye kute endleleni, endaweni yokulalisa, uyehova wahlangana naye, wafuna ukumbubisa.
Waza u‐Tsipora watabata ilitye elibukali, wasika ijwabu lonyana wake, waliposa ezinyaweni zake, wati: Ngenyaniso ungumyeni wegazi wena kum.
Wandula ukumyeka. Oko wati: Umyeni wegazi unguwe! ngenxa yokwaluka.
Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Arone: Hamba, uye kukaulela u‐Mosesi entlango. Wasuka waya, wahlangana naye entabeni katixo, wamanga.
Waye u‐Mosesi waxela ku‐Arone onke amazwi kayehova obemtumile, nayo yonke imiqondiso abemyalele ngayo.
Waza wahamba u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, baya bahlanganisa bonke abadala bosapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Waye u‐Arone wateta onke amazwi abetetile wona uyehova ku‐Mosesi; wayenza nemiqondiso emehlweni abantu.
Baza abantu bakolwa; abati bakuba bevile okokuba uyehova ukumbule usapo luka‐Sirayeli, nokuba ukangele ubunzima babo, bandula batoba ngapantsi babedesha.
KWABEKUTE kamva, beza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, bati ku‐Faro: Utsho uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ukuti: Bandulule abantu bam, baye bandenzele umtendeleko entlango.
Koko wati u‐Faro: Ungubanina uyehova, okokuba ndipulapule ilizwi lake ukubandulula o‐Sirayeli? uyehova andimazi, no‐Sirayeli andiyi kubandulula.
Baza bati: Utixo wama‐Hebere uhlangene nati; makesiye ngoko ihambo yemihla ibe mitatu entlango, ukuya kubingela uyehova, utixo wetu, hleze asiwele ngesifo esibubisayo, umhlaumbi ngesiṙele.
Wandul’ ukuti kubo ukumkani we‐Jipete: Kunganina, Mosesi no‐Arone! ukuba nenze abantu bayeke imisebenzi yabo? hambani niye emitwalweni yenu.
Walekela wati u‐Faro: Bona ke, abantu belizwe sebebaninzi nje, niya kubapumza na emitwalweni yabo?
Wati ngoko u‐Faro kwa ngalomini, wayalela inkosi zomsebenzi zabantu, namagosa abo, ngokuti:
Aniyi kupinda ukunika abantu inca yokwenza izitene, njengexesha lapambili; mabaye bona bazibutele inca.
Kodwa inani lezitene, babefudula besenza lona pambili, niya kulibeka pezu kwabo noko; aniyi kuncipisa nto kulo: ngokuba benqena; kungoko bakalayo, besiti: Masihambe siye kubingela utixo wetu.
Maibe inkonzo inzima pezu kwamadoda la, ukuze asebenze kuyo, angabekeli amazwi obuxoki.
Kwaza kwapuma inkosi zomsebenzi zabantu, namagosa abo, bateta ebantwini, besiti: Utsho u‐Faro ukuti: Andisayi kuninika inca.
Hambani nina, niye kuzitabatela inca apo ningayifumana kona; kodwa akuyi kuncitshiswa nento enkonzweni yenu.
Baza abantu batiwa sa kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, ukuya kubuta indiza endaweni yenca.
Zasuka inkosi zomsebenzi zanxamisa, zisiti: Fezani imisebenzi yenu, into yemini ngemini yayo, njengokuya bekuko inca.

Kwaye kubetwa amagosa osapo luka‐Sirayeli, lawo zibe ziwamisile pezu kwalo inkosi zomsebenzi zika‐Faro, kwatiwa: Kunganina ukuba ningafezanga umsebenzi eniwumiselweyo, ngokwenza izitene, kwa izolo nanamhla, njengexesha lapambili?
Andula amagosa osapo luka‐Sirayeli aya akala ku‐Faro, esiti: Yinina ukuba wenje nje ezicakeni zako?
Ayiko inca enikelwa izicaka zako; kodwa izitene, kutiwa kuti, nizenze noko: kanjalo, bona ke, izicaka zako zibetwa, kanti ngabantu bako abonayo.
Kuloko wati: Niyanqena nina, niyanqena; kungoko nitshoyo ukuti: Masiye sibingele uyehova.
Hambani ke kaloku, nisebenze; ngokuba ningayi kunikwa inca; kodwa inani lezitene niya kunikela lona noko.
Aza abona amagosa osapo luka‐Sirayeli ukuba asebubini, kusitwa nje: Aniyi kuncipisa nto eziteneni zenu zomsebenzi wenu wemihla ngemihla.
Aye ehlangana no‐Mosesi no‐Arone, abebemi malungana nawo, ekupumeni kwawo ku‐Faro,
ati kubo: Makabone uyehova pezu kwenu, agwebe; ngokokuba ivumba letu nilinukisile emehlweni ka‐Faro, nasemehlweni ezicaka zake, kude kunikwe isiṙele esandleni sabo sokusibulala.
Waza u‐Mosesi wabuyela kuyehova, wati: Nkosi! kunganina ukuba ubapete kakubi ababantu? kunganina lento unditumileyo?
Ngokuba kwa kuseloko ndafikayo ku‐Faro, ukuza kuteta egameni lako, ubapete kakubi yena ababantu; kanjalo akusindisanga abantu bako nakanye.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Kaloku uya kubona oko ndiya kukwenza ku‐Faro; ngokuba ngesandla esinamandla eya kubandulula, nangesandla esinamandla eya kubagxota elizweni lake.
WABUYA wateta utixo ku‐Mosesi, wati kuye: Mna ndi nguyehova.
Ndabonakala ku‐Abrahame, ku‐Yisake, naku‐Yakobi, ngokuba ngutixo onamandla onke; kodwa ngegama lam eli nguyehova, bendingazeki kubo.
Kanjalo ndilumisile ucebano lwam nabo, lwokuba ndibape ilizwe le‐Kanane, ilizwe lokupambukela kwabo, elo babengabasemzini kulo.
Nakanjalo ndikuvile ukugula kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, olukonzisiweyo ngama‐Jipete; nocebano lwam ndilukumbule.

Yiti ke ngoko elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Mna ndi nguyehova; ndonipumisa kwa pantsi kwemitwalo yama‐Jipete, ndinihlangule nasebukonzini bawo; ndandiya kunikulula ngengalo eyolulweyo, nangemigwebo emikulu;
ndoti kanjalo ndinitabate nibe ngabantu kum, ndize mna ndibe ngutixo kuni; naniya kukwazi ukuba ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu, onipumisayo kwa pantsi kwemitwalo yama‐Jipete.
Ndandiya kunizisa kwelozwe, endandipakamisa isandla sam ukuba ndilinike ku‐Abrahame, ku‐Yisake, naku‐Yakobi; lona ndolinika kuni libe lilifa: mna ndi nguyehova.
Waza u‐Mosesi wateta ngokunjalo elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli; kuloko belungampulapuli u‐Mosesi, ngenxa yokucapuka kwomoya, nangenxa yenkonzo elukuni.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Yiya utete ku‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete, ukuba andulule usapo luka‐Sirayeli ezweni lake.
Koko u‐Mosesi wateta ebusweni bukayehova, esiti: Bona ke, usapo luka‐Sirayeli alundipulapulanga; woti nina ngoko ukundipulapula u‐Faro, ndingomlomo ungalukanga nje?
Waza wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, naku‐Arone, wabayalezela elusatsheni uka‐Sirayeli, naku‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete, ukuba makupunyiswe usapo luka‐Sirayeli ezweni le‐Jipete.
KEKALOKU aba ngabazintloko zendlu zoyise zalo: onyana baka‐Rubene, owamazibulo ka‐Sirayeli; u‐Hanoki no‐Palu, u‐Hetserone no‐Kami: zizo ezi izizalwane zika‐Rubene.
Nonyana baka‐Simone; u‐Jemuweli, no‐Yamine, no‐Ohadi, no‐Yakine, no‐Tsohare, no‐Saule unyana wom‐Kananekazi: zizo ezi izizalwane zika‐Simone.
Ngawo la amagama onyana baka‐Levi ngezizukulwana zabo; u‐Gereshone, no‐Kohati, no‐Merari: iminyaka yokuhlala kuka‐Levi ibiyiminyaka elikulu linamashumi matatu anesixe̔nxe.
Onyana baka‐Gereshone; u‐Libeni no‐Shimehi, ngezizalwane zabo.
Nonyana baka‐Kohati; u‐Hamerame, no‐Yitsare, no‐Hebrone, no‐Huziyeli: iminyaka yokuhlala kuka‐Kohati ibiyiminyaka elikulu linamashumi matatu anesitatu.
Nonyana baka‐Merari; u‐Mahali no‐Mushi. Ezi zizizalwane zika‐Levi ngezizukulwana zazo.
Waye u‐Hamerame wazeka u‐Yokebedi, udade woyise, abe ngumfazi wake; owamzalela u‐Mosesi no‐Arone: iminyaka yokuhlala kuka‐Hamerame ibiyiminyaka elikulu linamashumi matatu anesixe̔nxe.
Nonyana baka‐Yitsare; u‐Kora, no‐Nefege, no‐Zikeri.
Nonyana baka‐Huziyeli; u‐Mishayeli, no‐Elitsafane, no‐Siteri.
Waye u‐Arone wazeka u‐Elisheba, intombi ka‐Haminadabi, udade ka‐Nahashone, abe ngumfazi wake; owamzalela u‐Nadabi, no‐Abihu, no‐ Elezari, no‐Yitamare.
Nonyana baka‐Kora; u‐Asire, no‐Lekana, no‐Abiyasafa: zizo ezi izizalwane zama‐Kora.
Waye u‐Elezari, unyana ka‐Arone, wazeka enye ezintombini zika‐Putiyeli ibe ngumfazi wake; eyamzalela u‐Finehasi. Aba ngabazintloko zendlu zoyise zaba‐Levi ngezizalwane zabo.
Nguló u‐Arone no‐Mosesi wabesiti kubo uyehova: Pumisani usapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni le‐Jipete ngemikosi yalo.
Ngaba bona ababeteta ku‐Faro, ukumkani we‐Jipete, ukuba makupunyiswe usapo luka‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete: nguló u‐Mosesi no‐Arone.
KWAYE kute, emhleni wateta uyehova no‐Mosesi ezweni le‐Jipete,
wandula wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti: Mna ndi nguyehova; teta ku‐Faro, ukumkani we‐Jipete, konke endikuteta kuwe.
Koko u‐Mosesi wati ebusweni bukayehova: Bona ke, ndingomlomo ungalukanga nje, woti nina ukundipulapula u‐Faro?
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Kangela, ndikwenzile ube ngutixo ku‐Faro; no‐Arone, umkuluwe wako, woba ngumprofite wako.
Uya kuteta wena konke endikuyalela ngako; andule u‐Arone, umkuluwe wako, atete ku‐Faro, ukuba andulule usapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni lake.
Nam ndiya kuyenza lukuni intliziyo ka‐Faro; ndandiya kwandisa imiqondiso yam nemimangaliso yam ezweni le‐Jipete.
Koko u‐Faro engayi kunipulapula, ndandiya kubeka isandla sam pezu kwe‐Jipete, ndikupe imikosi yam, abantu bam abalusapo luka‐Sirayeli, elizweni le‐Jipete, ngemigwebo emikulu.
Aeya kukwazi ama‐Jipete okokuba ndi nguyehova, ekwoluleni kwam isandla sam pezu kwe‐Jipete, nasekukupeni kwam usapo luka‐Sirayeli pakati kwawo.
Baza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone benza njengoko uyehova wabeyalele ngako; benza ngokunjalo ke.
Waye u‐Mosesi, ubudala bake, wayiminyaka imashumi asibozo, no‐Arone obake babuyiminyaka imashumi asibozo anemitatu, okuya bateta no‐Faro.
Waza wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone, esiti:
Xeshekweni u‐Faro aya kuteta nani, esiti: Zenzeleni ummangaliso; wandule uti ku‐Arone: Tabata intonga yako, uyipose pantsi ebusweni buka‐Faro; yoba yinyoka ke.
Baya u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ku‐Faro, benje njalo ke, njengokuba uyehova ebeyalele: wati u‐Arone waposa pantsi intonga yake ebusweni buka‐Faro, nasebusweni bezicaka zake, yaza yaba yinyoka.
Wandula u‐Faro wabiza izilumko nezanuse: zaza incibi zase‐Jipete zenje njalo nazo ngento zobugqi bazo.
Ngokuba zibe ziposa pantsi ezinye ngezinye intonga zazo, zaza zaba zinyoka; koko isuke intonga ka‐Arone yaginya intonga zazo.
Yaba gwenxa ke intliziyo ka‐Faro, waza akabapulapula, njengokuba ebetshilo uyehova.
Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Inzima intliziyo ka‐Faro: uyala ukubandulula abantu.
Yiya ku‐Farokwakusa; bona ke, wopuma ukuya emanzini; wauya kuma malungana naye elunxwemeni lwomlambo; nentonga ebiguqulwa yaba yinyoka uya kuyipata esandleni sako.
Wauya kuti kuye: Uyehova, utixo wama‐Hebere, unditumile kuwe, esiti: Bandulule abantu bam, ukuze bandikonze entlango; kodwa bona ke, akupulapulanga kwada kwakaloku nje.
Utsho uyehova ukuti: Ngako oku uya kukwazi okokuba ndi nguyehova; bona ke, ndiya kubeta ngentonga esesandleni sam pezu kwamanzi asemlanjeni, aeya kuguqulwa abe ligazi.
Kanjalo intlanzi ezisemlanjeni ziya kufa, ude unuke umlambo; oti nama‐Jipete adele ukusela amanzi omlambo.

Waza wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yiti ku‐Arone: Tabata intonga yako, usolule isandla sako pezu kwamanzi ase‐Jipete, pezu kwemilanjana yabo, pezu kwemijelo yabo, napezu kwamacibi abo, napezu kwazo zonke indawo zabo zokuhlanganisana kwamanzi, abe ligazi; kuze kubeko igazi kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, nakweyemiti nakweyamatye imipanda.

Baye besenje njalo u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, njengokuba ebeyalele uyehova; wapakamisa intonga, wabeta amanzi asemlanjeni, pambi kwamehlo ka‐Faro, napambi kwamehlo ezicaka zake; aza aguqulwa onke amanzi asemlanjeni aba ligazi.
Kanjalo intlanzi ezisemlanjeni zafa ke; wanuka nomlambo, ada ama‐Jipete akohlwa kusela amanzi omlambo; laye libako igazi kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Zaza incibi zase‐Jipete zenje njalo ngento zobugqi bazo: yaba gwenxa ke intliziyo ka‐Faro, akabapulapula kanjako, njengokuba ebetshilo uyehova.
Wasuka wajika u‐Faro, waya endlwini yake engayibekelanga nale n to intliziyo yake.
Aza onke ama‐Jipete embela amanzi okusela ezindaweni ezingqongayo umlambo; ngokuba ebekohlwa ukusela amanzi omlambo.
Zaye zizaliseka intsuku zasixe̔nxe, emveni kwokuba ebebetile umlambo uyehova.
WABUYA wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yiya ku‐Faro, uti kuye: Utsho uyehova ukuti: Bandulule abantu bam, ukuze bandikonze.
Naxeshekweni usala wena ukubandulula, bona ke, ndiya kubeta yonke imida yako ngamasele;

ude umlambo uvelise amasele kakulu; aeya kunyuka angene endlwini yako, nasenkambilini yako yokulala, napezu kwawo umandlalo wako, nasendlwini yezicaka zako, napezu kwabantu bako, nasemaziko ako, nasemikombeni yokubuca yako.
Kanjalo amasele lawo okwela pezu kwako, napezu kwabantu bako, napezu kwazo zonke izicaka zako.
Walekela wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yiti ku‐Arone: Yolula isandla sako ngentonga yako pezu kwemilanjana, na pezu kwemijelo, napezu kwamacibi, uwenze amasele enyuke pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete.
Waye u‐Arone wolula isandla sake pezu kwawo amanzi ase‐Jipete; aza enyuka amasele, agubungela ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Zazisenje njalo nencibi ngento zobugqi bazo, zenyusa amasele pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete.
Wandula u‐Faro wabiza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, wati: Tandazani kuyehova ukuba asuse amasele kum, nasebantwini bam; ndandiya kubandulula abantu baye kubingela uyehova.
Waza wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Faro: Ziqa̔yise pezu kwam! Kwoba ninina endiya kutandazela wena, nezicaka zako, nabantu bako, ukuba kutshatyalaliswe lamasele kuwe, nakuzo izindlu zako, asale emlanjeni wodwa?
Wati: Kube ngomso. Wayesiti: Makube njengelizwi lako, ukuze ukwazi okokuba akuko onjengaye uyehova, utixo wetu.
Oti amasele emke kuwe, nasezindlwini zako, nasezicakeni zako, nasebantwini bako; osala emlanjeni wodwa.
Bada bapuma u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ku‐Faro: waza u‐Mosesi wakala kuyehova ngendawo yamasele abewazisile pezu kwo‐Faro.
Waye uyehova wenza ngelizwi lika‐Mosesi; afa ke amasele kwa sezindlwini, nasemabaleni, nasemasimini.
Baza bafumbisa ngawo imfumba ngemfumba; wada wanuka umhlaba.
Kodwa u‐Faro akubona ukuba kuko ixesha lokuti pefu, wayenza nzima intliziyo yake, engabapulapulanga, njengokuba ebetshilo uyehova.
Wabuya wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yiti ku‐Arone: Yolula intonga yako, ubete utuli lwomhlaba luze lube zintwala kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.

Baye besenje njalo ke: ngokuba u‐Arone wolula isandla sake ngentonga yake, wabeta utuli lwomhlaba, olwaba zintwala ebantwini nasezinkomeni: lwonke utuli lwomhlaba lwaba zintwala kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Zenje njalo nencibi ngento zobugqi bazo, ukuba zivelise intwala; koko zakohlwayo: kwaza kwabako intwala pezu kwabantu napezu kwenkomo.
Zaza zati incibi ku‐Faro: Ngumnwe katixo oku! Yaba gwenxa intliziyo ka‐Faro noko, akabapulapula kanjako, njengokuba ebetshilo uyehova.
Wandula uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Vuka kusasa ngomso, uye uzimise ebusweni buka‐Faro; bona ke, wopuma ukuya emanzini; uti kuye: Utsho uyehova ukuti: Bandulule abantu bam, ukuze bandikonze.

Ngokuba xeshekweni ungandululi abantu bam, bona ke, ndiya kutuma izibau zibe pezu kwako, napezu kwezicaka zako, napezu kwabantu bako, nasezindlwini zako; zide zizale izindlu zama‐Jipete zizibau, kwa nomhlaba apezu kwawo.
Ndandiya kulahlula ngalomini ilizwe le‐Goshene, abemi kulo abantu bam, ukuba zingabiko kona izibau; ukuze ukwazi okokuba mna ndi nguyehova pakati kwomhlaba.
Ndandiya kubeka isahlulo pakati kwabantu bam nabantu bako. Ngomso wobako lomqondiso.
Wenje njalo ke uyehova; kwaye kusiza amabukubuku ezibau endlwini ka‐Faro, nasezindlwini zezicaka zake, nakulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete; lonakaliswa ilizwe zizibau ezo.
Waza u‐Faro wabiza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, wati: Hambani, niye nibingele utixo wenu kwelilizwe.

Koko wati u‐Mosesi: Akufanelekile ukuba senje njalo; ngokuba siya kubingela uyehova, utixo wetu, okuyintshontsho kuma‐Jipete; bona ke, kesiya kubinga okuyintshontsho kuma‐Jipete pambi kwamehlo awo, aze angasigibiseli ngamatye na?
Soya ihambo yentsuku ntatu entlango, sibingele uyehova, utixo wetu, njengokuba eya kutsho kuti.
Waza wati u‐Faro: Ndonindulula ke, ukuba niye kubingela uyehova, utixo wenu, entlango; kodwa musani ukuya kude kakulu: nditandazeleni ke.

Wayesiti u‐Mosesi: Bona ke, ndipuma kuwe, ndandiya kutandaza kuyehova, ukuba izibau zimke ku‐Faro, na sezicakeni zake, nasebantwini bake, ngomso; kodwa makangapindi u‐Faro ukwenza ngenkohliso, ngokungandululi abantu baye kubingela uyehova.
Wandul’ ukupuma u‐Mosesi ku‐Faro, waya watandaza kuyehova.
Waye uyehova wenza ngelizwi lika‐Mosesi; wemkisa izibau ku‐Faro, na sezicakeni zake, nasebantwini bake; akwasala nasinye.
Kanti u‐Faro wayenza nzima intliziyo yake nangelixesha; akandulula abantu kanjako.
WAZA wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yiya ku‐Faro, utete naye, usiti: Utsho uyehova, utixo wama‐Hebere, ukuti: Bandulule abantu bam, ukuze bandikonze.
Ngokuba xeshekweni usala ukubandulula, umana ubabamba nje,
bona ke, isandla sikayehova soba pezu kwenkomo zako ezisendle, pezu kwamahashe, pezu kwamaqwaṙashe, pezu kwenkamela, pezu kwenkabi, napezu kwegusha: isifo esinzima kunene.
Waye uyehova eya kwahlula pakati kwenkomo zama‐Sirayeli nenkomo zama‐Jipete; akuyi kufa nto kuzo zonke ezizezosapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Waza uyehova wadala ixesha elitile, esiti: Ngomso uyehova uya kwenza lento kwelilizwe.
Waye uyehova wayenza lento kwakusa, zati zonke inkomo zama‐Jipete zafa; kanti kwinkomo zosapo luka‐Sirayeli akufanga nanye.
Waza watuma u‐Faro, kekaloku bona ke, akufanga kuzo inkomo zama‐Sirayeli kwa nanye. Wenza nzima u‐Faro intliziyo yake noko; akandulula abantu kanjako.
Wandula uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone: Zitabateleni ngento ezalisa izandla ututu lwesidlangalala; ati u‐Mosesi alusasaze ngasezulwini pambi kwamehlo ka‐Faro.
Lwaluya kuba njengotuli kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, lube ngamatumba ejaduka ngamatyakuva, pezu kwabantu, napezu kwezilo, kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Baza balutabata ututu lwesidlangalala, bema pambi kwo‐Faro; waye u‐Mosesi walusasaza ngasezulwini; lwaza lwaba ngamatumba ejaduka ngamatyakuva, pezu kwabantu, napezu kwezilo.
Zati incibi zakohlwa kukuma ebusweni buka‐Mosesi ngenxa yamatumba; ngokuba bekuko amatumba pezu kwencibi, napezu kwama‐Jipete onke.
Waye uyehova wagwenxisa intliziyo ka‐Faro, waza akabapulapula, njengokuba uyehova ebetshilo ku‐Mosesi.
Wabuya wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Vuka kusasa ngomso, uye uzimise ebusweni buka‐Faro, uti kuye: Utsho uyehova, utixo wama‐Hebere, ukuti: Bandulule abantu bam, ukuze bandikonze.
Ngokuba ngelixesha ndiya kutuma zonke izibulalo zam entliziyweni yako, napezu kwezicaka zako, napezu kwabantu bako; ukuze ukwazi okokuba akuko onjengam kuwo wonke umhlaba.
Ngokuba kaloku bendingolulayo isandla sam, ndibete wena nabantu bako ngesifo esibubisayo; uze utshatyalaliswe emhlabeni.
Kodwa okunene, ngenxa yoku ndikumisile, ngenxa yokuba ndikubonise amandla am, nokuba igama lam lishunyayelwe emhlabeni wonke.
Usazipakamisa ngakubo abantu bam na, ukuba akuyi kubandulula?
Bona ke, malunga nelixesha langomso ndiya kunisa izicoto ezinzima kakulu, ekungazanga kubeko ezinjalo e‐Jipete, kwa semhleni wokusekwa kwayo kwada kwakaloku nje.
Ngako kaloku tuma ke, ugoduse inkomo zako, nako konke onako ezindle; bonke abantu nezilo eziya kufunyanwa ezindle zingabutelwanga endlwini, zakuhla pezu kwazo izicoto, ziya kufa.
Obesoyika ilizwi likayehova pakati kwezicaka zika‐Faro, izicaka zake nenkomo zake wazisabisela ezindlwini.
Kodwa obengabekeli ilizwi likayehova intliziyo yake, wazishiya izicaka zake nenkomo zake ezindle.

Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yolula isandla sako ngasezulwini, kuze kubeko izicoto kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, pezu kwabantu, napezu kwezilo, napezu kwayo yonke imifuno yasendle, kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Wasuka u‐Mosesi wayolula intonga yake ngasezulwini; waza uyehova wakupa indudumo nezicoto, wati umlilo wabaleka pezu kwomhlaba; wanisa uyehova izicoto pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete.
Kwaye bekuko izicoto, nomlilo upitikeziwe ndawonye nezicoto; zazinzima kakulu, ekungazanga kubeko ezinjalo kulo lonke ilizwe lama‐Jipete, kuseloko aba sisizwe.
Zaza izicoto zabeta kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete konke okusendle, kwa nabantu nezilo; zati izicoto kanjalo zabeta yonke imifuno yasendle, zapula yonke imiti yasendle nayo.
Kupela ezweni le‐Goshene, apo lwalukona usapo luka‐Sirayeli, bekungeko zicoto.
Waza watuma u‐Faro, wabiza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, wati kubo: Ndonile ngoku; uyehova ulungile, mna kodwa nabantu bam sikohlakele.
Tandazani kuyehova, (ngokuba sekwanele,) kuze kungabi sabiko indudumo zikatixo nezicoto; ndose ndinindulula ke, naningayi kuba salibala.
Waza u‐Mosesi wati kuye: Nxa ndipumileyo esixekweni, ndiya kutwabulula izandla zam ngakuyehova: indudumo ziya kupeza, nezicoto aziyi kuba sabiko; ukuze ukwazi okokuba umhlaba ungo kayehova.
Wena kanti nezicaka zako, ndiyazi ukuba anikamoyiki uyehova utixo.
Kekaloku kwakubetiwe umyaṙa neṙalasi; ngokuba iṙalasi ibisel’ idubule, nomyaṙa wausel’ utyatyambile.
Kodwa inqolowa nespelete zazingabetwanga zona; ngokuba zibe zingekahlumi.
Waye u‐Mosesi wapuma esixekweni ku‐Faro, watwabulula izandla zake ngakuyehova; kwandu ukupeza indudumo nezicoto, ayaba sagalelwa nemvula emhlabeni.
Wati u‐Faro akubona ukuba kupelile imvula, nezicoto, nendudumo, wabuya wona, wayenza nzima intliziyo yake, kwa yena nezicaka zake.
Yaba gwenxa ke intliziyo ka‐Faro, waza akandulula usapo luka‐Sirayeli, njengokuba ebetshilo uyehova ngaye u‐Mosesi.
WANDULA uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Yiya ku‐Faro; ngokuba ndiyenze nzima intliziyo yake, nentliziyo yezicaka zake, ukuze ndibeke lemiqondiso yam pakati kwabo;
nokuze ubalise ezindlebeni zonyana wako, nezonyana wonyana wako, oko ndikwenzileyo e‐Jipete, nemiqondiso endiyimisileyo pakati kwabo; nize nazi nkuba ndi nguyehova.
Baya u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ku‐Faro, bati kuye: Utsho uyehova, utixo wama‐Hebere, ukuti: Uya kwala kude kube ninina ukuzigoba ebusweni bam? bandulule abantu bam ukuba bandikonze.
Ngokuba xeshekweni usala ukundulula abantu bam, bona ke, ndiya kuzisa ngomso inkumbi emideni yako;
eziya kugubungela ubuso bomhlaba, kude kukohlwe ukubona umhlaba; zaziya kutya iliva lokusindileyo, oko nisaliselwe kona zizicoto; nayo yonke imiti enimilelayo ezindle ziya kuyidla:

kanjalo zozalisa izindlu zako, nezindlu zazo zonke izicaka zako, nezindlu zawo onke ama‐Jipete; abangazanga bazibone ezinjalo oyihlo bako, noyise boyihlo bako, kwa semhleni babeko pezu kwomhlaba kwada kwanamhla nje. Wayejika ke, wapuma ku‐Faro.
Zaza izicaka zika‐Faro zati kuye: Kwoba kade kangakananina lo engumgibe kuti? Zundulule amadoda lawo, aye kukonza uyehova, utixo wawo: akukazi na, ukuba i‐Jipete seitshabalele?
Kwaza kwabuyiswa u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ukuza ku‐Faro, owati kubo: Hambani, konzani uyehova, utixo wenu! kodwa ngubanina nobanina abaya kuhamba?
Wayesiti u‐Mosesi: Sohamba sinabatsha betu nabadala betu; sohamba sinonyana betu nentombi zetu, sinegusha zetu nenkomo zetu; ngokuba sinawo umtendeleko kayehova.
Waza wati kubo: Makabe njalo uyehova ukuba nani, njengokuba ndiya kunindulula nina nabantwana benu! lumkani, ngokuba ububi bupambi kwenu.
Kungabi njalo! hambani ke nina ningamadoda, niye kukonza uyehova; ngokuba oko nibe nikufuna. Baza bagxotwa ebusweni buka‐Faro.
Wandula uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Yolula isandla sako pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete ngenxa yenkumbi, zize zinyukele pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete, zidle yonke imifuno yelizwe elo, kwa konke okusalisiwe zizicoto.

Wasuka u‐Mosesi wolula intonga yake pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete, waza uyehova wazisa umoya wasempumalanga pezu kwelozwe, yonke leyomini nabo bonke obobusuku; kwati kwakusa, umoya wasempumalanga wazisa inkumbi.

Zaza inkumbi zenyuka pezu kwalo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, zapumla kuyo yonke imida yase‐Jipete, into enzima kunene; ngapambili kuzo bekungeko nkumbi ezingako zinjengazo ezo, nasemva kwazo akusayi kubako ezinjalo.

Ngokuba zibe zigubungela ubuso balo lonke ilizwe, lada lenziwa mnyama elozwe; zaza zatya yonke imifuno yomhlaba, nazo zonke iziqa̔mo zemiti ezazishiyiwe zizicoto; kwada akwasala nanye into eluhlaza emitini, nasemifunweni yasendle, kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Wandula wanxama u‐Faro ukubiza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone; waza wati: Ndonile ngakuye uyehova, utixo wenu, nangakuni.
Uze uti ke ngoko undixolele isono sam kube kaloku kodwa; kanjalo tandazani kuyehova, utixo wenu, ukuba asuse kum okukufa kupela.
Wapuma ke ku‐Faro, waya watandaza kuyehova.
Waza uyehova wajika umoya wentshonalanga onamandla kakulu, owafunqula inkumbi, waziwisa elwandle olubomvu; akwasala nanye inkumbi kuyo yonke imida yase‐Jipete.
Kodwa uyehova wagwenxisa intliziyoka‐Faro, waza akandulula usapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Wandula wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yolula isandla sako ngasezulwini, kuze kubeko ubumnyama pezu kwelizwe le‐Jipete, kude kuveke ubumnyama.
Wasuka u‐Mosesi wolula isandla sake ngasezulwini; kwaza kwabako ubumnyama obubungqingqwa kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete imihla yamitatu:
ababonana, kanjako akasuka mntu endaweni yake, nga leyo mihla mitatu: kanti kulo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli bekuko ukukanya emakayeni alo.
Waza u‐Faro wabiza u‐Mosesi, wati: Hambani, konzani uyehova; kupela igusha zenu nenkomo zenu mazisaliswe; kwa nabantwana benu mabahambe nani.
Koko wati u‐Mosesi: Uya kunika kanjalo ezandleni zetu imibingo namadini okutshiswa, ukuba sinikele kuyehova, utixo wetu.
Nakanjako inkomo zetu ziya kuhamba nati; akuyi kusala nopupu lunye: ngokuba siya kucapula kuzo ukukonza uyehova, utixo wetu; kodwa asiyazi tina into esiya kukonza uyehova ngayo, side sifike kona.
Kodwa uyehova wagwenxisa intliziyo ka‐Faro, waza akavuma ukubandulula.
Waza wati u‐Faro kuye: Suka kum, uzilumkele, ungapindi ukubona ubuso bam; ngokuba mhlana ubonayo ubuso bam, uya kufa.
Wayesiti u‐Mosesi: Unyanisile ukutsho; andisayi kupinda ukubona ubuso bako.
(Ngokuba ebete uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Kuseko isibeto sinye endiya kusizisa pezu kwo‐Faro napezu kwe‐Jipete; woti emveni kwoko anindulule kule ndawo: kekaloku akunindulula, uya kugqibela ukunigxota apa.
Teta kaloku ezindlebeni zabantu, ukuba onke amadoda abize kubamelwane bawo, nabo bonke abafazi babize kubamelwanekazi babo, impahla zesilivere, nempahla zegolide.
Waye uyehova wanika abantu ufefe emehlweni ama‐Jipete. Kanjako indoda engu‐Mosesi ibinkulu kakulu ezweni le‐Jipete, emehlweni ezicaka zika‐Faro, nasemehlweni abantu.)
Walekela u‐Mosesi wati: Utshilo uyehova ukuti: Ngapakati kwobusuku ndopuma ndiye pakati kwe‐Jipete;
aeya kufa onke amazibulo asezweni le‐Jipete, kwa sezibulweni lika‐Faro ohleli eteroneni yake kude kube sezibulweni lesicakakazi esisemva kwelitye lokusila, kwa nawo onke amazibulo ezilo.
Kwakuya kubako isikalo esikulu kulo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete, ekungazanga kubeko esinjalo, nekungayi kubuya kubeko esinjalo.
Kodwa ngakulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli akuyi kubako nenja eya kubaza ulwimi lwayo, nangakuye umntu nangakuso isilo; ukuze nikwazi okokuba uyehova uyenza isahlulo pakati kwama‐Jipete nama‐Sirayeli.

Ziya kwandula zihle zonke ezizicaka zako zize kum, zizitobe pambi kwam, zisiti: Puma wena, nabo bonke abantu abasezinyaweni zako; ndoti emveni kwoko ndipume ke. Waza wapuma ebusweni buka‐Faro ngobushushu bengqumbo.
Kekaloku wabete uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Akayi kunipulapula u‐Faro, ize yenziwe mininzi imimangaliso yam ezweni le‐Jipete.
Bati u‐Mosesi no‐Arone benza yonke lemimangaliso ebusweni buka‐Faro; waye uyehova wagwenxisa intliziyo ka‐Faro, waza akandulula usapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni lake.
WATSHO uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone ezweni le‐Jipete, esiti:
Inyanga le yoba sisiqalo senyanga kuni; yoba yeyokuqala inyanga yomnyaka kuni yona.
Tetani kuyo yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli, nisiti: Ngolweshumi usuku lwalenyanga mabazitabatele ixwana abanye ngabanye ngezindlu zoyise, libe linye ixwana kwindlu nye.
Kodwa xeshekweni abendlu bancinane ukuba babe nexwana, andule alitabate umntu nommelwane wake okufupi nendlu yake, ngento engangenani lemipefumlo; nobalela ixwana abanye ngabanye ngokudla kwabo.
Noba nexwana elimsulwa, liyinkunzana yomnyaka mnye; niya kulitabata ezigusheni umhlaumbi ezibokweni.
Loba sekugcineni kwenu kude kube ngumhla weshumi linesine walenyanga; wonke umhlambi wentlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli uya kulixe̔la pakati kwokuhlwa.
Babeya kucapula egazini, balibeke emigubasini yomibini, nasemqolweni, ezindlwini abaya kulidla kuzo.
Nenyama baya kuyidla ngobobusuku, eyojiweyo ngomlilo, kwa nezonka ezingenagwele; boyidla kunye nemifuno eṙaṙa.
Ningadli kuyo eṙwada, nepekiweyo ipekiwe ngamanzi, kodwa eyojiweyo ngomlilo; intloko yalo, kunye nentungo zalo nombilini walo.
Aniyi kusalisa nto kulo kude kuse; okuseleyo kulo kude kwasa, niya kukutshisa ngomlilo.
Nowenje njalo ukulidla: izinqe zenu ziya kubinqwa, izihlangu zenu zoba sezinyaweni zenu, nomsimelelo wenu woba sesandleni senu; niya kulidla ngobunxamo ke; yipasika kayehova lona.
Ngokuba ndiya kucanda elizweni le‐Jipete kwa ngobubusuku, ndibete onke amazibulo asezwenile‐Jipete, nawabantu nawezilo; nabo bonke otixo base‐Jipete ndiya kuyenza imigwebo pezu kwabo, kwa mna Yehova.
Laye igazi elo liya kuba ngumqondiso kuni pezu kwezindlu enikuzo; ndoti ndakubona igazi, ndigqite kuni, size singabiko pezu kwenu isibulalo sokutshabalalisa, xa ndilibetayo ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Kanjalo lomhla woba yinkumbuzo kuni; niya kubamba wona ube ngowomtendeleko kuyehova; nowubamba ke ngezizukulwana zenu ube ngummiselwa ongunapakade.

Nodla izonka ezingenagwele intsuku zibe sixe̔nxe; kwa ngosuku lwokuqala nolisusa igwele ezindlwini zenu: ngokuba osukuba esidla okubiliswayo, kowokuqala umhla kude kube ngowesixe̔nxe umhla, umpefumlo lowo uya kunqanyulwa ko‐Sirayeli.

Ngomhla wokuqala kwobako intlanganisano engewele; nangomhla wesixe̔nxe noba nentlanganisano engewele; akuyi kwenziwa namnye umsebenzi ngawo, kupela into eya kutyiwa ngabantu bonke, ingenziwa nini yona yodwa.

Naniya kugcina umtendeleko wezonka ezingenagwele; ngokuba ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo ndikupile imikosi yenu elizweni le‐Jipete: kukona niya kugcina lomhla ngezizukulwana zenu ube ngummiselwa ongunapakade.
Ngeyokuqala inyanga, ngosuku lweshumi linesine lwenyanga, ngokuhlwa, nodla izonka ezingenagwele, kude kube lusuku lwamashumi mabini anesinyelwenyanga, ngokuhlwa.

Intsuku zoba sixe̔nxe ekungayi kufunyanwa gwele ezindlwini zenu: ngokuba osukuba esidla okunegwele, kwa lowompefumlo uya kunqanyulwa entlanganisweni yo‐Sirayeli, nokuba ungowasemzini, nokuba ungozelweyo elizweni.
Aniyi kudla nto ibiliswayo: kuzo zonke indawo zokuhlala zenu niya kudla izonka ezingenagwele.
Waza u‐Mosesi wabiza bonke abadala bo‐Sirayeli, wati kubo: Ṙolani nizitabatele amaxwana ngezizalwane zenu, nixe̔le ipasika.

Nize nitabate isiqunyana sehisope, nisifake egazini elisesityeni, nibete emqolweni nasemigubasini yomibini ngegazi elisesityeni; kanjalo nina, makungapumi namnye umntu elucangweni lwendlu yake kude kuse.

Ngokuba uyehova eya kucanda ukuza kubeta ama‐Jipete; woti akubona igazi pezu kwomqolo, napezu kwemigubasi yomibini, andule uyehova agqite kolocango, angavumi ukuba umtshabalalisi angene ezindlwini zenu ukuza kubeta.
Niya kugcina lento, ibe ngummiselwa kuwe nakonyana bako, kude kube ngunapakade.
Kwakuya kuti, nakufika kwelozwe aya kunipa lona uyehova, njengokuba etshilo, niya kugcina lenkonzo.
Kwoti kanjalo, xeshekweni abantwana benu baya kuti kuni: Yinto nina lenkonzo kuni?
niya kwandula ukuti: Lidini lepasika kuyehova, owayegqita ezindlwini zosapo luka‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete, okuya wabebeta ama‐Jipete, wasindisa izindlu zetu. Baza abantu batoba ngapantsi, babedesha.
Lwemka usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwenza njengokuba uyehova ebeyalele u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, lwenje njalo ke.

KWAZA kwati pakati kwobusuku, wandula uyehova wabeta onke amazibulo asezweni le‐Jipete, kwa sezibulweni lika‐Faro obehleli eteroneni yake, kwada kwasezibulweni lombanjwa obesentolongweni, kwa nawo onke amazibulo ezilo.
Waza wavuka u‐Faro ebusuku, kwa yena nazo zonke izicaka zake, nawo onke ama‐Jipete; kwaye kuko nesikalo esikulu e‐Jipete; ngokuba bekungeko nanye indlu apo angeko kona ofileyo.
Waselebiza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ebusuku, wati: Sukani, nipume ebantwini bam, kwa nina nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, niye nikonze uyehova njengokutsho kwenu.
Zitabateni negusha zenu, nenkomo zenu, njengokutsho kwenu, nimke; ize ninditamsanqelise kanjako.
Ati nama‐Jipete anyanzela abantu, ngokunxamela ukubandulula kwelozwe, ngokuba ebesiti: Sonke singabafileyo!
Baza abantu batabata intlama yabo ingekabiliswa, imikombe yokubuca yabo ibotshiwe ezingutyeni zabo pezu kwamagxalaba abo.
Lwaye usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwenza ngelizwi lika‐Mosesi; lwabiza kuma‐Jipete impahla zesilivere, nempahla zegolide, nezivato.
Waye uyehova wanika abantu ufefe emehlweni ama‐Jipete, ada abenzela ukucela kwabo: baza bapanga ama‐Jipete.
Lwandula usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwanduluka e‐Ramesese lwaya ngase‐Sukote, lungati lungamawaka angamakulu matandatu amadoda ehamba ngenyawo, ngapandle kwabantwana.
Kwenyuka nalo nento eninzi yabadityanisiweyo, negusha, nenkomo, imfuyo enkulu kunene.
Lwaza lwoja izonkana ezingenagwele ngentlama belupumile nayo e‐Jipete, ngokuba yona ibingabiliswanga; ngokuba belugxotwe e‐Jipete, lwada lwakohlwa ukulibala; lube lungazilungiselanga umpako kanjalo.
Kekaloku ukuhlala kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, olube luhleli ngako e‐Jipete, bekuyiminyaka imakulu mane, neminyaka imashumi matatu ngapandle.
Kwaza kwati ekupeleni kweminyaka imakulu mane anamashumi matatu, kwandul’ ukuti ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo, kwapuma yonke imikosi kayehova ezweni le‐Jipete.
Bubusuku obo bokugcinelwa uyehova, ngenxa yokuyipumisa kwake ezweni le‐Jipete: obu bobobusuku bokugcinelwa uyehova lulo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli ngezizukulwana zalo.
Walekela wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone: Ngulo ummiselwa wayo ipasika: Osukuba engowasemzini akayi kutya kuyo:
kodwa osukuba esisicaka somntu, otengiweyo ngemali, woti wakuba umalusile, andule atye kuyo.
Oliṙanuka, nomqeshwa, akayi kudla kuyo.
Iya kutyiwa endlwini nye; akuyi kupuma nento yenyama endlwini ukuya ngapandle; kanjalo aniyi kwapula nalinye itambo kuyo.
Yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli iya kuyenza.

Naxeshekweni kupambukele kuwe owasemzini, oya kuyenza ipasika kuyehova, makati onke amadoda anawo aluke, aze andule ukusondela, ayenze; waeya kuba njengozelweyo elizweni: kodwa osukuba engalukanga akasayi kutya kuyo.
Umteto okwa mnye woba kozelweyo elizweni, nakowasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu.
Lwaye luyenza ke lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli; kwa njengokuba uyehova ebeyalele u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, lwenje njalo ke.
Kwaza kwati ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo, wapumisa uyehova usapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni le‐Jipete ngemikosi yalo.
Wandula wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Wenze ngcwele kum onke amazibulo, kwa konke kuzityulwa ngako pakati kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, okwabantu nokwezilo; kukokwam oko.
Waye u‐Mosesi wati ebantwini: Wukumbuleni lomhla, enipumile ngawo e‐Jipete, endlwini yobukoboka; ngokuba ngokwomelela kwesandla uyehova wanikupa kule ndawo: ngako akuyi kutyiwa okunegwele.
Namhla nje napuma ke, ngenyanga engu‐Abibe.

Kwakuya kuti, xeshekweni uyehova akuzisile elizweni laba‐Kanane, nama‐Hete, naba‐Amori, nama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi, elo wabafungela oyihlo bako ukuba akupe lona, ilizwe elela ubisi nobusi, wandule uyenze lenkonzo ngalenyanga.
Intsuku zoba sixe̔nxe uya kuzidla izonka ezingenagwele ngazo, nangolwesixe̔nxe usuku kwobako umtendeleko kuyehova.
Izonka ezingenagwele zotyiwa intsuku ezo zosixe̔nxe: akuyi kubonwa ngakuwe okubiliswayo; kanjalo aliyi kubonwa ngakuwe igwele kuyo yonke imida yako.
Wauya kushumayela kunyana wako ngomhla lowo, usiti: Oku kwenziwe ngenxa yoko uyehova wandenzelayo, ndakupuma e‐Jipete.
Kanjalo kwoba ngumqondiso kuwe pezu kwesandla sako, nenkumbuzo pakati kwamehlo ako, uze umteto kayehova ube semlonyeni wako: ngokuba ngesandla esomeleleyo uyehova wakukupa e‐Jipete.
Ngako uya kugcina lommiselwa ngexesha lawo, kwiminyaka ngeminyaka.
Kwakuya kuti, xeshekweni uyehova aya kukuzisa ezweni laba‐Kanane, njengokuba ebefunga kuwe nakoyihlo bako, akupe lona;
uya kwandula wahlukanisele uyehova konke kuzityulwa ngako, nawo onke amazibulo avela kwizilo onazo; amaduna oba nga kayehova.
Kodwa onke amazibulo eqwaṙashe uya kukulula wona ngexwana; ukuba kanti akuyi kuwakulula, wowapula intamo; kanjalo onke amazibulo abantu pakati kwonyana bako uya kuwakulula.
Kwakuya kuti, xeshekweni unyana wako aya kukubuza ngexesha elizayo, esiti: Iyinina lento? wandule ukuti kuye: Ngokwomelela kwesandla wabesikupa uyehova e‐Jipete, endlwini yobukoboka:
