ngokuba bekute, nxa u‐Faro wakwenza umgushanxa ukusindulula, wandula uyehova wabulala onke amazibulo ezweni le‐Jipete, kwa namazibulo abantu, namazibulo ezilo: kukona ndibingela uyehova konke kuzityulwa ngako, okuzinkunzi; kodwa onke amazibulo onyana bam ndiyawakulula.
Kwakuya kuba ngumqondiso pezu kwesandla sako, nembasa pakati kwamehlo ako: ngokuba ngokwomelela kwesandla wabesikupa uyehova e‐Jipete.

KWAYE kute, xeshekweni u‐Faro ebendulule abantu, waza utixo akabakapa ngendlela yasezweni lama‐Filistiya, nakuba leyo ibifutshane; ngokuba ebesiti utixo: Hleze abantu babe nosizi bakubona imfazwe, baze babuyele e‐Jipete.
Kodwa utixo wabazekelelisa abantu ngendlela yasentlango yolwandle olubomvu. Lwati usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwenyuka ezweni le‐Jipete luxo̔bile.
Waye u‐Mosesi watabata naye amatambo ka‐Josefe; ngokuba yena ebekolisile ukulufungisa usapo luka‐Sirayeli, esiti: Utixo wonikumbula ngenyaniso; naniya kunyusa amatambo am kule ndawo kunye nani.
Baye benduluka e‐Sukote, baya bati waca e‐Etame, ngasesipelweni sentlango.
Waza uyehova wahamba pambi kwabo, emini entsikeni yelifu, ukuba abakokele endleleni, nasebusuku entsikeni yomlilo, ukuba abakanyisele, kuze kuhanjwe emini nasebusuku.
Ayemka intsika yelifu emini, kwa nentsika yomlilo ebusuku, ebusweni babantu.
Wandula wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba lujike luti waca pambi kwe‐Pihahirote, pakati kwe‐Migidole nolwandle, malungana ne‐Bali‐tsefone: pambi kwayo niya kuti waca ngaselwandle.
Waeya kuti u‐Faro ngalo usapo luka‐Sirayeli: Luxakekile elizweni; intlango iluvalele.
Ndize ndigwenxise intliziyo ka‐Faro, ukuba woluputuma: ndandiya kubekwa ngaye u‐Faro, nangayo yonke impi yake, ukuze akwazi ama‐Jipete ukuba mna ndi nguyehova. Lwenje njalo ke.

Kwati kwakuxelwa kukumkani we‐Jipete ukuba abantu besabile, yandula yaguqulwa intliziyo ka‐Faro, neyezicaka zake, ngakubo abantu, bati: Kunganina ukuba siyenze lento, yokokuba sibandulule o‐Sirayeli ekusikonzeni?
Waza waselebopa inqwelo yake yokulwa, watabata naye abantu bake.
Watabata zazimakulu matandatu inqwelo zokulwa ezinyuliweyo, nazo zonke inqwelo zokulwa zase‐Jipete, nenjengele pezu kwazo zonke ngazinye.
Ngokuba uyehova ebegwenxisile intliziyo ka‐Faro, yokumkani we‐Jipete, waza waputuma usapo luka‐Sirayeli; kodwa usapo luka‐Sirayeli beluse lupumile ngesandla esipakamileyo.
Asuka ama‐Jipete aluputuma, alufumana lute waca ngaselwandle; (onke amahashe n enqwelo zokulwa zika‐Faro, nabakweli bake bamahashe, nempi yake;) kufupi ne‐Pihahirote, ngapambi kwe‐Bali‐tsefone.
Kwati akusondela u‐Faro, lwandula usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwapakamisa amehlo alo, kekaloku nangaya ama‐Jipete ehamba emva kwalo; lwoyika kakulu ke; lwaza usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwakala kuyehova.
Lwaye lusiti ku‐Mosesi: Kungokuba kube kungeko mancw̔aba e‐Jipete na, lento usifudusileyo sifele entlango? kunganina ukuba wenje njalo kuti, ukuba usikupile e‐Jipete?
Asi lilo na ilizwi esalitetayo kuwe e‐Jipete, sisiti: Siyeke, size siwakonze ama‐Jipete? Ngokuba kunge kusilungele okokuba sikonze ama‐Jipete, ngapezu kwokokuba sifele entlango.
Koko wati u‐Mosesi ebantwini: Ningoyiki, yimani, nibone usindiso lukayehova, aya kunenzela namhla nje; ngokuba ama‐Jipete eniwabonileyo namhla nje, ningasayi kupinda ukuwabona kude kube ngunapakade.
Uyehova uya kunilwela, noba niti tu nina.
Waza wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yinina ukuba ukale kum? Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba lunduluke:
uze wena upakamise intonga yako, usolule isandla sako ngapezu kwolwandle, ulucande: lwoti usapo luka‐Sirayeli luye pakati kwolwandle pezu kwowomileyo umhlaba.
Nam, bona ke, ndozigwenxisa intliziyo zama‐Jipete, aeya kuza emva kwalo; ndandiya kubekwa ugaye u‐Faro nangayo yonke impi yake, ngazo inqwelo zake zokulwa nangabo abakweli bake bamahashe.
Aeya kukwazi ama‐Jipete ukuba mna ndi nguyehova, ndakubekwa ngo‐Faro, na ngenqwelo zake zokulwa, nangabakweli bake bamahashe.
Yaza ingelosi katixo, ebihamba pambi kwomkosi wama‐Sirayeli, yesuka yaya ngasemva kwawo; yati nentsika yelifu yesuka ebusweni bawo, yema ngasemva kwawo.
Yeza pakati kwomkosi wama‐Jipete nomkosi wama‐Sirayeli; laye liba lilifu lobumnyama kwabaya, kanti labukanyisa ubusuku kwaba; waza omnye umkosi awasondela komnye bonke ubusuku obo.

Waye u‐Mosesi wolula isandla sake ngapezu kwolwandle; wandula uyehova wemkisa ulwandle ngomoya onamandla wasempumalanga bonke ubusuku obo, walwenza ulwandle lube ngumhlaba owomileyo, ati amanzi acandeka.
Lwaza usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwaya pakati kwolwandle pezu kwowomileyo umhlaba; aza amanzi aba ludonga kulo ngesokunene salo nangesokohlo salo.
Aputuma ke ama‐Jipete, angena emva kwalo, onke amahashe ka‐Faro, inqwelo zake zokulwa, nabakweli bake bamahashe, kwa pakati kwolwandle.
Kwaza kwati ngelokusa ivaṙasho, wakangela uyehova ngasemkosini wama‐Jipete ngayo intsika yomlilo nelifu, wapitizelisa umkosi wama‐Jipete;
wahlangula nevili zenqwelo zawo zokulwa, wazihambisa ngokunzima; ada ati ama‐Jipete: Masisabe ebusweni bama‐Sirayeli, ngokuba uyehova elwela wona ngakuwo ama‐Jipete.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Yolula isandla sako ngapezu kwolwandle, aze amanzi abuyele pezu kwama‐Jipete, pezu kwenqwelo zawo zokulwa, napezu kwabakweli bawo bamahashe.

Wasuka u‐Mosesi wolula isandla sake ngapezu kwolwandle; lwandula ulwandle lwabuyela ekweleni kwalo okufuti, kwakuza kusa; ati ama‐Jipete esaba ngakulo; waza uyehova wavutulula ama‐Jipete pakati kwolwandle.
Ngokuba ebebuya amanzi lawo, aselela inqwelo zokulwa, nabakweli bamahashe, kunye nayo yonke impi ka‐Faro ebingene emva kwawo elwandle; akwasala kubo kwa namnye.
Kodwa usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwahamba pezu kwowomileyo umhlaba pakati kwolwandle; ati amanzi aba ludonga kulo ngesokunene salo nangesokohlo salo.
Kwa njalo ke uyehova wasindisa o‐Sirayeli ngalomhla esandleni sama‐Jipete; baza o‐Sirayeli babona ama‐Jipete efile ngaselunxwemeni lwolwandle.
Kanjalo babona o‐Sirayeli lowomsebenzi umkulu, owayewenzile uyehova pezu kwama‐Jipete; baye abantu besoyika uyehova, bakolwa nguyehova nokukolwa, nangu‐Mosesi isicaka sake.
WANDULA wavuma u‐Mosesi, kwa nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, lengoma kuyehova; baye besitsho nkuti: Ndovuma kuyehova, ngokuba epakanyisiwe ngento ebungcwalisa. Ihashe nomkweli walo ubaposele elwandle.
Uyehova uludumiso lwam neculo lam; ude waba lusindiso kum: lo ungutixo wam, ndiya kumbonga; ngutixo kabawo, ndiya kumdumisekisa.
Uyehova uliṙoti lemfazwe: nguyehova igama lake.
Inqwelo zokulwa zika‐Faro nempi yake uzijulele elwandle; injengele zake ezidluliseleyo zintywilisiwe elwandle olubomvu.
Inzulu zibagubungele; batshonele emazantsi njengelitye.
Isandla sako sokunene, Yehova! sizukisiwe ngamandla; isandla sako sokunene, Yehova! silute gqobo utshaba.
Ngobukulu besitomo sako ubacitile abo basukela ngakuwe; watuma umsindo wako, obubadla njengendiza.
Ngomoya wempumlo yako afumbeka amanzi; imisinga yapakama njengemfumba; inzulu zajiyiswa embilini wolwandle.
Lwati utshaba: Ndoputuma, ndofumana, ndowaba amaxo̔ba; umxe̔lo wam wozaliswa ngabo; ndiya kuṙola isiṙele sam: isandla sam sobagqogqa.
Waqutisa ngomoya wako; ulwandle lwabagubungela; batshona njengelode emanzini amakulu.
Ngubanina onjengawe pakati kwotixo, Yehova? Ngubanina onjengawe, uzukisekile ngobungcwele, usoyikeka ezindunyisweni, usenza okungummangaliso?
Wolula isandla sako sokunene; wabaginya ke umhlaba.
Wakokela ngobubele bako ababantu ubakululeyo; wabakapela ngamandla ako ekaya lako elingcwele.
Intlanga ziya kuva, zibe nevuso; ututumelo luya kubamba abemi base‐Filistiya.
Ziya kwandula zituswe inkosana zase‐Edome; abakulu base‐Mowabi kwobabamba ukungcangcazela; baya kunyibilika bonke abemi base‐Kanane.
Kwobawela ukwoyika nokunkwantya; ngobukulu bengalo yako boti cwaka njengelitye; bade bagqite abantu bako, Yehova! bade bagqite ababantu ubatengileyo.
Uya kubangenisa, ubatyale entabeni yelifa lako, endaweni uyenzile ibe yeyokuhlala kwako, Yehova! kweyingcwele, Nkosi! ezite izandla zako zayiqinisa.
Uyehova uya kupata ngobukumkani kude kube ngunapakade!

Ngokuba bekungenile amahashe ka‐Faro, kunye nenqwelo zake zokulwa, nakunye nabakweli bake bamahashe, kulo ulwandle, waza uyehova wabuyisa amanzi olwandle pezu kwabo; kanti usapo luka‐Sirayeli beluhambile pezu kwowomileyo umhlaba pakati kwolwandle.
Waye u‐Miriyame, umprofitekazi, udade ka‐Arone, watabata intambula esandleni sake: aza apuma onke amankazana emva kwake, enentambula nemidudo.
Wandula u‐Miriyame wapendula kuwo amadoda, ngokuti: Vumani kuyehova, ngokuba epakanyisiwe ngento ebungcwalisa. Ihashe nomkweli walo ubaposele elwandle.
Wada u‐Mosesi wandulula o‐Sirayeli elwandle olubomvu; baza bapumela ngasentlango ye‐Shure; bahamba intsuku zantatu entlango apo, bengafumananga manzi.
Bati bakufika e‐Mara, bakohlwa kusela amanzi ase‐Mara, ngokuba ebeṙaṙa wona; ngako oko igama lalo ndawo labizwa ngokuti yi‐Mara.
Baza abantu baṙoṙa ngaku‐Mosesi, besiti: Sosela nto nina?
Wakala ke kuyehova; waza uyehova wambonisa umti, owati akuwuposa emanzini, amanzi asel’ eba mnandi. Apo ke wabenzela ummiso nesiko; nalapo wabalinga;

wati: Xeshekweni uya kukutala ukupulapula ilizwi likayehova, lotixo wako, ukwenze okufaneleyo emehlweni ake, unikele imiyalelo yake indlebe, uyigcine yonke imimiso yake, andiyi kubeka pezu kwako nasinye kwezozifo ndizibekileyo pezu kwama‐Jipete: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova okupilisayo.
Baza bafika e‐Elime, apo kwakuko imitombo yamanzi ilishumi linamibini, nemiti yepalime imashumi asixe̔nxe: bati waca apo ke ngasemanzini.

KWADA kwandulukwa e‐Elime; yaza yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli yafika entlango ye‐Sine, epakati kwe‐Elime ne‐Sinai, ngoweshumi linesihlanu umhla wenyanga yesibini yokupuma kwalo ezweni le‐Jipete.
Yasuka yaṙoṙa yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli ngaku‐Mosesi nangaku‐Arone entlangoapo.

Lwaye usapo luka‐Sirayeli lusiti kubo: Akwaba sabesifele ezweni le‐Jipete ngesandla sikayehova, nxa sibe sihleli ngasezimbizeni zenyama, na nxa sibe sisitya isonka kwada kwahlutwa! ngokuba nisipumisile ukuza kulentlango, ukuba nibubise wonke lomhlambi ngokulamba.

Wandula uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Bona ke, ndiya kuninisela isonka ezulwini; babeya kupuma abantu, babute into yemini nye ngemini yayo; ukuze ndibalinge, ukuba bohamba emtetweni wam, abayi kuhamba kuwo, kusinina.
Kwakuya kuti ngemini yesitandatu, bakulungisa oko bakungenisileyo, kwoba kokupindiweyo ngapezu kwoko bakubutayo imihla ngemihla.
Baza bati u‐Mosesi no‐Arone kulo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli: Ngokuhlwa niya kwandula ukwazi ukuba nguyehova onikupileyo ezweni le‐Jipete;
nangokusa niya kwandula ukubona ubungcwalisa bukayehova; ngokuba evile ukuṙoṙa kwenu ngakuyehova: kekaloku tina siyinto nina, okokuba niṙoṙa ngakuti?

Wati kanjalo u‐Mosesi: Nxa uyehova aya kunipa ngokuhlwa inyama ukuba nitye, ati kwakusa anipe isonka ukuba nihlute, kwoba ngokuba uyehova evile ukuṙoṙa kwenu eniṙoṙa ngako ngakuye: kekaloku tina siyinto nina? akungakuti ukuṙoṙa kwenu, kungakuye uyehova.
Waza u‐Mosesi wati ku‐Arone: Yiti kuyo yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli: Sondelani ebusweni bukayehova; ngokuba evile ukuṙoṙa kwenu.
Kwaye kute, nxa asateta u‐Arone kuyo yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli, kwabekwa ngasentlango, kekaloku nabu ubungcwalisa bukayehova bubonakala efini.
Waza wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Ndikuvile ukuṙoṙa kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli; teta kulo, usiti: Pakati kwokuhlwa niya kudla inyama, nangokusa niya kuhluta sisonka; naniya kukwazi okokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Kwaza kwati, ngokuhlwa zenyuka izagwityi, zagubungela umnquba; nangokusa umbete waulele ungqonga umnquba.
Kwati kwakunyuka umbete obulele kona, nantsi ipezu kwobuso bentlango into encinanana equvileyo, encinanana njengengqele emhlope pezu kwomhlaba.
Lwaza usapo luka‐Sirayeli, lwakuyibona, lwati olunye kolunye: Yinto nina le? ngokuba lube lungazi iyinto nina. Wayesiti u‐Mosesi kulo: Le isisonka anipileyo uyehova sibe kukutya.
Into ayiyaleleyo uyehova yile yokuti: Butani kuyo, abanye ngabanye ngento engangokutya kwabo, ibe yiomere kumntu mnye, njengenani leziqu zakokwenu; bonke mabatabatele abo basezintenteni zabo.
Lwenje njalo usapo luka‐Sirayeli, lwabuta ke, inxenye ngokuninzi, nenxenye ngokuncinane.
Kodwa kwakulinganiswa ngeomere, obebute okuninzi akabanga nokupezulu, nobebute okuncinane akabanga nakuswela; babuta abanye ngabanye ngento engangokutya kwabo.
Wayesiti u‐Mosesi kubo: Makungabiko mntu osalisa kuyo kude kuse.
Abampulapula u‐Mosesi noko; kodwa inxenye babesalisa kuyo kwada kwasa, yaza yabola zimpetu, yanuka; wabaqumbela ke u‐Mosesi.
Kekaloku bayibuta ngemiso ngemiso, abanye ngabanye ngento engangokutya kwabo; yati, lakubalela ilanga, yanyibilika.
Kwaza kwati, ngemini yesitandatu babuta isonka esipindiweyo, zaziziomere zimbini kumntu mnye; zasuka zonke inkosana zentlanganiso zeza zaxela ku‐Mosesi.

Wayesiti kuzo: Koku uyehova akutshilo: Ngomso lixesha lopumlo, isabata eyingcwele kuyehova; leyo niya kuyoja, yojeni, naleyo niya kuyipeka, yipekeni: nayo yonke eliliva nizibekelele yona ize igcinwe kude kuse.
Baza bayibekela kwada kwasa, njengokuba ebeyalele u‐Mosesi; ayanuka ke, akwabako mpetu kuyo kanjalo.
Wandula wati u‐Mosesi: Yityani leyo namhla nje, ngokuba namhla yisabata kuyehova; aniyi kuyifumana ezindle namhla.
Noyibuta imihla ibe mitandatu; kodwa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe, ngowesabata, ayiyi kubako ngawo.
Kwaza kwati ngomhla wesixe̔nxe, kwapuma inxenye yabantu ukuya kubuta, koko bengafumananga.
Waza wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Niya kwala kude kube ninina ukugcina imiyalelo yam nemiteto yam?
Niyabona ke, ngokokuba uyehova enipile isabata, kukona anipayo ngomhla wesitandatu isonka semihla mibini: hlalani, abanye ngabanye ezindaweni zabo, kungesuki namnye endaweni yake ngomhla wesixe̔nxe.
Baza abantu bapumla ngomhla wesixe̔nxe.
Kekaloku indlu ka‐Sirayeli yayibiza ngegama eliyimana: yabinjengembewu yekoriyande, imhlope; nesongo layo belinjengezonkana ezinobusi.
Wati kanjalo u‐Mosesi: Into ayiyaleleyo uyehova yile yokuti: Zalisani iomere ngayo, ize igcinelwe izizukulwana zenu; ukuze babone isonka endinidlisile sona entlango, ndakunikupa elizweni le‐Jipete.
Waza wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Arone: Tabata isitya sibe sinye, uyibeke kuso iomere izele yemana; uze uyibekele ngasebusweni bukayehova, ukuba igcinelwe izizukulwana zenu.
Njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi, kwa njalo u‐Arone wayibekela ngasebusweni be tyeya ye sinqi̔no ukuba igcinwe.
Lwaye usapo luka‐Sirayeli belusidla imana iminyaka yamashumi mane, lwada lwafika ezweni elimiweyo; lwadla imana lwada lwafika emideni yelizwe le‐Kanane.
Kekaloku iomere iseseshumi isiqingata seyefa.
YAZA yanduluka yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli entlango ye‐Sine, ngemfuduko zayo, njengokuxela kukayehova, yada yati waca e‐Refidime: kwaye kungeko manzi okuba basele abantu.
Ngako abantu bapika no‐Mosesi, bati: Sipe amanzi, sisele. Wati kubo u‐Mosesi: Yinina ukuba nipike nam? Yinina ukuba nilinge uyehova?
Koko abantu bebenxanelwa amanzi kona; bandula abantu baṙoṙa ngaku‐Mosesi, bati: Yinina lento ukuba usinyusile e‐Jipete, ukuze usibubise tina, nabantwana betu, nenkomo zetu, ngenxanwa?
Waza u‐Mosesi wakala kuyehova, esiti: Ndoti nina kubo ababantu? bohla bandigibisele ngamatye!
Wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Yandulela wena pambi kwabantu, utabate nawe kubadala bo‐Sirayeli; nentonga yako, obubeta ngayo umlambo, uyipate esandleni sako, uhambe.
Bona ke, ndiya kuma ebusweni bako kona, pezu kwelityekazi lase‐Horebe; wauya kubeta ilityekazi, kuze kupume amanzi kulo, ukuba basele abantu. Wenje njalo ke u‐Mosesi emehlweni abadala bo‐Sirayeli.
Wabiza igama lalondawo ngo‐Masa, nango‐Meriba, ngenxa yokupika kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nangenxa yokumlinga kwalo uyehova, lusiti: Uko na uyehova pakati kwetu, akako kusinina?
KWANDULA kweza o‐Amaleki, balwa no‐Sirayeli e‐Refidime.
Waza wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Yoshuwa: Siketele amadoda, uze upume, ulwe no‐Amaleki; ngomso ndiya kuma engcopo yenduli, ndinentonga katixo esandleni sam.
Waya u‐Yoshuwa wenza njengokuba ebetshilo kuye u‐Mosesi, walwa no‐Amaleki; koko u‐Mosesi, n o‐Arone, no‐Hure, benyukela engcotsheni yenduli.
Kwaza kwati, akupakamisa isandla sake u‐Mosesi, kwandula kweyisa o‐Sirayeli; kanti akuhlisa isandla sake, kwandula kweyisa o‐Amaleki.

Kodwa izandla zika‐Mosesi zaba nzima; ngako batabata ilitye, balibeka ngapantsi kwake, waza wahlala pezu kwalo: bati u‐Arone no‐Hure baxasa izandla zake, omnye engelinye icala, omnye engelinye; zaza izandla zake zati nqi lada latshona ilanga.
Kwa njalo u‐Yoshuwa wacita o‐Amaleki nabantu bakowabo ngohlangoti lwesiṙele.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Ba̔la lento ibe yinkumbuzo encwadini, uyibeke ezindlebeni zika‐Yoshuwa; ngokuba ndiya kugqibela ukucima inkunjulwa ka‐Amaleki ngapantsi kwezulu.
Wandula u‐Mosesi waka isibingelo, wasibiza ngegama lokuti: Uyehova yibanile yam!
ngokuba ebesiti: Ngokokuba isandla sabo sibe singakuyo iterone kayehova, kukona imfazwe kayehova iya kuba ngako‐Amaleki kwisizukulwana ngesizukulwana.
WATI u‐Yetero, umperisite wase‐Midiyane, usomfazi ka‐Mosesi, akuba evile konke utixo ebekwenzele u‐Mosesi no‐Sirayeli abantu bake, okokuba uyehova ebepumisile o‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete;
wandula u‐Yetero, usomfazi ka‐Mosesi, watabata u‐Tsipora, umfazi ka‐Mosesi, (emveni kwokuba ebemndulule,)
nonyana bake bobabini; elati igama lomnye lalingu‐Gereshome; ngokuba ebesiti: Ndingowasemzini elizweni lasemzini;
negama lomnye lalingu‐Eliyezeri; ngokuba ebesiti: Utixo kabawo ebengumncedi wam, wandisindisa esiṙeleni sika‐Faro:
waza waya u‐Yetero, usomfazi ka‐Mosesi, nonyana bake, nomfazi wake, ku‐Mosesi entlango, apo abete waca kona ngasentabeni katixo.
Wayesiti ku‐Mosesi: Mna somfazi wako u‐Yetero, ndiyeza kuwe, nomfazi wako, nonyana bake bobabini kunye naye.
Waselepuma u‐Mosesi waya kukaulela usomfazi wake, wazitoba ke, wamanga: baza babuzana ngokupila kwabo; bada bangena ententeni.
Waye u‐Mosesi wabalisela usomfazi wake konke uyehova wabekwenzile ku‐Faro, nakuma‐Jipete, ngenxa yo‐Sirayeli; nayo yonke inkatazo ebibahlile endleleni, nokuba uyehova ubebasindisile.
Waza wavuya u‐Yetero pezu kwabo bonke ububele uyehova wabebenzele o‐Sirayeli, abebasindisile esandleni sama‐Jipete.
Wayesiti u‐Yetero: Makabongwe uyehova onisindisileyo esandleni sama‐Jipete, nasesandleni sika‐Faro; obasindisileyo abantu kwa pantsi kwesandla sama‐Jipete!
Kaloku ndiyazi ukuba uyehova umkulu kubo bonke otixo; ngokuba entweni benza nger̔atshi ngayo, ebepezulu kubo.
Waza u‐Yetero, usomfazi ka‐Mosesi, watabatela utixo idini lokutshiswa nemibingelelo: wayesiza u‐Arone, nabo bonke abadala bo‐Sirayeli, ukuza kutya isonka nosomfazi ka‐Mosesi ebusweni bukatixo.
Kwaye kute ngomnye umhla, wahlala u‐Mosesi ukugweba ebantwini; bati abantu bema ngakuye u‐Mosesi kwa sekuseni kwada kwahlwa.
Waza usomfazi ka‐Mosesi, akubona konke owakwenzayo ebantwini, wati: Yinto nina lento uyenzayo ebantwini? kunganina ukuba uhlale wena wedwa, nokuba bonke abantu beme ngakuwe kwa sekuseni kude kuhlwe?
Wati u‐Mosesi kusomfazi wake: Kungokuba abantu besiza kum ukuza kubuza kutixo.
Xeshekweni banendawo, bayeza kum; nditi mna ndigwebe pakati kwomnye nomnye, ndibazise imimiso katixo nemiteto yake.
Waza wati usomfazi ka‐Mosesi kuye: Ayilungile lonto uyenzayo wena.
Uya kusinyeka ngenyaniso, kwa wena nababantu abanawe: ngokuba lendawo ikusinda; akungeyenze ngokwako wedwa.
Kaupulapule ilizwi lam; ndokunika icebo, waye utixo eya kuba nawe. Yiba wena ngenxa yabantu pambi kwotixo, ukuba uzise indawo kutixo:
uze ubafundise imimiso nemiteto, ubazise indlela abaya kuhamba ngayo, nomsebenzi abaya kuwenza.

Kanjako uya kufuna kubo bonke abantu amadoda omeleleyo, amoyikayo utixo, amadoda enyaniso, ayitiyayo inzuzo ekohlakeleyo; uwabeke pezu kwabo, abe ngabapati bamawaka, n abapati bamakulu, n abapati bamashumi mahlanu, nabapati bamashumi manye;
baze bagwebe ebantwini ngamaxesha onke; kwaye kuya kuti, zonke indawo ezinkulu bozizisa kuwe, kodwa zonke indawo ezincinane mabazigwebe bona; kuze kube lula kuwe, bakutwalise nabo.
Ukuba lento uyayenza, nokuba utixo uyakuyalela njalo, woba nako ukunyamezela; kanjalo nababantu bonke boya endaweni yabo ngoxolo.
Waye u‐Mosesi epulapula ilizwi losomfazi wake, wakwenza konke abetshilo kona.
Waza u‐Mosesi wanyula amadoda omeleleyo kubo bonke o‐Sirayeli, wawenza intloko pezu kwabantu, abapati bamawaka, n abapati bamakulu, n abapati bamashumi mahlanu, nabapati bamashumi manye;
ababegweba ebantwini ngamaxesha onke; indawo ezinqabileyo bazizisa kuye u‐Mosesi, kodwa zonke indawo ezincinane bazigweba bona.
Waza u‐Mosesi wandulula usomfazi wake; waya yena elizweni lakowabo.
EKUTWASENI kwenyanga yesitatu emveni kwokupuma kwalo usapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni le‐Jipete, kwa ngalomini lwafika entlango ye‐Sinai.
Ngokuba belundulukile e‐Refidime, lwafika entlango ye‐Sinai, lwati waca entlango; kwa lapo ke bati waca o‐Sirayeli ngapambi kwentaba.
Wasuka u‐Mosesi wenyukela kutixo; waza uyehova wambiza esentabeni, esiti: Uya kutsho kwindlu ka‐Yakobi, uxele elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, ukuti:
Nibonile oko ndakwenzayo kuma‐Jipete, nokokuba ndanitwala emapikweni okozi, ndanizisa kwa kum.
Ngako kaloku, ukuba niya kukutala ukuliva ilizwi lam, nilugcine ucebano lwam, noba yinto enqabileyo kum pezu kwazo zonke intlanga; ngokuba wonke umhlaba ungowam:
naniya kuba bubukumkani babaperisite kum, nesizwe esingcwele. Ngawo la amazwi oya kuteta wona elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli.
Waselesiza u‐Mosesi wabiza abadala babantu, wabeka ebusweni babo onke lamazwi wabemyalela wona uyehova.
Bapendula bonke abantu kwa kunye, bati: Konke akutetileyo uyehova siya kukwenza. Waza u‐Mosesi wawabuyisela kuyehova amazwi abantu.

Wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Bona ke, ndiyeza kuwe elifini elibungqingqwa, ngenxa yokuba abantu beve ndakuteta nawe, nokuba bakolwe nguwe kude kube ngunapakade. Waye u‐Mosesi waxela amazwi abantu kuyehova.
Wati uyehova kanjalo ku‐Mosesi: Yiya ebantwini, ubangcwalise namhla nangomso; mabahlanze ingubo zabo kanjalo;
baze babe sebelungile ngemini yesitatu: ngokuba ngemini yesitatu eya kuhla uyehova pambi kwamehlo abantu bonke, pezu kwentaba ye‐Sinai.
Wauya kumisela abantu imida ngokungqonga, usiti: Zilumkeleni, ize ningenyukeli entabeni, ningacukumisi nodini lwayo: osukuba ecukumisa intaba, uya kubujiswa ngenyaniso;
akuyi kuyicukumisa isandla, koko aya kugityiselwa ngamatye, umhlaumbi uya kuhlatywa; nokuba sisilo, nokuba yindoda, ayiyi kupila. Nxa ixilongo lihlokomayo, baya kunyuka beze entabeni.
Waza u‐Mosesi wehla entabeni waya ebantwini, wabangcwalisa abantu; baza bahlanza ingubo zabo.
Wayesiti ebantwini: Yibani nilungile ngemini yesitatu; ningasondeli emfazini.
Kwaza kwati ngemini yesitatu, kwakusa, kwabako indudumo nemibane, nelifu elinzima pezu kwentaba, nentlokoma yexilongo inamandla kakulu; bada bangcangcazela bonke abantu ababesemnqubeni.
Wandula u‐Mosesi wapuma nabantu emnqubeni, ukuya kuhlangana notixo; baya bema emazantsi entaba.
Yaza intaba ye‐Sinai yaquma umsi yonke, ngokokuba uyehova ebesihla pezu kwayo emlilweni: kanjalo umsi wayo wenyuka njengomsi wesidlangalala, yangcangcazela kakulu intaba yonke.
Kwati yakumana ukwanda ngamandla ngakumbi intlokoma yexilongo, kwateta u‐Mosesi; waye utixo wampendula ngelizwi.
Wehla uyehova pezu kwentaba ye‐Sinai, kwa sengcopo yentaba: wandula uyehova wambiza u‐Mosesi enyukele engcopo yentaba; wenyuka ke u‐Mosesi.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Yihla, yala abantu, hleze batyobozele kuyehova ukuza kubonela, kwenzakale kubo into eninzi.
Kanjalo nabaperisite, abasondelayo kuyehova, mabazingcwalise, hleze uyehova agaleleke pezu kwabo.
Waza u‐Mosesi wati kuyehova: Abantu bakohliwe kukunyukela entabeni ye‐Sinai; ngokuba wena usiyalile, usiti: Misela intaba imida, uyingcwalise.
Koko uyehova wati kuye: Hamba, uhle, ubuye unyuke, wena no‐Arone kunye nawe; kodwa abaperisite nabantu mabangatyobozeli ukuza kunyukela kuyehova, hleze agaleleke pezu kwabo.
Wandul’ ukuhla u‐Mosesi waya ebantwini, watsho kubo.
WAZA utixo wateta onke lamazwi, esiti:
Mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wako, okukupileyo elizweni le‐Jipete, endlwini yobukoboka.
Akuyi kuba nabo otixo bambi ngapandle kwam.
Akuyi kuzenzela umfanekiso oqingqiweyo, nanye into efana nesezulwini pezulu, nesemhlabeni pantsi apa, nesemanzini pantsi kwomhlaba:

akuyi kutoba pambi kwazo; akuyi kuzikonza kanjalo: ngokuba mna Yehova, utixo wako, ndi ngutixo onekwele, ndiyohlwayela inkohlakalo yoyise pezu kwabantwana, pezu kwesesitatu napezu kwesesine isizukulwana sabanditiyayo;
ndiwenzela ububele amawaka abanditandayo nabayigcinayo imiyalelo yam.
Akuyi kufumana ulibize igama likayehova, utixo wako: ngokuba uyehova engayi kumyeka angabi natyala lowo ufumana elibiza igama lake.
Kumbula umhla we‐Sabata, ukuba uwenze ngcwele.
Wosebenza imihla ibe mitandatu, uwenze wonke umsebenzi wako;

kodwa umhla wesixe̔nxe uyi‐Sabata kayehova, utixo wako; akuyi kwenza namnye umsebenzi ngawo, kwa wena, nonyana wako, nentombi yako, n esicaka sako, nesicakakazi sako, nenkomo zako, nowasemzini wako opakati kwamasango ako:
ngokuba ngemihla mitandatu wenza uyehova izulu nomhlaba, n olwandle, nako konke okukuzo, waza wapumla ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ngoko wawutamsanqelisa uyehova umhla wesixe̔nxe, wawenza ngcwele.
Beka uyihlo nonyoko, ukuze imihla yako yolulwe elizweni ulipiweyo nguyehova, utixo wako.
Akuyi kubulala.
Akuyi kuṙexeza.
Akuyi kuba̔.
Akuyi kunqi̔na ubunqi̔na’obubuxoki ngakuye ummelwane wako.
Akuyi kunqwenela indlu yommelwane wako, akuyi kunqwenela umfazi wommelwane wako, nesicaka sake, nesicakakazi sake, nenkabi yake, neqwaṙashe lake, nanye into eyeyommelwane wako.
BAYE abantu bonke babona indudumo, nemibane, nentlokoma yexilongo, nentaba iquma: baza abantu bakubona, bahlehla, bema kude;
bati ku‐Mosesi: Teta wena nati, sasiya kuva; kodwa makangateti nati utixo, hleze sife.
Waza u‐Mosesi wati ebantwini: Ningoyiki; ngokuba uyehova eze ukuba anilinge, nokuba kubeko ukwoyikwa kwake ngasebusweni benu, ukuze ningoni.
Kekaloku abantu bema kude; kodwa u‐Mosesi wasondela esitokotokweni, apo wayekona utixo.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Wotsho elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli ukuti: Nibonile ukuba ndibe nditeta nani ndisezulwini.
Aniyi kwenza ndawonye nam otixo besilivere, kanjako aniyi kuzenzela otixo begolide.

Uya kundenzela isibingelo somhlaba, uze ubinge pezu kwaso amadini ako okutshiswa, neminikelo yako yoxolo, igusha zako, nenkabi zako: kuzo zonke indawo endiya kulenza igama lam likankanywe kona, ndoza kuwe, ndikutamsanqele.
Naxeshekweni uya kundenzela isibingelo samatye, akuyi kusaka ngalawo abaziweyo; nxa upakamisayo pezu kwaso intsimbi yako, seuya kusinco̔lisa.
Kanjalo akuyi kukwela ngezinyukelo ngapezu kwesibingelo sam, ukuba kungatyileki ubuzé bako pezu kwaso.
Kekaloku zizo ezi izigwebo oya kuzibeka pambi kwabo.
Nxa utengayo isicaka esingum‐Hebere, siya kukonza iminyaka ibe mitandatu; kodwa ngowesixe̔nxe sopuma sikululekile ngesisa.
Ukuba seza ngesiqu saso, sopuma ngesiqu saso; ukuba besiyindoda enomfazi, uya kupuma umfazi waso kwa naso.
Ukuba inkosi yaso isinikile umfazi, osizalele onyana, umhlaumbi intombi, umfazi lowo nabantwana bake boba ngabenkosi yake, sipume sona ngesiqu saso.
Kodwa ukuba isicaka eso soqinisa ukuti: Ndiyatanda inkosi yam, n omfazi wam, nabantwana bam, andiyi kupuma ndikululekile;
yoti inkosi yaso isisondeze kubagwebi; ibuye isisondeze naselucangweni, umhlaumbi emgubasini; ize inkosi yaso icumbuze indlebe yaso ngenyatyowa, sasiya kuyikonza kude kube ngunapakade.
Naxeshekweni umntu atengisa ngayo intombi yake ibe sisicakakazi, asiyi kupuma sona njengokupuma kwezicaka ezingamadoda.
Ukuba siba sibi emehlweni enkosi yaso, esixamele yona, iya kwandula isikululise: ayiyi kuba nagunya okusitengisa ebantwini basemzini, ngokuba isipete ngenkohliso.
Nokuba isixamele unyana wayo, iya kusenzela njengesiko lentombi.
Ukuba iyamtabatela omnye umfazi, ayiyi kuncipisa ukutya kwaso, nesivato saso, nebango laso lokutshata.
Nokuba ayisenzeli ezi zinto zontatu, siya kupuma ngesisa, kungeko imali.
Obetayo umntu, ade afe, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Kanti lowo ongamlalelanga, koko utixo emyekelele esandleni sake, ndokumisela indawo apo aya kusabela kona.
Kodwa xeshekweni umntu enza ngenkani ngakuye ummelwane wake, ukuba ambulale ngobuqinga, uya kumsusa esibingelweni sam, aze afe.
Nobetayo uyise, umhlaumbi unina, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Kanjalo oba̔yo umntu, nokuba uyatengisa ngaye, nokuba uyafunyanwa esandleni sake, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Notukayo uyise, umhlaumbi unina, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Naxeshekweni amadoda apikisana, ize enye ibete enye ngelitye, umhlaumbi ngesandla esifunjatiweyo, iti ke yona ingafi, koko ilele pezu kwomandlalo:
ukuba iyabuya ivuke, ihambe pandle ngomsimelelo wayo, ayiyi kuba natyala leyo eyayibetayo; kupela iya kuhlaulela ixesha lokupumla kwayo, yenze nokuba igqibele ukupoliswa.
Nxa, kanjalo, umntu abeta isicaka sake, umhlaumbi isicakakazi sake, ngentonga, side sife ngapantsi kwesandla sake, kwopindezelwa ke ngenyaniso.
Kodwa ukuba sisahlala umhla mnye, umhlaumbi imihla mibini, akuyi kupindezelwa; ngokuba siyimali yake sona.

Xeshekweni amadoda angxolisana, asunduze umfazi omitiyo, size sipume isisu sake, koko kungeko kwenzakala, uya kuhlauliswa ngenyaniso owenje njalo, njengokuba iya kubeka pezu kwake indoda yalomfazi; uya kuhlaula pambi kwabagwebi.
Kodwa ukuba kuko ukwenzakala, uya kwandul’ ukunika ubomi ngenxa yobomi,
iliso ngenxa yeliso, izinyo ngenxa yezinyo, isandla ngenxa yesandla, unyawo ngenxa yonyawo,
isitshiswa ngenxa yesitshiswa, inxeba ngenxa yenxeba, umvimbo ngenxa yomvimbo.
Naxeshekweni umntu abeta iliso lesicaka sake, umhlaumbi iliso lesicakakazi sake, alitshabalalise, uya kusindulula sikululekile ngenxa yeliso laso.
Kanjalo ukuba uyawisa izinyo lesicaka sake, umhlaumbi izinyo lesicakakazi sake, uya kusindulula sikululekile ngenxa yezinyo laso.
Xeshekweni inkabi inqubayo indoda, umhlaumbi inkazana, ide ife, inkabi leyo yogityiselwa ngamatye ngenyaniso, nenyama yayo ayiyi kudliwa; kanti umnini wenkabi akayi kuba natyala.

Kodwa ukuba inkabi ibiyenqubayo ngexesha lapambili, nokuba kunqi̔nelwe umniniyo, kanti akayigcinanga noko, yaza yafisa indoda, umhlaumbi inkazana, inkabi leyo yogityiselwa ngamatye, nomniniyo uya kufiswa naye.
Ukuba ubekelwe intlaulo, uya kunikela inkululwa yobomi bake njengokubekiweyo pezu kwake.
Nokuba inqubile unyana, nokuba inqubile intombi, kuya kwenziwa kuye njengalomgwebo.
Ukuba inkabi iya kunquba isicaka, umhlaumbi isicakakazi, uya kunika inkosi yaso ishekele zesilivere zibe ngamashumi matatu, nenkabi iya kugityiselwa ngamatye.
Kanjalo xeshekweni umntu aya kuvumbulula umnxuma, umhlaumbi xeshekweni umntu aya kumba umnxuma, kanti akawugubungeli, ize yeyele kona inkabi, umhlaumbi iqwaṙashe;
umnini womnxuma uya kubuyekeza, anike imali kumniniyo; kanti into efileyo yoba yeyake.
Naxeshekweni inkabi yomnye umntu ihlabayo inkabi yomnye, ide ife, baya kutengisa ngayo inkabi epilileyo, baqingatise imali yayo; nefileyo baya kuqingatisa yona nayo.
Ukuba kodwa kuyaziwa ukuba lonkabi ibiyenqubayo ngexesha lapambili, nokuba umniniyo akayigcinanga noko, uya kubuyekeza inkabi ngenxa yenkabi; kanti efileyo yoba yeyake.
Xeshekweni umntu eba̔yo inkabi, umhlaumbi igusha, aze ayixe̔le, umhlaumbi atengise ngayo, uya kubuyekeza inkomo zibe ntlanu ngenxa yenkabi nye, negusha zibe ne ngenxa yegusha nye.
Ukuba isela liyafunyanwa ekugqobozeni, lize libetwe lide life, akayi kuba natyala legazi obelibeta.
Ukuba lipumile ilanga pezu kwalo, woba netyala legazi olibetayo; logqibela ukubuyekeza; ukuba alinanto, kwotengiswa ngalo ngenxa yokuba̔ kwalo.
Ukuba iyafunyanwa ngenyaniso esandleni salo into ebi̔weyo ipilile, nokuba yinkabi, nokuba liqwaṙashe, nokuba yigusha, lobuyekeza ngokupindiweyo.

Xeshekweni umntu aya kwenza intsimi idliwe, umhlaumbi sisitiya semiti yeveyine, aqu̔bele kona inkomo zake, zize zidle entsimini yomnye umntu; uya kubuyekeza kwa ngokulungileyo kweyake intsimi, nangokulungileyo kwesake isitiya semiti yeveyine.
Xeshekweni upuma umlilo, ufumane ameva, kuze kugqityelwe izita zenqolowa, umhlaumbi yileyo isemiyo, umhlaumbi yintsimi; lowo upembileyo umlilo wobuyekeza ngenyaniso.
Xeshekweni umntu anikela kummelwane wake imali, umhlaumbi impahla, ukuba igcinwe, ize ibi̔we endlwini yalomntu; ukuba liyafunyanwa isela, liya kubuyekeza ngokupindiweyo.
Ukuba alifunyanwa isela, umnini walondlu uya kusondezwa kubagwebi, abuzwe ukuba akolulanga isandla sake ngakuyo impahla yommelwane wake kusinina.

Pezu kwendawo zonke zokwona, pezu kwenkabi, pezu kweqwaṙashe, pezu kwegusha, pezu kwengubo, pezu kwako konke okulahlekileyo, atshoyo omnye ngako ukuba kokwake, indawo yabo bobabini yoza pambi kwabagwebi; ati lowo abagwebi baya kumgweba, abuyekeze ngokupindiweyo kummelwane wake.
Xeshekweni umntu anikela kummelwane wake iqwaṙashe, umhlaumbi inkabi, umhlaumbi igusha, umhlaumbi esinye isilo, ukuba sigcinwe, size sife, umhlaumbi sapulwe, umhlaumbi sitinjwe, kungeko obonayo;
isifungo sikayehova soba pakati kwabo bobabini, sokuba akolulanga isandla sake ngakuyo impahla yommelwane wake; andule umniniso asamkele, angabuyekezi.
Kanti ukuba sibi̔we kanye kuye, wobuyekeza kumniniso.
Ukuba siqwengiwe kanye, makasizise sibe linqi̔na: akayi kubuyekezela okuqwengiweyo.
Kanjalo xeshekweni umntu aboleka into kummelwane wake, ize yapulwe, umhlaumbi ife, umniniyo engeko nayo, wobuyekeza ngenyaniso.
Ukuba umniniyo uko nayo, akayi kubuyekeza: ukuba iyinto eqeshiweyo, yeza ngenxa yomvuzo wayo.
Nxa indoda ihendayo intombi engaxanyiweyo, ide ilale nayo, yosel’ iyilobolela ukuba ibe ngumfazi wayo.
Ukuba uyise uyala kanye ukuyinika kuyo, yor̔ola imali njengekazi lentombi.
Akuyi kuvuma isanusekazi sipile.
Osukuba elala nesilo uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Obingela otixo bambi, ngapandle kwake uyehova yedwa, wolahlelwa ekutshabalaleni.
Akuyi kumkataza owasemzini, akuyi kumucinezela kanjako; ngokuba nibe ningabasemzini ezweni le‐Jipete.
Aniyi kubandezela namnye umhlolokazi nenkedama.
Ukuba uka ubabandezele, nokuba baka bakale kum, ndiya kukuva ngenyaniso ukukala kwabo;
yandule ivute ingqumbo yam, ndize ndinibulale nina ngesiṙele; bati abafazi benu babe ngabahlolokazi, nabantwana benu babe zinkedama.
Ukuba uyaboleka omnye wabantu bam olihlwempu ngakuwe imali, akuyi kuba kuye njengomboleki obang’ inzuzo; akuyi kubeka pezu kwake inzuzo enkulu.
Ukuba uka utabate ingubo yommelwane wako ibe ngumbambiso, woyibuyisela kuye lingekatshoni ilanga:
ngokuba yona isisigubungelo sake yodwa; iyingubo yake pezu kwentlonze yake: ebeya kulala nganto nina? kwakuya kuti, nxa akala kum, ndandule ukuva: ngokuba ndinofefe mna.
Utixo akuyi kumtuka, nenkosi pezu kwabantu bako akuyi kuyiqalekisa.
Ulibo lwenqolowa yako nolweveyine yako ungalibali ukunikela ngalo: owamazibulo konyana bako uya kumnika kum.
Uya kwenje njalo ngenkomo zako na ngegusha zako; zoba nonina imihla ibe sixe̔nxe; ngomhla wesibozo uya kuzinika kum.
Naniya kuba ngabantu abangcwele kum: kanjako inyama eqwengiweyo ezindle aniyi kuyidla; yona niya kuyiposa ezinjeni.
Akuyi kutabata iṙeto elibuxoki: isandla sako ungasibekani nokohlakeleyo ukuba linqi̔na lobudlwengu.
Akuyi kulandela abaninzi ng okwenza okubi; kanjalo akuyi kuteta elupikisweni ngokupambukela emva kwabaninzi ukutyekisa ugwebo:
nolihlwempu akuyi kumbuka elupikisweni lwake.
Nxa ufumanana nenkabi yotshaba lwako, umhlaumbi neqwaṙashe lalo lilahleka, wolibuyisela kulo ngenyaniso.
Nxa ulibona iqwaṙashe lokutiyayo lilele ngapantsi kwomtwalo walo, uya kulandula ukumkululela na? wokulula ngenyaniso kunye naye.
Akuyi kutyekisa ibango lehlwempu lako elupikisweni lwalo.
Kwelela kude emcimbini wobuxoki; kanjalo ongenatyala nolungileyo ungababulali: ngokuba ndingayi kugwebela okohlakeleyo.
Nebaso akuyi kulamkela; ngokuba ibaso limfamekisa abanokubona, lijikise amazwi abalungileyo.
Nowasemzini akuyi kumncinezela; ngokuba nina niwazi umpefumlo wowasemzini, ekokubeni nibe ningabasemzini ezweni le‐Jipete.
Yiminyaka mitandatu uya kuhlwayela umhlaba wako, ubute ukuvelisa kwawo;

kodwa ngowesixe̔nxe uya kuwupumza, uwuyeke; ukuba amahlwempu abantu bako adle, nokushiyiweyo ngawo zikudle izilo zasendle: uya kwenje njalo ngesitiya sako semiti yeveyine, na ngesitiya sako seminquma.
Yimihla mitandatu uya kwenza umsebenzi wako, kodwa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe uya kupumla; ukuba kupumle inkabi yako neqwaṙashe lako, nokuba ati pefu unyana wesicakakazi sako, nowasemzini.
Ngako konke endikutshilo kuni zilumkeleni: negama lotixo bambi ningalikankanyi; malingaviwa emlonyeni wako.
Ngamaxesha matatu uya kundenzela umtendeleko emnyakeni mnye.

Umtendeleko wezonka ezingenagwele wowubamba: (wodla izonka ezingenagwele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe, njengokuba ndikuyalele, ngelimisiweyo ixesha lenyanga engu‐Abibe; ngokuba ngayo ubupuma e‐Jipete: kanjalo mabangabonakali pambi kwam bengenanto:)
nomtendeleko wokuvuna, wolibo lwokwemisebenzi yako, oko ukuhlwayeleyo entsimini: nomtendeleko wokubuta, ngasekupeleni kwomnyaka, nxa ubutileyo okwemisebenzi yako entsimini.
Kwoba ngamaxesha matatu emnyakeni mnye onke amadoda ako aya kubonakala ebusweni benkosi uyehova.
Akuyi kunikela igazi lombingo wam ndawonye n esonka esibiliswayo; kanjako inqata lombinge womtendeleko wam aliyi kuhlala kude kuse.
Isiqalo selibo zomhlaba wako uya kusingenisa endlwini kayehova, utixo wako. Musa ukupeka itakane lebokwe elubisini lwonina.
BONA ke, ndituma ingelosi pambi kwako, ukuya kukugcina endleleni nokukuzisa kulondawo endiyilungisileyo.
Lumkela yona, ulive ilizwi layo, ungayicapukisi; ngokuba ingayi kuxolela izigqito zenu; ngokuba igama lam likuyo.
Kodwa ukuba uya kukutala ukuliva ilizwi layo, wenze konke endikutetayo, ndiya kwandula ndibe lutshaba ezintshabeni zako, nomalane kubalane bako.
Ngokuba ingelosi yam iya kuhamba ebusweni bako, ikungenise kuba‐Amori, nama‐Hete, nama‐Perizi, naba‐Kanane, n ama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi; ndandiya kubatshabalalisa.
Musa ukutoba pambi kwotixo babo, ungabakonzi nokubakonza; kanjalo akuyi kwenza ngemisebenzi yabo: koko uya kubacita kanye, ugqibele ukuziqekeza izifanekiso zabo.
Naniya kumkonza uyehova, utixo wenu, oya kutamsanqelisa isonka sako namanzi ako; ndandiya kususa isifo pakati kwenu.
Akuyi kubako osisu sipumayo nodlolileyo ezweni lenu: inani lemihla yako ndolizalisa.
Isoyikiso sam ndosituma pambi kwako, ndize ndipitizelise bonke abantu eniya kufika kubo; ndandiya kwenza zonke intshaba zako zikujikele umhlana.
Kanjako ndiya kutuma onomeva pambi kwako, abaya kugxota ama‐Hivi, n aba‐Kanane, nama‐Hete, kwa sebusweni bako.
Andiyi kubagxota pambi kwako emnyakeni mnye, hleze ilizwe libe bugxwayiba, namaṙamncwa asendle andiswe ngakuwe.
Ngento encinane nangento encinane ndiya kubagxota ebusweni bako, ude ucume, ulifuye ilizwe.

Ndandiya kubeka imida yako kwa selwandle olubomvu kude kube selwandle lwama‐Filistiya, nasentlango kude kube kuwo umlambo: ngokuba abemi belozwe ndiya kubanikela esandleni sako, uze ubagxote ebusweni bako.
Akuyi kwenza ucebano kunye nabo, nakunye notixo babo.
Abayi kuhlala elizweni lako, hleze bakwenze wone kum: ukuba uyakonza otixo babo, kwoba ngumgibe kuwe ngenyaniso.
WAZA wati ku‐Mosesi: Nyukela kuyehova, wena no‐Arone, u‐Nadabi no‐Abihu, namashumi asixe̔nxe kubadala bo‐Sirayeli; nize nibedeshe nikude.
Makasondele u‐Mosesi yedwa kuyehova; bona kanti mabangasondeli; nabantu mabangenyuki naye.
Weza u‐Mosesi wabalisela abantu onke amazwi kayehova, nazo zonke izigwebo: baza bapendula bonke abantu ngelizwi linye, bati: Onke amazwi awatetileyo uyehova siya kuwenza.
Waye u‐Mosesi waoa̔la onke amazwi kayehova, wavuka kwa kusasa, waka isibingelo ezantsi kwentaba, neshumi elinambini lentsika zamatye, njengezilishumi linazibini izizwe zo‐Sirayeli.
Watuma amadodana aselusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, awanikelayo amadini okutshiswa, abingela uyehova nemibingo yoxolo ngenkatyana.
Waza u‐Mosesi watabata esinye isiqingata segazi, walibeka ezityeni; n esinye isiqingata segazi, walitshiza pezu kwesibingelo.
Watabata nencwadi yocebano, walesesha ezindlebeni zabantu; abati: Konke akutetileyo uyehova siya kukwenza, sive nokuva.
Waza u‐Mosesi watabata igazi elo, walitshiza pezu kwabantu, wati: Nali igazi locebano uyehova alwenzileyo nani ngawo onke lamazwi.
Bandula benyuka u‐Mosesi no‐Arone, u‐Nadabi no‐Abihu, namashumi asixe̔nxe kubadala bo‐Sirayeli.
Baye bebona utixo wo‐Sirayeli: nangapantsi kwenyawo zake beku njengesetyenzwa lesafire ebengezelayo, nanjengesibili sezulu ngokukazimla.
Koko engolulanga isandla sake ngakuwo amaduna osapo luka‐Sirayeli; kodwa abona utixo, adla asela nokusela.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Nyukela kum entabeni, ube kona apo; ndandiya kukunika amacwecwe amatye, nomteto, nemiyalelo endiyiba̔lileyo, ukuba bafundiswe.
Wesuka ke u‐Mosesi, no‐Yoshuwa umkonzi wake; waza u‐Mosesi wenyukela entabeni katixo.
Wayesiti kubadala: Silindeni apa, side sibuye size kuni: kanjalo naba u‐Arone no‐Hure benani; osukuba enendawo yokumangalela, makasondele kubo.
Waza u‐Mosesi wenyukela entabeni, lati ilifu lagubungela intaba.
Kanjalo ubungcwalisa bukayehova bahlala pezu kwentaba ye‐Sinai, nelifu layigubungela intsuku zantandatu; waza ngolwesixe̔nxe usuku wambiza u‐Mosesi kwa pakati kwelifu.
(Kekaloku ukubonakala kwobungewalisa bukayehova kwakunjengomlilo odlayo, engcotsheni yentaba, emehlweni osapo luka‐Sirayeli.)
Wasuka u‐Mosesi wangena pakati kwelifu, wenyukela entabeni: waye u‐Mosesi wasentabeni imini zamashumi mane nobusuku bamashumi mane.
WAZA uyehova wateta ku‐Mosesi esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba lunditabatele umnikelo: kubo bonke abantu abantliziyo zibaqu̔bayo, niya kuwamkela umnikelo wam.
Nguwo lo umnikelo eniya kuwamkela kubo: igolide, nesilivere, nexina,
nezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, neqiya eshiceneyo, n oboya bebokwe,
nezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nezintsu zamacelesi, nemiti yeshitime;
ioli, ibe yeyesikanyiso; izimnandi, zibe zezeoli yokutambisa, nezesiqumiso esimnandi;
amatye eshohame, namatye okufakwa, aweyefodi nawembeka.
Kanjalo mabandenzele indawo eyingcwele, ndize ndihlale pakati kwabo.
Njengako konke ndikubonisa kona, njengawo umfanekiselo wetabanakele, nomfanekiselo wazo zonke impahla zayo, niya kuyenza kwa ngokunjalo.

Babeya kuyenza ityeya ngemiti yeshitime: yoba zikubite zibe mbini nesiqingata sekubite ubude bayo, nekubite ibe nye nesiqingata sekubite ububanzi bayo, nekubite ibe nye nesiqingata sekubite ubupakamo bayo.
Wauya kuyaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo, ngapakati nangapandle uya kuyaleka; uze wenze pezu kwayo isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Woyityityishela yona imisesane yegolide ibe mine, uyibeke emagumbini ayo omane, ize ibeko imisesane mibini ngelinye icala layo, nemisesane ekwa mibini ngelinye icala layo.
Wauya kuzenza izibonda ngemiti yeshitime, uzaleke ngegolide.
Nezibonda ezo uya kuzingenisa kuyo imisesane esemacaleni etyeya, ize ityeya itwalwe ngazo.
Zoba semisesaneni yetyeya ezozibonda; aziyi kususwa kuyo.
Wauya kubeka etyeyeni isinqi̔no endiya kusinika kuwe.
Kanjalo uya kusenza isihlalo sofefe ngegolide ecocekileyo: soba zikubite zibe mbini nesiqingata sekubite ubude baso, nekubite ibe nye nesiqingata sekubite ububanzi baso.
Uya kuzenza nekerubime zibe mbini ngegolide; ngesetyenzwa elikandelweyo uya kuzenza, zipuma ezincameni zombini zesihlalo sofefe.
Yenza ikerubime enye encameni yakweli icala, nekerubime enye encameni yakweliya icala; zipuma kuso isihlalo sofefe uya kuzenza ikerubime, ezincameni zaso zombini.
Zoti ikerubime zitwabulule amapiko omabini ngapezulu, zisigubungela ngamapiko azo isihlalo sofefe; nobuso bazo obenye bobekana nobenye; boba ngakuso isihlalo sofefe ubuso bekerubime.
Nesihlalo sofefe uya kusibeka pezulu pezu kwetyeya; nakuyo ityeya uya kubeka isinqi̔no endiya kusinika kuwe.

Ndandiya kuhlangana nawe kona apo, nditete nawe ndipezu kwaso isihlalo sofefe, kwa pakati kwazo ikerubime zombini ezingapezu kwetyeya yesinqi̔no, ngako konke endokuyalezela kona elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli.
Kanjalo uya kuyenza itafile ngemiti yeshitime: yoba zikubite zibe mbini ubude bayo, nekubite ibe nye ububanzi bayo, nekubite ibe nye nesiqingata sekubite ubupakamo bayo.
Wauya kuyaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo; uze uyenzele isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Uya kuyenzela nodini, lungangobubanzi besandla, ngento engqongayo; uze wenzele udini lwayo isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Wauya kuyenzela yona imisesane yegolide ibe mine, uyibeke imisesane emagumbini omane asezinyaweni zayo zone.
Yoba malungana nodini imisesane leyo, ibe zindawo zezibonda zokuba kutwalwe itafile.
Izibonda ezo uya kuzenza ngemiti yeshitime, uzaleke ngegolide, ize itafile itwalwe ngazo.
Wauya kwenza izikotile zayo, nezitya zayo, nebekile zayo, nendebe zayo, ekuya kugalelwa ngazo: uya kuzenza ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Napezu kwetafile leyo uya kubeka izonka zokubonakala ebusweni bam ngamaxesha onke.

Kanjalo uya kuyenza ikandelare ngegolide ecocekileyo: ngesetyenzwa elikandelweyo iya kwenziwa lekandelare; isikondo sayo, nexokama layo, indetyana zayo, izikandana zayo, nentyatyambo zayo, zoba zezakuyo.
Imbaxa ezintandatu ziya kupuma emacaleni ayo; kwopuma imbaxa ezintatu zekandelare kwelinye icala layo, nembaxa ezintatu zekandelare kwelinye icala layo.

Indetyana ezintatu zifanisiwe nezamonde zoba kwenye imbaxa, kwa n esikandana nentyatyambo; nendetyana ezintatu zifanisiwe nezamonde zoba nakwenye imbaxa, kwa n esikandana nentyatyambo; zoba kwa njalo imbaxa zontandatu ezipuma ekandelareni.
Nakuyo ikandelare kwobako indetyana ezine zifanisiwe nezamonde, kunye nezikandana zazo, nentyatyambo zazo.

Kwobako esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, n esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, n esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, njengazo imbaxa zontandatu ezipuma ekandelareni.
Izikandana zazo nembaxa zazo zoba zezakuyo: loba linye isetyenzwa elikandelweyo legolide ecocekileyo lipela.
Wauya kuyenzela izibane zibe sixe̔nxe; zaziya kumiswa izibane zayo, zize zikanyise ngapambi kwayo.
Izicimo zayo, nezipatelo zayo, zoba yigolide ecocekileyo.
Iya kwenziwa yona ngetalente yegolide ecocekileyo, kunye nazo zonke ezimpahla.
Uze ulumke ukuba uzenze ngomfanekiselo wazo, obuwuboniswa entabeni.
Kanjako itabanakele uya kuyenza ngeshumi lezikuselo zepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, nezuluṙa nesimnyama, nesibomvu; uya kuzenza zinekerubime, ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka.
Ubude baso isikuselo sinye boba zikubite zimashumi mabini anesibozo, nobubanzi baso isikuselo sinye boba zikubite zine; zonke ezizikuselo zoba nomlinganiswa mnye.
Esinye isihlanu sezikuselo sobandakanyiswa esinye kwesinye; n esinye isihlanu sezikuselo sobandakanyiswa esinye kwesinye.
Wauya kwenza amasango ezuluṙa ngasempetweni wesinye isikuselo, ngasencameni, esibandakanyelweni; uya kwenje njalo nasempetweni wapandle wesikuselo, ekubandakanyweni kwesesibini.
Wowenza amasango abe ngamashumi mahlanu kwesinye isikuselo, namasango akwa ngamashumi mahlanu uya kuwenza encameni yesikuselo esisekubandakanyweni kwesesibini: lamasango olungelelana elinye nelinye.
Wowenza namakonxo egolide abe ngamashumi mahlanu, uze ubandakanyise izikuselo, esinye kwesinye, ngamakonxo lawo, ize ibe yitabanakele inye.
Kanjalo uya kuzenza izikuselo ngoboya bebokwe, zibe yintente pezu kwayo itabanakele: zizikuselo ezilishumi linasinye oya kuzenza.
Ubude baso isikuselo sinye boba zikubite zimashumi matatu, nobubanzi baso isikuselo sinye boba zikubite zine: ezizikuselo zolishumi linasinye zoba nomlinganiswa mnye.
Wauya kubandakanyisa izikuselo ezihlanu zizodwa, nezikuselo ezitandatu zizodwa nazo; nesesitandatu isikuselo wosipindisa ngasebusweni betabanakele.
Wowenza namasango abe ngamashumi mahlanu ngasempetweni wesinye isikuselo, wesangapandle ekubandakanyweni, namasango akwa ngamashumi mahlanu ngasempetweni wesikuselo esibandakanyana nesesibini.
Wowenza namakonxo exina abe ngamashumi mahlanu, uze ungenise amakonxo lawo emasangweni, uyibandakanyise intente, ibe inye.
Neliva eliseleyo ezikuselweni zentente, isiqingata sesikuselo esiseleyo siya kulembelela pezu kwelasemva icala letabanakele.
Yikubite ngelinye icala, nekubite kwa ngelinye, kokuseleyo ebudeni bezikuselo zentente, eya kulembelela pezu kwamacala ayo itabanakele, ngelinye icala nangelinye, ize igujungelwe.
Kanjalo woyenzela intente isigubungelo ngezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nesigubungelo esinye ngapezulu ngezintsu zamacelesi.
Kanjako woyenzela itabanakele iplanke ngemiti yeshitime, zipakama.
Boba zikubite zilishumi ubude beplanke nye, nobubanzi bayo iplanke nye yoba yikubite nesiqingata sekubite.
Iplanke nye yoba nezibambelo zizibini, zicwangcisiwe esinye silunge nesinye: uya kwenje njalo kuzo zonke iplanke zetabanakele.
Wauya kuyenzela itabanakele iplanke, zibe mashumi mabini iplanke kwelasesuyide icala ngasesuyide.

Wozenza neziseko zesilivere zingamashumi mane ngapantsi kwazo iplanke zomashumi mabini; zibe ziziseko ezibini ngapantsi kwenye iplanke kuzo izibambelo zayo zozibini, neziseko ezibini ngapantsi kwenye iplanke kuzo izibambelo zayo zozibini.
Nakwelesibini icala letabanakele, kwelasenode icala, kwobako iplanke zimashumi mabini:
kwa neziseko zazo zesilivere ezimashumi mane; iziseko ezibini zingapantsi kwenye iplanke, neziseko ezibini zingapantsi kwenye iplanke.
Necala lasemva letabanakele ngasentshonalanga wolenzela iplanke zibe ntandatu.
Neplanke ezimbini uya kuzenzela amagumbi etabanakele, ecaleni lasemva.
Zaziya kuhlanganiswa kunye ezantsi, kanjalo zohlanganiswa kunye napezulu, kuwo umsesane umnye: kwoba njalo ke kuzo zombini; zoba zezamagumbi omabini.
Zoba ziplanke zisibozo, neziseko zazo zesilivere zoba ziziseko ezilishumi linesitandatu; iziseko ezibini zingapantsi kwenye iplanke, neziseko ezibini zingapantsi kwenye iplanke.
Kanjako uya kuyenza imivalo ngemiti yeshitime; ibe mihlanu eziplankeni zelinye icala letabanakele,
nemihlanu imivalo eziplankeni zelinye icala letabanakele, nemihlanu imivalo eziplankeni zecala letabanakele, zecala lasemva ngasentshonalanga.
Nowapakati umvalo pakati kwazo iplanke, wona wodluliswa kwa kwenye incam kude kube kwenye incam.
Neplanke ezo uya kuzaleka ngegolide, nemisesane yazo uya kuyenza ngegolide ibe zindawo zemivalo: kanjako uya kuyaleka imivalo ngegolide.
Wauya kupakamisa itabanakele njengesimilo sayo obusiboniswa entabeni.
Kanjalo uya kulenza ikuselo ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo; liya kwenziwa ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka, linekerubime.
Wauya kulixo̔ma pezu kwentsika zibe ne zemiti yeshitime, zalekiwe ngegolide; amagwegwe azo oba ngawegolide; zimi pezu kweziseko zesilivere zine.
Wolixo̔ma ikuselo ezantsi kwamakonxo, uze ungenise kona pakati kwekuselo ityeya yesinqi̔no; elokuselo lonahlukanisela pakati kweyingcwele indawo neyingcwele yezingcwele.
Wauya kubeka isihlalo sofefe pezu kwetyeya yesinqi̔no, kweyingcwele yezingcwele.
Itafile woyimisa ibe ngapandle kwekuselo, nekandelare ibe malungana netafile ecaleni letabanakele ngasesuyide; kodwa itafile woyibeka ecaleni lasenode.
Kanjalo uya kwenzela ucango lwentente ilengalenga, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, isetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala.
Ilengalenga elo wolenzela intsika zibe ntlanu ngemiti yeshitime, uzaleke ngegolide; amagwegwe azo oba ngawegolide; wauya kuzityityishela iziseko zexina zibe zihlanu.
Kanjako uya kusenza isibingelo ngemiti yeshitime, sizikubite ezintlanu ubude baso, nekubite ezintlanu ububanzi baso; soba namacala mane isibingelo eso; nobupakamo baso soba zikubite ezintatu.
Impondo zaso uya kuzenza pezu kwamagumbi aso omane; zopuma kwa kuso impondo zaso; wauya kusaleka ngexina.
Uya kuzenza nembiza zaso zokususa ututu lwaso, nezikotululo zaso, nezitya zaso zokufefela, neforoke zaso, nezipatamlilo zaso: zonke impahla zaso uya kuzenza ngexina.
Wauya kusenzela iziko lesetyenzwa elilinqwanqwa ngexina; napezu kwalo inqwanqwa elo uya kuyenza imisesane emine yexina emancameni alo omane.
Uze ulibeke ngapantsi kwesazinge sesibingelo ngasezantsi, ukuba inqwanqwa lifikele kwa pakati kwesibingelo.
Uya kwenzela isibingelo nezibonda, izibonda zemiti yeshitime, uzaleke ngexina.
Ziya kungeniswa izibonda zaso kuyo imisesane, ukuze izibonda ezo zibe semacaleni omabini esibingelo sakutwalwa.
Siliholo ngeplanke uya kwenza sona: njengokuba ububoniswa entabeni, baya kwenje njalo.
Kanjako wolenza ibala letabanakele: ngecala lasesuyide ngasesuyide, ibala loba namalengalenga epotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo; boba zikubite ezilikulu ubude becala linye.
Intsika zalo ezimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo ezimashumi mabini, zoba zezexina; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo zoba zezesilivere.

Kwa njalo ngecala lasenode, ebudeni, amalengalenga oba zikubite ezilikulu ubude bawo; intsika zalo ezimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo ezimashumi mabini, zoba zezexina; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo zoba zezesilivere.
Nasebubanzini bebala, ngecala litshona ilanga, oba ngamalengalenga akubite zingamashumi mahlanu; intsika zawo zilishumi, neziseko zazo zikwa lishumi.
Kwa njalo ububanzi bebala, ngecala lipuma ilanga ngasempumalanga, boba zikubite zingamashumi mahlanu.
Amalengalenga elinye icala lesango oba zikubite zilishumi linesihlanu; intsika zawo zintatu, neziseko zazo zikwa zitatu.
Nangelinye icala amalengalenga oba zikubite zilishumi linesihlanu; intsika zawo zintatu, neziseko zazo zikwa zitatu.

Nesango lebala lona loba nelengalenga elikubite zingamashumi mabini, lezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, isetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala; intsika zawo zine, nezizeko zazo zikwa zine.
Zonke intsika ezingqongayo ibala zobandakanyiswa ngentonga zesilivere: amagwegwe azo oba ngawesilivere, kodwa iziseko zazo zoba zezexina.
Ubude bebala boba zikubite ezilikulu, nobubanzi boba zezingamashumi mahlanu indawo zonke, nobupakamo boba zikubite ezintlanu zepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo; kodwa iziseko zazo zoba zezexina.
Zonke impahla zetabanakele kuyo yonke inkonzo yayo, kwa zonke izikonkwane zayo, nazo zonke izikonkwane zebala, zoba zezexina.
Kanjalo wena uya kuyalela usapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba luyizise kuwe ioli engcwengileyo yamanquma anqushiweyo ibe yeyesikanyiso, kuze kumiswe izibane ngamaxesha onke.

Kuyo intente yentlangano, ngapandle kwekuselo, elipambi kwesinqi̔no, baya kulungisa sona u‐Arone nonyana bake, kwa sekuhlweni kude kuse, ebusweni bukayehova: woba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kwizizukulwana zabo, ngenxa yosapo luka‐Sirayeli.

UZE usondeze kuwe u‐Arone umkuluwe wako, nonyana bake kunye naye, pakati kwalo usapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba andikonze ngobuperisite; kwa u‐Arone, u‐Nadabi no‐Abihu, u‐Elezari no‐Yitamare, onyana baka‐Arone.
Wauya kumenzela u‐Arone, umkuluwe wako, izivato ezingcwele, zibe zezobungcwalisa nezobuhle.
Kanjalo uya kuteta kubo bonke abalumkileyo ngentliziyo, abo ndiwuzalisile umoya wabo ngobulumko, ukuba bazenze izivato zika‐Arone ukumngcwalisa, aze andikonze ngobuperisite.
Zizo ezi izivato baya kuzenza: yimbeka, neyefodi, nengubo, nehempe epetiweyo, unkontsho noqwemesha; izivato ezingcwele bozenzela u‐Arone, umkuluwe wako, nonyana bake, ukuze andikonze ngobuperisite.
Botabata igolide, nezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, neqiya eshiceneyo.
Babeya kuyenza iyefodi ngegolide, ngezuluṙa nesimnyama, ngesibomvu nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka.
Yoba nezibini iziziba zamagxalaba, zibandakanyiwe emancameni ayo omabini; yo wenzwa njalo ke ukubandakanyiswa.
Nombinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi yake, opezu kwayo, woba yinto yakuyo, njengesetyenzwa layo; ngegolide, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo.
Wauya kutabata amatye eshohame emabini, uwaqingqe pezu kwawo amagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli;
abe matandatu amagama abo pezu kwelinye ilitye, namagama amatandatu aseleyo pezu kwelinye ilitye, njengokuzalwa kwabo.
Ngesetyenzwa lomqingqi wamatye, njeng eziqingqwa zaso isincamatiselo, wowaqingqa lamatye omabini, enamagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli: uya kuwenza evingcelwe ezigingqini zegolide.

Woti lamatye omabini uwabeke pezu kwezamagxalaba iziziba zeyefodi, abe ngamatye okukumbuza elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli; waye u‐Arone eya kutwala amagama abo ebusweni bukayehova, pezu kwawo amagxalaba ake omabini, abe yinkumbuzo.
Wauya kuzenza izigingqi zegolide;
nemixokolelwane emibini yegolide ecocekileyo; ijijanisiwe uya kuyenza, njeng esetyenzwa elitsontelweyo; nalemixokolelwane etsontelweyo woyikonxa kuzo izigingqi.
Kanjako uya kuyenza imbeka yokugweba ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka; njengesetyenzwa leyefodi uya kuyenza; ngegolide, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, uya kuyenza yona.
Yoba namacala mane, ipindiwe; yoba sisoluko sesandla ubude bayo, nesoluko sesandla ububanzi bayo.
Wauya kufaka kuyo imfakwa zamatye, kwa inṙozo zine zamatye: olunye uṙozo lwoba yirubi, ne topaze, nekabunukele: lulo olu uṙozo lwokuqala.
Olwesibini uṙozo lwoba yisamagide, n esafire, neyahalome.
Olwesitatu uṙozo lwoba yiyasinte, n eyagate, neyametisite.
Olwesine uṙozo lwoba yikrusolite, nesadonutse, nejasipidi: oqiniswa ngegolide ezimfakweni zawo.
Amatye la oba njengamagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli, elishumi linamabini, njengawo amagama abo, njeng eziqingqwa zaso isincamatiselo; elinye ngelinye linegama lalo, oba ngawezizwe ezilishumi linazibini.
Wauya kuyenza pezu kwembeka imixokolelwane ejijanisiweyo, njeng esetyenzwa elitsontelweyo, ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Uya kuyenza kanjalo pezu kwembeka imisesane yegolide ibi mibini: wauya kubeka lemisesane mibini pezu kwazo incam ezimbini zembeka.
Uze uyifake lomibini imixokolelwane etsontelweyo yegolide kuleyomisesane mibini esezincameni zembeka.
Kodwa ezinye incam ezimbini emixokolelwane mibini etsontelweyo wozikonxa kuzo izigingqi zibini; uze ubeke zona pezu kweziziba zamagxalaba zeyefodi empambili wayo.
Wobuya uyenze imisesane mibini yegolide, uyimise ezincameni ezimbini zembeka, empetweni wayo osecaleni leyefodi ngapakati.

Ne minye imisesane mibini yegolide uya kuyenza, ubeke yona pezu kweziziba zamagxalaba zozibini zeyefodi ngasezantsi, ngasempambili wayo, malungana nokubandakanywa kwayo, ngapezulu kwombinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi.
Babeya kuyinxibelela imbeka ngemisesane yayo kuyo imisesane yeyefodi ngosinga lwezuluṙa, ukuba ibe pezulu kwawo umbinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi, nokuba imbeka ingashenxeki kuyo iyefodi.
Waye u‐Arone eya kutwala amagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli embekeni yokugweba, pezu kwentliziyo yake, akungena kweyingcwele indawo, abe yinkumbuzo pambi kwoyehova futi.

Uya kubeka kanjalo embekeni yokugweba i‐Urime ne‐Tumime, zize zibe pezu kwentliziyo ka‐Arone, akungena ebusweni bukayehova; woti u‐Arone amane akutwale okwokugweba kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli pezu kwentliziyo yake pambi kwoyehova futi.
Kanjako ingubo yaseyefodini uya kuyenza ipela ngezuluṙa.
Kwobako intunja yayo yentloko pakati kwayo; yoti l entunja yayo ibe nompeto wesetyenzwa lomluki ngento engqongayo; njengentunja yesigcinisifuba yoba nawo, ize ingaṙazuki.
Wauya kuzenza pezu kwemiqukumbelo yayo igranate zezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, kwa pezu kwemiqukumbelo yayo ngento engqongayo; nezikencezelo zegolide pakati kwazo ngento engqongayo:
sibe sisikencezelo segolide negranate, sibe sisikencezelo segolide negranate, pezu kwemiqukumbelo yengubo leyo ngento engqongayo.
Yoba pezu kwake u‐Arone ekukonzeni; ize ivakale intlokoma yayo, nxa angena kweyingcwele indawo ebusweni bukayehova, nanxa apumayo, ukuba angafi.
Kanjalo uya kuyenza imbasa ngegolide ecocekileyo, uqingqe pezu kwayo, njeng eziqingqwa zesincamatiselo, ukuti: ubungcwele kuyehova!
Uya kubopa yona ngosinga lwezuluṙa, ibe pezu kwalo unkontsho; yoba kwelapambili icala lonkontsho.

Yoba pezu kwebunzi lika‐Arone, ukuba u‐Arone abutwale ubono bezinto ezingcwele, ezo usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwozingcwalisa kuzo zonke izipo zalo ezingcwele; yomana ibako pezu kwebunzi lake ngamaxesha onke, ukuze lukoleke ebusweni bukayehova.
Kanjako uya kuluka ihempe ngeqiya eshiceneyo; nonkontsho uya kulwenza ngeqiya eshiceneyo; noqwemesha uya kulwenza ngesetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala.
Nonyana baka‐Arone uya kwenzela bona ihempe, ubenzele nengqwemesha; neminqwazi uya kuyenzela bona, ibe yeyobungcwalisa neyobuhle.
Wauya kwambatisa u‐Arone umkuluwe wako ezo nto, kwa nonyana bake kunye naye; uze ubatambise, uzalise izandla zabo, ubangcwalise nokubangcwalisa, ukuba bandikonze ngobuperisite.
Uya kubenzela nebrukwe zeqiya, kugujungelwe ubuzé babo; zoba zivela esinqeni kude kube kuwo amatanga.

Zoba pezu kwo‐Arone, napezu kwonyana bake, ekungeneni kwabo ententeni yentlangano, nasekusondeleni kwabo esibingelweni ukukonza kweyingcwele indawo; baze bangatwali ubono, bafe ke: woba ngummiselwa ongunapakade lo, kwa kuye, nakwinzalo yake emva kwake.
Yiyo lento uya kuyenza kubo ukubangcwalisa, ukuba bandikonze ngobuperisite: Tabata inkunzana ibe nye elitole lenkomo, nenkunzi zegusha zibe mbini ezimsulwa,
nesonka esingenagwele, nezonkana ezingenagwele zinyeliwe ngeoli, nezonkanyana ezingenagwele zitanjisiwe ngeoli: uya kuzenza ngomgubo ocolekileyo wenqolowa.
Wauya kuzibeka esityeni sinye, uzisondeze zisesityeni, kwa nenkunzana yenkomo, nenkunzi zegusha zombini.
Uze ubasondeze u‐Arone nonyana bake elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, ubahlambe ngamanzi.
Wauya kutabata izivato, wambatise u‐Arone ihempe; nengubo yaseyefodini, neyefodi, nembeka; uze umbinqise umbinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi.
Kanjalo uya kubeka unkontsho entloko yake, nekrone engcwele uya kuyibeka pezu kwalo unkontsho.
Wandule utabate ioli yokutambisa, uyigalele pezu kwentloko yake, umtambise.
Nonyana bake uya kubasondeza, ubavatise ihempe.
Uya kubabinqisa imibinqo, kwa u‐Arone nonyana bake, uyibope kubo iminqwazi; baze babe nabo ubuperisite ngommiselwa ongunapakade: wauya kuzalisa isandla sika‐Arone nesandla sonyana bake.
Uze uyisondeze inkunzana ngapambi kwentente yentlangano; bati u‐Arone nonyana bake balalise izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzana.
Wandule uyixe̔le inkunzana pambi kwoyehova, ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Uze ucapule egazini lenkunzana, ulibeke ezimpondweni zesibingelo ngomnwe wako; nalo lonke elinye igazi uya kuligalela ngasesekweni lesibingelo.
Wauya kutabata lonke inqata eligubungela umbilini, nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, uzitshise esibingelweni.
Kodwa inyama yenkunzana, nesikumba sayo, nomswane wayo, uya kuzitshisa ngomlilo ngapandle kwomnquba: lidini lesono yona.
Kanjalo uya kutabata enye inkunzi yegusha; boti ke u‐Arone nonyana bake balalise izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzi yegusha.
Wandule uyixe̔le inkunzi yegusha, ulitabate igazi layo, ulisasaze pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Lenkunzi yegusha uya kuyicanda ezitweni zayo, uhlambe umbilini wayo, nentungo zayo, uzibeke pezu kwezito zayo napezu kwentloko yayo.
Uze uyitshise inkunzi yegusha ipela pezu kwesibingelo: lidini lokutshiswa yona kuyehova; livumba elimnandi, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Wobuya uyitabate eyesibini inkunzi yegusha; boti ke u‐Arone nonyana bake balalise izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzi yegusha.

Wandule uyixe̔le inkunzi yegusha, ucapule egazini layo, ulibeke pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe ka‐Arone, napezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yonyana bake, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sabo, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwabo, ulisasaze igazi pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.

Uze ucapule kulo igazi elipezu kwesibingelo, nakuyo ioli yokutambisa, uti fefe pezu kwo‐Arone, napezu kwezivato zake, napezu kwonyana bake, napezu kwezivato zonyana bake kunye naye; aze enzwe ngcwele yena, nezivato zake, nonyana bake, nezivato zonyana bake kunye naye.

Wauya kutabata kuyo inkunzi yegusha inqata nomsila, nenqata eligubungela umbilini, nendawo ezizengezelayo zesibindi, nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, nowokunene umkono; ngokuba yona yinkunzi yegusha yedini lokuzalisa:
kwa nesimba linye lesonka, nesonkana sinye sesonka esineoli, nesonkanyana sinye sivela esityeni sezonka ezingenagwele, esipambi kwoyehova:
uze uzibeke zonke ezandleni zika‐Arone, nasezandleni zonyana bake; uti kanjalo uzishukushukumise zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova.
Wandule uzitabate ezandleni zabo, uzitshise esibingelweni, pezu kwedini lokutshiswa, zibe livumba elimnandi pambi kwoyehova: ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Kanjalo uya kutabata isifuba senkunzi yegusha yedini lokuzalisa elilelika‐Arone, usishukushukumise sibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova: soba sisabelwa sako sona.

Wauya kungcwalisa isifuba somnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa, nomkono womnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa, oko kushukushukunyiswayo, noko kufunqufunqulwayo, kwinkunzi yegusha yedini lokuzalisa, kwa kokukokuka‐Arone, nakokukokwonyana bake:

kwoba kokuka‐Arone nokwonyana bake ngommiselwa ongunapakade, kuvela elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli; ngokuba ngumnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa: woba ngumnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa uvela elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, kwimibingo yoxolo yalo, kwa ngumnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa walo kuyehova.
Nengubo ezingcwele ezizezika‐Arone zona ziya kuba zezonyana bake emva kwake, ukuba kutanjiswe kuzo, nokuba kuzaliswe izandla zabo kuzo.
Wozambata imihla ibe sixe̔nxe ong umperisite esikundleni sake konyana bake, lowo ongenayo ententeni yentlangano ukuya kukonza kweyingcwele indawo.
Nenkunzi yegusha yedini lokuzalisa woyitabata, uyipeke inyama yayo endaweni eyingcwele.
Boti ke u‐Arone nonyana bake badle inyama yenkunzi yegusha, nesonka esisesityeni, ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Babeya kuzidla ezozinto kube kuxoliswa ngazo, ukuba kuzaliswe izandla zabo, n okuba bangcwaliswe; kodwa owasemzini akayi kuzidla, ngokuba zingcwele.
Kanjalo ukuba kuya kusala into yenyama yedini lokuzalisa, nento yesonka, kude kuse, uya kwandula usitshise isisalela ngomlilo; asiyi kudliwa, ngokuba singcwele.
Uya kwenje njalo ke ku‐Arone, nakonyana bake, kwa njengoko ndikuyalele ngako: kwoba yimihla isixe̔nxe uya kuzalisa izandla zabo.
Wauya kunikela imihla ngemihla inkunzana yedini lesono, ngenxa yokuxolisa; uya kusihlanza isibingelo ngokusixolisela kwako: wositambisa kanjalo, ukuba singcwaliswe.
Kwoba yimihla isixe̔nxe uya kuxolisela isibingelo, usingcwalise; soba sisibingelo esingcwelekazi: konke okucukumisayo isibingelo kwoba kungcwele.
Kuko oku uya kunikela ngako pezu kwaso isibingelo: imvana zomnyaka mnye zibe mbini, imihla ngemihla futi.
Enye imvana woyinikela ngokusa; neyesibini imvana woyinikela pakati kwokuhlwa.
Nakunye nenye imvana uya kunikela eseshumi isiqingata seyeja yomgubo ocolekileyo, unyeliwe ngeoli enqushelweyo esisiqingata sesine sehine, nomnikelo wokusela usisiqingata sesine sehine yeveyine.
Neyesibini imvana woyinikela pakati kwokuhlwa; wauya kwenzela yona njengomnikelo wokudla wokusa, nanjengomnikelo wokusela wawo, libe livumba elimnandi, kwa umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Loba lelifuti idini lokutshiswa ngezizukulwana zenu, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, pambi kwoyehova: apo ndiya kuhlangana nani kona, ukuba nditete kuni kona.
Kwa lapo ndohlangana nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ize yenziwe ngcwele ngobungcwalisa bam.
Ndandiya kungcwalisa intente yentlangano, nesibingelo; kanjalo u‐Arone nonyana bake ndiya kubangcwalisa, ukuba bandikonze ngobuperisite.
Ndandiya kuhlala pakati kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ndize ndibe ngutixo walo.
Luya kwandula lukwazi okokuba ndi nguyehova, utixo walo, olukupileyo elizweni le‐Jipete, ukuba ndihlale pakati kwalo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo walo.
KANJAKO uya kusenza isibingelo sokuqunyiselwa kwesiqumiso; uya kusenza ngemiti yeshitime.
Soba yikubite nye ubude baso, nekubite nye ububanzi baso; soba namacala mane; nobupakamo baso soba zikubite zimbini: zopuma kwa kuso impondo zaso.
Wauya kusaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo, ingcopo yaso namacala aso ngento engqongayo, kwa nempondo zaso; uya kusenzela nesitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Kanjalo uya kusenzela imisesane mibini yegolide ngapantsi kwesitsaba saso, emagumbini aso omabini; uya kuyenza pezu kwamacala aso omabini: yoba zindawo zezibonda zokuba sitwalwe ngazo.
Izibonda zaso uya kuzenza ngemiti yeshitime, uze uzaleke ngegolide.
Wauya kusibeka pambi kwekuselo elingakuyo ityeya yesinqi̔no, pambi kwesihlalo sofefe esipezu kwesinqi̔no, apo ndiya kuhlangana nawe kona.
Woti u‐Arone aqumise pezu kwaso isiqumiso esimnandi; imiso ngemiso, akulungisa izibane, uya kusiqumisa.
Naxeshekweni u‐Arone aya kumisa izibane pakati kwokuhlwa, wosiqumisa, sibe sisiqumiso esifuti pambi kwoyehova ngezizukulwana zenu.
Aniyi kunikela pezu kwaso isiqumiso esisimbi, nedini lokutshiswa, nomnikelo wokutya; aniyi kugalela pezu kwaso umnikelo wokusela kanjalo.

Waye u‐Arone eya kulwenza uxoliso pezu kwempondo zaso kube kanye emnyakeni mnye, ngegazi ledini lesono lokuxolisa; kwoba kanye emnyakeni mnye aya kulwenza uxoliso pezu kwaso ngezizukulwana zenu: yingcwelekazi ke kuyehova.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Xeshekweni utabatayo inani labalusapo luka‐Sirayeli ngokubalwa kwabo, baya kwandula banike abanye ngabanye isizi semipefumlo yabo kuye uyehova, nxa ubabalayo; ukuze kungabiko pakati kwabo isibulalo, nxa ubabalayo.
Oku bokunika, bonke abagqitela kwababalweyo, isiqingata seshekele, engangayo ishekele yeyingcwele indawo; (zigera ezimashumi mabini ishekele leyo;) isiqingata seshekele soba ngumnikelo kuyehova.
Bonke abagqitela kwababalweyo, bengabaminyaka ingamashumi mabini nabapezulu, ubudala babo, bonika umnikelo kuyehova.
Osityebi akayi kwandisa, nolihlwempu akayi kuncipisa isiqingata seshekele, ukunika umnikelo kuyehova, ukuba kwenzelwe imipefumlo yenu uxoliso.

Wauya kutabata imali yokuxolisa kulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli, uyinike ngenxa yenkonzo yentente yentlangano; ukuze ibe yinkumbuzo elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli pambi kwoyehova, ukuba kwenzelwe imipefumlo yenu uxoliso.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Uya kwenza nesihlambelo ngexina, nesikondo saso ngexina kanjalo, kuze kuhlanjwe: wauya kusibeka pakati kwentente yentlangano nesibingelo, uwafake kona amanzi.
Ngokuba u‐Arone nonyana bake beya kuhlamba kwa kuso izandla zabo nenyawo zabo:
xeshekweni bangena ententeni yentlangano, baya kuhlamba ngamanzi, ukuba bangafi: naxeshekweni basondela esibingelweni ukukonza, ukuza kutshisa umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova;
baya kwandula bahlambe izandla zabo nenyawo zabo, ukuba bangafi: oku kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kubo, kwa kuye nakwinzalo yake ngezizukulwana zabo.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Uzitabatele wena izimnandi ezidumileyo, imore engcwengileyo ibe zishekele zimakulu mahlanu, nekinamone emnandi ibe sisiqingata selonani, kwa ishekele zimakulu mabini anamashumi mahlanu, nekalame emnandi ibe zishekele zimakulu mabini anamashumi mahlanu,
nekasiya ibe zishekele zimakulu mahlanu, ezingangayo ishekele yeyingcwele indawo, neoli yamanquma ibe yihine nye;
uze wenze ngazo ioli yesitambiso esingcwele, amafuta amnandi amanyiweyo ngobuncibi bomenzi wezinukamnandi: yoba yioli yesitambiso esingcwele.
Wauya kuti ngayo utambise intente yentlangano, netyeya yesinqi̔no;
netafile, nazo zonke impahla zayo; nekandelare, nempahla zayo; nesibingelo sokuqumisa;
nesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa, nazo zonke impahla zaso; nesihlambelo, nesikondo saso.
Wauya kuzingcwalisa, ukuze zibe yingcwelekazi: konke okuzicukumisayo kwoba kungcwele.
Kanjalo u‐Arone nonyana bake uya kubatambisa, ubangcwalise bona ukuba bandikonze ngobuperisite.
Nakulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli uya kuteta ngokuti: Le yoba yioli yesitambiso esingcwele kum ngezizukulwana zenu.
Ayiyi kugalelwa pezu kwenyama yomntu; kanjako aniyi kuyenza efana nayo, ngokulinganiswa kwayo: ingcwele yona, yoba ngcwele kuni.
Osukuba eyimanya efana nayo, nosukuba ebeka kuyo pezu kwowasemzini, yena uya kunqanyulwa ebantwini bake.
Wati uyehova kanjako ku‐Mosesi: Zitabatele izimnandi, isitakite, neyonika, negabano, ezi zimnandi nentlakamhlope engcwengileyo: enye yolingana nenye.
Wauya kwenza ngazo isiqumiso, into emanyiweyo ngobuncibi bomenzi wezinukamnandi, imvumvuzelwe ngetyuwa, icocekile, ingcwele.
Woti inxenye yaso uyityumze icoleke, ubeke kuyo pambi kwesinqi̔no ententeni yentlangano, apo ndiya kuhlangana nawe kona: yoba yingcwelekazi kuni.
Nesisiqumiso oya kusenza, aniyi kuzenzela nina ngokulinganiswa kwaso: soba yingcwele kuwe ngenxa kayehova.
Osukuba eya kusenza esifana naso, ukuze sisezelwe, lowo uya kunqanyulwa ebantwini bake.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Uyabona ke, sendimbizile ngegama u‐Betsalele, unyana ka‐Uri, unyana ka‐Hure, owesizwe sika‐Juda.
Yena ndimzalisile ngomoya katixo, ngobulumko, nangengqondo, nangokwazi, nangentlobo zonke zomsebenzi;
ukuze aqinge amasetyenzwa obuncibi, enze ngegolide, nangesilivere, nangexina,
nangokuqingqa amatye, okuba kufakwe, nangokuqingqa imiti, yokuba kwenziwe ngentlobo zonke zomsebenzi.

Kanjalo mna, bona ke, ndinikile kunye naye u‐Aholiyabi, unyana ka‐Ahisamaki, owesizwe sika‐Dane: nasezintliziyweni zabo bonke abantliziyo zilumkile ndibekile ubulumko, ukuba bakwenze konke endikuyalele ngako:
intente yentlangano, netyeya yesinqi̔no, nesihlalo sofefe esipezu kwayo, nazo zonke impahla zentente;
netafile, nempahla zayo: nekandelare ecocekileyo, nazo zonke impahla zayo; nesibingelo sokuqumisa:
nesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa, nazo zonke impahla zaso; nesihlambelo, nesikondo saso;
nezivato zobukonzo: kwa izivato ezingcwele zika‐Arone umperisite, nezivato zonyana bake, zokuba kukonzwe ngobuperisite:
neoli yokutambisa; nesiqumiso esimnandi sakweyingcwele indawo: njengako konke ndikuyalele ngako baya kwenza.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Wena kanjalo teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Okwenene isabata zam niya kuzigcina; ngokuba oku kungumqondiso pakati kwam nani ngezizukulwana zenu; kuze kwaziwe ukuba ndi nguyehova oningcwalisayo.
Ngako niya kugcina isabata; ngokuba ingcwele kuni: oyinco̔lisayo uya kufiswa ngenyaniso; ngokuba osukuba ewenza ngayo umsebenzi, umpefumlo lowo uya kunqanyulwa ebantwini bawo.
Yimihla mitandatu ekuya kwenziwa umsebenzi; koko ngomhla wesixe̔nxe kuko isabata yopumlo, ibungcwele kuyehova: osukuba ewenza umsebenzi ngomhla wesabata, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Ngako usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwoyigcina isabata, ukuyibamba isabata ngezizukulwana zalo ngocebano olungunapakade.
Ingumqondiso yona pakati kwam nosapo luka‐Sirayeli kude kube ngunapakade; ngokuba ngemihla mitandatu wenza uyehova izulu nomhlaba, waza wapumla ngomhla wesixe̔nxe, womelezwa.
Wandula wanika ku‐Mosesi, akuba egqibile ukuteta naye entabeni ye‐Sinai, amabini amacwecwe esinqi̔no, amacwecwe amatye, eba̔lelwe ngomnwe katixo.

KEKALOKU abantu bakubona ukuba u‐Mosesi uyalibala ukuhla entabeni, baza abantu bahlanganisana ngaku‐Arone, bati kuye: Suka, usenzele otixo, abaya kuhamba pambi kwetu; ngokuba u‐Mosesi lowo, londoda eyasinyusayo ezweni le‐Jipete, singamazi ukuba uhliwe yinto nina.
Wati u‐Arone kubo: Kumlani amacici egolide asezindlebeni zabafazi benu, na kwezonyana benu, nakwezentombi zenu, niwazise kum.
Baza bonke abantu bawakumla amacici egolide abesezindlebeni zabo, bawazisa ku‐Arone.
Wayamkela ke esandleni sabo, wayiyila ngento yokuqoqa, wayenza itole elityityishiweyo. Baza bati: Aba bangotixo bako, Sirayeli! abakunyusileyo ezweni le‐Jipete.
Wati u‐Arone akulibona, waka isibingelo ebusweni balo; waza wadanduluka u‐Arone, wati: Ngomso kuya kubako umtendeleko kuyehova.
Baza bavuka kusasa ngomnye umhla, banikela amadini okutshiswa, basondeza neminikelo yoxolo; bahlala pantsi ke abantu badle basele nokusela, bandula ukusuka badlale.
Wada wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, ngokuti: Hamba, uhle; ngokuba abantu bako, abo ububanyusa elizweni le‐Jipete, sebezonakalisile:
bapambukile kamsinya endleleni endibe ndibayalele yona; bazenzele itole elityityishiweyo, bazitobile pambi kwalo, balibingele, bati: Aba bangotixo bako, Sirayeli! abakunyusileyo ezweni le‐Jipete.
Wati kanjako uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Ndibabonile abantu aba; kekaloku, bona ke, bangabantu abantamo ilukuni.
Ngako kaloku ndiyeke, uze umsindo wam uvute ngakubo, ndide ndibagqibele: ndandiya kwenza wena ube sisizwe esikulu.
Kodwa u‐Mosesi wambongoza uyehova, utixo wake, wati: Kunganina, Yehova! ukuba kuvute umsindo wako ngasebantwini bako, obakupileyo ezweni le‐Jipete, ngamandla amakulu, nangesandla esomeleleyo?

Kunganina ukuba ama‐Jipete atsho ukuti: Kungenxa yobubi abakupileyo, ukuba ababulale ezintabeni, nokuba abagqibele ebusweni bomhlaba? Buya ebushushwini bengqumbo yako, ube nosizi pezu kwobububi ngakubo abantu bako.

Kumbula ngo‐Abrahame, ngo‐Yisake, nango‐Sirayeli, izicaka zako, owabubafungela ngokwako, wateta kubo ngokuti: Ndiya kwandisa inzalo yenu ibe njengenkwenkwezi zezulu, nalo lonke elilizwe enditetile ngalo, ndolinika kwinzalo yenu, ize ilidle ilifa lalo kude kube ngunapakade.
Waza wanosizi uyehova pezu kwobububi wabete uya kubenza ebantwini bake.
Wajika u‐Mosesi wehla entabeni, enawo amacwecwe amabini esinqi̔no esandleni sake; bekuba̔liwe emacwecweni ngamacala omabini; kwaba̔lwa kuwo ngelinye icala nangelinye.
Lamacwecwe ebengumsebenzi katixo, nokuba̔la kwakukuba̔la kukatixo, kuqoqiwe emacwecweni.
Xeshekweni u‐Yoshuwa weva ingxokozelo yabantu ekumemezeni kwabo, wati ku‐Mosesi: Kuko ingxokozelo yokulwa emnqubeni.
Koko wati: Asi lilo ilizwi lesidanduluko sokweyisa, asi lilo nelizwi lesikalo sokucitwa; lilizwi lokucula endilivayo mna.
Kwaza kwati, akusondela emnqubeni, wabona itole elo, nokududa; yandul’ ukuvuta ingqumbo ka‐Mosesi, owalahla amacwecwe ezandleni zake, wawaqekeza ezantzi kwentaba.
Watabata netole ababelenzile, walitshisa emlilweni, walisila lada lacoleka, walivutululela emanzini, waza waseza usapo luka‐Sirayeli kuwo.
Wandula wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Arone: Benze nto nina kuwe abantu aba, ukuba uzisile pezu kwabo isono esikulu kangaka?
Wati ke u‐Arone: Maingavuti ingqumbo yenkosi yam! uyabazi ababantu wena, ukuba banxam ele inkohlakalo.
Baye besiti kum: Senzele otixo, abaya kuhamba pambi kwetu; ngokuba u‐Mosesi lowo, londoda eyasinyusayo ezweni le‐Jipete, singamazi ukuba uhliwe yinto nina.
Ndaza ndati kubo: Osukuba enegolide, makayikumle, ayinike kum; yona ndayiposa emlilweni, kwada kwapuma itole eli.
Wati u‐Mosesi akubona abantu ukuba bahlubulukile, (ngokuba u‐Arone ebebahlubisile babe nehlazo pakati kwabasukelayo,)
wandula wema u‐Mosesi esangweni lomnquba, wati: Olunge kuyehova, makeze kum! Baye bebutelana ngakuye bonke abalusapo luka‐Levi.

Waza wati kubo: Utsho uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ukuti: Abanye ngabanye mabafake iziṙele zabc ngasematangeni abo, badlule, babuye kwelinye isango baye kwelinye isango lomnquba, basike omnye umzalwana wake, nomnye umhlobo wake, nomnye ummelwane wake.
Lwaye usapo luka‐Levi lwenza ngelizwi lika‐Mosesi; kwawa ke ebantwini, ngalomini, ngati angamawaka matatu amadoda.
Ngokuba u‐Mosesi ebesiti: Zalisani izandla zenu kuyehova namhla; ngokuba umntu’eya kuba ngakuye unyana wake, nangakuye umzalwana wake; ukuze namkeliswe namhla itamsanqa.
Kwaye kute ngomnye umhla, wati u‐Mosesi ebantwini: Nina nonile ngesono esikulu; kodwa kaloku ndonyukela kuyehova, kungati umhlaumbi ndiya kwenzela isono senu uxoliso.
Waza u‐Mosesi wabuyela kuyehova, wati: Au! ababantu bonile ngesono esikulu, bazenzele otixo begolide.
Nakaloku, ukuba uya kubaxolela isono sabo —; ukuba kodwa akungebe njalo, uze undicime encwadini yako oyiba̔lileyo.
Wandula uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Lowo osukuba onile ngakum, nguye endiya kumcima encwadini yam.
Kodwa hamba kaloku, ukokele abantu kulo ndawo endanditeta ngayo kuwe: bona ke, ingelosi yam iya kuhamba pambi kwako; koko ngemini yokubuza kwam ndiya kusohlwayela isono sabo pezu kwabo.
Waza uyehova wabeta abantu, ngenxa yokuba bebelenzile itole, elo walenzayo u‐Arone.

Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, wati: Hamba, unyuke kwa lapa, wena nabantu abo ubanyusileyo ezweni le‐Jipete, niye ezweni endandifunga ngalo ku‐Abrahame, ku‐Yisake, naku‐Yakobi, ndisiti: Kwinzalo yako ndiya kulipa:
ndandiya kutuma pambi kwako ingelosi, ndigxote nokugxota aba‐Kanane, naba‐Amori, nama‐Hete, nama‐Perizi, nama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi:
kwa sezweni elela ubisi nobusi: ngokuba ndingayi kunyuka pakati kwako mna, ngenxa yokuba ungabantu abantamo ilukuni; hleze ndikugqibele endleleni.
Baza abantu bakuva elilizwi libi, balila; kwaye kungabiko namntu owafaka izihombo zake kuye.

Ngokuba uyehova ebete ku‐Mosesi: Yiti elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Nina ningabantu abantamo ilukuni; ngepanyazo linye bendinganyukelayo pakati kwako, ndikugqibele; kodwa kaloku, zitule izihombo zako kwa kuwe, ndize ndazi ke ukuba ndiya kukwenzela nto nina.
Lwaza usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwazihluba izihombo zalo ngasentabeni ye‐Horebe.

Waye u‐Mosesi watabata intente, wazolulela yona ngapandle kwomnquba, kwa kude nomnquba, wayibiza ngokuti yintente yentlangano. Kwaza kwati, bonke ababefuna uyehova bapuma baya ententeni yentlangano, ebingapandle kwomnquba.
Kwaza kwati, Xeshekweni u‐Mosesi wapumayo ukuya ententeni, besuka bonke abantu, bema abanye ngabanye eminyango yentente zabo, bakangela ngaku‐Mosesi wada wangena ententeni.
