Kwaza kwati, nxa angenileyo u‐Mosesi ententeni, yehla intsika yelifu, yema emnyango wentente: waza u‐Yehova wateta no‐Mosesi.
Bati bonke abantu bakubona intsika yelifu imi emnyango wentente, bandula besuka bonke abantu, batoba pantsi, abanye ngabanye eminyango yentente zabo.

Waza uyehova wateta ku‐Mosesi ubuso bungakubo ubuso, njengokuba umntu eteta nomhlobo wake. Wada wabuyela emnqubeni; kodwa umkonzi wake u‐Yoshuwa, unyana ka‐Nune, isicaka, waengasukanga ententeni yena.
Wandula wati u‐Mosesi kuyehova: Uya bona ke, uti wena kum: Nyusa ababantu! kanti akundazisanga oyena uya kumtuma nam; nangona ubusiti: Ndiyakwazi wena ngegama; nakanjalo: Ufumene ufefe emehlweni am.
Ngako kaloku, ukuba ke ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, zundazise indlela yako, ukuba ndikwazi wena, ndize ndifumane ufefe emehlweni ako; kanjalo gqala ukuba singabantu bako esisizwe.
Wayesiti: Isiqu sam siya kuhamba nawe, ndandiya kukunika ukupumla.
Waza wati kuye: Ukuba isiqu sako asihambi nam, zungasinyusi kule ndawo.

Ngokuba kuya kwaziwa nganto nina kaloku, ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, mna nabantu bako? asi ngako na ukuhamba kwako nati? kukona siya kwahlulwa, kwa mna nabantu bako, kubo bonke abantu abapezu kwobuso bomhlaba.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Kwa nalento uyitetileyo ndiya kuyenza; ngokokuba ufumene ufefe emehlweni am, nokuba ndikwazi ngegama.
Wayesiti: Uz’ undibonise ubungcwalisa bako.

Waza wati: Ndiya kudlulisa konke ukulunga kwam pambi kwako, ndishumayele negama likayehova ebusweni bako; ndandiya kumpata ngofefe lowo endiya kumpata ngofefe, ndoba netaṙu napezu kwalowo endiya kuba netaṙu ngakuye.
Wati kanjalo: Akungebone ubuso bam; ngokuba kungeko mntu oya kundibona, apile nokupila.
Walekela wati uyehova: Nantsi ke indawo ingakum; uya kuma kona pezu kwelityekazi.
Kwoza kuti, ekudluleni kwobungcwalisa bam, ndokubeka emfanteni welityekazi, ndize ndikugubungele ngesandla sam nxa ndidlulayo.
Ndandiya kususa isandla sam, uze ubone umva wam; kodwa ubuso bam abuyi kubonwa.
WANDULA uyehova wati ku‐Mosesi: Zibazele amacwecwe amatye abe mabini enjengawokuqala; ndandiya kuba̔la pezu kwalamacwecwe amazwi abesemacwecweni okuqala, owauwaqekezile.
Yiba selulungile kwakusa, uze unyukele kusasa entabeni ye‐Sinai, uzimise pambi kwam kona, engcopo yentaba.
Kanti akuyi kunyuka mntu nawe; kanjalo makungabonwa mntu kuyo yonke intaba; kwa negusha nenkomo mazingadli pambi kwentaba leyo.
Wasuka wabaza amabini amacwecwe amatye enjengawokuqala; waza wavuka u‐Mosesi kwa kusasa, wenyukela entabeni ye‐Sinai, njengokuba ebemyalele uyehova; watabata esandleni sake amacwecwe amatye omabini.
Waye uyehova esihla efini, wema naye kona, washumayela igama likayehova.
Waza wadlula uyehova pambi kwake, washumayela ngokuti: Uyehova, uyehova e ngutixo, enetaṙu, enofefe, equmba kade, emkulu ngobubele nenyaniso;

ogcinela amawaka ububele, oxolela inkohlakalo, nesigqito, nesono, ongayi kuka agwebele onetyala; eyohlwayela inkohlakalo yoyise pezu kwabantwana, napezu kwabantwana babantwana, pezu kwesesitatu napezu kwesesine isizukulwana.
Wanxama ke u‐Mosesi, watoba pantsi ngasemhlabeni, wabedesha.

Wati: Ukuba kaloku ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, Nkosi! maize ihambe inkosi pakati kwetu; nakuba bengabantu abantamo ilukuni aba; uze uxolele inkohlakalo yetu nesono setu, usamkele tina sibe lilifa lako.

Waza wati: Bona ke, sendilwenza ucebano: pambi kwabo bonke abantu bako ndoyenza imimangaliso, ekungazanga kudalwe enjalo kuwo wonke umhlaba, nakuzo zonke izizwe; boti bonke abantu opakati kwabo babone umsebenzi kayehova; ngokuba iyinto eyoyikekayo leyo endiya kuyenza kuwe.
Gcina wena oko ndikuyalela kona namhla nje: bona ke, ndiza kugxota ebusweni bako aba‐Amori, naba‐Kanane, nama‐Hete, nama‐Perizi, nama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi.
Zilumkele, ukuba ungalwenzi ucebano nabemi belozwe uya kulo, hleze lube ngumgibe pakati kwako.
Koko izibingelo zabo niya kuzicita, nezifanekiso zabo niya kuziqekeza, ne‐Ashera zabo niya kuzigaula:
(ngokuba ungayi kubedesha utixo wumbi; ngokuba uyehova, ngu‐Bukwele igama lake, ngutixo enobukwele yena:)
hleze ulwenze ucebano nabemi belizwe, uti bakuṙexezela otixo babo, babingele nokubingela otixo babo, ati omnye akumeme, wandule utye kumbingo wake;
uti kanjalo utabatele onyana bako kwintombi zabo, ziti intombi zabo, zakuṙexezela otixo babo, zenze nonyana bako baṙexezele otixo babo.
Akuyi kuzenzela otixo abatyityishiweyo.

Umtendeleko wezonka ezingenagwele uya kuwugcina: yoba yimihla isixe̔nxe uya kuzidla izonka ezingenagwele, njengokuba bendikuyalela, ngelimisiweyo ixesha lenyanga engu‐Abibe; ngokuba ngenyanga engu‐Abibe wabupuma e‐Jipete.
Konke kuzityulwa ngako kukokwam; kwa zonke inkomo zako ezizalwa zingamaduna, amazibulo enkomo ezinkulu nezincinane.
Kodwa izibulo leqwaṙashe uya kukulula lona ngexwana; ukuba kanti akuyi kulikulula, uze ulapule intamo. Bonke abangamazibulo onyana bako uya kubakulula. Mabangabonakali pambi kwam bengenanto.
Yimihla mitandatu uya kusebenza, kodwa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe uya kupumla: ngexesha lokulima nangexesha lokuvuna uya kupumla.
Kanjalo umtendeleko weveki uya kuwenza, owolibo lwokuvunwa kwenqolowa, kwa nomtendeleko wokubuta ngasekupeleni kwomnyaka.
Kwoba ngamaxesha matatu emnyakeni mnye ekuya kubonakala onke amadoda ako ebusweni benkosi uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli.

Ngokuba ndiya kugqogqa intlanga pambi kwako, ndiyenze banzi nemida yako: kanjako aliyi kunqwenelwa mntu ilizwe lako, nxa unyukayo ukuya kubonakala ebusweni bukayehova, utixo wako, amaxesha matatu emnyakeni mnye.
Akuyi kunikela igazi lombingo wam kunye nokubiliswayo; kanjalo akuyi kuhlala kude kuse umbingo womtendeleko wepasika.
Isiqalo selibo zomhlaba wako uya kusingenisa endlwini kayehova, utixo wako. Musa ukupeka itakane lebokwe elubisini lwonina.
Waza wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Ba̔la wena lamazwi; ngokuba kwa njengokutsho kwalamazwi ndilwenzile ucebano nawe no‐Sirayeli.
Wayeko kona ndawonye no‐yehova imini zamashumi mane nobusuku bakwa mashumi mane; isonka akasidla, namanzi akawasela: wandula waba̔la pezu kwamacwecwe amazwi ocebano, amazwi olishumi.
Kwaza kwati, akuhla u‐Mosesi entabeni ye‐Sinai, amacwecwe omabini esinqi̔no esesandleni sika‐Mosesi, ekuhleni kwake entabeni, waengazi u‐Mosesi ukuba intlonze yobuso bake ibikazimla akuteta naye.
Wati u‐Arone, nalo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli, bakubona u‐Mosesi, bona ke, intlonze yobuso bake yakazimla; ngako babesoyika ukusondela kuye.
Waza u‐Mosesi wababiza; wasuka u‐Arone, nazo zonke inkosi zentlanganiso, babuya beza kuye: waye u‐Mosesi wateta nabo.
Kwati kamva kwasondela lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli: waza waluyalela ngako konke uyehova wabekutetile kuye entabeni ye‐Sinai.
Wati u‐Mosesi akuba egqibile ukuteta nabo, wabeka pezu kwobuso bake isigubungelo.
Kodwa nxa u‐Mosesi wangenayo ebusweni bukayehova ukuya kuteta naye, wandula wasusa isigubungelo wada wapuma: wati akuba epumile, wateta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli oko wayeyalelwa kona.
Lwandula usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwabona ubuso buka‐Mosesi, ukuba intlonze yobuso buka‐Mosesi iyakazimla; waza u‐Mosesi wabuya wabeka isigubungelo pezu kwobuso bake, wada wangena ukuya kuteta naye.
WAZA u‐Mosesi wahlanganisa yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli, wati kulo: Ngala amazwi ayalele ngawo uyehova, ukuba niwenze.
Yimihla mitandatu ekuya kwenziwa umsebenzi, kodwa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe kuya kubako kuni owobungcwele, isabata yopumlo kuyehova: osukuba ewenza umsebenzi ngawo, uya kufiswa.
Aniyi kupemba mlilo kuzo zonke izindlu zenu ngomhla wesabata.
Wayeteta u‐Mosesi kuyo yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli, esiti: Lilo eli ilizwi uyehova ayalele ngalo, ukuti:
Tabatani kokukuni umnikelo kuyehova; osukuba enentliziyo evumayo, makawuzise, umnikelo kayehova: igolide, nesilivere, nexina,
nezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, neqiya eshiceneyo, n oboya bebokwe,
nezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nezintsu zamacelesi, nemiti yeshitime,
neoli ibe yeyesikanyiso, nezimnandi zibe zezeoli yokutambisa nezesiqumiso esimnandi,
namatye eshohame, namatye okufakwa, aweyefodi nawembeka.
Babeya kuza bonke abantliziyo zilumkile pakati kwenu, benze konke ayalele ngako uyehova:
itabanakele, intente yayo, nesigubungelo sayo, amakonxo ayo, neplanke zayo, imivalo yayo, intsika zayo, neziseko zayo;
ityeya, nezibonda zayo, isihlalo sofefe, nekuselo lelengalenga;
itafile, nezibonda zayo, nazo zonke impahla zayo, nezonka zokubonakala;
nekandelare yesikanyiso, nempahla zayo, nezibane zayo, neoli yesikanyiso;
nesibingelo sesiqumiso, nezibonda zaso, neoli yokutambisa, nesiqumiso esimnandi; nelengalenga locango emnyango wetabanakele;
isibingelo samadini okutshiswa, neziko lexina esiya kuba nalo, izibonda zaso, nazo zonke impahla zaso; isihlambelo, nesikondo saso;
amalengalenga ebala, intsika zalo, neziseko zazo; nelengalenga lesango lebala;
izikonkwane zetabanakele, nezikonkwane zebala, nentambo zazo;
izivato zobukonzo, zokuba kukonzwe kweyingcwele indawo, izivato ezingcwele zika‐Arone umperisite, nezivato zonyana bake, zokuba bakonze ngobuperisite.
Yandula yapuma yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli ebusweni buka‐Mosesi.

Baye besiza bonke ngabanye abantliziyo ibavusileyo, nabo bonke abamoya wabaqu̔bayo, bazisa umnikelo kayehova ngenxa yomsebenzi wentente yentlangano, nangenxa yenkonzo yayo, nangenxa yezivato ezingcwele.
Baye besiza, kwa amadoda nabafazi, bonke abanentliziyo evumayo, bazisa izacolo, namacici, nemisesane, nezidanga, zizinto zegolide zonke; nabo bonke abanikela umnikelo wegolide kuyehova.
Kanjalo bonke abantu bekufunyanwa kubo izuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, neqiya eshiceneyo, n oboya bebokwe, nezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nezintsu zamacelesi, bazizisa.
Bonke abanikela umnikelo wesilivere nowexina, bawuzisa umnikelo kayehova; nabo bonke bekufunyanwa kubo imiti yeshitime, ngenxa yomnye umsebenzi wenkonzo, bayizisa.
Nabo bonke abafazi, abantliziyo ilumkileyo, basonta ngezandla zabo; baza bazisa okusontiweyo, okwezuluṙa nesimnyama, okwesibomvu neqiya eshiceneyo.
Nabo bonke abafazi abantliziyo yabavusayo ebulumkweni, basonta uboya bebokwe.
Nenkosi zazisa zona amatye eshohame, namatye okufakwa, aweyefodi nawembeka;
nezimnandi, nezeoli yokutambisa, nezesiqumiso esimnandi, neoli yesikanyiso.
Lwazisa lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli umnikelo wesisa kuyehova, onke amadoda nabo bonke abafazi, abantliziyo ibaqu̔bayo ukuzisela yonke imisebenzi, abeyalele uyehova ukuba yenziwe ngesandla sika‐Mosesi.
Waza u‐Mosesi wati elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Niyabona ke, uyehova umbizile ngegama u‐Betsalele, unyana ka‐Uri, unyana ka‐Hure, owesizwe sika‐Juda.
Yena umzalisile ngomoya katixo, ngobulumko, nangengqondo, nangokwazi, nangentlobo zonke zomsebenzi;
ukuze aqinge amasetyenzwa obuncibi, enze ngegolide, nangesilivere, nangexina,
nangokuqingqa amatye, okuba kufakwe nangokuqingqa imiti, yokuba kwenziwe ngemisebenzi yonke yobuncibi.
Kanjalo ubekile entliziyweni yake ukuba afundise abanye, kwe yake na kwe ka‐Aholiyabi, unyana ka‐Ahisamaki, owesizwe sika‐Dane.

Aba ubazalisile ngobulumko bentliziyo, ukuze kwenziwe yonke imisebenzi, eyomqingqi, neyencibi yokuluka, neyomtungi wamabala ngamabala, ngezuluṙa, nangesimnyama, nangesibomvu, nangeqiya eshiceneyo, neyomluki, n eyabenzi bemisebenzi yonke, neyabaqingi bamasetyenzwa obuncibi.

BAZA basebenza u‐Betsalele no‐Aholiyabi, nawo onke amadoda anentliziyo elumkileyo, abete uyehova wanika ubulumko nengqondo kuwo, ukuba akwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yenkonzo yeyingcwele indawo, njengako konke uyehova abeyalele kona.

Ngokuba u‐Mosesi ebebizile u‐Betsalele no‐Aholiyabi, nawo onke amadoda anentliziyo elumkileyo, abebekile uyehova ubulumko ezintliziyweni zawo, kwa bonke abantliziyo yabavusayo ukusondela emsebenzini, ukuza kuwenza:
abawamkela ku‐Mosesi wonke umnikelo, usapo luka‐Sirayeli beluwuzisile ngenxa yomsebenzi wenkonzo yeyingcwele indawo, ukuba wenziwe. Koko babesazisa kuye iminikelo yesisa ngemiso ngemiso.
Kweza ngoko onke amalumko abesenza wonke umsebenzi weyingcwele indawo, evela amanye ngamanye emsebenzini wawo awenzayo,
atsho ku‐Mosesi, esiti: Abantu bayazisa ngokuninzi pezu kwokuyaneleyo inkonzo yomsebenzi, lo wo uyehova ayalele ngawo ukuba wenziwe.
Waza waxela u‐Mosesi, ukuba makudluliswe ilizwi emnqubeni, lisiti: Indoda nomfazi mabangabi sawenza umsebenzi ngenxa yomnikelo weyingcwele indawo! Kwa njalo abantu bayeka ukuzisa.
Ngokuba impahla ibibanele ngenxa yawo wonke umsebenzi, ukuba bawenze; ibiyegqitisayo kanjalo.

Baza bonke abantliziyo ilumkileyo pakati kwabo bawenzayo umsebenzi benzela itabanakele izikuselo zalishumi ngepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, nezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu: wayezenza zinekerubime, ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka.
Ubude baso isikuselo sinye babuzikubite ezimashumi mabini anesibozo, nobubanzi baso isikuselo sinye babuzikubite ezine: zonke izikuselo ezi zazinomlinganiswa mnye.
Esinye isihlanu sezikuselo wabandakanyisa esinye kwesinye; nesinye isihlanu sezikuselo wabandakanyisa esinye kwesinye.
Wenza namasango ezuluṙa ngasempetweni wesinye isikuselo, ngasencameni, esibandakanyelweni; wenje njalo nasempetweni wapandle wesikuselo, ekubandakanyweni kwesesibini.
Wayesenza amasango amashumi mahlanu kwesinye isikuselo, namasango akwa mashumi mahlanu wawenza encameni yesikuselo esisekubandakanyweni kwesesibini: lamasango alungelelana elinye nelinye.
Wenza namakonxo egolide amashumi mahlanu, wabandakanyisa izikuselo, esinye kwesinye, ngamakonxo lawo; yaza yaba yitabanakele inye.
Wayesenza izikuselo ngoboya bebokwe, zibe yintente pezu kwayo itabanakele: zazizikuselo ezilishumi linasinye wazenzayo.
Ubude baso isikuselo sinye babuzikubite ezimashumi matatu, nobubanzi baso isikuselo sinye babuzikubite ezine: ezizikuselo zilishumi linasinye zazinomlinganiswa mnye.
Wayebandakanyisa izikuselo zazihlanu zizodwa, nezikuselo zazitandatu zizodwa nazo.
Wenza namasango amashumi mahlanu ngasempetweni wesikuselo, wesapandle ekubandakanyweni, namasango akwa ngamashumi mahlanu wawenza ngasempetweni wesikuselo esibandakanyana nesesibini.
Wawenza namakonxo exina amashumi mahlanu, okuba kubandakanyiswe intente, ize ibe inye.
Kanjalo wayenzela intente isigubungelo ngezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nesigubungelo esinye ngezintsu zamacelesi pezu kwaso eso.
Waza wayenzela itabanakele iplanke ngemiti yeshitime, zipakama.
Zazikubite ezilishumi ubude beplanke nye, nobubanzi bayo iplanke nye yayikubite nesiqingata sekubite.
Iplanke nye ibinezibambelo zazibini, zicwangcisiwe esinye silunge nesinye; wenje njalo kuzo zonke iplanke zetabanakele.
Wayenzela itabanakele iplanke, zazimashumi mabini iplanke kwelasesuyide icala, ngasesuyide:

neziseko zesilivere ezimashumi mane wazenza ngapantsi kwazo iplanke zomashumi mabini; zazibini iziseko ngapantsi kwenye iplanke kuzo izibambelo zayo zozibini, nezibini iziseko ngapantsi kwenye iplanke kuzo izibambelo zayo zozibini.
Nakwelesibini icala letabanakele, kwelasenode icala, wazenza iplanke zamashumi mabini;
neziseko zazo zesilivere ezimashumi mane; zazibini iziseko ngapantsi kwenye iplanke, nezibini iziseko ngapantsi kwenye iplanke.
Necala lasemva letabanakele, ngasentshonalanga, walenzela iplanke zantandatu.
Wenzela namagumbi etabanakele, emacaleni omabini, iplanke zambini.
Zazihlanganiswa kunye ezantsi, kanjalo zahlanganiswa kunye napezulu kuwo umsesane umnye: wenje njalo kuzo zombini, emagumbini omabini.
Kwaye kuko iplanke ezisibozo, neziseko zazo zesilivere, iziseko ezilishumi linesitandatu; zazibini iziseko ngapantsi kweplanke ezinye ngezinye.
Wayesenza imivalo ngemiti yeshitime; yamihlanu eziplankeni zelinye icala letabanakele,
nemihlanu imivalo eziplankeni zelinye icala letabanakele, nemihlanu imivalo eziplankeni zetabanakele, zecala lasemva ngasentshonalanga.
Nowapakati umvalo wawenza ukuba udlule pakati kweplauke, kwa kwenye incam kwada kwakwenye incam.
Neplanke wazaleka ngegolide, nemisesane yazo wayenza ngegolide ibe zindawo zemivalo; kanjako wayaleka imivalo ngegolide.
Wayesenza ikuselo ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo: ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka walenza lona, linekerubime.
Walenzela intsika zane ngemiti yeshitime, wazaleka ngegolide: amagwegwe azo ebengawegolide; wayezityityishela iziseko zesilivere zazine.
Kanjalo walwenzela ucango lwentente ilengalenga, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, isetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala:
kwa nentsika zalo zontlanu, namagwegwe azo; wayezaleka intloko zazo nentonga zazo ngegolide; kodwa iziseko zazo zozihlanu zazizezexina.

Wati kanjalo u‐Betsalele wayenza ityeya ngemiti yeshitime: yayizikubite mbini nesiqingata sekubite ubude bayo, nekubite nye nesiqingata sekubite ububanzi bayo, nekubite nye nesiqingata sekubite ubupakamo bayo.
Waza wayaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo, pakati nangapandle; wayenzela isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Wayetyityishela yona imisesane yegolide yamine, ngasemagumbini ayo, imisesane mibini ngelinye icala layo, nemisesane ekwa mibini ngelinye icala layo.
Wazenza nezibonda ngemiti yeshitime, wazaleka ngegolide.
Waye izibonda ezo wazingenisa kuyo imisesane esemacaleni etyeya, ize itwalwe ityeya.
Kanjalo wasenza isihlalo sofefe ngegolide ecocekileyo: sasizikubite mbini nesiqingata sekubite ubude baso, nekubite nye nesiqingata sekubite ububanzi baso.
Wazenza nekerubime zambini ngegolide; wazenza ngesetyenzwa elikandelweyo, zipuma ezincameni zombini zesihlalo sofefe;
enye ikerubime isencameni yakweli icala, nenye ikerubime isencameni yakweliya icala: zipuma esihlalweni sofefe wayezenza ikerubime, ezincameni zaso zombini.
Zati ikerubime zatwabulula amapiko omabini ngapezulu, zisigubungela ngamapiko azo isihlalo sofefe; nobuso bazo obenye babubekana nobenye; babungakuso isihlalo sofefe ubuso bekerubime.
Wayenza netafile ngemiti yeshitime; yayizikubite mbini ubude bayo, nekubite nye ububanzi bayo, nekubite nye nesiqingata sekubite ubupakamo bayo.
Wayeyaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo, wayenzela isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Wayenzela nodini, lungangobubanzi besandla, ngento engqongayo; waza walwenzela udini lwayo isitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Wayityityishela imisesane yegolide yamine, wayibeka imisesane emagumbini omane asezinyaweni zayo zone.
Ibimalungana nodini imisesane leyo, ibe zindawo zezibonda zokuba kutwalwe itafile.
Wazenza izibonda ezo ngemiti yeshitime, wazaleka ngegolide, ize itwalwe itafile.
Wenza nempahla ezipezu kwetafile, izikotile zayo, nezitya zayo, nendebe zayo, nebekile zayo, ekwagalelwa ngazo, ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Wayenza nekandelare ngegolide ecocekileyo: ngesetyenzwa elikandelweyo wayenza ikandelare; isikondo sayo, nexokama layo, indetyana zayo, izikandana zayo, nentyatyambo zayo, zibe zizezakuyo.
Imbaxa ezintandatu zapuma emacaleni ayo; kwapuma imbaxa ezintatu zekandelare kwelinye icala layo, nembaxa ezintatu zekandelare kwelinye icala layo.

Kwako indetyana ezintatu, zifanisiwe nezamonde, kwenye imbaxa, kwa n esikandana nentyatyambo; nendetyana ezintatu, zifanisiwe nezamonde, nakwenye imbaxa, kwa n esikandana nentyatyambo; kwakunjalo kuzo zonke imbaxa ezipuma ekandelareni.
Nakuyo ikandelare zaziko indetyana ezine, zifanisiwe nezamonde, izikandana zayo, nentyatyambo zayo.

Kwakuko esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, n esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, n esinye isikandana ngapantsi kwezimbini imbaxa zakuyo, njengazo imbaxa zontandatu ezipuma ekandelareni.
Izikandana zazo nembaxa zazo zibe zizezakuyo; ibilinye isetyenzwa elikandelweyo legolide ecocekileyo ipela.
Wazenza nezibane zayo zosixe̔nxe, nezicimo zayo, nezipatelo zayo, ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Kwakungetalente yegolide ecocekileyo wenzayo yona, nazo zonke impahla zayo.

Kanjalo wasenza isibingelo sokuqumisa ngemiti yeshitime: sasiyikubite nye ubude baso, nekubite nye ububanzi baso; sanamacala mane; nobupakamo baso sasizikubite mbini; zibe zipuma kwa kuso impondo zaso.
Wayesaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo, ingcopo yaso, namacala aso ngento engqongayo, nempondo zaso; wasenzela nesitsaba segolide ngento engqongayo.
Wasenzela kanjalo yamibini imisesane yegolide ngapantsi kwesitsaba saso, ngasemagumbini aso omabini, pezu kwamacala aso omabini, ibe zindawo zezibonda zokuba sitwalwe ngazo.
Nezibonda zaso wazenza ngemiti yeshitime, wazaleka ngegolide.
Wayenza neoli engcwele yokutambisa, nesiqumiso esingcwengileyo sezimnandi, ngomsebenzi womenzi wezinukamnandi.
Kanjako wasenza isibingelo samadini okutshiswa ngemiti yeshitime: sasizikubite ezintlanu ubude baso, nekubite ezintlanu ububanzi baso; sanamacala mane; nobupakamo baso sasizikubite ezintatu.
Wazenza nempondo zaso pezu kwamagumbi aso omane; zibe zipuma kwa kuso impondo zaso; wayesaleka ngexina.
Wenza nazo zonke impahla zesibingelo eso, imbiza zaso, nezikotululo zaso, nezitya zaso zokufefela, n eforoke zaso, nezipatamlilo zaso: zonke impahla zaso wazenza ngexina.
Wayesenzela isibingelo iziko lesetyenzwa elilinqwanqwa ngexina, ngapantsi kwesazinge saso, ngasezantsi kwada kwapakati kwaso.
Wayetyityishela amancam omane eziko lexina imisesane yamine, ibe zindawo zezibonda.
Wazenza izibonda ngemiti yeshitime, wazaleka ngexina.
Waza wangenisa izibonda kuyo imisesane emacaleni esibingelo, ukuba sitwalwe ngazo: wenza sona siliholo ngeplanke.
Wayesenza isihlambelo ngexina, nesikondo saso ngexina kanjalo, ngezikangeliselo zamakonzikazi akonzayo emnyango wentente yentlangano.
Kanjako walenza ibala: ngecala lasesuyide ngasesuyide amalengalenga ebala ebengawepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, ikubite ezilikulu.
Intsika zawo zazimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo zazimashumi mabini, zizezexina; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo bezizezesilivere.
Nangecala lasenode amalengalenga ebezikubite ezilikulu; intsika zawo zimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo zikwa mashumi mabini, zizezexina; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo bezizezesilivere.
Nangecala litshona ilanga amalengalenga ebezikubite ezingamashumi mahlanu; intsika zawo zilishumi, neziseko zazo zikwa lishumi; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo bezizezesilivere.
Nangecala lipuma ilanga ngasempumalanga ikubite bezingamashumi mahlanu.
Amalengalenga elinye icala lesango ebezikubite ezilishumi linesihlanu; intsika zawo zantatu, neziseko zazo zazikwa zitatu.
Nangelinye icala lesango lebala, kwa lapa napaya, amalengalenga ebezikubite ezilishumi linesihlanu; intsika zawo zantatu, neziseko zazo zazikwa zitatu.
Onke amalengalenga elingqongayo ibala ebengawepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo.
Iziseko zentsika zibe zizezexina; amagwegwe entsika nentonga zazo bezizezesilivere; nesalekwa sentloko zazo besisesesilivere; zonke intsika zebala zabandakanyiswa ngentonga zesilivere.

Ilengalenga lesango lebala lalilisetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala, lezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo; lalizikubite ezingamashumi mabini ubude balo, nobupakamo balo, ebubanzini, lalizikubite ezintlanu, lilungelelene namalengalenga ebala.
Intsika zawo zane, neziseko zazo zazine, zizezexina; amagwegwe azo ebengawesilivere, nesalekwa sentloko zazo nentonga zazo bezizezesilivere.
Kanjalo zonke izikonkwane zetabanakele, nezebala elingqongayo, zazizezexina.
Zezi izinto ezibalweyo zetabanakele, zetabanakele yesinqi̔no, ezibe zibalwa ngelizwi lika‐Mosesi, ngenkonzo yaba‐Levi, ngesandla sika‐Yitamare, unyana ka‐Arone umperisite.
Waye u‐Betsalele unyana ka‐Uri, unyana ka‐Hure, owesizwe sika‐Juda, wenza konke uyehova abemyalele u‐Mosesi ngako.

Nakunye naye wabengu‐Aholiyabi, unyana ka‐Ahisamaki, owesizwe sika‐Dane, obengumqingqi, nencibi yokuluka, nomtungi wamabala ngamabala, ngezuluṙa, nangesimnyama, nangesibomvu, nangepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo.

Yonke igolide ekwenziwa ngayo umsebenzi, kuwo wonke umsebenzi weyingcwele indawo, kwa igolide yomnikelo, yabizitalente ezimashumi mabini anetoba, neshekele ezimakulu asixe̔nxe anamashumi matatu, ezingangayo ishekele yeyingcwele indawo.
Nesilivere yababalweyo bentlanganiso ibizitalente ezilikulu, ueshekele eziliwaka linamakulu asixe̔nxe enamashumi asixe̔nxe enantlanu, ezingangayo ishekele yeyingcwele indawo:

ibeka ngenxa yentloko ngentloko, oko kukuti, isiqingata seshekele, engangayo ishekele yeyingcwele indawo, ngenxa yabo bonke abagqitela kwababalweyo, bengabaminyaka ingamashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, ngenxa yabangamawaka angamakulu matandatu enamawaka matatu, anamakulu mahlanu enamashumi akwa mahlanu.
Italente zesilivere ezilikulu, kwatyityishwa ngazo iziseko zeyingcwele indawo, neziseko zekuselo; ikulu leziseko ngekulu letalente, italente inye iyeyesiseko sinye.
Neziliwaka linamakulu asixe̔nxe enamashumi asixe̔nxe enantlanu ishekele, wenza ngazo amagwegwe entsika, wazaleka intloko zazo, wazenzela intonga.
Kanjalo ixina yomnikelo ibizitalente ezingamashumi asixe̔nxe, neshekele ezingamawaka mabini anamakulu mane.
Wenza ngayo iziseko zocango lwentente yentlangano, nesibingelo sexina, neziko lexina esibe sinalo, nazo zonke impahla zeziko,
neziseko zebala elingqongayo, neziseko zesango lebala, nazo zonke izikonkwane zetabanakele, nazo zonke izikonkwane zebala elingqongayo.
Nangezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, bazenza izivato zobukonzo, zokuba kukonzwe kweyingcwele indawo; bazenza nezivato ezingcwele ezibe zezika‐Arone, njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Iyefodi wayenza ngegolide, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo.

Baye bekandela amaceba egolide, bancwela intsinga, kuze kusetyenzwe ngazo pakati kwezuluṙa, napakati kwesimnyama, napakati kwesibomvu, napakati kwayo epotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka.
Bayenzela neziziba zamagxalaba ezibandakanyiweyo; kwa sezincameni zayo ezimbini yabandakanyiswa.

Nombinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi yake, opezu kwayo, wayinto yakuyo, njengesetyenzwa layo; ngegolide, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eschiceneyo; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalale u‐Mosesi.
Balungisa namatye eshohame evingcelwe ezingingqini zegolide, eqingqelwe njeng eziqingqwa zaso isincamatiselo, enamagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli.
Wayebeka wona pezu kwezamagxalaba iziziba zeyefodi, abe ngamatye okukumbuza elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayenza nembeka ngesetyenzwa lencibi yokuluka, njengesetyenzwa layo iyefodi; ngegolide, ngezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, nepotiweyo iqiya eshicenyo.
Ibinamacala mane; ipindiwe bayenza imbeka: yaisisoluko sesandla ubude bayo, nesoluko sesandla ububanzi bayo, ipindiwe.
Baye befaka kuyo inṙozo zane zamatye; olunye uṙozo lwaluyirubi, n etpoasze, nekabunukele: lwaluṙozo lwokuqala olu.
Lwaye uṙozo lwesibini luyisamagide, n esafire, neyahalome.
Lwaye uṙozo lwesitatu luyiyasinte, n eyagate, neyametisite.
Lwaye uṙozo lwesine luyikrusolite, n esadonutse, nejasipidi: avingcelwa izigingqini zegolide ezimfakweni zawo.
Amatye la ebenjengamagama onyana baka‐Sirayeli, elishumi linamabini, njengawo amagama abo, njeng eziqingqwa zaso isincamatiselo, elinye ngelinye linegama lalo, ngenxa yezizwe ezilishumi linesibini.
Benza kanjalo pezu kwembeka imixokolelwane ejijanisiweyo, isetyenzwa elitsontelweyo, ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Bazenza nezigingqi zazibini ngegolide, nemisesane yegolide yamibini; baza babeka imisesane leyo yomibini pezu kwazo incam ezimbini zembeka.
Baye befaka lomibini imixokolelwane etsontelweyo yegolide kuyo imisesane mibini esezincameni zembeka.
Kodwa ezinye incam ezimbini zemixokolelwane mibini etsontelweyo bazikonxa kuzo izigingqi zibini, bazibeka pezu kweziziba zamagxalaba zeyefodi, empambili, wayo.
Babuya bayenza imisesane mibini yegolide, bayimisa ezincameni ezimbini zembeka, empetweni wayo osecaleni leyefodi ngapakati.

Bayenza n eminye imisesane mibini yegolide, wayibeka pezu kweziziba zamagxalaba zozibini zeyefodi ngasezantsi, ngasempambili wayo, malungana nokubandakanywa kwayo, ngapezulu kwombinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi.

Baye benxibelela imbeka ngemisesane yayo kwa kuyo imisesane yeyefodi ngosinga lwezuluṙa, ukuba ibe pezulu kwawo umbinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi, nokuba imbeka ingashenxeki kuyo iyefodi; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Kanjako wayenza ingubo yaseyefodini ngesetyenzwa lomluki, ipela ngezuluṙa.
Kwakuko intunja pakati kwayo ingubo, njengentunja yesigcinisifuba; ibinompeto le ntunja ngento engqongayo, ize ingaṙazuki.
Bazenza pezu kwemiqukumbelo yengubo igranate zezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, neqiya epotiweyo.
Bazenza nezikencezelo zegolide ecocekileyo, babeka izikencezelo ezo pakati kwazo ingranate pezu kwemiqukumbelo yengubo, kwa ngento engqongayo pakati kwegranate;
kuze kwabako isikencezelo negranate, isikencezelo negranate, pezu kwemiqukumbelo yengubo ngento engqongayo; ukuba kukonzwe, njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Baye besenza ihempe ngeqiya eshiceneyo, ngensetyenzwa lomluki, zibe zezika‐Arone nezonyana bake;
nonkontsho ngeqiya eshiceneyo, neminqwazi emihle ngeqiya eshiceneyo, nebrukwe zeqiya ngepotiweyo eqiya eshiceneyo;
noqwemesha ngepotiweyo iqiya eshiceneyo, nezuluṙa, nesimnyama, nesibomvu, ngesetyenzwa lomtungi wamabala ngamabala; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Bayenza nembasa yekrone engcwele ngegolide ecocekileyo, baba̔la pezu kwayo isiba̔lo, njeng eziqingqwa zesincamatiselo, sokuti: ubungcwele kuyehova!
Baye bebopa kuyo usinga lwezuluṙa, ize ibekwe pezulu pezu kwalo unkontsho; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Kwada kwagqitywa wonke umsebenzi wayo itabanakele yentente yentlangano: lwaye usapo luka‐Sirayeli lube lwenzile njengako konke uyehova abemyalele u‐Mosesi ngako, lwenje njalo ke.
Baza bazisa itabanakele ku‐Mosesi, intente, nazo zonke impahla zayo, amakonxo ayo, ipanke zayo, imivalo yayo, nentsika zayo, neziseko zayo;
nesigubungelo sezintsu zenkunzi zegusha zenziwe bomvu, nesigubungelo sezintsu zamacelesi, nekuselo lelengalenga;
ityeya yesinqi̔no, nezibonda wayo, nesihlalo sofefe;
itafila, nazo zonke impahla zayo, nezokna zokubonakala;
ikandelare ecocekileyo, n ezibane zayo, izibane zokucwangciswa, nazo zonke impahla zayo, neoli yesikanyiso;
nesibingelo segolide, neoli yokutambisa, nesiqumiso esimnandi, nelengalenga locango lwetabanakele;
isibingelo sexina, neziko lexina esibe sinalo, izibonda zaso, nazo zonke impahla zaso; isihlambelo, nesikondo saso;
amalengalenga ebala, intsika zalo, neziseko zalo; nelengalenga lesango lebala, intambo zalo, nezikonkwane zalo, nazo zonke impahla zenkonzo yetabanakele, ezintente yentlangano;
izivato zobukonzo, zokuba kukonzwe kweyingcwele indawo; izivato ezingcwele zika‐Arone umperisite, nezivato zonyana bake, zokuba bakonze ngobuperisite.
Njengako konke uyehova abemyalele u‐Mosesi ngako, lwenza kwa ngokunjalo usapo luke‐Sirayeli wonke umsebenzi.
Waza u‐Mosesi wawukangela wonke umsebenzi, kekaloku bona ke, beluwenzile njengokuba uyehova ebeyalele; kwa ngokunjalo ke beluwenzile: wandula u‐Mosesi walutamsanqelisa.
WAZA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Ngomhla wenyanga yokuqala, ngowokuqala wenyanga, uya kupakamisa itabanakele yentente yentlangano.
Wauya kubeka kona ityeya yesinqi̔no; uze uyikusele ityeya ngekuselo.
Wandule ungenise itafile, ucwangcise izinto zokucwangciswa pezu kwayo; uti kanjalo ungenise ikandelare, umise izibane zayo.
Wauya kubeka isibingelo segolide sokuqumisela pambi kwayo ityeya yesinqi̔no; uze ulixo̔me ilengalenga locango etabanakeleni.
Wauya kubeka isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa pambi kwocango lwetabanakele yentente yentlangano.
Kanjako uya kubeka isihlambelo pakati kwentente yentlangano nesibingelo; uze ubeke kuso amanzi.
Wandule ulimise ibala ngento engqongayo, ulixo̔me ilengalenga esangweni lebala.
Wauya kutabata ioli yokutambisa, utambise itabanakele, nako konke okukuyo; uya kungcwalisa yona, nazo zonke impahla zayo, ize ibe yingcwele.
Uya kutambisa kanjalo isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa, nazo zonke impahla zaso; uya kungcwalisa isibingelo, size sibe sisibingelo esiyingcwelekazi.
Uya kutambisa nesihlambelo, naso isikondo saso, usingcwalise.
Kanjalo u‐Arone nonyana bake uya kubasondeza elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, ubahlambe ngamanzi.
Wauya kumambatisa u‐Arone izivato ezingcwele, uze umtambise, umngcwalise nokumngcwalisa, ukuba andikonze ngobuperisite.
Nonyana bake wobasondeza, ubambatise ihempe:
wauya kutambisa bona, njengokutambisa kwako uyise wabo, ukuba bandikonze ngobuperisite: ngokuba okunene ukutanjiswa kwabo kwoba kokwobuperisite obungunapakade kubo ngezizukulwana zabo.
Wenje njalo u‐Mosesi: njengako konke uyehova abemyalele kona, wenje njalo ke.
Kwaza kwati ngenyanga yokuqala, ngomnyaka wesibini, ngowokuqala umhla wenyanga, kwapakanyiswa itabanakele.
Waye u‐Mosesi wapakamisa itabanakele, wabeka iziseko zayo, wamisa iplanke zayo, wafaka imivalo yayo, wapakamisa intsika zayo.
Waza watwabulula intente pezu kwetabanakele, wabeka isigubungelo sentente pezulu pezu kwayo; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayetabata isinqi̔no wasifaka etyeyeni, wamisa izibonda pezu kwetyeya, wabeka isihlalo sofefe pezulu pezu kwetyeya.
Waza wangenisa ityeya etabanakeleni, walixo̔ma ikuselo lelengalenga, wayikusela ityeya yesinqi̔no: njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayebeka itafile ententeni yentlangano, ecaleni letabanakele ngasenode, ngapandle kwekuselo.
Waza wacwangcisa pezu kwayo uṙozo lwezonka pambi kwoyehova; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayebeka nekandelare ententeni yentlangano, malungana nayo itafile, ecaleni letabanakele ngasesuyide.
Waza wamisa izibane pambi kwoyehova; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayebeka nesibingelo segolide ententeni yentlangano, pambi kwekuselo;
waqumisa pezu kwaso isiqumiso esimnandi; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Waza walixo̔ma ilengalenga locango lwetabanakele.
Kanjalo isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa wasibeka ngaselucangweni lwayo itabanakele yentente yentlangano; wanikela pezu kwaso idini lokutshiswa nomnikelo wokudla; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wayemisa isihlambelo pakati kwentente yentlangano nesibingelo, wabeka kuso amanzi, ukuba kuhlanjwe.
Baye behlamba kuso u‐Mosesi, no‐Arone, nonyana bake, izandla zabo nenyawo zabo:
bati ekungeneni kwabo ententeni yentlangano, nasekusondeleni kwabo esibingelweni, bahlamba; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Waza wapakamisa ibala ngento engqongayo itabanakele nesibingelo, walixo̔ma ilengalenga lesango lebala. Wada wagqiba u‐Mosesi umsebenzi.
Landula ilifu lasibekela intente yentlangano, bati ubungcwalisa bukayehova bazalisa itabanakele.
Waye u‐Mosesi wakohlwa kukungena ententeni yentlangano, ngokokuba ilifu lihleli pezu kwayo, nokuba ubungcwalisa bukayehova buzalisile itabanakele.
Kwati kwakunyuswa ilifu kuyo itabanakele, lwaza lwahamba usapo luka‐Sirayeli kuzo zonke ihambo zalo:
kodwa xeshekweni ilifu linganyuswanga, lwaza alwahamba kwada kwayimini yokunyuswa kwalo.
Ngokuba ilifu likayehova libe lipezu kwetabanakele ngemini, nomlilo ubupezu kwayo ngobusuku, emehlweni ayo yonke indlu yo‐Sirayeli, kuzo zonke ihambo zabo.
WAZA uyehova wabiza u‐Mosesi, wateta kuye esententeni yentlangano, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Nxa umntu wakuni aya kunikela umnikelo kuyehova, niya kunikela umnikelo wenu uvela ezinkomeni, kwezinkulu nakwezincinane.

Ukuba umnikelo wake ulidini lokutshiswa livela ezinkomeni ezinkulu, yoba yinkunzi emsulwa aya kunikela ngayo: ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano uya kunikela yona, ngenxa yokubukwa kwake pambi kwoyehova.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yedini lokutshiswa; eliya kubukwa ngenxa yake limxolisele.
Waeya kuxe̔la inkunzana leyo pambi kwoyehova; boti onyana baka‐Arone, abaperisite, balisondeze igazi, balisasaze igazi pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo, eso siselucangweni lwentente yentlangano:
andule ahlinze idini lokutshiswa, alicande ezitweni zalo.
Baye onyana baka‐Arone umperisite beya kubeka umlilo pezu kwesibingelo, bazicwangcise inkuni pezu kwomlilo.
Boti kanjalo onyana baka‐Arone, abaperisite, bacwangcise izito, intloko, nenqata, pezu kwenkuni ezisemlilweni opezu kwesibingelo:
kodwa umbilini walo nentungo zalo uya kuzihlanza ngamanzi: oko konke umperisite uya kukutshisa pezu kwesibingelo, kube lidini lokutshiswa, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Ukuba kanjalo uvela ezinkomeni ezincinane umnikelo wake, ezigusheni, umhlaumbi ezibokweni, libe lidini lokutshiswa, yoba yinkunzi emsulwa aya kunikela ngayo.
Waeya kuxe̔la yona ecaleni lesibingelo, ngasenode, pambi kwoyehova: boti onyana baka‐Arone, abaperisite, balisasaze igazi layo pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Waeya kuyicanda ezitweni zayo, kunye nentloko yayo nenqata layo; ati umperisite azicwangcise pezu kwenkuni ezisemlilweni opezu kwesibingelo:
kodwa umbilini nentungo uya kuzihlanza ngamanzi: oko konke umperisite wokusondeza, akutshise pezu kwesibingelo: lidini lokutshiswa, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Kanjako ukuba ulidini lokutshiswa livela ezintakeni umnikelo wake kuyehova, uya kwandula anikele umnikelo wake uvela emahobeni, umhlaumbi ematoleni ezuba.
Woti umperisite alisondeze esibingelweni, alinyikile intloko, atshise yona pezu kwesibingelo; laye igazi lalo liya kufocelwa ngasecaleni lesibingelo.
Nendlelo yalo kunye nomswane wayo uya kuyisusa, ayipose kufupi nesibingelo ngasempumalanga, endaweni yotutu.

Waeya kulicanda ngamapiko alo, angalahluki kanye kodwa; andule umperisite alitshise pezu kwesibingelo, pezu kwenkuni ezisemlilweni: lidini lokutshiswa, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
XESHEKWENI umntu aya kunikela ngomnikelo ongowokudla kuyehova, umnikelo wake woba ngowomgubo ocolekileyo: uya kugalela ioli pezu kwawo, nentlakamhlope uya kuyibeka pezu kwawo.

Waeya kuwuzisa konyana baka‐Arone, kubaperisite; ati omnye abambe kwa kona ngento ezalisa isandla sake kumgubo ocolekileyo wawo, nakwioli yawo, kunye nayo yonke intlakamhlope yawo; aze umperisite asitshise isikunjuzelwa sawo pezu kwesibingelo, sibe ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Oko kuseleyo kumnikelo wokudla, kwoba kokuka‐Arone nokwonyana bake: uyinto eyingcwelekazi kuyo iminikelo eyenziwayo ngomlilo kayehova.
Naxeshekweni uya kunikela ngomnikelo ongowokudla, into eyojiweyo eziko, woba ngowezingenagwele izonkana zomgubo ocolekileyo zinyeliwe ngeoli, nezingenagwele izonkanyana zitanjisiwe ngeoli.
Nokuba umnikelo wako ungowokudla owojiwayo elukambeni, woba ngowomgubo ocolekileyo ongenagwele, unyeliwe ngeoli.
Uya kuwuqezula emaqezwini, uze ugalele ioli pezu kwawo: ngumnikelo wokudla wona.
Ukuba kanjalo ungowokudla opekwayo embizeni umnikelo wako, uya kwenziwa ngomgubo ocolekileyo uneoli.
Wauya kuzisa umnikelo wokudla owenziweyo ngezizinto kuyehova; andule ati umperisite, akunikelwa wona, awusondeze esibingelweni.
Waye umperisite eya kususa kumnikelo wokudla isikunjuzelwa sawo, asitshise pezu kwesibingelo: ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Oko kuseleyo kumnikelo wokudla, kwoba kokuka‐Arone nokwonyana bake: uyinto eyingcwelekazi kuyo iminikelo eyenziwayo ngomlilo kayehova.
Akuko mnikelo wokudla, eniya kunikela ngawo kuyehova, oya kwenziwa ngegwele; ngokuba igwele nobusi ningayi kutshisa nanye into enazo ibe ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova:
umnikelo wolibo niya kunikela wona unazo kuyehova; kodwa azisayi kunyukela esibingelweni libe livumba elimnandi.

Nayo yonke iminikelo yomnikelo wokudla wako uya kumvumvuzela yona ngetyuwa; kanjako akuyi kupelisa ityuwa yocebano lwotixo wako kuwo umnikelo wokudla wako: yonke iminikelo yako uya kuyinikela inetyuwa.

Naxeshekweni uya kunikela ngomnikelo wokudla welibo zako kuyehova, ngezikwebu eziluhlaza zenqolowa zojiwe ngomlilo, ngenqolowa ecutyiweyo ezikwebini ezibonxileyo, uya kunikela umnikelo wokudla welibo zako.
Wauya kubeka ioli pezu kwawo, nentlakamhlope uya kuyibeka pezu kwawo: ngumnikelo wokudla wona.
Waye umperisite eya kutshisa isikunjuzelwa sawo, inxenye yenqolowa ecutyiweyo yawo, nenxenye yeoli yawo, kunye nayo yonke intlakamhlope yawo: ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
KANJAKO ukuba ngumbingo woxolo umnikelo wake: ukuba uyanikela ngenkomo, nokuba yinkunzi, nokuba yimazi, woyinikela emsulwa ebusweni bukayehova.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yomnikelo wake, awuxe̔le ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano; boti onyana baka‐Arone, abaperisite, basasaze igazi pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo:
andule awunikele uvela kulombingo woxolo umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova; inqata eligubungela umbilini, nalo lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini,
nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, elingasezintsendweni; nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, kunye nezintso, wozisusa.
Baye onyana baka‐Arone beya kutshisa lona esibingelweni, pezu kwedini lokutshiswa, elipezu kwenkuni ezisemlilweni: ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Ukuba kanjalo uvela ezinkomeni ezincinane umnikelo wake, ube ngumbingo woxolo kuyehova; nokuba yinkunzi, nokuba yimazi, woyinikela imsulwa.
Ukuba yimvana anikela ngayo umnikelo wake, makanikele yona ebusweni bukayehova.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yomnikelo wake, awuxe̔le pambi kwentente yentlangano; boti onyana baka‐Arone basasaze igazi lawo pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo:

andule awunikele uvela kulombingo woxolo umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova; inqata lawo, umsila upela, aya kuwususa kufupi nomqolo, nenqata eligubungela umbilini, nalo lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini,
nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, elingasezintsendweni; nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, kunye nezintso, wozisusa.
Lona umperisite wolitshisa esibingelweni: kukutya kwomnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Nokuba yibokwe umnikelo wake, makayinikele ebusweni bukayehova.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yayo, ayixe̔le pambi kwentente yentlangano; boti onyana baka‐Arone balisasaze igazi layo pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo:
andule awunikele uvela kwa kuyo umnikelo wake, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova; inqata eligubungela umbilini, nalo lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini,
nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, elingasezintsendweni; nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, kunye nezintso, woyisusa.
Lamanqata umperisite wowatshisa esibingelweni: kukutya kwomnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, libe livumba elimnandi; lonke inqata le— likayehova.
Kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade ezizukulwaneni zenu, kuzo zonke indawo zokuhlala zenu, okokuba ningadli nenqata negazi.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Nxa onayo umntu ngesiposo ngakweminye imiyalelo kayehova, ngezinto ezinga zingenziwa, enze into ngakwomnye kuyo:
ukuba umperisite otanjisiweyo uya kwona libe lityala labantu, makanikele ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso, inkunzana elitole lenkomo emsulwa kuyehova, ibe lidini lesono.
Waeya kuzisa inkunzana leyo elucangweni lwentente yentlangano pambi kwoyehova; aze alalise isandla sake pezu kwentloko yenkunzana, ayixe̔le inkunzana pambi kwoyehova.
Andule ati umperisite otanjisiweyo acapule egazini lenkunzana, alizise ententeni yentlangano:
ati umperisite kanjalo awufake umnwe wake egazini; aze ati fefe kwelogazi amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe ebusweni bukayehova, pambi kwekuselo leyingcwele indawo.

Waye umperisite eya kubeka inxenye yelogazi pezu kwempondo zesibingelo sesiqumiso esimnandi ebusweni bukayehova, esisententeni yentlangano; nalo lonke elinye igazi lenkunzana woligalela ngasesekweni lesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa, esisemnyango wentente yentlangano.
Kanjako lonke inqata lenkunzana yedini lesono uya kulisusa kuyo; inqata eligubungela umbilini, nalo lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini,
nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, elingasezintsendweni; nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, kunye nezintso, wozisusa,
njengokuba zibe zisuswa kuyo inkomo yombingo woxolo: lamanqata umperisite wowatshisa pezu kwesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa.
Kodwa isikumba senkunzana, nayo yonke inyama yayo, kunye nentloko yayo, nakunye nentungo zayo, nombilini wayo, nomswane wayo,
kwa inkunzana leyo ipela woyikupela pandle kwomnquba, endaweni emhlope, apo ututu lugalelwa kona, ayitshise pezu kwenkuni ngomlilo: ngasekugalelweni kwotutu iya kutshiswa.

Ukuba kanjalo yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli iya kuposisa, ize ifihlwe indawo emehlweni omhlambi, nxa benzile into ngakw omnye kuyo yonke imiyalelo kayehova, ngezinto ezinga zingenziwa, bada banetyala;
kwoti ke, sakwazeka esosono bonile ngaso ngakuwo, wandule umhlambi unikele ngenkunzana elitole lenkomo, ibe lidini lesono, uyizise pambi kwentente yentlangano;
baze abadala bentlanganiso balalise izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzana ebusweni bukayehova, iti inkunzana ixe̔lwe pambi kwoyehova.
Andule umperisite otanjisiweyo azise inxenye yegazi lenkunzana ententeni yentlangano.
Waye umperisite eya kufaka umnwe wake, acapule kwelogazi, ati fefe amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe ebusweni bukayehova, pambi kwekuselo.

Nakulo igazi elo uya kubeka inxenye pezu kwempondo zesibingelo esipambi kwoyehova, esisententeni yentlangano; aze agalele lonke elinye igazi ngasesekweni lesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa, esisemnyango wentente yentlangano.
Nalo lonke inqata layo wolisusa kuyo, alitshise pezu kwesibingelo.
Waeya kwenzela lenkunzana, njengokuba ebesenzela inkunzana yedini lesono; uya kwenzela le ngokunjalo: woti umperisite abaxolisele, baze baxolelwe.
Nenkunzana leyo woyikupela pandle kwomnquba, atshise yona njengokuba ebeyitshisa inkunzana yokuqala: lidini lesono lomhlambi yona.
Oko oyinkosi aya kwona, enze into ngakw omnye kuyo yonke imiyalelo kayehova, utixo wake, ngezinto ezinga zingenziwa, ngesiposo, ade abe netyala;
ngati umhlaumbi kuyaziswa kuye isono sake onileyo ngaso; uya kwandula azisele umnikelo wake itakane lebokwe, liyinkunzi emsulwa.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yebokwe, ayixe̔le endaweni apo kuxe̔lwa kona idini lokutshiswa pambi kwoyehova: lidini lesono yona.

Andule umperisite acapule egazini ledini lesono ngomnwe wake, alibeke pezu kwempondo zaso isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa; n elinye igazi lalo uya kugalela lona ngasesekweni lesibingelo sedini lokutshiswa.
Nalo lonke inqata lalo wolitshisa pezu kwesibingelo, njengalo inqata lombingo woxolo; woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenxa yesono sake, size simxolelwe.
Naxeshekweni omnye wasebantwini belizwe onayo ngesiposo, ngokwenza kwake into ngakw omnye kuyo imiyalelo kayehova, ngezinto ezinga zingenziwa, ade abe netyala;
ngati umhlaumbi kuyaziswa kuye isono sake onileyo ngaso; uya kwandula azisele umnikelo wake itakane lebokwe, liyimazi emsulwa, ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yedini lesono, alixe̔le idini lesono endaweni yedini lokutshiswa.
Andule umperisite acapule egazini lalo ngomnwe wake, alibeke pezu kwempondo zaso isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa; nalo lonke elinye igazi lalo uya kugalela lona ngasesekweni lesibingelo eso.

Kanjako lonke inqata lalo wolisusa, njengokuba inqata lisuswa kuwo umbingo woxolo; waye umperisite eya kulitshisa pezu kwesibingelo, libe livumba elimnandi kuyehova: woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso, aze axolelwe.
Kodwa ukuba uyazisela umnikelo wake imvana ibe lidini lesono, yoba yimazi emsulwa aya kuyizisa.
Waeya kulalisa isandla sake pezu kwentloko yedini lesono, ayixe̔le imvanakazi ibe lidini lesono endaweni apo kuxe̔lwa kona idini lokutshiswa.
Andule umperisite acapule egazini ledini lesono ngomnwe wake, alibeke pezu kwempondo zaso isibingelo sedini lokutshiswa; nalo lonke elinye igazi lalo uya kugalela lona ngasesekweni lesibingelo eso.

Kanjako lonke inqata lalo wolisusa, njengokuba inqata lemvana lisuswa kuwo umbingo woxolo; waye umperisite eya kutshisa amanqata lawo esibingelweni, pezu kweminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova: woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso, size simxolelwe.
XESHEKWENI umntu onayo, ekubeni elivile ilizwi lesifungiso, elinqi̔na nje, nokuba ubonile, nokuba wazile; ukuba akaxeleli, uya kutwala inkohlakalo yake.

Naxeshekweni umntu acukumisayo enye into enco̔lileyo, nokuba sisidumbu sesilo esinco̔lileyo, nokuba sisidumbu senkomo enco̔lileyo, nokuba sisidumbu sesinambuzane esinco̔lileyo, kuze kumfihlelwe; unco̔lile naye, unetyala.
Naxeshekweni acukumisayo ukunco̔la kwomntu, noko ukunco̔la kwake kunjanina anco̔lisiwe ngako, kuze kumfihlelwe; woti akukwazi, abe netyala.

Naxeshekweni umntu afungayo, enxama ukuteta ngomlomo ukuba enze okubi, umhlaumbi ukuba enze okulungileyo, noko kuyinto enjanina umntu uya kunxama ukuyiteta ngesifungo, kuze kumfihlelwe; woti akukwazi, abe netyala ngenye yezi zinto.
Kwakuya kuti, nxa anetyala ngenye yezi zinto, uya kuxela ukuba wonile ngalo nto:

waeya kuzisela ityala lake kuyehova, ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso, imazi yasezinkomeni ezincinane, imvanakazi umhlaumbi itakanekazi lebokwe, ibe lidini lesono; ati umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenxa yesono sake.

Kodwa ukuba isandla sake asinakufikela okwanele inkomo encinane, makazisele ityala lake, onileyo ngalo, amahobe abe mabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba abe mabini, kuyehova; elinye libe leledini lesono, elinye libe leledini lokutshiswa.
Uya kuzisa wona kumperisite, oya kunikela eledini lesono kuqala, alinyikile intloko ngasentanyeni, angalahluli kanye kodwa.
Waeya kufefa ngegazi ledini lesono pezu kwecala lesibingelo; koko isisalela segazi liya kufocelwa ngasesekweni lesibingelo: lidini lesono lona.
Nelesibini uya kulenza idini lokutshiswa, njengesiko; ati umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso, size simxolelwe.

Kodwa ukuba isandla sake asinakufikela amahobe amabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba amabini, makazisele umnikelo wake, lowo owonileyo, eseshumi isiqingata seyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo ube lidini lesono; akayi kubeka pezu kwawo ioli, akayi kubeka pezu kwawo intlakamhlope kanjalo: ngokuba wona ulidini lesono.

Andule awuzise kumperisite, ati umperisite abambe kuwo into ezalisa isandla sake, isikunjuzelwa sawo, asitshise pezu kwesibingelo, pezu kwayo iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova: ulidini lesono wona.
Waye umperisite eya kumenzela uxoliso ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso ngenye yezi zinto, size simxolelwe; siti isisalela sibe sesomperisite, njengawo umnikelo wokudla.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Nxa agqita umntu ngesigqito, one nokwona ngesiposo, kwezingcwele izinto zikayehova; uya kwandula azisele ityala lake kuyehova inkunzi yegusha emsulwa ivela emhlambini, ngokulinganisa kwako neshekele zesilivere, ezingangeshekele yeyingcwele indawo, ibe lidini letyala.

Nalonto onileyo ngayo kweyingcwele into woyibuyekezela, nesesihlanu isiqingata sayo uya kusongeza pezu kwayo, ayinike kumperisite; woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenkunzi yegusha yedini letyala, aze axolelwe.
Naxeshekweni umntu onayo, enze into ngakw omnye kuyo yonke imiyalelo kayehova, ngezinto ezinga zingenziwa; nakuba engayazi, unetyala noko; uya kutwala nenkohlakalo yake.

Waeya kuzisa inkunzi yegusha emsulwa ivela emhlambini, njengokulinganisa kwako, ibe lidini letyala, kumperisite; woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso ngenxa yesiposo sake aposisile ngaso, abengasazi; sasiya kumxolelwa.
Lidini letyala yona; unetyala ngenyaniso kuye uyehova.
Wateta uyehova kanjalo ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Ukuba umntu uyona, agqite ngesigqito ngakuye uyehova, amxokise ummelwane wake ngento enikelwe ekugcineni kwake, umhlaumbi ngento ebekelwe kuye, umhlaumbi ngento epangiweyo; ati umhlaumbi amlumkise ummelwane wake,
umhlaumbi afumane into elahlekileyo, aze axoke ngayo, afunge ngobuxoki; kwenye yezizinto zonke azenzayo umntu, esona ngazo;

kwoti ke, ngokuba onile, enetyala nje, wobuyisa lonto epangiweyo owayipangayo, umhlaumbi lonzuzo ingalungileyo walumkisa ngayo, umhlaumbi lonto yokugcinelwa ebinikelwa ekugcineni kwake, umhlaumbi lonto ilahlekileyo owayifumanayo,

umhlaumbi enye into kuko konke asukuba efungile pezu kwako ngobuxoki; wobuyekezela yona ngenani layo, nesesihlanu isiqingata salo wosongeza pezu kwalo; kulowo into iyeyake woyinika ngomhla wetyala lake.
Waeya kuzisela ityala lake kuyehova, inkunzi yegusha emsulwa ivela emhlambini, njengokulinganisa kwako, ibe lidini letyala, kumperisite;
woti umperisite amenzele uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova, kwakuya kumxolelwa pezu kwenye into kuko konke asukuba ekwenzile anetyala ngayo.
WABUYA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Yalela u‐Arone nonyana bake, ngokuti: Nguwo lo umteto wedini lokutshiswa: lidini lokutshiswa lona, ngenxa yokuvuta pezu kwesibingelo bonke ubusuku kude kuse, ngokuba umlilo wesibingelo uya kuhlala uvuta kuso.
Woti umperisite ayambate ingubo yake yeqiya, nebrukwe yeqiya ayambate pezu kwenyama yake, aze asuse ututu, oko umlilo seugqibele idini lokutshiswa pezu kwesibingelo, alubeke ngasecaleni lesibingelo.
Andule atule izivato zake, ambate izivato zimbi, apume notutu olo ukuya ngapandle kwomnquba, endaweni emhlope.

Waye umlilo esibingelweni uya kuhlala uvuta kuso; awusayi kucinywa; umperisite uya kupemba inkuni pezu kwawo imiso ngemiso, acwangcise nedini lokutshiswa pezu kwawo; waeya kutshisa pezu kwawo inqata leminikelo yoxolo.
Umlilo womana uvuta futi esibingelweni; awusayi kucinywa.
Kanjalo nguwo lo umteto womnikelo wokudla: wona omnye wonyana baka‐Arone wowunikela ebusweni bukayehova, ngapambi kwesibingelo.

Waeya kususa kuwo ngento ezalisa isandla sake, kwa kuwo umgubo ocolekileyo womnikelo wokudla, nakuyo ioli yawo, nayo yonke intlakamhlope epezu kwawo umnikelo wokudla; andule atshise pezu kwesibingelo, libe livumba elimnandi, isikunjuzelwa sawo, kuyehova.
Nokuseleyo kuwo baya kukudla u‐Arone nonyana bake: kwotyiwa kungenagwele endaweni eyingcwele; ebaleni lentente yentlangano baya kukudla.
Akuyi kwojwa kubilisiwe: kusisabelwa sabo endibanikile sona, kuyo iminikelo yam eyenziwa ngomlilo; kuyinto eyingcwelekazi, njengedini lesono, nanjengedini letyala.
Konke okubudoda pakati kwabantwana baka‐Arone kuya kukutya. Ngummiselwa ongunapakade ezizukulwaneni zenu ngayo iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova: konke okuyicukumisayo kwoba kungcwele.
Waye uyehova wateta ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Nguwo lo umnikelo ka‐Arone nonyana bake, abaya kunikela ngawo kuyehova ngomhla wokutanjiswa kwake: eseshumi isiqingata seyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo, ube ngumnikelo wokudla ofuti; esinye isiqingata sawo kwakusa, nesinye isiqingata sawo kwakuhlwa.
Pezu kwokamba uya kwenziwa ngeoli; unyakanyisiwe uya kuwuzisa; n amaqezu ojiweyo omnikelo wokudla uya kunikela wona abe livumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Umperisite otanjisiweyo esikundleni sake konyana bake wowunikela: ngummiselwa ongunapakade kuyehova; wogqityelwa ukutshiswa.
Ngokuba yonke iminikelo yokudla yomperisite iya kugqityelwa ukutshiswa; ayisayi kutyiwa.
Wati kanjalo uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta ku‐Arone nakonyana bake, usiti: Nguwo lo umteto wedini lesono: endaweni apo kuxe̔lwayo idini lokutshiswa, liya kuxe̔lwa kona idini lesono ebusweni bukayehova: liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona.
Umperisite olinikelayo ngenxa yesono uya kulidla; kweyingcwele indawo liya kudliwa, ebaleni lentente yentlangano.
Konke okuyicukumisayo inyama yalo kwoba kungcwele: naxeshekweni kufefiwe ngegazi lalo pezu kwesivato, lonto kwafefwa pezu kwayo woyihlanza endaweni eyingcwele:
kodwa into yodongwe lipekiwe kuyo iya kuqekezwa; ukuba kanti lipekiwe entweni yexina, iya kuhlanjululwa yona, iyalazwe ngamanzi.
Konke okubudoda pakati kwabaperisite kuya kulidla: liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona.
Kodwa onke amadini esono, ekuziswa inxenye yegazi lawo ententeni yentlangano, kuze kuxoliswe kweyingcwele indawo, wona akasayi kudliwa; aya kutshiswa ngomlilo.
Kanjalo nguwo lo umteto wedini letyala: liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona.
Endaweni apo kuxe̔lwayo idini lokutshiswa, liya kuxe̔lwa kona idini letyala; negazi lalo wolisasaza pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Nakulo uya kunikela lonke inqata lalo, umsila, nenqata eligubungela umbilini,
nezintso zombini, nenqata elipezu kwazo, elingasezintsendweni; nendawo ezizengezelayo pezu kwesibindi, kunye nezintso, wozisusa.
Waye umperisite eya kutshisa amanqata lawo esibingelweni, abe ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova: lidini letyala.
Konke okubudoda pakati kwabaperisite kuya kulidla; endaweni eyingcwele liya kudliwa: liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona.
Njengedini lesono, likwa njalo idini letyala; anomteto umnye: umperisite owenzayo uxoliso ngalo, loba lelake.
Kanjako umperisite onikelayo idini lokutshiswa lomntu, isikumba sedini lokutshiswa anikele ngalo soba sesake lowamperisite.
Nako konke okwomnikelo wokudla okwojiweyo eziko, nako konke okwenziweyo embizeni napezu kwokamba, kwoba kokwomperisite owunikelayo.
Kodwa yonke iminikelo yokudla enyeliweyo ngeoli, neyomileyo, bonke onyana baka‐Arone boba nayo, omnye njengomnye.
Nguwo lo nomteto wombingo woxolo, aya kunikela wona kuyehova.

Ukuba uyawunikela ube ngumbulelo, makanikele kunye nombingo wombulelo izonkana ezingenagwele zinyeliwe ngeoli, nezonkanyana ezingenagwele zitanjisiwe ngeoli; nomgubo ocolekileyo unyakanyisiwe, izonkana zinyeliwe ngeoli.
Ngapandle kwezonkana ez o, uya kunikelela umnikelo wake isonka esibilisiweyo, kunye nombingo wombulelo weminikelo yoxolo yake.
Nakuso uya kunikela esinye kuwo wonke umnikelo sibe ngumnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa kuyehova; soba sesalomperisite otshizayo igazi leminikelo yoxolo.
Nenyama yombingo wombulelo weminikelo yoxolo yake, yona iya kutyiwa kwa ngomhla wokunikelwa kwayo; akuyi kushiywa nto kude kuse.
Kodwa ukuba sisibambiso, umhlaumbi ngumnikelo wesisa, umbingo wokunikela kwake, uya kutyiwa wona ngomhla aya kunikela umbingo wake ngawo; kwoti nangomnye umhla kudliwe okuseleyo kuwo:
koko okuseleyo kwinyama yombingo ngowesitatu umhla kuya kutshiswa ngomlilo.
Nokuba kuka kudliwe enyameni yombingo woxolo wake ngowesitatu umhla, akayi kubukwa lowo oyinikelayo, ayiyi kumbalelwa, yoba yinto edlubukileyo; nomntu otyayo kuyo, yena uya kutwala inkohlakalo yake.
Kanjako inyama ecukumisayo enye into enco̔lileyo ayiyi kudliwa; iya kutshiswa ngomlilo; kanti inyama engenjalo, lonyama bonke abacocekileyo baya kutya yona.
Kodwa lowamntu odlayo inyama yombingo woxolo, ongo kayehova, enokunco̔la kwake pezu kwake, uya kunqanyulwa lowamntu ebantwini bake.

Naxeshekweni umntu acukumisayo enye into enco̔lileyo, ukunco̔la kwomntu, umhlaumbi isilo esinco̔lileyo, umhlaumbi enye intshontsho enco̔lileyo, aze atye kuyo inyama yombingo woxolo, ongo kayehova, uya kunqanyulwa lowamntu ebantwini bake.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Lonke inqata lenkomo, nelegusha, nelebokwe, aniyi kulidla.
Inqata lesidumbu, nenqata lento eqwengiweyo, lingapatwa emisebenzini yonke; kodwa anikuka nilidle nakanye.
Ngokuba osukuba esidla inqata lenkomo, ekunikelwe ngayo umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova, kwa lowamntu olidlayo wonqanyulwa ebantwini bake.
Kanjako lonke igazi aniyi kulidla kuzo zonke indawo zokuhlala zenu, elentaka nelenkomo.
Umntu osukuba esidla elinye igazi, uya kunqanyulwa lowamntu ebantwini bake.
Wateta uyehova kanjalo ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Lowo onikelayo ngombingo woxolo wake kuyehova, makazise umnikelo wake kuyehova uvela kuwo umbingo woxolo wake.

Ezake izandla ziya kuzisa iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova; inqata pezu kwesifuba wolizisa kunye nesifuba eso, ukuba sishukushukunyiswe sona sibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa ebusweni bukayehova.
Waye umperisite eya kutshisa elonqata pezu kwesibingelo; kodwa isifuba soba sesika‐Arone nesonyana bake.
Nowokunene umkono niya kunika wona kumperisite ube ngumnikelo wokufunqufunqulwa, kuyo imibingo yoxolo yenu.
Lowo onikelayo igazi leminikelo yoxolo, nenqata, kubo onyana baka‐Arone, woba ngowake umkono wokunene ube sisahlulelwa sake.

Ngokuba isifuba sokushukushukunyiswa nomkono wokufunqufunqulwa ndizicapule elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, kuyo imibingo yoxolo yalo, ndazinika ku‐Arone umperisite, nakonyana bake, ngommiselo ongunapakade, zivela kulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Oku kukokwokutanjiswa kuka‐Arone, nokwokutanjiswa kwonyana bake, kuvela kuyo iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova, emhleni abebasondeza ukuza kukonza ngobuperisite kuyehova;
oko uyehova waxela ukuba kunikwe kubo, emhleni wokubatambisa kwake, lusapo luka‐Sirayeli, ube ngummiselwa ongunapakade ngezizukulwana zalo.
Nguwo lo umteto wedini lokutshiswa, n owomnikelo wokudla, nowedini lesono, nowedini letyala, noweminikelo yokuzalisa, nowombingo woxolo;
lowo uyehova wayalela u‐Mosesi ngawo entabeni ye‐Sinai, emhleni wayalelayo usapo luka‐Sirayeli ukuba lunikele iminikelo yalo kuyehova, entlango ye‐Sinai.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Tabata u‐Arone nonyana bake kunye naye, nezivato, neoli yokutambisa, nenkunzana yedini lesono, nenkunzi zegusha zimbini, nesitya sezonka ezingenagwele;
uze ubutele yonke intlanganiso elucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Wenza u‐Mosesi njengokuba wabemyalela uyehova; yaza yonke intlanganiso yabutelwa elucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Wandula wati u‐Mosesi entlanganisweni: Yiyo le into uyehova ayalele ngayo ukuba yenziwe.
Waye u‐Mosesi wasondeza u‐Arone nonyana bake, wabahlamba ngamanzi.
Waza wamfaka ihempe, wambinqisa uqwemesha, wamambatisa ingubo; wamfaka neyefodi, wambinqisa nombinqo ocikiziweyo weyefodi, wayibopa kuye ngawo.
Wayebeka pezu kwake imbeka, wafaka embekeni i‐Urime ne‐Tumime.
Wabeka nonkontsho pezu kwentloko yake; napezu kwonkontsho, ngakubo ubuso bake, wabeka imbasa yegolide, ikrone engcwele; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Waza u‐Mosesi watabata ioli yokutambisa, watambisa itabanakele nento zonke ezikuyo, wazingcwalisa.
Wayefefa ngayo pezu kwesibingelo amaxesha asixe̔nxe, watambisa isibingelo nazo zonke impahla zaso, kunye nesihlambelo nesikondo saso, zize zingcwaliswe.
Nenxenye yeoli yokutambisa wayigalela pezu kwentloko ka‐Arone, wamtambisa, ukuba amngcwalise.
Waza u‐Mosesi wabasondeza onyana baka‐Arone, wabavatisa ihempe, wababinqisa ingqwemesha, wabopa kubo iminqwazi; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wandula wayisondeza inkunzana yedini lesono; bati u‐Arone nonyana bake balalisa izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzana yedini lesono.

Kwaye kuxe̔lwa ke; waza u‐Mosesi watabata igazi, walibeka ezimpondweni zesibingelo ngento engqongayo ngomnwe wake, wasihlambulula isibingelo; wandula waligalela igazi ngasesekweni lesibingelo, wasingcwalisa, kuze kwenziwe uxoliso pezu kwaso.
Wayetabata lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini, nendawo ezizengezelayo zesibindi, nezintso zombini, nenqata lazo; waza u‐Mosesi walitshisa esibingelweni.
Kodwa inkunzana nesikumba sayo, inyama yayo nomswane wayo, wazitshisa ngomlilo ngapandle kwomnquba; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wandula wasondeza inkunzi yegusha yedini lokutshiswa; bati u‐Arone nonyana bake balalisa izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzi yegusha.
Kwaye kuxe̔lwa ke; waza u‐Mosesi walisasaza igazi pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Nenkunzi yegusha wayicanda ezitweni zayo; waye u‐Mosesi watshisa intloko, nezito, nenqata;

kodwa umbilini nentungo wazihlanza ngamanzi; waza u‐Mosesi watshisa lonkunzi yegusha ipela esibingelweni: ibilidini lokutshiswa libe livumba elimnandi, ibingumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Wandula wayisondeza eyesibini inkunzi yegusha, inkunzi yegusha yokuzalisa; bati u‐Arone nonyana bake balalisa izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yenkunzi yegusha.
Kwaye kuxe̔lwa ke; waza u‐Mosesi wacapula kwigazi layo, walibeka pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe ka‐Arone, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sake, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwake.

Wasondeza onyana baka‐Arone nabo; waye u‐Mosesi wabeka inxenye yegazi elo pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yabo, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sabo, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwabo: wati kanjalo u‐Mosesi wasasaza igazi pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Waza watabata inqata, nomsila, nalo lonke inqata elipezu kwombilini, nendawo ezizengezelayo zesibindi, nezintso zombini, nenqata lazo, nowokunene umkono:

nakuso isitya sezonka ezingenagwele, esipambi kwoyehova, watabata isonkana sinye esingenagwele, nesonkana sinye sesonka esineoli, nesonkanyana sikwa sinye, wazibeka pezu kwamanqata lawo, napezu kwowokunene umkono.
Ezo nto zonke wazinika ezandleni zika‐Arone, nasezandleni zonyana bake, wazishukushukumisa zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova.
Waza u‐Mosesi wazitabata ezandleni zabo, wazitshisa esibingelweni, pezu kwedini lokutshiswa: zayiminikelo yokuzalisa libe livumba elimnandi; ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.

Kanjako u‐Mosesi watabata isifuba, wasishukushukumisa sibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova: sibe sisisabelwa sika‐Mosesi sivela kuyo inkunzi yegusha yokuzalisa; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.

Wandula u‐Mosesi wacapula kuyo ioli yokutambisa, nakulo igazi elipezu kwesibingelo, wati fefe pezu kwo‐Arone, na pezu kwezivato zake, napezu kwonyana bake, napezu kwezivato zonyana bake kunye naye; wangcwalisa u‐Arone, n ezivato zake, nonyana bake, nezivato zonyana bake kunye naye.

Waza u‐Mosesi wati ku‐Arone nakonyana bake: Pekani lonyama elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, niyidle kona apo, kwa nesonka esikuso isitya seminikelo yokuzalisa, njengoko ndiyaleleyo, ndisiti: u‐Arone nonyana bake baya kuyidla.
Nokuseleyo kuyo inyama nakuso isonka niya kukutshisa ngomlilo.

Kanjalo aniyi kupuma elucangweni lwentente yentlangano imihla ibe sixe̔nxe, ude ubeko umhla wokuzalisekiswa kwayo imihla yeminikelo yokuzalisa yenu: ngokuba yimihla isixe̔nxe kuya kuzaliswa izandla zenu ngayo.
Njengokuba kwenziwe namhla nje, uyalele uyehova ukuba kwenjwe njalo, ukuze nenzelwe uxoliso.
Kukona niya kuhlala elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, imini nobusuku, imihla ibe sixe̔nxe, nisigcine isigcinelo sikayehova, ukuze ningafi: ngokuba kungokunjalo endiyalelweyo.
Bati u‐Arone nonyana bake benza zonke izinto abeziyalele uyehova ngesandla sika‐Mosesi.
Kwaye kute ngomhla wesibozo, u‐Mosesi wabiza u‐Arone, nonyana bake, nabadala bo‐Sirayeli;
wati kuye u‐Arone: Zitabatele inkonyana, itole lenkomo, ibe lidini lesono, nenkunzi yegusha ibe lidini lokutshiswa, ezo zimsulwa, uzisondeze pambi kwoyehova.
Uze utete kulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Tabatani itakane lebokwe libe lidini lesono, kwa nenkonyana nemvana, zizezomnyaka mnye, zimsulwa, zibe lidini lokutshiswa;
kwa nenkabi nenkunzi yegusha zibe zezeminikelo yoxolo, kuze kubingelwe ebusweni bukayehova; nomnikelo wokudla unyeliwe ngeoli; ngokuba namhla uyehova eya kubonakala kuni.
Baza batabata oko wakuyalelayo u‐Mosesi, bakuzisa pambi kwentente yentlangano; yati yonke intlanganiso yasondela, yema pambi kwoyehova.
Wayesiti u‐Mosesi: Yilento uyehova ayiyaleleyo ukuba maniyenze; kuze kubonakale kuni ubungcwalisa bukayehova.

Waye u‐Mosesi wati ku‐Arone: Sondela esibingelweni, ulenze elako idini lesono, nelako idini lokutshiswa; uze ulwenze uxoliso ngenxa yako, nangenxa yabantu; wandule unikele umnikelo wabantu, ubenzele uxoliso; njengokuba eyalele uyehova.
Waza wasondela u‐Arone esibingelweni, waxe̔la inkonyana yedini lesono, eyelake.
Basuka onyana baka‐Arone balizisa igazi kuye; waza wafaka umnwe wake egazini elo, walibeka ezimpondweni zesibingelo; wandula wagalela igazi ngasesekweni lesibingelo.
Kodwa inqata, nezintso, nendawo ezizengezelayo esibindini, kulo idini lesono, wazitshisa pezu kwesibingelo; njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
Kanti inyama nesikumba wazitshisa ngomlilo ngapandle kwomnquba.
Waza waxe̔la idini lokutshiswa; basuka onyana baka‐Arone bamnikela igazi; owalitshizayo pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Bamnikela nedini lokutshiswa ngezito zalo, nentloko; owalitshisayo esibingelweni.
Umbilini nentungo wazihlanza ngamanzi, wazitshisa pezu kwedini lokutshiswa, esibingelweni.
Waza wasondeza umnikelo wabantu, watabata ibokwe yedini lesono, eyelabantu, wayixe̔la, wayenza idini lesono, njengelokuqala.
Wasondeza nedini lokutshiswa, walenza njengesiko.
Wasondeza kanjalo umnikelo wokudla, wazalisa isandla sake kwa kuwo, watshisa oko pezu kwesibingelo, ngapandle kwelokusa idini lokutshiswa.
Wandula waxe̔la inkabi nenkunzi yegusha zibe ngumbingo woxolo, ongowabantu: basuka onyana baka‐Arone bamnikela igazi, owalitshizayo pezu kwesibingelo ngento engqongayo;
kwa namanqata avela kwinkabi nakwinkunzi yegusha, umsila, nelo ligubungela umbilini, nezintso, nendawo ezizengezelayo zesibindi:
baye bebeka lamanqata pezu kwazo izifuba; waza watshisa amanqata lawo esibingelweni.
Kodwa izifuba nowokunene umkono wazishukushukumisa u‐Arone zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova; njengokuba ebeyalele u‐Mosesi.
Waye u‐Arone wapakamisa isandla sake ngasebantwini, wabatamsanqelisa; waza wehla, akuba enzile idini lesono, nedini lokutshiswa, neminikelo yoxolo.
Wandula wangena u‐Mosesi no‐Arone ententeni yentlangano; bapuma ke, batamsanqelisa abantu: bati ubungcwalisa bukayehova babonakala kubo bonke abantu.
Kwaye kupuma umlilo ebusweni bukayehova, wagqibela pezu kwesibingelo idini lokutshiswa namanqata: bati bakubona bonke abantu, badanduluka ngovuyo, bawa ngobuso babo.

KEKALOKU onyana baka‐Arone, u‐Nadabi no‐Abihu, batabata omnye ngomnye isiqumelo sake, bafaka kuzo umlilo, babeka pezu kwawo isiqumiso, banikela ebusweni bukayehova umlilo wasemzini, owaengabayalelanga ngawo.
Kwaza kwapuma umlilo ebusweni bukayehova, wabagqibela; bafa ke pambi kwoyehova.
Wandula wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Arone: Koku akutetileyo uyehova, esiti: Ngabo basondela kum ndiya kungcwaliswa, nasebusweni babantu bonke ndiya kuzukiswa. Koko u‐Arone wati cwaka.
Waza u‐Mosesi wabiza u‐Mishayeli no‐Elitsafane, onyana baka‐Huziyeli, uyisekazi ka‐Arone, wati kubo: Sondelani, susani abazalwana benu pambi kweyingcwele indawo niye ngapandle kwomnquba.
Basondela ke, babasusa besezihempeni zabo baya ngapandle kwomnquba; njengokuba ebetshilo u‐Mosesi.

Waza wati u‐Mosesi ku‐Arone, naku‐Elezari, naku‐Yitamare, onyana bake: Intloko zenu ningazihlubululi, nezivato zenu ningaziṙazuli, ukuba ningafi, nokuba kungaqunjelwa yonke intlanganiso; kodwa abazalwana benu, kwa yonke indlu yo‐Sirayeli, mabalilele okukutsha uyehova akupembileyo.
Aniyi kupuma elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, hleze nife; ngokuba ioli yokutambisa kayehova ipezu kwenu. Baye besenza njengelizwi lika‐Mosesi.
Waza wateta uyehova ku‐Arone, esiti:
Iveyine notywala akuyi kubusela, kwa wena nonyana bako kunye nawe, xeshekweni niya kungena ententeni yentlangano, ukuba ningafi: ngummiselwa ongunapakade ngezizukulwana zenu:
nokuba nenze ukwahluka pakati kwokungcwele nokungengcwele, napakati kwokunco̔lileyo nokucocekileyo;
nokuba nifundise usapo luka‐Sirayeli yonke imimiso ayitetileyo uyehova kulo ngesandla sika‐Mosesi.

Waye u‐Mosesi wateta ku‐Arone, naku‐Elezari, naku‐Yitamare, onyana bake abaseleyo, esiti: Tabatani umnikelo wokudla oseleyo kuyo iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova, niwutye ungenagwele kufupi nesibingelo; ngokuba uyinto eyingcwelekazi wona:
naniya kuwutya endaweni eyingcwele, ngokokuba wona usisahlulelwa sako, nesahlulelwa sonyana bako, kuyo iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova: ngokuba kungokunjalo endiyalelweyo.

Kanjako isifuba sokushukushukunyiswa nomkono wokufunqufunqulwa niya kuzidla endaweni emhlope, kwa wena, nonyana bako, nentombi zako kunye nawe: ngokuba zisisahlulelwa sako, nesahlulelwa sonyana bako, eni zipiwe kwimibingo yoxolo yosapo luka‐Sirayeli.

Umkono wokufunqufunqulwa nesifuba sokushukushukunyiswa baya kuzizisa kunye neminikelo yamanqata eyenziwa ngomlilo, kuze kushukushukunyiswe umnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa ebusweni bukayehova: oya kuba ngowako, nowonyana bako kunye nawe, ngommiselwa ongunapakade: njengokuba eyalele uyehova.
Waza u‐Mosesi wafuna kunene ibokwe yedini lesono, kekaloku nantsi itshisiwe: waequmbile ngaku‐Elezari nangaku‐Yitamare, onyana baka‐Arone abaseleyo, esiti:
Kunganina ukuba ningatyanga idini lesono endaweni engcwele? ngokuba liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona, nenilipiweyo ukuba nitwale inkohlakalo yentlanganiso, ize nenzele bona uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova.
Bona ke, akungeniswanga igazi lalo pakati kweyingcwele indawo; ninge nilidlile ngenyaniso kweyingcwele indawo, njengokuba ndiyalele.

Waza wateta u‐Arone ku‐Mosesi, wati: Bona ke, namhla nje banikele idini lesono labo nedini lokutshiswa labo pambi kwoyehova, nangona izinto ezinje zindihlile; ukuba bendityile idini lesono namhla nje, bekuya kuba kulungile na oko emehlweni kayehova?
Wati u‐Mosesi akuva oku, kwakulungile emehlweni ake.
WANDULA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone, esiti kubo:
Tetani nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nisiti: Nanzi izinto ezipilileyo eniya kuzidla pakati kwazo zonke izilo ezisemhlabeni.
Zonke ezilwahlula upupu, ezicanda upupu kubini, ezihlafuna umtyiso, pakati kwezilo, ezona niya kuzidla.
Ezi noko aniyi kuzidla kwezo zityisayo, nakwezo zilwahlulayo upupu: inkamela, ngokuba ihlafuna umtyiso, kodwa ayahluli upupu; inco̔lile yona kuni:
nembila, ngokuba ihlafuna umtyiso, kodwa ayahluli upupu; inco̔lile yona kuni:
nomvundla, ngokuba uhlafuna umtyiso, kodwa awahluli upupu; unco̔lile wona kuni:
nehangu, ngokuba leyo ilwahlula upupu, icanda upupu kubini kanjalo, kodwa ayihlafuni umtyiso; inco̔lile yona kuni.
Kwinyama yazo aniyi kudla, nesidumbu sazo aniyi kusicukumisa; zinco̔lile zona kuni.
Ezi niya kuzidla kwezo zonke ezisemanzini: zonke ezinamapiko nenkwetu emanzini, kuzo ilwandle nakuyo imilambo, ezona niya kuzidla.
Kodwa zonke ezingenamapiko nenkwetu ezilwandleni nasemilanjeni, kuzo zonke izinambuzane zamanzi, nakuzo zonke izinto ezipilileyo ezisemanzini, zona ziyintshontsho kuni.
Ewe, zoba yintshontsho kuni; kwinyama yazo aniyi kudla, nezidumbu zazo niya kubala zona ngokuba yintshontsho.
Zonke izinto ezingenamapiko nenkwetu emanzini, zona zoba yintshontsho kuni.
Nezi ke niya kuzibala ngokuba yintshontsho pakati kwentaka; aziyi kudliwa, ziyintshontsho: ukozi, nengqanga, nonomakwezane,
nesanxa, nexalanga ngemmilo yalo;
bonke onomyai ngemmilo yabo;
nenciniba, nondebeza, nogwidi, nontloyiya ngemmilo yake,
nesikova, nokwalimanzi, nentsikizi,
nelowe, nencwangube, nengqo,
neṙaside, uqimgqoshe ngemmilo yake, noboboyi, nelulwane.
Zonke izinambuzane ezinamapiko, ezihambayo ngamane amanqina, zoba yintshontsho kuni.
Ezi noko ningazidla kuzo zonke izinambuzane ezinamapiko, ezihambayo ngamane amanqina, ezinentungo ngapezu kwamanqina azo, kuze kutsitywe ngazo emhlabeni;
ezi kuzo ningazidla: inkumbi ngemmilo yayo, nesiboto ngemmilo yaso, nomqikela ngemmilo yawo, nomcikwane ngemmilo yawo.
Kodwa zonke ezinye izinambuzane ezinamapiko ezinamanqina mane, zoba yintshontsho kuni.
Nezi niya kunco̔liswa ngazo; osukuba ecukumisa isidumbu sazo woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kanjalo osukuba etwele into yesidumbu sazo, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Zonke izilo ezahlulayo upupu, kanti azilucandi kubini, zingahlafuni umtyiso kanjako, izidumbu zazo zinco̔lile kuni: osukuba ezicukumisa woba enco̔lile.
Nazo zonke ezihambayo ngezandla zazo pakati kwazo zonke izinto ezipilileyo ezihambayo ngamane amanqina, ezo zinco̔lile kuni: osukuba ecukumisa isidumbu sazo woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Notweleyo isidumbu sazo yena wohlanza izivato zake, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe; zinco̔lile zona kuni.
Ezi nazo zoba zinco̔lile kuni pakati kwezinambuzane ezinambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba: intuku, nempuku, noxami ngemmilo yake,
nequngequ, noxebeyi, necilitshe, noṙoqotyeni, nolovane.
Ezi ke zinco̔lile kuni pakati kwezinto zonke ezinambuzelayo: osukuba ezicukumisa, zakuba zifile, woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.

Kanjako konke iya kuwa pezu kwako enye kuzo, yakuba ifile, kwoba kunco̔lile; nokuba yenye impahla yomti, umhlaumbi sisivato, umhlaumbi yintsuba, umhlaumbi yinxowa, umhlaumbi yenye impahla ekwenziwa umsebenzi ngayo, iya kungeniswa emanzini, ibe inco̔lile kude kuhlwe; yandule icokiseke.
Nazo zonke impahla zodongwe, iya kweyela pakati kwazo enye kuzo, konke okupakati kwazo kwoba kunco̔lile, nazo zona noziqekeza.
Kuko konke ukudla okudlekayo, oko aya kuza pezu kwako amanzi anjalo, kwoba kunco̔lile; nalo lwonke uselo oluselekayo kuzo zonke impahla ezinjalo lwoba lunco̔lile.
Kanjako konke iya kuwa pezu kwako into yesidumbu sazo, kwoba kunco̔lile; nokuba liziko, nokuba ngongxawo, baya kucitwa; banco̔lile, ngako boba benco̔lile kuni.
Noko umtombo, nomnxuma wokuhlanganisana kwamanzi, woba ucocekile; kodwa lowo ucukumisayo isidumbu sazo woba enco̔lile.
Naxeshekweni iwayo into yesidumbu sazo pezu kwembewu eyintlwayelelo, eza kuhlwayelwa, yona yoba icocekile.
Kodwa nxa kubekwa amanzi pezu kwembewu, yandule into yesidumbu sazo iwe pezu kwayo, yoba inco̔lile leyo kuni.
Nokuya kufayo esinye isilo esidlekayo kuni, ocukumisayo isidumbu saso woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kanjalo odlayo kwisidumbu saso wohlanza izivato zake, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe; nalowo otweleyo isidumbu saso wohlanza izivato zake, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Zonke izinambuzane ezinambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba zoba yintshontsho nazo; aziyi kudliwa.
Konke okuhambayo ngesisu, nako konke okuhambayo ngamane amanqina, nako konke okumanqina maninzi, pakati kwazo zonke izinambuzane ezinambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba, aniyi kukudla; ngokuba kuyintshontsho.
Aniyi kudlubukisa imipefumlo yenu ngasinye isinambuzane esinambuzelayo; aniyi kuzinco̔lisa ngazo kanjako, ukuba nibe ninco̔lile ngazo.
Ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu: kukona niya kuzingcwalisa, nibe ngcwele, ngokuba ndingcwele mna; kanjalo aniyi kunco̔lisa imipefumlo yenu ngasinye isinambuzane esinambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba.
Ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, oninyusayo ezweni le‐Jipete, ndize ndibe ngutixo wenu; kukona niya kuba ngcwele, ngokuba ndingcwele mna.
Nguwo lo umteto wezilo, nowentaka, nowazo zonke izinto ezinokudliwa kwobomi ezishukumayo emanzini, nowazo zonke izinambuzane ezinambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba;
kuze kwenzwe ukwahluka pakati kwokunco̔lileyo nokucocekileyo, napakati kwesilo esidlekayo nesilo esingadlekiyo.
WABUYA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Umfazi nxa akaulileyo, wazala inkwenkwe, woba enco̔lile imihla ibe sixe̔nxe; njengasemihleni yokwahlukanela isifo sake woba enco̔lile.
Nangowesibozo umhla iya kwaluswa inyama yejwabu layo.

Uya kwandula ahlale egazini lokucokiswa kwake imihla ibe ngamashumi matatu anesitatu; konke okungcwele akayi kukucukumisa, neyingcwele indawo akayi kungena kuyo, kude kuzalisekiswe imihla yokucokiswa kwake.
Kodwa ukuba uzele inkazana woba enco̔lile iveki zibe mbini, njengasekwahlukaneni kwake; andule ahlale egazini lokucokiswa kwake imihla ibe ngamashumi matandatu anesitandatu.

Woti kwakuzalisekiswa imihla yokucokiswa kwake, ngenxa yonyana, umhlaumbi ngenxa yentombi, andule azise imvana yomnyaka mnye ibe lidini lokutshiswa, netole lezuba, umhlaumbi ihobe, libe lidini lesono, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, kumperisite:
oya kuyinikela ebusweni bukayehova, amenzele uxoliso; aze acokiswe etonjeni legazi lake. Nguwo lo umteto walowo uzeleyo inkwenkwe, umhlaumbi inkazana.

Kodwa ukuba isandla sake asifumani okwanele imvana, makatabate amahobe abe mabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba abe mabini, elinye libe leledini lokutshiswa, elinye libe leledini lesono; ati umperisite amenzele uxoliso, abe yena ecokisekile.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone, esiti:

Umntu xeshekweni anokudumba, umhlaumbi sisilonda, umhlaumbi lityakuva elikazimlayo, entlonzeni yenyama yake, elifanel’ ukuba sisibulawa sesilepero entlonzeni yenyama yake, uya kwandula aziswe ku‐Arone umperisite, umhlaumbi komnye konyana bake abaperisite.

Waye umperisite eya kukangela isibulawa esisentlonzeni yenyama; kekaloku, nxa ziguqulwe inwele esibulaweni zaba mhlope, na nxa isibulawa sinzulu kuyo intlonze yenyama yake ukubonakala kwaso, sisisibulawa sesilepero sona: andule ati umperisite akumkangela, axele ukuba unco̔lile.

Kodwa ukuba ityakuva elikazimlayo limhlope entlonzeni yenyama yake, nokuba alinzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwalo, nokuba aziguqulwe inwele zalo zaba mhlope, woti umperisite amtshixele onesibulawa imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.

Waye umperisite eya kumkangela ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ukuba, kekaloku, isibulawa site nqumama emehlweni ake, nokuba asitwabulukanga isibulawa entlonzeni, wobuya umperisite amtshixele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe ngokwesibini.

Woza umperisite amkangele ngomhla wesixe̔nxe ngokwesibini: ukuba, kekaloku, isibulawa simncumevu, nokuba asitwabulukanga isibulawa entlonzeni, umperisite uya kuxela ukuba ucocekile; sisilonda kodwa; waeya kuhlanza izivato zake, abe ecokisekile.
Kanti ukuba isilonda sesitwabulukile entlonzeni, emveni kwokubonakaliswa kwake kumperisite ngenxa yokucokiswa kwake, wobonakaliswa ngokwesibini kumperisite.
Ukuba umperisite uyabona ukuba nasi isilonda sitwabulukile entlonzeni, woti umperisite axele ukuba unco̔lile; sisilepero sona.
Xeshekweni isibulawa sesilepero sisemntwini, uya kwandula aziswe kumperisite.
Ukuba umperisite uya kubona ukuba nanku ukudumba okumhlope entlonzeni, okuguqule inwele zibe zimhlope, nokuba kuko ibala lenyama eṙwada ekudumbeni;
