sisilepero esidala sona entlonzeni yenyama yake; kukona umperisite aya kuxela ukuba unco̔lile: akayi kumtshixela, ngokuba enco̔lile yena.

Naxeshekweni kujadukayo kakulu isilepero entlonzeni, siti isilepero sigubungele yonke intlonze yonaso esosibulawa, kwa sentloko yake kude kube sezinyaweni zake, njengako konke ukubona kwamehlo omperisite;
woti umperisite, akubona ukuba nasi isilepero sigubungele yonke inyama yake, andule axele ukuba ucocekile onesibulawa: siguqulwe saba simhlope sipela: ucocekile yena.
Kodwa mhlana ibonakalayo kuye inyama eṙwada, woba enco̔lile.
Woti umperisite akubona lonyama eṙwada, axele ukuba unco̔lile; leyonyama eṙwada inco̔lile; sisilepero sona.
Naxeshekweni kubuya kujike lonyama eiwada, ide iguqulwe ibe mhlope, uya kwandula eze kumperisite.
Woti umperisite akumbona, ukuba nasi isibulawa siguqulwe saba mhlope, andule axele umperisite ukuba ucocekile lowo onesibulawa: ucocekile yena.
Kanjalo inyama, ebekukuyo intlonze yayo itumba, elipolisiweyo;
nekuya kubako kuyo endaweni yetumba ukudumba okumhlope, umhlaumbi ityakuva elikazimlayo, limhlope, libomvuṙa; yobonakaliswa yona kumperisite.

Ukuba umperisite uyabona ukuba nali linzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwalo, nokuba ziguqulwe inwele zalo zaba mhlope, uya kuxela umperisite ukuba unco̔lile: sisibulawa sesilepero, sijadukile ngetumba.
Kanti xeshekweni umperisite aya kulibona, ukuba kekaloku akuko kulo inwele ezimhlope, nokuba alinzulu kuyo intlonze, kodwa limncumevu, woti umperisite amtshixele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.
Kwandul’ ukuti, ukuba liyatwabuluka kakulu entlonzeni, kuxele umperisite ukuba unco̔lile: sisibulawa.
Kodwa ukuba ityakuva elikazimlayo liti nqumama endaweni yalo, lingatwabuluki nje, lukoko lwetumba; waye umperisite eya kuxela ukuba ucocekile.
Nenyama nxa kukuyo intlonze yayo isitsha somlilo, na nxa ibala lesitsha eso lilityakuva elikazimlayo, limhlope, libomvuṙa, umhlaumbi limhlope kanye;

woza umperisite ayikangele: ukuba kekaloku ziguqulwe inwele zaba mhlope kulo ityakuva elikazimlayo, nokuba linzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwalo, sisilepero, sijadukile ngesitsha; kukona umperisite aya kuxela ukuba unco̔lile: sisibulawa sesilepero.

Kanti xeshekweni umperisite aya kulibona, ukuba kekaloku akuko nwele ezimhlope kulo ityakuva elikazimlayo, nokuba alinzulu kuyo intlonze, kodwa limncumevu, woti umperisite amtshixele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.
Uya kubuya umperisite amkangele ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ukuba litwabulukile kakulu entlonzeni, uya kwandula umperisite axele ukuba unco̔lile: sisibulawa sesilepero.

Kodwa ukuba ityakuva elikazimlayo liti nqumama endaweni yalo, lingatwabuluki entlonzeni nje, kodwa limncumevu, kukudumba kwesitsha; kukona umperisite aya kuxela ukuba ucocekile; ngokuba lukoko lwesitsha.
Kanjako indoda, umhlaumbi umfazi, nxa kukuyo isibulawa pezu kwentloko, umhlaumbi pezu kwendevu;

woza umperisite akangele isibulawa eso: ukuba kekaloku sinzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwaso, nokuba kuko pezu kwaso inwele ezilubelu ezincinane, woti umperisite axele ukuba inco̔lile: lukwekwe, sisilepero sentloko umhlaumbi sesodevu.

Kodwa xeshekweni umperisite abona isibulawa sokwekwe, ukuba kekaloku asinzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwaso, nokuba inwele ezimnyama aziko kuso, woti umperisite amtshixele onesibulawa sokwekwe imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.
Andule abuye umperisite akangele isibulawa eso ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ukuba kekaloku alutwabuluki ukwekwe, nokuba aziko kulo inwele ezilubelu, nokuba ukwekwe alunzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwalo;
uya kugugulwa yena, kanti ukwekwe akayi kulugugula; aze ati umperisite amtshixele onokwekwe imihla ibe sixe̔nxe ngokwesibini.

Andule abuye umperisite akangele ukwekwe ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ukuba kekaloku ukwekwe alutwabuluki entlonzeni, nokuba alunzulu kuyo intlonze ukubonakala kwalo, woti umperisite axele ukuba ucocekile; waeya kuhlanza izivato zake, abe ecokisekile.
Kodwa ukuba ukwekwe luyatwabuluka kakulu entlonzeni, emveni kwokucokiswa kwake;
wobuya umperisite amkangele: ukuba kekaloku ukwekwe lutwabulukile entlonzeni, umperisite akayi kugqalela inwele ezilubelu; selenco̔lile yena.
Kodwa ukuba emehlweni ake ukwekwe lute nqumama, nokuba inwele ezimnyama zikulile pezu kwalo; selupilisiwe ukwekwe olo, ucocekile yena: kukona umperisite aya kuxela ukuba ucocekile.
Kanjako indoda, umhlaumbi umfazi, nxa kukuyo intlonze yenyama yabo amatyakuva akazimlayo, kwa amatyakuva akazimlayo amhlope;
woza umperisite akangele: ukuba kekaloku kuko entlonzeni yenyama yabo amatyakuva amhlopemncumevu; ligxuba elimhlope elijadukileyo entlonzeni; ucocekile onjalo.
Nendoda nxa intloko yayo igudile, yona iyinqai, icocekile noko.
Naxeshekweni kungasecaleni lobuso intloko yayo igudile, iyinqai ebunzini, icocekile noko.
Kodwa zeshekweni kuko ebunqayini bentloko, umhlaumbi ebunqayini bebunzi, isibulawa esimhlope‐bomvuṙa; sisilepero esijadukileyo ebunqayini bentloko yayo, umhlaumbi ebunqayini bebunzi layo.
Woza umperisite asikangele: ukuba kekaloku ukudumba kwesosibulawa kumhlope‐bomvuṙa ebunqayini bentloko yayo, umhlaumbi ebunqayini bebunzi layo, njengokubonakala kwaso isilepero sentlonze yenyama;
iyindoda elileperi yona, inco̔lile: umperisite uya kuxela ukuba inco̔lile kanye; isibulawa sayo sisentloko yayo.
Neleperi ekukulo isibulawa eso, izivato zalo zoba ziṙazukile, nentloko yalo yoba ihlubulukile, nembovu yalo loyigubungela; laliya kudanduluka ngokuti: Ndinco̔lile, ndinco̔lile!
Yonke imihla ekuya kubako kulo esisibulawa, loba linco̔lile; linco̔lile lona: liya kuhlala lodwa; kwoba ngapandle kwomnquba ukuhlala kwalo.
Kanjako isivato ekukuso isibulawa sesilepero, nokuba sisesivatweni soboya, nokuba sisesivatweni seqiya;
nokuba sikokwoluliweyo, nokuba sikokunqanyulezisiweyo, ngeqiya umhlaumbi ngoboya; nokuba siseluswini, nokuba sikwelinye isetyenzwa lolusu;

nxa isibulawa eso siluhlazaṙa, umhlaumbi sibomvuṙa, esivatweni, umhlaumbi eluswini, nokuba sikokwoluliweyo, nokuba sikokunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi kwenye into yolusu; sisibulawa sesilepero sona: ngako siya kubonakaliswa kumperisite.
Woti umperisite akangele isibulawa; andule akutshixele okunesibulawa imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.

Wobuya akangele isibulawa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe: ukuba isibulawa sitwabulukile esivatweni, nokuba sikokwoluliweyo, nokuba sikokunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi eluswini, umhlaumbi kwelinye isetyenzwa elenziweyo ngolusu; isibulawa eso sisilepero esidlayo; sinco̔lile.

Kukona aya kutshisa isivato eso, umhlaumbi oko kwoluliweyo, umhlaumbi oko kunqanyulezisiweyo, okwoboya umhlaumbi okweqiya, umhlaumbi enye into yolusu ekukuyo isibulawa eso: ngokuba sisilepero esidlayo; siya kutshiswa ngomlilo.
Kodwa xeshekweni umperisite aya kubona, ukuba kekaloku isibulawa asitwabulukanga esivatweni, nakoko kwoluliweyo, nakoko kunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi kwenye into yolusu;
woti umperisite axele ukuba kuhlanzwe lo nto isibulawa sikuyo, andule ayitshixele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe ngokwesibini.

Nxa umperisite, emveni kwokuhlanzwa kwayo, aya kubona isibulawa, ukuba kekaloku isibulawa asiguqukanga ukubonakala kwaso, nokuba isibulawa asitwabulukanga; inco̔lile yona; uya kuyitshisa ngomlilo: idlekile pakati, nokuba icucekile kwelasemva icala, nokuba icucekile kwelapambili.

Naxeshekweni aya kubona umperisite, ukuba kekaloku isibulawa simncumevu emveni kwokuhlanzwa kwaso; uya kwandula asiṙazule esivatweni, umhlaumbi eluswini, umhlaumbi kokwoluliweyo, umhlaumbi kokunqanyulezisiweyo.
Ukuba kodwa sisabonakala esivatweni, nokuba sikokwoluliweyo, nokuba sikokunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi kwenye into yolusu; sisilepero esijadukayo; uya kutshisa oko isibulawa sikuko ngomlilo.

Kanti isivato, umhlaumbi okwoluliweyo, umhlaumbi okunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi enye into yolusu, kwa oko kusukuba uya kuhlanza kona, ukuba isibulawa simkile kuko, kwohlanzwa ngokwesibini, kuze kube kucokisekile.

Nguwo lo umteto wesibulawa sesilepero sesivato soboya, umhlaumbi seseqiya, umhlaumbi, sesokwoluliweyo, umhlaumbi sesokunqanyulezisiweyo, umhlaumbi senye into yolusu, wokuba kuxelwe ukuti sicocekile, umhlaumbi kuxelwe ukuti sinco̔lile.
Wateta kanjako uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Nguwo lo oya kuba ngumteto weleperi ngomhla wokucokiswa kwalo: Lona liya kuziswa kumperisite:
waeya kupuma umperisite aye ngapandle kwomnquba; aze ati umperisite, akubona ukuba kekaloku isibulawa sesilepero sipilisiwe kulo ileperi,
andule axele umperisite, ukuba kutatyatelwe lowo oya kucokiswa intakana zibe mbini, ezipilileyo, ezicocekileyo, nomti wesedare, nesibomvu, nehisope;
abuye axele umpersite, ukuba kuxe̔lwe enye intakana empandeni wodongwe pezu kwamanzi elayo.
Epilileyo intakana uya kutabata yona, nomti wesedare, nesibomvu, nehisope, aze azifake ezi zinto nentakana epilileyo egazini lentakana exe̔liweyo pezu kwamanzi elayo.
Waeya kuti fefe pezu kwalowo oya kucokiswa esilepereni amaxesha asixe̔nxe, axele ukuba ucokisekile, nentakana epilileyo woyindululela ngasendle.

Nalowo oya kucokiswa yena uya kuhlanza izivato zake, agugule zonke inwele zake, ahlambe emanzini, aze abe ecokisekile: woti emveni kwoko angene emnqubeni; kodwa uya kuhlala ngapandle kwentente yake imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.

Kwakuya kuti ngomhla wesixe̔nxe, uya kugugula zonke inwele zake, intloko yake, nodevu lwake, namashiyi ake; kwa zonke inwele zake uya kuzigugula: waeya kuhlanza izivato zake, ayihlambe inyama yake ngamanzi, aze abe ecokisekile.

Nangomhla wesibozo uya kutabata imvana ezimsulwa zibe mbini, nemvanakazi ibe nye yomnyaka mnye emsulwa, nezeshumi iziqingata zibe zitatu zeyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo, ube ngumnikelo wokudla, unyeliwe ngeoli, neloge ibe nye yeoli.
Waeya kuti umperisite ocokisayo amise indoda eya kucokiswa, nezi zinto, pambi kwoyehova, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Andule umperisite atabate enye imvana, ayinikele ibe lidini letyala, kunye nayo iloge yeoli; aze azishukushukumise zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa ebusweni bukayehova.
Waeya kuxe̔la imvana leyo endaweni apo kuxe̔lwa kona idini lesono nedini lokutshiswa, endaweni eyingcwele: ngokuba njengedini lesono linjalo idini letyala, lelomperisite; liyinto eyingcwelekazi lona.

Waye umperisite eya kucapula egazini ledini letyala, aze umperisite alibeke pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yalowo oya kucokiswa, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sake, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwake.
Andule umperisite acapule kuyo iloge yeoli, ayigalele kwesokohlo isandla somperisite.
Aze umperisite afake owokunene umnwe wake kuyo ioli ekwesokohlo isandla sake, asasaze kuleoli ngomnwe wake amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe pambi kwoyehova.

Nakulo iliva leoli esesandleni sake, umperisite wobeka pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yalowo oya kucokiswa, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sake, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwake, pezu kwegazi lalo idini letyala.
Neseleyo kuyo ioli esesandleni somperisite woyigalela pezu kwentloko yalowo oya kucokiswa; ade umperisite amenzele uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova.
Woti kanjalo umperisite anikele idini lesono, enze uxoliso ngenxa yalowo oya kucokiswa ekunco̔leni kwake; andule axe̔le nedini lokutshiswa.
Elodini lokutshiswa umperisite uya kunikela lona nomnikelo wokudla pezu kwesibingelo; waye umperisite eya kumenzela uxoliso, aze abe ecokisekile.

Ukuba kodwa ulihlwempu yena, isandla sake singenakufikela okungaka nje, makatabate imvana ibe nye ibe lidini letyala, kushukushukunyiswe, kuze kumenzelwe uxoliso; kwa neseshumi isiqingata sibe sinye seyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo, unyeliwe ngeoli, ube ngumnikelo wokudla, neloge yeoli;
namahobe abe mabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba abe mabini, lawo isandla sake sinokuwafikela; eliya kuti elinye libe lidini lesono, nelinye libe lidini lokutshiswa.
Waeya kuzisa ezo zinto ngowesibozo umhla wokucokiswa kwake kumperisite, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, pambi kwoyehova.
Woti umperisite atabate imvana yedini letyala, neloge yeoli; aze umperisite azishukushukumise zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa pambi kwoyehova.

Waeya kuxe̔la imvana yedini letyala; andule umperisite acapule egazini ledini letyala, alibeke pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yalowo oya kucokiswa, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sake, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwake.
Nenxenye yeoli leyo umperisite woyigalela kwesokohlo isandla somperisite.
Andule umperisite asasaze ngowokunene umnwe wake, kuyo ioli ekwesokohlo isandla sake, amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe pambi kwoyehova.

Aze umperisite abeke kuyo ioli esesandleni sake pezu kwesitinzi seyokunene indlebe yalowo oya kucokiswa, napezu kwesitupa sesokunene isandla sake, napezu kwobontsi wolwokunene unyawo lwake, pezu kwendawo yegazi ledini letyala.
Neseleyo kuyo ioli esesandleni somperisite woyibeka pezu kwentloko yalowo oya kucokiswa, kuze kumenzelwe uxoliso pambi kwoyehova.
Waeya kunikela elinye kuwo amahobe, umhlaumbi kuwo amatole ezuba, kulawo isandla sake sinokuwafikela;

kwa ku lawo isandla sake sinokuwafikela wonikela elinye libe lidini lesono, nelinye libe lidini lokutshiswa, kunye nomnikelo wokudla; aze umperisite enze uxoliso ngenxa yalowo oya kucokiswa pambi kwoyehova.
Nguwo lo umteto wokukuye isibulawa sesilepero, osandla sake singenakufikela okukulu ekucokisweni kwake.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone, esiti:
Xeshekweni niya kufika elizweni le‐Kanane, endinipa lona libe yimfuyo, ndize ndibeke isibulawa sesilepero endlwini yaselizweni lemfuyo yenu;
makeze lowo indlu iyeyake, ashumayele kumperisite, esiti: Kubonakala kum njengokungati sisibulawa endlwini.

Waye umperisite eya kuxela ukuba balungise leyondlu, engekangeni umperisite ukuza kukangela esosibulawa, ukuze kunganco̔liswa konke okusendlwini: woti umperisite emveni kwoko, angene ukuza kukangela leyondlu.
Nxa abonayo isibulawa, ukuba nasi isibulawa sisezindongeni zendlu, intlambo eziluhlazaṙa umhlaumbi ezibomvuṙa, ezibenileyo kulo udonga ukubonakala kwazo;
woti umperisite apume endlwini aye elucangweni lwendlu, aze ayitshixe leyondlu imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.
Andule abuye umperisite ngomhla wesixe̔nxe, akangele: ukuba kekaloku isibulawa eso sitwabulukile ezindongeni zalondlu;
umperisite uya kuxela ukuba kur̔olwe lamatye isibulawa sikuwo, nokuba kuposwe wona ngapandle kwesixeko, endaweni enco̔lileyo.
Nendlu leyo uya kwenza ukuba bayiṙwele pakati ngento engqongayo, notuli baluṙwelileyo bolugalela ngapandle kwesixeko, endaweni enco̔lileyo.
Bandule batabate amatye wambi, bawangenise esikundleni samatye lawo; kwotatyatwa nodaka lumbi, kutyatyekwe indlu leyo.
Kodwa ukuba siyabuya size isibulawa, sijaduke kulondlu, emveni kwokur̔olwa kwamatye, nasemveni kwokuṙwelwa kwendlu, nasemveni kwokutyatyekwa kwayo;
woza umperisite akangele: ukuba kekaloku sesitwabulukile isibulawa endlwini, sisilepero esidlayo kulondlu; inco̔lile yona.
Kukona kuya kucitwa leyondlu, amatye ayo, nemiti yayo, nalo lwonke udaka lwendlu; yokutshelwa pandle kwesixeko, endaweni enco̔lileyo.
Kanjako ongenayo kulondlu ngayo yonke imihla yokutshixwa kwayo, woba enco̔lile yena kude kuhlwe.
Nolele pantsi kulondlu yena uya kuhlanza izivato zake; nalowo utyayo kulondlu, wohlanza izivato zake naye.

Kodwa nxa abuya angene umperisite, abone ukuba kekaloku isibulawa asitwabulukanga endlwini, emveni kwokutyatyekwa kwayo; woti umperisite axele ukuba icocekile leyondlu, ngokuba sesipilisiwe isibulawa eso.
Andule atabatele ukuhlanjululwa kwalondlu intakana zibe mbini, kwa nomti wesedare, nesibomvu, nehisope.
Waeya kuxe̔la enye intakana empandeni wodongwe, pezu kwamanzi elayo.
Aze atabate lomti wesedare, nehisope, nesibomvu, nentaka epilileyo, azifake ezo nto egazini layo intaka exe̔liweyo, nasemanzini elayo, ayisasaze indlu amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe.
Waeya kuhlambulula leyondlu ngegazi lentakana, nangalamanzi elayo, nangentakana epilileyo, nangalomti wesedare, nangehisope, nangesibomvu:
nentakana epilileyo uya kuyindululela pandle kwesixeko, ezindle: kwa njalo uya kwenzela leyondlu uxoliso, ize ibe icokisekile.
Nguwo lo umteto ngazo zonke izibulawa zesilepero, nezokwekwe;
nangaso isilepero sesivato, nesendlu;
nangokudumba, nangesilonda, nangetyakuva elikazimlayo;
kuze kufundiswe nxa into inco̔lile, nanxa into icocekile. Lo ungumteto wesilepero.
WATETA kanjako uyehova ku‐Mosesi naku‐Arone, esiti:
Tetani nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, niti kulo: Indoda esukuba inegqita lipuma enyameni yayo, inco̔lile yona ngenxa yegqita layo.
Oku kwoba kukunco̔la kwayo ngenxa yegqita layo: nokuba inyama yayo iyavuza igqita layo, nokuba inyama yayo ivingciwe ligqita layo, kukunco̔la kwayo oko.
Yonke imandlalo, alele pezu kwayo lowo unegqita, inco̔lile; nazo zonke izinto, ahleli pezu kwazo, zinco̔lile.
Kanjalo osukuba ecukumisa umandlalo wake, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nalowo ohlala pezu kwento, ate lowo unegqita wahlala pezu kwayo, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nalowo ocukumisa inyama yake onegqita, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Naxeshekweni lowo unegqita amtshicela ococekileyo, uya kwandula yena ahlanze izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kanjalo zonke izidwashu, akweleyo pezu kwazo lowo unegqita, zoba zinco̔lile.
Nosukuba ecukumisa enye into ebingapantsi kwake, woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe; nalowo otwele ezo zinto, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kanjalo lowo asukuba emcukumisile onegqita, engekayalazanga izandla zake ugamanzi, yena uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nompanda wodongwe, awucukumisileyo lowo unegqita, wona uya kuqekezwa; kanti yonke imipanda yemiti yoyalazwa ngamanzi.
Waeya kuti onegqita, nxa acokiswayo egqiteni lake, andule azibalele imihla isixe̔nxe ibe yeyokucokiswa kwake, aze ahlanze izivato zake, ahlambe inyama yake ngamanzi elayo, abe ecokisekile.
Nangomhla wesibozo wozitabatela amahobe emabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba emabini, eze nawo pambi kwoyehova ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano, awanike kumperisite.
Andule umperisite awanikele, elinye libe lidini lesono, nelinye libe lidini lokutshiswa; kwa njalo umperisite uya kumenzela uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova ngenxa yegqita lake.
Kanjako indoda, nxa kupuma kuyo imbewu yokulala, yosuka ihlambe yonke inyama yayo ngamanzi, ibe inco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kwa zonke izivato, nazo zonke izintsu, ekupezu kwazo imbewu yokulala, ziya kuhlanzwa ngamanzi, zibe zinco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nomfazi yakulala naye indoda inembewu yokulala, bohlamba emanzini bobabini, babe benco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kanjako umfazi, nxa anegqita, lilelegazi igqita lake enyameni yake, woba yimihla isixe̔nxe ekwahlukaneni kwake: osukuba emcukumisa woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Konke alele pezu kwako ekwahlukaneni kwake, kwoba kunco̔lile; nako konke ahleli pezu kwako, kwoba kunco̔lile.
Osukuba ecukumisa umandlalo wake, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nosukuba ecukumisa enye into abehleli pezu kwayo, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Nokuba lipezu kwomandlalo, nokuba lipezu kwento abehleli pezu kwayo, woti akulicukumisa, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Ukuba kanjalo indoda ika ilale naye, kuze kube pezu kwayo ukunco̔la kwake, yona yoba inco̔lile imihla isixe̔nxe; nomandlalo isukuba ilele pezu kwawo, woba unco̔lile nawo.

Naxeshekweni umfazi anokupuma kwegqita legazi lake imihla emininzi, kwakungabiko ixesha lokwahlukana kwake, umhlaumbi nxa anegqita pezu kwelokwahlukana kwake; yonke imihla yegqita lokunco̔la kwake, njengasemihleni yokwahlukana kwake, woba enco̔lile.
Yonke imandlalo alala pezu kwayo ngayo yonke imihla yegqita lake, yoba kuye njengomandlalo wokwahlukana kwake; nento zonke ahlala pezu kwazo zoba zinco̔lile, njengokunco̔la kwokwahlukana kwake.
Osukuba ecukumisa ezo zinto, woba enco̔lile naye; kukona aya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe.
Kodwa ukuba ucokisiwe egqiteni lake, uya kwandula azibalele imihla ibe sixe̔nxe, ati kamva abe ecokisekile.
Nangomhla wesibozo uya kuzitabatela amahobe emabini, umhlaumbi amatole ezuba emabini, aze awazise kumperisite, ngaselucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Waye umperisite eya kunikela elinye libe lidini lesono, nelinye libe lidini lokutshiswa; andule umperisite amenzele uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova, ngenxa yegqita lokunco̔la kwake.
Niya kwenje njalo ukwahlukanisa usapo luka‐Sirayeli ekunco̔leni kwalo; luze lungabubi ngokunco̔la kwalo, lwakunco̔lisa itabanakele yam epakati kwalo.
Lo ungumteto walowo unegqita, nowalowo kupuma kuye imbewu yokulala, ade anco̔liswe yiyo;
kwa nowomfazi ofayo ekwahlukaneni kwake, nowalowo opuma igqita, owendoda nowomfazi; nowendoda eleleyo nomfazi onco̔lileyo.
WAYE uyehova wateta ku‐Mosesi emveni kwokububa kwonyana baka‐Arone ababini, bakusondela ebusweni bukayehova, babuba ke;

waza wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Teta kumkuluwe wako u‐Arone, ukuba makangangeni ngamaxesha onke kweyingcwele indawo, pakati kwekuselo, ngapambi kwesihlalo sofefe, esipezu kwayo ityeya, ukuze angafi; ngokuba ndiya kubonakala ngelifu esihlalweni sofefe.
Kwoba ngokunje u‐Arone aya kungena kweyingcwele indawo: enenkunzana elitole lenkomo ibe lidini lesono, nenkunzi yegusha ibe lidini lokutshiswa.

Uya kwambata eyingcwele ihempe yeqiya, nebrukwe yeqiya yoba pezu kwenyama yake, noqwemesha weqiya wobinqa ngalo, nonkontsho lweqiya woyisonga entloko: zizivato ezingcwele ezi; kukona aya kuhlamba ngamanzi inyama yake, akuzambata.
Nakuyo intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli uya kwamkela amaxwana ebokwe emabini, abe lidini lesono, nenkunzi yegusha inye, ibe lidini lokutshiswa.
Waye u‐Arone eya kunikela inkunzana yedini lesono, leyo iyeyake, alwenze uxoliso ngenxa yake nangenxa yendlu yake.
Andule atabate ibokwe zombini, azimise pambi kwoyehova, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano.
Waye u‐Arone eya kwenza pezu kwebokwe zombini amaqashiso; elinye iqashiso libe le likayehova, nelinye iqashiso libe lelebokwe yokumka.
Nebokwe ekuya kuwa pezu kwayo iqashiso lokuba ibe ye kayehova, makayisondeze u‐Arone, enze ngayo idini lesono.
Kodwa ibokwe, ekuya kuwa pezu kwayo iqashiso lokuba ibe yibokwe yokumka, iya kumiswa yona ipilile ebusweni bukayehova, ize yenzelwe uxoliso; ukuba indululwe ibe yibokwe yokumka ukuya entlango.
Waye u‐Arone eya kusondeza inkunzana yedini lesono, leyo iyeyake, alwenze uxoliso ngenxa yake nangenxa yendlu yake; aze ayixe̔le inkunzana yedini lesono, leyo iyeyake.
Andule atabate isiqumelo sizele ngamalahle omlilo evela esibingelweni, pambi kwoyehova, nesiqumiso esimnandi, sicolekisiwe ngokunqushwa, ngento ezalisa izandla zake, angenise ezonto pakati kwekuselo.
Nesiqumiso eso uya kusibeka pezu kwomlilo, pambi kwoyehova; ukuba ilifu lesiqumiso lisibekele isihlalo sofefe esipezu kwaso isinqi̔no, aze angafi.
Waeya kucapula egazini lenkunzana, alisasaze ngomnwe wake pezu kwesihlalo sofefe ngasempumalanga; nangapambi kwesihlalo sofefe uya kusasaza amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe kwelogazi ngomnwe wake.

Uya kwandula axe̔le ibokwe yedini lesono, leyo iyeyabantu, angenise igazi layo pakati kwekuselo; aze enze ngegazi elo, njengokuba enzile ngalo igazi lenkunzana, alisasaze pezu kwesihlalo sofefe, nangapambi kwesihlalo sofefe.

Kanjako uya kwenzela eyingcwele indawo uxoliso, ngenxa yokunco̔la kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nangenxa yezigqito zalo ngazo zonke izono zalo; uya kwenje njalo nakuyo intente yentlangano, ehleliyo kulo pakati kwokunco̔la kwalo.

Akuyi kubako namnye umntu ententeni yentlangano, akungena ukuza kulwenza uxoliso kweyingcwele indawo, ade apume: wolwenje njalo uxoliso ngenxa yake, nangenxa yendlu yake, nangenxa yawo wonke umhlambi wo‐Sirayeli.
Waeya kupuma aye esibingelweni, esipambi kwoyehova, asenzele uxoliso; ati kanjalo acapule egazini lenkunzana, nasegazini lebokwe, alibeke pezu kwempondo zesibingelo ngento engqongayo.
Andule asasaze pezu kwaso kwelogazi ngomnwe wake amaxesha abe sixe̔nxe, asicokise, asingcwalise ekunco̔leni kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Woti akugqiba ukuxolisela eyingcwele indawo, nentente yentlangano, nesibingelo, ayisondeze ibokwe epilileyo.

Waye u‐Arone eya kulalisa izandla zake zozibini pezu kwentloko yebokwe epilileyo, axele pezu kwayo zonke inkohlakalo zosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nazo zonke izigqito zalo ngazo zonke izono zalo, azibeke pezu kwentloko yebokwe, ayindulule yona ngesandla yendoda efanelekileyo ukuya entlango.
Yoti ibokwe leyo itwale pezu kwayo zonke inkohlakalo zalo, iye nazo elizweni elilubala: yaiya kuyindulula ibokwe leyo apo entlango.
Waeya kuza u‐Arone angene ententeni yentlangano, ahlube izivato zeqiya, ezo abezambete ekungeneni kwake kweyingcwele indawo, azishiye kwa kona.
Andule ahlambe inyama yake ngamanzi endaweni engcwele, azambate izivato zake, abuye apume, anikele elake idini lokutshiswa, nelabantu idini lokutshiswa, enze uxoliso ngenxa yake, nangenxa yabantu.
Nenqata ledini lesono uya kutshisa lona pezu kwesibingelo.
Kanjalo lowo obeyindulula ibokwe ibe yibokwe yokumka, uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe inyama yake ngamanzi, ati emveni kwokunjalo abuye eze emnqubeni.

Nenkunzana yedini lesono, nebokwe yedini lesono, elalite igazi lazo langeniswa kuze kwenziwe uxoliso kweyingcwele indawo, ziya kukutshelwa ngapandle kwomnquba; nezikumba zazo, nenyama yazo, nomswane wazo, ezonto bozitshisa ngomlilo.
Nosukuba ezitshisa yena uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe inyama yake ngamanzi, ati emveni kwokunjalo abuye eze emnqubeni.

Kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kuni oku: ngenyanga yesixe̔nxe, ngoweshumi umhla wenyanga, niya kubandezela imipefumlo yenu, ningawenzi namnye umsebenzi, nokuba ngozelweyo elizweni, nokuba ngowasemzini opambukele pakati kwenu.
Ngokuba ngomhla lowo umperisite eya kunenzela uxoliso, ukuba nicokiswe, nize nibe nicokisekile kuzo zonke izono zenu ebusweni bukayehova.
Wona woba yisabata yopumlo kuni, ukuba nibandezele imipefumlo yenu: ngummiselwa ongunapakade.
Waye umperisite, lowo aya kumtambisa, kwa lowo aya kuzalisa izandla zake ukukonza ngobuperisite esikundleni soyise, eya kulwenza uxoliso: uya kuzambata izivato zeqiya, izivato ezingcwele,
axolisele indawo engcwele eyingcwele; waeya kuxolisela nentente yentlangano, nesibingelo; woxolisela nabaperisite, nabo bonke abantu bomhlambi, kanjalo.
Oku kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kuni, ukuba kwenzelwe usapo luka‐Sirayeli uxoliso, ngenxa yazo zonke izono zalo, kube kanye emnyakeni mnye. Waza wenza njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta ku‐Arone, nakonyana bake, nakubo bonke abalusapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kubo: Leli ilizwi aliyaleleyo uyehova, lokuti:
Umntu osukuba engowendlu ka‐Sirayeli, oya kuxe̔la inkabi, umhlaumbi imvana, umhlaumbi ibokwe, emnqubeni; umhlaumbi oya kuyixe̔la ngapandle kwomnquba;

kanti akayizisi elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, ukuba kunikelwe umnikelo kuyehova pambi kwayo itabanakele kayehova; igazi liya kubalelwa lowamntu; igazi ulipalazile; kanjalo uya kunqanyulwa lowamntu ebantwini bake;
ukuze usapo luka‐Sirayeli luze nayo imibingo yalo, oluyibingayo ngasendle, luyizise kuyehova, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, kumperisite, luyibinge ibe yimibingo yoxolo kuyehova.
Waye umperisite eya kusasaza igazi pezu kwesibingelo sikayehova, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano; nenqata wolitshisa libe livumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Alusayi kubuya lubingele idemoni imibingo yalo, ezo luṙexezele emva kwazo. Oku kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kulo ngezizukulwana zalo.
Wauya kuti kulo: Umntu osukuba engowendlu ka‐Sirayeli, nosukuba engowasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu, oya kunikela ngedini lokutshiswa, umhlaumbi ngombingo;
kanti akalizisi elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, ukuba lenzelwe uyehova; lowamntu wonqanyulwa ebantwini bake.
Nomntu osukuba engowendlu ka‐Sirayeli, nosukuba engowasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu, oya kulidla elinye igazi; sendiya kubeka ubuso bam ngakuye lowamntu odlayo igazi, ndimnqamle ebantwini bake.
Ngokuba ubomi benyama busegazini; kukona ndininikile lona pezu kwesibingelo, kuze kwenzelwe imipefumlo yenu uxoliso: ngokuba lilo igazi eliwenzela umpefumlo uxoliso.
Ngako oko ndite elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Makungabiko namnye umntu wakuni oya kulidla igazi; kanjako owasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu akayi kulidla igazi.

Nomntu osukuba engowosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nosukuba engowasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu, oya kubamba inyamakazi ekuzingeleni, umhlaumbi intaka edlekayo; lowo uya kupalaza igazi layo, aliselele ngotuli.

Ngokuba libubomi benyama yonke; igazi layo lingenxa yobomi bayo; ndati ngoko elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Igazi lenyama yonke aniyi kulidla; ngokuba ubomi benyama yonke ligazi layo; osukuba elidla, wonqanyulwa.

Nalomntu osukuba esidla into esisidumbu, umhlaumbi eqwengiweyo, nokuba ungozelweyo elizweni, nokuba ungowasemzini, yena uya kuhlanza izivato zake, ahlambe emanzini, abe enco̔lile kude kuhlwe; andule abe ecokisekile.
Kodwa ukuba akazihlanzi, nokuba akahlambi inyama yake, uya kutwala inkohlakalo yake.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Njengokwenza kwelizwe le‐Jipete, enibe nimi kulo, aniyi kwenza; nanjengokwenza kwelizwe le‐Kanane, apo ndinizisa kona, aniyi kwenza; kanjako ngemimiso yabo aniyi kuhamba.
Izigwebo zam niya kuzenza, nemimiso yam niya kuyigcina, ukuba nihambe ngayo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Ngako niya kugcina imimiso yam, nezigwebo zam; aya kuti umntu, ukuba uyazenza, apile ngazo: mna ndi nguyehova.
Akuyi kusondela namnye umntu kosukuba esisalamane senyama yake, ukuza kutyila ubuzé bake: mna ndi nguyehova.
Ubuzé boyihlo, nobuzé bonyoko, akuyi kubutyila: ungunyoko yena; akuyi kutyila ubuzé bake.
Ubuzé bomfazi woyihlo akuyi kubutyila: bubuzé boyihlo bona.
Ubuzé bodade wako, intombi yoyihlo, umhlaumbi intombi yonyoko, nokuba uzelwe endlwini, nokuba uzelwe ngapandle, ubuzé bake akuyi kubutyila.
Ubuzé bentombi yonyana wako, umhlaumbi bentombi yentombi yako, ubuzé bazo akuyi kubutyila: ngokuba zibubuzé bako zona.
Ubuzé bentombi yomfazi woyihlo, ezelweyo nguyihlo, yona ingudade wako, ubuzé bayo akuyi kubutyila.
Ubuzé bodade woyihlo akuyi kubutyila: usisalamane soyihlo yena.
Ubuzé bodade wonyoko akuyi kubutyila: ngokuba yena esisalamane sonyoko.
Ubuzé bomninawe woyihlo akuyi kubutyila, akuyi kusondela emfazini wake: yena ngunyokokazi wako.
Ubuzé bomolokazana wako akuyi kubutyila: ngumfazi wonyana wako yena; akuyi kutyila ubuzé bake.
Ubuzé bomfazi womninawe wako akuyi kubutyila: bubuzé bomninawe wako bona.
Ubuzé bomfazi nobentombi yake akuyi kubutyila; intombi yonyana wake, umhlaumbi intombi yentombi yake, akuyi kuyizeka, ukutyila ubuzé bayo; zizalamane zake zona: bubutshinitshini oku.
Kanjako akuyi kuzeka umfazi pezu kwodade wake, uku m xinezela, ukutyila ubuzé bake, ngapandle kwalowo nxa asahleli.
Akuyi kusondela emfazini esekwahlukaneleni ukunco̔la kwake, ukutyila ubuzé bake.
Akuyi kulala nomfazi wommelwane wako ngokulalela inzalo, ukuba unco̔lelwe nguye.
Nakuyo inzalo yako akuyi kunika namnye ukuba adluliswe emlilweni pambi kwo‐Moleke; negama lotixo wako akuyi kulidyoba: mna ndi nguyehova.
Akuyi kulala nendoda njengokuba kulalwa nomfazi: yintshontsho oku.
Kanjalo akuyi kulala nasinye isilo, ukuba unco̔lelwe siso: nomfazi makangemi ebusweni besilo, kuze kulalwe pantsi kuso: yinto ebugeza le.
Ize ningazinco̔lisi nganye yezi zinto: ngokuba zinco̔lelwe zizo zonke ezi zinto izizwe endiza kuzigxota pambi kwenu.
Linco̔lile ilizwe nalo; ngako ndiyohlwayela inkohlakalo yalo pezu kwalo, nelizwe lona liyahlanza abemi balo.
Nina kodwa niya kugcina imimiso yam nezigwebo zam, ningenzi nanye kuzo zonke ezizinto zibuntshontsho; owelizwe lakowenu, nowasemzini opambukeleyo pakati kwenu:
(ngokuba zonke ezizinto zibuntshontsho bezenzile abantu belozwe, ababepambili kuni; kukona ilizwe linco̔lile:)
ukuze elozwe lingahlanzi nina, nakulinco̔lisa, njengokuba lihlanzile izizwe ezibe zipambili kuni.
Ngokuba bonke abaya kwenza enye kuzo zonke ezi zinto zibuntshontsho, kwa imipefumlo eyenza ngazo yonqanyulwa pakati kwabantu bayo.
Ngako niya kugcina umyalezelo wam, wokuba ningenzi nalinye kulamasiko abuntshontsho abesenziwa pambili kuni, nokuba ningazinco̔lisi ngawo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nayo yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Noba bangcwele; ngokuba ndingcwele mna Yehova, utixo wenu.
Unyoko noyihlo niya kuboyika nonke ngabanye; nesabata zam niya kuzigcina: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Ningabeki ngakuwo amadalo, notixo abatyityishiweyo ningazenzeli bona: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Kanjalo nxa nibingelela umbingo woxolo kuyehova, niya kubingelela wona ngokutanda kwenu.
Ngomhla wokubingelela kwenu uya kudliwa, nangomnye umhla; kodwa oko kuseleyo kwada kwangumhla wesitatu, kwotshiswa ngomlilo.
Ukuba kuka kudliwe ngomhla wesitatu, kwoba yinto edlubukileyo oko; akuyi kubukwa.
Nokudlayo yena uya kutwala inkohlakalo yake, ngokuba eyinco̔lisile eyingcwele into kayehova; ngako umpefumlo lowo uya kunqanyulwa ebantwini bawo.
Kanjalo nxa nivunayo ukuvunwa kwomhlaba wenu, akuyi kugqibela ukuvuna amagumbi entsimi yako; nokubutekayo kwokuvuna kwako akuyi kukubuta.
Nesitiya sako semiti yeveyine akuyi kubikica sona; nedreyive ezivutulukileyo zesitiya sako semiti yeveyine akuyi kuzibuta; wozishiyela ihlwempu nowasemzini ezo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Ningebi̔; ningateti ilwimi, ningenzi ngobuxoki, omnye kwomnye.
Kanjako aniyi kufunga igama lam ngendawo ebuxoki; uze ungalidyobi igama lotixo wako; mna ndi nguyehova.
Akuyi kulumkisa ummelwane wako, akuyi kumpanga kanjalo; umvuzo woqeshiweyo maungalalisi kuwe kude kuse.
Akuyi kutuka ositulu, nasebusweni bemfama akuyi kubeka isiku̔bekiso; kodwa uya kwoyika utixo wako: mna ndi nguyehova.
Aniyi kwenza ngobumenemene ekugwebeni; ubuso behlwempu akuyi kububuka, nobuso bomkulu akuyi kububeka; uya kugweba ummelwane wako ngobulungisa.
Akuyi kuhambahamba uhleba pakati kwabantu bako; akuyi kuma ngakulo igazi lommelwane wako kanjalo: mna ndi nguyehova.
Akuyi kumtiya umzalwana wako entliziyweni yako; uya kukutala ukumohlwaya ummelwane wako, uze ungatwali ngenxa yake isono.
Akuyi kupindezela, kanjalo akuyi kubamba ingqumbo ngakulo usapo lwabantu bako; koko uya kutanda ummelwane wako njengokuzitanda kwako: mna ndi nguyehova.

Imimiso yam niya kuyigcina. Izilo‐zako ungazenzi zizeke ezolulumbi uhlobo; intsimi yako akuyi kuyihlwayela ngembewu yentlobo ngentlobo; kanjalo isivato esilukiweyo ngentlobo ngentlobo zencawa asiyi kuza pezu kwako.

Nosukuba elala nenkazana ngokulalela inzalo, elikobokakazi yona, exanyelwe indoda, engakululwanga nakanye, engapiwanga inkululeko kanjalo; kwobetwa ke; abayi kufiswa, ngokuba ingengokululekileyo inkazana leyo.
Waeya kuzisa idini letyala lake kuyehova, elucangweni lwentente yentlangano, kwa inkunzi yegusha ibe lidini letyala.
Waye umperisite eya kumenzela uxoliso ngegusha yedini letyala pambi kwoyehova, ngenxa yesono sake onileyo ngaso; aze axolelwe isono sake onileyo ngaso.

Naxeshekweni ningenileyo kwelozwe, natyala zonke intlobo zemiti yokutyiwa, isiqa̔mo sayo niya kusibala ngokuba sesingalukileyo: yoba yiminyaka mitatu esiya kuba njengesingalukileyo kuni; asiyi kudliwa.
Kodwa ngomnyaka wesine sonke isiqa̔mo sayo soba yinto eyingcwele yokumdumisa uyehova.
Nangomnyaka wesihlanu niya kusidla isiqa̔mo sayo, ize yandiswe kuni imveliso yayo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Aniyi kudla nto inegazi; aniyi kulaula; aniyi kwenza ngobugqi.
Amancam entloko zenu aniyi kwenza izazinge ngawo; nencam zendevu zako akuyi kuzonakalisa.
Izigebu ngenxa yofileyo aniyi kuzenza enyameni yenu, nomba̔lo wezivambo aniyi kuwenza pezu kwenu: mna ndi nguyehova.
Akuyi kudyoba intombi yako ngokuyenza ingnawokazi; ukuba ilizwe lingenzi umbulo, lide ilizwe lizale bubutshinitshini.
Isabata zam niya kuzigcina, nendawo yam eyingcwele niya kuyihlonela: mna ndi nguyehova.
Ningajikeli kubo abenzelana nemishologu, nakumatola; ningabafuni, ukuba ninco̔lelwe ngabo: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Uya kupakama ebusweni bezimvi, ububeke ubuso bexego, notixo wako umoyike: mna ndi nguyehova.
Naxeshekweni kupambukele kuwe owasemzini ukuhlala elizweni lenu, aniyi kumbandezela.
Woba njengozelweyo pakati kwenu kuni owasemzini opambukeleyo ukuhlala nani; uya kutanda yena njengokuzitanda kwako: ngokuba nibe ningabasemzini nina elizweni le‐Jipete: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Aniyi kwenza ngobumenemene ekugwebeni, ekwoluleni, ekulinganiseni, nasekuzaliseni.
Noba nesilinganiselo esilungeleleneyo, namatye okulinganisa alungeleleneyo, neyefa elungeleleneyo, nehine elungeleleneyo: ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu, onipumisileyo elizweni le‐Jipete.
Kukona niya kugcina yonke imimiso yam, nazo zonke izigwebo zam, nizenze: mna ndi nguyehova.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Woti kanjalo elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Umntu wakwabalusapo luka‐Sirayeli, nowakwabasemzini abapambukeleyo kwa‐Sirayeli, osukuba enika kwinzalo yake ku‐Moleke, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso; abantu belizwe baya kumgibisela ngamatye.
Nam ndiya kubeka ubuso bam ngakuye lowamntu, ndimnqamle pakati kwabantu bake; ngokuba enikile kwinzalo yake ku‐Moleke, ukuze anco̔lise indawo yam eyingcwele, negama lam elingcwele alidyobe.
Kanjalo ukuba abantu belizwe baka bamfihlele lowamntu amehlo abo, akunika kwinzalo yake ku‐Moleke, baze bangamfisi;
sendiya kubeka ubuso bam ngakuye lowamntu, nangakuso isizalwane sake, ndize ndimnqamle yena, nabo bonke abaṙexezela emva kwake, ukuya kuṙexezela emva kwo‐Moleke, pakati kwabantu babo.
Nompefumlo ojikelayo kwabenzelana nemishologu, nakumatola, ukuya kuṙexezela emva kwabo, sendiya kubeka ubuso bam ngakuwo umpefumlo lowo, ndiwunqamle pakati kwabantu bawo.
Zingcwaliseni ngoko, nibe ngabangcwele: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Ize nigcine imimiso yam, niyenze: mna ndi nguyehova oningcwalisayo.
Nxa kuko umntu otukileyo uyise, umhlaumbi unina, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso: utukile uyise, umhlaumbi unina; igazi lake loba pezu kwake.
Nendoda eṙexezayo nomfazi w omnye umntu, eṙexezayo nomfazi wommelwane wayo, umṙexezi nomṙexezikazi baya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Kanjalo indoda eleleyo nomfazi woyise, ubuzé boyise ibutyilile: baya kufiswa ngenyaniso bobabini; igazi labo loba pezu kwabo.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kulala nomolokazana wayo, baya kufiswa ngenyaniso bobabini: benze into ebugeza; igazi labo loba pezu kwabo.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kulala n enye indoda, njengokuba kulalwa nomfazi, wona ayenzile intshontsho omabini: aya kufiswa ngenyaniso; igazi lawo loba pezu kwawo.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kuzeka umfazi nonina wake, bubutshinitshini oku: baya kutshiswa ngomlilo, kwa yona nabo bona; kuze kungabiko ubutshinitshini pakati kwenu.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kulala nesilo, iya kufiswa ngenyaniso: nesilo niya kusibulala.
Kanjalo umfazi nxa aya kusondela kwesinye isilo ukuza kulala pantsi kuso, uya kubulala umfazi lowo nesilo eso: baya kufiswa ngenyaniso: igazi labo loba pezu kwabo.

Naxeshekweni indoda iya kuzeka udade wayo, intombi kayise, umhlaumbi intombi kanina, ibone ubuzé bake, ati yena abone ubuzé bayo, kulihlazo oko; ngako bonqanyulwa emehlweni osapo lwabantu babo: ibutyilile ubuzé bodade wayo; iya kutwala inkohlakalo yayo.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kulala nomfazi onesifo sake, ibutyile ubuzé bake; itombo lake ilenze zé, naye ulityilile itombo legazi lake: ngako bonqanyulwa bobabini pakati kwabantu babo.
Kanjako ubuzé bodade kanyoko, nobodade kayihlo, akuyi kubutyila: ngokuba owenje njalo ehlubulule isalamane sake: baya kutwala inkohlakalo yabo.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kulala noninakazi wayo, ubuzé boyisekazi wayo ibutyilile: baya kutwala isono sabo; baya kufa bengenabantwana.
Naxeshekweni indoda iya kuzeka umfazi womninawe wayo, kuyinto enco̔lileyo oko: ubuzé bomninawe wayo ibutyilile; boba bengenabantwana.
Gcinani ngoko yonke imimiso yam, nazo zonke izigwebo zam, nizenze; lize linganihlanzi elozwe, apo ndinizisa kona ukuba nihlale kulo.
Ize ningahambi ngamasiko esizwe, endisikupayo pambi kwenu: ngokuba zonke ezi zinto bezenzile bona; kungoko endibatiyileyo.
Nina kodwa ndite kuni: Niya kulidla ilifa lelizwe labo; ndolinika kuni kwa mna, ukuba nilidle ilifa lalo, ilizwe elela ubisi nobusi: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu, onahlulileyo kw abanye abantu.

Kukona niya kukwenza ukwahluka pakati kwezilo ezicocekileyo nezinco̔lileyo, napakati kwentaka ezinco̔lileyo nezicocekileyo; aniyi kudlubukisa imipefumlo yenu ngesilo, nangentaka, nanganye into enambuzelayo pezu kwomhlaba, endinahlulele zona ukuba nizibale ngokuba zinco̔lile.
Noba ngabangcwele kum, ngokuba ndingcwele mna Yehoya; kungoko endinahlulile kw abanye abantu, ukuze nibe ngabam.
Kanjako indoda, umhlaumbi umfazi, ekukubo ubushologu, umhlaumbi ubutola, baya kufiswa ngenyaniso: baya kugityiselwa ngamatye; igazi labo loba pezu kwabo.
WANDULA wati uyehova ku‐Mosesi: Teta kubaperisite, onyana baka‐Arone, uti kubo: Ngenxa yofileyo akayi kuzinco̔lisa umperisite pakati kwabantu bake:
kupela ngenxa yesalamane sake esikufupi kuye, ngenxa yonina, nangenxa yoyise, nangenxa yonyana wake, nangenxa yentombi yake, nangenxa yomninawe wake;
nangenxa yodade wake oyintombi ipela, okufupi kuye, ongekabi nandoda; ngenxa yaló uya kuzinco̔lisa.
Akayi kuzinco̔lisa nangenxa yoyinkosi pakati kwabantu bake, ukuba azidyobe.
Abayi kwenza ubunqai pezu kwentloko zabo, nezincam zendevu zabo abayi kuzigugula, nasenyameni yabo abayi kugebula izigebu.
Boba ngabangcwele kutixo wabo, negama lotixo wabo abayi kulidyoba: ngokuba bona benikela iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova, ukutya kwotixo wabo; ngako boba ngcwele.
Inkazana eyingnawokazi umhlaumbi edyojiweyo abayi kuyizeka, nomfazi olahliweyo yindoda yake abayi kumzeka kanjalo: ngokuba umperisite eyingcwele kutixo wake.
Ngako uya kumngcwalisa; ngokuba enikela ukutya kwotixo wako: woba ngcwele kuwe; ngokuba ndingcwele mna Yehova, oningcwalisayo.
Kanjako intombi yongumperisite, nxa izidyobayo ngokwenza umbulo, iyadyoba noyise wayo: iya kutshiswa ngomlilo.

Nalowo ongumperisite omkulu pakati kwabazalwana bake, obekugalelwa pezu kwentloko yake ioli yokutambisa, nozandla zake zizalisiwe ukwambata izivato, intloko yake akayi kuyihlubulula, nezivato zake akayi kuziṙazula.
Kanjalo akayi kuza ngakuwo namnye umzimba ofileyo; akayi kuzinco̔lisa ngenxa yoyise nangenxa yonina.
Akayi kupuma endaweni eyingcwele, aze angayidyobi eyingcwele indawo yotixo wake; ngokuba ikrone yeoli yokutambisa yotixo wake ipezu kwake: mna ndi nguyehova.
Uya kuzeka umfazi esebutonjini bake.
Umhlolokazi, nolahliweyo, nodyojiweyo, n oyingnawokazi, abanjalo akayi kubazeka; koko eya kuzeka intombi ipela yasebantwini bake ibe ngumfazi.
Kanjako akayi kudyoba inzalo yake pakati kwabantu bake: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova omngcwalisayo.
Waza wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta ku‐Arone, usiti: Umntu wakwinzalo yako, ngezizukulwana zabo, ekukuye isonakalo, akayi kusondela ukuza kunikela ukutya kwotixo wake.
Ngokuba engasayi kusondela namnye umntu ekukuye isonakalo: oyimfama, umhlaumbi osisiqwala, umhlaumbi ompumlo ibenileyo, umhlaumbi onendawo ekulelweyo,
umhlaumbi umntu ononyawo oluṙunekileyo, umhlaumbi onesandla esapukileyo,
umhlaumbi osisifombo, umhlaumbi oyingqeqe, umhlaumbi onomlanga elisweni lake, umhlaumbi onokubabeka, umhlaumbi onokwekwe, umhlaumbi omasende atyunyuzweyo:

akayi kusondela namnye umntu, ekukuye isonakalo, kwinzalo ka‐Arone umperisite, ukuza kunikela iminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova: isonakalo sikuye; ukutya kwotixo wake akayi kusondela ukunikela kona.
Ukutya kwotixo wake, okwezinto ezingcwelekazi, nokwezinto ezingcwele, angakudla;
kodwa kulo ikuselo akayi kuza, nakuso isibingelo akayi kusondela, ngenxa yokuba isonakalo sikuye; ukuze angazidyobi indawo zam ezingcwele: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova obangcwalisayo.
Waye u‐Mosesi wateta ezizinto ku‐Arone, nakonyana bake, nakulo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta ku‐Arone nakonyana bake, ukuba bazile izinto ezingcwele zosapo luka‐Sirayeli, nokuba bangadyobi igama lam elingcwele ngoko lundingcwalisele kona: mna ndi nguyehova.

Yiti kubo: Umntu wakuyo yonke inzalo yenu, pakati kwezizukulwana zenu, osukuba eya kusondela kwezingcwele izinto, ezo usapo luka‐Sirayeli luzingcwalisile kuyehova, nxa ukunco̔la kwake kupezu kwake, umpefumlo lowo wonqanyulwa kwa sebusweni bam: mna ndi nguyehova.

Owakuyo inzalo ka‐Arone osukuba elileperi, umhlaumbi engonegqita, yena akayi kuzidla izinto ezingcwele, ade abe ecokisekile. Kanjako ocukumisayo enye into enco̔lileyo ngomzimba ofileyo, umhlaumbi indoda ekupuma kuyo imbewu yokulala;
umhlaumbi osukuba ecukumisa esinye isinambuzane anganco̔liswayo siso, umhlaumbi umntu anganco̔liswayo nguye, noko ukunco̔la kwake kukokunjanina;
umntu ocukumisayo okunjalo, woba enco̔lile kude kuhlwe; akayi kudla kwezingcwele izinto, kupela nxa ahlambile inyama yake ngamanzi.
Woti lakutshona ilanga abe ecokisekile, ati kamva adle kwezingcwele izinto; ngokuba kukutya kwake oko.
Into esisidumbu, umhlaumbi eqwengiweyo, akayi kuyidla, ukuba azinco̔lise ngayo: mna ndi nguyehova.
Ngako baya kugcina umyalezelo wam, ukuba bangatwali isono ngenxa yawo, bafe nokufa ngawo, nxa bawudyobayo: mna ndi nguyehova obangcwalisayo.
Kanjalo akuyi kudla okuyingcwele namnye owasemzini; oliṙanuka lomperisite, noqeshiweyo, akayi kudla okuyingcwele.
Kodwa nxa umperisite aya kutenga umntu ngemali yake, lo uya kudla kuko, kwa nozelweyo endlwini yake: bona baya kudla ekutyeni kwake.
Nentombi yomperisite, nxa ingumfazi wendoda engowasemzini, yona ayiyi kudla kumnikelo wezinto ezingcwele.

Koko ukuba intombi yomperisite ingumhlolokazi, umhlaumbi ngolahliweyo, ekungeko kuyo inzalo, nebuyeleyo endlwini kayise njengasebutsheni bayo, iya kudla kuko ukutya kwoyise wayo: kodwa akuyi kudla kuko namnye owasemzini.
Kanjako ukuba umntu uya kudla into eyingcwele ngesiposo, uya kubeka esesihlanu isiqingata senani lako pezu kwako, andule asinike kumperisite kunye nalonto eyingcwele.
Abayi kuzidyoba izinto ezingcwele zosapo lu ka‐Sirayeli, ezo luzinikele kuyehova;
baze balutwese inkohlakalo yetyala, lwakuzidla izinto zalo ezingcwele: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova olungcwalisayo.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Teta ku‐Arone, nakonyana bake, nakulo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kubo: Umntu osukuba engowendlu ka‐Sirayeli, nowabasemzini abakwa‐Sirayeli, oya kunikela umnikelo wake, ngenxa yazo zonke izibambiso zabo, nangenxa yayo yonke iminikelo yabo yesisa, abaya kunikela ngayo kuyehova, libe lidini lokutshiswa;
makunikelwe ngentando yenu inkunzi emsulwa pakati kwenkomo, pakati kwegusha, umhlaumbi pakati kwebokwe.
Zonke ekukuzo isonakalo, aniyi kunikela ngazo; ngokuba zingayi kuba nakunibukelwa.

Nosukuba eya kunikela umbingo woxolo kuyehova, ukufeza isibambiso, umhlaumbi ukunika umnikelo wesisa, ngezinkulu umhlaumbi ngezincinane inkomo, wona woba msulwa ukuba ukoleleke; akuyi kubako nasinye isonakalo kuwo.

Into eyimfama, umhlaumbi eyapukileyo, umhlaumbi esisilima, umhlaumbi enesihlava, umhlaumbi enokubabeka, umhlaumbi enokwekwe, aniyi kunikela ngezinjalo kuyehova; nomnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo aniyi kuwenza ngazo pezu kwesibingelo kuyehova.
Kanti inkomo, umhlaumbi igusha, enendawo ekulelweyo umhlaumbi efinyeleyo, leyo ungawenza ngayo umnikelo wesisa; kodwa ukuba ibe sisibambiso ayiyi kukoleleka.
Aniyi kunikela kuyehova encinezelweyo, netyunyuziweyo, neṙuzulweyo, nesikelweyo; aniyi kwenje njalo elizweni lenu.
Kanjako aniyi kunikela ukutya kwotixo wenu ngenye yezi ezivela esandleni sowelinye ilizwe; ngokuba ukudlubuka kwazo kukuzo; isonakalo sikuzo; aziyi kunibukelwa.
Wateta uyehova kanjako ku‐Mosesi, esiti:

Inkomo, umhlaumbi igusha, umhlaumbi ibokwe, xeshekweni izelweyo, yoba yimihla isixe̔nxe ngapantsi kwonina; yoti ngomhla wesibozo nangexesha eliza kuza, ikoleleke ukuba ibe ngumnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Nokuba yinkomo, nokuba yigusha, aniyi kuxe̔la yona netole layo ngomhla mnye.
Naxeshekweni niya kubinga umbingo wombulelo kuyehova, niya kubinga ngokwentando yenu.
Kwa ngomhla lowo uya kudliwa; aniyi kusalisa nto kuwo kude kuse: mna ndi nguyehova.
Ngako niya kugcina imiyalelo yam, niyenze: mna ndi nguyehova.
Negama lam elingcwele aniyi kulidyoba, koko ndiya kungcwaliswa pakati kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli: mna ndi nguyehova, oningcwalisayo;
lowo onipumisileyo elizweni le‐Jipete, ndize ndibe ngutixo wenu: mna ndi nguyehova.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Imitendeleko kayehova, eniya kuyishumayela ukuba zintlanganisano ezingcwele, yiyo le imitendeleko yam.
Yimihla mitandatu ekuya kwenziwa umsebenzi; kodwa ngomhla wesixe̔nxe yisabata yopumlo, intlanganisano engcwele; aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi ngawo: yisabata kayehova kuwo onke amakaya enu.
Yiyo le imitendeleko kayehova, intlanganisano ezingcwele, eniya kuyishumayela ngamaxeska ayo amisiweyo.
Ngenyanga yokuqala, ngoweshumi linesine umhla, pakati kwokuhlwa, yipasika kayehova.
Nangomhla weshumi linesihlanu walenyanga, ngumtendeleko wezonka ezingenagwele kuyehova: yimihla esixe̔nxe eniya kutya izonka ezingenagwele.
Ngowokuqala umhla noba nentlanganisano engcwele: aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi wenkonzo ngawo.
Koko niya kunikela umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova imihla ibe sixe̔nxe: ngomhla wesixe̔nxe yintlanganisano engcwele; aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi wenkonzo ngawo.
Wabuya wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Xeshekweni nise nifikile kwelozwe endinipa lona, naza navuna ukuvunwa kwalo, niya kwandula nizise isitungu sesiqalo sokuvuna kwenu kumperisite;
oya kushukushukumisa isitungu eso pambi kwoyehova, ngenxa yokubukwa kwenu: ngomhla wokusa emveni kwayo isabata umperisite wosishukushukumisa.
Naniya kunikela ngomhla wokushukushukumisa kwenu isitungu eso imvana emsulwa, eyomnyaka mnye, ibe lidini lokutshiswa kuyehova;

kwa nomnikelo wokudla wayo, isibini sezeshumi iziqingata zeyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo unyeliwe ngeoli, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova, libe livumba elimnandi; nomnikelo wokusela wayo weveyine, isiqingata sesine sehine.
Isonka, namaqashu, nezikwebu eziluhlaza, aniyi kuzidla, kude kube ngokwa nguwo umhla eniya kuzisa ngawo umnikelo wotixo wenu: woba ngummiselwa ongunapakade ngezizukulwana zenu, kuwo onke amakaya enu.
Kanjalo niya kubala kuni nitabata komnye umhla emveni kwesabata, kwa semhleni wokuzisa kwenu isitungu sokushukushukunyiswa; zoba zisabata ezizalisekileyo zisixe̔nxe:
kwa kude kube ngomnye umhla emveni kweyesixe̔nxe isabata niya kubala imihla imashumi mahlanu; nize ninikele umnikelo wokudla omtsha kuyehova.
Niya kuzisa zivela emakayeni enu izonka zokushukushukunyiswa zizibini; zoba zezezibini ezeshumi iziqingata zeyefa yomgubo ocolekileyo; sezibilisiwe ziya kwojwa: lulibo kuyehova.

Naniya kunikela ndawonye nezonka ezo imvana ezimsulwa zibe sixe̔nxe, ezomnyaka mnye, kwa nenkunzana elitole lenkomo ibe nye, nenkunzi zegusha zibe mbini: zoba lidini lokutshiswa kuyehova, kunye nomnikelo wokudla wazo neminikelo yokusela yazo, umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuyehova.
Nandule nenze ixwana linye lebokwe libe lidini lesono, nemvana zimbini zomnyaka mnye zibe ngumbingo woxolo.
Waye umperisite eya kuzishukushukumisa ndawonye nezonka zolibo, zibe ngumnikelo wokushukushukunyiswa, pambi kwoyehova, kunye nemvana zombini: zoba yingcwele kuyehova ngenxa yomperisite.

Naniya kushumayela ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo, ukuba makube yintlanganisano engcwele kuni: aniyi kwenza namnye umsebenzi wenkonzo ngawo: kwoba ngummiselwa ongunapakade kuwo onke amakaya enu ngezizukulwana zenu.

Naxeshekweni nivunayo ukuvunwa kwomhlaba wenu, akuyi kugqibela amagumbi entsimi yako ekuvuneni kwako; nokubutekayo kwokuvuna kwako akuyi kukubuta; wokushiyela ihlwempu nowasemzini oko: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Wateta uyehova kanjako ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Ngenyanga yesixe̔nxe, ngowokuqala umhla wenyanga, noba nopumlo, inkumbuzo yokuhlokoma kwamaxilongo, intlanganisano engcwele.
Aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi wenkonzo; koko niya kunikela umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Walekela wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Kanjalo ngoweshumi umhla walenyanga yesixe̔nxe, ngumhla wokuxolisa wona; noba nentlanganisano engcwele; naniya kubandezela imipefumlo yenu, ninikele umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Nangokwa nguwo umhla lowo aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi: ngokuba ungumhla wokuxolisa wona, wokuba kunenzelwe uxoliso ebusweni bukayehova, utixo wenu.
Ngokuba yonke imipefumlo engabandezelwanga ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo, yona yonqanyulwa ebantwini bayo.
Nayo yonke imipefumlo eyenzayo omnye umsebenzi ngokwa nguwo umhla lowo, sendiya kutshabalalisa imipefumlo leyo pakati kwabantu bayo.
Aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi: ngummiselwa ongunapakade ngezizukulwana zenu kuwo onke amakaya enu.
Woba yisabata yopumlo kuni, eniya kubandezela imipefumlo yenu ngayo: ngowesitoba umhla wenyanga ngokuhlwa, kwa sekuhlweni kude kube sekuhlweni, niya kuyenza isabata yenu.
Wandula wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, usiti: Ngoweshumi linesihlanu umhla walenyanga yesixe̔nxe, kwobako umtendeleko wamapempe imihla ibe sixe̔nxe kuyehova.
Ngomhla wokuqala kwobako intlanganisano engcwele: aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi wenkonzo ngawo.

Yoba yimihla esixe̔nxe eniya kunikela umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova; ngomhla wesibozo noba nentlanganisano engcwele, naniya kunikela umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova: yintlanganiso enkulu; aniyi kuwenza namnye umsebenzi.

Yiyo le imitendeleko kayehova, eniya kuyishumayela ukuba zintlanganisano ezingcwele, kuze kunikelwe umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova, idini lokutshiswa nomnikelo wokudla, umbingelelo neminikelo yokusela, into yemini ngemini yayo:
ngapandle kwesabata zikayehova, nangapandle kwezipo zenu, nangapandle kwazo zonke izibambiso zenu, nangapandle kwayo yonke iminikelo yenu yesisa, eniyinikayo kuyehova.

Kodwa ngoweshumi linesihlanu umhla wenyanga yesixe̔nxe, nxa nibutileyo imveliso yomhlaba, niya kubamba umtendeleko kayehova imihla ibe sixe̔nxe: ngomhla wokuqala lwobako upumlo, nangomhla wesibozo lwobako upumlo.

Niya kutabatela kuni ngomhla wokuqala amasebe emiti emihle, amasebe emiti yepalime, namagatya emiti ebungqingqwa, nemincunuba yasemlanjaneni; naniya kugcoba pambi kwoyehova, utixo wenu, imihla ibe sixe̔nxe.
Lowo umtendeleko niya kuwubamba kuyehova imihla ibe sixe̔nxe emnyakeni mnye: ngummiselwa ongunapakade ezizukulwaneni zenu; ngenyanga yesixe̔nxe niya kuwubamba.
Niya kuhlala emapempeni imihla ibe sixe̔nxe; bonke abangama‐Sirayeli ngokuzalwa bohlala emapempeni;
ukuze zikwazi izizukulwana zenu okokuba bendihlalisa usapo luka‐Sirayeli emapempeni, ndakulupumisa elizweni le‐Jipete: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Waye u‐Mosesi waxela imitendeleko kayehova elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli.
WABUYA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Yalela usapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba luyizise kuwe ioli engcwengileyo yamanquma anqushiweyo ibe yeyesikanyiso, kuze kumiswe izibane ngamaxesha onke.
Ngapandle kwekuselo lesinqi̔no, kuyo intente yentlangano, uya kulungisa sona u‐Arone, kwa sekuhlweni kude kuse, ebusweni bukayehova, ngamaxesha onke: ngummiselwa ongunapakade kwizizukulwana zenu.
Pezu kwekandelare ecocekileyo uya kulungisa izibane ebusweni bukayehova futi.
Kanjalo uya kutabata umgubo ocolekileyo, woje ngawo izonkana zibe lishumi elinazibini: zoba zezibini ezeshumi iziqingata zeyefa kwesinye isonkana.
Wauya kubeka zona ngenṙozo zimbini, zibe zitandatu eluṙozweni lunye, pezu kwayo itafile ecocekileyo, pambi kwoyehova.
Wandule ubeke pezu kwenṙozo zombini intlakamhlope engcwengileyo, ize ibe ngumnikelo wokukumbuza pezu kwesonka, kwa umnikelo owenziwa ngomlilo kuyehova.
Yonke imihla yesabata ngaminye wosilungisa pambi kwoyehova futi, sivela elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli ngocebano olungunapakade.
Soba sesika‐Arone nesonyana bake, abaya kusitya kweyingcwele indawo; ngokuba siyinto eyingcwelekazi kuye pakati kweminikelo eyenziwa ngomlilo kayehova, ngommiselo ongunapakade.
KEKALOKU kwapuma unyana womfazi ongum‐Sirayelikazi, obengunyana wendoda engum‐Jipete, pakati kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli: wasuka lo nyana wom‐Sirayelikazi wangxolisana nendoda engum‐Sirayeli emnqubeni.
Waza unyana wom‐Sirayelikazi waligxeka igama lika‐Yehova, watuka; ngako bamzisa ku‐Mosesi: laye igama lonina lingu‐Shelomiti, intombi ka‐Diberi, owesizwe sika‐Dane.
Baye bemfaka entolongweni, ukuda bashunyayezwe ngelizwe likayehova.
Wada wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Umtuki lowo mkupele pandle kwomnquba, bati bonke ababesiva balalise izandla zabo pezu kwentloko yake; yandule yonke intlanganiso imgibisele ngamatye.
Nakulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli uya kuteta, usiti: Umntu osukuba etuka utixo wake, uya kutwala isono sake.
Nogxekayo igama likayehova, yena uya kufiswa ngenyaniso; yonke intlanganiso yomgibisela ngamatye ngenyaniso: owasemzini woba njengozelweyo elizweni; nxa agxekayo igama lika‐Yehova, uya kufiswa.
Nosukuba ebulala omnye umntu ubomi, uya kufiswa ngenyaniso.
Kanjalo obulalayo isilo ubomi, uya kusibuyekezela; isilo ngenxa yesilo.
Naxeshekweni umntu enzela ummelwane wake isonakalo; njengoko akwenzileyo, kuya kwenziwa njalo nakuye:
isapuko ngenxa yesapuko, iliso ngenxa yeliso, izinyo ngenxa yezinyo: njengokuba enzele umntu isonakalo, uya kwenzelwa njalo naye.
Lowo obulalayo isilo, wosibuyekezela; kanti obulalayo umntu, uya kufiswa.
Noba nesiko linye; owasemzini woba njengozelweyo elizweni: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Waza u‐Mosesi wateta elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, ukuba malumkupe umtuki lowo ngapandle kwomnquba, lumgibisele ngamatye. Lwati usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwenza njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi ngasentabeni ye‐Sinai, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, uti kulo: Xeshekweni nise nifikile kulomhlaba endinipa wona, uya kupumla umhlaba lowo isabata kuyehova.
Yiminyaka mitandatu uya kuhlwayela intsimi yako, neminyaka mitandatu uya kunqumla isitiya sako semiti yeveyine, nemveliso yaso uyibute.
Kodwa ngomnyaka wesixe̔nxe yobako isabata yopumlo emhlabeni, isabata kuyehova: intsimi yako akuyi kuyihlwayela, nesitiya sako semiti yeveyine akuyi kusinqumla.
Oko kuhlumileyo ngokwako kwokuvuna kwako akuyi kukuvuna, nedreyive zomti wako weveyine onganqunyulwanga akuyi kuzika: woba ngumnyaka wopumlo emhlabeni.
Isabata yomhlaba yoba kukutya kuni; kwa kuwe, nakwisicaka sako, nakwisicakakazi sako, nakumqeshwa wako, nakwiṙanuka lako lakwabapambukele kuwe,
nakwinkomo zako, nakwizilo eziselizweni lako, yonke imveliso yayo yoba kukutya.
Kanjako uya kubala kuwe isabata zeminyaka zibe sixe̔nxe, kwa izixe̔nxe zeminyaka ezisixe̔nxe; ize imihla yesabata zeminyaka zosixe̔nxe ibe yiminyaka ingamashumi mane anesitoba kuwe.
Uya kwandula uhlokomise ixilongo lokuvusa ngenyanga yesixe̔nxe, ngoweshumi umhla wenyanga; ngomhla wokuxolisa niya kuhlokomisa ixilongo kulo lonke ilizwe lenu.

Naniya kuwenza ngcwele lomnyaka wamashumi mahlanu, nishumayele inkululeko elizweni kubo bonke abemi balo: woba ngumnyaka womgcobo kuni wona; naniya kubuya nonke ngabanye niye emafeni enu, niti kanjalo nibuye nonke ngabanye niye kwizizalwane zenu.
Woba ngumnyaka womgcobo kuni lomnyaka wamashumi mahlanu: aniyi kuhlwayela, aniyi kuvuna nokuvuna oko kuhlumileyo ngokwako kuwo, n edreyive zawo zomti weveyine onganqunyulwanga aniyi kuzika.
Ngokuba ngumnyaka womgcobo wona; woba ngcwele kuni: niya kuyidla imveliso yawo emasimini.
Ngalomnyaka womgcobo niya kubuya nonke ngabanye niye emafeni enu.
Ngako xeshekweni nitengisa ummelwane wako into yokutengwa, umhlaumbi nitenge into esandleni sommelwane wako, aniyi kubandezelana:
ngenani leminyaka emveni kwowomgcobo uya kutenga kummelwane wako, na ngenani leminyaka yokuvelisa uya kutengisa kuwe:
njengobuninzi beminyaka uya kwandisa ixabiso layo, nanjengobuncinane beminyaka uya kuncipisa ixabiso layo; ngokuba kungenani leminyaka yokuvelisa atengisayo kuwe.
Ize ningabandezelani; kodwa moyike utixo wako: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Ngako niya kuyenza imimiso yam, nezigwebo zam niya kuzigcina, nizenze; naniya kuhlala elizweni ngokunqaba.
Kanjalo umhlaba wonika ukuqa̔ma kwawo, naniya kutya kude kuhlutwe, nihlale nokuhlala ngokunqaba kuwo.
Naxeshekweni niya kuti: Sotya nto nina ngomnyaka wesixe̔nxe? bona ke, asiyi kuhlwayela, asiyi kubuta inzuzo yetu kanjako;
ndiya kwandula ndiyalele itamsanqa lam libe pezu kwenu ngomnyaka wesitandatu, oya kuvelisa inzuzo eyan ele iminyaka mitatu.
Noti umnyaka wesibozo nihlwayele, nitye nokutya kwendala inzuzo ude ube ngumnyaka wetoba; kude kufike imveliso yawo niya kutya endala.
Umhlaba awuyi kutengiselwa ixesha elingunapakade, umhlaba ungowam nje: ngokuba nina ningabasemzini namaṙanuka ngakum.
Ngako kuwo wonke umhlaba wokufuya kwenu, niya kuvumela umhlaba inkululwa.
Nxa umzalwana wako aya kuhlwempuza, aze atengise ngento yomhlaba wemfuyo yake, sekuya kuza umkululi, osisalamane kuye, akulule okutengisiweyo ngumzalwana wake.
Naxeshekweni umntu angenaye umkululi, kanti yena unamandla ngokwake ukufumana okwaneleyo inkululwa yako;
makayibale iminyaka yokutengiswa kwako, ati okupezulu akubuyisele kulomntu waetengisile ngako kuye; aze abuyele emfuyweni yake.

Kodwa ukuba isandla sake asinakufumana okwaneleyo ukuba akubuyisele kuye, kwohlala okutengisiweyo nguye esandleni salowo okutengileyo, kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo; koko ngo mnyaka womgcobo kuya kupuma, ati yena abuyele emfuyweni yake.
Naxeshekweni umntu atengisa ngendlu yokuhlala esixekweni esibiyelwe ludonga, angaba nokuyikulula ude ugqitywe umnyaka wokutengiswa kwayo: pakati kwomnyaka upela angaba nokuyikulula.

Kodwa ukuba ayikululwa pakati kwokuzaliswa kwomnyaka ofezekileyo, leyondlu esesixekweni esibiyelwe ludonga yoqiniswa kude kube ngunapakade kulowo oyitengileyo ngezizukulwana zake: ayiyi kupuma ngo mnyaka womgcobo.
Kanti izindlu zemizi ekungeko kuyo udonga olungqongayo, zobalwa ngokuba zizindle zelizwe: zoba nokukululwa; ziya kupuma ngo mnyaka womgcobo.
Kodwa izixeko zaba‐Levi, n ezindlu zezixeko zemfuyo yabo, aba‐Levi boba nokuzikulula ngamaxesha onke.
Naxeshekweni kukululwe ngowaba‐Levi, kuya kupuma indlu ebitengisiwe, nesixeko semfuyo yake, ngo mnyaka womgcobo: ngokuba izindlu zezixeko zaba‐Levi ziyimfuyo yabo pakati kwalo usapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Kodwa izindle zenqele zezixeko zabo azitengeki; ngokuba ziyimfuyo engunapakade kubo.
Kanjako nxa umzalwana wako aya kuhlwempuza, abohle ngamandla ake ngakuwe, yena uya kumxasa, nokuba ungowasemzini, nokuba uliṙanuka, ukuze abe nokupila ngakuwe.
Akuyi kutabata kuye inzuzo enkulu, nokwanda okuninzi; koko uya kwoyika utixo wako, ukuze abe nokupila ngakuwe umzalwana wako.
Imali yako akuyi kuyinika kuye ngenxa yenzuzo enkulu, nokutya kwako akuyi kumboleka kona ngenxa yokwanda okuninzi.
Mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu, onipumisileyo ezweni le‐Jipete, ukuba ndininike ilizwe le‐Kanane, ndize ndibe ngutixo kuni.
Kananjalo nxa umzalwana wako ongakuwe aya kuhlwempuza, andule azitengise kuwe, akuyi kumkonzisa ngenkonzo yekoboka:
njengomqeshwa, njengoliṙanuka wobako kuwe: kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo uya kukonza kuwe;
andule apume kuwe, yena nosapo lwake kunye naye, abuyele kwisizalwane sakowabo; wobuyela kwa kuyo imfuyo yoyise bake.
Ngokuba bezizicaka zam, endibapumisileyo elizweni le‐Jipete; abayi kutengelwa ngokutengiswa kwekoboka.
Akuyi kupata ubukosi pezu kwake ngobulukuni; koko uya kwoyika utixo wako.
Ikoboka lako nekobokakazi lako, lawo uya kuba nawo, wona oba ngawentlanga eziningqongayo; kwa kuzo niya kutenga ikoboka nekobokakazi.
Nakanjako usapo lwamaṙanuka apambukeleyo kuni, kwa kulo niya kuwatenga, nakuzo izizalwane zalo ezipakati kwenu, ezo luzizeleyo elizweni lenu: wona oba yimfuyo kuni.

Naniya kuwashiya abe lilifa kubantwana benu emva kwenu, ukuba bawabambe abe yimfuyo; wona niya kuwakonzisa kude kube ngunapakade; kodwa pezu kwabazalwana benu usapo luka‐Sirayeli, aniyi kupata ubukosi omnye pezu kwomnye ngobulukuni.

Naxeshekweni aya kutyeba owasemzini umhlaumbi oliṙanuka ngakuwe, ati umzalwana wako ngakuye ahlwempuze, ade azitengise kowasemzini umhlaumbi k oliṙanuka ngakuwe, umhlaumbi kowesipunzi sesizalwane sowasemzini:
angati emveni kwokutengiswa kwake enzelwe inkululwa; omnye kwabazalwana bake angamkulula.
Umhlaumbi uyisekazi wake, umhlaumbi unyana woyisekazi wake, uya kumkulula; umhlaumbi osisalamane senyama yake kwisizalwane sake uya kumkulula; umhlaumbi ukuba kuyenzeka kuye, angazikulula yena.

Waeya kubalelana nalowo owamtengayo, kutabata emnyakeni wokutengiswa kwake kuye, kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo: yoti imali yokutengiswa kwake ibe ngenani leminyaka; njengemihla yomqeshwa kwoba njalo kuye.
Ukuba isemininzi ke iminyaka, kwa ngokwaleyo uya kubuyisa ixabiso lenkululwa yake, kulomali watengwa ngayo.
Kanti ukuba kusala iminyaka emincinane kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo, uya kubalelana naye; na ngokweminyaka yake wobuyisa ixabiso lenkululwa yake.
Njengomqeshwa womnyaka ngomnyaka wobako kuye; akayi kupata ubukosi pezu kwake ngobulukuni emehlweni ako.
Woti ukuba akakululwa pakati kwale minyaka, andule apume ngomnyaka womgcobo, yena nosapo lwake kunye naye.
Ngokuba usapo luka‐Sirayeli luzizicaka kum; luzizicaka zam lona, endilupumisileyo elizweni le‐Jipete: mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.

ANIYI kuzenzela amadalo, nomfanekiso oqingqiweyo; aniyi kuzipakamisela isifanekiso esimiyo kanjalo; nelitye eliba̔liweyo aniyi kulimisa elizweni lenu, ukuba nitobe pantsi pambi kwalo: ngokuba mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu.
Isabata zam niya kuzigcina, nendawo yam engcwele niya kuyihlonela: ndi nguyehova mna.
Ukuba niyahamba ngemimiso yam, nigcine nemiyalelo yam, niyenze nokuyenza;
ndiya kwandula ndiyinise imvula yenu ngexesha layo; woti umhlaba unike ukuhluma kwawo, nemiti yasendle inike ukuqa̔ma kwayo;
liti ixesha lokubula lifikele ukuvunwa kwedreyive, nokuvunwa kwedreyive kufikele ixesha lokuhlwayela; naniya kudla ukutya kwenu kude kuhlutwe, nihlale ngokunqaba elizweni lenu.
Kanjalo ndonika uxolo elizweni, nize, niti tyambalala, kungeko oya kunitusa: ndandiya kupelisa amaṙamncwa elizweni; kanjalo iṙele aliyi kudlula elizweni lenu.
Naniya kusukela intshaba zenu, eziya kuwa pambi kwenu ngeṙele.
Isihlanu sakuni sosukela iwaka, nekulu lakuni losukela ishumi lamawaka; ziti intshaba zenu ziwe pambi kwenu ngeṙele.
Ngokuba ndiya kubeka kuni, ndinicumise, ndinandise nokunandisa; nocebano lwam ndiya kulumisa nani.
Naniya kutya okudala, okwomileyo; kanjalo okudala nokukupa ngenxa yokutsha.
Ndandiya kubeka itabanakele yam pakati kwenu; waye umpefumlo wam ungayi kunidela.
Ndiya kuhamba pakati kwenu, ndibe ngutixo kuni, noti nina nibe ngabantu kum.
Mna ndi nguyehova, utixo wenu, endinipumisileyo elizweni le‐Jipete, ukuze ningabi ngamakoboka kubo; ndandapule izibonda zeyokwe yenu, ndenza ukuba nihambe ngokupakama.
Kodwa ukuba aniyi kupulapula kum, nayo yonke lemiyalelo aniyi kuyenza;
nokuba niya kulahla imimiso yam, nokuba umpefumlo wenu uya kudela izigwebo zam, nize ningayenzi yonke imiyalelo yam, nide nilwapule ucebano lwam:

kanjalo nam ndiya kwenza oku kuni, okwokuba ndiya kubeka pezu kwenu isituso, nokungcungcuteka, necesine, ezonto eziya kugqibela amehlo, ziwucubukise nompefumlo; nembewu yenu nofumana niyihlwayele, ngokuba ziya kuyidla intshaba zenu.
Ndandiya kumisa ubuso bam ngakuni, ukuze noyiswe pambi kwentshaba zenu; baye abatiyi benu beya kunipata ngobukosi, naniya kusaba nina, nxa kungeko oniputumayo.
Nokuba aniyi kuti ngako oku nipulapule kum, sendiya kwongeza ukunohlwaya ngokusixe̔nxe ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ngokuba ndiya kwapula iṙatshi lokwomelela kwenu; ndandiya kwenza izulu lenu njengesincete, nomhlaba wenu njengobedu.
Kanjako kwofumana kupeliswe amandla enu; ngokuba umhlaba wenu ungayi kunika ukuhluma kwawo, nemiti yelizwe ingayi kunika ukuqa̔ma kwayo.
Nokuba niya kuhamba ngokucasana nam, nize ningavumi ukupulapula kum, sendiya kwongeza pezu kwenu izibeto ngokusixe̔nxe njengezono zenu.
Ndandiya kutuma pakati kwenu izilo zasendle, eziya kunihluta abantwana benu, zibubise nenkomo zenu, zenze nina nibe bancinane; zaye indlela zenu ziya kweneka.
Nokuba aniyi kuti ngezizinto nilulekwe ndim, koko niya kuhamba ngokucasana nam;
sendiya kuhamba kwa nam ngokucasana nani, ndinibete kanjalo ngokusixe̔nxe ngenxa yezono zenu.

Ndandiya kuzisa pezu kwenu iṙele, eliya kupindezela impindezelo yocebano lwam: kanjalo nakubutelwa ezixekweni zenu, ndiya kwandula nditume isifo esibubisayo pakati kwenu; naniya kunikelwa esandleni sotshaba.
Kwoti xeshekweni ndinapulele umsimelelo wesonka, bandule abafazi abalishumi boje isonka senu eziko linye, babuyise isonka senu ngokulinganisa: notya ke, kanti aniyi kuhluta.
Nokuba aniyi kuti ngako oku nipulapule kum, koko niya kuhamba ngokucasana nam;
sendiya kuhamba ngokucasana nani ngobuṙalaṙume, ndinohlwaye kanjalo ngokusixe̔nxe ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ngokuba niya kuyidla inyama yonyana benu, nenyama yentombi zenu niya kuyidla.
Ndandiya kuzicita indawo zenu ezipakamileyo, ndizigaule izifanekiselo zelanga zenu, nezidumbu zenu ndoziposa pezu kwezidumbu zezitixwana zenu; woti umpefumlo wam unidele.
Nezixeko zenu ndiya kuzenza bunxuwa, nendawo zenu ezingcwele ndozicitakalisa; kanjako andiyi kusezela ivumba elimnandi lenu.
Ewe, elozwe ndolicitakalisa; zide ziti nqa pezu kwalo intshaba zenu ezihlala kulo.
Nani nina ndoniti sa pakati kwabaheyideni, ndir̔ole nasemva kwenu iṙele: loti ilizwe lenu libe yingcitakalo, nezixeko zenu zibe bunxuwa.
Oko ilizwe liya kwenzelela isabata zalo, yonke imihla yokucitakala kwalo, neyokubako kwenu ezweni lentshaba zenu; kwa oko liya kupumla ilizwe, lenzelele isabata zalo.
Yonke imihla yokucitakala kwalo liya kupumla; ngokokuba lingapumlanga kuzo isabata zenu, nxa nibe nihleli pezu kwalo.

Nabaseleyo pakati kwenu ndiya kuzisa ubugwala ezintliziyweni zabo emazweni entshaba zabo; side isandi segqabi elipetshulweyo sibasabise: babeya kubaleka, njengokungati kubalekwa iṙele, bawe nokuwa, nxa kungeko oputumayo.
Baya kuwelana njengapambi kweṙele, nxa oputumayo angeko; kanjako aniyi kuba nako ukuma ebusweni bentshaba zenu.
Koko niya kububa pakati kwabaheyideni, nelizwe lentshaba zenu lonidla.
Boti abaseleyo pakati kwenu bangcungcuteke ngenkohlakalo yabo emazweni entshaba zenu; nakanjako ngenkohlakalo zoyise babo baya kungcungcuteka kunye nabo.
Ukuba baya kuxela inkohlakalo yabo, nenkohlakalo yoyise babo, ngesigqito bagqitile ngaso ngakum; nokokuba kanjalo bahambile ngokucasana nam;
nokuba kanjalo ndihambile ngokucasana nabo, ndabazisa elizweni lentshaba zabo: ukuba oko zitobekile intliziyo zabo ezingalukileyo, nokuba oko bayavuma ukwohlwayelwa kwenkohlakalo yabo;
ndiya kwandula ndikumbule ucebano lwam kunye no‐Yakobi; nalo nocebano lwam kunye no‐Yisake, nalo nocebano lwam kunye no‐Abrahame ndolukumbula; nelizwe ndolikumbula.

Kwa njalo ilizwe loshiyelwa ngabo, lenzelele isabata zalo, nxa licitakele ngenxa yabo, bade bavume bona ukwohlwayelwa kwenkohlakalo yabo; ngokuba, ewe ngokokuba belahlile izigwebo zam, nokuba umpefumlo wabo udelile imimiso yam.
Kodwa noko kunjalo, bakuba besemazweni entshaba zabo, andiyi kubalahla, andiyi kubadela kanjalo, ukuba ndibagqibele, no kuba ndilwapule ucebano lwam kunye nabo: ngokuba ndi nguyehova mna, utixo wabo.
Kodwa ndobakumbulela ucebano lwomakulu babo, endapumisa bona elizweni le‐Jipete emehlweni abaheyideni, ukuze ndibe ngutixo wabo: mna ndi nguyehova.
Yiyo le imimiso, nemigwebo, nemiteto, abeyenza uyehova pakati kwake nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, entabeni ye‐Sinai, ngesandla sika‐Mosesi.
WALEKELA wateta uyehova ku‐Mosesi, esiti:
Teta nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, niti kulo: Xeshekweni umntu aya kwahlukanisa isibambiso, iziqu zoba ze zikayehova ngokulinganisa kwako.

Kwakuba ukulinganisa kwako kukokwendoda, eminyaka imashumi mabini ubudala bayo, kude kube yeminyaka imashumi matandatu ubudala bayo, makuti ukulinganisa kwako kube zishekele zesilivere ezimashumi mahlanu, ngeshekele yeyingcwele indawo.
Kodwa ukuba yinkazana, ukulinganisa kwako kwoba zishekele ezimashumi matatu.
Nokuba ngominyaka mihlanu, kude kube ngominyaka imashumi mabini, makuti ukulinganisa kwako indoda kube zishekele ezimashumi mabini, nangenxa yenkazana makube zishekele ezilishumi linye.
Nokuba ngowenyanga nye, kude kube ngominyaka mihlanu, makuti ukulinganisa kwako indoda kube zishekele zesilivere ezintlanu, nangenxa yenkazana ukulinganisa kwako kwoba zishekele zesilivere ezintatu.
Nokuba ngominyaka imashumi matandatu napezulu, ukuba yindoda, makuti ukulinganisa kwako kube zishekele ezilishumi linesihlanu, nangenxa yenkazana makube zishekele ezilishumi.
Kodwa ukuba ungohlwempuzileyo ngapantsi kwokulinganisa kwako, makazimise pambi kwomperisite, aze umperisite amlinganise: ngokwamandla ake obambisileyo umperisite uya kumlinganisa.
Nokuba sisilo, ekunganikelwa ngaso umnikelo kuyehova; zonke ekunikwa ngumntu kwezinjalo kuyehova zoba ngcwele.
Akayi kusiguqula, akayi kusanana kanjalo, esilungileyo ngesibi, umhlaumbi esibi ngesilungileyo; kodwa ukuba uka asanane isilo ngesilo noko, kwa sona neso kwananwa ngaso zoba ngcwele.
Nokuba sisesinye isilo esinco̔lileyo, ekungenikelwe ngaso umnikelo kuyehova, uya kwandula amise esosilo ebusweni bomperisite.
Waye umperisite eya kusilinganisa, ukuba silungile, ukuba sibi kusinina: njengokulinganisa kwako, mperisite! soba njalo.
Kodwa ukuba woka asikulule, uya kwandula asongeze esesihlanu isiqingata senani laso pezu kwokulinganisa kwako.
Naxeshekweni umntu aya kungcwalisa indlu ibe ngcwele kuyehova, woti umperisite ayilinganise, ukuba ilungile, ukuba imbi kusinina: njengokuba eyilinganisa umperisite, iya kuma njalo.
Nokuba lowo oyingcwalisileyo wokulula indlu yake, uya kusongeza esesihlanu isiqingata semali yokulinganisa kwako pezu kwayo, ize ibe yeyake.

Nokuba yindawana entsimini yemfuyo yake aya kuyingcwalisa umntu kuyehova, kwoba njengembewu yayo ukulinganisa kwako: indawana yehomere yembewu yeṙalasi yolingana neshekele zesilivere ezimashumi mahlanu.
Ukuba uyangcwalisa intsimi yake kuqala emnyakeni womgcobo, iya kuma kwa njengokulinganisa kwako.
Kodwa ukuba uyangcwalisa intsimi yake emveni kwomnyaka womgcobo, makati umperisite ambalele imali njengeminyaka esaseleyo, kwa kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo, ize isuswe kweyokulinganisa kwako.
Nokuba woka akulule intsimi lowo oyingcwalisileyo, makongeze esesihlanu isiqingata semali yokulinganisa kwako pezu kwayo, ize iqiniswe kuye.
Nokuba akayi kukulula lontsimi, umhlaumbi ukuba utengisile lontsimi komnye umntu, ayisayi kubuya ikululwe.
Koko intsimi leyo, yakupuma ngomnyaka womgcobo, iya kuba ngcwele kuyehova, njengentsimi eyahlukanisiweyo; yoba yeyomperisite imfuyo yayo.
Kanjako ukuba yintsimi ayitengileyo umntu, engeyeyakuwo amasimi emfuyo yake, aya kuyingcwalisa kuyehova;
woti umperisite ambalele inani lokulinganisa kwako kude kube ngumnyaka womgcobo; n emali yokulinganisa kwako woyinika ngomhla lowo, ibe yingcwele kuyehova.
Ngomnyaka womgcobo yobuya ize intsimi leyo kulowo wayitenga kuye, kwa kulowo imfuyo yomhlaba ibiyeyake.
Konke ukulinganisa kwako kwoba ngeshekele yeyingcwele indawo: zigera ezimashumi mabini eziya kuba yishekele leyo.
Kodwa izibulo, ekuzityulwa ngalo kuyehova sisilo, akuyi kubako mntu oya kulingcwalisa; nokuba liyinkomo enkulu, nokuba liyinkomo encinane, le likayehova lona.
Nanxa lilelesilo esinco̔lileyo, uya kukulula lona ngokulinganisa kwako, ati kanjalo ongeze esesihlanu isiqingata sako pezu kwako; nanxa lingakululwa, liya kutengiswa ngokulinganisa kwako.

Kodwa into esukuba yahlukanisiwe, aya kuti umntu ayahlukanisele uyehova kuko konke anako, kubantu nakwizilo, nakwintsimi yemfuyo yake, ayisayi kutengiswa, ayisayi kukululwa kanjako: zonke izinto ezahlukanisiweyo, zizinto ezingcwelekazi kuyehova zona.
Konke okwahlukanisiweyo, okuya kwahlukaniswa pakati kwabantu, akuyi kukululwa; kwofiswa ngenyaniso.
Kananjalo zonke izishumi zomhlaba, ezembewu yomhlaba, ezesiqa̔mo semiti, zona ze zikayehova; zingcwele kuyehova.
Naxeshekweni umntu aya kuka akulule into kwizishumi zake, esesihlanu isiqingata sazo uya kusongeza pezu kwazo.
Nazo zonke izishumi zezinkulu nezezincinane inkomo, ezazo zonke ezidlula ngapantsi kwayo intonga, eyeshumi yoba yingcwele kuyehova.
Akayi kugqalela ukuba ilungile, ukuba imbi kusinina, akayi kuyanana kanjalo: kodwa ukuba woka ayanane noko, kwa yona naleyo kwananwa ngayo zoba ngcwele; ayisayi kukululwa.
Yiyo le imiyalelo uyehova wayiyalezela u‐Mosesi elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, entabeni ye‐Sinai.
WAYE uyehova wateta ku‐Mosesi, entlango ye‐Sinai, ententeni yentlangano, ngowokuqala umhla wenyanga yesibini, ngomnyaka wesibini emva kwokupuma kwabo elizweni le‐Jipete, esiti:
Tabatani inani layo yonke intlanganiso yosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ngezizalwane zalo, ngendlu zoyise zalo, ngombalo wamagama, onke amadoda ngamanye ngamanye;
engaminyaka imashumi mabini napezulu ubudala bawo, onke apumayo nomkosi kwa‐Sirayeli: lawo niya kuwabala ngemikosi yawo, wena no‐Arone.
Nakunye nani kwobako indoda ibe nye kwisizwe ngesizwe, indoda eyintloko pezu kwendlu yoyise yayo.
Ngawo la amagama awo amadoda aya kuma nani; eyesika‐Rubene, ngu‐Elitsure unyana ka‐Shedeyure;
eyesika‐Simone, ngu‐Shelumiyele unyana ka‐Tsurishadai;
eyesika‐Juda, ngu‐Nahashone unyana ka‐Haminadabi;
eyesika‐Yisakare, ngu‐Netaneli unyana ka‐Tsuhare;
eyesika‐Zebulone, ngu‐Eliyabe unyana ka‐Heloni;
eyosapo luka‐Josefe, — eyesika‐Frayime, ngu‐Elishama unyana ka‐Hamihude; eyesika‐Manase, ngu‐Gamaliyeli unyana ka‐Pedatsure;
eyesika‐Benjamine, ngu‐Abidane unyana ka‐Gideyoni;
eyesika‐Dane, ngu‐Ahihezere unyana ka‐Hamishadai;
eyesika‐Ashere, ngu‐Pagiyeli unyana ka‐Okerane;
eyesika‐Gadi, ngu‐Eliyasafa unyana ka‐Dehule;
eyesika‐Nefatali, ngu‐Ahira unyana ka‐Henani.
Aba bebengabadumileyo bentlanganiso, inkosi zezizwe zoyise babo; bebezintloko zamawaka akwa‐Sirayeli.
Baza u‐Mosesi no‐Arone batabata lamadoda abalulwayo ngamagama;

bahlanganisela ndawonye yonke intlanganiso, ngowokuqala umhla wenyanga yesibini, abati bona bashumayela ukuzalwa kwabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, bengabaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, ngabanye ngabanye.
Njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele u‐Mosesi, kwa njalo wababala entlango ye‐Sinai.

Kekaloku onyana baka‐Rubene, owamazibulo ka‐Sirayeli, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, ngabanye ngabanye, bonke abangamadoda aminyaka imashumi mabini napezulu ubudala bawo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Rubene, bebengamawaka angamashumi mane enesitandatu, anamakulu mahlanu.

Abonyana baka‐Simone, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ababalweyo babo, ngombalo wamagama, ngabanye ngabanye, bonke abangamadoda aminyaka imashumi mabini napezulu ubudala bawo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Simone, bebengamawaka angamashumi mahlanu enesitoba, anamakulu matatu.
Abonyana baka‐Gadi, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Gadi, bebengamawaka angamashumi mahlanu enesihlanu, anamakulu matandatu enamashumi mahlanu.
Abonyana baka‐Juda, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Juda, bebengamawaka angamashumi asixe̔nxe enesine, anamakulu matandatu.
Abonyana baka‐Yisakare, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi:
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Yisakare, bebengamawaka angamashumi mahlanu enesine, anamakulu mane.
Abonyana baka‐Zebulone, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Zebulone, bebengamawaka angamashumi mahlanu enesixe̔nxe, anamakulu mane.

Abonyana baka‐Josefe:— Abonyana baka‐Frayime, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi:
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Frayime, bebengamawaka angamashumi mane, anamakulu mahlanu:
Abonyana baka‐Manase, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Manase, bebengamawaka angamashumi matatu enesibini, anamakulu mabini.
Abonyana baka‐Benjamine, izizukulwana zabo, ngezizalwane zabo, ngendlu zoyise zabo, ngombalo wamagama, abaminyaka imashumi mabini nabapezulu ubudala babo, bonke abapumayo nomkosi;
ababalweyo babo, abesizwe sika‐Benjamine, bebengamawaka angamashumi matatu enesihlanu, anamakulu mane.
