Kwa njalo u‐Jese wadlulisa isixe̔nxe sonyana bake pambi kwo‐Samyali. Wayesiti u‐Samyali ku‐Jese: Uyehova akanyulanga aba.

Walekela u‐Samyali wati ku‐Jese: Kukupela kwabantwana bako aba na? Wayesiti: Kusasele omncinane; kekaloku bona ke, uyalusa igusha. Waza u‐Samyali wati ku‐Jese: Tuma, umtabate; ngokuba singayi kuhlala ngokungqonga, ade afike apa.
Watuma ke, wamngenisa. Waye yena ebomvuṙa, enobuhle bamehlo nesoya sokubonakala. Wayesiti uyehova: Suka, umtambise; ngokuba lo enguye.
Wandula u‐Samyali watabata upondo oluneoli, wamtambisa pakati kwabakuluwe bake: wati umoya kayehova wehla pezu kwo‐Davide kwa semhleni lowo nangasemva. Wesuka ke u‐Samyali, waya e‐Rama.
KODWA umoya kayehova wemka ku‐Saule; waye umoya okohlakeleyo evela kuyehova wamzuma.
Zaza izicaka zika‐Saule zati kuye: Bona ke, umoya okohlakeleyo katixo uyakuzuma:

maiti ke inkosi yetu ixelele izicaka zako ezisebusweni bako, ukuba zifune indoda eyaziyo ukubeta uhadi; kwakuya kuti, nxa umoya okohlakeleyo katixo apezu kwako, iya kwandula ibete ngesandla sayo, wauya kulunga.
Waza u‐Saule wati kuzo izicaka zake: Kanindikangelele indoda elungisayo ukubeta, niyizise kum.
Sapendula esinye sezicaka, sati: Bona ke, ndibonile unyana ka‐Jese um‐Beteleheme, owaziyo ukubeta, oligoṙa elibuṙoti, nendoda yokulwa, neciko lokuteta, nendoda enewonga; kanjalo uyehova unaye.
Ngako u‐Saule watuma izigidimi ku‐Jese, wati: Tuma kum u‐Davide unyana wako, osezigusheni.
Wandula u‐Jese watabata iqwaṙashe linesonka, nentsuba yeveyine, netakane lebokwe, wazituma ngesandla sika‐Davide, unyana wake, ku‐Saule.
Wasuka u‐Davide weza ku‐Saule, wema pambi kwake; waza watandwa nguye kakulu, waba ngumtwali wake wezixo̔bo.
Wabuya u‐Saule watuma ku‐Jese, esiti: Makati ke u‐Davide eme pambi kwam; ngokuba efumene ufefe emehlweni am.
Kwaye kute, akuba umoya okohlakeleyo katixo ebepezu kwo‐Saule, wandula u‐Davide watabata uhadi, walubeta ngesandla sake; wada u‐Saule womelela, walunga nokulunga, wati umoya okohlakeleyo wemka kuye.
KEKALOKU ama‐Filistiya ahlanganisa imikosi yawo kuliwe, ahlanganisana e‐Soko yakwa‐Juda, aya ati waca pakati kwe‐Soko ne‐Hazeka, e‐Epese‐damime.
Kanjako kwahlanganisana u‐Saule namadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, baya bati waca emhlanjeni wemikoba, bazicwangcisa ukulwa ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya.
Ati ama‐Filistiya ema ngasentabeni ngelicala, nama‐Sirayeli ema ngasentabeni ngeliya icala, isihlambo sipakati kwawo.
Kwaza kwapuma emnqubeni wama‐Filistiya indoda engumlamli, ebingu‐Goliyate igama layo, eyase‐Gate, ebude bayo bebuzikubite ezintandatu zinesoluko sesandla.
Yabinomnqwazi wobedu pezu kwentloko yayo, ivatisiwe ngehempe yentsimbi ebukwetuṙa; nokuba nzima kwayo ihempe yentsimbi, ibizishekele zobedu ezimawaka mahlanu.
Yabinebrukwe yobedu emilenzeni yayo, nomkonto wobedu pakati kwamagxalaba ayo.
Uluti lwentshuntshe yayo belunjengomti wabaluki; nentsimbi yentshuntshe yayo ibiyeyeshekele ezingamakulu matandatu zesincete; waye umtwali wekaka ehamba pambi kwayo.

Yati ke yona yema yabiza emabandleni ama‐Sirayeli, yati kuwo: Kunganina ukuba nipumile ukuza kuzicwangcisa ukulwa? andinguye na um‐Filistiya, nani anizizicaka zika‐Saule na? zinyuleleni indoda, ize ihlele kum.
Ukuba ingalwa nam, indibulale, sesiya kuba zizicaka zenu; kodwa ukuba ndiyoyisa yona, ndiyibulale, seniya kuba zizicaka zetu, nisikonze.
Waza wati um‐Filistiya lowo: Ndiyagxeka namhla nje amabandla ama‐Sirayeli; ndinikeni indoda, ukuze silwane.
Bati bakuva u‐Saule nawo onke ama‐Sirayeli lamazwi om‐Filistiya, bandula betuswa, boyika kakulu.
Kekaloku u‐Davide ebengunyana walom‐Eferata wase‐Beteleheme‐juda, ogama belingu‐Jese; owabenonyana abasibozo: kanjalo indoda leyo, emihleni ka‐Saule, yahlala ilixego pakati kwabantu.
Baya onyana abatatu baka‐Jese abakulu, bamlandela u‐Saule ukuya ekulweni: namagama onyana bake abatatu ababesiya ekulweni, ngu‐Eliyabe owamazibulo, nowesibini wake u‐Abinadabi, nowesitatu u‐Shama:
waye u‐Davide wayengomncinane: bati abakulu abo abatatu bamlandela u‐Saule.
Kodwa u‐Davide wemka wabuya ku‐Saule, ukuya kuzalusa igusha zoyise e‐Beteleheme.
Wati um‐Filistiya lowo wasondela kusasa nangokuhlwa, wazimisa kona imihla yamashumi mane.
Waza u‐Jese wati ku‐Davide unyana wake: Batabatele ke abakuluwe bako iyefa yalamaqashu, nezizonka ezilishumi, ugidime uye emnqubeni kubakuluwe bako;
nezizonka zamasi ezilishumi uzise kuyo inkosi yewaka, nabakuluwe bako uye kubabona ukuba kunjanina ukupila kwabo, nombambiso wabo uwutabate.
Kekaloku u‐Saule, nabo bona, nawo onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, bebesemhlanjeni wemikoba, besilwa nama‐Filistiya.
Wandula u‐Davide wavuka kusasa, wazishiya igusha kumlindi, watabata, wahamba, njengokuba u‐Jese ebemyalele; wada wafika eludongeni lwenqwelo, nxa impi ibipuma ngamabandla, nanxa kwamemezelwa ukulwa:
ngokuba ama‐Sirayeli nama‐Filistiya ebecwangcisile ibandla ngakulo ibandla.
Wasuka u‐Davide washiya impahla ezikuye ezandleni zomlindi wempahla, wagidimela ngasemabandleni, weza wabuza abakuluwe bake ukupila kwabo.
Nxa abeteta nabo, nantsi indoda engumlamli inyuka, egama belingu‐Goliyate, um‐Filistiya wase‐Gate, ivela emabandleni ama‐Filistiya, eyateta njengalamazwi: weva ke u‐Davide.
Aza onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, akubona londoda, abaleka ebusweni bayo, oyika kakulu.

Kanjalo amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli ati: Niyibonile na lendoda enyukileyo? ngokuba inyukile ukuza kugxeka o‐Sirayeli: kwakuya kuti, leyondoda eyibulalayo, ukumkani uya kuyityebisa ngobutyebi obukulu, ayinike intombi yake, ayenze indlu yoyise ibe ikululekile.

Waza u‐Davide wateta kumadoda abemi ngakuye, esiti: Kuya kwenzwa nto nina kulondoda ebulalayo lom‐Filistiya, nesusayo ihlazo kwa‐Sirayeli? ngokuba engubanina lom‐Filistiya ongalukileyo, ukuba agxeke amabandla katixo ohleliyo?
Batsho abantu kuye njengelozwi, besiti: Kuya kwenziwa njalo kulondoda embulalayo.

Waza u‐Eliyabe, umkuluwe wake omkulu, weva akuteta kulomadoda; yandula yavuta ingqumbo ka‐Eliyabe ngakuye u‐Davide, wati: Yinina ukuba uhlele apa? kanjalo uzishiyile kubanina ezogusha zincinane entlango? ndiyazi mna ir̔atshi lako, nenkohlakalo yentliziyo yako; ngokuba uhlile, ukuze ubone ukulwa.
Wayesiti u‐Davide: Yinto nina endiyenzileyo kaloku? ilizwi belingenjalo na?
Waza washenxa kuye wabeka komnye, wateta njengelozwi; bati abantu babuya bampendula njengelizwi lokuqala.
Kwati kwakuviwa amazwi abewateta u‐Davide, andula axelwa ebusweni buka‐Saule, o watuma wamtabata.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Saule: Makungawi intliziyo yomntu ngenxa yake; isicaka sako siya kuya silwe nalom‐Filistiya.
Koko u‐Saule wati ku‐Davide: Akungeye ngakuye lom‐Filistiya ukulwa naye; ngokuba wena ungumfana, kodwa yena uyindoda yokulwa kwa sebutsheni bake.
Wandula u‐Davide wati ku‐Saule: Isicaka sako besisalusa igusha zoyise waso; kwaye kufika ingonyama, nebere, ebisusa igusha emhlambini;
ndaza ndapuma emva kwayo, ndayibeta, ndayisindisa emlonyeni wayo; nanxa ibisukela ngakum, ndayibamba ngodevu lwayo, ndayibeta, ndayibulala.
Isicaka sako sabeta nengonyama nebere; nalom‐Filistiya angalukileyo yena uya kuba njengenye kwezo; ngokuba egxekile amabandla katixo ohleliyo.
Wati kanjalo u‐Davide: Uyehova, owandisindisa enqineni lengonyama nasenqineni lebere, kwa yena wondisindisa esandleni salom‐Filistiya. Waza u‐Saule wati ku‐Davide: Yiya, wanga uyehova angako nawe!
Waye u‐Saule wamvatisa u‐Davide ngezivato zake, wabeka umnqwazi wobedu entlokweni yake; wamvatisa ngehempe yentsimbi kanjalo.

Waza u‐Davide wabinqa iṙele lake pezu kwezivato zake, wafuna ukuhamba, ngokuba ebengalilinganga. Wandula u‐Davide wati ku‐Saule: Andingeye nezizinto, ngokuba ndingazilinganga. Ngako u‐Davide wazisusa kuye.

Waza watabata induku yake esandleni sake, wazinyulela amatye abutelezi amahlanu emlanjaneni, wawabeka enxoweni yabalusi abenayo, kwa sesidleni; kanjako isisaulo sake besisesandleni sake: waya wasondela kum‐Filistiya lowo.
Wasuka wahamba um‐Filistiya, wamana esondela ku‐Davide; yati indoda etwele ikaka yahamba pambi kwake.
Wati um‐Filistiya akukangela, wambona u‐Davide, wamdela: ngokuba ebengumfana, ebomvuṙa, emhle ukubonakala kwake.
Waza um‐Filistiya wati ku‐Davide: Ndiyinja na mna, ukuba wena uyeza kum ngenduku? Waye um‐Filistiya wamqalekisa u‐Davide ngotixo bake.
Wati um‐Filistiya kanjako ku‐Davide: Yiza kum, ndandiya kunika inyama yako kuzo intaka zezulu, nakuzo izilo zasendle.
Wandula u‐Davide wati kum‐Filistiya: Wena uyeza kum ngeṙele, nangentshuntshe, nangekaka; kodwa mna ndiyeza kuwe egameni likayehova wemikosi, utixo wamabandla ama‐Sirayeli, lowo umgxekileyo:

namhla nje uyehova wokunikela esandleni sam; ndandiya kukubeta, ndisuse intloko yako kuwe, ndinike izidumbu zomkosi wama‐Filistiya namhla nje kuzo intaka zezulu, nakuwo amaṙamncwa omhlaba; ukuze umhlaba wonke wazi ukuba uko utixo kwa‐Sirayeli:
kanjalo wonke lomhlambi wokwazi ukuba uyehova akasindisi ngeṙele nangentshuntshe; ngokuba ukulwa kuko kukayehova, oya kuninikela esandleni setu.
Kwaza kwati, wesuka um‐Filistiya, wahamba, wasondela ukumkaulela u‐Davide; wandula u‐Davide wanxama, wagidimela ngasemabandleni ukuya kumkaulela um‐Filistiya.
Waye u‐Davide wafaka isandla sake enxoweni, wasusa kona ilitye, walisaula, wabeta um‐Filistiya ebunzini lake; lati ilitye latshona ebunzini lake, wawa yena ebusweni bake ngasemhlabeni.
Kwa njalo u‐Davide wameyisa um‐Filistiya ngesisaulo nangelitye, wambeta um‐Filistiya, wambulala; kodwa bekungeko iṙele esandleni sika‐Davide.

Waza u‐Davide wagidima, wema pezu kwom‐Filistiya, watabata iṙele lake, walir̔ola esinxobeni salo, wambulala, wanqumla ngalo intloko yake. Kekaloku akubona ama‐Filistiya ukuba igoṙa lawo lifile, abaleka.

Andula esuka amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli nawakwa‐Juda, amemeza, aputuma ama‐Filistiya, kude kwafikwa esihlanjeni, nakude kwasemasangweni ase‐Hekrone. Zati inxweleṙa zama‐Filistiya zawa endleleni yase‐Sharayime, kwa kude kwase‐Gate, nakude kwase‐Hekrone.
Lwada usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwabuya ekugxotiseni ama‐Filistiya, lwapanga iminquba yawo.
Waza u‐Davide watabata intloko yom‐Filistiya, wayizisa e‐Yerusaleme; kodwa izixo̔bo zake wazibeka ententeni yake.
Nxa ke u‐Saule abembona u‐Davide epumela ngakuye um‐Filistiya, wati ku‐Abenere, inkosi yomkosi: Ungunyana kabanina lomfana, Abenere? Wayesiti u‐Abenere: Bomi bompefumlo wako, kumkani! andimazi.
Waza wati ukumkani: Buza wena ingunyana kabanina indodana le.
Wati akuba u‐Davide ebebuya ekubulaleni um‐Filistiya, u‐Abenere wamtabata, wamzisa ebusweni buka‐Saule, enentloko yom‐Filistiya esandleni sake.
Waza u‐Saule wati kuye: Ungunyana kabanina, mfanandini? Wayesiti u‐Davide: Ndingunyana wesicaka sako u‐Jese um‐Beteleheme.
Kwaye kute, akuba egqibile ukuteta ku‐Saule, wandula umpefumlo ka‐Jonatane wanxityelelwa empefumlweni ka‐Davide; waye u‐Jonatane wamtanda njengompefumlo wake.
Waza u‐Saule wamtabata ngomhla lowo, engamvumeli ukuba abuyele endlwini yoyise.
Wandula u‐Jonatane wenza ucebano no‐Davide, ngokuba ebemtanda njengompefumlo wake:
wati kanjalo u‐Jonatane wazihluba ingubo ebikuye, wayinika ku‐Davide, nezivato zake, kwa neṙele lake, nesipeta sake, noqwemesha lwake.
Waye u‐Davide wapumela apo asukuba u‐Saule ebemtumela kona, wenza ngobulumko; waza u‐Saule wambeka pezu kwamadoda okulwa; waekolekile emehlweni abantu bonke, nasemehlweni ezicaka zika‐Saule kanjako.

Kwaye kute ekutikeni kwabo, nxa u‐Davide abebuya ekubulaleni um‐Filistiya, kwapuma abafazi kuzo zonke izixeko zakwa‐Sirayeli, ngokuvuma nangemidudo, ukuya kumkaulela u‐Saule ukumkani, ngentambula, na ngovuyo, nangeziculiso.
Baza abafazi bapendulana ekudlaleni kwabo, bati: u‐Saule ubulele amawaka ake, kodwa u‐Davide amawaka ake alishumi.
Wandula u‐Saule waqumba kunene, ngokuba belibi emehlweni ake ilizwi elo; wayesiti: Banikile ku‐Davide amawaka alishumi, kanti kum banikile amawaka odwa; kuseko ukunikwa kuye ubukumkani kupela.
Waye u‐Saule enomona ngakuye u‐Davide, kwa semhleni lowo nangasemva kwawo.

KWABEKUTE ngomhla olandelayo, ukuba umoya okohlakeleyo katixo wamzuma u‐Saule, wada waprofitesha pakati kwendlu; waza u‐Davide wabeta uhadi ngesandla sake, njengakweminye imihla: kekaloku bekuko intshuntshe esandleni sika‐Saule.
Wasuka u‐Saule wabinza ngentshuntshe, wati: Ndiya kumbetela u‐Davide kwa seludongeni; kodwa u‐Davide wapepa ebusweni bake kabini.
Wandula u‐Saule wamoyika u‐Davide, ngokuba uyehova enaye, kanti ebemkile ku‐Saule.
Ngako u‐Saule wamshenxisa kuye, wammisa abe yinkosi yake yewaka; waza wapuma wangena pambi kwabantu.
Kekaloku u‐Davide wenza ngobulumko kuzo zonke indlela zake; waye uyehova enaye.
Wati u‐Saule akubona ukuba u‐Davide wenza ngokulumkileyo kakulu, wamoyika.
Kodwa bonke o‐Sirayeli no‐Juda bamtanda u‐Davide, ngokuba wapuma wangena ebusweni babo.

Waza u‐Saule wati ku‐Davide: Nanku u‐Merabi, intombi yam enkulu, endiya kumnika kuwe abe ngumfazi; kupela ube ngunyana wobuṙoti kum, ulwe imfazwe zikayehova. Ngokuba u‐Saule ebesiti: Masingabi ngakuye isandla sam, masibe ngakuye isandla sama‐Filistiya.
Koko u‐Davide wati ku‐Saule: Ndingubanina mna? buyinto nina nobomi bam? siyinto nina isizalwane sobawo kwa‐Sirayeli, ukuba ndibe ngumyeni kukumkani?
Kwaye kute kodwa ngexesha abeya kunikwa u‐Merabi, intombi ka‐Saule, ku‐Davide, wanikwa yena ku‐Hadriyeli, um‐Mehola, abe ngumfazi.
Waza u‐Mikali, intombi ka‐Saule, wamtanda u‐Davide; kwati kwakuxelwa ku‐Saule, yabifanele londawo emehlweni ake.
Wayesiti u‐Saule: Ndiya kumnika yena, ukuba abe ngumgibe kuye, nokuba isandla sama‐Filistiya sibe ngakuye. Ngako u‐Saule wati ku‐Davide: Uya kuba ngumyeni kum namhla ngowesibini.
Waye u‐Saule wayalela izicaka zake, wati: Tetani ku‐Davide ngasese, nisiti: Bona ke, ukumkani ukolisiwe nguwe, nazo zonke izicaka zake ziyakutanda; ngako kaloku yiba ngumyeni kuye ukumkani.
Zaza izicaka zika‐Saule zateta lamazwi ezindlebeni zika‐Davide. Wayesiti u‐Davide: Kuyinto elula emehlweni enu na ukuba ngumyeni kukumkani, ndiyindoda elihlwempu nedelekileyo nje?
Zaza izicaka zika‐Saule zamxelela, zisiti: Njengalamazwi wateta u‐Davide.

Wandula u‐Saule wati: Niya kutsho ku‐Davide ukuti: Ukumkani akanyamekeli ikazi, kodwa ikulu lamajwabu ama‐Filistiya, ukuze kupindezelwe ezintshabeni zokumkani. Kanti u‐Saule wacinga ukumwisa u‐Davide ngesandla sama‐Filistiya.
Zaza izicaka zake zamxelela u‐Davide lamazwi; kekaloku londawo ibifanele emehlweni ka‐Davide, yokuba abe ngumyeni kukumkani: kodwa imihla ibingekazalisekile:

ngako wesuka u‐Davide waya, yena namadoda ake, wabulala amadoda angamakulu mabini pakati kwama‐Filistiya; wati u‐Davide wazisa amajwabu awo, baza bawanika ngelonani lonke kukumkani, ukuba abe ngumyeni kuye ukumkani. Wandula u‐Saule wamnika u‐Mikali, intombi yake, abe ngumfazi.
Waye u‐Saule wabona, wakwazi, ukuba uyehova uno‐Davide; kanjalo u‐Mikali, intombi ka‐Saule, wamtanda u‐Davide.
Waza walekela u‐Saule ukumoyika u‐Davide ngakumbi; wati u‐Saule waba lutshaba luka‐Davide imihla yonke.
Zandula zapuma inkosi zama‐Filistiya: kwaye kute, nxa sukuba zipumile, u‐Davide wenza ngobulumko pezu kwazo zonke izicaka zika‐Saule, lada igama lake lanconywa kakulu.
WADA u‐Saule wateta ku‐Jonatane unyana wake, nakuzo zonke izicaka zake, ukuba bamfise u‐Davide. Kodwa u‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Saule, wakoliswa ngu‐Davide kakulu:
waza u‐Jonatane wamxelela u‐Davide, esiti: u‐Saule, ubawo, uyafuna ukukufisa; ngako kaloku zilumkele ke kwakusa, uhlale endaweni efihlakeleyo, uzimele:
sendiya kupuma mna, ndime ngasesandleni sobawo endle, apo wena ukona; ndandiya kuteta kubawo ngawe; nento endiyibonayo, ndoyixela kuwe.

Waye u‐Jonatane wateta okulungileyo ngaye u‐Davide ku‐Saule uyise, wati kuye: Makangoni ukumkani ngakuso isicaka sake, ngakuye u‐Davide; ngokuba engonanga ngakuwe, nangokuba izenzo zake kuwe zilungile kakulu:

ngokuba ebebeka ubomi bake esandleni sake, wambulala um‐Filistiya lowo, wati uyehova wenzela o‐Sirayeli bonke usindiso olukulu: ubulubona wena, wavuya nokuvuya: yinina ngoko ukuba uya kwona ngakulo igazi elingenatyala, ngokumfisa u‐Davide kungeko nto?
Waza u‐Saule wapulapula ilizwi lika‐Jonatane; kanjalo wafunga u‐Saule ngokuti: Njengokuba uyehova ehleli, akayi kufiswa!
Wasuka u‐Jonatane wambiza u‐Davide; wati u‐Jonatane wamxelela lamazwi onke. Waza u‐Jonatane wamzisa u‐Davide ku‐Saule, owabako ebusweni bake njengapambili.
Kwabuya kwabako imfazwe: wandula wapuma u‐Davide walwa nama‐Filistiya, wawabulala ngesibulalo esikulu; ada abaleka ebusweni bake.
Kekaloku umoya okohlakeleyo kayehova waba pezu kwo‐Saule, nxa abehleli endlwini yake, enentshuntshe yake esandleni sake; waye u‐Davide wabeta uhadi ngesandla.
Waza u‐Saule wafuna ukumbetela u‐Davide ngentshuntshe kwa seludongeni; kodwa wanyebeleza ebusweni buka‐Saule, owabetela intshuntshe eludongeni; wati u‐Davide wabaleka, wasinda ngobobusuku.

Wandula u‐Saule watuma izigidimi ukuya endlwini ka‐Davide, zimlinde, zimfise kwakusa: koko u‐Mikali, umfazi wake, wamxelela u‐Davide, esiti: Ukuba akusindisi ubomi bako ngobubusuku, ngomso uya kufiswa.
Waza u‐Mikali wamhlisa u‐Davide ngefenstile; wahamba ke, wesaba, wasinda.
Wandula u‐Mikali watabata iterafi, wayibeka emandlalweni, wabeka umqamelelo woboya bebokwe ngasentlokweni yayo, wayigubungela ngengubo.
Kekaloku akutuma u‐Saule izigidimi, zize zimtabate u‐Davide, wati: Uyafa yena.
Wabuya u‐Saule watuma izigidimi ukuba zimbone u‐Davide, esiti: Nimnyusele kum emandlalweni, ndimfise.
Kwati kwakungena izigidimi, nantsi ke iterafi emandlalweni, nomqamelelo woboya bebokwe ngasentlokweni yayo.
Waza u‐Saule wati ku‐Mikali: Yinina ukuba wenje njalo ukundibukuqa, undulule nje utshaba lwam, lusinde? Wayesiti u‐Mikali ku‐Saule: Yena wati kum: Ndindulule; yinina ukuba ndikufise?
Kwa njalo u‐Davide wesaba, wasinda, weza ku‐Samyali e‐Rama, wamxelela konke abekwenzelwe ngu‐Saule. Wahamba yena no‐Samyali, baya bahlala e‐Nayote.
Kwaza kwaxelwa ku‐Saule, kusitwa: Nankuya u‐Davide, e‐Nayote ngase‐Rama.

Wandula u‐Saule watuma izigidimi ukuya kumtabata u‐Davide: kwati kwakubonwa umhlambi wabaprofite beprofitesha, no‐Samyali emi, emisiwe pezu kwabo, kwabako umoya katixo pezu kwezigidimi zika‐Saule, zaye ziprofitesha nazo.
Kwakuxelwa ku‐Saule, watuma ezinye izigidimi, zaye ziprofitesha nazo. Walekela u‐Saule watuma izigidimi ngokwesitatu, zaye ziprofitesha nazo.
Wandula waya naye e‐Rama, weza equleni elikulu elise‐Seku, wabuza, wati: Bapina u‐Samyali no‐Davide? Kwatiwa: Nabaya, e‐Nayote ngase‐Rama.
Waza waya kona e‐Nayote ngase‐Rama; wati umoya katixo wabako napezu kwake, wahamba, wamana eprofitesha, wada wafika e‐Nayote ngase‐Rama.
Wati naye wahluba ingubo zake, waprofitesha naye ebusweni buka‐Samyali, walala pantsi eba zé ngalomini yonke nangobobusuku bonke. Ngako oko kwatiwa: Kanene u‐Saule upakati kwabaprofite naye na?
WANDULA u‐Davide wesaba e‐Nayote ngase‐Rama, weza wati ebusweni buka‐Jonatane: Iyinto nina endiyenzileyo? liyinina ityala lam? siyinina nesono sam ebusweni boyihlo, ukuba uyafuna ubomi bam?
Wayesiti kuye: Makube lé oko! akuyi kufa. Bona ke, ubawo akenzi into enkulu umhlaumbi into encinane, angayityiliyo endlebeni yam; kunganina ke ukuba ubawo andifihlele lento? akunjalo.

Walekela wafunga u‐Davide, wati: Uyihlo uyazi ngenyaniso ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako; ngako ute: Makangazi oku u‐Jonatane, hleze adandateke; kodwa noko, njengokuba uyehova ehleli, na njengokuba umpefumlo wako uhleli, kuko inyatela linye kupela pakati kwam nokufa!
Wandula u‐Jonatane wati ku‐Davide: Into uyitetayo umpefumlo wako, ndiya kukwenzela yona.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Jonatane: Bona ke, inyanga iya kutwasa ngomso, nxa ndifanele ukuhlala nokumkani ngasekudleni; kodwa ndindulule, ukuba ndizifihle ezindle, kude kuhlwe ngomhla wesitatu.

Ukuba uyihlo uka abone ukungabiko kwam, yandula uti: Wazingisa u‐Davide ukucela kum, ukuba agidimele e‐Beteleheme, isixeko sakowabo; ngokuba kuko apo umbingo womnyaka ngomnyaka, owenz elwa isizalwane sonke.
Ukuba utsho ukuti: Kulungile; sesiya kuba noxolo isicaka sako: kodwa ukuba unokuqumba kakulu, yazi ke ukuba ububi bugqityiwe nguye.
Ngako yenza ngobubele kwisicaka sako; ngokuba ungenisile isicaka sako elucebanweni lukayehova kunye nawe: noko, ukuba kuko ityala kum, ndifise ngokwako, ngokuba kunganina ukuba undizise kuyihlo?
Waza u‐Jonatane wati: Makube lé kuwe, okokuba, nxa bendisazi ngenyaniso ukuba ububi bugqityiwe ngubawo buze pezu kwako, bendingayi kuxela bona kuwe.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Jonatane: Ngubanina oya kundixelela, ukuba uyihlo uka akupendule into ngobulukuni?
Wandula u‐Jonatane wati ku‐Davide: Hamba, sipume siye ezindle. Bapuma baya ezindle bobabini.

Waza u‐Jonatane wati ku‐Davide: Yehova, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! nxa ndimṙoṙonya ubawo ngelixesha ngomso, umhlaumbi ngomso mnye, kuze kuti, bona ke, kulungele u‐Davide, ndize ndinganduli nditume kuwe, ndityile endlebeni yako,

makenje njalo uyehova ku‐Jonatane, alekele ukwenje njalo! kodwa ukuba kuyakolisa ubawo ukuzisa ububi pezu kwako, ndiya kwandula ndiyityile endlebeni yako, ndikundulule, ukuba uhambe ngoxolo: wanga uyehova angako nawe, njengokuba ebeko nobawo.
Kanjalo akuyi kundenzela ububele bukayehova nxa ndisahleli kupela, ukuze ndingafi;
kodwa akuyi kunqamla ububele bako kuyo indlu yam kude kube ngunapakade; hai, nanxa uyehova anqamlile intshaba zika‐Davide zonke ebusweni bomhlaba.
Waza u‐Jonatane wenza ucebano nendlu ka‐Davide, esiti: Makabize uyehova esandleni sentshaba zika‐Davide!
Walekela u‐Jonatane ukumfungisa u‐Davide, ngenxa yokumtanda kwake; ngokuba ebemtanda ngokutanda kwompefumlo wake.
Wandula u‐Jonatane wati ku‐Davide: Ngomso inyanga iya kutwasa; kwakuya kubonwa ukuba akuko, ngokuba isihlalo sako soba zé.
Ngako ngomhla wesitatu uya kuhla kamsinyane, uye kulondawo apo wazifihla kona ngomhla walomsebenzi, uhlale ngaselityeni le‐Ezele.
Nam, ndiya kutola intolo ezintatu ngasecaleni, njengokungati ndibe nditola emlinganisweni.

Kekaloku bona ke, ndiya kutuma umfana, ndisiti: Hamba, uzifune intolo. Ukuba nditi ekuhleni kumfana: Nanzi intolo zinganeno kwako, zitabate; wandule uze, ngokuba kuko uxolo kuwe, kungeko nto, njengokuba uyehova ehleli.
Kodwa ukuba nditsho kwindodana ukuti: Nanziya intolo ngasele kwako; hamba ke, ngokuba uyehova ekundulule.
Nalonto esibe siteta mna nawe ngayo, bona ke, uyehova makabe pakati kwam nawe kude kube ngunapakade.
Waya u‐Davide wazifihla ezindle: kwati kwakutwasa inyanga, wandula ukumkani wahlala ngasekudleni ukuba atye.

Wati ukumkani wahlala esihlalweni sake, njengakuwo amanye amaxesha, esihlalweni saseludongeni; wesuka ke u‐Jonatane, waza u‐Abenere wahlala ngasecaleni lika‐Saule, kodwa indawo ka‐Davide ibifunyanwa zé.
Kekaloku u‐Saule akateta nanye into ngomhla lowo; ngokuba ebesiti: Uhlelwe yinto; akacocekile, ngenyaniso akacocekile.

Kwaye kute ngomnye umhla, ngowesibini wenyanga etwasileyo, kwakufunyanwa zé indawo ka‐Davide, wandula wati u‐Saule ku‐Jonatane unyana wake: Kunganina ukuba unyana ka‐Jese akezanga ekudleni nezolo nanamhla?
Waza u‐Jonatane wampendula u‐Saule, wati: Wazingisa u‐Davide ukucela kum ukuba aye e‐Beteleheme;

wayesiti: Ndindulule ke, ngokuba isizalwane setu sinombingo esixekweni; kanjalo umkuluwe wam undiyalele ngokwake: ngako kaloku, ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, makendisuke ke, ndiye kubona abakuluwe bam. Kukona ke angezanga etafileni yokumkani.
Yandula yavuta ingqumbo ka‐Saule ngakuye u‐Jonatane, wati kuye: Wena nyana womfazi ogwenxa ongevayo! andazi na ukuba umnyulile unyana ka‐Jese libe lihlazo lako, nehlazo lobuzé bonyoko?
ngokuba yonke imihla unyana ka‐Jese aya kudla ubomi ngayo emhlabeni, ungayi kuqiniswa wena, nobukumkani bako: ngako kaloku, tuma ke, umtabate eze kum, ngokuba emelwe kukufa yena.
Wandula u‐Jonatane wampendula u‐Saule uyise, wati kuye: Kunganina ukuba afiswe? yinto nina ayenzileyo?
Wasuka u‐Saule wambinza ngentshuntshe, ukuba ambete: ngako u‐Jonatane wazi ukuba bekugqityiwe nguyise ukumbulala u‐Davide.
Waza u‐Jonatane wesuka etafileni ngobushushu bengqumbo; waye engadli isonka ngomhla wesibini wenyanga etwasileyo, ngokuba ebedandateka ngaye u‐Davide, ngokuba uyise ebemhlazisile.
Kwaye kute kwakusa, wapuma u‐Jonatane waya endle endaweni yokuhlangana no‐Davide, umfana omncinane enaye.
Waza wati kumfana wake: Baleka, uzifune ke intolo endizitolayo. Nxa umfana abebaleka, watola utolo ukuba alugqitise kuye.
Akufika umfana endaweni yotolo abelutolile u‐Jonatane, wandula u‐Jonatane wabiza emva kwomfana, wati: Utolo alungasele kwako na?
Wabuya u‐Jonatane wabiza emva kwomfana, esiti: Nxama, kauleza, ungemi. Waza umfana ka‐Jonatane wabuta intolo, weza enkosini yake.
Kodwa umfana ebengazi nto: ngu‐Jonatane no‐Davide abebesazi londawo kupela.
Waza u‐Jonatane wanika izixo̔bo zake kumfana obenaye, wati kuye: Hamba, uzise esixekweni.
Nxa umfana abemkile, wesuka u‐Davide ecaleni lesuyide, wawa ngobuso bake ngasemhlabeni, wazitoba katatu: baza bangana, balilana omnye nomnye, ade u‐Davide enze kakulu.

Wayesiti u‐Jonatane ku‐Davide: Hamba ngoxolo: ngokokuba sifungile sobabini egameni likayehova, sisiti: Uyehova makabe pakati kwam nawe, napakati kwenzalo yam nenzalo yako, kude kube ngunapakade! Waselesuka wemka; wati u‐Jonatane wangena esixekweni.
WANDULA weza u‐Davide e‐Nobe ku‐Ahimeleki umperisite: waye u‐Ahimeleki wamkaulela u‐Davide ngokungcangcazela, wati kuye: Yinina ukuba uwedwa, ingeko indoda nawe nje?

Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Ahimeleki umperisite: Ukumkani undiyalele umcimbi, wati kum: Makungaziwa mntu nanye into yalomcimbi endikutumileyo ngawo, nendikuyalele wona; kanjalo amadodana ndiwanqopisele indawo etile.
Ngako kaloku, yinto nina epantsi kwesandla sako? nikela izonka ezihlanu esandleni sam, umhlaumbi oko kusukuba kuko.
Waza umperisite wampendula u‐Davide, wati: Akuko isonka esingengcwele pantsi kwesandla sam, kuko kodwa isonka esingcwele, ukuba amadodana azigcinile ebafazini kupela.

Waza u‐Davide wampendula umperisite, wati kuye: Ngenyaniso abafazi babanjiwe kuti izolo nezolo elinye, nxa ndapumayo; kanjalo izitya zamadodana zingcwele; neso sesingati sisonka esingengcwele, nangokukodwa nxa siya kungcwaliswa namhla esinye esityeni.
Waza umperisite wamnika isonka esingcwele; ngokuba bekungeko kona isonka ngapandle kwezonka zokubonakala, ezibe zisuswa pambi kwoyehova, ukuze kubekwe isonka esifudumeleyo ngomhla wokususwa kwazo.
(Kwaye kuko kona indoda ezicakeni zika‐Saule ngalomhla, ebibanjezelwa pambi kwoyehova, egama belingu‐Dowegi, um‐Edome, inkosi yabalusi aba lunge ku‐Saule.)

Wati u‐Davide kanjako ku‐Ahimeleki: Kanene akuko apa na pantsi kwesandla sako intshuntshe umhlaumbi iṙele? ngokuba ndingatabatanga esandleni sam kwa neṙele lam nezixo̔bo zam, ngokuba umcimbi wokumkani ubunxamile.

Waza wati umperisite: Iṙele lika‐Goliyate um‐Filistiya, obumbulala emhlanjeni wemikoba, nali lilapa, lisongiwe engutyeni emva kweyefodi: ukuba uya kuzitabatela lona, litabate; ngokuba lingeko limbi ngapandle kwalo. Wayesiti u‐Davide: Akuko elinjengelo; linike kum.
Wesuka ke u‐Davide, wesaba ngalomhla ebusweni buka‐Saule, waya ku‐Akishe ukumkani we‐Gate.
Zaza izicaka zika‐Akishe zati kuye: Lo asi nguye na u‐Davide, ukumkani welizwe? abavumanga ngaye na emidudweni, besiti: u‐Saule ubulele amawaka ake, kodwa u‐Davide amawaka ake alishumi?
Waye u‐Davide wabekela lamazwi entliziyweni yake, woyika kakulu ngenxa ka‐Akishe ukumkani we‐Gate.
Ngako wayenza yimbi ingqondo yake emehlweni abo, wazenzisa igeza ezandleni zabo, waṙwela pezu kwengcango zesango, wahlisela amate ake eludevini lwake.
Waza u‐Akishe wati kuzo izicaka zake: Kangelani, niyabona lendoda ukuba iyageza: yinina ukuba niyizisile kum?
ndinokuswela abagezayo na, ukuba nimzisile lo ageze pambi kwam? uya kuza lo endlwini yam yinina?
Wandula u‐Davide wemka kona, wasindela emqolombeni we‐Hadulame: bati bakuva oko abakuluwe bake nayo yonke indlu yoyise, behlela kuye apo.

Kanjalo kwazihlanganisela kuye onke amadoda abeseluxinezelweni, nawo onke amadoda abenetyala, nawo onke amadoda ampefumlo uṙaṙa; waza waba yinkosi pezu kwawo: kwaye kuko naye anga angamakulu mane amadoda.
Wasuka u‐Davide wemka kona waya e‐Mitsipe yase‐Mowabi; wayesiti kukumkani we‐Mowabi: Mabapume ke ubawo noma̔ babe nani, ndide ndazi into endiya kwenzelwa yona ngutixo.
Waza wabakapela ebusweni bokumkani we‐Mowabi: baza bahlala naye yonke imihla u‐Davide abesenqatyeni.
Koko umprofite u‐Gadi wati ku‐Davide: Ungahlali enqatyeni; hamba, uye ezweni lakwa‐Juda. Wahamba u‐Davide waya ehlatini le‐Harete.
KEKALOKU akuva u‐Saule ukuba u‐Davide wazekile, namadoda abenaye, (waye u‐Saule ehleli e‐Gibeha pantsi kwomti wetamariske e‐Rama, enentshuntshe esandleni sake, nazo zonke izicaka zake zimi ngakuye,)

wandula wati u‐Saule kuzo izicaka zake ezibe zimi ngakuye: Yivani ke, nina ma‐Benjamine! unyana ka‐Jese woninika nina nonke na amasimi nezitiya zemiti yeveyine? wonenza nina nonke na inkosi zamawaka nenkosi zamakulu,

ukuba nina nonke nicebile ngakum, nokuba akuko namnye otyilayo endlebeni yam ukuba unyana wam wenzile ucebano nonyana ka‐Jese, nokuba akuko namnye kuni obuhlungu ngenxa yam, notyilayo endlebeni yam ukuba unyana wam uvusile isicaka sam ngakum sibe ngumlaleli, njengokuba kunjalo namhla nje?
Wandula wapendula u‐Dowegi um‐Edome, obemisiwe pezu kwezicaka zika‐Saule, wati: Ndabona unyana ka‐Jese esiza e‐Nobe, ku‐Ahimeleki unyana ka‐Ahitube;
owambuzela kuyehova, wamnika umpako; neṙele lika‐Goliyate um‐Filistiya walinika kuye.
Wandula ukumkani watuma ukumbiza u‐Ahimeleki, unyana ka‐Ahitube, umperisite, nayo yonke indlu yoyise, abaperisite ababese‐Nobe; basuka beza bonke kukumkani.
Waza u‐Saule wati: Yiva ke, nyana ka‐Ahitube! Wayesiti: Nanku ndi lapa, nkosi yam!
Waza u‐Saule wati kuye: Yinina ukuba nicebile ngakum, wena nonyana ka‐Jese, ekokubeni umnikile isonka neṙele, wambuzela kutixo, ukuze avukele ukundilalela, njengokuba kunjalo namhla nje?
Wandula u‐Ahimeleki wampendula ukumkani, wati: Ngubanina pakati kwazo zonke izicaka zako onyanisekileyo njengo‐Davide, ongumyeni kukumkani, ongenayo ekuveni kwako, obekekileyo endlwini yako?

Kunamhla nje na endiqalileyo ukumbuzela kutixo? makube le oko kum! makangati ukumkani abeke ityala pezu kwesicaka sake, na pezu kwayo yonke indlu kabawo; ngokuba isicaka sako besingazani nako konke oku, nokuba yinto encinane, nokuba yenkulu.
Kodwa wati ukumkani: Uya kufa ngenyaniso, Ahimeleki! wena, nayo yonke indlu kayihlo.

Waza ukumkani wati kumlisela obumi ngakuye: Sondelani, nibulale abaperisite bakayehova; ngokuba nesandla sabo sino‐Davide, nangokuba bebesazi ukuba uyasaba yena, kanti akatyilanga oko endlebeni yam. Kodwa izicaka zokumkani bezingavumi ukwolula isandla sazo ukuba ziwele abaperisite bakayehova.

Ngako ukumkani wati ku‐Dowegi: Sondela wena, ubawele abaperisite. Wasondela ke u‐Dowegi um‐Edome, wabawela abaperisite, wabulala ngalomini amadoda angamashumi asibozo anamahlanu abevete iyefodi yeqiya:
ne‐Nobe, isixeko sabaperisite, wayibeta ngohlangoti lweṙele, kwa amadoda nabafazi, intsapo nentsana; nenkabi, namaqwaṙashe, negusha, wazibeta ngohlangoti lweṙele.
Kodwa wasinda unyana wamnye ka‐Ahimeleki unyana ka‐Ahitube, ogama belingu‐Abiyatare, wesabela emva kwo‐Davide.
Waza u‐Abiyatare, wamxelela u‐Davide ukuba u‐Saule ubabulele abaperisite bakayehova.
Wandula u‐Davide wati ku‐Abiyatare: Bendikwazi ngalomini, oko u‐Dowegi um‐Edome abekona, ukuba uya kumxelela u‐Saule ngenyaniso: ndim ozuzisele yonke imipefumlo yendlu kayihlo ukufa.
Hlala nam, ungoyiki; ngokuba ofuna ubomi bam efuna ubomi bako; kodwa woba sekugcinweni unam.
KWAZA kwaxelwa ku‐Davide, kusitwa: Nanga ama‐Filistiya esilwa ngakuyo i‐Kehila, epanga izibaya zokubula.
Ngako u‐Davide wabuza kuyehova, esiti: Ndiya kuya na ndibete lama‐Filistiya? Waza uyehova wati ku‐Davide: Yiya ubete ama‐Filistiya, usindise i‐Kehila.
Kodwa amadoda ka‐Davide ati kuye: Bona ke, silapa nje kwa‐Juda siyoyika; kangakananina ngakumbi ke, nxa siya kuya e‐Kehila ngakuwo amabandla ama‐Filistiya?
Wapinda kanjako u‐Davide ukubuza kuyehova. Waye uyehova wampendula, wati: Suka, yihla uye e‐Kehila; ngokuba ndiya kunikela ama‐Filistiya esandleni sako.
Waza waya u‐Davide namadoda ake e‐Kehila, walwa ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya, watimba inkomo zawo, wawabeta ngesibulalo esikulu. Kwa njalo u‐Davide wasindisa abemi base‐Kehila.
Kwaye kute, akusaba u‐Abiyatare unyana ka‐Ahimeleki ukuya ku‐Davide e‐Kehila, wehla neyefodi esandleni sake.
Kwada kwaxelwa ku‐Saule ukuba u‐Davide utikile e‐Kehila. Wayesiti u‐Saule: Utixo umlahlele esandleni sam; ngokuba evalelwe, ngokungena esixekweni esinengcango nemivalo.
Waza u‐Saule wababiza bonke abantu emfazweni, ukuya kuhlela e‐Kehila, ukuvingcela u‐Davide namadoda ake.
Kekaloku akwazi u‐Davide ukuba u‐Saule ebeqinga ububi ngakuye, waza wati ku‐Abiyatare umperisite: Sondeza iyefodi.
Wandula wati u‐Davide: Yehova, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! isicaka sako sivile ngenyaniso ukuba u‐Saule uyafuna ukuza e‐Kehila, ukusitshabalalisa isixeko ngenxa yam.
Baya kundinikela na abemi base‐Kehila esandleni sake? uya kuhla na u‐Saule, njengokuba isicaka sako sivile? Yehova, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! zusixelele ke isicaka sako. Wayesiti uyehova: Uya kuhla.
Waza wati u‐Davide: Abemi base‐Kehila baya kunikela na mna namadoda am esandleni sika‐Saule? Wayesiti uyehova: Baya ku ku nikela.
Wandula wesuka u‐Davide, namadoda ake, anga angamakulu matandatu, bapuma e‐Kehila, bahamba apo babenokuhamba kona. Kwaza kwaxelwa ku‐Saule ukuba u‐Davide usindile e‐Kehila; ngako wayeka ukupuma.
Waza u‐Davide wahlala entlango ezinqatyeni, wahlala entabeni esentlango ye‐Zifi. Waye u‐Saule wamfuna imihla yonke; kodwa uyehova akamnika esandleni sake.
Wati u‐Davide wabona ukuba u‐Saule upumile ukufuna ubomi bake: waye u‐Davide esentlango ye‐Zifi, ehlatini.
Kekaloku wesuka u‐Jonatane unyana ka‐Saule, waya ku‐Davide ehlatini, wasomeleza isandla sake kutixo.
Wayesiti kuye: Ungoyiki; ngokuba isandla sika‐Saule ubawo singayi kukufumana; koko wena uya kuba ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, nam ndiya kuba ngosemva kwako; kanjako no‐Saule ubawo uyazi njalo.
Baza bobabini benza ucebano ebusweni bukayehova: wati u‐Davide wahlala ehlatini, kodwa u‐Jonatane waya endlwini yake.
Bandula benyuka aba‐Zifi baya ku‐Saule e‐Gibeha, besiti: u‐Davide akazifihlanga nati na ezinqatyeni ehlatini, endulini ye‐Hakila, engasesuyide yobala?
Ngako kaloku, kumkani! yihla, ngako konke ukukanuka kwompefumlo wako ukuhla; nokwetu, siya kumnikela esandleni sokumkani.
Waza u‐Saule wati: Manitanyusanqelwe nina nguyehova; ngokuba ninenceba pezu kwam.
Kanihambe ke, nibe nisalungisa, nazi nibone indawo yake, apo unyawo lwake lukona, nokuba ngubanina ombonileyo kona; ngokuba kutshiwo kum ukuba uyenza ngobuqinga futi.

Ngako bonani, nazane nendawo zokuzimela apo azimela kona, nize nibuyele kum ninenyaniso, ndandiya kuhamba nani; kwakuya kuti, ukuba uko elizweni, sendiya kumfunisela pakati kwawo onke amawaka akwa‐Juda.
Baza besuka, bandulela ku‐Saule ukuya e‐Zifi. Kodwa u‐Davide namadoda ake bebesentlango yase‐Mahone, etafeni, ngasesuyide yobala.
Waya no‐Saule namadoda ake ukufuna. Kwada kwaxelwa ku‐Davide; ngako wehla eliweni, wahlala entlango yase‐Mahone. Wati u‐Saule akuva oko, wamputuma u‐Davide entlango yase‐Mahone.

Waye u‐Saule ehamba ngelicala lentaba, no‐Davide namadoda ake ngeliya icala lentaba: waza u‐Davide wanxama ukumka ngenxa ka‐Saule; ngokuba u‐Saule namadoda ake bebemṙaula u‐Davide namadoda ake, ukuze bababambe.
Koko bekufika isigidimi ku‐Saule, sisiti: Nxama uze; ngokuba ama‐Filistiya egalelekile pezu kwelizwe.
Wandula wabuya u‐Saule ekumputumeni u‐Davide, waya ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya: kukona londawo ibibizwa ngokuti yi‐Sela‐mahelekote.
Waza u‐Davide wenyuka apo, waya wahlala ezinqatyeni zase‐Hene‐gedi.
KWAYE kute, akuba u‐Saule ebuyile ekulandeleni ama‐Filistiya, kwaxelwa kuye ngokuti: Nanku u‐Davide entlango yase‐Hene‐gedi.
Wandula u‐Saule watabata amadoda anyuliweyo angamawaka matatu kubo bonke o‐Sirayeli, waya ukumfuna u‐Davide namadoda ake pezu kwelwalwa zamagogo.
Wada wafika ezibayeni zegusha ngasendleleni, apo ubukona umqolomba; waza wangena u‐Saule ukugubungela inyawo zake. Kekaloku u‐Davide namadoda ake bahlala emacaleni omqolomba.

Aza amadoda ka‐Davide ati kuye: Nangu umhla uyehova wati ngawo kuwe: Bona ke, ndiya kunikela utshaba lwako esandleni sako, uze wenze kulo njengokulungileyo emehlweni ako. Wesuka u‐Davide, watsheca kakuhle isondo lengubo ka‐Saule.
Kwaye kute emveni kwoko, ukuba intliziyo ka‐Davide yambeta, ngenxa yokuba ebetshecile isondo lengubo ka‐Saule.
Wayesiti kumadoda ake: Ubunzima mabube kum buvela kuyehova, ukuba ndiyenza lento kwinkosi yam, kumtanjiswa kayehova, yokuba ndisolule isandla sam ngakuye! ngokuba engumtanjiswa kayehova yena.
Kwa njalo u‐Davide wakalimela amadoda ake ngamazwi lawo, engawavumelanga ukuba asukele ngakuye u‐Saule. Wada u‐Saule wesuka emqolombeni, wahamba endleleni.
Wesuka no‐Davide emveni kwoko, wapuma emqolombeni, wamemeza emva kwo‐Saule, esiti: Nkosi yam, kumkani! Wati akukangela u‐Saule emva kwake, watoba u‐Davide ngobuso ngasemhlabeni, waziqubuda.
Wayesiti u‐Davide ku‐Saule: Yinina ukuba upulapule amazwi abantu, besiti: Nanku u‐Davide efuna ilishwa lako?

Bona ke, kwa namhla nje amehlo ako abonile okokuba uyehova wakunikela namhla esandleni sam emqolombeni; kwaye kutiwa mandikubulale; kodwa iliso lam belinosizi pezu kwako; ndandisiti: Andiyi kusolula isandla sam ngakuyo inkosi yam; ngokuba ingumtanjiswa kayehova.

Kanjalo, bawo! kangela, ewe, kangela isondo lengubo yako esandleni sam; ngokuba ngokutsheca kwam isondo lengubo yako, ndingakubulalanga nje, yazi ubone ukuba akuko esandleni sam inkohlakalo nesilandu, nokuba andonanga ngakuwe; noko wena uyazingela umpefumlo wam, ukuba uwususe.
Uyehova uya kugweba pakati kwam nawe, ewe uyehova uya kundipindezelela kuwe; kodwa isandla sam asiyi kuba ngakuwe;
njengokuba usiti umzekeliso wabakudala: Inkohlakalo iyapuma kubakohlakeleyo; kodwa isandla sam asiyi kuba ngakuwe.
Upumile emva kwobanina ukumkani wo‐Sirayeli? uyaputuma wena emva kwobanina? emva kwenja efileyo! emva kwentakumba inye!
Ngako uyehova makabe ngumgwebi, agwebe pakati kwam nawe, abone, apikise upikiso lwam, andikulule esandleni sako.
Kwaye kute, nxa u‐Davide abegqibile ukuteta lamazwi ku‐Saule, wandula u‐Saule wati: Lilizwi lako na eli, nyana wam Davide? Waza u‐Saule wapakamisa ilizwi lake, walila.
Wayesiti ku‐Davide: Wena undigqitisile ngobulungisa; ngokuba wena undivuzile ngokulungileyo, kanti mna ndikuvuzile ngokukohlakeleyo.
Kanjako wena uxelile namhla okokuba undenzele okulungileyo; ekubeni uyehova ebendiyekelele esandleni sako, kodwa akundibulalanga.
Ngokuba nxa indoda ilufumeneyo utshaba lwayo, iya kulundulula ngendlela elungileyo na? Ngako uyehova makabuyekeze kuwe okulungileyo ngenxa yoko ukwenzileyo kum namhla nje.
Nakaloku, bona ke, ndiyazi ngenyaniso ukuba woba ngukumkani, nokuba ubukumkani bakwa‐Sirayeli buya kuma esandleni sako.
Ngako kaloku ndifungele uyehova ukuba akuyi kunqamla inzalo yam emva kwam, nokuba akuyi kutshabalalisa igama lam kuyo indlu kabawo.
Wandula u‐Davide wafungela u‐Saule. Wasuka u‐Saule wagoduka; kodwa u‐Davide namadoda ake benyukela enqatyeni.
WADA wafa u‐Samyali; baza bahlanganiswa o‐Sirayeli bonke, bamlilela, bamncw̔aba endlwini yake e‐Rama. Wemka u‐Davide, wehla waya entlango ye‐Parane.
Kwabekuko indoda e‐Mahone, emfuyo yayo yabise‐Karamele; kanjalo indoda leyo ibinkulu kunene; ibinegusha ezingamawaka matatu, nebokwe eziliwaka linye: yabisekucebeni igusha zayo e‐Karamele.
Igama lalondoda lalingu‐Nabali; negama lomfazi wayo lalingu‐Abigali; yena ebengumfazi ongqondo ilungileyo, nosimilo sihle; kodwa indoda ibilukuni, ibikohlakele ngezenzo kanjako; yabingum‐Kalebi yona.
Kekaloku u‐Davide weva entlango ukuba u‐Nabali uyaceba igusha zake.
Waza u‐Davide watuma abafana abalishumi; wayesiti u‐Davide kubafana abo: Nyukelani e‐Karamele, niye ku‐Nabali, nibuze egameni lam ukupila kwake:
nize nitsho kohleli kamnandi ukuti: Uxolo malube kuwe, uxolo malube nakwindlu yako, uxolo malube nakuko konke unako!
Sendivile ke ukuba unabacebi: kekaloku abalusi bako bebeko nati, asibonanga; kanjako bekungeko nanye into ebalahlekileyo, yonke imihla abebeko e‐Karamele.

Buza abafana bako, bokuxelela ke. Ngako mabati abafana aba bafumane ufefe emehlweni ako; ngokuba sisiza ngomhla olungileyo: kaunike oko kusukuba sikufumana isandla sako kwizicaka zako, nakunyana wako, ku‐Davide.
Bati bakufika abafana baka‐Davide, bateta ku‐Nabali njengalomazwi onke egameni lika‐Davide, bada bati cwaka.
Waza u‐Nabali wapendula izicaka zika‐Davide, wati: Ngubanina u‐Davide? ngubanina ke unyana ka‐Jese? kuko namhla izicaka ezininzi eziqweshayo ezinye ngezinye ezinkosini zazo:
sendiya kutabata na isonka sam, namanzi am, nesixe̔lo sam endisixe̔leleyo abacebi bam, ndinike kumadoda endingawazi ukuba angawapina?
Bandula abafana baka‐Davide bajikela endleleni yabo, babuya, beza bamxelela njengalomazwi onke.

Wayesiti u‐Davide kumadoda ake: Binqani nonke amaṙele enu. Abinqa ke amanye ngamanye amaṙele awo; no‐Davide wabinqa iṙele lake naye. Aza enyuka emva kwo‐Davide amadoda anga angamakulu mane; aye amakulu mabini ehleli ngasempahleni.
Koko umfana emnye ebafaneni wamxelela u‐Abigali, umfazi ka‐Nabali, esiti: Bona ke, u‐Davide wasusa izigidimi entlango ukuza kubulisa inkosi yetu; yaza yazituka.
Kodwa amadoda lawo ebelungile kakulu kuti: besingoniwa, besingalahleki nanye into kanjako, ngayo yonke imihla besihambana nawo, sakubako ezindle:
ebeludonga kuti nasebusuku nasemini, ngayo yonke imihla sibe sindawonye nawo sizalusa igusha.
Ngako kaloku, yazi ubone into uya kuyenza; ngokuba ububi sebugqityiwe ngakuyo inkosi yetu, nangakuyo yonke indlu yayo: ngokuba yona ingunyana wobunginingini, kude kungabi nakutetwa kuyo.

Wandula wanxama u‐Abigali, watabata izonka ezimakulu mabini, nentsuba zeveyine ezimbini, negusha ezilungisiweyo ezintlanu, nezilinganiso zamaqashu ezihlanu, nekulu lezipa zedreyive ezishwenyileyo, namakulu mabini amasimba amakiwane, wazibeka pezu kwamaqwaṙashe.
Wayesiti kuzo izicaka zake: Dlulani pambi kwam; nanku mna ndisiza emva kwenu. Kodwa akayixelela indoda yake u‐Nabali.
Kwabekute, esakwele pezu kweqwaṙashe, esihla ngendawo efihlakeleyo yentaba, bona ke, u‐Davide namadoda ake bebesihla besiza kumkaulela; waza wahlangana nabo.
Kekaloku u‐Davide ebete: Ngenyaniso ndifumane ndagcina konke anako lo entlango, kwada akwamlahleka nanye into kuko konke anako: kanjako ubuyekezile kum okukohlakeleyo esikundleni sokulungileyo.
Utixo makenje njalo ezintshabeni zika‐Davide, alekele ukwenje njalo, ukuba ndiyashiya kubo bonke anabo kude kukanye ukusa lowo onobudoda!
Wati u‐Abigali akubona u‐Davide, wanxama, wahlika eqwaṙasheni, wawa ebusweni bake pambi kwo‐Davide, wazitoba ngasemhlabeni,
wawa ngasezinyaweni zake, wati: Malibe pezu kwam, nkosi yam! ityala elo: kanjalo makesitete isicakakazi sako ezindlebeni zako, uve amazwi esicakakazi sako.

Inkosi yam maingabeki intliziyo yayo kulendoda yobunginingini, kuye u‐Nabali; ngokuba njengegama lake enjalo yena; ngu‐Nabali igama lake, nobubedengu bukuye: kodwa mna sicakakazi sako, andibonanga abafana benkosi yam, abo ububatumile.

Ngako kaloku, nkosi yam! njengokuba ehleli uyehova, nanjengokuba uhleli nompefumlo wako, unguye uyehova okunqandileyo ekuzeni ngegazi, ukuba uzipindezelele ngesako isandla: ngako kaloku, mababe njengo‐Nabali abazintshaba zako, nabafunela inkosi yam ububi.
Nakaloku, elitamsanqa elizisiweyo sisicakakazi sako enkosini yam, makelinikwe kubo abafana abahambayo ezinyaweni zenkosi yam.

Sixolele ke isilandu sesicakakazi sako: ngokuba uyehova eya kuyenzela inkosi yam ngenyaniso indlu eqinileyo; ngokokuba inkosi yam isilwa ukulwa kukayehova, nokuba inkohlakalo ingafunyanwanga kuwe ngemihla yako.

Noko kuvukile umntu ukukuputuma, nokufuna umpefumlo wako: kodwa umpefumlo wenkosi yam wobotshelwa esiqunyeni sobomi kuyehova, utixo wako; nompefumlo wentshaba zako uya kuwusaula pakati kwesigingqi sesisaulo.
Kwakuya kuti, nxa uyehova aya kwenzela inkosi yam njengako konke okulungileyo akutetile ngawe, na nxa aya kukumisela ube yinkosi pezu kwo‐Sirayeli;

oku akuyi kwandula kube sisigexiso kuwe, nesiku̔bekiso sentliziyo kuyo inkosi yam, okokuba upalazile igazi kungeko tuba, nokokuba inkosi yam izipindezelele ngokwayo: kodwa nxa uyehova aya kwenzela inkosi yam okulungileyo, wandul’ ukukumbula isicakakazi sako.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Abigali: Makabongwe uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, okutumileyo namhla nje ukuza kundikaulela.
Kanjako maitanyusanqeliswe intelekelelo yako, mautanyusanqeliswe nawe, ondibambileyo namhla nje ekuzeni ngegazi, ukuba ndizipindezelele ngesam isandla.

Ngokuba okunene, njengokuba uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ehleli, ondinqandileyo ekukwenzeleni ububi, ukuba ubunganxamanga ukuza kundikaulela, ngenyaniso bekungayi kusaliselwa u‐Nabali kude kukanye ukusa namnye onobudoda!
Wandula u‐Davide wamkela esandleni sake oko abemzisele kona, wati kuye: Nyuka uye ngoxolo endlwini yako; kangela, ndipulapulile ilizwi lako, ndibukile ubuso bako.

Wasuka u‐Abigali weza ku‐Nabali; kekaloku bona ke, ebenesidlo endlwini yake njengesidlo sokumkani; yati intliziyo ka‐Nabali yacwayita pakati kwake, ngokuba enxilile kakulu; ngako akamxelela nto, encinane nenkulu, kwada kwakanya ukusa.
Kwabekute kusasa, yakuba iveyine ipumile ku‐Nabali, wandula umfazi wake wamxelela ezizinto: yaza intliziyo yake yafa pakati kwake, wada waba njeng elitye.
Kwaye kute emva kwemihla yanga ilishumi, uyehova wambeta u‐Nabali, wada wafa.

Waza u‐Davide, akuva ukuba u‐Nabali ufile, wati: Makabongwe uyehova, opikisile impikiso yesigxekwa sam esandleni sika‐Nabali, nesicaka sake wasisonga enkohlakalweni; ngokuba inkohlakalo ka‐Nabali uyehova eyibuyisile pezu kweyake intloko. Wandula watuma u‐Davide, wateta no‐Abigali, ukuba amtabatele kuye abe ngumfazi.
Zati zakufika izicaka zika‐Davide ku‐Abigali e‐Karamele, zateta kuye, zisiti: u‐Davide usitumile kuwe, ukuba akutabatele kuye ube ngumfazi.
Waza wesuka, watoba ngobuso ngasemhlabeni, wati: Nasi isicakakazi sako sibe ngumkonzikazi ukuhlamba inyawo zezicaka zenkosi yam.
Wanxama ke wesuka u‐Abigali, wakwela eqwaṙasheni, enesihlanu sentombi zake ezihamba ezinyaweni zake; waza walandela izigidimi zika‐Davide, waba ngumfazi wake.
Kanjako u‐Davide wamzeka u‐Ahinohame wase‐Yezerele: baba ngabafazi bake nabo bobabini.
Kodwa u‐Saule ebenikile u‐Mikali intombi yake, umfazi ka‐Davide, ku‐Faliti unyana ka‐Layishe, obengowase‐Galime.
KEKALOKU aba‐Zifi beza ku‐Saule e‐Gibeha, besiti: u‐Davide akazimeli na endulini ye‐Hakila, ngapambi kwobala?
Waselesuka u‐Saule, wehla waya entlango yase‐Zifi, enaye amadoda anyuliweyo akwa‐Sirayeli angamawaka matatu, ukumfuna u‐Davide entlango yase‐Zifi.
Waza u‐Saule wati waca endulini ye‐Hakila, engapambi kwobala, ngasendleleni: kodwa u‐Davide wahlala entlango, wabona ukuba u‐Saule uze emva kwake ngasentlango.
Ngako u‐Davide watuma intlola, wazi ukuba u‐Saule selezile ngenyaniso.

Wesuka ke u‐Davide, weza kulondawo apo u‐Saule abete waca kona: waza u‐Davide wabona indawo apo u‐Saule ebelele kona, no‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere, inkosi yomkosi wake: kekaloku u‐Saule ebelele pakati kwodonga lwenqwelo, bati abantu bati waca ngokumngqonga.

Wandula wateta u‐Davide, wati ku‐Ahimeleki um‐Hete, naku‐Abishai unyana ka‐Tseruya, umninawe ka‐Jowabi, esiti: Ngubanina oya kuhla nam ukuya ku‐Saule emnqubeni? Waza u‐Abishai wati: Mna ndiya kuhla nawe.

Kwa njalo u‐Davide no‐Abishai beza ebantwini ebusuku; kekaloku nanku u‐Saule elele ubutongo pakati kwodonga lwenqwelo, nentshuntshe yake igxunyekiwe emhlabeni ngasentlokweni yake; kodwa u‐Abenere nabantu bebelele ngokumngqonga.
Wandula u‐Abishai wati ku‐Davide: Utixo uluyekelele namhla utshaba lwako esandleni sako; ngako kaloku, makendimbetele ngentshuntshe emhlabeni kube kanye, ndandingayi kumpindela.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Abishai: Ungamtshabalalisi: ngokuba ngubanina ongolulayo isandla sake ngakuye umtanjiswa kayehova, aze angabi natyala?
Wabuya wati u‐Davide: Njengokuba uyehova ehleli, nguyehova oya kumbeta; umhlaumbi umhla wake uya kuza ukuba afe, umhlaumbi uya kuhlela ekulweni, andule abube:
ubunzima mabube kum buvela kuyehova, ukuba ndiyasolula isandla sam ngakuye umtanjiswa kayehova! Kodwa ngoku kaususe intshuntshe engasentlokweni yake, negubu lamanzi, sihambe ke.

Waye u‐Davide wasusa intshuntshe negubu lamanzi endaweni yentloko ka‐Saule; baza bemka ke: kwaye kungeko namnye obebona, nobesazi, nobevuka; ngokuba bona bonke bebelele butongo, ngokuba ubutongo obukulu bukayehova bebuwile pezu kwabo.
Wandula u‐Davide wawela waya pesheya, wema pezu kwococoyi lwentaba, ekude; umgama omkulu upakati kwabo.
Waza u‐Davide wabiza kubo abantu, nakuye u‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere, esiti: Akupenduli na, Abenere? Wasuka wapendula u‐Abenere, wati: Ungubanina wena obizayo kukumkani?

Wayesiti u‐Davide ku‐Abenere: Akuyindoda na? ngubanina nofana nawe kwa‐Sirayeli? yinina ke ukuba akuyilindanga inkosi yako ukumkani? ngokuba bekungena omnye wabantu ukuza kutshabalalisa ukumkani inkosi yako.

Ayilungile lento uyenzileyo. Ehleli nje uyehova, nifanelwe kukufa, ngokokuba ningayilindanga inkosi yenu, umtanjiswa kayehova. Nakaloku, kangela ipina intshuntshe yokumkani, negubu lamanzi elibe lingasentlokweni yake.
Waza u‐Saule walazi ilizwi lika‐Davide, wati: Eli lilizwi lako na, nyana wam Davide? Wayesiti u‐Davide: Lilizwi lam, nkosi yam, kumkani!
Wati kanjalo: Kunganina ukuba inkosi yam yenje nje ukuputuma isicaka sayo? ngokuba iyinto nina endiyenzileyo? yiyipina inkohlakalo esesandleni sam?

Ngako kaloku maiti inkosi yam ukumkani ike ive amazwi esicaka sayo. Ukuba nguyehova okuvusileyo ngakum, makasezele irumba lomnikelo wokudla: kodwa ukuba ngabo onyana babantu, mabaqalekiswe bona pambi kwoyehova; ngokuba bendigxotile namhla ukuba ndingazibandakanyeli kwilifa likayehova, besiti: Hamba, ukonze otixo bambi.
Ngako kaloku, malingawi igazi lam ngasemhlabeni pambi kwobuso bukayehova: ngokuba ukumkani wo‐Sirayeli epumile ukufuna intakumba inye, njengokuba kuzingelwa isikwatsha ezintabeni.

Wandula wati u‐Saule: Ndonile; buya, nyana wam Davide! ngokuba ndingasayi kukupata kakubi, ngenxa yokuba umpefumlo wam ubunqabile emehlweni ako namhla nje: bona ke, ndenzile ngobudenge, ndiposisile ngokuninzi kakulu.
Waza u‐Davide wapendula wati: Nantsi intshuntshe yokumkani: makake omnye wabafana awele, ayitabate.
Wanga uyehova angabuyisela kubo bonke ngabanye ubulungisa babo nenyaniso yabo: ngokuba uyehova ebekunikele namhla esandleni sam, kodwa bendingavumi ukwolula isandla sam ngakuye umtanjiswa kayehova.
Kanjako bona ke, njengokuba umpefumlo wako ubusenziwa mkulu namhla nje emehlweni am, kwa njalo mawenziwe mkulu umpefumlo wam emehlweni kayehova, ade andisindise kubo bonke ubunzima.
Wandula u‐Saule wati ku‐Davide: Mautanyusanqelwe wena, nyana wam Davide! uya kukwenza kakulu ke, uya kumana ukweyisa kanjalo. Waza u‐Davide wahamba ngendlela yake, no‐Saule wabuyela endaweni yake.

WADA u‐Davide wati entliziyweni yake: Kaloku ndiya kububa omnye umhla ngesandla sika‐Saule; akuko nto endilungeleyo, kupela ndinxame ndisindele elizweni lama‐Filistiya, ati u‐Saule ancame ngam, ayeke ukundifuna kanjako kuyo yonke imida yakwa‐Sirayeli; kwa njalo ndiya kusinda esandleni sake.
Wandula wesuka u‐Davide, wagqita, yena namadoda angamakulu matandatu abenaye, waya ku‐Akishe, unyana ka‐Mahoke, ukumkani we‐Gate.

Waye u‐Davide wahlala no‐Akishe e‐Gate, yena namadoda ake, abanye ngabanye benabendlu yabo; u‐Davide enabafazi bake bobabini, u‐Ahinohame um‐Yezerelekazi, no‐Abigali um‐Karamelekazi, umfazi ka‐Nabali.
Kwaza kwaxelelwa u‐Saule ukuba u‐Davide usabele e‐Gate; ngako akasapinda ukumfuna.

Wayesiti u‐Davide ku‐Akishe: Ukuba ke ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, makunikwe kum indawo kwesinye sezixeko zangapandle, ukuba ndihlale kona; ngokuba kunganina ukuba isicaka sako sihlale esixekweni sobukumkani ndawonye nawe?
Wandula u‐Akishe wamnika ngalomhla i‐Tsikilage; kukona i‐Tsikilage ilunge kubo okumkani bo‐Juda kude kwanamhla nje.
Laye inani lemihla u‐Davide ebehlala ngayo ezweni lama‐Filistiya lingumnyaka mnye nenyanga zine.

Kekaloku wenyuka u‐Davide, namadoda ake, baya bagaleleka pezu kwama‐Geshure, nama‐Gezere, nama‐Amaleki; ngokuba wona ebengabemi belozwe kudala, njengokuba kuyiwa e‐Shure, nakude kube kulo ilizwe le‐Jipete.
Waza u‐Davide wabeta ilizwe elo, akalondoloza ebomini nendoda nomfazi; kanjako watabata igusha, nenkomo, namaqwaṙashe, nenkamela, nezivato, wada wabuya, weza ku‐Akishe.
Wandula wati u‐Akishe: Nigalelekile ngapina namhla? Wati ke u‐Davide: Ngasesuyide yakwa‐Juda, nangasesuyide yama‐Jeramele, nangasesuyide yama‐Keni.
Waye u‐Davide engalondolozanga ebomini nendoda nomfazi, ukubazisa e‐Gate, esiti: Hleze baxele ngati ukuti: Wenje njalo u‐Davide. Laye linjalo isiko lake yonke imihla abehlala elizweni lama‐Filistiya.
Waza u‐Akishe wakolwa ngu‐Davide, esiti: Ugqibele ukuzinukisa pakati kwabantu bake, pakati kwo‐Sirayeli; ngako woba sisicaka sam ngamaxa onke.

KWAYE kute ngalomihla, ukuba ama‐Filistiya ahlanganisa imikosi yawo ukwenza imfazwe, kuze kuliwe ngakubo o‐Sirayeli. Wandula u‐Akishe wati ku‐Davide: Yazi ngenyaniso ukuba uya kupuma nomkosi kunye nam, wena namadoda ako.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Akishe: Ngokunjalo uya kukwazi oko isicaka sako siya kukwenza. Wayesiti u‐Akishe ku‐Davide: Ngako oko ndiya kukumisa ube ngumgcini wentloko yam imihla yonke.
Kekaloku u‐Samyali ebefile; kanjalo bonke o‐Sirayeli bebemlilele, bamncw̔aba e‐Rama, kwa sesixekweni sake. Waye u‐Saule ebekwelelisile abenzelana nemishilogu, namatola, elizweni.
Aza ama‐Filistiya ahlanganiswa, eza ati waca e‐Shuneme: kanjako u‐Saule wahlanganisa onke ama‐Sirayeli, aya ati waca e‐Giliboha.
Wati u‐Saule akubona umkosi wama‐Filistiya, wasuka woyika, nentliziyo yake yangcangcazela kakulu.
Waza wabuza u‐Saule kuyehova, kodwa uyehova akampendula, nangamapupa, nange‐Urime, nangabaprofite.
Wandula u‐Saule wati kuzo izicaka zake: Ndifuneleni umfazi onobushologu, ndize ndiye kulowo, ndibuze kuye. Zaye zisiti izicaka zake kuye: Nankuya umfazi onobushologu e‐Hene‐dore.
Waza u‐Saule wazenza ngakumbi, wambata ingubo zimbi, wahamba yena, namadoda mabini kunye naye, beza kumfazi lowo ebusuku; wayesiti: Zundilaulele ngomshologu, undinyusele lowo endiya kumxela kuwe.
Wayesiti umfazi kuye: Bona ke, uyakwazi oko akwenzileyo u‐Saule, okokuba unqamlile abenzelana nemishologu, namatola, elizweni; yinina ngoko ukuba uyatiyela umpefumlo wam ukundifisa?
Waza u‐Saule wamfungela uyehova, esiti: Ehleli nje uyehova, akuyi kuhlelwa lityala ngenxa yalento!
Wandula umfazi wati: Ngubanina lowo ndiya kumnyusela kuwe? Wayesiti: Ndinyusele u‐Samyali.
Wati umfazi lowo akumbona u‐Samyali, wakala ngelizwi elikulu; wayesitsho umfazi lowo ku‐Saule, esiti: Yinina ukuba undikohlisile, wena ungu‐Saule nje?
Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Ungoyiki; ngokuba iyinto nina uyibonileyo? Wati umfazi ku‐Saule: Ndabona otixo benyuka emhlabeni.
Wayesiti kuye: Isimilo sake sinjanina? Wati yena: Yindoda elixego enyukayo, eyambete ingubo ende. Wandula u‐Saule wazi ukuba nguye u‐Samyali, watoba ngobuso ngasemhlabeni, waziqubuda.

Waza u‐Samyali wati ku‐Saule: Yinina ukuba undixalisile ngokundinyusa? Wayesiti u‐Saule: Ndixinezekile kakulu; ngokokuba ama‐Filistiya esilwa ngakum, nokuba utixo wemkile kum, engasandipenduli nangabaprofite nangamapupa; ngako ndibizile wena, ukuba undazise oko endiya kukwenza.
Wandula wati u‐Samyali: Kunganina ukuba ubuze mna, nxa uyehova emkile kuwe, esel’ elutshaba lwako nje?
Ngokuba uyehova ezenzele njengokuba ebeteta ngam; ngokuba uyehova eṙazulile ubukumkani esandleni sako, ebunikile kummelwane wako, ku‐Davide:
ngokokuba ungalivanga ilizwi likayehova, nokuba ungenzanga ngobushushu bomsindo wake ngakuwo ama‐Amaleki, kukona uyehova ekwenzele lento namhla nje.
Kanjako uyehova uya kunikela ama‐Sirayeli kunye nawe esandleni sama‐Filistiya: nangomso wena nonyana bako noba nam; nomkosi wama‐Sirayeli uyehova wowunikela esandleni sama‐Filistiya.
Wandula wawa ngobunxamo u‐Saule ubude bake bonke ngasemhlabeni, woyika kakulu ngenxa yamazwi ka‐Samyali: kwaye kungeko amandla kuye; ngokuba engadlanga isonka yonke imini nabo bonke ubusuku.

Waza umfazi lowo weza ku‐Saule, wabona ukuba uyetuswa kakulu, wati kuye: Bona ke, isicakakazi sako sivile ilizwi lako, nompefumlo wam ndiwubekile esandleni sam, namazwi ako obuwateta kum ndiwapulapule:
ngako kaloku kaupulapule nawe ilizwi lesicakakazi sako, ukuba mandibeke umtamo wesonka ebusweni bako, uze udle; wauya kuba namandla, nxa uhamba ngendlela yako.
Koko walayo, wati: Andiyi kudla. Kodwa zamqu̔ba izicaka zake, kwa nomfazi lowo kanjalo; wada wapulapula ilizwi labo. Waza wesuka emhlabeni, wahlala emandlalweni.
Waye umfazi ebenetole elityetyisiweyo endlwini; wanxama ke walixe̔la; watabata nomgubo, wawubuca, woja izonka ezingenagwele ngawo:
waza wazisondeza ebusweni buka‐Saule, nasebusweni bezicaka zake; badla ke. Bandula besuka, bemka ngobobusuku.
KEKALOKU ama‐Filistiya ebehlanganisile yonke imikosi yawo e‐Afeki; nama‐Sirayeli wona abete waca ngasemtonjeni ose‐Yezerele.
Zaza inkosi zama‐Filistiya zadlula ngamakulu nangamawaka; kodwa u‐Davide namadoda ake badlula ngasemva kunye no‐Akishe.

Zandula inkosi zama‐Filistiya zati: Afuna nto nina ama‐Hebere la? Wayesiti u‐Akishe kuzo inkosi zama‐Filistiya: Lo asi nguye na u‐Davide, isicaka sika‐Saule ukumkani wo‐Sirayeli, obeko nam ngalemihla, umhlaumbi ngaleminyaka? ndandingafumananga nto kuye, kwa semhleni wokupongoma kwake kwada kwanamhla nje.

Koko inkosi zama‐Filistiya zaqumba ngakuye; zaza inkosi zama‐Filistiya zati kuye: Buyisa londoda, iye ibuyele endaweni yayo, apo uyimisele kona, ukuba ingehli nati ukuya ekulweni, ize ingabi ngumalane kuti ekulweni; ngokuba kunganto nina aya kuzikolekisa lo enkosini yake? akungazo intloko zalamadoda na?
Lo asi nguye na u‐Davide, ababevuma ngaye emidudweni, besiti: u‐Saule ubulele amawaka ake, kodwa u‐Davide amawaka ake alishumi?

Wandula u‐Akishe wambiza u‐Davide, wati kuye: Ehleli nje uyehova, ulungelelene wena; kanjalo ukupuma kwako nokungena kwako kunye nam emkosini kulungile emehlweni am; ngokuba ndingafumananga inkohlakalo kuwe, kwa semhleni wokuza kwako kum kude kwanamhla nje: noko emehlweni azo inkosi akulungile wena.
Ngako kaloku buya, uhambe ngoxolo, ukuba ungenzi okubi emehlweni enkosi zama‐Filistiya.

Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Akishe: Yinto nina pofu endiyenzileyo? yinto nina kanjalo uyifumeneyo kwisicaka sako, kwa semhleni bendisebusweni bako ngawo kude kwanamhla nje, ukuba ndingayi ndilwe ngakuzo intshaba zenkosi yam ukumkani?
Wapendula u‐Akishe wati ku‐Davide: Ndiyazi ukuba ulungile wena emehlweni am, njengengelosi katixo: kodwa inkosi zama‐Filistiya zite: Akayi kunyuka nati ukuya ekulweni.
Ngako kaloku, vuka kusasa ngomso, nezicaka zenkosi yako ezibe zisiza nawe; niti nakuba nivukile kusasa ngomso, nxa kunikanyeleyo, nandule nimke.
Waza u‐Davide wavuka kusasa, yena namadoda ake, ukuba bemke kusasa ukuya kubuyela ezweni lama‐Filistiya. Ati ama‐Filistiya enyuka aya e‐Yezerele.
KWAYE kute, akufika u‐Davide namadoda ake e‐Tsikilage ngomhla wesitatu, kekaloku ama‐Amaleki ebegalelekile pezu kwesuyide, napezu kwe‐Tsikilage, abeta i‐Tsikilage, ayitshisa ngomlilo;
nabafazi abebekuyo ebebatimbile, engabulalanga nje namnye umntu kodwa, kwa nomncinane nomkulu; koko abebafudusile, ahamba ngendlela yawo.
Kwa njalo akufika u‐Davide namadoda ake esixekweni, nasi sitshisiwe ngomlilo; nabafazi babo, nonyana babo, nentombi zabo, bona bebetinjiwe.
Bandula u‐Davide nabantu abanaye bapakamisa ilizwi labo, balila, kwada akwabi sabiko kubo amandla okulila.
Baye betinjiwe abafazi baka‐Davide bobabini, u‐Ahinohame um‐Yezerelekazi, no‐Abigali umfazi ka‐Nabali um‐Karamele.

Waye u‐Davide waxinezeka kakulu; ngokuba abantu bebeteta ngokumgibisela ngamatye, ngokuba umpefumlo wabantu bonke ubunobuṙaṙa, abanye ngabanye pezu kwonyana babo, napezu kwentombi zabo; kodwa u‐Davide wazomeleza kuye uyehova, utixo wake.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Abiyatare umperisite, unyana ka‐Ahimeleki: Kausondeze kum iyefodi. Wayisondeza u‐Abiyatare iyefodi ku‐Davide.
Wandula u‐Davide wabuza kuyehova ngokuti: Ndiya kuputuma elibandla na? ndiya kulifumana na? Wayesiti kuye: Putuma; ngokuba uya kufumana ngenyaniso, uya kugqibela ukuhlangula kanjako.
Wasuka wahamba u‐Davide, yena namadoda angamakulu matandatu abenaye, baza kufika emlanjaneni we‐Besore, apo abo basalayo bahlala kona.
Kodwa u‐Davide waputuma, yena namadoda angamakulu mane: ngokuba bekuhlala amadoda angamakulu mabini, abecubukile kangaka, ukuba ebengenako ukuwela umlanjana we‐Besore.
Baza bafumana indoda engum‐Jipete ezindle, bayizisa ku‐Davide; bayinika isonka, yada yatya; bayiseza amanzi;

bayinika kanjalo iqezu lesimba lamakiwane, nezipa zibini zedreyive ezishwenyileyo: yati yakuba idlile, umoya wayo wabuya weza kuyo; ngokuba isonka ibingasityanga, namanzi ibingawaselanga, imini zantatu nobusuku butatu.
Waza u‐Davide wati kuyo: Ungokabanina? uvela pina? Yayisiti: Ndiyindodana yase‐Jipete, isicaka som‐Amaleki; yandishiya inkosi yam, ngokuba bendihliwa sisifo kuse kuntsuku ntatu.
Tina sabesigaleleka pezu kwelasesuyide ilizwe lama‐Keriti, napezu kwelakwa‐Juda, napezu kwelasesuyide lakwa‐Kalebi, satshisa i‐Tsikilage ngomlilo.
Waza u‐Davide wati kuyo: Ungaka undihlisele kwelibandla na? Yayisiti: Ndifungele utixo, ukuba akuyi kundibulala, nokuba akuyi kundinikela esandleni senkosi yam, ndandiya kukuhlisela kwelibandla.

Kekaloku yakuba imhlisile, naba ke betwabulukile pezu kwobuso bomhlaba wonke, besidla, besela, beduda nokududa, ngenxa yalo lonke ixoba elikulu, ababelisusile ezweni lama‐Filistiya, nasezweni lakwa‐Juda.

Waza u‐Davide wababeta kwa kuso isifingo sokusa kwada kwakukuhlwa kwomnye umhla; kwaye kungasindanga namnye umntu pakati kwabo, ngapandle kwamadodana angamakulu mane, abekwele pezu kwenkamela, esaba ke.
Waye u‐Davide wahlangula konke ama‐Amaleki abekususile; nabafazi bake bobabini u‐Davide wabahlangula.
Kwaye kungasweleki kubo, kwa nomncinane nomkulu, kwa nonyana nentombi, kwa nexoba nako konke ababekutabatele kubo; konke u‐Davide wakubuyisa.
Waza u‐Davide watabata zonke igusha nenkomo; baziqu̔ba pambi kw ezinye inkomo ezo, bati: Lixoba lika‐Davide eli.

Kekaloku akuza u‐Davide kulawomadoda angamakulu mabini abecubukile kangaka ukuba ebengenako ukumlandela u‐Davide, nababewahlalisile emlanjaneni we‐Besore, apuma wona ukuya kumkaulela u‐Davide, nokubakaulela abantu ababenaye; waza u‐Davide wasondela ebantwini, wababulisa.

Andula apendula onke amadoda akohlakeleyo nawobunginingini, pakati kwamadoda abehamba no‐Davide, ati: Ngenxa yokuba ebengahambanga nati, asiyi kuwanika nto kwixoba esilihlanguleyo, kupela kwindoda ngendoda umfazi wayo nabantwana bayo; makakape bona, emke.
Koko wati u‐Davide: Aniyi kwenje njalo, bazalwana bam! ngoko uyehova akunikileyo kuti, osigcinileyo tina, nebandla elezayo ngakuti ulinikele esandleni setu.
Ngubanina ke oya kunipulapula ngalento? ngokuba njengesabelwa sabo bahlela ekulweni, siya kuba njalo isabelwa sabo bahlala ngasempahleni; kwolingana ukwabelwa kwabo.
Kwabekute kwa semhleni lowo nangasemva, ukuba wakumisa oku kube ngumteto nesiko kwa‐Sirayeli kwada kwanamhla.
Wati akufika u‐Davide e‐Tsikilage, watuma inxenye yexoba kubo abadala bo‐Juda, kubo abahlobo bake, esiti: Nali itamsanqa kuni, kwixoba lentshaba zikayehova;
kwa kubo abase‐Betele, nakubo abase‐Ramote yasesuyide, nakubo abase‐Yatire,
nakubo abase‐Harohere, nakubo abase‐Sifimote, nakubo abase‐Shetemoha,
nakubo abase‐Rakale, nakubo abasezixekweni zama‐Jeramele, nakubo abasezixekweni zama‐Keni,
nakubo abase‐Horema, nakubo abase‐Kore‐hashane, nakubo abase‐Hatake,
nakubo abase‐Hebrone, nakuzo zonke indawo, apo u‐Davide ebehambile kona, yena namadoda ake.
KEKALOKU ama‐Filistiya alwa no‐Sirayeli; aza amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli esaba pambi kwama‐Filistiya, awa ehlatyiwe entabeni ye‐Giliboha.
Asuka ama‐Filistiya ati nama ukulandela u‐Saule nonyana bake; ada ama‐Filistiya abulala u‐Jonatane, no‐Abinadabi, no‐Maleki‐shuha, onyana baka‐Saule.
Kwabekunzima ke ukulwa ngakuye u‐Saule, ati amadoda abetola ngesipeta amcana; waza watutumela kakulu ngenxa yabatoli.

Wandula u‐Saule wati kumtwali wezixo̔bo zake: Ṙola iṙele lako, undihlabe ngalo; hleze aba bangalukileyo beze, bandihlabe, badlale ngam. Kodwa umtwali wezixo̔bo zake ebengavumi; ngokuba ebesoyika kakulu. Waza u‐Saule watabata iṙele, wawa pezu kwalo.
Wati umtwali wezixo̔bo zake, akubona ukuba u‐Saule ufile, wawa naye pezu kweṙele lake, wafa kunye naye.
Kwa njalo wabuba u‐Saule, nonyana bake bobatatu, nomtwali wezixo̔bo zake, nawo onke amadoda ake, ngalomini kwa kunye.

Ati akubona amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli abenganeno kwomhlambo, nabenganeno kwe‐Yoredane, ukuba amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli esabile, nokuba u‐Saule nonyana bake bafile, andula ashiya izixeko, esaba; ati ama‐Filistiya eza ahlala kuzo.
Kwaye kute ngomnye umhla, akufika ama‐Filistiya ukuhluba abahlatyiweyo, afumana u‐Saule nonyana bake bobatatu belele entabeni ye‐Giliboha.
Aza anqumla intloko yake, ahluba izixo̔bo zake, atumela ezweni lama‐Filistiya elingqongayo, ukushumayela endlwini yezitixo zawo nasebantwini.
Kekaloku izixo̔bo zake azibeka endlwini ka‐Hashetorete, nesidumbu sake asibetela eludongeni lwase‐Bete‐shane.
Bati bakuva abemi base‐Yabeshe‐gileyadi oko akwenzileyo ama‐Filistiya ku‐Saule,
bandul’ ukusuka bonke abangamaṙoti, bahamba bonke ubusuku, batula isidumbu sika‐Saule, nezidumbu zonyana bake, eludongeni lwase‐Bete‐shane, beza e‐Yabeshe, bazitshisa kona.
Baza batabata amatambo abo, bawancw̔aba ngapantsi kwomti wetamariske e‐Yabeshe, bazila ukutya intsuku zasixe̔nxe.
KWAYE kute emva kwokufa kuka‐Saule, nxa u‐Davide abebuyile ekubulaweni kwama‐Amaleki, na nxa u‐Davide abehleli imihla mibini e‐Tsiki lage;

kwaye kute kwa ngomhla wesitatu, ukuba, bona ke, indoda yavela emkosini ku‐Saule, inengubo zayo ziṙazukile, nomhlaba pezu kwentloko yayo: kwati ke, ekuzeni kwayo ku‐Davide, yawa ngasemhlabeni, yaziqubuda.
Waza u‐Davide wati kuyo: Uvela pina? Yati kuye: Ndisindile emkosini wama‐Sirayeli.
Wati u‐Davide kuyo: Kwehla nto nina? ndixeleleke. Yayisiti: Abantu besabile ekulweni; kanjako kuwile abaninzi kubo abantu, batile; no‐Saule, no‐Jonatane unyana wake, bafile nabo.
Walekela u‐Davide wati kuyo indodana ebimxelele: Wazi nganina, ukuba u‐Saule ufile, no‐Jonatane unyana wake?
Yaza indodana ebimxelele yati: Ndahla ndafika entabeni ye‐Giliboha; kekaloku nanku u‐Saule esimelele ngentshuntshe yake; kanjalo, bona ke, inqwelo nabakweli bamahashe bebemputuma ngokuti nama;
wati akubeka ngasemva kwake, wandibona, wandibiza; ndaza ndati: Nanku ndi lapa.
Waza wati kum: Ungubanina? Ndati kuye: Ndingum‐Amaleki.
Wati kum kanjalo: Yima ke pezu kwam, undifise, ngokuba isizunguzane sindibambile; ngokuba ubomi bam busebonke pakati kwam.

Ndaza ndema pezu kwake, ndamfisa, ngokuba bendisazi ukuba akayi kupila emva kwokuwa kwake; ndaye nditabata ikrone ebisentlokweni yake, nesacolo esibe sisengalweni yake, endizizisileyo enkosini yam apa.
Wandula u‐Davide wabamba ingubo zake, waziṙazula; kwa nawo onke amadoda abenaye;
baza benza isijwili, balila, bazila ukutya kwada kwahlwa, ngenxa ka‐Saule, nangenxa ka‐Jonatane unyana wake, nangenxa yabantu bakayehova, nangenxa yendlu ka‐Sirayeli, ngokuba bebewile ngeṙele.
Wabuya u‐Davide wati kuyo indodana ebimxelele: Uvela pina? Yati: Ndingunyana womntu wasemzini, um‐Amaleki.
Waza u‐Davide wati kuyo: Yinina ukuba ubungoyiki ukwolula isandla sako ukumbulala umtanjiswa kayehova?
Wandula u‐Davide wayibiza enye kumadodana, wati: Sondela, yiwele. Yaza yayibeta, yada yafa.
Waye u‐Davide esiti kuyo: Igazi lako malibe pezu kweyako intloko; ngokuba umlomo wako unqi̔nile ngakuwe, usiti: Mna ndimfisile umtanjiswa kayehova.
Kekaloku u‐Davide wenza isililo esi pezu kwo‐Saule, napezu kwo‐Jonatane unyana wake:
(wayexela ukuba usapo luka‐Juda malufundiswe isi‐Peta; bona ke, siba̔liwe encwadini ka‐Yashere:)
Buhle buka‐Sirayeli, buhlatyiwe pezu kwenduli zako! hai ukuwa kwamaṙoti!
Ningaxeleli e‐Gate, ningashumayeli ezitarateni ze‐Ashekelone; hleze zivuye intombi zama‐Filistiya, hleze zigcobe intombi zabangalukileyo.

Nina zintaba zase‐Giliboha? makungabiko umbete, makungabiko nemvula pezu kwenu, kwa namasimi eminikelo: ngokuba kona apo bekulahlwa ikaka lamaṙoti, ikaka lika‐Saule, njengokungati ebengenguye otanjisiweyo ngeoli.
Isipeta sika‐Jonatane asihlehlanga ngomva, neṙele lika‐Saule alibuyanga zé, kulo igazi labahlatyiweyo, kulo inqata lamaṙoti.
U‐Saule no‐Jonatane bebengabatandekayo nabamnandi ekudleni kwabo ubomi, nasekufeni kwabo bebengahlukene: bebenamendu ngapezu kwenkozi, bebenamandla ngapezu kwengonyama.
Zintombi zakwa Sirayeli! lilelani u‐Saule, obenivatisa ngesibomvu kunye neziyoliso, owafaka izihombo zegolide pezu kwokuvata kwenu.
Hai ukuwa kwamaṙoti pakati kwokulwa! Jonatane, uhlatyiwe pezu kwenduli zako.
Kubuhlungu kum ngenxa yako, mzalwana wam Jonatane! ubumnandi kum kakulu; utando lwako lube lungummangaliso kum, lupezu kwotando lwabafazi!
Hai ukuwa kwamaṙoti, nokutshabalala kwezixo̔bo zemfazwe!

KWAYE kute emveni kwoku, ukuba u‐Davide wabuza kuyehova, esiti: Ndiya kunyuka na ndiye kwesinye sezixeko zakwa‐Juda? Wayesiti uyehova kuye: Nyuka. Waza u‐Davide wati: Ndiya kunyukela pina? Wati: e‐Hebrone.
Wasuka u‐Davide wenyukela kona, kwa nabafazi bake bobabini, u‐Ahinohame um‐Yezerelekazi, no‐Abigali umfazi ka‐Nabali um‐Karamele.
Namadoda ake abenaye wawenyusa u‐Davide, amanye ngamanye enabendlu zawo: baza bahlala ezixekweni zase‐Hebrone.
Andula eza amadoda akwa‐Juda, amtambisa kona u‐Davide abe ngukumkani pezu kwendlu ka‐Juda. Kwaye kuxelwa ku‐Davide, kusitwa: Amadoda ase‐Yabeshe‐gileyadi angabo abamncw̔abileyo u‐Saule.
Waza u‐Davide watuma izigidimi kuwo amadoda ase‐Yabeshe‐gileyadi, wati kuwo: Manitanyusanqelwe nina nguyehova, ngokokuba nenzile obububele enkosini yenu, ku‐Saule, nimncw̔abile nje.
Nakaloku makenze uyehova kuni ububele nenyaniso; kanjalo nam ndiya kubuyekeza kuni ukulunga oku, ngokokuba nenzile lento.
Ngako kaloku, mazomelele izandla zenu, nibe ngamadoda obuṙoti; ngokuba ifile inkosi yenu, u‐Saule; kanjalo nam indlu ka‐Juda inditambisile ndibe ngukumkani pezu kwabo.
Koko u‐Abenere, unyana ka‐Nere, inkosi yomkosi obungoka‐Saule, watabata u‐Shiboshete unyana ka‐Saule, wamweza ukuya e‐Mahanayime;
wamenza ukumkani pezu kwe‐Gileyadi, napezu kwama‐Ashuri, napezu kwe‐Yezerele, napezu kwo‐Frayime, napezu kwo‐Benjamine, napezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke.
Ebengominyaka imashumi mane u‐Shiboshete unyana ka‐Saule ubudala bake, akuba ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli; wapata ubukumkani iminyaka yamibini. Kodwa indlu ka‐Juda ibimlandela u‐Davide.
Laye inani lemihla u‐Davide ebengukumkani ngayo e‐Hebrone, pezu kwendlu ka‐Juda, liyiminyaka isixe̔nxe nenyanga zintandatu.
Kekaloku u‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere, nezicaka zika‐Shiboshete unyana ka‐Saule, bapuma e‐Mahanayime baya e‐Gibeyone:
kanjalo u‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya, nezicaka zika‐Davide, bapuma, bahlangana nabo ngasecibini lase‐Gibeyone: baza bahlala pantsi, aba ngelinye icala lecibi, nabo ngelinye icala lecibi.
Wandula u‐Abenere wati ku‐Jowabi: Makasuke ke amadodana, adlale ebusweni betu. Wati u‐Jowabi: Makasuke.
Aza esuka, adlula ngenani; ishumi linamabini amadodana akwa‐Benjamine, abengaka‐Shiboshete unyana ka‐Saule, neshumi linamabini ezicakeni zika‐Davide.
Asuka abambana ngentloko, ahlaba enye ngeṙele layo ecaleni lenye, awa kwa kunye; ngako londawo ibibizwa ngokuti yi‐Helekate‐hatsurime, ese‐Gibeyone.
Kwabekuko ukulwa okunzima kakulu ngalomhla: waza woyiswa u‐Abenere, namadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, ebusweni bezicaka zika‐Davide.
Kwaye kuko kona onyana abatatu baka‐Tseruya, u‐Jowabi, no‐Abishai, no‐Hasaheli; waye u‐Hasaheli ebenamendu ngenyawo zake, njengelinye lamabadi asendle.
Waza u‐Hasaheli wamsukela u‐Abenere; ebengashenxi ukuya ngasekunene nangasekohlo ekumlandeleni u‐Abenere.
Wandula u‐Abenere wabeka ngasemva kwake, wati: Unguwe na, Hasaheli? Wati: Ndim.
Waza u‐Abenere wati kuye: Shenxela ngasekunene kwako, umhlaumbi ngasekohlo kwako, uyibambe enye yamadodana, utabate izixo̔bo zayo. Kodwa u‐Hasaheli ebengavumi ukupambuka ekumlandeleni.
Wapinda kanjako u‐Abenere ukuti ku‐Hasaheli: Pambuka ekundilandeleni; yinina ukuba ndikubete ngasemhlabeni? ngendisiti nina ke ukupakamisa ubuso bam ku‐Jowabi umkuluwe wako?

Kodwa wala ukupambuka: ngako u‐Abenere wambeta ngencam yasemva yentshuntshe esiswini, yada intshuntshe yapumela emva kwake; waza wawa kona, wafa endaweni yake: kwaza kwati, bonke abezayo kulondawo, apo wawayo u‐Hasaheli wafa kona, bati uqumama.
Kanjalo u‐Jowabi no‐Abishai bamsukela u‐Abenere: lati ilanga latshona bakufika endulini ye‐Ama, epambi kwe‐Giya, ngasendleleni yentlango yase‐Gibeyone.
Lwaza usapo luka‐Benjamine lwazihlanganisa emva kwo‐Abenere, lwaba liqela linye, lwema pezu kwococoyi lwenduli.

Wandula u‐Abenere wabiza ku‐Jowabi, wati: Iṙele liya kudla kude kube ngunapakade na? akwazi na ukuba kwobako ubuṙaṙa ekupeleni? kwoda kube ninina ke ungayi kuxelela abantu, ukuba mababuye ekulandeleni abazalwana babo?
Waza wati u‐Jowabi: Ehleli nje uyehova, ukuba ubungatetanga, ngenyaniso oko kwa kusasa bange benyukile abantu abanye ngabanye ekulandeleni abazalwana babo!
Wandula u‐Jowabi wavutela ngexilongo; baza bonke abantu bati nqumama; ababuya basukele o‐Sirayeli; ababi sapinda ukulwa kanjako.
Kekaloku u‐Abenere namadoda ake bahamba bonke ubusuku obo etafeni, bawela i‐Yoredane, bacanda kuyo yonke i‐Biterone, bada bafika e‐Mahanayime.
Wati no‐Jowabi wabuya ekumlandeleni u‐Abenere, wahlanganisa bonke abantu: kwaza kwasweleka ezicakeni zika‐Davide amadoda alishumi elinesitoba, no‐Hasaheli:
kodwa izicaka zika‐Davide bezibetile ku madoda akwa‐Benjamine, napakati kwamadoda ka‐Abenere, ukuba amadoda angamakulu matatu anamashumi matandatu abefile.
Baza bamsusa u‐Hasaheli, bamncw̔aba encw̔abeni loyise, elibe lise‐Beteleheme. Basuka bahamba u‐Jowabi namadoda ake bonke ubusuku, kwada kwabakanyela e‐Hebrone.
KEKALOKU kwabekuko ukulwa okude pakati kwendlu ka‐Saule nendlu ka‐Davide: kodwa u‐Davide wamana ukwomelela, kanti indlu ka‐Saule bona bamana ukuba butataka.
Kwaye kumzalelwa u‐Davide onyana e‐Hebrone: owamazibulo wake ebengu‐Amnone, ngo‐Ahinohame um‐Yezerelekazi;
nowesibini wake ebengu‐Kileyabi, ngo‐Abigali umfazi ka‐Nabali um‐Karamele; nowesitatu ebengu‐Abasalome, unyana ka‐Mahaka intombi ka‐Talemai ukumkani we‐Geshure;
nowesine ebengu‐Adonija, unyana ka‐Hagiti; nowesihlanu ebengu‐Shefatiya, unyana ka‐Abitale;
nowesitandatu ebengu‐Yiterame, ngo‐Hegela umfazi ka‐Davide. Aba bebemzalelwa u‐Davide e‐Hebrone.
Kwaye kute, xeshekweni bekuko ukulwa pakati kwendlu ka‐Saule nendlu ka‐Davide, ukuba u‐Abenere wazomelezela indlu ka‐Saule.
Kekaloku u‐Saule ebeneshweshwe, eligama belingu‐Ritsepa, intombi ka‐Aya. Wayesiti u‐Shiboshete ku‐Abenere: Yinina ukuba ubungena kulo ishweshwe likabawo?

Wandula u‐Abenere waqumba kakulu ngenxa yamazwi ka‐Shiboshete, wati: Ndiyintloko yenja na mna, enditi ngakubo o‐Juda, ndenze ububele namhla kuyo indlu ka‐Saule uyihlo, kubo abazalwana bake, nakubo abahlobo bake, ndingakunikelanga esandleni sika‐Davide, ukuba uyabeka pezu kwam ityala lalomfazi namhla?
Utixo makenje njalo ku‐Abenere, alekele ukwenje njalo kuye, ukuba anditi, njengokuba uyehova efungile ku‐Davide, ndenze kwa njalo kuye:
ukufudusa ubukumkani kuyo indlu ka‐Saule, nokumisa iterone ka‐Davide pezu kwo‐Sirayeli napezu kwo‐Juda, kwa se‐Dane kude kube se‐Beresheba.
Waza wakohlwa ukumpendula u‐Abenere kanjako nalinye ilizwi, ngokuba ebemoyika.
Wandula u‐Abenere watuma izigidimi ku‐Davide ngenxa yokwake, ukuti: Lelikabanina ilizwe? n okuti: Yenza ucebano lwako nam; bona ke, isandla sam sesiya kuba nawe, ukuguqulela kuwe o‐Sirayeli bonke.
Waza wati: Kulungile, ndiya kulwenza nawe ucebano; inye into kodwa ndiyibiza kuwe, yokuti: Akuyi kubona ubuso bam, ukuba akumzisi kuqala u‐Mikali intombi ka‐Saule, wakuza ukubona ubuso bam.
Kanjalo u‐Davide watuma izigidimi ku‐Shiboshete unyana ka‐Saule, esiti: Kupa umfazi wam u‐Mikali, endimxamele mna ngekulu lamajwabu ama‐Filistiya.
Watuma ke u‐Shiboshete, wamsusa endodeni, ku‐Falitiyeli unyana ka‐Layishe.
Yaza indoda yake yahamba naye, yamana ilila emva kwake kude kwase‐Bahurime. Wandula u‐Abenere wati kuyo: Hamba, buya. Yaza yabuya.
Kekaloku u‐Abenere ebenamazwi kunye nabadala bo‐Sirayeli, esiti: Ngamaxesha apambili benimfuna u‐Davide ukuba abe ngukumkani pezu kwenu;
ngako kaloku yenzani; ngokuba uyehova etetile ngo‐Davide, esiti: Ngesandla sika‐Davide isicaka sam ndiya kusindisa abantu bam o‐Sirayeli esandleni sama‐Filistiya, nasesandleni sentshaba zabo zonke.

Wateta u‐Abenere kanjalo ezindlebeni zo‐Benjamine: waya u‐Abenere kanjako ukuteta ezindlebeni zika‐Davide e‐Hebrone, konke okube kulungile emehlweni o‐Sirayeli, nasemehlweni ayo yonke indlu ka‐Benjamine.
Kwa njalo u‐Abenere weza ku‐Davide e‐Hebrone, enaye amadoda angamashumi mabini. Waza u‐Davide wenzela u‐Abenere namadoda abenaye isidlo.

Wandula u‐Abenere wati ku‐Davide: Ndiya kusuka ndihambe, ndiye kuhlanganisela enkosini yam ukumkani bonke o‐Sirayeli, ukuba benze ucebano nawe, uze upate ubukumkani pezu kwako konke okukanukwayo ngumpefumlo wako. Wada u‐Davide wamndulula u‐Abenere; wasuka wahamba ngoxolo.
Kekaloku bona ke, izicaka zika‐Davide no‐Jowabi bavela ebandleni, bazisa nabo amaxoba amaninzi: kodwa u‐Abenere ebengenaye u‐Davide e‐Hebrone, ngokuba ebemndulule, waza wemka ngoxolo.
Kwati kwakufika u‐Jowabi nomkosi wonke obunaye, kwaxelwa ku‐Jowabi ngokuti: u‐Abenere, unyana ka‐Nere, weza kukumkani, owamndulula, wada wemka ngoxolo.
Wandula u‐Jowabi wangena kukumkani, wati: Wenze nto nina; bona ke, u‐Abenere weza kuwe; yinina lento umndululeyo, wada wemka kanye?
Uyamazi u‐Abenere, unyana ka‐Nere, ukuba weza ukukukohlisa, nokukwazi ukupuma kwako nokungena kwako, nokukwazi konke okwenzayo wena.
Waza u‐Jowabi wapuma ku‐Davide, watuma izigidimi emva kwo‐Abenere, ezambuyisayo equleni le‐Sira. Kodwa u‐Davide wayengazi oku.
Nxa u‐Abenere abebuyele e‐Hebrone, waza u‐Jowabi wamshenxisela pakati esangweni, ukuze atete naye ngasese, wambeta kona esiswini, wada wafa, ngenxa yegazi lika‐Hasaheli umninawe wake.
Kwakuviwa ngu‐Davide kamva, wandula wati: Mna nobukumkani bam asinatyala pambi kwoyehova kude kube ngunapakade ngenxa yegazi lika‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere:
malibekwe pezu kwentloko ka‐Jowabi, napezu kwayo yonke indlu yoyise; kanjalo makunganqamki kwindlu ka‐Jowabi lowo unegqita, nolileperi, nowayama ngomsimelelo, nowayo ngeṙele, noswele isonka.
Kwa njalo u‐Jowabi no‐Abishai umninawe wake bambulala u‐Abenere, ngenxa yokuba ebemfisile u‐Hasaheli umninawe wabo e‐Gibeyone ekulweni.
Wandula u‐Davide wati ku‐Jowabi, nakubo bonke abantu ababenaye: Ṙazulani ingubo zenu, nibinqe intlakantlaka, nimlilele u‐Abenere. Wasuka ukumkani u‐Davide wahamba emva kwetala.
Baza bamncw̔aba u‐Abenere e‐Hebrone: waye ukumkani wapakamisa ilizwi lake, walila ngasencw̔abeni lika‐Abenere; balila bonke abantu nabo.
Kekaloku ukumkani wenzela u‐Abenere isililo, wati: Wafa na u‐Abenere, njengokuba kusifa ibedengu?
Izandla zako bezingabotshwanga, nenyawo zako bezingafakwanga emakamandeleni obedu: njengowayo pambi kwonyana bobumenemene, wawa wena. Baza bonke abantu bandisa ukulila pezu kwake.

Bandula beza bonke abantu ukumdlisa u‐Davide isonka, nxa kuseko imini: kodwa wafunga u‐Davide, esiti: Utixo makenje njalo kum, alekele ukwenje njalo, ukuba nditi, lingekatshoni ilanga, ndive isonka umhlaumbi enye into yimbi.
Bati bonke abantu bakunakana oko, bekulungile emehlweni abo; njengokuba konke abekwenza ukumkani bekulungile emehlweni abantu bonke.
Baza bonke abantu, kwa bonke o‐Sirayeli, bazi ngalomhla, ukuba bekungavelanga kukumkani ukumnsa u‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere.
Wati ukumkani kanjalo kwizicaka zake: Anazi na ukuba iwile inkosi nendoda enkulu namhla nje kwa‐Sirayeli?
Nam ke, namhla ndibutataka, noko ndingukumkani otanjisiweyo; nalamadoda, onyana baka‐Tseruya, alukuni kum: uyehova uya kumvuza umenzi wenkohlakalo njengenkohlakalo yake.
WATI akuva unyana ka‐Saule ukuba u‐Abenere utile e‐Hebrone, zandula izandla zake zapolelwa, nabo bonke o‐Sirayeli betuswa.

Waye unyana ka‐Saule ebenamadoda mabini, inkosi zamabandla; igama lenye lalingu‐Bahana, negama lenye lalingu‐Rekabe, onyana baka‐Rimone um‐Berote, owosapo luka‐Benjamine: (ngokuba ne‐Berote ibibalelwa o‐Benjamine:
kanjalo ama‐Berote ebesabele e‐Gitayime, aba ngabasemzini kona kude kwanamhla nje.)

Waye u‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Saule, ebenonyana oqwalela ngenyawo: wabeyiminyaka mihlanu ubudala bake, nxa zibe zivela indaba ngaye u‐Saule no‐Jonatane e‐Yezerele; waza umondlikazi wake wamtabata, wesaba: kwaza kwati, akunxama ukusaba, wawa, waba sisiqwala. Laye igama lake lingu‐Mefiboshete.
Basuka bahamba onyana baka‐Rimone um‐Berote, u‐Rekabe no‐Bahana, beza endlwini ka‐Shiboshete yakufudumala imini: waye yena elele emandlalweni emini enkulu.
Baza bangena kona kude kwapakati kwendlu, njengokungati bebezeka inqolowa, bambeta esiswini: bati u‐Rekale no‐Bahana umzalwana wake basinda.
