Ngokuba, bakungena endlwini, ebelele yena pezu kwomandlalo wake enkambilini yake yokulala; bandula bambeta, bambulala, bamnqumla intloko, batabata intloko yake, bahamba ngendlela yetafa bonke ubusuku.

Baza bazisa intloko ka‐Shiboshete ku‐Davide e‐Hebrone, bati kukumkani: Nantsi intloko ka‐Shiboshete, unyana ka‐Saule, utshaba lwako, obefuna ubomi bako; kwa njalo uyehova wenzele inkosi yam ukumkani impindezelo namhla nje kuye u‐Saule nakuyo inzalo yake.
Koko u‐Davide wapendula u‐Rekabe no‐Bahana umzalwana wake, onyana baka‐Rimone um‐Berote, wati kubo: Ehleli nje uyehova, okululeyo umpefumlo wam kubo bonke ubunzima;
xeshekweni lowo owandixelela ngokuti: Bona ke, u‐Saule ufile; obenjengozisayo indaba ezilungileyo kwawake amehlo; ndambamba ke, ndambulala e‐Tsikilage; o beba ndiya kumnika umvuzo wendaba:
kwoba kangakananina ngakumbi, nxa amadoda akohlakeleyo abulele indoda elungileyo endlwini yayo pezu kwomandlalo wayo? ngako kaloku, andiyi kubiza na igazi layo ezandleni zenu, ndisuse nina emhlabeni?

Waza u‐Davide wayalela amadodana ake, aza ababulala, anqumla izandla zabo nenyawo zabo, abaxo̔ma ngasecibini e‐Hebrone: kodwa intloko ka‐Shiboshete ayitabata, ayincw̔aba encw̔abeni lika‐Abenere e‐Hebrone.
ZANDULA zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli zeza ku‐Davide e‐Hebrone, zatsho zisiti: Bona ke, silitambo lako nenyama yako tina.

Kanjako kwa ngapambili, xeshekweni u‐Saule abengukumkani pezu kwetu, ebenguwe owapumisa nowangenisa o‐Sirayeli; kanjalo uyehova wati kuwe: Wena uya kwalusa abantu bam o‐Sirayeli, wauya kuba yinkosi pezu kwo‐Sirayeli.
Ngako bonke abadala bo‐Sirayeli beza kukumkani e‐Hebrone; waye ukumkani u‐Davide wenza ucebano nabo e‐Hebrone ebusweni bukayehova; baza bamtambisa u‐Davide abe ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli.
Waye u‐Davide ebeyiminyaka imashumi matatu ubudala bake, akuba ngukumkani; wapata ubukumkani iminyaka yamashumi mane.
E‐Hebrone wapata ubukumkani pezu kwo‐Juda iminyaka isixe̔nxe nenyanga zintandatu; nase‐Yerusaleme wapata ubukumkani iminyaka yamashumi matatu anamitatu pezu kwabo bonke o‐Sirayeli no‐Juda.

Waza waya ukumkani namadoda ake e‐Yerusaleme kuwo ama‐Yebusi, abemi belozwe: atsho ke ku‐Davide esiti: Akuyi kungena apa, ungekazikwelelisanga imfama neziqwala; oko kukuti: u‐Davide akayi kungena apa.
Wati u‐Davide noko wati̔mba inqaba ye‐Ziyone, ekwa siso isixeko sika‐Davide.

Wayesiti u‐Davide ngalomhla: Osukuba ebeta ama‐Yebusi, afikelele emjelweni, abete nemfama neziqwala ezitiywayo ngumpefumlo ka‐Davide, kwa yena uya kuba yintloko nenkosi. Ngako oko bekutiwa: Oyimfama nosisiqwala akayi kungena endlwini.
Wandula u‐Davide wahlala enqatyeni, wayibiza ngokuti sisixeko sika‐Davide. Waza u‐Davide waka ngokungqonga, kutabata e‐Milo nangapakati.
Waye u‐Davide wamana ehambisa, waba mkulu; ngokuba uyehova, utixo wemikosi, ebenaye.
Kanjalo u‐Hirame, ukumkani we‐Tire, watuma izigidimi ku‐Davide, nemiti yesedare, nencibi zemiti, nencibi zamatye zodonga; zaye zimakela u‐Davide indlu.
Waza wanakana u‐Davide ukuba uyehova ebemqinisile ukuba ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, nokuba ebepakamisile ubukumkani bake ngenxa yabantu bake o‐Sirayeli.
Walekela u‐Davide ukuzeka amashweshwe nabafazi e‐Yerusaleme, emveni kwokuvela kwake e‐Hebrone; kwaza kwamzalelwa u‐Davide kanjako onyana nentombi.
Nanga amagama abo ababemzalelwa e‐Yerusaleme: u‐Shamuha, no‐Shobabe, no‐Natane, no‐Solomone,
no‐Yibare, no‐Elishuba, no‐Nefege, no‐Yafiha,
no‐Elishama, no‐Eliyada, no‐Elifelete.
Kwati kwakuviwa ngama‐Filistiya ukuba bamtambisile u‐Davide abe ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, andula enyuka onke ama‐Filistiya ukuya kumfuna u‐Davide. Waza u‐Davide, akuva oko, wehla waya enqatyeni.
Ada eza ama‐Filistiya, azitwabulula emhlanjeni wama‐Rafa.

Waza u‐Davide wabuza kuyehova, esiti: Ndiya kunyuka na ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya? wowanikela esandleni sam na? Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Davide: Nyuka; ngokuba ngenyaniso ndiya kunikela ama‐Filistiya esandleni sako.

Wandula u‐Davide weza e‐Bali‐peratsime; wawabeta kona u‐Davide, wati: Uyehova utyobozele ezintshabeni zam ebusweni bam njengesityobozelo samanzi. Ngako oko kwabizwa igama lalondawo ngokuti yi‐Bali‐peratsime.
Ayeshiya kona amadalo awo; baza u‐Davide namadoda ake bawasusa.
Apinda kanjako ama‐Filistiya ukunyuka, azitwabulula emhlanjeni wama‐Rafa.
Waza u‐Davide wabuza kuyehova, owati: Akuyi kunyuka; kodwa zekelela ukuya ngasemva kwawo, uwafikele malungana nemiti yebaka.
Kwakuya kuti, nxa uvayo isandi sokuhanjwa ezincameni zemiti yebaka, wandule unxame; ngokuba oko uyehova esel’ epumile pambi kwako, ukubeta umkosi wama‐Filistiya.
Wenje njalo u‐Davide, njengokuba uyehova ebemyalele; wabeta ama‐Filistiya kwa se‐Geba kude kwafikwa e‐Gezere.
WABUYA wahlanganisa u‐Davide bonke abanyuliweyo bakwa‐Sirayeli, bengamawaka amashumi matatu.
Wayesuka u‐Davide, wemka nabantu bonke ababenaye e‐Bahale‐juda, uku nyusa kwa kona ityeya katixo, ekupezu kwayo igama libizwayo, igama likayehova wemikosi, ohlala pakati kwekerubime.
Baza bakwelisa ityeya katixo enqwelweni entsha, bayisusa endlwini ka‐Abinadabi, ebise‐Gibeha: bati u‐Huza no‐Ahiyo, onyana baka‐Abinadabi, babexesha lonqwelo entsha.
Kekaloku bakuyisusa endlwini ka‐Abinadabi, ebise‐Gibeha, kunye netyeya katixo, waza u‐Ahiyo wahamba pambi kwetyeya.

Bandula u‐Davide nayo yonke indlu ka‐Sirayeli badlala ebusweni bukayehova, ngezinto zonke zokuculisa ezenziweyo ngemiti yeberoshe, kwa ngehadi, nangenebele, nangentambula, nangezikencezelo, nangesimbali.
Kwati kwakufikwa esibayeni sokubula sika‐Nakone, waza u‐Huza wasolula isandla sake ngakuyo ityeya katixo, wayibamba; ngokuba inkabi beziku̔beka.
Yandula ingqumbo kayehova yavuta ngakuye u‐Huza; waye utixo wambeta kona ngenxa yesiposo eso; waza wafa kwa kona ngasetyeyeni katixo.
Wasuka waqumba u‐Davide ngenxa yokuba uyehova ebenzile isityobozelo pezu kwo‐Huza; ngako wayibiza londawo ngokuti yi‐Peretse‐huza, kude kwanamhla nje.
Waza u‐Davide wamoyika uyehova ngalomini, wayesiti: Yotiwa nina ukuza kum ityeya kayehova?
Ngako u‐Davide ebengavumi ukuba ityeya kayehova ipanjukiselwe kuye esixekweni sika‐Davide; kodwa u‐Davide wayishenxisela endlwini ka‐Obedi‐edome um‐Gate.
Yaye ityeya kayehova ihleli endlwini ka‐Obedi‐edome um‐Gate inyangazantatu: waza uyehova watamsanqela u‐Obedi‐edome, nayo yonke indlu yake.

Kwaza kwaxelwa kukumkani u‐Davide, kusitwa: Uyehova utamsanqele indlu ka‐Obedi‐edome, nako konke anako, ngenxa yetyeya katixo. Waza u‐Davide waya wenyusa ityeya katixo endlwini ka‐Obedi‐edome, wayizisa esixekweni sika‐Davide ngovuyo.
Kwaye kute, xeshekweni abo batwala ityeya kayehova bebehambile amanyatela amatandatu, wandula wabingelela inkabi nenkomo ezityetyisiweyo.
Waye u‐Davide waduda ngawo onke amandla ake ebusweni bukayehova: kanjako u‐Davide wabinqwa ngeyefodi yeqiya.
Kwa njalo u‐Davide nayo yonke indlu ka‐Sirayeli benyusa ityeya kayehova, ngokumemeza, nangentlokoma yexilongo.

Kwaza kwati, yakufika ityeya kayehova esixekweni sika Davide, u‐Mikali, intombi ka‐Saule, wakangela ngefenstile, wabona ukumkani u‐Davide exu̔ma eduda nokududa ebusweni bukayehova; wandula wamdela entliziyweni yake.
Baza bangenisa ityeya kayehova, bayimisa endaweni yayo, pakati kwentente ebe yolulelwe yona ngu‐Davide: wati u‐Davide wanikela amadini okutshiswa neminikelo yoxolo ebusweni bukayehova.
Xeshekweni u‐Davide abegqibile ukunikela amadini okutshiswa neminikelo yoxolo, wandula wabatamsanqelisa abantu egameni likayehova wemikosi.

Kanjalo wabela kubo bonke abantu, kuso sonke isihlwele sama‐Sirayeli, kwa kuwo amadoda nakubo abafazi, kwabanye ngabanye isimbana lesonka, nesiqendu senyama, negubu leveyine. Bada bemka bonke abantu baya abanye ngabanye ezindlwini zabo.

Wandula wabuya u‐Davide ukuya kutamsanqelisa indlu yake. Waza wapuma u‐Mikali, intombi ka‐Saule, ukuza kumkaulela u‐Davide, wati: Hai ukubekeka kwokumkani wo‐Sirayeli namhla, obezihluba namhla emehlweni ezicakakazi zezicaka zake, njengokuba omnye wabantu abangendawo ezihluba ekuhleni!

Kodwa u‐Davide wati ku‐Mikali: Ebusweni bukayehova, ondinyulileyo pezu kwoyihlo, napezu kwayo yonke indlu yake, ukundimisa inkosi pezu kwabantu bakayehova, pezu kwo‐Sirayeli; ewe, ebusweni bukayehova ndiya kudlala:
ndandiya kudeleka ngakumbi pezu kwoku, ndibe yinto etobekileyo emehlweni am; napakati kwezicakakazi obuteta ngazo, pakati kwazo ndiya kubekeka.
Ngako u‐Mikali, intombi ka‐Saule, wayengenamntwana kwada kwakuwo umhla wokufa kwake.
KWABEKUTE, nxa ukumkani abehleli endlwini yake, akuba uyehova ebemnikile ukupumla ngento engqongayo kuzo zonke intshaba zake;
wandula ukumkani wati ku‐Natane umprofite: Kangela ke, mna ndihleli endlwini yesedare, kodwa ityeya kayehova ihleli pakati kwezikuselo.
Waza u‐Natane wati kukumkani: Hamba, ukwenze konke okusentliziyweni yako; ngokuba uyehova enawe.
Kwaye kute ngobobusuku, kweza ilizwi likayehova ku‐Natane, lisiti:
Hamba uti kuso isicaka sam, ku‐Davide: Utsho uyehova ukuti: Kanene wena uya kundakela indlu yokuhlala kwam na?
Ngokuba ndingahlalanga endlwini, kwa semhleni ndabendinyusa usapo luka‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete, kwada kwanamhla nje, koko ndihambile ententeni nasetabanakeleni.

Kuzo zonke indawo apo ndihambile kona pakati kwalo lwonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli, ndike ndateta ilizwi na kwesinye sezizwe zo‐Sirayeli, endibe ndiziyalele ukwalusa abantu bam o‐Sirayeli, ndisiti: Yinina ukuba anindakeli indlu yesedare?
Ngako kaloku, uya kutsho kwisicaka sam, ku‐Davide, ukuti: Utsho uyehova wemikosi ukuti: Mna ndakutabata esibayeni, kwa sekulandeleni igusha, ukuba ube yinkosi pezu kwabantu bam, pezu kwo‐Sirayeli:
ndabendiko nawe kuzo zonke indawo apo ubuhamba kona, nazo zonke intshaba zako ndizinqamlile ebusweni bako; kanjalo ndikwenzele igama elikulu, njengegama labakulu abasemhlabeni:
ndandiya kumisela abantu bam o‐Sirayeli indawo, ndibatyale, baze beme endaweni yabo, bangabi sazanyazanyiswa; kanjalo usapo lwobumenemene aluyi kubuya lubabandezele, njengasekuqaleni,
nakuselokwalomhla ndabendimisa abagwebi pezu kwabantu bam o‐Sirayeli; nawe ndikupumzile kuzo zonke intshaba zako. Kanjako uyehova uyashumayela kuwe, okokuba uyehova uya kukwenzela indlu.
Xeshekweni imihla yako izalisekile, yokuba uya kulala noyihlo bako, ndiya kwandula ndivuse owenzalo yako emva kwako, oya kuvela ematunjini ako, ndiqinise ubukumkani bake.
Nguye oya kulakela igama lam indlu, ndandiya kuqinisa iterone yake kude kube ngunapakade.
Mna ndiya kuba nguyise kuye, naye woba ngunyana kum. Ukuba uyenza ngobugwenxa, ndiya kumohlwaya ngoswazi lwabantu, nangezibeto zonyana babantu:
kodwa ububele bam abuyi kumka kuye, njengokuba bendibususa ku‐Saule, lowo bendimsusa kwa pambi kwako.
Kwoba kunqabile indlu yako nobukumkani bako kude kube ngunapakade pambi kwako: iterone yako iya kuqiniswa kude kube ngunapakade.
Ngawo onke lamazwi, nangawo wonke lomboniso, wateta u‐Natane ngokunjalo ku‐Davide.
Wandula ukumkani u‐Davide wangena wahlala ebusweni bukayehova, wati: Ndingubanina mna, Nkosi, Yehova? iyinto nina nendlu yam, ukuba undizisile kude kwalapa?
Oku bekusencinane noko emehlweni ako, Nkosi, Yehova! ngokuba utetile kanjalo ngayo indlu yesicaka sako kude kube kude. Eli ke lisiko labantu na, Nkosi, Yehova?
Yinto nina angasalekela u‐Davide ukuyiteta kuwe? ngokuba wena, Nkosi, Yehova! usazi isicaka sako.
Ngenxa yelizwi lako, nangokweyako intliziyo, wenzile zonke ezizinto ezinkulu, ukuba uzazise kuso isicaka sako.
Ngako oko wena umkulu, Yehova, Tixo! ngokuba kungeko onjengawe, kanjako akuko utixo ngapandle kwako, njengako konke esikuvileyo ngendlebe zetu.

Kanjalo sisipina isizwe sinye emhlabeni esinjengabantu bako, njengo‐Sirayeli; owati utixo waya ukubakulula babe ngabantu kuye, nokuzimisela igama, nokunenzela nina izinto ezinkulu nezoyikekayo elizweni lako, pambi kwabantu bako, obuzikululela bona e‐Jipete, ebagxota abaheyideni notixo babo?
Wabuziqinisela abantu bako o‐Sirayeli ukuba ngabantu bako kude kube ngunapakade; nawe, Yehova! waba ngutixo wabo.
Ngako kaloku, Yehova, Tixo! elolizwi ulitetileyo ngaso isicaka sako, nangayo indlu yaso, ulimise kude kube ngunapakade, wenze njengokuba utetile.
Malenziwe likulu igama lako kude kube ngunapakade, kuze kutiwe: Uyehova wemikosi u ngutixo pezu kwo‐Sirayeli; nendlu yesicaka sako u‐Davide, maiqiniswe ebusweni bako.
Ngokuba wena, Yehova wemikosi, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! utyilele indlebe yesicaka sako, usiti: Ndiya kukwakela indlu; ngako oko isicaka sako sifumene entliziyweni yaso ukutandaza lomtandazo kuwe.
Nakaloku, Nkosi, Yehova! wena unguye utixo, namazwi ako ayinyaniso; nezizinto ezilungileyo uzitetile ngaso isicaka sako:

ngako kaloku makukoleke kuwe ukutamsanqela indlu yesicaka sako, ukuba ibeko ebusweni bako kude kube ngunapakade; ngokuba wena, Nkosi, Yehova! utetile; nangetamsanqeliso lako iya kutanyusanqelwa indlu yesicaka sako kude kube ngunapakade.
KWABEKUTE emveni kwoku, ukuba u‐Davide wabeta ama‐Filistiya, wawatobisa; waza u‐Davide watabata i‐Metege‐ama esandleni sama‐Filistiya.

Wabeta nama‐Mowabi, wawalinganisa ngentambo, ewalalisa ngasemhlabeni; walinganisa ngentambo ezimbini zokuba kufiswe, nangentambo ezeleyo yokuba kulondolozwe ebomini: aza ama‐Mowabi aba ngabakonzi ku‐Davide, asa iminikelo.
Waza u‐Davide wabeta u‐Hadadezere, unyana ka‐Rebobi, ukumkani we‐Tsoba, ekuhambeni kwake ukuya kubuyisa amandla ake ngasemlanjeni wom‐Ferate.

Waye u‐Davide watimba kuye iwaka lenqwelwana, namakulu asixe̔nxe abakweli bamahashe, namawaka angamashumi mabini abahamba ngenyawo; waza u‐Davide wawasika umbotshwa onke amahashe enqwelwana; kodwa wasalisa kuwo a wenqwelwana zalikulu.
Kekaloku ama‐Siriya ase Damakusi eza ukumnceda u‐Hadadezere ukumkani we‐Tsoba; waza u‐Davide wabulala kuwo ama‐Siriya amadoda angamawaka angamashumi mabini anamabini.
Wandula u‐Davide wazibeka ilali e‐Siriya yase‐Damakusi; ati ama‐Siriya aba ngabakonzi ku‐Davide, asa iminikelo. Kwa njalo uyehova wamnceda u‐Davide apo kusukuba ebesiya kona.
Wayetabata u‐Davide amakaka egolide abekuzo izicaka zika‐Hadadezere, wawazisa e‐Yerusaleme.
Waye ukumkani u‐Davide kanjalo wayisusa e‐Beta, nase‐Berotai, izixeko zika‐Hadadezere, ixina, into eninzi kakulu.
Kekaloku kwakuviwa ngu‐Tohi ukumkani we‐Hamati, ukuba u‐Davide ubetile wonke umkosi ka‐Hadadezere,

wandula u‐Tohi watuma u‐Yorame unyana wake ukuya kukumkani u‐Davide, ukumbulisa, nokumtamsanqelisa, ngenxa yokuba ebelwile ngakuye u‐Hadadezere wambeta; (ngokuba u‐Tohi ebenzile imfazwe no‐Hadadezere;) nasesandleni sake beziko impahla zesilivere, nempahla zegolide, nempahla zexina.
Ezi nazo ukumkani u‐Davide wazenza ngcwele kuyehova, kunye nesilivere negolide abezenze ngcwele zivela kuzo zonke intlanga ezibe zoyisiwe nguye:
kuwo ama‐Siriya, nakuwo ama‐Mowabi, nakulo usapo luka‐Hamoni, nakuwo ama‐Filistiya, nakuwo ama‐Amaleki, nakuwo amaxoba ka‐Hadadezere, unyana ka‐Rehobi, ukumkani we‐Tsoba.
Wandula u‐Davide wazenzela igama, akubuya ekuwabulaleni ama‐Siriya emhlanjeni we‐Tyuwa, amawaka alishumi elinesibozo.
Waza wazibeka ilali e‐Edome; kuyo yonke i‐Edome wazibeka ilali; ada onke ama‐Edome aba ngabakonzi ku‐Davide. Kwa njalo uyehova wamnceda u‐Davide apo kusukuba ebesiya kona.
Waye u‐Davide wapata ubukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke; kanjako u‐Davide wenzela bonke abantu bake ubugwebo nobulungisa.
Kekaloku u‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya wabepezu kwomkosi; no‐Yehoshafate unyana ka‐Ahilude ebengumkumbuzi:
kanjako u‐Tsadoki unyana ka‐Ahitube, no‐Ahimeleki unyana ka‐Abiyatare, bebengabaperisite; no‐Seraya ebengumba̔li;
no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada wabepezu kwaba‐Kereti naba‐Peleti; nonyana baka‐Davide bebengamanene.
WAYESITI u‐Davide: Kuseko na oseleyo kwindlu ka‐Saule, ukuze ndimenzele ububele ngenxa ka‐Jonatane?
Kwabekuko isicaka sendlu ka‐Saule, esigama belingu‐Tsiba; baza bambiza eze ku‐Davide. Wandula ukumkani wati kuye: Wena ungu‐Tsiba na? Wayesiti: Isicaka sako singuye.
Waza ukumkani wati: Akuseko na umntu wendlu ka‐Saule, ukuba ndimenzele ububele bukatixo? Wati u‐Tsiba kukumkani: Kuseko unyana ka‐Jonatane, oqwalelayo ngenyawo.
Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Upina yena? Wati u‐Tsiba kukumkani: Bona ke, usendlwini ka‐Makire, unyana ka Hamiyeli, e‐Lo‐debare.
Wandula watuma ukumkani u‐Davide, wamtabata endlwini ka‐Makire, unyana ka‐Hamiyeli, e‐Lo‐debare.
Wati akufika u‐Mefiboshete, unyana ka‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Saule, ku‐Davide, wandula wawa ebusweni bake, waziqubuda. Wayesiti u‐Davide: Mefiboshete! Wati yena: Nasi isicaka sako!

Waza u‐Davide wati kuye: Ungoyiki; ngokuba ndiya kukwenzela ububele ngenyaniso, ngenxa ka‐Jonatane uyihlo, ndibuyisele kuwe onke amasimi ka‐Saule uyihlo; nawe uya kumana ukudla isonka ngasetafileni yam.
Wasuka wazitoba, wati: Isicaka sako siyinto nina, ukuba ubeke kuyo inja efileyo enjengam?
Wandula ukumkani wambiza u‐Tsiba, isicaka sika‐Saule, wati kuye: Konke okube kukokuka‐Saule, nokwayo yonke indlu yake, ndikunikile kunyana wenkosi yako.

Ngako uya kumlimela umhlaba, wena nonyana bako, nezicaka zako, ungenise iziqa̔mo, ukuze unyana wenkosi yako abe nesonka, ukuba adle; kodwa u‐Mefiboshete, unyana wenkosi yako, womana ukudla isonka ngasetafileni yam. Kekaloku u‐Tsiba ebenonyana balishumi elinabahlanu, nezicaka zamashumi mabini.

Waza u‐Tsiba wati kukumkani: Njengako konke inkosi yam ukumkani isiyalele isicaka sayo, siya kwenje njalo isicaka sako. Kanjalo u‐Mefiboshete, watsho ukumkani, esidla ngasetafileni yam, woba njengomnye wonyana bokumkani.
Waye u‐Mefiboshete enonyana omncinane, ogama belingu‐Mika. Kanjako bonke ababehlala endlwini ka‐Tsiba, bebezizicaka kuye u‐Mefiboshete.
Kwa njalo u‐Mefiboshete wahlala e‐Yerusaleme; ngokuba ebemana ukudla ngasetafileni yokumkani: wayesisiqwala ngenyawo zake zombini.
KWAYE kute emveni kwoku, ukuba ukumkani wosapo luka‐Hamoni wabuba; waza u‐Hanune unyana wake waba ngukumkani esikundleni sake.

Wandula u‐Davide wati: Ndiya kwenza ububele ku‐Hanune unyana ka‐Nahashe, njengokuba uyise ebebenza ububele kum. Waza u‐Davide watuma ngesandla sezicaka zake ukumku̔za ngaye uyise. Zada izicaka zika‐Davide zafika ezweni losapo luka‐Hamoni.

Koko inkosana zosapo luka‐Hamoni zati ku Hanune inkosi yazo: u‐Davide uyambeka na uyihlo emehlweni ako, ngokuba ebatumele kuwe abaku̔zi? akungenxa yokuba apengulule isixeko esi, asihlole, asicite, ukuba u‐Davide uzitumile izicaka zake kuwe kusinina?
Ngako u‐Hanune watabata izicaka zika‐Davide, waguya isiqingata sendevu zazo, watsheca izivato zazo ngokuziqingatisa ezinyongeni zazo, wazindulula.
Kwati kwakuxelelwa u‐Davide, watuma ukuzikaulela; ngokuba amadoda lawo ebehlazisiwe kakulu. Wayesiti ukumkani: Hlalani e‐Jeriko, zide zikule indevu zenu, nandule nibuye.

Kekaloku lwakubona usapo luka‐Hamoni ukuba lunukele u‐Davide, lwandula lwatuma usapo luka‐Hamoni lwaqesha kuma‐Siriya ase‐Bete‐rehobi, nakuma‐Siriya ase‐Tsoba, amawaka angamashumi mabini abahamba ngenyawo, nakuye ukumkani we‐Mahaka iwaka lamadoda, nakuwo amadoda ase‐Tobe amawaka alishumi linamabini amadoda.
Wati u‐Davide akuva oku, watuma u‐Jowabi nawo wonke umkosi wamagoṙa.
Lwaza lwapuma usapo luka‐Hamoni, lwacwangcisela ukulwa ngasemnyango wesango; kodwa ama‐Siriya ase‐Tsoba nawase‐Rehobi, namadoda ase‐Tobe nawase‐Mahaka, ebewodwa ngasendle.
Wati u‐Jowabi, akubona ukuba ubuso bokulwa bungakuye, ngapambili nangasemva, wanyula abantu kubo bonke abanyuliweyo bakwa‐Sirayeli, wabacwangcisa ngakuwo ama‐Siriya:
nesisalela sabantu wabanikela esandleni sika‐Abishai umninawe wake, owabacwangcisa ngakulo usapo luka‐Hamoni.
Wayesiti: Ukuba ama‐Siriya anamandla pezu kwam, woza ukunceda mna; kodwa ukuba usapo luka‐Hamoni lunamandla pezu kwako, ndoya ukunceda wena.
Yomelela, sizomelezele abantu betu nezixeko zotixo wetu; noyehova makenze okulungileyo emehlweni ake.
Waza wasondela u‐Jowabi, nabantu ababenaye, kuze kuliwe ngakuwo ama‐Siriya; ada esaba pambi kwake.
Lwati lwakubona usapo luka‐Hamoni ukuba ama‐Siriya esabile, lwandula lwesaba nalo pambi kwo‐Abishai, lwangena esixekweni. Waza u‐Jowabi wabuya kulo usapo luka‐Hamoni, waya e‐Yerusaleme.
Xeshekweni ama‐Siriya abebona ukuba oyisiwe pambi kwama‐Sirayeli, andula azihlanganisa ndawonye.
Waza watuma u‐Hadarezere, wapumisa ama‐Siriya abepesheya kwomlambo; asuka eza e‐Helame; wati u‐Shovaki, inkosi yempi ka‐Hadarezere, waya pambi kwawo.
Kwati kwakuxelelwa u‐Davide, wahlanganisa onke ama‐Sirayeli, wawela i‐Yoredane, weza e‐Helame. Aza ama‐Siriya azicwangcisa ngakuye u‐Davide, alwa naye.

Kodwa ama‐Siriya esaba pambi kwama‐Sirayeli; waza u‐Davide wabulala kuwo ama‐Siriya amadoda enqwelwana ezingamakulu asixe̔nxe, nabakweli bamahashe abangamawaka angamashumi mane; wambeta no‐Shovaki, inkosi yempi yawo, owafa kona.

Bati bakubona bonke okumkani abazizicaka zika‐Hadarezere, ukuba boyisiwe pambi kwama‐Sirayeli, bandula benza uxolo nama‐Sirayeli, bawakonza. Ngako ama‐Siriya ebesoyika ukulunceda kanjako usapo laka‐Hamoni.

KWABEKUTE ekutwaseni kwomnyaka, ngexesha lokupuma kwabo okumkani, wandula u‐Davide watuma u‐Jowabi, nezicaka zake kunye naye, nawo onke ama‐Sirayeli, ukuya kutshabalalisa usapo luka‐Hamoni, nokuvingcela i‐Raba. Kodwa u‐Davide wasala e‐Yerusaleme.

Kwaza kwati ngexesha lokuhlwa, wesuka u‐Davide emandlalweni wake, wahamba pezu kwesifulelwa sendlu yokumkani; wati esesifulelweni wabona umfazi ezihlamba: kekaloku umfazi lowo ebemhle kakulu ukubonakala kwake.
Waza watuma u‐Davide, wabuza ngalomfazi. Kwaye kusitwa: Lo asi nguye na u‐Batesheba, intombi ka‐Elihame, umfazi ka‐Huriya um‐Hete?
Wandula u‐Davide watuma izigidimi, wamtabata; wati akungena kuye, walala naye; ngokuba ebezihlambulule ekunco̔leni kwake: wada wabuyela endlwini yake.
Waza wakaula umfazi lowo, watuma wamxelela u‐Davide, wati: Mna ndikaulile.
Wandula u‐Davide watuma ku‐Jowabi, esiti: Tuma kum u‐Huriya um‐Hete. Waza u‐Jowabi wamtuma u‐Huriya ku‐Davide.
Wati akutika u‐Huriya kuye, wabuza u‐Davide ngokupila kuka‐Jowabi, nangokupila kwabantu, nangokuhambiseka kwokulwa.
Waza wati u‐Davide ku‐Huriya: Yihla uye endlwini yako, uhlambe inyawo zako. Kwati kwakupuma u‐Huriya endlwini yokumkani, kwapuma emva kwake isabelwa sokutya kukumkani.
Kodwa u‐Huriya walala ngasemnyango wendlu yokumkani, ndawonye nazo zonke izicaka zenkosi yake; akehlela endlwini yake.
Kwati kwakuxelwa ku‐Davide, kusitwa: u‐Huriya akehlelanga endlwini yake; wati u‐Davide ku‐Huriya: Ubungaveli ekuhambeni na? yinina ukuba akuhlelanga endlwini yako?

Wayesiti u‐Huriya ku‐Davide: Ityeya, no‐Sirayeli, no‐Juda, bahleli ezintenteni; kanjalo inkosi yam u‐Jowabi, nezicaka zenkosi yam, zite waca ezindle; kanene mna ndiya kungena endlwini yam na, ndidle, ndisele, ndilale nomfazi wam? Njengokuba uhleli wena, na njengokuba uhleli umpefumlo wako, andiyi kuyenza lento.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Huriya: Hlala apa nanamhla, ndandiya kukundulula ngomso. Kwa njalo wahlala u‐Huriya e‐Yerusaleme ngomhla lowo, nangomhla olandelayo.

Wati akuba u‐Davide ebemmemile, wadla ebusweni bake, wasela nokusela; wada wamnxilisa: waza wapuma ngokuhlwa ukuya kulala emandlalweni wake ndawonye nezicaka zenkosi yake; kodwa akehlela endlwini yake.
Kwaye kute kusasa, waba̔la u‐Davide incwadi ku‐Jowabi, wayituma ngesandla sika‐Huriya.
Waba̔la encwadini leyo, esiti: Beka u‐Huriya ngasebusweni bokulwa okunamandla, nize nibuye emva kwake, ukuba abetwe, afe nokufa.
Kwabekute, xeshekweni u‐Jowabi abegqalile isixeko, wammisa u‐Huriya kulondawo apo abesazi ukuba amadoda obuṙoti akona.
Asuka apuma amadoda esixeko, alwa no‐Jowabi; kwaza kwawa inxenye yabantu ezicakeni zika‐Davide; wafa u‐Huriya um‐Hete naye.
Wandula watuma u‐Jowabi, washumayela ku‐Davide zonke indawo zokulwa;
wayalela isigidimi ngokuti: Nxa ugqibile ukuteta zonke indawo zokulwa kuye ukumkani,
kwoti ke, ukuba umsindo wokumkani uya kuvuka, aze ati kuwe: Yinina ukuba nasondela esixekweni ukulwa? anazi na ukuba baya kutola beseludongeni?

ngubanina owambeta u‐Abimeleki unyana ka‐Yerubeshete? ebengengumfazi na owaposa pezu kwake ilitye lapezulu lokusila kwa seludongeni, wada wafa e‐Tebetse? bekunganina ukuba nasondela kulo udonga? wandule uti: Kanjako isicaka sako, u‐Huriya um‐Hete, sifile.
Sahamba ke isigidimi eso, seza samshumayeza u‐Davide konke u‐Jowabi abesitumile ngako.
Saye sisiti isigidimi ku‐Davide: Ngenyaniso amadoda lawo ebenamandla pezu kwetu, apumela kuti ezindle; saye sipezu kwawo kwada kwasemnyango wesango:
bati abatoli batola ngakuzo izicaka zako beseludongeni; yaza yafa inxenye yezicaka zokumkani; kanjako isicaka sako, u‐Huriya um‐Hete, sifile naso.

Wandula u‐Davide wati kuso isigidimi: Uya kutsho ku‐Jowabi ukuti: Lendawo maingabi ikohlakele emehlweni ako, ngokuba iṙele lisidla naló kwa njengalowo; yomeleza ukulwa kwako ngakuso isixeko, usicite: uti wena umomeleze.
Wati akuva umfazi ka‐Huriya ukuba u‐Huriya, indoda yake, ufile, wandula wayililela inkosi yake.
Naxeshekweni isililo sidlulileyo, watuma u‐Davide, wamamkela endlwini yake; waza waba ngumfazi wake, wamzalela unyana. Kodwa lendawo, abeyenzile u‐Davide, ibikohlakele emehlweni kayehova.
Wandula uyehova wamtuma u‐Natane ku‐Davide. Waza wangena kuye, wati kuye: Kwabekuko amadoda amabini esixekweni sinye, enye ibisisityebi, enye ibilihlwempu.
Esisityebi ibinegusha nenkomo, into eninzi kakulu:

kodwa elihlwempu ibingenanto, kupela yanetakanekazi legusha linye elincinane, ebilitengile, nebilipilisile, lada laba likulu kuyo nakubo abantwana bayo kunye; ladla kumtamo wayo, lasela kwindebe yayo, lalala esifubeni sayo, laba njengentombi kuyo.

Kwaza kwafika umhambi kuyo indoda esisityebi, eyayeka ukutabata kwigusha zayo nakwinkomo zayo, ukuba ipekele umhambi obefikile kuyo, kodwa yatabata itakanekazi lendoda elihlwempu, yalipekela indoda ebifikile kuyo.
Yaza yavuta ingqumbo ka‐Davide ngakuyo indoda leyo kakulu; wayesiti ku‐Natane: Ehleli nje uyehova, indoda eyenzileyo lento imelwe kukufa!
netakanekazi elo yolibuyekeza ngokukane, ngenxa yokuba iyenzile lento, nangenxa yokuba ibingenanceba.
Wandula u‐Natane wati ku‐Davide: Nguwe indoda leyo. Utsho uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ukuti: Ndikutambisile ube ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, ndakuhlangula esandleni sika‐Saule;

kanjalo ndikunikile indlu yenkosi yako, nabafazi benkosi yako esifubeni sako; ewe ndikunikile indlu ka‐Sirayeli neka‐Juda; nokuba kube kuncinane oko, ngendizongezelele kuwe izinto ezinjengezi nezinjengeziya.

Yinina ukuba udelile ilizwi likayehova, ngokwenza okukohlakeleyo emehlweni ake? u‐Huriya um‐Hete umbetile ngeṙele, nomfazi wake umtabatile abe ngumfazi wako; ewe yena umbulele ngeṙele losapo luka‐Hamoni.
Ngako kaloku, iṙele aliyi kupambuka endlwini yako kude kube ngunapakade; ngenxa yokuba undidelile mna, nokuba umtabatile umfazi ka‐Huriya um‐Hete abe ngumfazi wako.

Utsho uyehova ukuti: Bona ke, ndiya kuvusa ngakuwe ububi buvela endlwini yako, ndandiya kutabata abafazi bako pambi kwamehlo ako, ndibanike kummelwane wako, oya kulala nabafazi bako pambi kwamehlo elanga eli.
Ngokuba wena ubusenza oko ngasese; kodwa mna ndiya kuyenza lento pambi kwabo bonke o‐Sirayeli, napambi kwelanga.
Wandula u‐Davide wati ku‐Natane: Ndonile ngakuye uyehova. Waza u‐Natane wati ku‐Davide: Kanjako uyehova ususile isono sako; akuyi kufa.
Kodwa, ngenxa yokuba uzenzile intshaba zikayehova zigxeke kakulu ngalento, kanjalo unyana ozelweyo kuwe uya kufa ngenyaniso.
Wemka u‐Natane waya endlwini yake. Waza uyehova wambeta umntwana obezalelwe u‐Davide ngumfazi ka‐Huriya, ukuba wabesifa kakulu.
Ngako u‐Davide wamfuna utixo ngenxa yomntwana lowo; waza u‐Davide wenza inzilo, wangena, walala ubusuku bonke emhlabeni.
Bandula besuka abadala bendlu yake, baya kuye, ukuze bamsukise emhlabeni; kodwa ebengavumi, ebengadli isonka nabo kanjako.

Kwaye kute ngomhla wesixe̔nxe ukuba umntwana wabuba. Zaza izicaka zika‐Davide zoyika ukumxelela ukuba umntwana ufile; ngokuba bezisiti: Bona ke, nxa umntwana asahleli, sateta naye, kodwa ebengapulapuli ilizwi letu; soti nina ke ukuti kuye: Umntwana ufile? ngokuba eya kuzenzakalisa.
Kodwa akubona u‐Davide ukuba izicaka zake bezisebezelana, wandula u‐Davide waqonda ukuba umntwana ufile; ngako u‐Davide wati kuzo izicaka zake: Ufile na umntwana? Zati: Ufile.
Waza u‐Davide wesuka emhlabeni, wazihlamba, wazitambisa, waguqula izivato zake, wangena endlwini kayehova, wabedesha: wandula wangena endlwini yake; wati akucela, wabekelwa isonka, wadla ke.
Zaza izicaka zake zati kuye: Yinina lento oyenzileyo? ngenxa yomntwana ehleli nje ubuzila ukutya, walila nokulila; kodwa akuba umntwana efile, ubusuka wadla isonka.
Wayesiti: Nxa umntwana asahleli, ndazila ukutya, ndalila nokulila, ngokuba ndibe ndisiti: Ngubanina owaziyo? angati uyehova abe nofefe kum, ukuba umntwana apile.
Kodwa ngoku efile nje, sendiya kuzilela nina? ndingaba nokumbuyisa kanjako na? ndiya kuya kuye, kodwa yena akayi kubuyela kum.
Wandula u‐Davide wamtutuzela u‐Batesheba umfazi wake, wangena kuye, walala naye; wazala unyana ke; waza wabiza igama lake ngo‐Solomone: wati uyehova wamtanda;
watuma ngesandla sika‐Natane umprofite, owabiza igama lake ngo‐Yedidiya, ngenxa kayehova.
Kekaloku u‐Jowabi walwa ngakuyo i‐Raba yosapo luka‐Hamoni, wasitimba isixeko sobukumkani.
Waza u‐Jowabi watuma izigidimi ku‐Davide, wati: Ndilwile ngakuyo i‐Raba, kanjako ndisitimbile isixeko samanzi:
ngako kaloku, hlanganisa isisalela sabantu, usiṙaule isixeko, usitimbe; hleze ndiya kusitimba isixeko mna, lize igama lam libizwe pezu kwaso.
Wandula u‐Davide wahlanganisa bonke abantu, waya e‐Raba, walwa ngakuyo, wayitimba.

Wayesusa isitsaba sokumkani walo entlokweni yake, esibe siyitalente yegolide ukuba nzima kwaso, sinamatye anqabileyo; saye si bekwa pezu kwentloko ka‐Davide: namaxoba esixeko wawapumisa ngento eninzi kakulu:

nabantu ababekuso wabapumisa, wababeka pantsi kwesaṙa, napantsi kwezibulo zesincete, napantsi kwezixenxe zesincete, wabadlulisa endaweni yokugqwagqwa izitene: wenje njalo ke kuzo zonke izixeko zosapo luka‐Hamoni. Waza u‐Davide wabuyela e‐Yerusaleme, nabo bonke abantu.
KWAYE kute emveni kwoku, ukuba u‐Abasalome unyana ka‐Davide ebenodade eyinzwakazi, ogama belingu‐Tamare; waye u‐Amnone unyana ka‐Davide wamtanda.
Kwaza kwabuhlungu ku‐Amnone kangaka, wada wazenzela isifo ngenxa ka‐Tamare udade wake; ngokuba ebeyintombi ipela; ngako bekunqabile emehlweni ka‐Amnone ukwenza into kuye.
Kodwa u‐Amnone ebenomhlobo, ogama belingu‐Yonadabi, unyana ka‐Shimeha umzalwana ka‐Davide; kanjalo u‐Yonadabi ebeyindoda elumkileyo kakulu.
Wayesiti kuye: Yinina ukuba wena, ungunyana wokumkani nje, unqinile kangaka ngemiso ngemiso? akuyi kundixelela na? Wandula u‐Amnone wati kuye: Ndiyamtanda u‐Tamare, udade ka‐Abasalome umzalwana wam.

Waza u‐Yonadabi wati kuye: Lala pezu kwomandlalo wako, uzenzise uyafa; nanxa uyihlo aya kuza ukuba akubone, yiti kuye: Makeze ke u‐Tamare udade wam, andidlise isonka, alungise ukutya pambi kwamehlo am, ukuze ndibonele, ndidle kwa sesandleni sake.

Walala ke u‐Amnone, wazenzisa uyafa: kekaloku akuba ukumkani ebeze ukumbona, wati u‐Amnone kukumkani: Makeze ke u‐Tamare udade wam, enze izonkana zibe zibini pambi kwamehlo am, ndize ndidle kwa sesandleni sake.
Wandula u‐Davide watumela ku‐Tamare endlwini, esiti: Kauhambe ke uye endlwini ka‐Amnone umzalwana wako, uze umlungisele ukutya.
Wahamba u‐Tamare waya endlwini ka‐Amnone umzalwana wake: waye yena elele. Waza watabata intlama, wayibuca, wenza izonkana pambi kwamehlo ake, wazoja izonkana ezo kanjalo.
Waza watabata ukamba, wagalela pambi kwake; kodwa wala ukudla. Wayesiti u‐Amnone: Pumisani onke amadoda kum; aza onke amadoda apuma kuye.
Wandula u‐Amnone wati ku‐Tamare: Zisa ukutya enkambilini apa, ndidle kwa sesandleni sako. Waza u‐Tamare watabata izonkana abezenzile, weza nazo ku‐Amnone umzalwana wake enkambilini.
Kekaloku akuzisondeza kuye ukuba adle, wambamba, wati kuye: Yiza, lala nam, dade wam!
Koko wati kuye: Hai, mzalwana wam! ungandidlwenguli; ngokuba kunge kungenziwa okunjalo kwa‐Sirayeli: zungenzi lento ehlazekileyo:
ngokuba mna, ndiya kuya ngapina nehlazo lam? nawe, uya kuba njengelinye lamabedengu kwa‐Sirayeli: ngako kaloku, kautete nokumkani; ngokuba engayi kundibamba kuwe.
Kodwa akavuma ukupulapula ilizwi lake; wati, enamandla pezu kwake nje, wamdlwengula, walala naye.
Wandula u‐Amnone wamtiya ngentiyo enkulu kakulu; ngokuba intiyo abemtiya ngayo, ibinkulu pezu kwotando abemtandile ngalo. Wati u‐Amnone kuye: Suka, umke.
Wayesiti kuye: Akuko ndawo; lenkohlakalo yokundindulula inkulu pezu kwenye ubuyenza kum. Kodwa akavuma ukumpulapula.
Waza wabiza isicaka sake esimkonzayo, wati: Ku̔pani ke lo kum aye pandle, utshixe ucango emva kwake.
Kekaloku ingubo yamabala ngamabala ibipezu kwake: ngokuba intombi zokumkani, ezibe zizintombi zipela, bezivatiswa ngengubo ezinjalo. Waza umkonzi wake wampumisela pandle, watshixa ucango emva kwake.
Wandula u‐Tamare wabeka ututu pezu kwentloko yake, waṙazula ingubo yamabala ngamabala ebipezu kwake, wabeka isandla sake pezu kwentloko yake, wahamba wamana ekala.

Waza wati u‐Abasalome umzalwana wake kuye: u‐Amnone, umzalwana wako, wabeko nawe na? kodwa kaloku, dade wam! yiti cwaka, engumzalwana wako nje; ungabeki intliziyo yako kulento. Waye u‐Tamare wahlala eyedwa endlwini ka‐Abasalome umzalwana wake.
Wati akuva ukumkani u‐Davide zonke ezizinto, waqumba kakulu.
Kodwa u‐Abasalome ebengateti no‐Amnone, kwa nokukohlakeleyo nokulungileyo; ngokuba u‐Abasalome ebemtiya u‐Amnone, ngendawo yokuba ebedlwengule u‐Tamare udade wake.
Kwaye kute emva kweminyaka mibini, ukuba u‐Abasalome wabenabacebi e‐Bali‐hatsore, engakwa‐Frayime; wandula u‐Abasalome wamema bonke onyana bokumkani.
Kanjalo u‐Abasalome weza kukumkani, wati: Bona ke, isicaka sako sinabacebi; makaye ke ukumkani nezicaka zake kunye nesicaka sako.
Kodwa ukumkani wati ku‐Abasalome: Hai, nyana wam! masingayi ke tina sonke, ukuze singabi nzima pezu kwako. Waza wamqu̔ba; koko ebengavumi ukuya, kodwa wamtamsanqela.
Wandula u‐Abasalome wati: Ukuba akungebe njalo, makaye ke nati u‐Amnone umzalwana wam. Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Kunganina ukuba aye nawe?
Kodwa u‐Abasalome wamqu̔ba, wada watuma naye u‐Amnone nabo bonke onyana bokumkani.

Kekaloku u‐Abasalome wayalela izicaka zake, esiti: Gqalani ke nxa intliziyo ka‐Amnone icwayitile ngeveyine, nanxa nditi kuni: Mbeteni u‐Amnone; nandule nimfise, ningoyiki; asi ndim na oniyaleleyo? yomelelani, nibe ngamadoda obuṙoti.
Zaza izicaka zika‐Abasalome zenza kuye u‐Amnone, njengokuba u‐Abasalome ebeziyalele. Bandula besuka bonke onyana bokumkani, bakwela abanye ngabanye pezu kwamaqwaṙaṙa abo, babaleka.
Kwaye kute, nxa basendleleni, zafika indaba ku‐Davide zokuti: u‐Abasalome ubabulele bonke onyana bokumkani, akuko namnye kubo oseleyo.
Waselesuka ukumkani, waṙazula izivato zake, walala emhlabeni; kanjalo zonke izicaka zake zema kona zinengubo eziṙazukileyo.

Waza u‐Yonadabi, unyana ka‐Shimeha umzalwana ka‐Davide, wapendula wati: Maingati inkosi yam kufisiwe onke amadodana, onyana bokumkani; ngokuba u‐Amnone yedwa efile: ngokuba ngelizwi lika‐Abasalome kumiselwe oku, kuselokwalomhla wamdlwengulayo u‐Tamare udade wake.
Ngako kaloku, inkosi yam ukumkani maingabekeli lento intliziyo yayo, ukuti bonke onyana bokumkani bafile; ngu‐Amnone yedwa ofileyo.
Kodwa u‐Abasalome wesaba. Yati indodana ebingumlindi yapakamisa amehlo ayo, yakangela, kekaloku naba abantu abaninzi besiza endleleni emva kwayo ngasecaleni lentaba.
Waza u‐Yonadabi wati kukumkani: Naba onyana bokumkani besiza; njengalo ilizwi lesicaka sako, kwenziwe njalo ke.
Kwabekute, akuba egqibile ukuteta, bona ke, onyana bokumkani bafika, bapakamisa ilizwi labo, balila; kanjalo nokumkani, nazo zonke izicaka zake, balila ngokulila okukulu kunene.
Kodwa u‐Abasalome wesaba, waya ku‐Talemai, unyana ka‐Hamihude, ukumkani we‐Geshure. Wati u‐Davide walilela unyana wake imihla yonke.
Kwa njalo u‐Abasalome wesaba, waya e‐Geshure, wayekona iminyaka yamitatu.
Waza umpefumlo ka‐Davide ukumkani wagqibela ukupuma ngakuye u‐Abasalome; ngokuba ebetutuzelekile ngaye u‐Amnone, ngokuba ebefile.
XESHEKWENI u‐Jowabi, unyana ka‐Tseruya, ebesazi ukuba intliziyo yokumkani ibingaku‐Abasalome,

wandula u‐Jowabi watumela e‐Tekoha, watabata kona umfazi olumkileyo, wati kuye: Kauzenze olilayo, wambate ke izivato zokulilela, ungazitambisi ngeoli, ube njengomfazi olilele ofileyo imihla esel’ imininzi;
uze kukumkani, utete kuye njengalendawo. Waza u‐Jowabi wabeka amazwi emlonyeni wake.
Wati akuteta um‐Tekohakazi lowo kukumkani, wawa ebusweni bake ngasemhlabeni, waziqubuda, wati: Nceda, kumkani!
Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Unanina? Wayesiti: Okunene ndingumhlolokazi mna, nendoda yam ifile.
Sasibe isicakakazi sako sinonyana ababini, baye bona bengxolisana bobabini ngasendle, kwakungeko owabahlukisa, kodwa omnye wabeta omnye, wambulala.

Kekaloku bona ke, sonke isizalwane sivukele ngakuso isicakakazi sako, sati: Nikela lo owabeta umzalwana wake, ukuba simfise ngenxa yobomi bomzalwana wake ambuleleyo, size sibubise indlalifa nayo: kwa njalo baya kucima ilahle lam eliseleyo, bangayishiyeli indoda yam negama nesisalela pezu kwomhlaba.
Wayesiti ukumkani kulomfazi: Yiya endlwini yako, ndandiya kuyalela ngawe.
Waza um‐Tekohakazi lowo wati kukumkani: Ityala malibe pezu kwam, nkosi yam, kumkani! napezu kwendlu kabawo; kodwa ukumkani makabe msulwa, neterone yake.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Osukuba eteta ngakuwe, mzise kum, waengayi kubuya akucukumise kanjako.

Wandula wati: Makake ukumkani amkumbule uyehova, utixo wako, ukuze abapindezeli begazi bangandisi ukutshabalalisa, baze bangabubisi unyana wam. Wayesiti: Ehleli nje uyehova, akuyi kuwa nalunye unwele lwonyana wako ngasemhlabeni.
Waza wati umfazi lowo: Makesitete ilizwi isicakakazi sako kuyo inkosi yam ukumkani. Wayesiti: Teta.
Waza wati umfazi lowo: Kunganina ke ukuba ucingile okunjalo ngakubo abantu bakatixo? ngokuba ukumkani eteta lendawo njengonetyala, ekubeni ukumkani engabuyisi igxotwa lake.
Ngokuba siya kufa ngenyaniso, sibe njengamanzi apaleleyo emhlabeni, angenakubutwa: kodwa utixo akasusi ubomi, uyaqinga amaqinga okuba angamgxoti kuye ogxotiweyo.

Ngako kaloku, ukuba ndize ukuteta kuye ukumkani inkosi yam lendawo, kungokuba abantu bendoyikisile; saza sati isicakakazi sako: Ndoka nditete kukumkani; angaba ukumkani uya kwenza ilizwi lesicakakazi sake.
Ngokuba ukumkani eya kuva, ukuba asindise isicakakazi sake esandleni sendoda efuna ukutshabalalisa mna nonyana wam kwa kunye elifeni likatixo.

Sati kanjalo isicakakazi sako: Ilizwi lenkosi yam ukumkani loba lelokwonwabisa ke; ngokuba njengengelosi katixo, injalo inkosi yam ukumkani, ukuqonda okulungileyo nokukohlakeleyo; ngako uyehova, utixo wako, woba nawe.
Wandula wapendula ukumkani wati kulomfazi: Ungandifihleli ke into endiya kukubuza yona. Wayesiti umfazi: Mayitete ke inkosi yam ukumkani.

Waza ukumkani wati: Isandla sika‐Jowabi asi nawe na kuko konke oku? Wapendula umfazi wati: Bomi bompefumlo wako, nkosi yam, kumkani! akuko ongashenxa nangasekunene nangasekohlo kuko konke okutetiweyo yinkosi yam ukumkani; ngokuba isicaka sako u‐Jowabi singuye ondiyaleleyo, nowabeka onke lamazwi emlonyeni wesicakakazi sako:
ukuze kuguqulwe isimilo senteto, isicaka sako u‐Jowabi senzile lento; kodwa inkosi yam ilumkile ngabo ubulumko bengelosi katixo, ukwazi konke okusemhlabeni.
Wandula ukumkani wati ku‐Jowabi: Bona ke, ndiyenzile lento; hamba ke, buyisa indodana leyo, u‐Abasalome.

Waza u‐Jowabi wawa ngobuso bake ngasemhlabeni, wazitoba, wambulela ukumkani; wayesiti u‐Jowabi: Namhla isicaka sako siyazi ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, nkosi yam, kumkani! ngokokuba ukumkani enzile ilizwi lesicaka sake.
Waselesuka u‐Jowabi, waya e‐Geshure, wamzisa u‐Abasalome e‐Yerusaleme.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Makajikele endlwini yake, angaboni ubuso bam. Kwa njalo u‐Abasalome wajikela endlwini yake, nobuso bokumkani akabubona.
Kekaloku bekungeko indoda eyinzwana njengo‐Abasalome pakati kwabo bonke o‐Sirayeli ukudunyiswa kakulu kangaka; kwa kuwo umzantsi wonyawo lwake kude kwaselukakayini lwake, bekungeko bala kuye.

Naxeshekweni wagugulayo intloko yake, (kwakusekupeleni kweminyaka ngeminyaka ukuba wayigugula; ngokuba ibinzima pezu kwake, ngako wayigugula,) walinganisa inwele zentloko yake ngamakulu mabini eshekele ngesilinganiso sokumkani.
Kwaye kumzalelwe u‐Abasalome onyana abatatu, nentombi inye, egama belingu‐Tamare; yena ebeyinzwakazi ukubonakala kwake.
Kekaloku u‐Abasalome wahlala e‐Yerusaleme iminyaka yamibini, engabonanga ubuso bokumkani.
Waza u‐Abasalome watumela u‐Jowabi, ukuba amtume kukumkani; kodwa ebengavumi ukuza kuye: wabuya watuma nangokwesibini, kodwa ebengavumi ukuza.
Ngako wati kuzo izicaka zake: Kangelani, intsimi ka‐Jowabi isecaleni leyam, kanjalo uneṙalasi kona; hambani, niyitshise ngomlilo. Zaza izicaka zika‐Abasalome zatshisa intsimi leyo ngomlilo.
Wandula wesuka u‐Jowabi, weza ku‐Abasalome endlwini, wati kuye: Yinina ukuba izicaka zako ziyitshisile intsimi yam ngomlilo?

Wayesiti u‐Abasalome ku‐Jowabi: Bona ke, ndatumela wena, ndisiti: Yiza apa, ukuba ndikutume kukumkani, ukuti: Ndizele nina ndivela e‐Geshure? ngokuba kulungile kum ukuba bendiseko kona: ngako kaloku mandibone ubuso bokumkani; nokuba kuko ityala kum, makandifise.
Wandula u‐Jowabi weza kukumkani, wamxelela: waza wambiza u‐Abasalome, owangena kukumkani, wazitoba kuye ebusweni bake ngasemhlabeni pambi kwokumkani: wati ukumkani wamanga u‐Abasalome.
KWAYE kute emveni kwoku, ukuba u‐Abasalome wazilungisela inqwelo namahashe, namadoda angamashumi mahlanu abaleke pambi kwake.

Wavuka kusasa u‐Abasalome, wema ngasecaleni lendlela yesango: kwaza kwati, umntu osukuba enempikiso yokuba eze kukumkani ekugwebeni, wabiza u‐Abasalome kuye, wati: Uvela kwisipina isixeko? Wayesiti: Isicaka sako sivela kwesinye sezizwe zo‐Sirayeli.
Waza u‐Abasalome wati kuye: Kangela, indawo zako zilungile, zifanelekile; kodwa akuko umpulapuli kuwe evela kukumkani.
Wati kanjalo u‐Abasalome: Akwaba ndamiswa umgwebi elizweni, ukuba eze kum umntu osukuba enempikiso nesimangalo, ukuze ndimlungise!
Kwaza kwati, akusondela umntu ukuza kutoba pambi kwake, wandula wasolula isandla sake, wambamba, wamanga.
Wenza ke u‐Abasalome ngendawo enjalo kubo bonke o‐Sirayeli abezayo kukumkani ekugwebeni: wada u‐Abasalome weba̔ intliziyo zamadoda akwa‐Sirayeli.
Kwabekute ekupeleni kweminyaka yamashumi mane, wandula u‐Abasalome wati kukumkani: Mandihambe ke, ndiye ndisifeze isibambiso sam, endibambisileyo ngaso kuyehova, e‐Hebrone:
ngokuba isicaka sako besibambisa ngesibambiso, ndakuhlala e‐Geshure e‐Siriya, sisiti: Ukuba uyehova uya kundibuyisela e‐Yerusaleme ngenyaniso, ndiya kwandula ndimkonze uyehova.
Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Hamba ngoxolo. Wesuka ke, waya e‐Hebrone.
Kekaloku u‐Abasalome watuma abahloli pakati kwazo zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli, esiti: Xeshekweni niya kuva ilizwi lexilongo, nandul’ ukuti: u‐Abasalome ungukumkani e‐Hebrone.
Kwaye kumka no‐Abasalome e‐Yerusaleme amadoda angamakulu mabini, engamenyiweyo; aya ngolungelelwano lwawo, engazi luto.

Kanjalo u‐Abasalome watumela u‐Ahitofele um‐Gilo, umpakati ka‐Davide, avele esixekweni sake, e‐Gilo, nxa ebebingelela imibingo. Yati ingcebiswano yaba namandla; ngokuba abantu bebemana besandela u‐Abasalome.
Wada weza umbiki ku‐Davide, esiti: Intliziyo zamadoda akwa‐Sirayeli ziyalandela u‐Abasalome.

Wandula wati u‐Davide kuzo zonke izicaka zake ezibe zinaye e‐Yerusaleme: Sukani, sisabe; ngokuba kungayi kubako kuti ukusinda ebusweni buka‐Abasalome: nxamani ukumka, hleze asifumane kamsinyane, ahlise pezu kwetu ilishwa, abete isixeko ngohlangoti lweṙele.
Zaza izicaka zokumkani zati kukumkani: Njengako konke iya kukunyula inkosi yam ukumkani, nazi izicaka zako ukwenje njalo!
Waza wapuma ukumkani, nabo bonke abendlu yake ngasezinyaweni zake: kodwa ukumkani washiya ishumi labafazi abangamashweshwe, ukuba balinde indlu.
Kwa njalo wapuma ukumkani, nabo bonke abantu ngasezinyaweni zake; baya bahlala e‐Bete‐meraki.

Zaza zonke izicaka zake zadlula ngasecaleni lake; nabo bonke aba‐Kereti, nabo bonke aba‐Peleti, nawo onke ama‐Gate, amadoda angamakulu matandatu abevele e‐Gate ngasezinyaweni zake, badlula pambi kwokumkani.
Wandula ukumkani wati ku‐Yitai um‐Gate: Kunganina ukuba nawe uhambe nati? buya, uhlale nokumkani; ngokuba wena ungowasemzini, nofudukileyo ukuza endaweni yako kanjako:
ufikile izolo nje, sendiya kukudungudelisa na namhla ngokuhamba nati? mna kambe ndiya kuhamba apo ndingahambela kona; buya wena, ubuyise abazalwana bako: ububele nenyaniso maibe nawe.

Koko u‐Yitai wampendula ukumkani, wati: Njengokuba ehleli uyehova, na njengokuba ihleli inkosi yam ukumkani, endaweni apo iya kubako kona inkosi yam ukumkani, nokuba kube kukufa, nokuba kube kukudliwa kwobomi, kwa lapo siya kubako isicaka sako!
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Yitai: Hamba, uwele. Wasuka wawela u‐Yitai um‐Gate, nawo onke amadoda ake, nabo bonke abantwana ababenaye.
Lati ilizwe lonke lalila ngelizwi elikulu, bakuwela bonke abantu: kanjalo ukumkani wawela umlanjana we‐Kidrone, baza bawela nabantu bonke, ngasendleleni yentlango.

Kwaye kuko, bona ke, no‐Tsadoki, nabo bonke aba‐Levi kunye naye, betwele ityeya yocebano lukatixo; bayibeka pantsi ke ityeya katixo; waza wenyuka u‐Abiyatare, bada bagqiba bonke abantu ukudlula bevela esixekweni.
Wayesiti ukumkani ku‐Tsadoki: Yibuyisele ityeya katixo esixekweni: ukuba ndiya kufumana ufefe emehlweni kayehova, uya kundibuyisa, andibonise yona nekaya lake;
kodwa ukuba utsho ukuti: Andikoliswa nguwe; nanku mna, makenze kum njengo kuba kulungile emehlweni ake.
Walekela ukumkani wati ku‐Tsadoki umperisite: Wena aku ngumboni na? buyela esixekweni ngoxolo, nonyana bako bobabini kunye nawe, u‐Himahatse unyana wako, no‐Jonatane unyana ka‐Abiyatare.
Kangelani, ndiya kulibala ematafeni entlango, kude kuvele ilizwi kuni lokundibika.
Ngako u‐Tsadoki no‐Abiyatare babuyisela ityeya katixo e‐Yerusaleme, baza bahlala kona.

Kekaloku u‐Davide wenyuka ngeqina lentaba yeminquma, elila ekunyukeni kwake, enentloko yake igqujutelwe, wahamba ngenyawo zingenazihlangu: kanjalo bonke abantu ababenaye bagqubutela abanye ngabanye intloko zabo, benyuka, belila ekunyukeni kwabo.
Kwada kwaxelelwa u‐Davide, ukuti: u‐Ahitofele upakati kwabacebiswene no Abasalome. Waza wati u‐Davide: Zumatise ke icebo lika‐Ahitofele, Yehova!
Kwabekute, akufika u‐Davide emmangweni, apo wambedesha kona utixo, nanku u‐Hushai um‐Areki esiza kumkaulela, enengubo yake iṙazukile, nomhlaba pezu kwentloko yake.
Wayesiti u‐Davide kuye: Ukuba uyadlula nam, uya kwandula ube ngumtwalo kum;

kodwa ukuba uya kubuyela esixekweni, uti ku‐Abasalome: Mna ndoba sisicaka sako, kumkani! bendisisicaka soyihlo ngapambili, kodwa kaloku ndoba sisicaka sako; uya kwandula unditshitshisele icebo lika‐Ahitofele.
Abako na nawe kona u‐Tsadoki no‐Abiyatare abaperisite? ngako kuya kuti, zonke indawo uya kuziva zivela endlwini yokumkani, wozixela ku‐Tsadoki naku‐Abiyatare abaperisite.
Bako nabo kona onyana babo bobabini, u‐Himahatse oka‐Tsadoki, no‐Jonatane oka‐Abiyatare; ngezandla zabo niya kutuma kum zonke indawo eniya kuziva.
Waza u‐Hushai, umhlobo ka‐Davide, weza esixekweni; wati no‐Abasalome weza e‐Yerusaleme.

Kekaloku akuba u‐Davide egqitile kancinane emmangweni, bona ke, u‐Tsiba isicaka sika‐Mefiboshete wamkaulela, enesibini samaqwaṙashe enezidwashu, zipezu kwawo izonka ezimakulu mabini, nekulu lezipa zedreyive ezishwenyileyo, nekulu lamasimba eziqa̔mo zehlobo, nentsuba yeveyine.

Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Tsiba: Uti nina ngezizinto? Wayesiti u‐Tsiba: Amaqwaṙashe ngawabendlu yokumkani kukwelwe; izonka neziqa̔mo zehlobo zezokuba amadodana adle; neveyine yeyokuba abadiniweyo entlango basele.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Upina kodwa unyana wenkosi yako? Waza u‐Tsiba wati kukumkani: Bona ke, uhleli e‐Yerusaleme; ngokuba ebesiti: Namhla indlu ka‐Sirayeli iya kubuyisela kum ubukumkani bobawo.
Wandula ukumkani wati ku‐Tsiba: Bona ke, konke okukokuka‐Mefiboshete kukokwako. Wayesiti u‐Tsiba: Ndiyatoba pantsi; mandifumane ufefe emehlweni ako, nkosi yam, kumkani!
Kekaloku, akuza ukumkani u‐Davide ngase‐Bahurime, bona ke, kwapuma kona indoda yakwisizalwane sendlu ka‐Saule, egama belingu‐Shimehi, unyana ka‐Gera: wapuma, eqalekisa ekupumeni kwake.
Wasuka wagibisela ngamatye u‐Davide, nazo zonke izicaka zokumkani u‐Davide; baye bonke abantu nawo onke amagoṙa bengasekunene kwake nangasekohlo kwake.
Wayesitsho u‐Shimehi ekuqalekiseni kwake ukuti: Puma, puma, ndoda yegazi, ndoda yobunginingini!

uyehova ubuyisile pezu kwako lonke igazi lendlu ka‐Saule, lowo obupata ubukumkani esikundleni sake; kanjako uyehova unikele ubukumkani esandleni sika‐Abasalome unyana wako; kanti nanku wena usengozini yako, ngokuba uyindoda yegazi.
Wandula u‐Abishai unyana ka‐Tseruya wati kukumkani: Yinina ukuba lenja efileyo iqalekise inkosi yam ukumkani? mandidlule ke, ndiye ndisuse intloko yake.
Koko ukumkani wati: Ndiyinto nina kuni, bonyana baka‐Tseruya? makaqalekise bo, ngokuba uyehova ete kuye: Mqalekise u‐Davide; ngubanina ke oya kuti: Yinina ukuba wenje njalo?

Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Abishai nakuzo zonke izicaka zake: Bona ke, unyana wam owapuma ematunjini am, uyafuna ubomi bam; kwoba kangakananina ngakumbi kaloku enje njalo lom‐Benjamine? myekeni, makaqalekise; ngokuba uyehova emxelele:
kungaba uyehova uya kukangela pezu kwelishwa lam, aze uyehova abuyekeze kum okulungileyo esikundleni sokuqalekisa kwake namhla nje.
Wahamba ke u‐Davide namadoda ake endleleni; wati u‐Shimehi wahamba ecaleni lentaba malungana naye, waqalekisa ekuhambeni kwake, wagibisela ngamatye ngakuye, waposa utuli.
Wada wafika ukumkani, nabantu bonke ababenaye, bediniwe nje, bati pefu kona.
KEKALOKU u‐Abasalome, nabo bonke abantu, amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, beza e‐Yerusaleme, no‐Ahitofele kunye naye.
Kwaye kute, okuya u‐Hushai um‐Areki, umhlobo ka‐Davide, wezayo ku‐Abasalome, wandula u‐Hushai wati ku‐Abasalome: Makapile ukumkani, makapile ukumkani!
Waza u‐Abasalome wati ku‐Hushai: Bubo obu na ububele bako kumhlobo wako? yinina ukuba akuyanga nomhlobo wako?
Wayesiti u‐Hushai ku‐Abasalome: Hai; ngulowo unyuliweyo nguyehova, nangababantu, nangamadoda onke akwa‐Sirayeli, endiya kuba ngowake, nendiya kuhlala naye:
nakanjako, ngendimkonza banina? ngekungabi sebusweni bonyana wake na? njengokuba ndikonzile ebusweni boyihlo, ndoba njalo ebusweni bako.
Wandula u‐Abasalome wati ku‐Ahitofele: Nikani icebo! siya kwenza nto nina?

Waza u‐Ahitofele wati ku‐Abasalome: Ngena kuwo amashweshwe kayihlo, awashiyileyo ukulinda indlu; baye o‐Sirayeli bonke beya kuva ukuba unukele uyihlo; kwa njalo ziya kwomelela izandla zabo bonke abanawe.
Ngako bamolulela u‐Abasalome intente pezu kwendlu; waza u‐Abasalome wangena kuwo amashweshwe oyise pambi kwamehlo o‐Sirayeli bonke.
Kekaloku icebo lika‐Ahitofele, elo wacebisa ngalo ngalomihla, belinjengokungati kwabuzwa elizwini likatixo: belinjalo lonke icebo lika‐Ahitofele nakuye u‐Davide nakuye u‐Abasalome.
Walekela u‐Ahitofele wati ku‐Abasalome: Makendinyule ke amadoda angamawaka alishumi linamabini, ukuze ndisuke, ndiputume u‐Davide ngobubusuku:
ndandiya kuza pezu kwake ediniwe, epolelwe izandla, ndimnkwantyise; baye bonke abantu abanaye beya kusaba: ndiya kwandula ndimbete ukumkani yedwa;
nabo bonke abantu ndobabuyisela kuwe: londoda uyifunayo injengokubuya kwabo bonke: kwa njalo abantu bonke boba seluxolweni.
Lalibe elozwi lifanele emehlweni ka‐Abasalome nasemehlweni abo bonke abadala bo‐Sirayeli.
Kodwa u‐Abasalome wati: Kaubize no‐Hushai um‐Areki, ukuba sive woti nina naye.
Wati akufika u‐Hushai ku‐Abasalome, watsho u‐Abasalome kuye, esiti: u‐Ahitofele utetile ngendawo enje nje; siya kulenza izwi lake na? ukuba asiyi kulenza, teta wena.
Waza wati u‐Hushai ku‐Abasalome: Alilungile icebo acebisile ngalo u‐Ahitofele ngelixesha.
Wahambisa u‐Hushai wati: Wena uyamazi uyihlo namadoda ake, ukuba bangamagoṙa, nabampefumlo uṙaṙa, njengebere ehlutiweyo amatole ayo ngasendle; kanjako uyihlo uyindoda yokulwa, akayi kulalisa nabantu.
Bona ke, ngoku uzimele kwomnye weminxuma, umhlaumbi kwenye yezondawo: kwaye kuya kuti, nxa kuviwa pakati kwabo ekuqaleni, osukuba esiva woti: Kuko isibulalo pakati kwabantu abamlandelayo u‐Abasalome;
andule kwa lowo oyindoda yobuṙoti, ontliziyo injengentliziyo yengonyama, agqibele ukunyibilika; ngokuba bonke o‐Sirayeli besazi ukuba uyihlo uligoṙa, nokuba bangamadoda obuṙoti abo banaye.
Ngako ndiyanika icebo lokuba bonke o‐Sirayeli babutelwe kuwe kamsinyane, bevela e‐Dane nakude kube se‐Beresheba, njengentlabati engaselwandle ngobuninzi, nokuba uye isiqu sako ekulweni.
Siya kwandul’ ukuza kuye kwenye yezondawo apo aya kufunyanwa kona, si we pezu kwake njengokuba umbete usiwa pezu kwomhlaba: kwaye kungayi kusala mntu kuye nakuwo onke amadoda anaye noko amnye.
Kanjako ukuba wamkelwe esixekweni, sebeya kuti o‐Sirayeli bonke bafake esosixeko intambo, ukuze sisir̔olele emlanjeni, kude kungafunyanwa kona nalinye ilityana.

Waza wati u‐Abasalome, nawo onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli: Icebo lika‐Hushai um‐Areki lilungile pezu kwecebo lika‐Ahitofele. Ngokuba uyehova ebemisele icebo elilungileyo lika‐Ahitofele ukuba litshitshiswe, ukuze uyehova azise pezu kwo‐Abasalome ilishwa.

Wandula u‐Hushai wati ku‐Tsadoki naku‐Abiyatare abaperisite: Njengokunje nanjengokunje wanika icebo u‐Ahitofele ku‐Abasalome, nakubadala bo‐Sirayeli; kanjalo njengokunje nanjengokunje ndanika icebo mna:
ngako kaloku tumani ngokunxama, nishumayele ku‐Davide, ukuti: Ungalalisi ngobubusuku ematafeni entlango; nokuti: Kauleza ukuwela; hleze ukumkani acitwe, nabantu bonke abanaye.

Kekaloku u‐Jonatane no‐Himahatse bebehlala ngasemtonjeni we‐Rogele; saza isicakazana saya sabaxelela; (ngokuba bebekohlwa ukubonakala ngokungena esixekweni;) bati bona baya bamxelela ukumkani u‐Davide.
Kodwa umfana wababona, wamxelela u‐Abasalome: basuka baya bobabini ngokunxama, beza endlwini yendoda e‐Bahurime, ebinequla ebaleni layo; baye behlela kona.
Wandula umfazi watabata isigubungelo, wasandlala pezu kwomlomo wequla, wayaneka inqolowa enqushiweyo pezu kwaso; kwaza akwaziwa lonto.

Zada zafika izicaka zika‐Abasalome kumfazi lowo endlwini, zati: Bapina u‐Himahatse no‐Jonatane? Wayesiti umfazi kuzo: Bawelile umlanjana wamanzi. Zati zakuba zifunile, zingafumananga nje, zabuyela e‐Yerusaleme.
Kwaye kute emveni kwokumka kwazo, bandula benyuka equleni, baya bamxelela ukumkani u‐Davide, bati ku‐Davide: Sukani, niwele amanzi ngokunxama: ngokuba kunje nje u‐Ahitofele anikile icebo ngakuni.
Waza wesuka u‐Davide, nabantu bonke ababenaye, bawela i‐Yoredane; kwati kwakukanya ukusa, akwasweleka kwa namnye ongawelanga i‐Yoredane.
Kekaloku akubona u‐Ahitofele ukuba icebo lake belingenzwanga, wabopa iqwaṙashe, wesuka, waya endlwini yake, esixekweni sake, wayolela indlu yake, wazixo̔ma; waza wafa, wancw̔atywa encw̔abeni loyise.
WANDULA u‐Davide weza e‐Mahanayime. Kanjalo u‐Abasalome wawela i‐Yoredane, yena nawo onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli kunye naye.

Waye u‐Abasalome ebebekile u‐Hamasa pezu kwomkosi esikundleni sika‐Jowabi: u‐Hamasa lowo ebengunyana wendoda egama belingu‐Yitera, um‐Sirayeli, eyangena ku‐Abigali intombi ka‐Nahashe, udade ka‐Tseruya unina ka‐Jowabi.
Kwa njalo o‐Sirayeli no‐Abasalome bati waca ezweni le‐Gileyadi.
Kwaye kute, akuba u‐Davide efikile e‐Mahanayime, wandula u‐Shobi unyana ka‐Nahashe wase‐Raba yosapo luka‐Hamoni, no‐Makire unyana ka‐Hamiyeli wase‐Lo‐debare, no‐Barezilai um‐Gileyadi wase‐Rogelime,
bazisa imandlalo, nezitya, nemipanda yombumbi, nenqolowa, neṙalasi, nomgubo, namaqashu, namabontye, nelentile, nenkozo ezojiweyo,
nobusi, namasi, negusha, nezonka zamasi enkomo, banik ela u‐Davide nabantu ababenaye, ukuze badle; ngokuba bebesiti: Abantu balambile, badiniwe, banxaniwe, entlango apo.
Wada u‐Davide wabala abantu ababenaye, wabeka pezu kwabo inkosi zamawaka nenkosi zamakulu.

Waza u‐Davide watuma abantu, esinye isiqingata sesitatu ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Jowabi, nesinye isiqingata sesitatu ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Abishai, unyana ka‐Tseruya, umninawe ka‐Jowabi, nesinye isiqingata sesitatu ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Yitai um‐Gate. Wayesiti ukumkani ebantwini: Ndiya kupuma nani ngenyaniso nam.

Koko abantu bati: Akuyi kupuma; ngokuba nxa sika sibaleke, abayi kubekela tina intliziyo; nanxa esinye isiqingata sabetu sibubayo, abayi kubekela tina intliziyo; kodwa ngoku u njengamawaka alishumi abakuti; ngako kaloku kulungile ukuba ube usinceda usesixekweni.
Wandula ukumkani wati kubo: Oko kulungileyo emehlweni enu ndiya kukwenza. Wasuka ukumkani wema ngasecaleni lesango, bati bonke abantu bapuma ngamakulu nangamawaka.

Waza ukumkani wayalela u‐Jowabi, no‐Abishai, no‐Yitai, ngokuti: Patani kakuhle indodana leyo, u‐Abasalome, ngenxa yam. Baye bonke abantu besiva, akuba ukumkani ebeyalela zonke inkosi ezo ngayo indawo ka‐Abasalome.
Kwa njalo abantu bapumela ezindle ngakuwo ama‐Sirayeli: kwaza kwabako ukulwa ehlatini le‐Frayime;
bati abantu bakwa‐Sirayeli babulawa kona ebusweni bezicaka zika‐Davide; kwaye kuko kona isibulawa esikulu ngalomhla, amawaka amashumi mabini amadoda:
ngokuba ukulwa kwatiwa sa pezu kwobuso belizwe lonke; lada ihlati ladla ebantwini ngento eninzi kubo ababedliwa liṙele ngalomhla.

Wahla u‐Abasalome wahlangana nezicaka zika‐Davide: kekaloku u‐Abasalome wakwela pezu kweqwaṙaṙa; lati lakufika iqwaṙaṙa pantsi kwamasebe apingeleleneyo omkoba omkulu, yandula intloko yake yabambeka emkobeni, wabekwa pakati kwezulu nomhlaba; laye iqwaṙaṙa elipantsi kwake ladlula.
Yaza indoda etile yabona oko, yamxelela u‐Jowabi, yati: Bona ke, ndibonile u‐Abasalome exo̔mekile emkobeni.
Wayesiti u‐Jowabi kuyo indoda ebimxelele: Bona ke, ubonile nje, kuyinina ukuba ubungambeti kona ngasemhlabeni! ndandinge ndikunikile ishumi leshekele zesilivere noqwemesha lunye.

Koko indoda leyo yati ku‐Jowabi: Nakuba bendiya kulinganisa pezu kwesandla sam iwaka leshekele zesilivere, ngandingoluli isandla sam ngakuye unyana wokumkani; ngokuba ukumkani ebeyalela wena, no‐Abishai, no‐Yitai, ekuveni kwetu, esiti: Gcinani nonke ngabanye indodana u‐Abasalome.
Ukuba kodwa bendenzile ubuxoki ngakubo ubomi bam; (ngokuba kungeko nto efihlelweyo ukumkani;) ngeuba nawe umele ngaku m.
Wandula wati u‐Jowabi: Andiyi kulibala ngokunjalo ebusweni bako. Waza watabata izikali ezitatu esandleni sake, wazihlaba entliziyweni ka‐Abasalome, nxa asahleli pakati kwomkoba.
Aza asondela amadodana alishumi, abatwali bezixo̔bo zika‐Jowabi, ambeta u‐Abasalome, amfisa.
Wandula u‐Jowabi wavutela ngexilongo, bati abantu babuya ekusukeleni ama‐Sirayeli; ngokuba u‐Jowabi wababamba abantu.
Baza bamtabata u‐Abasalome, bamposa ehlatini emnxunyeni omkulu, bamisa pezu kwake imfumba yamatye enkulu kakulu: asuka onke ama‐Sirayeli esaba aya amanye ngamanye ezintenteni zawo.

Kekaloku u‐Abasalome, nxa abesadla ubomi, watabata wazimisela intsika, esemhlanjeni wokumkani; ngokuba ebesiti: Andinanyana, ukuze kukunjuzwe igama lam; wayibiza intsika leyo ngegama lake: ngako yabizwa kwada kwanamhla nje ngokuti yinkumbuzelo ka‐Abasalome.
Wandula wati u‐Himahatse unyana ka‐Tsadoki: Makendigidime, ndishumayele kukumkani indaba zokuba uyehova umkulule esandleni sentshaba zake.
Koko u‐Jowabi wati kuye: Akuyi kuba ngumshumayeli wendaba namhla nje, kodwa uya kushumayela indaba ngomhla wumbi; kodwa namhla nje akuyi kushumayela indaba, ngenxa yokuba unyana wokumkani efile.
Waza u‐Jowabi wati ku‐Kushi: Hamba, umxelele ukumkani oko ukubonileyo. Watoba ke u‐Kushi pambi kwo‐Jowabi, wagidima.
Wapinda kanjako u‐Himahatse unyana ka‐Tsadoki wati ku‐Jowabi: Kodwa noko, makendigidime nam emva kwo‐Kushi. Wayesiti u‐Jowabi: Kunganina ukuba ugidime wena, nyana wam! ungenandaba ezikolekileyo nje?
Kodwa noko, watsho, makendigidime. Waza wati kuye: Gidima. Wasuka u‐Himahatse wagidima ngendlela yetafa, wagqita ku‐Kushi.
Kekaloku u‐Davide wahlala pakati kwamasango amabini; wati umlindi wahamba pezu kwesifulelwa sesango, pezu kwodonga, wapakamisa amehlo ake, wakangela; kekaloku nantsiya indoda igidima iyodwa.
Waza wabiza umlindi, wamxelela ukumkani. Wayesiti ukumkani: Ukuba iyodwa, kuko indaba emlonyeni wayo. Yakaulezisa ukuhamba ke, yasondela.
Wabuya umlindi wabona enye indoda igidima; waza umlindi wabiza kumgcini wesango, wati: Nantsi enye indoda igidima iyodwa. Wayesiti ukumkani: Nalé ingumshumayeli wendaba.
Wati umlindi kanjalo: Ndiyabona ukugidima kweyokuqala njengokugidima kuka‐Himahatse unyana ka‐Tsadoki. Wayesiti ukumkani: Uyindoda elungileyo lowo, uyeza nendaba ezilungileyo.

Waza wabiza u‐Himahatse, wati kukumkani: Luxolo! Watoba ngobuso bake ngasemhlabeni pambi kwokumkani, wati: Makabongwe uyehova, utixo wako, owanikeleyo amadoda abepakamisa isandla sawo ngakuyo inkosi yam ukumkani.
Wandula ukumkani wati: Ipilile na indodana u‐Abasalome? Wati u‐Himahatse: Kendabona impitimpiti enkulu, nxa u‐Jowabi abetuma isicaka sokumkani, na m isicaka sako, kodwa bendingayazi iyinto nina.
Wati ukumkani: Sondela, zimise apa; waza wasondela, wema.
Wada wafika, bona ke, u‐Kushi; wayesiti u‐Kushi: Maishunyayezwe inkosi yam ukumkani, okokuba uyehova ukukulule namhla esandleni sabo bonke ababesukela ngakuwe.
Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Kushi: Ipilile na indodana u‐Abasalome? Wayesiti u‐Kushi: Intshaba zenkosi yam ukumkani, nabo bonke abavukela ububi bako, mababe njengendodana leyo!

Wandula ukumkani wabetwa lusizi, wenyuka waya enkambilini epezulu kwesango, walila; wayesitsho ekuyeni kwake ukuti: Nyana wam Abasalome, nyana wam, nyana wam Abasalome! akwaba ndabendifile esikundleni sako, Abasalome, nyana wam, nyana wam!
Kwaza kwaxelwa ku‐Jowabi ukuti: Nanku ukumkani elila esenza isijwili pezu kwo‐Abasalome.
Lwati usindiso ngalomhla lwaba lulilo kubo bonke abantu; ngokuba abantu bebesiva ngalomhla kusitwa: Ukumkani udandatekile pezu kwonyana wake.
Baza abantu banyebeleza ngalomhla ukungena esixekweni, njengokuba benyebeleza abantu abavisiweyo ihlazo, bakubaleka ekulweni.
Kodwa ukumkani wagqubutela ubuso bake, wakala ukumkani ngelizwi elikulu, esiti: Nyana wam Abasalome! Abasalome, nyana wam, nyana wam!

Wandula u‐Jowabi weza kukumkani endlwini, wati: Udanisile namhla ubuso bazo zonke izicaka zako, ezisindisileyo namhla ubomi bako, nobomi bonyana bako nobentombi zako, nobomi babafazi bako, nobomi bamashweshwe ako,

ngokubatanda abakutiyayo nangokubatiya abakutandayo: ngokuba uxele namhla, ukuba azinto kuwe inkosi nezicaka; ngokuba ndinakana namhla, ukuba u‐Abasalome ebesahleli, nokuba tina sonke sibe sifile namhla, oko ngekuba kulungile emehlweni ako.

Ngako kaloku suka, upume, utete kwintliziyo zezicaka zako: ngokuba ndifunga uyehova, ungapumi nje, akuyi kulalisa mntu nawe obubusuku: oku ke kwoba kubi kuwe, ngapezu kwabo bonke ububi ubuhlelwa bubo kwa sebutsheni bako kude kwangoku.

Wandula ukumkani wesuka, wahlala esangweni. Kwaza kwaxelwa kubo bonke abantu ukuti: Nanku ukumkani ehleli esangweni. Basuka bonke abantu beza ebusweni bokumkani; kodwa ama‐Sirayeli ebesabele amanye ngamanye ezintenteni zawo.

BAZA bapikisana bonke abantu, pakati kwezizwe zonke zama‐Sirayeli, besiti: Ukumkani wasihlangula esandleni sentshaba zetu, wasisindisa esandleni sama‐Filistiya; kodwa ngoku wesabile elizweni ngenxa ka‐Abasalome;
no‐Abasalome, esibe simtambisa pezu kwetu, ufile ekulweni: ngako kaloku, kunganina ukuba niti cwaka ngokumbuyisa ukumkani?

Kekaloku ukumkani u‐Davide watuma ku‐Tsadoki naku‐Abiyatare abaperisite, ukuti: Tetani kubo abadala bo‐Juda, nisiti: Yinina ukuba ningabokugqibela ukumbuyisela ukumkani endlwini yake? (ngokuba ukuteta kwama‐Sirayeli onke bekufikile kukumkani, endlwini yake:)
nina ningabazalwana bam; nilitambo lam nenyama yam: yinina ukuba ningabokugqibela ukumbuyisa ukumkani?
Nize niti ku‐Hamasa: Akulitambo lam nenyama yam na wena? utixo makenje njalo kum, alekele ukwenje njalo kum, ukuba akuyi kuba yinkosi yomkosi pambi kwam imihla yonke esikundleni sika‐Jowabi!
Waza watobela intliziyo yawo onke amadoda akwa‐Juda njengeyendoda inye; ada atuma kukumkani, esiti: Buya wena, nezicaka zako zonke.
Wandula wabuya ukumkani, weza e‐Yoredane: basuka o‐Juda beza e‐Gilegale, ukuya kumkaulela ukumkani, ukuba bamwelise ukumkani i‐Yoredane.
Waza wanxama u‐Shimehi unyana ka‐Gera, um‐Benjamine, owase‐Bahurime, wehlela pakati kwamadoda akwa‐Juda, ukuya kumkaulela ukumkani u‐Davide.

Kwaye kuko naye iwaka lamadoda akwa‐Benjamine; kwa no‐Tsiba isicaka sendlu ka‐Saule, nonyana bake abalishumi linabahlanu, nezicaka zake ezimashumi mabini, kunye naye: baza bawela i‐Yoredane pambi kwokumkani.
Kwaye kuwela umtantatu wokuweza abendlu yokumkani, nowokwenza okulungileyo emehlweni ake. Wandula u‐Shimehi unyana ka‐Gera wawa pambi kwokumkani, akuba ewelile i‐Yoredane,

wati kukumkani: Maingati inkosi yam ibalele kum ityala; kanjalo ungakumbuleli oko isicaka sako sibe sikwenza ngobugwenxa, ngomhla yabipuma ngawo inkosi yam ukumkani e‐Yerusaleme, ukuba ukumkani akubekele intliziyo yake.
Ngokuba isicaka sako sisazi ukuba ndonile; ngako, bona ke, ndizile namhla ndingowokuqala kuyo yonke indlu ka‐Josefe ukuba ndihle ukuya kukaulela inkosi yam ukumkani.
Waza wapendula u‐Abishai unyana ka‐Tseruya, wati: Akayi kufiswa na u‐Shimehi ngenxa yoku, ukuba emqalekisile umtanjiswa kayehova?

Koko u‐Davide wati: Ndiyinto nina kuni, bonyana baka‐Tseruya! ukuba nibe namhla ningabalane kum? kwofiswa namhla na umntu kwa‐Sirayeli? ngokuba ndingazi na ukuba ndingukumkani namhla pezu kwo‐Sirayeli?
Ngako ukumkani wati ku‐Shimehi: Akuyi kufa. Waza ukumkani wamfungela.

Wehla no‐Mefiboshete unyana ka‐Saule, ukuza kumkaulela ukumkani, engahlambanga inyawo zake, engacazanga udevu lwake, engahlanzanga ingubo zake, kwa semhleni wokumka kwokumkani kude kwangumhla lowo wabuya wafika ngoxolo.
Kwaye kute, akuba efikile e‐Yerusaleme ukuza kumkaulela ukumkani, wati ukumkani kuye: Yinina ukuba ubungayanga nam, Mefiboshete?
Wayesiti: Nkosi yam, kumkani! isicaka sam sandikohlisa; ngokuba isicaka sako sibe sisiti: Ndiya kuzibopela iqwaṙashe, ndikwele pezu kwalo, ndiye kukumkani; ngokuba isicaka sako sisisiqwala.
Sasihleba isicaka sako kuyo inkosi yam ukumkani; kodwa inkosi yam ukumkani injengengelosi katixo: ngako yenza okulungileyo emehlweni ako.

Ngokuba bonke abendlu kabawo bebengamadoda okufa kupela pambi kwenkosi yam ukumkani: noko umisile isicaka sako pakati kwabo abadlayo ngasetafileni yako. Ndisenegunya lanina, ukuba ndikale kanjako kuye ukumkani?
Waza ukumkani wati kuye: Kunganina ukuba uyateta kanjako ngendawo zako? Ndite: Wena no‐Tsiba yahlulelanani umhlaba lowo.
Wayesiti u‐Mefiboshete kukumkani: Makatabate kwa wonke, emveni kwokuba inkosi yam ukumkani ifikile ngoxolo endlwini yayo.
Kanjalo u‐Barezilai um‐Gileyadi wehla e‐Rogelime, wawela i‐Yoredane nokumkani, ukumpelekelela e‐Yoredane.
Waye u‐Barezilai ebemdala kakulu, engominyaka imashumi asibozo: yena ebemfunzele ukumkani nxa abehlala e‐Mahanayime; ngokuba ebeyindoda enkulu kunene.
Wayesiti ukumkani ku‐Barezilai: Wela nam, ndandiya kukufunzela kum e‐Yerusaleme.
Kodwa u‐Barezilai wati kukumkani: Yoba mingapina imihla yeminyaka yokudla kwam ubomi, ukuba ndinyuke nokumkani ukuya e‐Yerusaleme?

Ndingominyaka imashumi asibozo ubudala bam namhla: ndinokuqiqa na pakati kwokumnandi nokubi? isicaka sako sinokuva na oko endikudlayo nendikuselayo? ndisenako na ukupulapula ilizwi labaculi nelabaculikazi? kunganina ke ukuba isicaka sako sibe sisengumtwalo kuyo inkosi yam ukumkani?
Isicaka sako siya kuwela i‐Yoredane nokumkani ukuya umganyana wodwa: kunganina ke ukuba ukumkani andivuze ngomvuzo onjalo?
Makesibuye isicaka sako, ukuba ndibubele esixekweni sam, ngasencw̔abeni lobawo noma̔. Kodwa nasi isicaka sako u‐Kimuhame; masiwele nenkosi yam ukumkani; uze usenzele oko kulungileyo emehlweni ako.
Waza wati ukumkani: u‐Kimuhame uya kuwela nam, ndandiya kumenzela oko kulungileyo emehlweni ako; nako konke uya kukufuna kum, ndiya kukwenzela kona.
Bada bonke abantu bawela i‐Yoredane; wawela nokumkani: wandula ukumkani wamanga u‐Barezilai, wamtamsanqelisa; owabuya waya endaweni yake.
Waza ukumkani wadlulela e‐Gilegale, no‐Kimuhame wadlula naye: bati bonke abantu bakwa‐Juda bamwelisa ukumkani, kwa nesinye isiqingata sabantu bakwa‐Sirayeli.

KEKALOKU bona ke, onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli eza kukumkani, ati kukumkani: Yinina ukuba abazalwana betu, amadoda akwa‐Juda, bakubi̔le, nokuba bawezile ukumkani nabendlu yake i‐Yoredane, nawo onke amadoda ka‐Davide kunye naye?

Andula onke amadoda akwa‐Juda apendula ngakuwo amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli, ati: Ngokuba ukumkani esalamana nati; kunganina ke ukuba niqumbile pezu kwalendawo? sike sadla na okuvela kukumkani? uke wasibasela ngebaso na?

Aza amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli apendula amadoda akwa‐Juda, ati: Tina sinezahlulo ezilishumi kuye ukumkani, kwa nakuye u‐Davide, ngapezu kwenu; kunganina ke ukuba nisidelile? besingenalo ilizwi letu kuqala ke na, lokuba kubuyiswe ukumkani wetu? Kodwa ilizwi lamadoda akwa‐Juda belilukuni ngapezu kwelizwi lamadoda akwa‐Sirayeli.

Kwahla kwabako kona indoda yobunginingini, egama belingu‐Sheba, unyana ka‐Bikeri, um‐Benjamine: yona yavutela ngexilongo, yati: Asinasabiwo ku‐Davide, asinalifa kuye unyana ka‐Jese; abanye ngabanye ezintenteni zabo, bo‐Sirayeli!
Andula onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli enyuka ekulandeleni u‐Davide, alandela u‐Sheba unyana ka‐Bikeri: kodwa amadoda akwa‐Juda anamatela kukumkani wawo, kutabata e‐Yoredane kude kwakuyo i‐Yerusaleme.

Wayesiza u‐Davide endlwini yake e‐Yerusaleme; waza ukumkani watabata abafazi abangamashweshwe bolishumi, abo wabashiya ukulinda indlu, wabafaka endlwini yokugcinela, wabafunzela, kodwa akangena kubo: kwa njalo bavalelwa kwada kwangumhla wokufa kwabo, behleli ngobuhlolokazi.
Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Hamasa: Ndibizele ndawonye amadoda akwa‐Juda pakati kwemihla mitatu, ube lapa nawe umi.
Wasuka u‐Hamasa waya ukubiza ndawonye amadoda akwa‐Juda; kodwa walibala ngapezu kwexesha elimisiweyo, elo wabemmisele lona.

Ngako u‐Davide wati ku‐Abishai: Kaloku u‐Sheba, unyana ka‐Bikeri, uya kusenzela okubi ngapezu kwo‐Abasalome; tabata wena izicaka zenkosi yako, umputume, hleze azifumanele izixeko ezinqatyisiweyo, asinde emehlweni etu.
Andula apuma emva kwake amadoda ka‐Jowabi, naba‐Kereti, naba‐Peleti, nawo onke amagoṙa: bapuma ke e‐Yerusaleme, ukuya kumputuma u‐Sheba unyana ka‐Bikeri.

Bati bakuba ngasetyeni elikulu elise‐Gibeyone, wandula u‐Hamasa waya pambi kwabo. Waye u‐Jowabi ebinqiwe ngengubo yake abeyambete, upezu kwayo umbinqo o neṙele libotshiwe pezu kwesinqe sake esinxobeni salo; elati akupuma lawa.
Wayesiti u‐Jowabi ku‐Hamasa: Upilile na, mzalwana wam? Wandula u‐Jowabi walubamba ngesandla sokunene udevu luka‐Hamasa, ukuza kumanga:

kodwa u‐Hamasa ebengalumkeli iṙele elibe lisesandleni sika‐Jowabi: waza wambeta ngalo esiswini, wapalaza amatumbu ake ngasemhlabeni, engampindelanga ke: wada wafa. Basuka u‐Jowabi no‐Abishai umzalwana wake bamputuma u‐Sheba unyana ka‐Bikeri.
Yaza indoda ezicakeni zika‐Jowabi yema ngakuye, yati: Osukuba ekolela u‐Jowabi, nosukuba engecala lika‐Davide, makamlandele u‐Jowabi.

Kekaloku u‐Hamasa waqikaqikeka egazini pakati kwomendo. Yati yakubona indoda leyo ukuba abantu bonke bema, yamsusa u‐Hamasa emendweni yambeka ngasendle, yaposa ingubo pezu kwake, ngokokuba ebebona bonke ababesiza ngakuye ukuba bema.
Okuya ebesusiwe emendweni, badlula bonke abantu emva kwo‐Jowabi, ukuya kumputuma u‐Sheba unyana ka‐Bikeri.
Waza wacanda kuzo zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli kude kwakuyo i‐Abele, ne‐Bete‐mahaka, nayo yonke i‐Berime: baza bahlanganiselwa ndawonye, baya nabo emva kwake.
Basuka beza bamvingcela e‐Abele‐bete‐mahaka, baposela indulana ngakuso isixeko, eyemayo ngakulo udonga lwapandle: baza bonke abantu ababeno‐Jowabi balwonakalisa udonga, ukuze baluwise.
Wandula wabiza umfazi olumkileyo esesixekweni, esiti: Yivani! yivani! niti ke ku‐Jowabi: Sondela kwa lapa, ukuba nditete nawe.
Akuba esondele kuye, wati umfazi: Ungu‐Jowabi na? Wayesiti: Ndinguye. Waza wati kuye: Yiva amazwi esicakakazi sako. Wayesiti: Ndiyeva mna.
Wandula watsho ukuti: Kwatetwa ekuhleni ngapambili, kusitwa: Baya kubuza ngenyaniso e‐Abele, bagqibe njalo ke.
Mna ndingowabaxolileyo, ndingowabanyanisekileyo kwa‐Sirayeli: wena uyafuna ukububisa isixeko nonina kwa‐Sirayeli; kunganina ukuba uya kucita ilifa likayehova?
Wapendula u‐Jowabi, wati: Makube le̔, makube le̔ kum, ukuba ndicite nokuba ndonakalise!

Lendawo ayinjalo; koko indoda yasentabeni yakwa‐Frayime, ngu‐Sheba, unyana ka‐Bikeri, igama layo, ipakamisile isandla sayo ngakuye ukumkani, ngakuye u‐Davide; yinikeleni yona yodwa, ndandiya kumka esixekweni. Wayesiti umfazi ku‐Jowabi: Bona ke, intloko yayo iya kuposwa kuwe pezu kwodonga.

Wandula umfazi waya kubo bonke abantu ngobulumko bake. Baza banqumla intloko ka‐Sheba unyana ka‐Bikeri, bayiposa ku‐Jowabi. Wasuka wavutela ngexilongo, bada baciteka esixekweni, besiya abanye ngabanye ezintenteni zabo. Waza u‐Jowabi wabuyela e‐Yerusaleme kukumkani.
Kekaloku u‐Jowabi ebepezu kwawo wonke umkosi wo‐Sirayeli; no‐Benaya, unyana ka‐Yoyada, ebepezu kwaba‐Kereti napezu kwaba‐Peleti;
no‐Adorame ebepezu kwabesitabataba; no‐Yehoshafate, unyana ka‐Ahilude, ebengumkumbuzi;
kanjalo u‐Sheva ebengumba̔li; u‐Tsadoki no‐Abiyatare bebengabaperisite;
no‐Hira, um‐Yahire, yena ebelinene lika‐Davide.

KWAZA kwabako indlala emihleni ka‐Davide iminyaka yamitatu, ngomnyaka ngomnyaka; waza u‐Davide wafuna ubuso bukayehova. Wayesiti uyehova: Ingenxa ka‐Saule nangenxa yendlu yamagazi, ngokokuba wabulala aba‐Gibeyone.

Waza ukumkani wababiza aba‐Gibeyone, wati kubo: (kekaloku aba‐Gibeyone bebengengabosapo luka‐Sirayeli, koko bebengabesisalela saba‐Amori; lwaza usapo luka‐Sirayeli lwabafungela; kodwa u‐Saule wafuna ukubabulala ebukweleni bake ngenxa yosapo luka‐Sirayeli no‐Juda:)
ngako u‐Davide wati kuba‐Gibeyone: Ndiya kunenzela nto nina? kanjalo ndiya kulwenza uxoliso nganto nina, ukuba nitamsanqelise ilifa likayehova?

Bandula aba‐Gibeyone bati kuye: Asi kokwetu ukubiza isilivere negolide ku‐Saule, nakuyo indlu yake; kanjako asi kokwetu ukufisa umntu kwa‐Sirayeli. Wayesiti: Into eniya kuyiteta, ndiya kunenzela yona.
Baza bati kukumkani: Indoda ebisigqibela, nebicinga ngakuti ukuba sitshatyalaliswe side singabi nakuma kweminye imida yakwa‐Sirayeli,
makunikwe kuti amadoda asixe̔nxe kubo onyana bayo, size siwaxo̔mele uyehova e‐Gibeha ka‐Saule, umqashwa kayehova. Wayesiti ukumkani: Ndiya kuwanika.
Kodwa ukumkani wanenceba pezu kwo‐Mefiboshete, unyana ka‐Jonatane unyana ka‐Saule, ngenxa yesifungo sikayehova, esibe sipakati kwabo, pakati kwo‐Davide no‐Jonatane unyana ka‐Saule.

Koko ukumkani watabata onyana bobabini baka‐Ritsepa intombi ka‐Aya, owabazalela u‐Saule, u‐Aremoni no‐Mefiboshete; nonyana bobahlanu bodade bo‐Mikali intombi ka‐Saule, owabazalela u‐Hadriyeli unyana ka‐Barezilai um‐Mehola;
wabanika esandleni saba‐Gibeyone, ababaxo̔ma entabeni pambi kwoyehova: bawa bosixe̔nxe kwa kunye, bafiswa emihleni yokuvuna, kweyokuqala imihla, ekuqaleni kwokuvunwa kweṙalasi.

Kekaloku u‐Ritsepa intombi ka‐Aya watabata intlakantlaka, wazolulela yona elulwalweni, kwa sekuqaleni kwokuvuna kwada kwatululwa amanzi pezu kwabo ezulwini, engavumelanga ukuba intaka zezulu zipumle pezu kwabo emini, nezilo zasendle ebusuku.
Kwaza kwaxelelwa u‐Davide oko akwenzileyo u‐Ritsepa intombi ka‐Aya, ishweshwe lika‐Saule.

Wandula waya u‐Davide, wasusa amatambo ka‐Saule, namatambo ka‐Jonatane unyana wake, kubo abemi base‐Yabeshe‐gileyadi, abebewebi̔le enkundleni yase‐Bete‐shane, apo ama‐Filistiya ebebaxo̔mile kona, nxa ama‐Filistiya abembulele u‐Saule e‐Giliboha;
waza wenyusa kona amatambo ka‐Saule, namatambo ka‐Jonatane unyana wake; kanjalo amatambo abaxo̔nyiweyo bawabuta.

Baza bawancw̔aba amatambo ka‐Saule naka‐Jonatane unyana wake, elizweni lakwa‐Benjamine e‐Tsela, encw̔abeni lika‐Kishe uyise. Bakwenza konke abeyalele ngako ukumkani. Wada utixo wakungeleka ngenxa yelizwe emveni kwoko.
KEKALOKU ama‐Filistiya ebenokulwa kanjako ngakubo o‐Sirayeli: wehla u‐Davide, nezicaka zake kunye naye, balwa nama‐Filistiya; wada u‐Davide wacubuka.
Waza u‐Shibibenobe, obengowenzalo ka‐Rafa, ontshuntshe ibi zishekele zobedu ezimakulu matatu ukuba nzima kwayo, obebinqiwe ng eṙele elitsha, waba uya kumbulala u‐Davide.
Kodwa u‐Abishai unyana ka‐Tseruya wamsiza, wambeta um‐Filistiya lowo, wamfisa. Andula amadoda ka‐Davide amfungela esiti: Akusayi kubuya upume nati ukuya ekulweni, uze ungacimi isibane so‐Sirayeli.
Kwaye kute emveni kwoko, kwabuya kwabako ukulwa e‐Gobe ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya: okuya u‐Sibekai, um‐Husha, wambulala u‐Safe, obengowenzalo ka‐Rafa.
Kwabuya kwabako ukulwa e‐Gobe ngakuwo ama‐Filistiya: waza u‐Lehanane, unyana ka‐Yare‐oregime, um‐Beteleheme, wambulala umzalwana ka‐Goliyate um‐Gate, oluti lwentshuntshe belunjengomti wabaluki.

Kwabuya kwabako ukulwa e‐Gate: kwaye kuko kona indoda ende, ebineminwe emitandatu ezandleni zayo namazwane amatandatu ezinyaweni zayo, amashumi mabini anesine ngenani; kwa yona ibizalelwe kuma‐Rafa nayo.
Xeshekweni ibigxeka o‐Sirayeli, wandula u‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Shimeha umzalwana ka‐Davide, wayibulala.
Aba bane bazalelwa kuma‐Rafa e‐Gate, bawa ngesandla sika‐Davide, nangesandla sezicaka zake.
WAZA u‐Davide wawateta kuyehova amazwi eliculo, ngomhla uyehova wamsindisayo esandleni sazo zonke intshaba zake, nasesandleni sika‐Saule:
wayesiti: Uyehova uliliwa lam, nenqaba yam, nomkululi wam;
utixo wam, ilityekazi lam; ndiya kutembela kuye: ikaka lam, nopondo lwosindiswa lwam, ihlati lam, nendawo yokupepela yam, umsindisi wam; uyandisindisa wena ebudlwengwini.
Ndobiza kuyehova, odumisekayo; ndandiya kusindiswa ezintshabeni zam.
Ngokuba amaza okufa ebendiṙaula; imisinga yobunginingini yandoyikisa:
intambo zehadesi zandingqonga; imigibe yokufa yandipangela;
ebunzimeni bam ndabiza kuyehova, ndabiza kutixo wam; waza weva ilizwi lam esetempileni yake, nokukala kwam kweza ezindlebeni zake.
Wandula umhlaba wazamazama, wangcangcazela; amasekwa ezulu ashukuma, azamazama, ngokuba ebequmbile.
Kwenyuka umsi ezimpumlweni zake, nomlilo uvela emlonyeni wake wadla; amalahle avuta ngawo.
Wagoba izulu, wehla; sasitokotoko pantsi kwenyawo zake.
Wakwela pezu kwekerubime, wapapazela; wabonakala pezu kwamapiko omoya.
Ubumnyama wabenza intente ngento emngqongayo, intlanganiso yamanzi, amafu abungqingwa ezulu.
Ngenkazimlo epambi kwake avuta amalahle omlilo.
Uyehova wadudumisa ezulwini; opezu konke wanika ilizwi lake.
Watuma intolo, wabacita; n emibane, wabapitizelisa.
Kwandula kwabonakala amazantsi olwandle, atyileka amasekwa omhlaba, ngokutetisa kukayehova, ngokuquta kwomoya wempumlo zake.
Wasusa pezulu, wanditabata; wandir̔ola emanzini amaninzi;
wandisindisa elutshabeni lwam olunamandla; na kwabo banditiyayo, ngokuba bebendidlula ngamandla.
Bandipangela ngomhla wengozi yam; kodwa uyehova ebesisixaso kum.
Wandipumisela endaweni ebanzi, wandikulula, ngokuba ebekoliswa ndim.
Uyehova wandivuza njengobulungisa bam; njengobumhlope bezandla zam wandibuyekezela.
Ngokuba ndizigcinile indlela zikayehova, ndandingemkanga ngenkohlakalo kutixo wam.
Ngokuba zonke izigwebo zake zibe zipambi kwam; nemimiso yake andipambukanga kuyo.
Bendilungisekile pambi kwake, ndandizibamba enkohlakalweni yam:
ngako uyehova undibuyekezele njengobulungisa bam, njengobumhlope bam pambi kwamehlo ake.
Konobubele uyazibonakalisa unobubele; kwindoda elungisekile uyazibonakalisa ulungisekile;
komsulwa uyazibonakalisa umsulwa; nakogwenxa uyazibonakalisa ugwenxa.
Kanjalo abantu ababandezelweyo uyabasindisa; kodwa amehlo ako angakubo abaner̔atshi, ukuba ubatobise.
Ngokuba wena usisibane sam, Yehova! uyehova uyakanyisa ubumnyama bam.
Ngokuba ngawe ndiliwele ibandla; ngotixo wam ndigqitile eludongeni.
Utixo indlela yake ifezekile ukulunga; ilizwi likayehova licocekile: ulikaka yena kubo bonke abatembela kuye.
Ngokuba ngubanina ongutixo ngapandle kwoyehova? ngubanina olilityekazi ngapandle kwotixo wetu?
Utixo uyinqaba yam yamandla; uyamalatisa olungisekileyo indlela yake.
Uyenza inyawo zam zibe njengezamaxamakazi; uyandimisa ezinyangweni zam.
Uyafundisa izandla zam ukulwa, side sityedwe isipeta sexina ngengalo zam.
Undipile ikaka losindiso lwako; ukululama kwako kundenze mkulu.
Wabusenza banzi ukunyatela kwam pantsi kwam; ati amaqata am akahexa.
Ndaputuma intshaba zam, ndazitshabalalisa; andabuya ndada ndazigqibela.
Ndazigqibela, ndazityumza, azabuya zivuke; zawa pantsi kwenyawo zam.
Ngokuba ubundibinqela ukulwa ngamandla; ubatobisile pantsi kwam abo babevuka ngakum:
wandinika umhlana wentshaba zam, ndize ndibapelise abanditiyayo.
Bakangela, kodwa bekungeko osindisayo; kwa kuyehova, kodwa akabapendula.
Ndaza ndabacolekisa njengotuli lwomhlaba; ndabanqusha njengenkunkuma yesitarate, ndabangqisha.
Kanjalo undikulule emapikeni abantu bam, wandigcina ndibe yintloko yentlanga; abantu endingabazanga bayandikonza.
Abasemzini bayazenzisa kum; ngokuva kwendlebe bayapulapula kum.
Abasemzini bayasinya, bayabinqa bapume ezinqatyeni zabo.
Uyehova uhleli; malibongwe ilityekazi lam; makadunyiswe utixo wam, ilityekazi losindiswa lwam.
Ngutixo ondenzela impindezelo, oweyelisa abantu pantsi kwam,
ondipumisa ezintshabeni zam: wena undipakamisele ngapezulu kwabo bavuka ngakum; undikulule emntwini wobudlwengu.
