Ngako oko ndobulela kuwe, Yehova! pakati kwabaheyideni, ndicule egameni lako:
owandisa intsindiswa zokumkani wake; owenza ububele kumtanjiswa wake, ku‐Davide, nakuyo inzalo yake kude kube ngunapakade.
NANGA amazwi okugqibela ka‐Davide: watsho u‐Davide unyana ka‐Jese, yatsho indoda ebipakanyiswa pezulu, umtanjiswa wotixo ka‐Yakobi, nomculi omnandi wakwa‐Sirayeli, ukuti:
Umoya kayehova wateta ngam, nelizwi lake belipezu kwolwimi lwam.
Wati utixo wo‐Sirayeli, — olilityekazi lo‐Sirayeli wateta kum, esiti: Kwobako umpati pezu kwabantu olungileyo, umpati emoyika utixo;
oya kuba njengokukanya kwokusa, lakupuma ilanga, njeng okwokusa okungenamafu, njeng enca eluhlaza ipuma emhlabeni ngokukazimla emva kwemvula.

Nakuba indlu yam ingenjalo kutixo, undimisele ucebano olungunapakade noko, olulungiselelweyo ngento zonke, oluqinisiweyo; ngokuba engayi kuluhlumisa ngenyaniso na lwonke usindiswa lwam, nalo lwonke unqwenelo lwam?
Kodwa abalusapo lwobunginingini bona bonke boba njengameva asunduzwayo, ngokuba engenako ukutatyatwa ngezandla;
nosukuba eya kuwapata, wonqatyiswa ngentsimbi nangoluti lwentshuntshe; aeya kutshiswa kanye ngomlilo endaweni yawo.

NANGA amagama amagoṙa u‐Davide abenawo: u‐Yoshebe‐bashebete um‐Tahakemoni, intloko yenjengele; nguye u‐Hadino um‐Hetsene: yena wavivinya intshuntshe yake ngakuwo amakulu asibozo abahlatyiweyo nguye ngexesha linye.

Kwaye kuko emva kwake u‐Elezari, unyana ka‐Dodo, unyana wom‐Ahoha; ebepakati kwawo amagoṙa amatatu ndawonye no‐Davide, akuba ebegxeka ama‐Filistiya abebutene kona ukulwa, nxa amadoda akwa Sirayeli abenyukile:
wesuka yena, wabulala ama‐Filistiya sada sadinwa isandla sake, sati nama isandla sake eṙeleni: waza uyehova wenza usindiso olukulu ngalomhla; bati abantu babuyela emva kwake ngenxa yokupanga kupela.
Kwaye kuko emva kwake u‐Shama, unyana ka‐Age, um‐Harari. Kekaloku ama‐Filistiya ebebutene abe libandla, apo bekuko kona isahlulo somhlaba sizele zilentile; baza abantu besaba ebusweni bama‐Filistiya.
Kodwa wazimisa pakati kwentsimi leyo, wayilondoloza, wawabulala ama‐Filistiya: waza uyehova wenza usindiso olukulu.
Kwaye kusihla abatatu bakubo abamashumi matatu abazintloko, beza ku‐Davide ngexesha lokuvuna emqolombeni we‐Hadulame; lati ibandla lama‐Filistiya lati waca emhlanjeni wama‐Rafa.
Waye u‐Davide oko ebesenqatyeni, nelali yama‐Filistiya ibiko oko e‐Beteleheme.
Waza u‐Davide walangazelela, wati: Akwaba bendinokusezwa amanzi equleni lase‐Beteleheme, elisesangweni!

Asuka lamagoṙa matatu atyoboza emkosini wama‐Filistiya, aka amanzi equleni lase‐Beteleheme, elisesangweni, awatwala, awazisa ku‐Davide: koko u‐Davide ebengavumi ukuwasela, kodwa wawatululela kuyehova,
wati: Makube lé kum, Yehova! ukuba ndiyenze lento; ndiya kusela igazi lalamadoda na, abehamba ngokubuncama ubomi bawo? ngako ebengavumi ukuwasela. Ezizinto azenza lawomagoṙa matatu.
Kanjalo u‐Abishai, umninawe ka‐Jowabi, unyana ka‐Tseruya, ebeyintloko yabatatu: yena wavivinya intshuntshe yake ngakuwo amakulu matatu abahlatyiweyo nguye, waza wanegama pakati kwabatatu abo.
Kubo abatatu abo asi nguye na obekekileyo? ngako waba yinkosi yabo; kodwa akafikelela kwabatatu bokuqala.

No‐Benaya, unyana ka‐Yoyada, unyana wendoda ebuṙoti, obemkulu ngezenzo, owase‐Kabetsele, yena wabulala amadoda mabini abungonyamaṙa ase‐Mowabi: kanjako wehla wabulala ingonyama pakati kwomnxuma ngomhla wengqele:

wabulala nendoda engum‐Jipete, indoda enomkita; nasesandleni som‐Jipete lowo ibiko intshuntshe; koko wehlela kuye ngentonga, wayityutula intshuntshe esandleni som‐Jipete, wambulala ngeyake intshuntshe.
Ezizinto wazenza u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, waza wanegama pakati kwalawomagoṙa matatu.
Pakati kwabo abamashumi matatu ebebekekile; kodwa akafikelela kwabatatu bokuqala. Wati u‐Davide wammisa pezu kwomlisela wake.
U‐Hasaheli umninawe ka‐Jowabi ebepakati kwabo abamashumi matatu; u‐Lehanane unyana ka‐Dodo, um‐Beteleheme;
u‐Shama, um‐Harodi; u‐Elika, um‐Harodi;
u‐Heletse, um‐Paliti; u‐Hira unyana ka‐Hikeshe, um‐Tekoha;
u‐Abihezere, um‐Hanatote; u‐Mebunai, um‐Husha;
u‐Tsalimone, um‐Ahoha; u‐Maharai, um‐Netofati;
u‐Helebe unyana ka‐Bahana, um‐Netofati; u‐Yitai unyana ka‐Ribai, owase‐Gibeha yosapo luka‐Benjamine;
u‐Benaya, um‐Piratone; u‐Hidai, owasezintilini zase‐Gahashe;
u‐Abi‐halibone, um‐Haraba; u‐Hazamaveti, um‐Bahurime;
u‐Eliyaba, um‐Shahalaboni; kubo onyana baka‐Yashene, u‐Jonatane;
u‐Shama, um‐Harari; u‐Ahiyame unyana ka‐Sharare, um‐Harari;
u‐Elifelete unyana ka‐Ahasebai, unyana wom‐Mahaka; u‐Eliyame unyana ka‐Ahitofele, um‐Gilo;
u‐Hetserai, um‐Karamele; u‐Parai, um‐Areba;
u‐Yigali unyana ka‐Natane, owase‐Tsoba; u‐Bani, um‐Gadi;
u‐Tseleki, um‐Hamoni; u‐Naharai, um‐Berote, umtwali wezixo̔bo ku‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya;
u‐Hira, um‐Yetere; u‐Garebi, um‐Yetere;
u‐Huriya, um‐Hete: bonke bangamashumi matatu anesixe̔nxe.
YABUYA yavuta ingqumbo kayehova ngakubo o‐Sirayeli; waza wamvusa u‐Davide ngakubo, esiti: Hamba, ubale o‐Sirayeli no‐Juda.
Wayesiti ukumkani ku‐Jowabi, inkosi yempi ebinaye: Kaucande kuzo zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli, kwa se‐Dane kude kube se‐Beresheba, nibale abantu, ukuba ndilazi inani labantu.

Waza wati u‐Jowabi kukumkani: Makongeze uyehova, utixo wako, ebantwini, inani elinjengokuba bengaka, nelinjengokuba bengaka kube ngamaxesha alikulu, aze amehlo enkosi yam ukumkani abone oko: kunganina pofu ukuba inkosi yam ukumkani inyamekela lento?
Kodwa ilizwi lokumkani belinamandla pezu kwelika‐Jowabi, napezu kwelenkosi zempi. Waza wapuma u‐Jowabi nenkosi zempi ebusweni bokumkani ukuya kubala abantu, o‐Sirayeli.
Basuka bawela i‐Yoredane, bati waca e‐Harohere, ngasesuyide yesixeko esipakati kwentili ka‐Gadi, nangase‐Yahezere:
bandula beza e‐Gileyadi, nasezweni lase‐Tahetime‐hodeshi; beza nase‐Dane‐yahane, na seziceni elingqongayo i‐Tsidone;
beza nasenqatyeni yase‐Tire, nakuzo izixeko zama‐Hivi nezaba‐Kanane; bada bapumela ngasesuyide yakwa‐Juda, e‐Beresheba.
Bati bakuba becandile kulo lonke ilizwe, bafika e‐Yerusaleme ekupeleni kwenyanga ezilitoba nentsuku ezimashumi mabini.

Waza u‐Jowabi wanika inani lokubalwa kwabantu kukumkani: kekaloku kwabako kwa‐Sirayeli amawaka angamakulu asibozo amadoda abuṙoti, aber̔ola iṙele; namadoda akwa‐Juda, ebengamadoda angamawaka angamakulu mahlanu.

Yandula intliziyo ka‐Davide yambeta, emveni kwokuba ebebalile abantu. Waza wati u‐Davide kuyehova: Ndonile kakulu ngoko endikwenzileyo: kodwa kaloku, Yehova! zukwelelise inkohlakalo yesicaka sako, ngokuba ndenze ngobudenge kakulu.
Kwati kwakuvuka u‐Davide kusasa, kweza ilizwi likayehova ku‐Gadi umprofite, umboni ka‐Davide, lisiti:
Hamba, uye utete ku‐Davide, usiti: Utsho uyehova ukuti: Izinto ezintatu ndiyazibeka pambi kwako; zinyulele ibe nye kuzo, ukuba ndiyenze kuwe.

Wasuka u‐Gadi weza ku‐Davide, wamxelela, wati kuye: Kuya kuza kuwe iminyaka esixe̔nxe yendlala na elizweni lako? umhlaumbi uya kwesaba na inyanga ezintatu pambi kwentshaba zako, nxa zikuputumayo? umhlaumbi iya kubako imihla emitatu yesifo esibubisayo elizweni lako kusinina? telekelela kaloku, ugqale lelinina ilizwi endiya kulibuyisela konditumileyo.
Waza u‐Davide wati ku‐Gadi: Ndixakekile kakulu; makesiwe esandleni sikayehova, ngokuba izibele zake zininzi; mandingawi esandleni sabantu.
Ngako uyehova watuma isifo esibubisayo kwa‐Sirayeli, kwa kuwo umso lowo kude kwakulo ixesha elimisiweyo: aza afa kubantu, kwa se‐Dane kude kwase‐Beresheba, amadoda angamawaka angamashumi asixe̔nxe.

Yati yakwolula ingelosi isandla sayo pezu kwe‐Yerusaleme ukuyitshabalalisa, wandula uyehova waba nosizi pezu kwobubi obo, wati kuyo ingelosi ebitshabalalisa ebantwini: Kwanele; yekisa kaloku isandla sako. Kekaloku ingelosi kayehova ibingasesibayeni sokubula sika‐Arauna um‐Yebusi.

Waza wateta u‐Davide kuyehova, akuyibona ingelosi ebibeta ebantwini, wati: Bona ke, ndim ondonileyo, kanjalo ndim ondenze ngobugwenxa; kodwa igusha ezi, yinto nina ziyenzileyo? isandla sako masibe ngakum, nangakuyo indlu kabawo.
Kanjalo u‐Gadi weza ku‐Davide ngalomhla, wati kuye: Nyuka, ummisele uyehova isibingelo esibayeni sokubula sika‐Arauna um‐Yebusi.
Waye u‐Davide wenyuka ngelizwi lika‐Gadi, njengokuba uyehova ebeyalele.
Wati u‐Arauna wakangela, wabona ukumkani nezicaka zake bedlula besiza ngakuye; waza wapuma u‐Arauna, wazitoba pambi kwokumkani ngobuso bake ngasemhlabeni.

Waza wati u‐Arauna: Kunganina ukuba inkosi yam ukumkani ize esicakeni sayo? Wayesiti u‐Davide: Ukuba nditenge kuwe isibaya sokubula, ukuze ndimakele uyehova isibingelo, ukuba isibulalo sinqamke ebantwini.

Wandula u‐Arauna wati ku‐Davide: Maiti inkosi yam ukumkani itabate inikele konke okulungileyo emehlweni ayo; kangela, nanzi inkabi zibe lidini lokutshiswa, nenqwelwana zokubula nempahla zenkabi zibe zinkuni.
Ezizinto zonke wazinika u‐Arauna kuye ukumkani. Wati kanjalo u‐Arauna kukumkani: Uyehova, utixo wako, makakubuke.

Kodwa ukumkani wati ku‐Arauna: Hai; koko ndiya kusitenga ngenyaniso kuwe ngenani: ngokuba ndingayi kunikela kuyehova, utixo wam, amadini okutshiswa angamelwanga nto. Kwa njalo u‐Davide watenga isibaya sokubula nenkabi ngeshekele zesilivere ezimashumi mahlanu.
Waza u‐Davide wakela kona kuyehova isibingelo, wanikela amadini okutshiswa neminikelo yoxolo. Ngako uyehova wakungeleka ngenxa yelizwe, sada sanqamka isibulalo kwa‐Sirayeli.
KEKALOKU ukumkani u‐Davide ebemdala, ekolisile ukuba nemihla; baye bemgubungela ngengubo, kodwa bekungeko kufudumala kuye.
Zaza izicaka zake zati kuye: Makufunelwe inkosi yam ukumkani intombi, intombi ipela, eya kuma ebusweni bokumkani, ibe likolwanekazi lake; mailale esifubeni sako, ize ifudumale inkosi yam ukumkani.
Basuka bafuna intombi entle kuyo yonke imida yakwa‐Sirayeli, bamfumana u‐Abishage um‐Shunemekazi, bamzisa kukumkani.
Yaye intombi leyo ibintle kunene, yaba likolwanekazi lokumkani, yamonga; kodwa ukumkani wabengayazi.
Wandula u‐Adonija unyana ka‐Hagiti wazipakamisa, esiti: Mna ndoba ngukumkani; waza wazilungisela inqwelo nabakweli bamahashe, namadoda angamashumi mahlanu abaleke pambi kwake.
Kekaloku uyise ebengambindisanga emihleni yake ngokuti: Yinina ukuba wenje njalo? Yena naye ebemhle kakulu isimilo sake, wati unina wamzala emva kwo‐Abasalome.
Waza wacebisana no‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya, no‐Abiyatare umperisite; ababenceda, belandela u‐Adonija.
Kodwa u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, no‐Natane umprofite, no‐Shimehi, no‐Rehi, namagoṙa abengaka‐Davide, bebengeko no‐Adonija.

Waza u‐Adonija wabinga igusha, nenkabi, nenkomo ezityetyisiweyo, ngasetyeni le‐Zohelete, elingasemtonjeni we‐Rogele, wamema bonke abazalwana bake, onyana bokumkani, nawo onke amadoda akwa‐Juda, izicaka zokumkani:
kodwa u‐Natane umprofite, no‐Benaya, namagoṙa, no‐Solomone umzalwana wake, akabamema.
Wandula wateta u‐Natane ku‐Batesheba unina ka‐Solomone, esiti: Akuvile na okokuba u‐Adonija unyana ka‐Hagiti ungukumkani, inkosi yetu u‐Davide ingakwazi nje?
Ngako kaloku yiza ke, makendikunike icebo, ukuba usindise ubomi bako, nobomi bonyana wako u‐Solomone.

Hamba uye ungene kukumkani u‐Davide, uti kuye: Akufunganga na wena, nkosi yam, kumkani! kwisicakakazi sako, ngokuti: Ngenyaniso u‐Solomone unyana wako woba ngukumkani emva kwam, waeya kuhlala yena pezu kweterone yam? kunganina ngoko ukuba u‐Adonija ungukumkani?
Bona ke, nxa usateta kona nokumkani, sendiya kungena mna emva kwako, ndiwaqinise amazwi ako.
Waza u‐Batesheba wangena kukumkani enkambilini: kekaloku ukumkani ebemdala kakulu; wati u‐Abishage um‐Shunemekazi wamonga ukumkani.
Watoba pantsi u‐Batesheba, waziqubuda pambi kwokumkani. Waza wati ukumkani: Ufuna nto nina?
Wayesiti kuye: Nkosi yam! wena wamfunga uyehova, utixo wako, kwisicakakazi sako, ngokuti: Ngenyaniso u‐Solomone unyana wako woba ngukumkani emva kwam, waeya kuhlala yena pezu kweterone yam!
Kanti kaloku, nanku u‐Adonija engukumkani; kanti kaloku, nkosi yam, kumkani! akukwazi:
kanjalo ubingile inkabi, nenkomo ezityetyisiweyo, negusha ngento eninzi, wamema bonke onyana bokumkani, no‐Abiyatare umperisite, no‐Jowabi inkosi yomkosi; kodwa u‐Solomone isicaka sako akammemanga.
Nawe, nkosi yam, kumkani! amehlo o‐Sirayeli bonke angakuwe, ukuba ubaxelele ungubanina oya kuhlala pezu kweterone yenkosi yam ukumkani emva kwayo.
Okanye kuya kuti, nxa inkosi yam ukumkani iya kulala noyise bayo, mna nonyana wam u‐Solomone soba ngaboni.
Kekaloku bona ke, nxa asateta nokumkani, wangena no‐Natane umprofite.
Kwaxelwa ke kukumkani, kusitwa: Nanku u‐Natane umprofite. Waza wangena ebusweni bokumkani, wazitoba pambi kwokumkani ngobuso bake ngasemhlabeni.
Wayesiti u‐Natane: Nkosi yam, kumkani! utshilo na wena ukuti: u‐Adonija woba ngukumkani emva kwam, waeya kuhlala yena pezu kweterone yam?

Ngokuba ehlile namhla, waya wabinga inkabi, nenkomo ezityetyisiweyo, negusha ngento eninzi, wamema bonke onyana bokumkani, nenkosi zomkosi, no‐Abiyatare umperisite: kanjalo, bona ke, bayadla bayasela nokusela pambi kwake, bati: Makapile ukumkani u‐Adonija!
Kodwa mna, mna sicaka sako, no‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, no‐Solomone isicaka sako, akasimemanga.
Kanene lento yenziwe yinkosi yam ukumkani na, ungasazisanga ke isicaka sako ungubanina oya kuhlala pezu kweterone yenkosi yam ukumkani emva kwayo?
Wapendula ukumkani u‐Davide, wati: Ndibizele u‐Batesheba. Waza wangena ebusweni bokumkani, wema pambi kwokumkani.
Wandula wafunga ukumkani, wati: Ehleli nje uyehova, okululeyo umpefumlo wam kulo lwonke uxinezeko;

ngenyaniso, njengokuba bendikufungela uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ndisiti: Ngenyaniso u‐Solomone unyana wako woba ngukumkani emva kwam, waeya kuhlala yena pezu kweterone yam esikundleni sam; ngenyaniso ndiya kwenje njalo namhla nje.
Waza u‐Batesheba watoba ngobuso ngasemhlabeni, waziqubuda pambi kwokumkani, wati: Maipile inkosi yam ukumkani u‐Davide kude kube ngunapakade!
Wayesiti ukumkani u‐Davide: Ndibizele u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Natane umprofite, no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada. Baza bangena ebusweni bokumkani.
Waza ukumkani wati kubo: Zitabateni nani izicaka zenkosi yenu, nikwelise u‐Solomone unyana wam pezu kweqwaṙaṙa elilelam, nihle naye ngase‐Gihone;
mabati u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Natane umprofite, bamtambise kona abe ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli; nize nivutele ngexilongo, niti: Makapile ukumkani u‐Solomone!
Niya kwandula ninyuke emva kwake, ukuba eze ahlale pezu kweterone yam; ngokuba yena eya kuba ngukumkani esikundleni sam; kanjalo yena ndimmisele ukuba abe yinkosi pezu kwo‐Sirayeli napezu kwo‐Juda.
Waza u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada wapendula ukumkani, wati: Amene; wanga angatsho njalo uyehova, utixo wenkosi yam ukumkani!
Njengokuba uyehova ebeko nenkosi yam ukumkani, kwa njalo makabeko no‐Solomone; neterone yake ayenze nkulu pezu kweterone yenkosi yam ukumkani u‐Davide.
Wandula wehla u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Natane umprofite, no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, naba‐Kereti, naba‐Peleti, bamkwelisa u‐Solomone pezu kwalo iqwaṙaṙa lokumkani u‐Davide, bamkokela ngase‐Gihone.
Waye u‐Tsadoki umperisite watabata upondo lweoli ententeni, wamtambisa u‐Solomone. Baza bavutela ngexilongo, bati bonke abantu: Makapile ukumkani u‐Solomone!
Basuka bonke abantu benyuka emva kwake, bati abantu kanjalo baloza ngemilozi, bavuya ngovuyo olukulu, wada waṙazuka umhlaba ngentlokoma yabo.
Kekaloku weva u‐Adonija, nabo bonke abamenywa ababenaye, nxa bebegqibile ukudla. Weva no‐Jowabi intlokoma yexilongo, wati: Inganina le ngxokozelo yesixeko sinempitimpiti?
Nxa asateta, bona ke, u‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Abiyatare umperisite, wafika; waza wati u‐Adonija: Ngena, ngokuba wena uyindoda etembekileyo, uya kushumayela indaba ezilungileyo.
Wapendula u‐Jonatane wati ku‐Adonija: Okunene inkosi yetu, ukumkani u‐Davide, imenzile u‐Solomone abe ngukumkani;
waye ukumkani etumile naye, u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Natane umprofite, no‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, naba‐Kereti, naba‐Peleti, abamkwelisile pezu kwalo iqwaṙaṙa lokumkani;
kanjalo u‐Tsadoki umperisite, no‐Natane umprofite, bamtambisile abe ngukumkani e‐Gihone; benyukile kwa kona bevuya, sada sazanyazanyiswa isixeko: yiyo ingxokozelo eniyivileyo:
nakanjako u‐Solomone uhleli pezu kweterone yobukumkani.

Ewe kanjako zeza izicaka zokumkani ukutamsanqelisa inkosi yetu, ukumkani u‐Davide, zisiti: Igama lika‐Solomone makalenze utixo lilungile pezu kwegama lako, neterone yake ayenze nkulu pezu kweterone yako. Waza ukumkani wazitoba pezu kwomandlalo.
Kananjalo watsho ukumkani ukuti: Makabongwe uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ondinikileyo namhla ohleliyo pezu kweterone yam, amehlo am ebonile nje!
Baza bankwantya bonke abamenywa ababekuye u‐Adonija, besuka, bahamba abanye ngabanye ngendlela yabo.
Woyika no‐Adonija ngenxa ka‐Solomone, wesuka, wahamba, waya wabambelela ezimpondweni zesibingelo.

Kwaza kwashunyayelwa ku‐Solomone, kusitwa: Nankuya u‐Adonija esoyika ukumkani u‐Solomone; ngokuba, bona ke, selebambile impondo zesibingelo, esiti: Makandifungele namhla nje ukumkani u‐Solomone, ukuba akayi kufisa isicaka sake ngeṙele.
Wayesiti u‐Solomone: Ukuba uya kwenza njengendoda etembekileyo, akuyi kuwa nalunye lwenwele zake ngasemhlabeni; kodwa ukuba inkohlakalo iya kufunyanwa kuye, uya kwandula afe.
Watuma ke u‐Solomone, baza bamhlisa esibingelweni. Wasuka weza, wazitoba pambi kwokumkani u‐Solomone. Wati u‐Solomone kuye: Yiya endlwini yako.
KWADA kwasondela imihla ka‐Davide yokuba afe; waza wamyolela u‐Solomone unyana wake, esiti:
Mna ndiyahamba ngendlela yomhlaba wonke: uze womelele, wenze njengendoda;

uwugcine umyalezelo kayehova, utixo wako, ukuhamba ezindleleni zake, ukugcina imimiso yake, n emiyalelo yake, nezigwebo zake, nezinqi̔nelo zake, njengokuba̔liweyo emtetweni ka‐Mosesi: ukuze ulungiseke kuko konke okwenzayo, nalapo usukuba usinga kona;

ukuze uyehova aliqinise ilizwi owalitetayo ngam, esiti: Ukuba onyana bako baya kulumkela indlela yabo, ukuhamba ebusweni bam ngenyaniso, ngayo yonke intliziyo yabo, nangawo wonke umpefumlo wabo, akuyi kukunqamkela indoda (wabesitsho) pezu kweterone yakwa‐Sirayeli.

Kanjako wena uyakwazi oko wakwenzayo kum u‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya, oko wakwenzayo kwinkosi ezimbini zemikosi yo‐Sirayeli, ku‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere, naku‐Hamasa unyana ka‐Yetere, owababulalayo, wapalaza igazi lemfazwe ekuxoleni, wabeka igazi lemfazwe pezu kwombinqo wake obusesinqeni sake, napezu kwezihlangu zake ebezisezinyaweni zake:
yenza ngoko ngobulumko bako, uze ungazihliseli encw̔abeni izimvi zake ngoxolo.
Kodwa onyana baka‐Barezilai um‐Gileyadi, benzele bona ububele; mababe pakati kwabo abadlayo etafileni yako: ngokuba kwa ngokunjalo bebesondela kum, ndakusaba ebusweni buka‐Abasalome umzalwana wako.

Kanjalo, bona ke, kuko nawe u‐Shimehi unyana ka‐Gera, um‐Benjamine wase‐Bahurime, owandiqalekisayo ngesiqalekiso esinzima, emhleni ndabendisiya e‐Mahanayime: kodwa wehla ukuza kundikaulela e‐Yoredane, ndaza ndamfungela uyehova, ndisiti: Andiyi kukufisa ngeṙele.
Ngako kaloku, ungamyeki angabi natyala, ngokuba wena uyindoda elumkileyo; wauya kukwazi oko unga ukwenza kuye, ukuba uzihlisele encw̔abeni izimvi zake ngegazi.
Wada walala u‐Davide noyise bake, wancw̔atywa esixekweni sika‐Davide.

Kekaloku imihla u‐Davide ebepete ubukumkani ngayo pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, ibiyiminyaka engamashumi mane: e‐Hebrone wapata ubukumkani iminyaka yasixe̔nxe, nase‐Yerusaleme wapata ubukumkani iminyaka yamashumi matatu anamitatu.
WAZA u‐Solomone wahlala pezu kweterone ka‐Davide uyise; bati ubukumkani bake baqiniswa kakulu.
Wandula weza u‐Adonija unyana ka‐Hagiti ku‐Batesheba unina ka‐Solomone; owati: Luxolo na ukuza kwako? Wayesiti: Luxolo.
Walekela wati: Ndinelizwi kuwe. Wayesiti: Teta.

Waza wati: Uyazi wena ukuba ubukumkani ububobam, nokuba bonke o‐Sirayeli bebebekile ubuso babo pezu kwam, ukuba ndibe ngukumkani; kodwa buguqukile ubukumkani, baba bobomzalwana wam; ngokuba bebubobake buvela kuyehova.
Nakaloku, ndiyacela isicelo sinye kuwe, ungasongi ubuso bam. Wayesiti kaye: Teta.
Waza wati: Zutete ku‐Solomone ukumkani, (ngokuba engayi kusonga ubuso bako,) ukuba andinike u‐Abishage um‐Shunemekazi abe ngumfazi.
Wayesiti u‐Batesheba: Kulungile; ndokutetela kukumkani.

Waza waya u‐Batesheba kukumkani u‐Solomone, ukuba atete kuye ngenxa ka‐Adonija. Wesuka ke ukumkani ukuya kumkaulela, watoba kuye; wandula wahlala eteroneni yake, wambekela unina wokumkani isihlalo; waya wahlala ngasekunene kwake.
Waza wati: Ndiyacela kuwe isicelo sinye esincinane, ungasongi ubuso bam. Wati ukumkani kuye: Cela, ma̔! ngokuba ndingayi kusonga ubuso bako.
Wayesiti: Makanikwe u‐Abishage um‐Shunemekazi ku‐Adonija umzalwana wako abe ngumfazi.

Wapendula ukumkani u‐Solomone, wati kuye unina: Kunganina pofu ukuba umcelele u‐Adonija u‐Abishage um‐Shunemekazi? mcelele ubukumkani nabo; ngokuba engumkuluwe wam yena; ewe cel ela yena, no‐Abiyatare umperisite, no‐Jowabi unyana ka‐Tseruya.
Waza ukumkani u‐Solomone wafunga uyehova, esiti: Utixo makenje njalo kum, alekele ukwenje njalo, ukuba u‐Adonija akalitetanga elilizwi ngakubo ubomi bake!
Ngako kaloku, ehleli nje uyehova, ondiqinisileyo, wandihlalisa pezu kweterone ka‐Davide ubawo, nondenzeleyo indlu, njengoko abekutetile, ngenyaniso namhla uya kufiswa u‐Adonija!
Wandula watuma ukumkani u‐Solomone ngesandla sika‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada; owamwelayo wada wafa.

Nakuye u‐Abiyatare umperisite wati ukumkani: Hamba uye e‐Hanatote, emasimini ako; ngokuba wena ufanelwe kukufa: kodwa ngelixesha andiyi kukufisa, ngokuba ubuyitwala ityeya yenkosi e nguyehova pambi kwo‐Davide ubawo, nangokuba ububandezelwa kuko konke wabebandezelwa ngako ubawo.
Waza u‐Solomone wamgxota u‐Abiyatare, ukuba angabi ngumperisite kuyehova; kuze kuzalisekiswe ilizwi likayehova, abelitetile pezu kwendlu ka‐Heli e‐Shilo.

Zada zafika indaba ku‐Jowabi; ngokuba u‐Jowabi ebepambukele emva kwo‐Adonija, nangona abengapambukelanga emva kwo‐Abasalome. Wandula u‐Jowabi wesabela ententeni kayehova, wabambelela ezimpondweni zesibingelo.

Kwaza kwashunyayelwa kukumkani u‐Solomone, okokuba u‐Jowabi wesabele ententeni kayehova, nokuba nankuya ngasesibingelweni. Wandula u‐Solomone watuma u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, esiti: Hamba, uye umwele.

Wasuka u‐Benaya weza ententeni kayehova, wati kuye: Utsho ukumkani ukuti: Puma. Wayesiti: Hai; koko ndiya kufa kwa lapa. Wabuya u‐Benaya wazisa impendulo kukumkani, esiti: Kungokunje watetayo u‐Jowabi, nangokunje wandipendula.
Wati ukumkani kuye: Yenza njengoko akutetileyo, umwele, umncw̔abe; ukuze ususe igazi elingenatyala, elo walipalazayo u‐Jowabi, kwa kum, nakuyo indlu kabawo.

Waye uyehova eya kubuyisa igazi lake pezu kweyake intloko, owawela amadoda amabini abemgqita ngobulungisa nangokulunga, wawabulala ngeṙele, ubawo u‐Davide engazi nje; kwa u‐Abenere unyana ka‐Nere, inkosi yomkosi wo‐Sirayeli, no‐Hamasa unyana ka‐Yetere, inkosi yomkosi wo‐Juda.

Kwa njalo igazi labo liya kubuya pezu kwentloko ka‐Jowabi, napezu kwentloko yenzalo yake kude kube ngunapakade; kodwa ku‐Davide, nakuyo inzalo yake, nakuyo indlu yake, nakuyo iterone yake, kwobako uxolo kude kube ngunapakade luvela kuyehova.
Wasuka wenyuka u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, wamwela, wamfisa; waza wancw̔atywa endlwini yake entlango.
Wandula ukumkani wammisa u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada esikundleni sake pezu kwomkosi; no‐Tsadoki umperisite, ukumkani wammisa esikundleni sika‐Abiyatare.
Waza watuma ukumkani wambiza u‐Shimehi, wati kuye: Zakele indlu e‐Yerusaleme, uhlale apo, uze ungapumi kona ukuya nalapa napaya:
ngokuba kuya kuti ngomhla wokupuma kwako, nxa uya kuwela umlanjana we‐Kidrone, woqinisa ukwazi ukuba uya kufa ngenyaniso; igazi lako loba pezu kweyako intloko.
Wayesiti u‐Shimehi kukumkani: Lilungile ilizwi elo; njengoko ikutetileyo inkosi yam ukumkani, siya kwenje njalo isicaka sako. Waza u‐Shimehi wahlala e‐Yerusaleme imihla yamininzi.
Kwaye kute ekupeleni kweminyaka mitatu, zaqwesha izicaka zibini zika‐Shimehi zaya ku‐Akishe unyana ka‐Mahaka, ukumkani we‐Gate. Kwaza kwaxelwa ku‐Shimehi, kusitwa: Naziya izicaka zako e‐Gate.
Wandula wesuka u‐Shimehi, wabopa iqwaṙashe lake, wahambela e‐Gate ku‐Akishe ukufuna izicaka zake; wahamba ke u‐Shimehi, wabuyisa izicaka zake e‐Gate.
Kwada kwashunyayelwa ku‐Solomone, okokuba u‐Shimehi ebemkile e‐Yerusaleme waya e‐Gate, nokuba ebebuyile.

Waza watuma ukumkani wambiza u‐Shimehi, wati kuye: Andikufungisanga uyehova na, ndanqi̔nisa kuwe, ndisiti: Ngomhla wokupuma kwako, nxa uya kuhamba nalapa napaya, qinisa ukwazi ukuba uya kufa ngenyaniso? waza wati kum: Lilungile ilizwi endilivileyo.
Kunganina ngoko ukuba akugcinanga isifungo sikayehova, nomyalelo endikuyaleleyo ngawo?
Walekela wati ukumkani ku‐Shimehi: Uyazi wena yonke inkohlakalo, leyo iyaziyo intliziyo yako, obuyenza ku‐Davide ubawo; ngako uyehova uya kubuyisa inkohlakalo yako pezu kweyako intloko;
kodwa ukumkani u‐Solomone uya kutanyusanqelwa, neterone ka‐Davide yona yoqiniswa pambi kwoyehova kude kube ngunapakade.
Waza ukumkani wamyalela u‐Benaya unyana ka‐Yoyada, owapuma ke, wamwela, wada wafa. Kwa njalo ubukumkani bebuqiniswa esandleni sake u‐Solomone.

WAZA u‐Solomone watshatiselana no‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete, wayizeka intombi ka‐Faro, wayizisa esixekweni sika‐Davide, wada wagqiba ukwaka indlu yake, nendlu kayehova, nodonga lwe‐Yerusaleme ngento engqongayo.
Kodwa abantu babingela ezindaweni ezipakamileyo, ngokuba bekungeko indlu eyakelwa igama likayehova, kwada kwayimihla leyo.
Waye u‐Solomone emtanda uyehova, ehamba emimisweni ka‐Davide uyise: kodwa wabinga waqumisa ezindaweni ezipakamileyo.
Waza ukumkani waya e‐Gibeyone ukubingela kona; ngokuba leyo ibiyindawo epakamileyo enkulu: iwaka lamadini okutshiswa walinikela u‐Solomone pezu kwesibingelo eso,
e‐Gibeyone wabonakala uyehova ku‐Solomone ngepupa ebusuku; waza utixo wati: Cela into endiya kuyinika kuwe.

Wayesiti u‐Solomone: Usenzele isicaka sako u‐Davide ubawo ububele obukulu, njengokuba ebehamba pambi kwako ngenyaniso, nangobulungisa, nangolungelelwano lwentliziyo kunye nawe; kanjalo umgcinele obububele bukulu, bokuba umnikile unyana ohleli pezu kweterone yake, njengokuba kunjalo namhla nje.
Nakaloku, Yehova, Tixo wam! usenzile isicaka sako ukumkani esikundleni sika‐Davide ubawo; kanti mna ndingumntwana omncinane, andikwazi ukupuma nokungena.
Kanjako isicaka sako sipakati kwabantu bako obanyulileyo, abantu abakulu, abangenako ukulinganiswa nokubalwa ngokuba baninzi.
Ngako sinike isicaka sako intliziyo eqondayo, ukuba ndigwebe abantu bako, ukuba ndiqiqe pakati kwokulungileyo nokukohlakeleyo; ngokuba engubanina ongagwebayo aba abantu bako bakulu?
Kekaloku elozwi belilungile emehlweni kayehova, lokuba u‐Solomone ebecelile lento.
Waza utixo wati kuye: Ngenxa yokuba ucelile lento, ungazicelelanga imihla emininzi, ungazicelelanga nobutyebi, ungacelanga nobomi bentshaba zako, koko uzicelele ingqiqo ukuba uqonde ukugweba;
bona ke, ndenzile njengamazwi ako; bona ke, ndikupile intliziyo enobulumko nobuqiqo, ekungabangako onjengawe pambili kuwe, nasemva kwako akuyi kuvuka onjengawe.
Nakanjako oko ubungakuceli ndikupile kuwe, kwa ubutyebi nobungcwalisa; ekungayi kubako namnye pakati kwabo okumkani onjengawe yonke imihla yako.
Nanxa uya kuhamba ezindleleni zam, ngokugcina imimiso yam nemiyalelo yam, njengokuba ebehamba u‐Davide uyihlo wako, ndiya kwandula ndolule imihla yako.

Waza wavuka u‐Solomone; kekaloku bona ke, lipupa. Wasuka weza e‐Yerusaleme, wema pambi kwetyeya yocebano lukayehova, wanikela amadini okutshiswa, wenza iminikelo yoxolo, wazenzela zonke izicaka zake isidlo.
OKUYA beza abafazi babini abangamadikazi kukumkani, bema ebusweni bake.
Wati ke omnye umfazi: Ke, nkosi yam! mna nomfazi lo sihleli endlwini nye; ndaza ndazala ndinaye endlwini.
Kwaye kute ngolwesitatu usuku emva kwokuzala kwam, wandula wazala nalomfazi; sabesindawonye tina, kungeko owasemzini nati endlwini, kupela siti sobabini abebesendlwini.
Waza unyana walomfazi wafa ebusuku, ngokuba ebelele pezu kwake.
Wesuka ke pakati kwobusuku, watabata unyana wam engakum, nxa isicakakazi sako sibe silele ubutongo, wamlalisa esifubeni sake, nonyana wake ofileyo wamlalisa esifubeni sam.
Kekaloku ndakuvuka kusasa, ukuba ndanyise unyana wam, nanku efile; kodwa ndakumnakana kusasa, bona ke, ebengenguye unyana wam, lowo ndamzalayo.
Waza wati omnye umfazi: Hai: ohleliyo ngunyana wam, nofileyo ngunyana wako. Wati nalowo: Hai; ofileyo ngunyana wako, nohleliyo ngunyana wam. Bateta njalo ke ebusweni bokumkani.
Wandula wati ukumkani: Omnye uti: Lo ngunyana wam ohleliyo, nonyana wako ngofileyo; kanjalo omnye nti: Hai; ofileyo ngunyana wako, nohleliyo ngunyana wam.
Walekela wati ukumkani: Ndizekele iṙele. Baza bazisa iṙele ebusweni bokumkani.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Nqumlani umntwana ohleliyo kubini, ninike esinye isiqingata kwomnye, nesinye isiqingata kwomnye.

Waza wateta umfazi, abengowake umntwana ohleliyo, kukumkani, ngokuba umbilini wake ubuvuta pezu kwonyana wake, wayesiti: Ke, nkosi yam! mnikeni yena umntwana ohleliyo, nize ningake nimbulale. Kodwa omnye wati: Makangabi ngowam, makangabi ngowako kanjalo; nqumlani.
Wandula wapendula ukumkani, wati: Mnikeni lowo umntwana ohleliyo, nize ningake nimbulale; nguye unina wake.
Baye o‐Sirayeli bonke beva umgwebo abegwebile ngawo ukumkani; baza bamoyika ukumkani: ngokuba bebebona ukuba ubulumko bukatixo bukuye, ukwenza ukugweba.
KWA njalo ukumkani u‐Solomone ebengukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke.
Aba ke bazinkosana abenazo: u‐Hazariya, unyana ka‐Tsadoki, ebelinene;
u‐Elihorefe no‐Ahiya, onyana baka‐Shisha, bebengababa̔li; u‐Yehoshafate, unyana ka‐Ahilude, ebengumkumbuzi;
no‐Benaya, unyana ka‐Yoyada, ebepezu kwomkosi; u‐Tsadoki no‐Abiyatare bebengabaperisite;
no‐Hazariya, unyana ka‐Natane, ebepezu kwabo abongama; no‐Zabude, unyana ka‐Natane, ebelinene, umhlobo wokumkani;
no‐Ahishare ebepezu kwendlu; no‐Adonirame, unyana ka‐Abeda, ebepezu kwabesitabataba.
Kanjalo u‐Solomone ebenabongama abalishumi linababini pezu kwe‐Sirayeli yonke, abafunzelayo ukumkani nabendlu yake; bebenenyanga nye abanye ngabanye emnyakeni mnye ukuba kufunzelwe.
Ngawo la amagama abo: unyana ka‐Hure, entabeni yakwa‐Frayime:
unyana ka‐Dekere, e‐Makatse, nase‐Shahalabime, nase‐Bete‐shemeshe, nase‐Elonibete‐hanane:
unyana ka‐Hesede, e‐Arubote; ebene‐Soko nalo lonke ilizwe lase‐Hefere:
unyana ka‐Abinadabi, kuzo zonke induli zase‐Dore; u‐Tafate, intombi ka‐Solomone, ebengumfazi wake:
u‐Bahana, unyana ka‐Ahilude, ebe ne‐Tahanaki ne‐Megido, nayo yonke i‐Bete‐shane, engase‐Tsaretana ezantsi kwe‐Yezerele, kutabata e‐Bete‐shane kude kwase‐Abele‐mehola, kude kwasele kwe‐Yokemame:

unyana ka‐Gebere, e‐Ramote yase‐Gileyadi; ebenemizi ka‐Yahire unyana ka‐Manase, ese‐Gileyadi; ebenesahlulo se‐Ragobi, esise‐Bashane, izixeko ezikulu zingamashumi matandatu, zinendonga nemivalo yexina:
u‐Ahinadabi, unyana ka‐Hido, ebe ne‐Mahanayime:
u‐Himahatse ebekwa‐Nefatali; kanjalo yena wazeka u‐Basemate, intombi ka‐Solomone, abe ngumfazi:
u‐Bahana, unyana ka‐Hushai, ebekwa‐Ashere nase‐Halote:
u‐Yehoshafate, unyana ka‐Paruha, ebekwa‐Yisakare:
u‐Shimehi, unyana ka‐Ela, ebekwa‐Benjamine:
u‐Gebere, unyana ka‐Uri, ebeselizweni le‐Gileyadi, ilizwe lika‐Sihone ukumkani waba‐Amori, nelika‐Hogi ukumkani we‐Bashane; yena ebekupela kwomongama obekulo ilizwe elo.
O‐Juda no‐Sirayeli bebebaninzi, njengentlabati engaselwandle ngobuninzi, besidla, besela, bevuya nokuvuya.

Wati u‐Solomone wapata ubukosi pezu kwabo bonke ubukumkani, kwa kuwo umlambo kude kwasezweni lama‐Filistiya, nakude kwasemdeni we‐Jipete: bayisa iminikelo, bamkonza u‐Solomone yonke imihla yokudla kwake ubomi.
Kekaloku ukutya kuka‐Solomone, okwemini nye, bekuzikore zomgubo ocolekileyo ezingamashumi matatu, nekore zomgubo ezingamashumi matandatu;
nenkabi ezityetyisiweyo ezilishumi, nenkabi zamadlelo ezimashumi mabini, negusha ezilikulu; ngapandle kwamaxama, namabadi, namaza, nenkuku ezityetyisiweyo.
Ngokuba ebenobukosi pezu kwalo lonke ilizwe elinganeno kwomlambo, kwa kuyo i‐Tipesahi kude kwase‐Gaza, pezu kwabo bonke okumkani nganeno kwomlambo; waye enoxolo ngawo onke amacala ake ngokungqonga.
Bati o‐Juda no‐Sirayeli bahlala ngokunqaba, abanye ngabanye ngapantsi kwomti weveyine wabo nangapantsi kwomkiwane wabo, kwa se‐Dane kude kwase‐Beresheba, yonke imihla ka‐Solomone.
Kanjalo u‐Solomone ebenezitale zamahashe enqwelwana zake ezingamawaka angamashumi mane, namahashe okukwelwa angamawaka alishumi linesibini.
Kekaloku abongama abo babefunzela ukumkani u‐Solomone, nabo bouke abasondelayo etafileni yokumkani u‐Solomone, abanye ngabanye ngenyanga yabo; abaswelekisa nto:
neṙalasi nenca bazizisela amahashe lawo namahashe azimbaleki kulondawo, apo baye beko kona, abanye ngabanye njengesiko labo.
Kanjako utixo wampa u‐Solomone ubulumko, nengqondo eninzi kakulu, nobubanzi bentliziyo, njengentlabati eselunxwemeni lwolwandle.
Babubukulu ubulumko buka‐Solomone pezu kwobulumko bawo onke amadoda asempumalanga, napezu kwabo bonke ubulumko bama‐Jipete:
ewe ebelumkile pezu kwabantu bonke; pezu kwo‐Etane um‐Ezera, no‐Hemani, no‐Kalikoli, no‐Dareda, onyana baka‐Mahole: lwati udumo lwake lwabako kuzo zonke izizwe ezingqongayo.
Wayeteta imizekeliso engamawaka matatu; nengoma zake zibe ziliwaka elinantlanu.
Wateta nangemiti, kwa kuyo isedare ese‐Lebanone kwada kwakuyo ihisope epumayo eludongeni; wateta nangezilo, nangentaka, nangezinambuzane, nangentlanzi.
Kwaza kwavela kubo bonke abantu ukuva ubulumko buka‐Solomone, kubo bonke okumkani bomhlaba, ababevile ngobulumko bake.

KEKALOKU u‐Hirame, ukumkani we‐Tire, wasusa izicaka zake ukuya ku‐Solomone; ngokuba ebevile okokuba bamtambisile yena abe ngukumkani esikundleni soyise: ngokuba u‐Hirame ebemtandile u‐Davide ngamaxesha onke.
Wandula watuma u‐Solomone ku‐Hirame ukuti:
Wena uyamazi u‐Davide ubawo ukuba ebekohliwe kukwaka indlu egameni likayehova, utixo wake, ngenxa yemfazwe ezibe zimngqonga, wada uyehova wazibeka ngapantsi kwemizantsi yenyawo zake.
Kodwa ngoku uyehova, utixo wam, undipumzile ngamacala onke, kungeko umalane, kungeko nebaqo elibi.

Kekaloku bona ke, ndiyacinga ukwaka indlu egameni likayehova, utixo wam, njengokuba ebeteta uyehova ku‐Davide ubawo, esiti: Unyana wako, lowo endiya kummisa esikundleni sako pezu kweterone yako, nguye oya kwaka indlu egameni lam.

Ngako kaloku xela ukuba kundigaulelwe imiti yesedare e‐Lebanone; zaye izicaka zam ziya kuba nezako, nomvuzo wezicaka zako ndowunika kuwe, njengako konke uya kukutsho: ngokuba usazi wena ukuba akuko pakati kwetu namnye okwaziyo ukugaula imiti njengama‐Tsidone.
Kwabekute, akuva u‐Hirame amazwi ka‐Solomone, wandula wavuya kakulu, wati: Makabongwe uyehova namhla nje, onike ku‐Davide unyana olumkileyo pezu kwababantu bakulu.
Waza watuma u‐Hirame ku‐Solomone ukuti: Ndivile oko utumile kum ngako; ndiya kuyenza yonke intando yako ngemiti yesedare, nangemiti yeberoshe:

izicaka zam ziya kuhla nayo e‐Lebanone ziyise elwandle; ndandiya kuyisa ngemitantatu pezu kwolwandle kulondawo uya kunditumela ilizwi ngayo, ndize ndiyicite kona, wandule wena uyisuse: kanjako wena uya kufeza intando yam, ngokunika abendlu yam ukudla.
Kwa njalo ke u‐Hirame wanika u‐Solomone imiti yesedare nemiti yeberoshe, njengayo yonke intando yake.

Waza u‐Solomone wanika u‐Hirame ikore ezingamawaka angamashumi mabini zenqolowa, ibe kukudla kwabendlu yake, nekore ezimashumi mabini zeoli enqushelweyo: wenje njalo u‐Solomone ukunika u‐Hirame ngomnyaka ngomnyaka.
Kekaloku uyehova wampa u‐Solomone ubulumko, njengokuba ebetetile kuye: kwaye kuko uxolo pakati kwo‐Hirame no‐Solomone, balwenza ucebano bobabini.
Waye ukumkani u‐Solomone wenyusa isitabataba kubo bonke o‐Sirayeli; isitabataba eso besingamawaka angamashumi matatu amadoda.
Waza wawatuma e‐Lebanone, amawaka alishumi ngenyanga ngenyanga ngokuguqulelana: inyanga inye ebese‐Lebanone, inyanga zimbini ebesekaya: waye u‐Adonirame epezu kwesitabataba eso.
Kanjako u‐Solomone wabenamawaka angamashumi asixe̔nxe abetwala imitwalo, namawaka angamashumi asibozo ababazi ezintabeni;
ngapandle kwenkosi zabongama baka‐Solomone ababepezu kwomsebenzi, amawaka matatu anamakulu matatu, ezibe zinobukosi pezu kwabantu abawenza umsebenzi.
Waxela ukumkani, baza banqikela amatye amakulu, amatye anqabileyo, kuze kusekwe indlu leyo ngamatye aqandulweyo.
Bati abaki baka‐Solomone nabaki baka‐Hirame bawaqandula, kwa nama‐Gebali: kwa njalo ke balungisa imiti namatye ukuba kwakiwe indlu leyo.

KWAZA kwati, ngowamakulu mane anamashumi asibozo umnyaka emva kwokupuma kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli elizweni le‐Jipete, ngomnyaka wesine wobukumkani buka‐Solomone pezu kwo‐Sirayeli, ngenyanga yo‐Zive: eyiyo inyanga yesibini, waqala ukwaka indlu kayehova.
Nalondlu ukumkani u‐Solomone wayakela uyehova, bebuzikubite ezingamashumi matandatu ubude bayo, n ekubite ezingamashumi mabini ububanzi bayo, nekubite ezingamashumi matatu ubupakamo bayo.
Nentendelezo ngapambi kwetempile yendlu, bebuzikubite ezingamashumi mabini ubude bayo ngapambi kwobubanzi bendlu; bebuzikubite ezilishumi ububanzi bayo ngapambi kwendlu.
Wayenzela indlu ifenstile ezivaliweyo ngamanqwanqwa.
Wayesaka ngaseludongeni lwendlu inkambili ngokungqonga, ngasezindongeni zendlu ngokungqonga, ezetempile nezendawo yokupendula: wazenza inkambili zasecaleni ngento engqongayo:

inkambili yasezantsi ibizikubite ezintlanu ububanzi bayo, neyapakati ibizikubite ezintandatu ububanzi bayo, neyesitatu ibizikubite ezisixe̔nxe ububanzi bayo; ngokuba ebeyenzele indlu izifinyelo ngento engqongayo ngapandle, ukuze zingabambeki ezindongeni zendlu.
Kekaloku indlu le, ekwakiweni kwayo, yakiwa ngamatye asel’ elungisiwe engekasiwa; ukuba bekungavakali izando, nezembe, n enye impahla yesincete kulondlu, ekwakiweni kwayo.
Ucango lweyapakati inkambili yasecaleni belungelokunene icala lendlu; kwaza kwenyukwa ngezinyukelo ezijikelelayo ukuya kweyapakati, n okunyuka kweyapakati ukuya kweyesitatu.
Kwa njalo wayaka indlu, wayigqiba; waza wayifulela indlu ngemiqadi nangeplanke zemiti yesedare.
Wayesaka inkambili ngakuyo yonke indlu, buzikubite ezintlanu ubupakamo bazo: zabambelela endlwini ngemiti yesedare.
Landula leza ilizwi likayehova ku‐Solomone, lisiti:

Indlu le, oyakayo wena, ukuba uya kuhamba ngemimiselo yam, uzenze izigwebo zam, uyigcine yonke imiyalelo yam ngokuhamba ngayo, ndiya kwandula ndiliqinise ilizwi lam nawe, endandiliteta ku‐Davide uyihlo wako:
ndandiya kuhlala pakati kwosapo luka‐Sirayeli; ewe andiyi kushiya abantu bam o‐Sirayeli.
Kwa njalo u‐Solomone wayaka indlu leyo, wayigqiba.
Wayesaka indonga zendlu pakati ngeplanke zemiti yesedare; kwa kuwo umzantsi wendlu kude kwakuzo indonga zesifulelwa, waleka ngemiti pakati; nomzantsi wendlu wawaleka ngeplanke zemiti yeberoshe.
Wayesaka ikubite ezimashumi mabini ecaleni lasemva lendlu ngeplanke zemiti yesedare, kwa kuwo umzantsi kude kwakuzo indonga: wazakela yona pakati, zibe yindawo yokupendula, eyingcwele yezingcwele.
Ibizikubite ezimashumi mane indlu leyo, kwa itempile engapambili.
Nesedare pezu kwendlu pakati yona ibilisetyenzwa eliqingqiweyo lekomkomereṙa nentyatyambo ezibenqekileyo; konke bekuyisedare, kungeko nalitye elibonakalayo.
Nendawo yokupendula wayilungisa endlwini pakati, ukuba kubekwe kona ityeya yocebano lukayehova.

Kanjako indawo yokupendula ngapambili ibizikubite ezimashumi mabini ubude bayo, nekubite ezimashumi mabini ububanzi bayo, nekubite ezimashumi mabini ubupakamo bayo; wayaleka ngegolide enqabileyo: wasaleka nesibingelo ngesedare.
Kwa njalo u‐Solomone wayaleka indlu leyo pakati ngegolide enqabileyo: wayedlulisa isikuselo ngemixokolelwane yegolide pambi kwendawo yokupendula, wasaleka ngegolide.
Nayo yonke indlu wayaleka ngegolide, ide yagqitywa yonke indlu; nesibingelo sipela, esibe sipambi kwendawo yokupendula, wasaleka ngegolide.
Napakati kwendawo yokupendula wazenza ikerubime zambini ngemiti yeoli: zibe zizikubite zilishumi ubupakamo benye.
Lazikubite zintlanu elinye ipiko lekerubime, nekubite zintlanu elinye ipiko lekerubime: kwa sencameni yelinye ipiko layo, kude kwasencameni yelinye ipiko layo, ikubite zazilishumi.
Yabizikubite ezilishumi nekerubime yesibini: zaye zinomlinganiswa mnye nesimilo sinye ikerubime ezo zombini.
Ubupakamo benye ikerubime bebuzikubite ezilishumi; ibinjalo nekerubime yesibini.

Wayebeka ikerubime ezo endlwini yapakati: kwaye kutwabululwa amapiko ekerubime, ukuba ipiko lenye lafikela olunye udonga, nepiko lenye ikerubime lafikela olunye udonga; kanjako amapiko azo afikelana pakati kwendlu.
Ezokerubime wazaleka ngegolide.
Nazo zonke indonga zendlu ngento engqongayo waziqingqela iziba̔lo eziqingqiweyo zekerubime, nemiti yepalime, nentyatyambo ezibenqekileyo, pakati nangapandle.
Nomzantsi wendlu wawaleka ngegolide, pakati nangapandle.
Nocango lwendawo yokupendula walwenzela amapepa ngemiti yeoli: umqolo n emigubasi ibisisiqingata sesihlanu sodonga.

Amapepa lawo omabini ebengemiti yeoli; napezu kwawo waqingqa iziqingqwa zekerubime, nemiti yepalime, nentyatyambo ezibenqekileyo, wazaleka ngegolide; wafaka igolide pezu kwekerubime napezu kwemiti yepalime kanjako.
Nangokunjalo walwenzela ucango lwetempile imigubasi ngemiti yeoli, isisiqingata sesine sodonga.
Namapepa omabini wona ebengawemiti yeberoshe: amapepa omabini olunye ucango ebengajingayo, namapepa omabini olunye ucango ebengajingayo.
Wayeqingqa pezu kwawo ikerubime, nemiti yepalime, nentyatyambo ezibenqekileyo, wazaleka ngegolide ilungisiwe pezu kwokuqingqiweyo.
Waza waka ibala lapakati, linenṙozo zintatu zamatye aqandulweyo, noṙozo lunye lwemiqadi yesedare.
Ngomnyaka wesine ibisekwa indlu kayehova, ngenyanga yo‐Zive;
nangomnyaka weshumi linesinye, ngenyanga yo‐Bule, eyinyanga yesibozo, ibigqitywa leyondlu, ngazo zonke indawo zayo, nangaso sonke isimilo sayo. Kwa njalo ebeyaka iminyaka yasixe̔nxe.
KODWA indlu yake u‐Solomone wabeyaka iminyaka yalishumi linesitatu; wada wayigqiba yonke indlu yake.

Wayaka indlu yehlati le‐Lebanone, ilikulu lekubite ubude bayo, namashumi mahlanu ekubite ububanzi bayo, namashumi matatu ekubite ubupakamo bayo, pezu kwenṙozo ezine zentsika zesedare, nemiqadi yesedare pezu kwazo intsika.
Yabifulelwa ngesedare pezulu pezu kweplanke, ezibe zipezu kwentsika ezimashumi mane anesihlanu, zilishumi linesihlanu ngoṙozo.
Kwaye kuko izituba, inṙozo ezintatu, ifenstile ingapezu kwefenstile amaxesha matatu.
Zonke ingcango nemigubasi zibe zinamacala mane, kwa n ezituba; kanjalo ifentsile ibimalungana nefenstile amaxesha matatu.
Wayesenza intendelezo ngentsika, izikubite ezimashumi mahlanu ubude bayo, nekubite ezimashumi matatu ububanzi bayo; nentendelezo pambi kwazo; nentsika nendawo yeplanke pambi kwazo.
Waza wenzela iterone intendelezo, apo wagwebayo kona, intendelezo yokugweba; ibe yalekiwe ngesedare, kwa kuwo umzantsi emhlabeni kude kwakuwo umzantsi pezulu.
Nendlu yake, apo wahlala kona kwelinye ibala ngapakati kuyo intendelezo, ibinjengesetyenzwa elinjalo. Kanjako wayenzela indlu intombi ka‐Faro, leyo abeyizekile u‐Solomone, njengayo intendelezo leyo.
Zonke ezi zibe zingamatye anqabileyo, njengemilinganiswa yamatye aqandulweyo, esikiwe ngesaṙa, pakati nangapandle, kwa kulo isekwa kude kwakulo ulundi, nangapandle ngasebaleni elikulu.
Kwaye kusekwa ngamatye anqabileyo, amatye amakulu, amatye ekubite zilishumi, namatye ekubite zisibozo.
Napezulu bekuko amatye anqabileyo, njengemilinganiswa yamatye aqandulweyo, nesedare.
Kanjalo ibala elikulu ngento engqongayo libe linenṙozo zintatu zamatye aqandulweyo, noṙozo lunye lwemiqadi yesedare; njengakwelapakati ibala lendlu kayehova, nakuyo intendelezo yendlu.
WAZA watuma ukumkani u‐Solomone, wamtabata u‐Hirame e‐Tire.

Ebengunyana womhlolokazi yena, kwisizwe sika‐Nefatali, oyise ebeyindoda yase‐Tire, incibi yexina; wabezele bubulumko, nengqondo, nokwazi, ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngexina. Wayesiza kukumkani u‐Solomone, wawenza wonke umsebenzi wake.
Ngokuba wadala intsika zambini ngexina, buzikubite ezilishumi linesibozo ubupakamo benye intsika; kanjalo usinga lwekubite ezilishumi linambini belungqonga enye intsika.
Wenza nentloko zambini ngexina etyityishiweyo, zokubeka ezincameni zentsika; ubupakamo benye intloko bebuzikubite ezintlanu, nobupakamo benye intloko bebuzikubite ezintlanu.
Kwaye kuko iminata yesetyenzwa elipanjanisiweyo, n ezitsaba zesetyenzwa lemixokelelwane, kuzo intloko ezibe zisezincameni zentsika; isixe̔nxe kwenye intloko, nesixe̔nxe kwenye intloko.
Wayesenza intsika ezo, nenṙozo zambini ngento engqongayo pezu kwomnata umnye, kuze kugujungelwe intloko ezibe zisencameni, ngegranate; wenje njalo nakwenye intloko.
Kekaloku intloko, ezibe zisencameni yentsika, zazingesetyenzwa eliyinyibibaṙa entendelezweni, ikubite zane.
Kanjalo intloko pezu kwentsika ezo zombini zibe zinegranate nangapezulu, malungana nendawo epumayo ebingakuwo umnata: kwaye kuko negranate ezimakulu mabini ngenṙozo ngokungqonga pezu kwenye intloko.
Waza wazimisa intsika ezo entendelezweni yetempile: wayimisa intsika yasekunene, wayibiza ngegama elingu‐Yakine; wayimisa intsika yasekohlo, wayibiza ngegama elingu‐Bohazi.
Napezu kwencam yentsika bekuko isetyenzwa eliyinyibibaṙa: kwa njalo kwafezwa umsebenzi wentsika.

Walwenza nolwandle olutyityishiweyo; lwaluzikubite ezilishumi kwa kuwo omnye umpeto kwada kwakuwo omnye umpeto, luyinqukuva ngokungqonga, luzikubite ezintlanu ubupakamo balo; lwalujikelezwa ngentambo yekubite ezimashumi matatu ngento engqongayo.

Nangapantsi kwompeto walo ngokungqonga bekuko ikomkomereṙa zilungqonga, zilishumi ekubiteni nye, zilujikelezela ulwandle ngokungqonga: zatyityishwa ikomkomereṙa ezo ngenṙozo zambini, lwakutyityishwa lona.

Lwema pezu kwenkabi ezilishumi linambini, ezintatu zibeka ngasenode, nezintatu zibeka ngasentshonalanga, nezintatu zibeka ngasesuyide, nezintatu zibeka ngasempumalanga; lwalupezulu ulwandle pezu kwazo, yonke imiva yazo ingapakati.
Isibili salo besibububanzi besandla, nompeto walo ubunjengesetyenzwa lompeto wendebe, njeng entyatyambo zenyibiba: lwabamba ibate ezingamawaka mabini.
Wenza nezikondo ezilishumi ngexina; zazikubite ezine ubude besikondo sinye, nekubite ezine ububanzi baso, nekubite ezintatu ubupakamo baso.
Lilo eli isetyenzwa lazo izikondo: zibe zinendini, kanjalo indini ezo zibe zipakati kwembombo:

napezu kwendini, ezibe zipakati kwembombo, bekuko ingonyama, nenkabi, nekerubime; napezu kwembombo bekuko isikondo ngapezulu; nangapantsi kwazo ingonyama nenkabi bekuko izinto ezibandakanyiweyo zesetyenzwa elikandelweyo.

Kwaye kuko ivili zexina zazine kwisikondo sinye, namaceba exina; amagumbi aso omane ebenamagxalaba; ngapantsi kwaso isihlambelo ebeko amagxalaba atyityishiweyo, ngecala lezinto ezibandakanyiweyo ezinye ngezinye.

Umlomo waso pakati kwentloko nangapezulu ubuyikubite nye; kanjalo umlomo waso ubuquvile njeng esetyenzwa lesikondo, ikubite nesiqingata sekubite; nakanjako pezu kwomlomo waso bekuko iziqingqwa; kodwa indini zazo bezinamacala mane, zingezeziquvileyo.
Kekaloku ivili zone zibe zingapantsi kwendini, nease zevili zona zibe zikuso isikondo; nobupakamo bayo ivili ibiyikubite nesiqingata sekubite.
Nesetyenzwa lazo ivili libe linjengesetyenzwa levili yenqwelo: iase zazo, nenafe zazo, nefelenge zazo, nespeke zazo, zonke zatyityishwa.
Kwaye kuko amagxalaba mane kuwo amagumbi mane esikondo sinye: amagxalaba aso ebe puma kwa kuso isikondo.
Napezu kwengcopo yesikondo bekuko into equvileyo ngokungqonga, isiqingata sekubite ubupakamo bayo; napezu kwengcopo yesikondo izipumelo zaso nendini zaso zibe zi puma kwa kuso.
Wayeziqingqa pezu kwamacwecwe ezipumelo zaso napezu kwendini zaso ikerubime, nengonyama, nemiti yepalime, njengendawo yezinye ngezinye, nezinto ezibandakanyiweyo ngokungqonga.
Njengokunje wazenza izikondo zolishumi: bekuko ukutyityishwa kunye, umlinganiswa umnye, isimilo sinye, kuzo zonke.

Wazenza nezihlambelo ezilishumi ngexina; isihlambelo sinye sabamba ibate zamashumi mane; isihlambelo sinye sibe sizikubite zine; pezu kwazo izikondo zolishumi ezinye ngezinye bekuko isihlambelo sinye.
Waza wazibeka izikondo ezihlanu ngelokunene icala lendlu, nezihlanu ngelokohlo icala lendlu; nolwandle walubeka ngelokunene icala lendlu, ngasempumalanga, malungana nesuyide.
Kanjalo u‐Hirame wazenza imbiza, nezikotululo, nezitya zokufefela. Wada u‐Hirame wagqiba ukuwenza wonke umsebenzi, owawenzela ukumkani u‐Solomone ngenxa yendlu kayehova:
intsika zimbini, nezikanda zentloko ezibe zisencameni yentsika zombini; neminata mibini yokugubungela izikanda zozibini zentloko ezibe zisencameni yazo intsika;
negranate ezingamakulu mane zeminata yomibini, inṙozo zimbini zegranate kuwo umnata mnye, kuze kugujungelwe izikanda zozibini zentloko ezibe zisencameni yazo intsika;
kwa nezikondo zilishumi, nezihlambelo zilishumi pezu kwazo;
nolwandle lunye, nenkabi ezilishumi linambini ngapantsi kwolwandle olo;
nembiza, nezikotululo, nezitya zokufefela: nazo zonke ezimpahla, owati u‐Hirame wazenzela ukumkani u‐Solomone ngenxa yendlu kayehova, wazenza ngexina egudisiweyo.
Etafeni lase‐Yoredane wazityityisha ukumkani, emhlabeni oludongwe pakati kwe‐Sukote ne‐Tsaretane.
Zonke ezimpahla waziyeka u‐Solomone zingalinganiswa, ngenxa yobuninzi obukulu kakulu bazo; bekungenakupengululwa ukuba nzima kwexina.
Wayezenza u‐Solomone zonke impahla ezizezendlu kayehova: isibingelo segolide; netafile, ekube kupezu kwayo izonka zokubonakala, ngegolide;
nekandelare, isihlanu ngasekunene nesihlanu ngasekohlo, pambi kwendawo yokupendula, ngegolide enqabileyo; nentyatyambo, nezibane, nezitabatelo, ngegolide;
nezikotile, nezicimo, nezitya zokufefela, negxebeka, neziqumelo, ngegolide enqabileyo; nehinje zengcango zeyapakati indlu, zeyingcwele yezingcwele indawo, ne zengcango zendlu, zetempile, ngegolide.

Kwada kwafezwa wonke umsebenzi, owati ukumkani u‐Solomone wawenzela indlu kayehova. Waza u‐Solomone wazingenisa izinto ezingcwele zika‐Davide uyise, isilivere, negolide, nempahla, wazibeka pakati kwendyebo zendlu kayehova.

WANDULA u‐Solomone wabahlanganisa abadala bo‐Sirayeli, nabo bonke abazintloko zezizwe, inkosi zendlu zoyise zosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ukuza kukumkani u‐Solomone e‐Yerusaleme, ukuba bayinyuse ityeya yocebano lukayehova esixekweni sika‐Davide, esiyiyo i‐Ziyone.
Aza onke amadoda akwa‐Sirayeli ahlanganiselwa kukumkani u‐Solomone, ngenyanga yo‐Etanime, emtendelekweni; yona yinyanga yesixe̔nxe.
Beza ke bonke abadala bo‐Sirayeli; bati abaperisite bayifunqula ityeya.
Baza benyusa ityeya kayehova, nentente yentlangano, nazo zonke impahla ezingcwele ezibe zikuyo intente leyo; ezi zinto bazinyusa abaperisite naba‐Levi.
Kanjalo ukumkani u‐Solomone, nayo yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli abebehlanganisene ngakuye, a bebenaye pambi kwetyeya, bebebinga igusha nenkabi, ezazingenakubalwa nokulinganiswa ngokuba zininzi.
Baza abaperisite bayingenisa ityeya yocebano lukayehova endaweni yayo, endaweni yokupendula yendlu, kweyingcwele yezingcwele, ngapantsi kwamapiko ekerubime.
Ngokuba ikerubime zatwabulula amapiko omabini ngapezu kwendawo yetyeya; kanjalo ikerubime zagubungela ityeya nezibonda zayo pezulu.
Kwandula kwar̔olwa izibonda, ukuba zabonakala incam zezibonda kweyingcwele indawo pambi kwendawo yokupendula, kanti bezingabonakali ngapandle; ziko nakona kude kube namhla nje.
Bekungeko nto etyeyeni, kupela ngamacwecwe amatye omabini, abe ebekwa kona ngu‐Mosesi e‐Horebe, okuya uyehova walwenza ucebano nosapo luka‐Sirayeli, ekupumeni kwalo elizweni le‐Jipete.
Kwaza kwati, bakupuma abaperisite kweyingcwele indawo, landula ilifu layizalisa indlu kayehova;
bada bakohlwa abaperisite kukuma ukukonza ngenxa yelifu elo; ngokuba ubungcwalisa bukayehova bebuzalisile indlu kayehova.
Waza wati u‐Solomone: Uyehova ute uya kuhlala esitokotokweni.
Sendikwakele ngenyaniso indlu yokuhlala, indawo yokuhlala kwako kude kube ngunapakade.
Wandula ukumkani waguqula ubuso bake, watamsanqelisa yonke intlanganiso yo Sirayeli; (yati yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli yema;)
wayesiti: Makabongwe uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, owateta ngomlomo wake ku‐Davide ubawo, waza wazalisekisa ngesandla sake, esiti:

Kuselokwalomhla endapumisayo abantu bam o‐Sirayeli e‐Jipete, andinyulanga nasinye isixeko kuzo zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli, ukuba kwakiwe indlu, lize igama lam libe kona; koko ndimnyulile u‐Davide ukuba abe pezu kwabantu bam o‐Sirayeli.
Kwaye kusentliziyweni ka‐Davide ubawo, ukwakela igama likayehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, indlu.
Kodwa uyehova wati ku‐Davide ubawo: Okokuba bekusentliziyweni yako ukwakela igama lam indlu, ulungisile ukuba bekusentliziyweni yako.
Noko indlu leyo akuyi kuyaka wena; kodwa unyana wako oya kupuma esinqeni sako, nguye oya kwakela igama lam indlu leyo.

Kwa njalo uyehova uqinisile ilizwi lake abelitetile; ngokuba ndivukile esikundleni sika‐Davide ubawo, ndihleli nje pezu kweterone yakwa‐Sirayeli, njengokuba etetile uyehova; ndandakele igama likayehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, indlu.
Kanjalo ndimisele kona indawo yetyeya, apo lukona ucebano lukayehova, olo walwenzayo nobawo betu, nxa wabapumisayo elizweni le‐Jipete.
Waza u‐Solomone wema pambi kwesibingelo sikayehova, ebusweni bayo yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli, wazolula izandla zake ngasezulwini,
wati: Yehova, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! akuko tixo njengawe, ezulwini pezulu, napezu kwomhlaba ezantsi, ogcinela izicaka zako, ezihambayo pambi kwako ngayo yonke intliziyo yazo, ucebano nobubele:
ogcinele isicaka sako u‐Davide, ubawo wam, oko wakuteta kuye: ngokuba utetile ngomlomo wako, nangesandla sako uzalisekisile, njengokuba kunjalo namhla nje.

Ngako kaloku, Yehova, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! gcinela isicaka sako u‐Davide, ubawo wam, oko ukutetileyo kuye, usiti: Akuyi kukunqamkela indoda ebusweni bam, ihleli pezu kweterone yakwa‐Sirayeli; kupela ukuba onyana bako baya kulumkela indlela yabo, bahambe pambi kwam, njengokuba wena uhambile pambi kwam.
Nakaloku, Tixo wo‐Sirayeli! malinyaniswe ke ilizwi lako, elo ulitetileyo kwisicaka sako u‐Davide, ubawo wam.
Kodwa utixo uya kuhlala ngenyaniso na emhlabeni? bona ke, izulu, nezulu lamazulu, alingekubambe: kancinane kangakananina ngakumbi ke lendlu endiyakileyo?
Uze ubeke noko kuwo umtandazo wesicaka sako, nakuso isitaṙuziso saso, Yehova, Tixo wam! upulapule isikalo nomtandazo sitandaza ngawo isicaka sako ebusweni bako namhla:
ukuba amehlo ako abe evulekile pezu kwalendlu emini nasebusuku, pezu kwendawo ute ngayo: Lobako igama lam kona: ukuba upulapule umtandazo siya kutandaza ngawo isicaka sako kulendawo.
Uze upulapule isitaṙuziso sesicaka sako, nesabantu bako o‐Sirayeli, oko baya kutandaza kulendawo; uve wena endaweni yokuhlala kwako, ezulwini, uti wakuva uxolele.
Okuya kwonayo umntu ngakuye ummelwane wake, aze abeke pezu kwake isifungo sokumfungisa, siti isifungo size pambi kwesibingelo sako kulendlu;
wandule wena uve ezulwini, wenze, ulungise izicaka zako, umgwebe okohlakeleyo, ngokunika indlela yake pezu kwentloko yake, umgwebele olungileyo, ngokumnika njengobulungisa bake.
Xeshekweni abantu bako o‐Sirayeli babetwa pambi kwotshaba, ngokuba bonile ngakuwe; baze babuyele kuwe, badumise igama lako, batandaze, bakutaṙuzise kulendlu;
wandule wena uve ezulwini, uxolele isono sabantu bako o‐Sirayeli, ubabuyisele emhlabeni owabuwunika koyise babo.
Xeshekweni livingcekile izulu, kungeko imvula, ngokuba bonile ngakuwe; ukuba bayatandaza kulendawo, badumise igama lako, baguquke esonweni sabo, oko ubabandezelayo;

wandule wena uve ezulwini, uxolele isono sezicaka zako, nesabantu bako o‐Sirayeli, oko ubafundisayo indlela yako elungileyo abaya kuhamba ngayo; uze unise imvula pezu kwelizwe lako, elo ulinikileyo ebantwini bako libe lilifa.

Nxa kubako indlala elizweni, nxa kubako isifo esibubisayo, nxa kubako imbabala, isihumba, inkumbi, uṙuxeshe; nxa intshaba zabo zibavingcela elizweni lezixeko zabo; nxa kubako isibulawa esinjanina, nesifo esinjanina:

konke ukutandaza, konke ukutaṙuzisa, okuya kwenziwa ngumntu otile, umhlaumbi ngabo bonke abantu bako o‐Sirayeli, oko baya kwazi abanye ngabanye isibulawa sezabo intliziyo, bazolule izandla zabo kulendlu;
wandule wena uve ezulwini, uxolele, wenze, ubanike abanye ngabanye njengazo zonke indlela zabo, abantliziyo uzaziyo; (ngokuba nguwe wedwa ozaziyo intliziyo zabo bonke onyana babantu;)
ukuze bakwoyike yonke imihla abaya kubudla ubomi ngayo pezu kwobuso bomhlaba, owabuwunika kobawo betu.
Nakanjako ngaye owolunye uhlanga, ongenguye owabantu bako o‐Sirayeli, kodwa uvele elizweni elikude ngenxa yegama lako;
(ngokuba beya kuva igama lako elikulu, nesandla sako esomeleleyo, nengalo yako eyolulweyo;) nxa aya kuza, atandaze kulendlu;

yiva wena ezulwini, endaweni yokuhlala kwako, wenze ngako konke aya kubiza kuwe ngako owolunye uhlanga lowo; ukuze bonke abantu bomhlaba balazi igama lako, boyike wena, njengabantu bako o‐Sirayeli; bazi kanjalo ukuba igama lako libiziwe pezu kwendlu le endiyakileyo.
Nxa abantu bako bapumayo ukuya kulwa ngakuzo intshaba zabo, ngendlela uya kubatuma ngayo, baze batandaze kuyehova, ngakuso esisixeko usinyulileyo, na ngakuyo lendlu endiyakileyo ngenxa yegama lako;
wandule uve ezulwini ukutandaza kwabo nokutaṙuzisa kwabo, ulenze ibango labo.
Nxa bonayo ngakuwe, (ngokuba kungeko umntu ongoniyo,) uti wena ubaqumbele, ubanikele ebusweni botshaba, bade abatimbi babo babatimbele elizweni lotshaba, elikude umhlaumbi elikufupi;
ukuba bayakumbuza intliziyo zabo elizweni apo batinjelwe kona, baguquke, bakutaṙuzise elizweni labatimbi babo, besiti: Sonile, senzile ngobugwenxa, senza okukohlakeleyo;

bade babuyele kuwe ngayo yonke intliziyo yabo, nangawo wonke umpefumlo wabo, elizweni lentshaba zabo ezibatimbileyo, batandaze kuwe ngakulo ilizwe labo, elo wabulinika koyise babo, ngakuso esisixeko usinyulileyo, na ngakuyo lendlu endiyakileyo ngenxa yegama lako;
wandule uve ezulwini, endaweni yokuhlala kwako, ukutandaza kwabo nokutaṙuzisa kwabo, ulenze ibango labo,
ubaxolele abantu bako abonileyo ngakuwe, nazo zonke izigqito zabo abagqitileyo ngakuwe ngazo, ubanike izibele ebusweni babo babatimbileyo, baze babe nobubele ngakubo:
ngokuba bona bengabantu bako, nelifa lako, owabaku̔payo elizweni le‐Jipete, pakati kwesidlangalala sesincete:
ukuze amehlo ako abe evulekile ekutaṙuziseni kwesicaka sako, nasekutaṙuziseni kwabantu bako o‐Sirayeli, ukuba ubapulapule kuko konke ukubiza kwabo kuwe.
Ngokuba wena ubahlulile kubo bonke abantu bomhlaba, babe lilifa lako, njengokuba utetile ngesandla sika‐Mosesi isicaka sako, wakupumisa obawo betu e‐Jipete, Nkosi, Yehova!
Kwaza kwati, nxa agqibileyo u‐Solomone ukutandaza kuyehova wonke lomtandazo nesitaṙuziso, wesuka ebusweni besibingelo sikayehova, ekuguqeni emadolweni ake, enezandla zake zoluliwe ngasezulwini.
Waza wema, watamsanqelisa yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli ngelizwi elikulu, esiti:

Makabongwe uyehova, obanikileyo abantu bake o‐Sirayeli ukupumla, njengoko konke akutetileyo: akutshitshanga nanye indawo kulo lonke ilizwi lake elilungileyo, abeliteta ngesandla sika‐Mosesi isicaka sake.
Wanga uyehova, utixo wetu, angaba nati, njengokuba ebenobawo betu; angasishiyi, angasilahli nokusilahla;
atobele intliziyo zetu ngakuye, ukuba sihambe kuzo zonke indlela zake, nokuba sigcine imiyalelo yake, nezimiselo zake, nezigwebo zake, abeyalela obawo betu ngazo.

Nalamazwi am, enditaṙuzisile ngawo pambi kwoyehova, makabe kufupi noyehova, utixo wetu, emini nasebusuku, ukuba alenze ibango lesicaka sake, nebango labantu bake o‐Sirayeli, indawo yemihla ngemihla ngomhla wayo:
ukuze bakwazi bonke abantu bomhlaba ukuba uyehova unguye utixo, kungeko wumbi.
Maibe ngoko intliziyo yenu ikolisekile ngakuyehova, utixo wetu, ukuhamba ngezimiselo zake, nokugcina imiyalelo yake, njengokuba kunjalo namhla.
Kwaza kwabinga ukumkani, nabo bonke o‐Sirayeli kunye naye, umbingo pambi kwoyehova.

Waye u‐Solomone wabinga umbingo weminikelo yoxolo, owawubingela uyehova, inkabi ezingamawaka angamashumi mabini anamabini, negusha ezingamawaka alikulu linamashumi mabini. Benje njalo ukutwasisa indlu kayehova ukumkani nalo lonke usapo luka‐Sirayeli.

Wati ukumkani ngomhla lowo wenza ngcwele umpakati webala elipambi kwayo indlu kayehova; ngokuba wabelungisa kona amadini okutshiswa, neminikelo yokudla, nenqata leminikelo yoxolo; ngenxa yokuba isibingelo sexina, esipambi kwoyehova, sibe sincinane kokokuba samkele amadini okutshiswa, neminikelo yokudla, nenqata leminikelo yoxolo.

Wayesenza u‐Solomone ngeloxesha umtendeleko, nabo bonke o‐Sirayeli kunye naye, intlanganiso enkulu, ivela kwa sekungenweni kwe‐Hamati kwada kwasemlanjeni wase‐Jipete, pambi kwoyehova, utixo wetu, imihla esixe̔nxe nemihla esixe̔nxe, imihla elishumi linamine.

Ngomhla wesibozo wabandulula abantu; abatamsanqelisayo ukumkani, bahambela ezintenteni zabo, bevuya, becwayitile ngentliziyo, pezu kwako konke okulungileyo abekwenzile uyehova ku‐Davide isicaka sake, nako‐Sirayeli abantu bake.
KWAYE kute, nxa u‐Solomone abegqibile ukwaka indlu kayehova, nendlu yokumkani, nako konke ukunqwenela kuka‐Solomone owabetanda ukukwenza,
wandula wabonakala uyehova ku‐Solomone ngokwesibini, njengokuba ebebonakele kuye e‐Gibeyone.

Wayesiti uyehova kuye: Ndivile umtandazo wako, nesitaṙuziso sako utaṙuzisile ngaso ebusweni bam; ndenzile ngcwele indlu le oyakileyo, ukuba ndibeke igama lam kona kude kube ngunapakade; kwakuya kubako kona amehlo am nentliziyo yam imihla yonke.

Kanjalo wena ukuba uya kuhamba pambi kwam, njengokuba ebehamba u‐Davide uyihlo wako, ngolungelelwano lwentliziyo, nangokulungisa, ukwenza ngako konke endikuyaleleyo; nokuba uya kugcina izimiselo zam nezigwebo zam:

ndiya kwandula ndiqinise Iterone yobukumkani bako pezu kwo‐Sirayeli kude kube ngunapakade; njengokuba benditeta ku‐Davide uyihlo wako, ndisiti: Akuyi kukunqamkela indoda pezu kweterone yakwa‐Sirayeli.
Kanti ukuba niya kuka nibuye ekundilandeleni, nina nabantwana benu, nize ningagcini imiyalelo yam, n ezimiselo zam endizibekileyo pambi kwenu, kodwa niye nikonze otixo bambi, nitobe pambi kwabo:

ndiya kwandula ndinqamle o‐Sirayeli emhlabeni, endiwunikileyo kubo; nalendlu, endiyingcwalisele igama lam, ndoyilahla ebusweni bam; waye u‐Sirayeli eya kuba yinto yokuzekeliswa nelizwi lokuhlekisa pakati kwabantu bonke:
nendlu le, e pezulu, osukuba edlula ngakuyo woti nqa, enze amakwelo; kwakuya kutiwa: Kungenxa yanina enzileyo uyehova njengokunjalo kwelilizwe nakulendlu?

kwakuya kutiwa: Ngenxa yokuba bamshiya uyehova, utixo wabo, owabapumisayo oyise babo elizweni le‐Jipete, nokuba babambelela kotixo bambi, batoba pambi kwabo, babakonza: kungoko uyehova azisileyo pezu kwabo bonke obububi.
KWAZA kwati ekupeleni kweminyaka emashumi mabini, okuya u‐Solomone abezakile izindlu ezo zombini, indlu kayehova, nendlu yokumkani,

(u‐Hirame, ukumkani we‐Tire, ebencedile u‐Solomone ngemiti yesedare, nangemiti yeberoshe, nangegolide, ngako konke ukutanda kwake,) wandula ukumkani u‐Solomone wampa u‐Hirame izixeko ezimashumi mabini elizweni le‐Galili.
Waza wapuma u‐Hirame e‐Tire ukuya kubona izixeko abezipiwe ngu‐Solomone; kodwa bezingafanele emehlweni ake.
Wati ngoko: Zezinina izixeko ezi uzipile kum, mzalwana wam? Wayezibiza ngokuti lilizwe le‐Kabule kwada kwanamhla nje.
Kekaloku u‐Hirame wabezitumile kukumkani italente zegolide zalikulu linamashumi mabini.
Nantsi indawo yesitabataba sabantu, abesinyusile ukumkani u‐Solomone, ukuba kwakiwe indlu kayehova, nendlu yake, ne‐Milo, nodonga lwe‐Yerusaleme, ne‐Hatsore, ne‐Megido, ne‐Gezere:
(Wayenyukile u‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete, wayibamba i‐Gezere, wayitshisa ngomlilo, naba‐Kanane ababehlala esixekweni wababulala, nayo yona wayinika ibe libaso kwintombi yake umfazi ka‐Solomone:
waza u‐Solomone wayaka i‐Gezere, ne‐Bete‐horone yasezantsi,
ne‐Bahalate, ne‐Tademore entlango, kwelolizwe,

nazo zonke izixeko zokubekela abenazo u‐Solomone, nezixeko zenqwelo, nezixeko zamahashe okukwelwa, noko asukuba ebenqwenela u‐Solomone ukukwaka e‐Yerusaleme, nase‐Lebanone, nakulo lonke ilizwe lobukosi bake:)
Bonke abantu ababesele kubo aba‐Amori, ama‐Hete, ama‐Perizi, ama‐Hivi, nama‐Yebusi, abebengengabo abosapo luka‐Sirayeli,
abantwana babo ababesele emva kwabo elizweni, abo usapo luka‐Sirayeli belukohliwe ukubalahlela ekutshatyalalisweni, kwa pezu kwabo wabeka u‐Solomone ukunikela ngenkonzo kwada kwanamhla nje.
Kanti kulo usapo luka‐Sirayeli u‐Solomone akenza nalinye ikonza; kodwa lona belungamadoda okulwa, nezicaka zake, nenkosana zake, nenjengele zake, nabapati benqwelo zake, nabakweli bake bamahashe.
Kulo olu beziko inkosi zabongama ababepezu kwomsebenzi ka‐Solomone, amakulu mahlanu anamashumi mahlanu, ezibe zinobukosi pezu kwabantu abenzayo emsebenzini.
Koko intombi ka‐Faro yenyuka esixekweni sika‐Davide ukuya endlwini yayo, abeyakele yona u‐Solomone: oko wayaka i‐Milo.

Waye u‐Solomone amaxesha matatu emnyakeni mnye enikela amadini okutshiswa neminikelo yoxolo, pezu kwesibingelo abesakele uyehova, waqumisa pezu kwaso isibingelo esibe sipambi kwoyehova: kwa njalo wayigqiba indlu.
Kanjako ukumkani u‐Solomone wazenza inqanawa e‐Hetsiyone‐gebere, engase‐Elote, elunxwemeni lwolwandle olubomvu, elizweni le‐Edome.
Waza u‐Hirame watuma ezinqanaweni ezo izicaka zake, amadoda enqanawa abelwazi ulwandle, kunye nezicaka zika‐Solomone.
Zaye zisiya e‐Ofire, zatabata kona igolide, italente ezingamakulu mane anamashumi mabini, zayizisa kukumkani u‐Solomone.
WATI ukumkanikazi we‐Sheba, akuva udumo luka‐Solomone ngokwegama likayehova, weza ukumlinga ngezintsonkotelo.
Wayesiza e‐Yerusaleme nomkosi omkulu kunene, inkamela zitwele izimnandi, nento eninzi yegolide, namatye anqabileyo: wati akuza ku‐Solomone, wateta naye konke okusentliziyweni yake.
Waza u‐Solomone wamtyilela onke amazwi ake: akwabiko nento ebimfihlelwa ukumkani, abengamtyileli yona.
Kekaloku nxa ukumkanikazi we‐Sheba wabona bonke ubulumko buka‐Solomone, nendlu abeyakile,
nokutya kwesitebe sake, nokuhlala kwezicaka zake, nokuma kwabakonzi bake, nezivato zabo, nabancamli bake, nesinyukelo sake, owenyuka ngaso ukuya endlwini kayehova, akwabi sabiko umoya kuye.
Wayesiti kukumkani: Beliyinene ilizwi elo bendiliva elizweni lam, ngemicimbi yako nangobulumko bako.
Kodwa bendingakolwa ngamazwi lawo, ndide ndafika, aza abona amehlo am: kekaloku bona ke, andixelelwanga nesiqingata; ugqitisile ngobulumko nangobutamsanqa iṙeto endalivayo.
Anenyweba amadoda ako, zinenyweba ezizicaka zako, ezimiyo futi ebusweni bako, ezivayo ubulumko bako.

Makabongwe uyehova, utixo wako, owakukolelayo, ukuba akubeke pezu kweterone yakwa‐Sirayeli. Ngokuba uyehova ebatandile o‐Sirayeli ngonapakade, kukona akumiseleyo ube ngukumkani, ukwenza ubugwebo nobulungisa.

Waza wamnika ukumkani italente zegolide zalikulu elinamashumi mabini, nento eninzi yezimnandi, namatye anqabileyo: bekungasiza izimnandi kanjako ngokuba zininzi njengezo ukumkanikazi we‐Sheba wazinika kukumkani u‐Solomone.
Nakanjalo inqanawa zika‐Hirame, ezatuta igolide e‐Ofire, zavela e‐Ofire nemiti yelamuge emininzi kakulu, namatye anqabileyo.

Waye ukumkani ngemiti yelamuge leyo wenzela indlu kayehova nendlu yokumkani izixaso, wenz ela abaculi ikinore nenebele kanjalo: bekungasiza imiti yelamuge enjalo, bekungabonwa enjalo kanjako, kwada kwanamhla nje.

Waza ukumkani u‐Solomone wamnika ukumkanikazi we‐Sheba konke ukutanda kwake, oko wakucelayo, ngapandle kwoko wamnikayo ngokwesisa sokumkani u‐Solomone. Wada wabuya, wahambela kwelake ilizwe, yena nezicaka zake.
Kekaloku ukulinganiswa kwayo igolide ebisiza ku‐Solomone emnyakeni mnye, bezizitalente zegolide ezingamakulu matandatu anamashumi matandatu enesitandatu;
ngapandle kwebisiza ngabaṙatyazi, nokutenga kwabatengisi, nabo bonke okumkani base‐Arabi, nenkosi zelizwe.
Waza ukumkani u‐Solomone wenza amakaka angamakulu mabini ngegolide ekandelweyo; kwafakwa amakulu matandatu eshekele zegolide pezu kwekaka linye:
wazenza nengweletshetshe ezingamakulu matatu ngegolide ekandelweyo; kwafakwa imina zegolide zantatu pezu kwengweletshetshe inye: waza ukumkani wazibeka endlwini yehlati le‐Lebanone.
Waye ukumkani kanjako wayenza iterone enkulu yopondo lwendlovu, wayaleka ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Iterone leyo ibinezinyukelo zitandatu, nentloko yeterone ibiyinqukuva ngasemva; bekuko nezayamelo ngelicala nangeliya ngasendaweni yokuhlala, nengonyama zimbini zimi kufupi nezayamelo ezo:
zema kona nengonyama zilishumi linambini ngelicala nangeliya pezu kwazo izinyukelo zitandatu: akwenziwanga enjalo kobunye ubukumkani.

Kanjako zonke impahla zokusela zokumkani u‐Solomone zibe zizezegolide, nazo zonke impahla zendlu yehlati le‐Lebanone zibe zizezegolide enqabileyo: bekungeko e zesilivere; ibingabalelwa luto yona emihleni ka‐Solomone.

Ngokuba ukumkani ebenenqanawa zase‐Tareshishe pezu kwolwandle, kunye nenqanawa zika‐Hirame: kwakanye eminyakeni mitatu zafika inqanawa zase‐Tareshishe, zizisa igolide, nesilivere, n empondo zendlovu, nenkau, namaseme.
Kwa njalo ukumkani u‐Solomone wayemkulu pezu kwabo bonke okumkani bomhlaba, ngobutyebi nangobulumko.
Kanjako umhlaba wonke wabufuna ubuso buka‐Solomone, ukuze babuve ubulumko bake, obo wabubeka utixo entliziyweni yake.
Baye besiza abanye ngabanye nebaso labo, impahla zesilivere, nempahla zegolide, nengubo, nezixo̔bo, nezimnandi, n amahashe, namaqwaṙaṙa; into yomnyaka ngomnyaka.

Waye u‐Solomone kanjalo wabuta inqwelo namahashe okukwelwa; wabenenqwelo zaliwaka linamakulu mane, namahashe okukwelwa angamawaka alishumi linesibini; owazibeka ezixekweni zenqwelo, nakuye ukumkani e‐Yerusaleme.
Kanjako ukumkani wayenza isilivere e‐Yerusaleme njengamatye, nemiti yesedare wayenza njengemikiwane esezihlanjeni, ngokuba mininzi.
Nokuvela kwamahashe ka‐Solomone e‐Jipete, wati umhlambi wabatengi bokumkani wamkela umhlambi wamahashe ngenani elitile.

Kwaye kunyuka kwapuma inqwelo e‐Jipete nge shekele zesilivere ezingamakulu matandatu, nehashe ngezilikulu linamashumi mahlanu: kwaye kunjalo bekuku̔tshelwa bonke okumkani bama‐Hete, nokumkani be‐Siriya, ngesandla sabo.
KODWA ukumkani u‐Solomone watanda abafazi bezinye intlanga abaninzi, ngapandle kwentombi ka‐Faro, ama‐Mowabikazi, aba‐Hamonikazi, ama‐Edomekazi, ama‐Tsidonekazi, n ama‐Hetekazi;

abentlanga abete uyehova elusatsheni luka̔‐Sirayeli: Aniyi kungena kuzo, kanjalo zona aziyi kungena kuni; ngenyaniso, ziya kupambukisa intliziyo yenu ukuya emva kwotixo bazo: kwa kubo aba wanamatela u‐Solomone ngotando.
Wayenabafazi abangamakulu asixe̔nxe, bengamakosikazi, namashweshwe angamakulu matatu: bada abafazi bake bapambukisa intliziyo yake.

Ngokuba bekute ngexesha lobudala buka‐Solomone, abafazi bake bapambukisa intliziyo yake ukuya emva kwotixo bambi; yaye intliziyo yake yayingakolisekile ngakuyehova, utixo wake, njengentliziyo ka‐Davide uyise.
Ngokuba u‐Solomone ebelandela u‐Hashetorete utixokazi wama‐Tsidone, no‐Milikome intshontsho yaba‐Hamoni.
Waye u‐Solomone kanjalo ekwenza okukohlakeleyo emehlweni kayehova, engakolisi ukulandela uyehova, njengo‐Davide uyise.
Oko wayaka u‐Solomone indawo epakamileyo ku‐Kemoshe intshontsho yama‐Mowabi, entabeni epambi kwe‐Yerusaleme, naku‐Moleke intshontsho yosapo luka‐Hamoni.
Wayesenzela bonke abafazi bake bezinye intlanga kwa ngokunjalo, abaqumisayo babingelela kotixo babo.
Waza waqumba uyehova ngakuye u‐Solomone, ngokuba intliziyo yake ipambukile kuyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, obebonakele kuye kabini,
wamyalela ngalendawo, ukuba makangalandeli otixo bambi: kodwa akagcina oko wamyalelayo uyehova.

Ngako wati uyehova ku‐Solomone: Ngenxa yokuba iko lento kuwe, ukuba akugcinanga ucebano lwam nezimiselo zam endikuyaleleyo ngazo, ndiya kuṙazula ngenyaniso ubukumkani obu kuwe, ndibunike kwisicaka sako.
Andiyi kukwenza oku noko emihleni yako, ngenxa ka‐Davide uyihlo wako; ndobuṙazula esandleni sonyana wako.
Kodwa andiyi kuṙazula ubukumkani bonke; isizwe sinye ndosinika kunyana wako, ngenxa ka‐Davide isicaka sam, nangenxa ye‐Yerusaleme endiyinyulileyo.
Waza uyehova wamvusela u‐Solomone umalane, u‐Hadade um‐Edome: yena ebengowenzalo yokumkani e‐Edome.
Ngokuba bekute, akuba u‐Davide ebese‐Edome, nxa u‐Jowabi inkosi yomkosi ebenyukile ukuya kuncw̔aba abahlatyiweyo, seebulele nje bonke ababudoda e‐Edome;
(ngokuba u‐Jowabi ebesala kona inyanga zantandatu, no‐Sirayeli bonke, wada wanqamla bonke ababudoda e‐Edome;)
wandula wesaba u‐Hadade, yena namadoda atile angama‐Edome ezicakeni zoyise kunye naye, ukuya e‐Jipete; waye u‐Hadade engumfana omncinane.
Baye besuka e‐Midiyane, beza e‐Parane; batabata amadoda nabo e‐Parane, bada bafika e‐Jipete, ku‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete; owamnika indlu, wamabela ukudla, wamnika nomhlaba.
Waza u‐Hadade wafumana ufefe olukulu emehlweni ka‐Faro, wada wamnika abe ngumfazi udade womfazi wake, udade ka‐Tapenesi ukumkanikazi.
Wati udade ka‐Tapenesi wamzalela u‐Genubate, unyana wake, obelunyulwa ngu‐Tapenesi endlwini ka‐Faro; waza u‐Genubate wasendlwini ka‐Faro pakati kwonyana baka‐Faro.
Kekaloku akuva u‐Hadade e‐Jipete, ukuba u‐Davide walala noyise bake, nokuba u‐Jowabi inkosi yomkosi ufile, wati u‐Hadade ku‐Faro: Ndindulule, ukuba ndiye elizweni lam.
Wandula wati u‐Faro kuye: Pofu uswele nto nina kum, ukuba, bona ke, ufuna ukuya elizweni lako? Wayesiti: Akuko nto; kodwa kaundindulule noko.
Kanjako utixo wamvusela omnye umalane, u‐Rezone unyana ka‐Eliyada, owesaba ku‐Hadadezere ukumkani we‐Tsoba inkosi yake.
Wada wahlanganisela kuye amadoda, waba yinkosi yebandla, okuya u‐Davide wababulala abase‐Tsoba: basuka baya e‐Damakusi, bahlala kona, bapata ubukumkani e‐Damakusi.
Wayengumalane yena ko‐Sirayeli yonke imihla ka‐Solomone, ngapandle kwobubi a bebenza u‐Hadade: wayetiya o‐Sirayeli, wapata ubukumkani pezu kwe‐Siriya.
No‐Jerobome unyana ka‐Nebati, um‐Eferata wase‐Tsereda, isicaka sika‐Solomone, onina ebenegama elingu‐Tseruha, umhlolokazi, kwa naye wapakamisa isandla ngakuye u‐Solomone.
Nantsi indawo wapakamisa isandla ngakuye ukumkani ngayo: u‐Solomone waka i‐Milo, wavingca intanda zesixeko sika‐Davide uyise.
Kekaloku indoda leyo, u‐Jerobome, ibiliṙoti elikalipileyo: waza u‐Solomone, akubona indodana leyo ukuba yawenza umsebenzi, wayongamisa pezu kwawo wonke umtwalo wendlu ka‐Josefe.
Kwaza kwati ngeloxesha, akuba u‐Jerobome epumile e‐Yerusaleme, wandula u‐Ahiya um‐Shilo, umprofite, wamfumana endleleni; waye yena ezinamekile ngengubo entsha; babebodwa bobabini endle:
waza u‐Ahiya wabamba ingubo entsha ebikuye, wayiṙazula ibe ziziziba zilishumi linazibini;
wayesiti ku‐Jerobome: Zitabatele iziziba zibe lishumi; ngokuba esitsho uyehova, utixo wo‐Sirayeli, ukuti: Bona ke, ndiya kuṙazula ubukumkani esandleni sika‐Solomone, ndinike wena izizwe ezilishumi:
(kodwa isizwe sinye soba sesake, ngenxa yesicaka sam u‐Davide, nangenxa ye‐Yerusaleme, isixeko endisinyulileyo kuzo zonke izizwe zo‐Sirayeli:)

ngenxa yokuba bandishiyile, nokuba batobile pambi kwo‐Hashetorete utixokazi wama‐Tsidone, n o‐Kemoshe utixo wama‐Mowabi, no‐Milikome utixo wosapo luka‐Hamoni, bengahambanga nje ezindleleni zam, ukwenza okufaneleyo emehlweni am, kwa izimiselo zam nezigwebo zam, njengo‐Davide uyise.

Kodwa andiyi kususa ubukumkani bonke esandleni sake; koko ndiya kumenza abe yinkosi yonke imihla yokudla kwake ubomi, ngenxa ka‐Davide isicaka sam, endamnyulayo, ngokuba wabegcina imiyalelo yam nezimiselo zam:
kodwa ndiya kususa ubukumkani esandleni sonyana wake, ndibunike kuwe, kwa izizwe ezilishumi.
Nakunyana wake ndiya kunika isizwe sinye, ukuze u‐Davide isicaka sam abe nesibane ngamaxesha onke ebusweni bam e‐Yerusaleme, isixeko endisinyulele mna, ukuba ndibeke igama lam kona.
Kanjalo wena ndokutabata, wauya kupata ubukumkani pezu kwako konke okukanukwayo ngumpefumlo wako, ube ngukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli.

Kwakuya kuti, ukuba uya kupulapula konke endikuyalelayo ngako, uhambe ezindleleni zam, wenze okufaneleyo emehlweni am, ukugcina imimiselo yam nemiyalelo yam, njengokuba wenje njalo u‐Davide isicaka sam, ndiya kwandula ndibe nawe, ndikwakele indlu eqinileyo, njengokuba ndimakele u‐Davide, ndikunike o‐Sirayeli.
Ndandiya kubandezela inzalo ka‐Davide ngenxa yoku; kodwa akuyi kuba njalo amaxesha onke.
Ngako u‐Solomone wafuna ukumfisa u‐Jerobome. Wandula wesuka u‐Jerobome, wesabela e‐Jipete, ku‐Shishaki ukumkani we‐Jipete, wabeko e‐Jipete kwada kwafa u‐Solomone.
Kekaloku isisalela semicimbi ka‐Solomone, nako konke wakwenzayo, nobulumko bake, ayiba̔lwanga na yona encwadini yemicimbi ka‐Solomone?
Nexesha u‐Solomone wabepata ubukumkani ngalo e‐Yerusaleme pezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke, ibiyiminyaka engamashumi mane.
Wada u‐Solomone walala noyise bake, wancw̔atywa esixekweni sika‐Davide uyise; waza u‐Rehobome unyana wake waba ngukumkani esikundleni sake.
WASUKA u‐Rehobome waya e‐Shekeme: ngokuba bebeze e‐Shekeme o‐Sirayeli bonke, ukuze bamenze ukumkani.
Kwaye kute, kwakuviwa ngu‐Jerobome unyana ka‐Nebati, (kekaloku yena ebeseko e‐Jipete, ngokuba ebesabile ebusweni buka‐Solomone ukumkani; waza u‐Jerobome wahlala e‐Jipete:
bada batuma bambiza;) kwandul’ ukuza u‐Jerobome nayo yonke intlanganiso yo‐Sirayeli, bateta ku‐Rehobome, besiti:
Uyihlo wako wayenza lukuni iyokwe yetu; uz’ uti wena kaloku wenze lula ubukonzo boyihlo obulukuni, neyokwe enzima abeyibeka pezu kwetu, sasiya kukukonza.
Wayesiti kubo: Mkani kanjako intsuku zibe ntatu, nandule nibuye nize kum. Bemka ke abantu.
Waza ukumkani u‐Rehobome wacebisana namaxego, abemi ebusweni buka‐Solomone uyise, nxa abesahleli, wati: Niti nina uku ndi cebisa nina, kuze kupendulwe ababantu?
Ateta kuye, esiti: Ukuba uya kuba sisicaka kwababantu namhla, ubakonze, ubapendule, utete kubo amazwi alungileyo, baya kwandula babe zizicaka zako imihla yonke.
Kodwa washiya icebo lamaxego, elo abemcebisile ngalo, waya wacebisana namadodana abekulile kunye naye, abemi ebusweni bake.
Wayesiti kuwo: Lelinina icebo nilinikayo nina, ukuba sipendule ababantu, abatetileyo kum, besiti: Yenza lula iyokwe ayibekileyo pezu kwetu uyihlo wako?

Aza ateta kuye amadodana abekulile kunye naye, esiti: Uya kutsho kwababantu abatetileyo kuwe, besiti: Uyihlo wako wayenza nzima iyokwe yetu, kodwa wena yenze lula pezu kwetu: uya kutsho kubo ukuti: Ucikicane wam woba mkulu kuso isinqe sobawo isibili sake.
Ukuba kaloku ubawo unitwesile ngeyokwe enzima, mna ke ndiya kwongeza kuyo iyokwe yenu: ubawo unohlwayile ngezwiniya, kodwa mna ndonohlwaya ngonomadudwane.
Kwa njalo kweza u‐Jerobome nabo bonke abantu ku‐Rehobome ngosuku lwesitatu, njengokuba ebetetile ukumkani, esiti: Buyani nize kum ngosuku lwesitatu.
Waza ukumkani wapendula abantu ngokulukuni, walishiya icebo lamaxego, elo amcebisa ngalo,
wateta kubo njengecebo lamadodana, esiti: Ubawo wenza nzima iyokwe yenu, kodwa mna ndiya kwongeza kuyo iyokwe yenu; ubawo wanohlwaya ngezwiniya, kodwa mna ndiya kunohlwaya ngonomadudwane.
Akapulapula ke ukumkani ebantwini; ngokuba belulujiko luvela kuyehova, ukuze aliqinise ilizwi lake, elo walitetayo uyehova ngaye u‐Ahiya um‐Shilo ku‐Jerobome unyana ka‐Nebati.

Bati bakubona bonke o‐Sirayeli ukuba ukumkani akapulapuli kubo, bapendula abantu kukumkani, besiti: Sisipina isabiwo esinaso ku‐Davide? akuko kuti nelifa kunyana ka‐Jese: ezintenteni zenu, bo‐Sirayeli! kaloku kangela kweyako indlu, Davide! Basuka baya o‐Sirayeli ezintenteni zabo.
Kodwa usapo luka‐Sirayeli olube luhleli ezixekweni zakwa‐Juda, wapata ubukumkani pezu kwalo u‐Rehobome.

Wandula ukumkani u‐Rehobome watuma u‐Adorame, obepezu kwabesitabataba; baza bonke o‐Sirayeli bamgibisela ngamatye, wada wafa. Ngako ukumkani u‐Rehobome wanxama ukukwela enqwelweni, ukuba asabele e‐Yerusaleme.
Kwa njalo o‐Sirayeli baqipukelana nendlu ka‐Davide, kwada kwanamhla nje.

Kwaye kute, kwakuviwa ngo‐Sirayeli bonke ukuba ubuyile u‐Jerobome, bandula batuma bambizela entlanganisweni, bamenza ukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke: akwabiko namnye owalandela indlu ka‐Davide, ngapandle kwesizwe sika‐Juda sodwa.

Wati u‐Rehobome akufika e‐Yerusaleme, wahlanganisa yonke indlu ka‐Juda, nesizwe sika‐Benjamine, amawaka alikulu linamashumi asibozo amadodana eqelene nokulwa, ukuba kuliwe nendlu ka‐Sirayeli, buze ubukumkani bubuyiselwe ku‐Rehobome unyana ka‐Solomone.
Kodwa ilizwi likatixo leza ku‐Shemaya indoda katixo, lisiti:
Yitsho ku‐Rehobome unyana ka‐Solomone ukumkani wo‐Juda, nakuyo yonke indlu ka‐Juda no‐Benjamine, nakwisisalela sabantu, usiti:

Utsho uyehova ukuti: Aniyi kunyuka, aniyi kulwa nabazalwana benu usapo luka‐Sirayeli kanjalo; buyani abanye ngabanye ukuya endlwini yabo; ngokuba lento yenzekile ngam. Baza bapulapula ilizwi likayehova, babuya ukumka, njengelizwi likayehova.
WANDULA u‐Jerobome waka i‐Shekeme entabeni yakwa‐Frayime, wahlala kuyo; wayepuma kona, waya waka i‐Penuweli.
Waza u‐Jerobome wati entliziyweni yake: Kaloku ubukumkani bobuyela kwindlu ka‐Davide:

xeshekweni baya kunyuka ababantu ukuya kuwenza amadini endlwini kayehova e‐Yerusaleme, iya kwandula intliziyo yababantu ibuyele enkosini yabo, ku‐Rehobome ukumkani wo‐Juda; babeya kubulala mna, babuyele ku‐Rehobome ukumkani wo‐Juda.
Ngako ukumkani wafuna icebo, wenza amatole amabini egolide, wati kubo: Kunzima pezu kwenu ukuba ninyukele e‐Yerusaleme; naba otixo bako, Sirayeli! abakunyusayo elizweni le‐Jipete.
Waza wabeka elinye e‐Betele, nelinye walimisa e‐Dane.
Lento kodwa yaba sisono: ngokuba abantu bebesiya pambi kwelinye, kwada kwase‐Dane.
