Aba‐Levi: usapo luka‐Yoshuwa n o‐Kadimele, olwosapo luka‐Hodeva, ngamashumi asixe̔nxe anesine.
Abaculi: usapo luka‐Safa, likulu linye elinamashumi mane anesibozo.
Abalindimnyango: usapo luka‐Shalume, usapo luka‐Atere, usapo luka‐Talimone, usapo luka‐Hakube, usapo luka‐Hatita, usapo luka‐Shobai, likulu linye elinamashumi matatu anesibozo.
Aba‐Netini: usapo luka‐Tsiha, usapo luka‐Hasufa, usapo luka‐Tabahoti,
usapo luka‐Kerosi, usapo luka‐Siha, usapo luka‐Padoni,
usapo luka‐Lebana, usapo luka‐Hagaba, usapo luka‐Shalemai,
usapo luka‐Hanane, usapo luka‐Gidele, usapo luka‐Gahari,
usapo luka‐Rehaya, usapo luka‐Retsine, usapo luka‐Nekoda,
usapo luka‐Gazame, usapo luka‐Huza, usapo luka‐Paseha,
usapo luka‐Besai, usapo luka‐Mehunime, usapo luka‐Nefishesime,
usapo luka‐Bakebuke, usapo luka‐Hakufa, usapo luka‐Harehure,
usapo luka‐Batseliti, usapo luka‐Mehida, usapo luka‐Haresha,
usapo luka‐Barekosi, usapo luka‐Sisera, usapo luka‐Tama,
usapo luka‐Netsiha, usapo luka‐Hatifa.
Usapo lwezicaka zika‐Solomone: usapo luka‐Sotai, usapo luka‐Soferete, usapo luka‐Perida,
usapo luka‐Yahala, usapo luka‐Darekone, usapo luka‐Gidele,
usapo luka‐Shefatiya, usapo luka‐Hatili, usapo luka‐Pokerete‐tsebayime, usapo luka‐Amoni.
Bonke aba‐Netini, nosapo lwezicaka zika‐Solomone, ngamakulu matatu anamashumi alitoba anesibini.
Kanjalo aba ngabanyukayo e‐Tele‐mela, nas e‐Tele‐haresha: u‐Kerube, u‐Adoni, no‐Yimeri: kodwa bakohlwa kuxela indlu yoyise yabo, nesizalwane sabo, ukuba bangabakwa‐Sirayeli na.
Usapo luka‐Delaya, usapo luka‐Tobiya, usapo luka‐Nekoda, ngamakulu matandatu anamashumi mane anesibini.
Nakubo abaperisite: onyana baka‐Habaya, onyana baka‐Kotse, onyana baka‐Barezilai, owazeka umfazi kwintombi zika‐Barezilai um‐Gileyadi, wabizwa ngegama lazo:
aba bafuna ukuba̔lelwa kwabo pakati kwababa̔lelweyo ngokuzalwa, kodwa akwafunyanwa: ngako bashenxiswa kubo ubuperisite njengabanco̔lileyo.
Yayisiti kubo inkosi enkulu, ukuba mabangatyi kwizinto ezingcwele kakulu, kude kusuke umperisite ene‐Urime ne‐Tumime.
Yonke intlanganiso kwa kunye ibingamawaka amashumi mane enesibini anamakulu matatu anamashumi matandatu,

ngapandle kwezicaka zabo nezicakakazi zabo, ezibe zingamawaka asixe̔nxe anamakulu matatu anamashumi matatu anesixe̔nxe: bebenabaculi nabaculikazi abangamakulu mabini anamashumi mane anesihlanu kanjako.
Amahashe abo ebengamakulu asixe̔nxe anamashumi matatu anesitandatu; amaqwaṙaṙa abo ebengamakulu mabini anamashumi mane anesihlanu;
inkamela zabo bezingamakulu mane anamashumi matatu anesihlanu; amaqwaṙashe abo ebengamawaka matandatu anamakulu asixe̔nxe anamashumi mabini.

Bati inxenye kubo bonke abazintloko zendlu zoyise, banika emsebenzini. Inkosi enkulu yanika endyetyeni, idarike zegolide zaliwaka linye, n ezitya zokufefela zamashumi mahlanu, n engubo zabaperisite zamakulu mahlanu anamashumi matatu.
Nabazintloko zendlu zoyise inxenye banika endyetyeni yomsebenzi, idarike zegolide zamawaka angamashumi mabini, nemina zesilivere zamawaka mabini anamakulu mabini.
Okwanikwayo ngabanye abantu bekuzidarike zegolide ezimawaka amashumi mabini, nemina zesilivere ezimawaka mabini, nengubo zabaperisite ezimashumi matandatu anesixe̔nxe.

Bada abaperisite, naba‐Levi, nabalindimnyango, nabaculi, nenxenye yabantu, naba‐Netini, no‐Sirayeli bonke, bahlala ezixekweni zakowabo: kwati kwakufika inyanga yesixe̔nxe, usapo luka‐Sirayeli belusezixekweni zalo.
BANDULA bonke abantu bazihlanganisela enkundleni engapambi kwesango lamanzi njengomntu mnye; bati ku‐Ezera umba̔li, ukuba makayizise incwadi yomteto ka‐Mosesi, lowo uyehova ubewumisele o‐Sirayeli.
Waza u‐Ezera umperisite wawuzisa umteto ebusweni bentlanganiso, kwa namadoda nabafazi, nabo bonke abebeqonda ukuva, ngowokuqala umhla wenyanga yesixe̔nxe.

Walesesha kuwo pambi kwenkundla engapambi kwesango lamanzi, kwa sekukanyeni kwokusa kwada kwasemini enkulu, ngapambi kwamadoda nabafazi, nabanokuqonda; zati indlebe zabantu bonke zabekwa encwadini yomteto.

Wema u‐Ezera umba̔li pezu kwesitulo semiti eside, abebesenzile ngenxa yalondawo: kwema ngakuye u‐Matitiya, no‐Shema, no‐Hanaya, no‐Huriya, no‐Hilikiya, no‐Mahaseya, ngesokunene sake; nangesokohlo sake, u‐Pedaya, no‐Mishayeli, no‐Malekiya, no‐Hashume, no‐Hashebadana, n o‐Zekariya, n o‐Meshulame.
Waza u‐Ezera wavula incwadi pambi kwamehlo abantu bonke; (ngokuba ebepezulu kubo bonke abantu;) nxa ayivulileyo, bema abantu bonke.
Wandula u‐Ezera wambonga uyehova, utixo omkulu. Bapendula bonke abantu, besiti: Amene, Amene! bepakamisa izandla zabo: baza batoba ngapantsi, bambedesha uyehova, ubuso bungasemhlabeni.

Kekaloku u‐Yoshuwa, no‐Bani, no‐Sherebiya, n o‐Yamine, n o‐Hakube, n o‐Shabetai, n o‐Hodiya, n o‐Mahaseya, n o‐Kelita, n o‐Hazariya, n o‐Yozabadi, n o‐Hanane, n o‐Pelaya, naba‐Levi, babafundisa abantu umteto: bati abantu bema endaweni yabo.
Baza balesesha encwadini, emtetweni katixo, kwa sekuhleni, bawuca̔zela, baqondisa ekulesesheni.

Wayesiti u‐Nehemiya, oyinkosi enkulu, no‐Ezera umperisite, umba̔li, naba‐Levi abafundisayo abantu, kubo bonke abantu: Lemini ingcwele kuyehova, utixo wenu; ningabi lusizi, ningalili nokulila. Ngokuba bonke abantu bebelila, nxa bevayo amazwi omteto.

Walekela wati kubo: Hambani, yityani okutyebileyo, nisele okumnandi, nizitume izabelwa kwabangalungiselwanga nto: ngokuba lemini ingcwele kwinkosi yetu: niti kanjako ningadandateki; ngokuba uvuyo lwoyehova, lulo amandla enu.
Kanjalo aba‐Levi batutuzela abantu bonke, besiti: Tutuni, ngokuba imini le ingcwele; ngako ningadandateki.
Bandula bahamba bonke abantu baya ukutya, nokusela, nokutuma izabelwa, nokuwenza umgcobo omkulu, ngenxa yokuba bebeqondile amazwi abeshunyayelwe kubo.
Nangowesibini umhla, kwahlanganiswa abazintloko zendlu zoyise zabantu bonke, n abaperisite, naba‐Levi, beza ku‐Ezera umba̔li, ukuze banakane amazwi omteto.
Baza bafumana kuba̔liwe emtetweni, ukuba uyehova ebeyalele ngo‐Mosesi, okokuba usapo luka‐Sirayeli luya kuhlala emapempeni ngomtendeleko wenyanga yesixe̔nxe;

nokokuba luvakalise ludlulise nokudlulisa ilizwi kuzo zonke izixeko zalo, nase‐Yerusaleme, lokuti: Pumani niye ezintabeni, nizise amasebe eminquma, namasebe emiti yeoli, namasebe emiti yemutele, namasebe emiti yepalime, namasebe emiti ebungqingqwa, kuze kwenziwe amapempe, njengokuba̔liweyo.

Basuka bapuma abantu, bawazisa, bazenzela amapempe, abanye ngabanye pezu kwezindlu zabo, nasemabaleni abo, nasemabaleni endlu katixo, nasenkundleni yesango lamanzi, nasenkundleni yesango lika‐Frayime.

Yaza yonke intlanganiso yababuyileyo ekutinjweni yawenza amapempe, yahlala emapempeni lawo: ngokuba belungenzanga usapo luka‐Sirayeli ngokunjalo, kuselokwemihla ka‐Yoshuwa unyana ka‐Nune kwada kwangumhla lowo. Kwaza kwabako umgcobo omkulu.

Kwaye kuleseshwa encwadini yomteto katixo, imini ngemini, kweyokuqala imini kwada kwayimini yokupela. Babamba umtendeleko imihla esixe̔nxe; nangowesibozo umhla kwabako intlanganisano engcwele, njengesiko.
KEKALOKU ngomhla wamashumi mabini anesine walenyanga, kwahlanganisana usapo luka‐Sirayeli, lunenzilo, nengubo ezintlakantlaka, nomhlaba pezu kwalo.
Yaza inzalo ka‐Sirayeli yazahlula kubo bonke abezinye intlanga, yema yaxela izono zayo, nenkohlakalo zoyise bayo.
Bapakama endaweni yokuma yabo, balesesha encwadini yomteto kayehova, utixo wabo, esesine isahluko semini; n esinye isahluko sesine, baxela, bambedesha uyehova, utixo wabo.
Basuka bema pezu kwendawo epezulu yaba‐Levi, u‐Yoshuwa, no‐Bani, u‐Kadimele, u‐Shebaniya, u‐Buni, u‐Sherebiya, u‐Bani, n o‐Kenani, bakala ngelizwi elikulu kuyehova, utixo wabo.

Bandula bati aba‐Levi, u‐Yoshuwa, no‐Kadimele, u‐Bani, u‐Hashabiniya, u‐Sherebiya, u‐Hodiya, u‐Shebaniya, n o‐Petahiya: Pakamani, bongani uyehova, utixo wenu, kwa kunapakade kude kube ngunapakade: malibongwe igama lako elibungcwalisa, elipakanyiselweyo ngapezu konke ukubongwa nokudunyiswa.

Wena unguye uyehova wedwa; nguwe owenzileyo izulu, izulu lamazulu, nawo wonke umkosi walo: umhlaba, nako konke okupezu kwawo; ilwandle, nako konke okukuzo: nguwe ezilondolozayo zonke ezo nto: umkosi wezulu uyabedesha wena.
Wena unguye uyehova o ngutixo, owamqashayo u‐Abrame, wamkupa e‐Ure yama‐Kaledine, wamtiya igama elingu‐Abrahame;

wayifumana intliziyo yake inyanisekile pambi kwako, walwenza naye ucebano, ukuba ulinike ilizwe laba‐Kanane, n ama‐Hete, n aba‐Amori, nama‐Perizi, nama‐Yebusi, nama‐Giregashe, ukuba ulinike kuyo inzalo yake: waza waqinisa amazwi ako: ngokuba ulungile wena:
kanjalo wabona ukubandezelwa kwobawo betu e‐Jipete, nokukala kwabo wakuva ngaselwandle olubomvu;

wakupa imiqondiso nemimangaliso pezu kwake u‐Faro, napezu kwazo zonke izicaka zake, napezu kwabo bonke abantu belizwe lake: ngokuba ubusazi ukuba benza nger̔atshi ngakubo: waza wazenzela igama, njengokuba kunjalo kwa namhla:
nolwandle wabulucanda pambi kwabo, bada badlula pakati kwolwandle pezu kw omhlaba owomileyo; nabatshutshisi babo wabubaposela ezinzulwini, njengelitye emanzini anamandla:
wabubakapa emini ngentsika yelifu; nasebusuku ngentsika yomlilo, baze bakanyiselwe endleleni abaya kuhamba ngayo.
Kanjako wabusihla pezu kwentaba ye‐Sinai, wateta nabo usezulwini, wabanika izigwebo ezifaneleyo, nemiteto eyinene, imimiselo nemiyalelo elungileyo:
nesabata yako engcwele wayazisa kubo; nemiyalelo, nemimiselo, nomteto, wayixela kubo ngo‐Mosesi isicaka sako:

nesonka sivela ezulwini wabusinika kubo ngenxa yokulamba kwabo, wabapumisela amanzi eweni ngenxa yokunxanwa kwabo, wabaxelela ukuba bangene ukufuya ilizwe obupakamisile isandla sako sokuba ulinike kubo.
Kodwa bona nobawo betu benza nger̔atshi, bazenza lukuni intamo zabo, abapulapula imiyalelo yako,

bala ukuva, abakumbulela imimangaliso yako obuyenzile pakati kwabo; bazenza lukuni intamo zabo, bati ngenkani yabo badala intloko, ukuba babuyele ebukobokeni babo: kodwa wena ungutixo wezixolelo, onofefe, onetaṙu, oqumba kade, onobubele obukulu; ngako ubungabashiyanga.
Ewe, naxeshekweni bebezenzele itole elityityishiweyo, bati: Eli lingutixo wako owakunyusayo e‐Jipete; baza benza izigxeko ezikulu;

wati wena noko, ngezibele zako ezininzi, akwabashiya entlango: intsika yelifu ibingemki kubo emini, ize ibakokele endleleni; kwa nentsika yomlilo ebusuku, ize ibakanyisele, nendlela abaya kuhamba ngayo.
Kanjalo wanika umoya wako olungileyo ukubafundisa; akwabamba imana yako emlonyeni wabo, wabapa amanzi ngenxa yokunxanwa kwabo;
wabanqaka entlango iminyaka yamashumi mane, abaswela luto; izivato zabo bezingenakuguga, nenyawo zabo azadumba.
Kanjako wabubanika ubukumkani nentlanga, wabahlulahlula kwindawo ngendawo: bada bafuya ilizwe lika‐Sihone, kwa ilizwe lokumkani we‐Heshebone, nelizwe lika‐Hogi ukumkani we‐Bashane.
Nabantwana babo wabubandisa njengenkwenkwezi zezulu, wabangenisa kwelolizwe ubuxelele oyise babo ukuba bongena ukulifuya.

Kwa njalo abantwana abo bangena balifuya ilizwe, wati wena wabatobisa pambi kwabo abemi belizwe, aba‐Kanane, wabanikela ezandleni zabo, nokumkani babo, nabantu belizwe, ukuze benze kubo njengokutanda kwabo.

Baza babamba izixeko ezinqatyisiweyo, nomhlaba otyebileyo, bafuya izindlu zizele zindyebo zonke, amacibi embelweyo, izitiya zemiti yeveyine, nezeminquma, nemiti yokutya, ngobuninzi: badla ke, bahluta, batyeba, baziyolisa ekulungeni kwako obukulu.
Kodwa benza ngenkani, bavukela ngakuwe, baposa umteto wako emva kwomhlana wabo, babulala abaprofite bako, abo banqi̔nayo ngakubo, ukuba bababuyisele kuwe, bazenza izigxeko ezikulu.

Ngako wabubanikela esandleni sentshaba zabo, ezababandezelayo; kodwa ngexesha lokubandezelwa kwabo, bakukala kuwe, wabusiva ezulwini, wabanika abasindisi, ngezibele zako ezininzi, ababasindisayo esandleni sentshaba zabo.

Kanti xeshekweni babenokupumla, babuya bakwenza okukohlakeleyo pambi kwako: ngako wena wabashiya esandleni sentshaba zabo, ukuba zaba nobukosi pezu kwabo; kodwa bakubuya bakala kuwe, wabusiva ezulwini, wabahlangula, ngazo izibele zako, amaxesha amaninzi;

wanqi̔nayo ngakubo, ukuba ubabuyisele emtetweni wako: benza nger̔atshi noko, abapulapula imiyalelo yako, koko bonayo ngakuzo izigwebo zako, (aya kuti umntu, ukuba uyazenza, apile ngazo,) bapepisa igxalaba, bayenza lukuni intamo yabo, abapulapula ke.
Kodwa wabubeka kade pezu kwabo iminyaka yamininzi, wanqi̔na ngakubo ngomoya wako ngabo abaprofite bako: ababekela ndlebe noko: ngako wabanikela esandleni sabantu bamazwe.
Kodwa, ngezibele zako ezininzi, akwenza ukugqityelwa kwabo, akwabashiya kanjako; ngokuba wena u ngutixo onofefe onetaṙu.

Ngako kaloku, Tixo wetu! utixo omkulu, onamandla, owoyikekayo, ogcinayo ucebano nobubele, mayingabi yinto encinane ebusweni bako yonke inkatazo esihlileyo tina, okumkani betu, inkosi zetu, nabaperisite betu, nabaprofite betu, nobawo betu, nabo bonke abantu bako, kuselokwexesha lokumkani be‐Asiriya kwada kwanamhla nje.
Kodwa ulungile wena ngako konke esifikelwe kuko; ngokuba ubusenza ngenyaniso, kodwa tina senzile ngokukohlakeleyo:
ababambanga umteto wako okumkani beta, n enkosi zetu, n abaperisite betu, nobawo betu; abapulapulanga imiyalelo yako, nezinqi̔nelo zako, owabunqi̔na ngakubo ngazo.
Ngokuba bengakonzanga wena ebukumkanini babo nasekulungeni kwako okukulu owakunika kubo, naselizweni elibanzi elityebileyo owalinikayo pambi kwabo; kanjako abaguquka kuzo izenzo zabo ezikohlakeleyo.
Bona ke, namhla singabakonzi, nelizwe owabulinika kobawo betu ukuba batye ukuxakata kwalo nokuba mnandi kwalo, nanku singabakonzi kulo:
nokuvelisa kwalo liyakwandisela okumkani obabekileyo pezu kwetu ngenxa yezono zetu: kanjalo banobukosi pezu kwemizimba yetu, napezu kwenkomo zetu, njengokutanda kwabo; sisebunzimeni obukulu tina.
Nangenxa kwako konke oku siyalwenza ucebano, siluba̔le; ziti inkosi zetu, n aba‐Levi betu, n abaperisite betu, baluncamatisele.
Kekaloku abo bancamatiselayo: ngu‐Nehemiya, inkosi enkulu, unyana ka‐Hakaliya, no‐Zedekiya,
u‐Seraya, u‐Hazariya, u‐Jeremiya,
u‐Pashure, u‐Amariya, u‐Malekiya,
u‐Hatushe, u‐Shebaniya, u‐Maluke,
u‐Harime, u‐Meremote, u‐Hobadiya,
u‐Danyeli, u‐Ginetoni, u‐Baruke,
u‐Meshulame, u‐Abiya, u‐Miyamine,
u‐Mahaziya, u‐Biligai, n o‐Shemaya: aba ngabaperisite.
Naba‐Levi: ngu‐Yoshuwa, unyana ka‐Azaniya, u‐Binuwi, konyana baka‐Henadade, u‐Kadimele;
nabazalwana babo, u‐Shebaniya, u‐Hodiya, u‐Kelita, u‐Pelaya, u‐Hanane,
u‐Mika, u‐Rehobi, u‐Hashabiya,
u‐Zakure, u‐Sherebiya, u‐Shebaniya,
u‐Hodiya, u‐Bani, n o‐Beninu.
Abazintloko zabantu: ngu‐Paroshe, u‐Pahati‐mowabi, u‐Helami, u‐Zatu, u‐Bani,
u‐Buni, u‐Hazegadi, u‐Bebai,
u‐Adonija, u‐Bigivai, u‐Hadine,
u‐Atere, u‐Hezekiya, u‐Hazure,
u‐Hodiya, u‐Hashume, u‐Betsai,
u‐Harife, u‐Hanatote, u‐Nebai,
u‐Magipashe, u‐Meshulame, u‐Hezire,
u‐Meshezabele, u‐Tsadoki, u‐Yaduwa,
u‐Pelatiya, u‐Hanane, u‐Hanaya,
u‐Hosheha, u‐Hananiya, u‐Hashube,
u‐Haloheshe, u‐Pileha, u‐Shobeke,
u‐Rehumi, u‐Hashabena, u‐Mahaseya,
no‐Ahiya, u‐Hanane, u‐Anane,
u‐Maluke, u‐Harime, n o‐Bahana.

Nesisalela sabantu, abaperisite, aba‐Levi, abalindimnyango, abaculi, aba‐Netini, nabo bonke abebezahlule kubo abantu bamazwe ngenxa yomteto katixo, abafazi babo, onyana babo, nentombi zabo, bonke abebenokwazi n okuqonda,

babambelela kubo abazalwana babo, imiduna yabo, bangena esiqalekisweni, nasesifungweni, sokuba bahambe ngomteto katixo, obunikwe ngo‐Mosesi isicaka sikatixo, nokuba bayigcine bayenze yonke imiyalelo kayehova, inkosi yetu, nezigwebo zake, nezimiselo zake;
nokuba singendisi intombi zetu kubo abantu belizwe, nentombi zabo singazitabateli onyana betu;
nokuba abantu belizwe bakuzisa impahla nento zonke zokutya ngomhla wesabata kutengiswe, singatengi kubo ngesabata, nangomhla oyingcwele; nokuba siwuyeke umnyaka wesixe̔nxe, nawo onke amatyala.
Kanjako sazimisela imimiso, yokuba kubekwe pezu kwetu esesitatu isiqingata seshekele, ngomnyaka ngomnyaka, ngenxa yenkonzo yayo indlu katixo wetu:

ngenxa yezonka zokuṙozwa, nomnikelo wokudla ofuti, nangenxa yedini lokutshiswa elifuti, n elesabata, n elenyanga ezitwasileyo, ngenxa yemitendeleko emisiweyo, nangenxa yezinto ezingcwele, nangenxa yedini lesono lokwenzela o‐Sirayeli uxoliso, na ngenxa yawo wonke umsebenzi wendlu katixo wetu.

Saza sawenzela umnikelo wenkuni amaqashiso, abaperisite, n aba‐Levi, nabantu, ukuba kuziswe endlwini katixo wetu, ngendlu zoyise zetu, ngamaxesha amiselweyo, umnyaka ngomnyaka, kuze kutshiswe pezu kwesibingelo sikayehova, utixo wetu, njengokuba̔liweyo emtetweni:
ukuba kanjalo kuziswe ilibo zomhlaba wetu, nelibo zako konke ukuqa̔ma kwemiti yonke, umnyaka ngomnyaka, endlwini kayehova;
nokuba amazibulo konyana betu, nakwizilo zetu, njengokuba̔liweyo emtetweni, namazibulo enkomo zetu nawegusha zetu, siwazise endlwini katixo wetu, kubaperisite abakonzayo endlwini katixo wetu;

nokuba isiqalo sentlama yetu, neminikelo yetu, nesiqa̔mo semiti yonke, iveyine entsha, neoli, sizizise kubaperisite, ezinkambilini zendlu katixo wetu, nezishumi zomhlaba wetu kuba‐Levi; ngokuba bona aba‐Levi benikwa izishumi, kuzo zonke izixeko zokulima kwetu.
Waye umperisite, unyana ka‐Arone, eya kubako naba‐Levi, nxa kunikwa aba‐Levi izishumi; baze aba‐Levi basinyusele isishumi lezishumi ezo endlwini katixo wetu, ezinkambilini zayo indlu yendyebo:

ngokuba usapo luka‐Sirayeli, nosapo luka‐Levi, luya kuzisa umnikelo wenqolowa, n eveyine entsha, neoli, ezinkambilini, apo zikoyo impahla zendawo eyingcwele, nabaperisite abakonzayo, nabalindimnyango, nabaculi: nendlu katixo wetu asisayi kuyishiya.

ZATI inkosi zabantu zahlala e‐Yerusaleme: nesisalela sabantu, bawenza amaqashiso okuba kuziswe abe mnye kwabalishumi ahlale e‐Yerusaleme, isixeko esiyingcwele, nokuba abanye abalitoba bahlale kw ezinye izixeko.
Baye abantu betamsanqelisa onke lomadoda azinikelayo ngokuvuma ukuza kuhlala e‐Yerusaleme.

Zizo ezi intloko zaselizwaneni ezahlala e‐Yerusaleme: (kekaloku ezixekweni zakwa‐Juda, kwahlala abanye ngabanye ezimfuyweni zabo, ezixekweni zakowabo, o‐Sirayeli, abaperisite, naba‐Levi, naba‐Netini, nosapo lwezicaka zika‐Solomone:

nase‐Yerusaleme kwahlala inxenye kulo usapo luka‐Juda, nakulo usapo luka‐Benjamine.) Kulo usapo luka‐Juda: u‐Hataya, unyana ka‐Huziya, unyana ka‐Zekariya, unyana ka‐Amariya, unyana ka‐Shefatiya, unyana ka‐Mahalalele, kulo usapo luka‐Faretse;
no‐Mahaseya, unyana ka‐Baruke, unyana ka‐Kolehoze, unyana ka‐Hazaya, unyana ka‐Hadaya, unyana ka‐Yoyaribe, unyana ka‐Zekariya, unyana ka‐Shilo.
Lwonke usapo luka‐Faretse olwahlala e‐Yerusaleme, ngamakulu mane anamashumi matandatu anesibozo amadoda akalipileyo.
Ngaba abalusapo luka‐Benjamine: u‐Salu, unyana ka‐Meshulame, unyana ka‐Yohedi, unyana ka‐Pedaya, unyana ka‐Kolaya, unyana ka‐Mahaseya, unyana ka‐Yitiyeli, unyana ka‐Yesaya;
nasemva kwake, u‐Gabai, u‐Salai; amakulu alitoba anamashumi mabini anesibozo:
u‐Joweli, unyana ka‐Zikeri, ebengumongama wabo: no‐Juda, unyana ka‐Hasenuwa, ebepezu kwesixeko esesibini isahlulo.
Kubo abaperisite: u‐Yedaya unyana ka‐Yoyaribe, u‐Yakine,
u‐Seraya, unyana ka‐Hilikiya, unyana ka‐Meshulame, unyana ka‐Tsadoki, unyana ka‐Merayoti, unyana ka‐Ahitube, umpati wendlu katixo;

nabazalwana babo, abawenza umsebenzi wendlu, amakulu asibozo anamashumi mabini anesibini; no‐Hadaya, unyana ka‐Yerohame, unyana ka‐Pelaliya, unyana ka‐Ametsi, unyana ka‐Zekariya, unyana ka‐Pashure, unyana ka‐Malekiya;
nabazalwana bake, intloko zendlu zoyise, amakulu mabini anamashumi mane anesibini; no‐Hamashesai, unyana ka‐Hazareli, unyana ka‐Ahezai, unyana ka‐Meshilemote, unyana ka‐Yimeri;
nabazalwana babo, amaṙoti akalipileyo, ikulu elinamashumi mabini anesibozo: umongama wabo ebengu‐Zabideli, unyana wo wabakulu.
Nakubo aba‐Levi: u‐Shemaya, unyana ka‐Hashube, unyana ka‐Zarikame, unyana ka‐Hashabiya, unyana ka‐Buni;
no‐Shabetai, no‐Yozabadi, abapezu kwomsebenzi wapandle wendlu katixo, kubo abazintloko zaba‐Levi;

no‐Mataniya, unyana ka‐Mika, unyana ka‐Zabedi, unyana ka‐Safa, intloko eyaqala ukubulela ekutandazeni; no‐Bakebukiya, owesibini pakati kwabazalwana bake; no‐Abeda, unyana ka‐Shamuha, unyana ka‐Galali, unyana ka‐Jedutune.
Bonke aba‐Levi esixekweni esiyingcwele bebengamakulu mabini anamashumi asibozo anabane.
Nabalindimnyango: u‐Hakube, u‐Talimone, nabazalwana babo abagcinayo amasango, ikulu elinamashumi asixe̔nxe anesibini.
Nesisalela so‐Sirayeli, abaperisite, n aba‐Levi, bebekuzo zonke izixeko zakwa‐Juda, abanye ngabanye emafeni abo.
Bati aba‐Netini bahlala e‐Hofeli: u‐Tsiha no‐Gishepa bebepezu kwaba‐Netini.
Kanjalo umongama waba‐Levi e‐Yerusaleme ebengu‐Huzi, unyana ka‐Bani, unyana ka‐Hashabiya, unyana ka‐Mataniya, unyana ka‐Mika. Kulo usapo luka‐Safa, abaculi bebepezu kwomsebenzi wendlu katixo.
Ngokuba umyalelo wokumkani ngabo, ubungowokuba abaculi babe nesabelwa esitile, into yemini ngemini yayo.
No‐Petahiya unyana ka‐Meshezabele, kulo usapo luka‐Zera unyana ka‐Juda, yena ebengecala lokumkani, ngento zonke zabantu.
Nasemizini, kunye nezindle zayo, kwahlala inxenye yosapo luka‐Juda e‐Kiriyate‐areba namagxamesi ayo, nase‐Dibone namagxamesi ayo, nase‐Yekabetsele nemizi yayo,
nase‐Yeshuha, nase‐Molada, nase‐Bete‐pelete,
nase‐Hatsareshuhali, nase‐Beresheba namagxamesi ayo,
nase‐Tsikilage, nase‐Mekona, nakuwo amagxamesi ayo,
nase‐Henerimone, nase‐Tsoreha, nase‐Yaremute,
e‐Zanoha, e‐Hadulame, na kuyo imizi yazo, e‐Lakishe nezindle zayo, e‐Hazeka namagxamesi ayo. Kwamiwa kwa se‐Beresheba kwada kwasesihlanjeni sika‐Hinome.
Kwahlala nosapo luka‐Benjamine lwase‐Geba e‐Mikimashe, nase‐Haya, nase‐Betele namagxamesi ayo,
e‐Hanatote, e‐Nobe, e‐Hananiya,
e‐Hatsore, e‐Rama, e‐Gitayime,
e‐Hadidi, e‐Tsebohime, e‐Nebalate,
e‐Lodi, nase‐Ono, emhlanjeni wencibi.
Nakubo aba‐Levi kwahlala inxenye ezahlulweni zakwa‐Juda, ne zakwa‐Benjamine.
ABA ngabaperisite naba‐Levi abanyukayo kunye no‐Zerubabeli unyana ka‐Shalatiyeli, no‐Yoshuwa: u‐Seraya, u‐Jeremiya, u‐Ezera,
u‐Amariya, u‐Maluke, u‐Hatushe,
u‐Shekaniya, u‐Rehumi, u‐Meremote,
u‐Hido, u‐Ginetoi, u‐Abiya,
u‐Miyamine, u‐Mahadiya, u‐Bilega,
u‐Shemaya, no‐Yoyaribe, u‐Yedaya,
u‐Salu, u‐Hamoke, u‐Hilikiya, n o‐Yedaya. Aba bebezintloko zabaperisite, nabazalwana babo, emihleni ka‐Yoshuwa.
Naba‐Levi: u‐Yoshuwa, u‐Binuwi, u‐Kadimele, u‐Sherebiya, u‐Juda, n o‐Mataniya: ebepezu kwemibulelo, yena nabazalwana bake.
Kanjalo u‐Bakebukiya no‐Huni, abazalwana babo, bebelunge nabo ekulindeni.
Kekaloku u‐Yoshuwa wazala u‐Yoyakime, no‐Yoyakime wazala u‐Eliyashibe, no‐Eliyashibe wazala u‐Yoyada,
no‐Yoyada wazala u‐Jonatane, no‐Jonatane wazala u‐Yaduwa.
Nasemihleni ka‐Yoyakime bebeko abaperisite, intloko zendlu zoyise: oka‐Seraya, ngu‐Meraya; oka‐Jeremiya, ngu‐Hananiya;
oka‐Ezera, ngu‐Meshulame; oka‐Amariya, ngu‐Jehohanane;
oka‐Meliku, ngu‐Jonatane; oka‐Shebaniya, ngu‐Josefe;
oka‐Harime, ngu‐Hadena; oka‐Merayoti, ngu‐Helekai;
oka‐Hido, ngu‐Zekariya; oka‐Ginetoni, ngu‐Meshulame;
oka‐Abiya, ngu‐Zikeri; oka‐Minyamine, oka‐Mohadiya, ngu‐Piletai;
oka‐Bilega, ngu‐Shamuha; oka‐Shemaya, ngu‐Jonatane;
noka‐Yoyaribe, ngu‐Matenai; oka‐Yedaya, ngu‐Huzi;
oka‐Salai, ngu‐Kalai; oka‐Hamoke, ngu‐Hebere;
oka‐Hilikiya, ngu‐Hashabiya; oka‐Yedaya, ngu‐Netaneli.
Aba‐Levi emihleni ka‐Eliyashibe, n o‐Yoyada, no‐Johanane, no‐Yaduwa, baba̔lwa ngokuba zintloko zendlu zoyise; kwa nabaperisite, kwada kwako ubukumkani buka‐Dariyusi um‐Peresiya.
Onyana baka‐Levi, intloko zendlu zoyise, bebeba̔lelwa encwadini yezikronike, kwada kwasemihleni ka‐Johanane unyana ka‐Eliyashibe.
Nentloko zaba‐Levi, u‐Hashabiya, u‐Sherebiya, no‐Yoshuwa unyana ka‐Kadimele, nabazalwana babo malungana nabo, badumisa babulela, ngomyalelo ka‐Davide indoda katixo, uluhlu malungana noluhlu.
U‐Mataniya, no‐Bakebukiya, u‐Hobadiya, u‐Meshulame, u‐Talimone, n o‐Hakube, bebengabalindimnyango begcina isigcino ezinkambilini zokubekela zamasango.
Aba bebeko emihleni ka‐Yoyakime, unyana ka‐Yoshuwa, unyana ka‐Yotsadaki, nasemihleni ka‐Nehemiya inkosi, no‐Ezera umperisite, umba̔li.

KEKALOKU ekutwasisweni kwodonga lwe‐Yerusaleme, kwafunwa aba‐Levi, kuzo zonke indawo zabo, ukuba baziswe e‐Yerusaleme, kuze kwenziwe ukutwasiswa ngokugcoba, nangokubulela, nangokuvuma, ngesimbali, na ngamaculo, nangehadi.
Kwahlanganiswa nonyana babaculi, kwa nasezweni elibutafa elingqongayo i‐Yerusaleme, nasemizini yama‐Netofati,
nase‐Bete‐gilegale, nasezindleni zase‐Geba ne‐Hazamaveti: ngokuba abaculi bebezakele imizi ngokungqonga i‐Yerusaleme.
Bati abaperisite naba‐Levi bazicokisa; bandula bacokisa abantu, namasango, nodonga.
Ndaza ndenyusa inkosi zakwa‐Juda pezu kwodonga, ndamisa amaqela mabini amakulu abayenza imibulelo nabahamba ngokuqoqoza, elati elinye laya ngasekunene pezu kwodonga ngasesangweni lenkunkuma:
nasemva kwabo kwahamba u‐Hoshaya, nesinye isiqingata senkosi zakwa‐Juda,
no‐Hazariya, u‐Ezera, no‐Meshulame,
u‐Juda, no‐Benjamine, no‐Shemaya, no‐Jeremiya;
nakubo onyana babaperisite benamaxilongo: u‐Zekariya, unyana ka‐Jonatane, unyana ka‐Shemaya, unyana ka‐Mataniya, unyana ka‐Mikaya, unyana ka‐Zakure, unyana ka‐Safa;
nabazalwana bake, u‐Shemaya, u‐Hazareli, u‐Milalai, u‐Gilalai, u‐Mahai, u‐Netaneli, no‐Juda, n o‐Hanani, benezinto zokuculisa zika‐Davide indoda katixo, u‐Ezera umba̔li epambi kwabo.
Nangasesangweni lomtombo, namalungana nabo, benyuka ngezinyukelo zesixeko sika‐Davide, apo kunyukayo ukuya eludongeni, ngasentla kwendlu ka‐Davide, baya esangweni lamanzi ngasempumalanga.
Nelesibini iqela labayenza imibulelo, elahamba malungana nelinye, kwahamba mna emva kwalo, nesinye isiqingata sabantu, pezu kwodonga, kwa sentla kwenqaba yamaziko kwada kwaseludongeni olubanzi;
nasentla kwesango lika‐Frayime, nasentla kwesango elidala, nasentla kwesango lentlanzi, nenqaba ye‐Hananele, nenqaba ye‐Meha, kwada kwalisango legusha: bada bema esangweni lentolongo.
Aza ema amaqela omabini abayenza imibulelo endlwini katixo, nam, nesinye isiqingata samagosa kunye nam;
nabaperisite, u‐Eliyakime, u‐Mahaseya, u‐Minyamine, u‐Mikaya, u‐Eliwenai, u‐Zekariya, n o‐Hananiya, benamaxilongo;
no‐Mahaseya, no‐Shemaya, no‐Elezari, no‐Huzi, no‐Jehohanane, no‐Malekiya, no‐Helami, no‐Hezere. Baye abaculi bevakalisa, no‐Yizeraya umongama.
Kanjalo ngalomini babinga imibingo emikulu, bagcoba; ngokuba utixo ebebagcobisile ngomgcobo omkulu: abafazi nabantwana bagcoba nabo: kwaza kwavakala umgcobo we‐Yerusaleme kwada kwakude.

KWAYE kupatiswa ngeloxesha abatile pezu kwenkambili, ezendyebo, ezeminikelo, ezelibo, nezezishumi, kuze kuqokelelwe kuzo okwamasimi asezixekweni, izabelwa ezimiselwe abaperisite naba‐Levi ngumteto: ngokuba o‐Juda bebevuya pezu kwabaperisite napezu kwaba‐Levi abakonzayo.
Bati nabaculi nabalindimnyango bagcina isigcinelo sotixo wabo, nesigcinelo sokucokisa, njengomyalelo ka‐Davide, no ka‐Solomone unyana wake:
ngokuba emihleni ka‐Davide no Safa, kwa kudala, bekuko intloko zabaculi, nengoma zendumiso nemibulelo kutixo.

No‐Sirayeli bonke, emihleni ka‐Zerubabeli, nasemihleni ka‐Nehemiya, banika izabelwa zabaculi nabalindimnyango, into yemini ngemini yayo: kanjako bangcwalisela aba‐Levi, naba‐Levi bangcwalisela usapo luka‐Arone.
NGEXESHA elo kwaleseshwa encwadini ka‐Mosesi ezindlebeni zabantu: kwaza kwafunyanwa kuba̔liwe kuyo, okokuba um‐Hamoni, umhlaumbi um‐Mowabi, akayi kungena emhlambini katixo kude kube ngunapakade;
ngenxa yokuba bebengezi nesonka namanzi ukukaulela usapo luka‐Sirayeli, nokuba bebemqesha ngakulo u‐Bilame, aze aluqalekise: kodwa utixo wetu waguqula isiqalekiso sibe litamsanqa.
Kwaza kwati, nxa bebevile umteto, babahlula bonke abantu abadityanisiweyo ko‐Sirayeli.
Kekaloku kungekabiko oku, u‐Eliyashibe umperisite, obemisiwe pezu kwenkambili yendlu katixo wetu, waba ngumhlobo ku‐Tobiya,

wamenzela inkambili enkulu, apo bekufuda kubekelwa kona iminikelo yokudla, ne ntlakamhlope, nempahla, nezishumi zenqolowa, n ezeveyine entsha, nezeoli, ezibe zimiselwe aba‐Levi, nabaculi, nabalindimnyango; neminikelo yabaperisite.

Kodwa ngalo lonke eli xesha, ndibe ndingeko e‐Yerusaleme: ngokuba ngomnyaka wamashumi matatu anesibini ka‐Aretashasheta ukumkani we‐Babilone, bendizile kukumkani; nasekupeleni kwemihla etile ndacela kukumkani ukuba ndibuye.
Ndada ndafika e‐Yerusaleme, ndaqonda ngenkohlakalo ayenzileyo u‐Eliyashibe ngenxa yake u‐Tobiya, ngokumenzela inkambili emabaleni endlu katixo.
Kwaza kwakubi kum kakulu: ngako ndakupa zonke impahla zendlu zika‐Tobiya ngapandle enkambilini.
Ndaxela ke, bazicokisa inkambili: ndaza ndabuyisela kona impahla zendlu katixo, kunye nomnikelo wokudla, nentlakamhlope.
Kanjako ndabona ukuba bekunganikwanga izabelwa zaba‐Levi: ngokuba aba‐Levi nabaculi, abawenza umsebenzi, bebesabele abanye ngabanye emasimini abo.
Ndasuka ndapika namagosa, ndati: Yinina ukuba indlu katixo ishiyiwe? Ndaza ndabahlanganisa, ndabamisa endaweni yokuma yabo.
Bandula o‐Juda bonke bazisa isishumi senqolowa, neseveyine entsha, neseoli, ezindaweni zendyebo.

Ndaza ndenza abapati pezu kwendawo zendyebo, u‐Shelemiya umperisite, no‐Tsadoki umba̔li, no‐Pedaya kubo aba‐Levi; nasemva kwabo u‐Hanane, unyana ka‐Zakure, unyana ka‐Mataniya: ngokuba bebebalwa ngokuba nenyaniso, ekwaye kupezu kwabo ukwabela abazalwana babo.
Ndikumbule, Tixo wam! ngako oku, uz’ ungacimi izenzo zam ezilungileyo endizenzeleyo indlu katixo wam, nezigcinelo zayo.

Ngalomihla ndabona kwa‐Juda abaxovulayo isincinezelo seveyine ngesabata, nabangenisayo izitungu, nabatwesayo amaqwaṙashe; kwa neveyine, nedreyive, namakiwane, nemitwalo yonke, abati bayizisa e‐Yerusaleme ngomhla wesabata: ndaza ndanqi̔na ngakubo ngomhla batengisa ukutya ngawo.
Kwahlala kona nabase‐Tire, abazisa intlanzi, nento zonke zokutengwa, batengisa elusatsheni luka‐Juda, nase‐Yerusaleme, ngesabata.
Ndaza ndapika nemiduna yakwa‐Juda, ndati kuyo: Yinto nina lento ikohlakeleyo niyenzayo, ninco̔lisa nje umhla wesabata?
Abenje njalo na oyihlo benu, waza utixo wabuzisa pezu kwetu bonke obububi, napezu kwesisixeko? nani ke niyawandisa umsindo pezu kwo‐Sirayeli ngokunco̔lisa isabata.

Kwaza kwati, nxa amasango e‐Yerusaleme atelwa ncwalazi ingekafiki icawa, ndaxela ke, kwavalwa ingcango; ndabuya ndaxela ukuba mazingavulwa kude kupele isabata; nakwizicaka zam ndamisa inxenye ngasemasangweni, ukuze kungangeniswa namnye umtwalo ngomhla wesabata.
Bandula abatengi nabatengisi bezinto zonke zokutengwa balalisa ngapandle kwe‐Yerusaleme, kwakanye umhlaumbi kabini.
Ngako ndanqi̔na ngakubo, ndati kubo: Yinina ukuba nilalise pambi kwodonga? nxa nipinda ukwenje njalo, ndobeka izandla pezu kwenu. Kuselokwexesha elo bebengezi ngesabata.
Ndaza ndaxelela aba‐Levi ukuba bazicokise, beze bagcine amasango, kuze kwenziwe ngcwele umhla wesabata. Ndikumbulele oku nako, Tixo wam! ube nenceba kum ngabo ubuninzi bobubele bako.
Kanjako ngalomihla ndabona ama‐Juda abezekile abafazi abangama‐Ashedodekazi, n aba‐Hamonikazi, nama‐Mowabikazi:
bati abantwana bawo inxenye bateta ngesi‐Ashedode, bengenakwazi ukuteta ngesi‐Juda; bateta ngenteto yabantu ngabantu.

Ndaza ndapika nawo, ndawatuka, ndabeta amadoda atile kuwo, ndancotula inwele zawo, ndawafungisa utixo, ngokuti: Intombi zenu aniyi kuzendisa konyana babo, nentombi zabo aniyi kuzitabatela onyana benu, aniyi kuzizeka nani.

Bekungengezizinto na wonayo u‐Solomone ukumkani wo‐Sirayeli? noko pakati kwezizwe ezininzi akwabiko ukumkani njengaye, owatandwa ngutixo wake, wada utixo wammisa ukumkani pezu kwo‐Sirayeli bonke: kwa yena lowo abafazi bezinye intlanga bamenza one.
Sesiya kupulapula kuni ke na, ukwenza konke okukukohlakala okukulu, senze ngobumenemene ngakuye utixo wetu ngokuzeka abafazi bezinye intlanga?
Kekaloku omnye konyana baka‐Yoyada, unyana ka‐Eliyashibe umperisite omkulu, ebengumyeni ku‐Sanebalati um‐Horonayime: ngako ndamgxota kum.
Kumbula ngabo, Tixo wam! ngenxa yokuba benco̔lisile ubuperisite, nocebano lwobuperisite, nolwaba‐Levi.
Kwa njalo ndabacokisa kubo bonke abezinye intlanga, ndamisa ukulinda kwabaperisite nokwaba‐Levi, abanye ngabanye emsebenzini wabo,
nokunikelwa kwenkuni ngamaxesha amiselweyo, nokwelibo. Ndikumbule, Tixo wam! kube kokulungileyo.
KWAYE kute emihleni ka‐Hasheveroshe, (nguyena Hasheveroshe owapata ubukumkani kwa se‐Yindiya kwada kwase‐Tiyopiya, amazwana alikulu linamashumi mabini anesixe̔nxe:)
emihleni leyo, nxa ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe abehleli eteroneni yobukumkani bake, ebise‐Shushane komkulu,
ngowesitatu umnyaka wokupata kwake, wenzela zonke inkosi zake nezicaka zake isidlo: abamandla base‐Peresiya ne‐Medi, inkosi ezinkulu, nenkosi zamazwana, bebepambi kwake,
akubonakalisa ubutyebi bobungewalisa bobukumkani bake, nenkazimlo yobungangamsha bobukulu bake, imihla emininzi, imihla elikulu linamashumi asibozo.
Kekaloku kwakuzaliseka imihla leyo, wandula ukumkani wabenzela isidlo bonke abantu ababeko e‐Shushane komkulu, kwa nabakulu nabancinane, imihla yasixe̔nxe, ebaleni lomyezo woxande lwokumkani:

amalengalenga alo ebengaweqiya emhlope, n eluhlaza, nezuluṙa, ebotshelelwe ngentambo zeqiya eshiceneyo nesibomvu kuyo imisesane yesilivere nakuzo intsika zamatye amhlope: izihlalo bezizezegolide nezesilivere, pezu kwesandlalwa samatye abomvu, namhlope, nalubelu, namnyama.
Kwaye kusezwa ngempahla zegolide, zingafani impahla enye nenye; kwabako neveyine eninzi yobukumkani, ngokwesisa sokumkani.
Nokusela bekungawo umteto; akwanyanzelwa mntu: ngokuba bekunjalo ukumkani ebemisele bonke abakulu bendlu yake, ukuba makwenziwe ngentando yabanye ngabanye.
Kanjako u‐Vashiti ukumkanikazi wenzela abafazi isidlo, endlwini yobukumkani abenayo ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe.

Ngowesixe̔nxe umhla, nxa intliziyo yokumkani ibicwayitile ngeveyine, waxelela u‐Mehumane, u‐Bizeta, u‐Harebona, u‐Bigeta, no‐Abageta, u‐Zetari, no‐Karekase, ababusi bosixe̔nxe abakonzayo ebusweni bokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe,
ukuba bamzise u‐Vashiti ukumkanikazi pambi kwokumkani, enesitsaba sobukumkani, aze abonise abantu nenkosi ubunzwakazi bake: ngokuba ebemhle ukubonakala kwake.
Kodwa ukumkanikazi u‐Vashiti wala ukuza ngelizwi lokumkani o walitumayo ngababusi abo: waza ukumkani waqumba kakulu, nomsindo wake wausitsha pakati kwake.
Wandula ukumkani wati kwizilumko, ezibe ziwazi amaxesha: (ngokuba belinjalo isiko lokumkani ebusweni babo bonke ababesazi umteto nokugweba:

nabakufupi kuye, ngu‐Kareshena, u‐Shetari, u‐Ademata, u‐Tareshishe, u‐Meresi, u‐Maresena, n o‐Memukane, inkosi zosixe̔nxe zase‐Peresiya ne‐Medi ezibe zibona ubuso bokumkani, ezahlala zizezokuqala ebukumkanini:)
Kuya kwenziwa nto nina kuye ukumkanikazi u‐Vashiti ngawo umteto, ngenxa yokuba engenzanga ingxelo yokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe ngababusi?
Waza u‐Memukane wati ebusweni bokumkani nenkosi: u‐Vashiti ukumkanikazi akonelanga ukumkani yedwa, koko oneleyo zonke inkosi, nabo bonke abantu abakoyo kuwo onke amazwana okumkani u‐Hasheveroshe.

Ngokuba le ndawo yokumkanikazi iya kupumela kubo bonke abafazi, bade badele amadoda abo emehlweni abo, kwakutiwa: Ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe waxela ukuba makuziswe pambi kwake u‐Vashiti ukumkanikazi, kanti akeza.
Aya kutsho kwa namhla nje amakosikazi ase‐Peresiya ne‐Medi, avileyo indawo yokumkanikazi, kuzo zonke inkosi zokumkani; kwandul’ ukubako ubuninzi bokudela nomsindo.

Ukuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, makupume ilizwi lobukumkani kwa sebusweni bake, maliba̔lwe pakati kwemiteto yama‐Peresiya nama‐Medi, lize lingatshitshi, lokokuba u‐Vashiti angez’ angene ebusweni bokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, nobukumkanikazi bake makabunike ukumkani kummelwanekazi wake omdlulayo ngokulunga.
Kwoti kwakuvakala umteto wokumkani aya kuwenza kubo bonke ubukumkani bake, (ngokuba bukulu bona,) bonke abafazi bowanika imbeko amadoda abo, kwa namakulu namancinane.
Laye ilizwi elo lilungile emehlweni okumkani nenkosi; waza ukumkani wenza ngalo ilizwi lika‐Memukane:

ngokuba wazituma incwadi kuwo onke amazwana okumkani, kwizwana ngezwana ngokuba̔la kwalo, nakwabantu ngabantu ngenteto yabo, zokuba onke amadoda abe nobukosi ezindlwini zawo, atete ngenteto yabantu bakowawo.
EMVENI kwezizinto, kwakudamba umsindo wokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, wakumbula u‐Vashiti, noko abekwenzile, noko bekugwetyiwe ngaye.
Zaza izicaka zokumkani ezamkonzayo zati kuye: Makufunelwe ukumkani intombi zipela, ezintle ukubonakala kwazo:

makamise ukumkani amagosa kuwo onke amazwana obukumkani bake, ukuba ahlanganisele e‐Shushane komkulu zonke intombi zipela ezintle ukubonakala kwazo, endlwini yamankazana, ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Hegai umbusi wokumkani, umgcini wamankazana; kanjalo makunikwe izinto zokuhlanjululwa kwazo:
iti intombi elungileyo emehlweni okumkani ibe ngukumkanikazi esikundleni sika‐Vashiti. Yabilungile londawo emehlweni okumkani: wenje njalo ke.
Kwaye kuko e‐Shushane komkulu indoda engum‐Juda, egama lingu‐Modekai, unyana ka‐Yahire, unyana kaShimehi, unyana ka‐Kishe, um‐Benjamine;
ebifudusiwe e‐Yerusaleme kunye nabatinjwa abebefudusiwe no‐Yekoniya ukumkani wo‐Juda, lowo u‐Nebukanetsare ukumkani wase‐Babilone wamfudusayo.

Yati ke yona yamondla u‐Hadasa, (okwa nguye u‐Esetere, intombi yoyisekazi wayo,) ngokuba ebengenayise nonina: intombi leyo ibintle nangesimilo nangokubonakala, owati u‐Modekai, xeshekweni bebefile uyise nonina, wayitabata ibe yintombi yake.

Kwaza kwati, nxa bekuvakele ilizwi lokumkani nomteto wake, nanxa intombi ezininzi bezihlanganiselwe e‐Shushane komkulu, ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Hegai, kwasiwa no‐Esetere endlwini yokumkani, ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Hegai umgcini wamankazana.

Yaye intombi leyo ibilungile emehlweni ake, yazuza ububele pambi kwake; ngako wanxama ukuyinika izinto zokuhlanjululwa kwayo, nezabelwa zayo, nentombi zisixe̔nxe ezazifunwa ukuba zinikwe kuyo zivela endlwini yokumkani: waza wabeka yona nentombi zayo kwelungileyo indawo yendlu yamankazana.
Ebengaxelanga u‐Esetere abantu bake nokwalamana kwake: ngokuba u‐Modekai ebemyalele ukuba angaxeli.
Kekaloku u‐Modekai wahamba imihla yonke pambi kwebala lendlu yamankazana, ukuze akwazi ukupila kuka‐Esetere, nento aya kwenzelwa yona.

Kwati kwakufika ixesha lentombi ngentombi lokuba ingene kukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, emveni kwokuba ibe ifezile inyanga ezilishumi linambini, njengesiko lamankazana; (ngokuba bekunjalo ukuzalisekiswa kwemihla yokuhlanjululwa kwazo, esinye isitandatu senyanga kwenziwa ngamafuta emore, nesinye isitandatu senyanga ngezimnandi, nange zinye izinto zokuhlanjululwa kwamankazana:)
yandula oko intombi leyo yangena kukumkani: konke ebikucela yanikwa kuyo, kupume nayo endlwini yamankazana kuye endlwini yokumkani.

Ngokuhlwa yangena, nangokusa yabuyela kweyesibini indlu yamankazana, ngapantsi kwesandla sika‐Shahashegaze umbusi wokumkani, umgcini wamashweshwe: akangena kanjako kukumkani, kupela nxa ukumkani wayikolelayo, na nxa ibibizwa ngegama.

Kekaloku kwakufika ixesha lika‐Esetere, intombi ka‐Abihayili, uyisekazi ka‐Modekai, obemtabatile abe yintombi yake, lokuba angene kukumkani, akafuna nto, kupela oko u‐Hegai umbusi wokumkani, umgcini wamankazana, wamxelelayo. Waye u‐Esetere wafumana ufefe emehlweni abo bonke abambonayo.
Kwa njalo u‐Esetere wasiwa kukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, endlwini yake yobukumkani, ngenyanga yeshumi, eyinyanga yo‐Tebete, ngowesixe̔nxe umnyaka wobukumkani bake.

Waza ukumkani wamtanda u‐Esetere pezu kwawo onke amankazana; wayefumana ufefe nobubele ebusweni bake ngapezu kwazo zonke intombi; wada wabeka isitsaba sobukumkani entlokweni yake, wamenza ukumkanikazi esikundleni sika‐Vashiti.
Wandula ukumkani wenzela zonke inkosi zake nezicaka zake isidlo esikulu, isidlo sika‐Esetere; kanjalo wenzela amazwana ukupumla, wapa amabaso, ngokwesisa sokumkani.
Kwati kwakuhlanganiswa intombi ngokwesibini, wandula wahlala u‐Modekai esangweni lokumkani.
U‐Esetere ebengaxelanga ukwalamana kwake nabantu bake, njengokuba ebemyalele u‐Modekai: ngokuba u‐Esetere ebesenza ingxelo ka‐Modekai, njengokuya abesondliwa nguye.
NGALEYOMIHLA, nxa u‐Modekai ebehlala esangweni lokumkani, baqumba u‐Bigitana no‐Tereshe, ababusi ababini bokumkani, kubo abagcini bomnyango, bafuna ukwolula isandla ngakuye ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe.
Yada yazeka lonto ku‐Modekai, owayishumayela ku‐Esetere ukumkanikazi; wati u‐Esetere wamxelela ukumkani egameni lika‐Modekai.
Kwati kwakubuzwa indawo leyo, yafunyanwa njalo ke; ngako baxo̔nywa bobabini emtini: yaza yaba̔lwa encwadini yemicimbi yemihla ngemihla ebusweni bokumkani.
EMVENI kwezizinto ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe wamenza mkulu u‐Hamani, unyana ka‐Medata, um‐Hagagi, wampakamisa, wamisa isihlalo sake ngapezu kw es azo zonke inkosi ezibe zinaye.
Kekaloku zonke izicaka zokumkani, ezibe zisesangweni lokumkani, zaguqa zaziqubuda pambi kwoHamani: ngokuba ukumkani ebeyalele njalo ngaye. Kodwa u‐Modekai akaguqa, akaziqubuda kanjako.
Zaza izicaka zokumkani, ezibe zisesangweni lokumkani, zati ku‐Modekai: Yinina ukuba uwugqite umyalelo wokumkani?
Kwaye kute, nxa zateta naye imihla ngemihla, kanti akapulapula kuzo, zandula zamxelela u‐Hamani, ukuze zibone ukuba amazwi ka‐Modekai aya kuma kusinina: ngokuba ebezixelele ukuba ungum‐Juda.
Wati akubona u‐Hamani ukuba u‐Modekai akaguqa, nokuba akaziqubuda pambi kwake, wandula u‐Hamani wazala ngumsindo.

Kodwa kwadeleka emehlweni ake ukwolula isandla ngakuye u‐Modekai yedwa: ngokuba bebexele kuye abantu baka‐Modekai: ngako wafuna u‐Hamani ukutshabalalisa onke ama‐Juda abekubo bonke ubukumkani buka‐Hasheveroshe, abantu baka‐Modekai.

Ngenyanga yokuqala, ekwa yinyanga yo‐Nisane, ngoweshumi linesibini umnyaka wokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, kwawiswa i‐Puri, oko kukuti, iqashiso, ebusweni buka‐Hamani, kwimini ngemini, nakwinyanga ngenyanga, kwada kwakuyo eyeshumi linesibini inyanga, ekwa yinyanga yo‐Adari.

Waza u‐Hamani wati kuye ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe: Kuko abantu abatile betiwe sa bahlukene pakati kwezizwe, kuwo onke amazwana obukumkani bako; imiteto yabo yahlukile kw ey abantu bonke; nemiteto yokumkani abayenzi: ngako akufanelekile kukumkani ukuba abavume.

Ukuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, makuba̔lwe ukuba babujiswe: ndandiya kuzilinganisela ezandleni zabo bawenza umsebenzi, italente zesilivere ezingamawaka alishumi, ukuba ziziswe ezindyetyeni zokumkani.
Waza ukumkani watula umsesane wake esandleni sake, wawunika ku‐Hamani, unyana ka‐Medata, um‐Hagagi, utshaba lwama‐Juda.
Wayesiti ukumkani ku‐Hamani: Upiwe isilivere leyo, nabantu abo, uze wenze ngabo njengokulungileyo emehlweni ako.

Kwandula kwabizwa ababa̔li bokumkani, ngoweshumi linesitatu umhla wenyanga yokuqala, kwaba̔lwa ke, njengako konke abeyalela ngako u‐Hamani, kuzo inkosi ezinkulu zokumkani, nakuzo inkosi ezibe zipezu kwezwana ngezwana, nakubo abapati babantu ngabantu, izwana ngezwana njengokuba̔la kwalo, nabantu ngabantu njengenteto yabo: kwaye kuba̔lwa egameni lokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, kwancanyatiselwa ngomsesane wokumkani kanjalo.

Kwaza kwatunywa incwadi ngezigidimi kuwo onke amazwana okumkani, zokuba kutshatyalaliswe, kubulawe, kubujiswe bonke abangama‐Juda, kwa nabatsha nabadala, intsapo nabafazi, emhleni mnye, koweshumi linesitatu umhla wenyanga yeshumi linesibini, eyinyanga yo‐Adari, nokuba kupangwe amaxoba abo.
Isitsho sesiba̔lo besisesokuba kunikwe umteto kuwo onke amazwana ngamanye, utyileka kubo bonke abantu, ukuba babe belungile ngomhla lowo,
izigidimi zapuma ke, zinxanyisiwe lilizwi lokumkani; wati umteto lowo wanikwa nase‐Shushane komkulu. Baza ukumkani no‐Hamani bahlala pantsi ukusela; kodwa isixeko se‐Shushane besixakekile.
WATI u‐Modekai akukwazi konke okube kwenziwe, wandula u‐Modekai waṙazula izivato zake, wambata intlakantlaka notutu, wapuma waya pakati kwesixeko, wakala ngesikalo esikulu esiṙaṙa;
weza kude kwapambi kwesango lokumkani: ngokuba bekungengenwe mntu esangweni lokumkani eyambete intlakantlaka.

Nakuwo onke amazwana ngamanye, apo kwafika kona ilizwi lokumkani nomteto wake, bekuko usizi olukulu pakati kwama‐Juda, nokuzila ukutya, nokulila, nesijwili; bati abaninzi balala pezu kwentlakantlaka notutu.

Zandula zeza izicakazana zika‐Esetere nababusi bake, bamxelela. Waza ukumkanikazi waba buhlungu kakulu; watuma izivato ukuba kuvatiswe u‐Modekai, nokuba kususwe kuye intlakantlaka yake: kodwa akazamkela.
Wandula u‐Esetere wambiza u‐Hataki, owababusi bokumkam, lowo abemmisele ukukonza kuye, wamyalezela ku‐Modekai, kuze kwaziwe lento ukuba iyinto nina, nokuba inganina.
Wapuma u‐Hataki waya ku‐Modekai, enkundleni yesixeko ebipambi kwesango lokumkani.
Waza u‐Modekai wamxelela konke obekumhlile, nesishumayelo sesilivere abete u‐Hamani uya kuyilinganisela ezindyetyeni zokumkani ngenxa yama‐Juda, ukuze abujiswe.

Nesitsho sesiba̔lo somteto esibe sinikwe e‐Shushane, sokuba atshatyalaliswe, wasinika kuye, ukuze ambonise u‐Esetere, amshumayeze, amyalele ukuba angene kukumkani ukutaṙuzisa kuye, nokubongozela abantu bake ebusweni bake.
Wasuka weza u‐Hataki wamxelela u‐Esetere amazwi ka‐Modekai.
Wabuya wateta u‐Esetere ku‐Hataki, wamyalezela ku‐Modekai, esiti:

Ziyazi zonke izicaka zokumkani, nabantu bamazwana okumkani, ukuba umntu, nokuba uyindoda nokuba uyinkazana, osukuba engena kukumkani ekusini lapakati, ongabizwanga, ngumteto wake umnye ukuba afiswe, ngapandle kwalowo aya kuti ukumkani olulele kuye intonga yegolide, aze apile: kodwa mna, andibizwanga ukuba ndingene kukumkani kuse kuntsuku ezimashumi matatu.
Bamxelela ke u‐Modekai amazwi ka‐Esetere.
Waza u‐Modekai wati ukupendula ku‐Esetere: Ningabi pakati kwako uya kusinda wena endlwini yokumkani, ngapezu kwawo onke ama‐Juda.

Ngokuba nxa ugqibela ukuti cwaka ngelixesha, kwopakamela ama‐Juda umciza nosindiso luvela kwiyimbi indawo; kodwa wena nendlu kayihlo niya kububa: ngubanina ke owaziyo, ukuba akufikelanga na ebukumkanini ngenxa yexesha elinjengeli?
Waza u‐Esetere wati ukupendula ku‐Modekai:

Hamba, hlanganisa onke ama‐Juda akoyo e‐Shushane, nenze inzilo ngenxa yam, nize ningadli ningaseli nokusela imihla ibe mitatu, ebusuku nasemini: kanjalo nam, nezicakazana zam, siya kuyenza inzilo enjalo; ndandule ukungena ngokunjalo kukumkani, okungalungelene nomteto: ukuba ke ndiyabuba, ndiyabuba.
Waza wemka u‐Modekai, wenza ngako konke u‐Esetere wabemyalela ngako.

Kwaye kute ngowesitatu umhla, wandula wambata u‐Esetere izivato zobukumkani, wema kwelapakati ikusi lendlu yokumkani, malungana nendlu yokumkani: waye ukumkani ehleli esihlalweni sake sobukumkani, ngasendlwini yobukumkani, malungana nocango lwendlu.

Kwaza kwati, nxa ukumkani wambona u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi emi ekusini, waselezuza ufefe emehlweni ake: wasuka ukumkani wayolulela ku‐Esetere intonga yegolide ebisesandleni sake; waza wasondela u‐Esetere wapata incam yentonga.
Wayesiti ukumkani kuye: Ufuna nto nina, kumkanikazi Esetere? siyinto nina isikungo sako? sonikwa kuwe nakude kube sisiqingata sobukumkani.
Wayesiti u‐Esetere: Ukuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, makeze ukumkani no‐Hamani namhla esidlweni endimlungisele sona.
Wandula wati ukumkani: Nxamisani u‐Hamani, ukuba enze ngalo ilizwi lika‐Esetere. Kwa njalo ukumkani no‐Hamani beza esidlweni abesilungisile u‐Esetere.
Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Esetere, esidlweni seveyine: Siyinto nina isicelo sako? sesiya kunikwa kuwe; siyinto nina nesikungo sako? siya kufezwa nakude kube sisiqingata sobukumkani.
Wapendula u‐Esetere, wati: Isicelo sam nesikungo sam sesokuti:

Ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni okumkani, nokuba kunga kulungile kukumkani ukunika isicelo sam, nokufeza isikungo sam, makeze ukumkani no‐Hamani esidlweni endiya kubalungisela sona, ndandiya kuti ngomso ndenze ngalo ilizwi lokumkani.

WAZA u‐Hamani wapuma ngalomini evuya, enentliziyo ecwayitileyo: kodwa xeshekweni u‐Hamani wambona u‐Modekai esangweni lokumkani, ukuba akasuki, nokuba akashukumi ngenxa yake, waselezala ngumsindo u‐Hamani ngakuye u‐Modekai.
Wazinyanzela u‐Hamani noko, weza endlwini yake: waza watuma wabiza izihlobo zake, no‐Zereshe umfazi wake.
Wandula u‐Hamani wababalisela ubungcwalisa bobutyebi bake, nobuninzi babantwana bake, nako konke ukumkani abemenze mkulu ngako, nokokuba ebempakamisile ngapezu kwenkosi nezicaka zokumkani.
Walekela wati u‐Hamani: Ewe, u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi akangenisa mntu kunye nokumkani esidlweni abesilungisile, kupela mna; kanjalo nangomso ndimenyelwe kuye kunye nokumkani.
Kodwa konke oku akundincedi luto, nxa ndisabona u‐Modekai um‐Juda ehleli esangweni lokumkani.

Waza wati kuye u‐Zereshe umfazi wake, nazo zonke izihlobo zake: Makulungiswe umti ube zikubite ezimashumi mahlanu ubude bawo, uti kwakusa utete kukumkani ukuba u‐Modekai makaxo̔nywe pezu kwawo; wandule ungene nokumkani esidlweni unokuvuya. Yabilungile lento ku‐Hamani, wawulungisa umti.
Ngobobusuku ukumkani wemkelwa bubutongo; waza waxela ukuba kuziswe incwadi yezikumbuzelo, e yemicimbi yemihla ngemihla, eyabileseshwa ebusweni bokumkani.
Kwafunyanwa kuba̔liwe okokuba u‐Modekai ebeshumayele ngo‐Bigitana no‐Tereshe, ababusi ababini bokumkani, kubo abagcini bomnyango, abafuna ukwolula isandla ngakuye ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Yiyipina imbeko nobukulu obenziweyo ku‐Modekai ngenxa yoku? Zaza izicaka zokumkani, ezakonza kuye, zati: Akwenziwanga nto kuye.
Wayesiti ukumkani: Ngubanina osebaleni? (Kekaloku u‐Hamani ebefikile ebaleni langapandle lendlu yokumkani, ukuza kuteta naye ukuba amxo̔me u‐Modekai pezu kwomti abemlungisele wona.)
Zaza izicaka zokumkani zati kuye: Nankuya u‐Hamani emi ebaleni. Wayesiti ukumkani: Makangene.

Waza u‐Hamani wangena. Wayesiti ukumkani kuye: Kuya kwenziwa nto nina kulondoda ukumkani ayitandayo imbeko yayo? Wandula u‐Hamani wati entliziyweni yake: Ngubanina atanda ukumkani ukumenzela imbeko ngapandle kwam?
Ngako u‐Hamani wati kukumkani: Indoda, ayitandayo ukumkani imbeko yayo,
makuyiziselwe isivato sobukumkani avata ngaso ukumkani, nehashe akwela ukumkani pezu kwalo; nesitsaba sobukumkani masibekwe entloko yayo:

kuze kunikwe esosivato nelohashe esandleni senye kuzo inkosi ezinkulu zokumkani, kuvatiswe indoda leyo ukumkani ayitandayo imbeko yayo, kwenzwe ukuba ikwele pezu kwehashe ihambe esitarateni sesixeko, kudandulukwe pambi kwayo ngokuti: Kuya kwenjwa njalo kwindoda leyo ukumkani ayitandayo imbeko yayo.

Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Hamani: Nxama, utabate isivato eso nehashe elo, njengokuba utshilo, uze wenje njalo ku‐Modekai um‐Juda, ohleliyo esangweni lokumkani: mayingatshitshi nanye into kuko konke ukutetileyo.

Wandula u‐Hamani watabata esosivato nelohashe, wamvatisa u‐Modekai, wamkwelisa ahambe esitarateni sesixeko, wadanduluka pambi kwake ngokuti: Kuya kwenjwa njalo kwindoda leyo ukumkani ayitandayo imbeko yayo.
Wabuya u‐Modekai waya esangweni lokumkani. Kodwa u‐Hamani wanxamela ukuya endlwini yake, elusizi, egqubutele intloko.

Waza u‐Hamani wambalisela u‐Zereshe umfazi wake, nazo zonke izihlobo zake, konke obekumhlile. Ayesiti kuye amalumko ake, no‐Zereshe umfazi wake: Ukuba u‐Modekai ungowenzalo yama‐Juda, osel’ uqalile ukuwa pambi kwake, akusayi kumeyisa, koko uya kuwa ngenyaniso pambi kwake.
NXA basateta naye, kwafika ababusi bokumkani, banxama ukumzisa u‐Hamani esidlweni abesilungisile u‐Esetere.
Wandula wangena ukumkani no‐Hamani ukusela no‐Esetere ukumkanikazi.

Wayesiti ukumkani ku‐Esetere, nangomhla wesibini, esidlweni seveyine: Siyinto nina isicelo sako, kumkanikazi Esetere? sesiya kunikwa kuwe; siyinto nina nesikungo sako? siya kufezwa nakude kube sisiqingata sobukumkani.
Wandula wapendula u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi, wati: Ukuba ndifumene ufefe emehlweni ako, kumkani! nokuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, mandinikwe ubomi bam ngesicelo sam, nabantu bam ngesikungo sam:

ngokuba sitengelwe, mna nabantu bam, ukutshatyalaliswa, ukubulawa, nokubujiswa. Ukuba kodwa sibe sitengelwe ukuba ngamakonza namakonzakazi, bendiya kuti cwaka, nangona utshaba lungenako ukwenzelelela ukwonakala kwokumkani.
Waza wapendula ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, wati ku‐Esetere ukumkanikazi: Ngubanina lo, upina lo, ontliziyo imkalipisile ukwenje njalo?
Wayesiti u‐Esetere: Utshaba nempi ngu‐Hamani lo okohlakeleyo. Wandula woyika u‐Hamani ebusweni bokumkani nokumkanikazi.

Wesuka ukumkani ngomsindo wake esidlweni seveyine, waya emyezweni woxande: wema no‐Hamani, ukuba abongozele ubomi bake ku‐Esetere ukumkanikazi; ngokuba ebebona ukuba ububi bugqityiwe ngakuye ngukumkani.

Wati akubuya ukumkani emyezweni woxande ukuza endlwini yesidlo seveyine, kekaloku u‐Hamani ebewile pezu kwomandlalo u‐Esetere abepezu kwawo. Wandula wati ukumkani: Kanene uya kumdlwengula ukumkanikazi na enam endlwini? Lisapuma ilizwi emlonyeni wokumkani, bagubungela ubuso buka‐Hamani.

Wayesiti u‐Harebona, omnye kubo ababusi, ebusweni bokumkani: Kanjako bona ke, lomti u‐Hamani wawenzela u‐Modekai, obetetele ukumkani okulungileyo, umi endlwini ka‐Hamani, uzikubite ezimashumi mahlanu ubude bawo. Wati ke ukumkani: Mxo̔meni pezu kwawo.
Baza bamxo̔ma u‐Hamani emtini abewulungisele u‐Modekai. Kwand’ ukudamba umsindo wokumkani.
Ngalomini ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe wamnika u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi indlu ka‐Hamani, utshaha lwama‐Juda: no‐Modekai yena weza ebusweni bokumkani; ngokuba u‐Esetere ebexele into uyiyo kuye.
Waza ukumkani watula umsesane wake abewususile ku‐Hamani, wawunika ku‐Modekai. Kanjalo u‐Esetere wambeka u‐Modekai pezu kwendlu ka‐Hamani.
WALEKELA u‐Esetere wateta ebusweni bokumkani, wawa ngasezinyaweni zake, walila inyembezi, wataṙuzisa kuye ukuba akwelelise ububi buka‐Hamani um‐Hagagi, neqinga lake waliqingayo ngakuwo ama‐Juda.
Wandula ukumkani wayolulela ku‐Esetere intonga yegolide. Waselesuka u‐Esetere, wema pambi kwokumkani,

wati: Ukuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, nokuba ndifumene ufefe ebusweni bake, nokuba ifanelekile lento pambi kwokumkani, nokuba ndikolekile mna emehlweni ake, makuba̔lwe ukuba kubuyiswe incwadi n eqinga lika‐Hamani unyana ka‐Medata, um‐Hagagi, owaba̔layo ukuba kubujiswe ama‐Juda akuwo onke amazwana okumkani.
Ngokuba ndingati nina ukuba namandla okuba ndibone ububi obuya kuhlela abantu bam? ndingati nina kanjalo ukuba namandla okuba ndibone imbujiswa yezalamane zam?

Waza wati ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe kuye u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi, nakuye u‐Modekai um‐Juda: Bona ke, indlu ka‐Hamani ndiyinikile ku‐Esetere, naye yena bamxo̔mile emtini, ngenxa yokuba wolula isandla sake ngakuwo ama‐Juda.

Ba̔lelani ama‐Juda nani, njengoko kulungileyo emehlweni enu, egameni lokumkani, nincamatisele ngomsesane wokumkani: ngokuba isiba̔lo, esiba̔liweyo egameni lokumkani, nesincanyatiselweyo ngomsesane wokumkani, kungeko mntu ongasibuyisayo.

Kwandula kwabizwa ababa̔li bokumkani ngexesha elo, ngenyanga yesitatu, ekwa yinyanga yo‐Sivane, ngowamashumi mabini anesitatu umhla wayo; kwaza kwaba̔lwa ngako konke wakuyalelayo u‐Modekai, kuma‐Juda, nakuzo inkosi ezinkulu, nenkosi nabapati bamazwana, a tabata e‐Yindiya kude kwase‐Tiyopiya, amazwana alikulu linamashumi mabini anesixe̔nxe, izwana ngezwana njengokuba̔la kwalo, nabantu ngabantu njengenteto yabo; nakuwo ama‐Juda, njengokuba̔la kwawo, nanjengenteto yawo.

Kwaye kuba̔lwa ke egameni lokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, kwancanyatiselwa ngomsesane wokumkani kanjalo; kwaza kwatunywa incwadi ngesandla sezigidimi pezu kwamahashe, zikwele emahasheni anamendu, nas emaqwaṙaṙeni, amatole amahashekazi:

zokuba ukumkani wavumela ama‐Juda, akuzo zonke izixeko ngazinye, ukuzihlanganisa, nokupakamela ubomi bawo, ukutshabalalisa, ukubulala, nokububisa, onke amandla abantu nezwana, abaya kuwapata ngobutshaba, intsapo nabafazi, nokupanga amaxoba abo,
emhleni mnye, kuwo onke amazwana okumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, koweshumi linesitatu umhla wenyanga yeshumi linesibini, ekwa yinyanga yo‐Adari.
Isitsho sesiba̔lo besisesokuba kunikwe umteto kuwo onke amazwana ngamanye, utyileka kubo bonke abantu; nokuba ama‐Juda abe elungile ngomhla lowo, ukuze azipindezelele ezintshabeni zawo.
Kekaloku izigidimi, zikwele emahasheni anamendu nas emaqwaṙaṙeni, zapuma zikaulezisiwe zinxanyisiwe nokunxanyiswa lilizwi lokumkani. Kwanikwa lomteto e‐Shushane komkulu.
Waza u‐Modekai wapuma ebusweni bokumkani, enesivato sobukumkani seqiya ezuluṙa nemhlope, nesitsaba esikulu segolide, nengubo yeqiya eshiceneyo nebomvu: sati isixeko se‐Shushane sagcoba, savuya.
Ama‐Juda ebenokukanya, novuyo, nomgcobo, nembeko.

Nakuwo onke amazwana ngamanye, nakuzo zonke izixeko ngazinye, apo lisukuba lafikela kona ilizwi lokumkani nomteto wake, ama‐Juda ebenovuyo nomgcobo, ebenesidlo nomhla omnandi. Baza abaninzi ebantwini belizwe baba ngama‐Juda; ngokuba ukwoyikwa kwama‐Juda bekuwile pezu kwabo.

KEKALOKU ngenyanga yeshumi linesibini, ekwa yinyanga yo‐Adari, ngoweshumi elinesitatu umhla wayo, okuya bekuza kufika ukwenziwa kwelizwi lokumkani nomteto wake, ngomhla ezati intshaba zama‐Juda zatembela ukuba zibe namandla pezu kwawo, (kodwa kwaguqulwa oko, ngokuba ama‐Juda wona ebenamandla pezu kwabatiyi bawo,)

ahlanganisana ama‐Juda ezixekweni zawo, kuwo onke amazwana okumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, ukuze abeke isandla pezu kwabo bakufunayo ukwenzakala kwawo: akwabiko mntu obenako ukuma ebusweni bawo; ngokuba ukwoyikwa kwawo bekuwile pezu kwabobantu bonke.
Kanjalo abapati bamazwana, nenkosi ezinkulu, nenkosi, nabo bawenza umsebenzi wokumkani, bawanceda ama‐Juda; ngokuba ukwoyikwa kuka‐Modekai bekuwile pezu kwabo:
ngokuba ebemkulu u‐Modekai endlwini yokumkani, nodumo lwake lwapumela kuwo onke amazwana: ngokuba lendoda, u‐Modekai, yamana yaba nkulu.
Aza ama‐Juda abeta zonke intshaba zawo ngokubeta kweṙele, nangesibulalo, nangembubiso, enza ngokutanda kwawo kubo abatiyi bawo,
nase‐Shushane komkulu ama‐Juda abulala abubisa amadoda amakulu mahlanu.
No‐Pareshandata, no‐Dalifone, no‐Asepata,
no‐Porata, no‐Adaliya, no‐Aridata,
no‐Paremasheta, no‐Arisai, no‐Aridai, no‐Vayezata,
onyana boshumi baka‐Hamani unyana ka‐Medata, utshaba lwama‐Juda, ababulala; kodwa impango akabeka izandla zawo pezu kwayo.
Ngalomini kwaziswa pambi kwokumkani inani lababuleweyo e‐Shushane komkulu.

Waza ukumkani wati ku‐Esetere ukumkanikazi: e‐Shushane komkulu ama‐Juda abulele abubisa amadoda amakulu mahlanu, nonyana boshumi baka‐Hamani; enze nto nina kuwo amanye amazwana okumkani? kekaloku siyinto nina isicelo sako? sesiya kunikwa kuwe: siseyinto nina isikungo sako? siya kwenzwa ke.
Wandula wati u‐Esetere: Ukuba kunga kulungile kukumkani, makuvunyelwe ama‐Juda ase‐Shushane nangomso, ukuba enze ngawo umteto wanamhla, nonyana boshumi baka‐Hamani mabaxo̔nywe emtini.
Waxela ukumkani ukuba makwenjwe njalo: kwaza kwanikwa umteto e‐Shushane, kwaxo̔nywa onyana boshumi baka‐Hamani.
Ahlanganisana ke ama‐Juda ase‐Shushane nangoweshumi linesine umhla wenyanga yo‐Adari, abulala amadoda amakulu matatu e‐Shushane; kodwa impango akabeka izandla zawo pezu kwayo.

Kanjalo amanye ama‐Juda abesemazwaneni okumkani ahlanganisana, apakamela ubomi bawo, apumla ezintshabeni zawo, abulala kubatiyi bawo amawaka angamashumi asixe̔nxe enesihlanu, (kodwa impango akabeka izandla zawo pezu kwayo,)
ngoweshumi linesitatu umhla wenyanga yo‐Adari; nangoweshumi elinesine umhla wayo apumla ke, awenza wona umhla wesidlo novuyo.
Kodwa ama‐Juda abese‐Shushane ahlanganisana ngoweshumi linesitatu umhla wayo, nangoweshumi linesine umhla wayo; apumla ke ngoweshumi linesihlanu umhla wayo, awenza wona umhla wesidlo novuyo.
Ngako oko ama‐Juda asemizini, lawo ahlala ezixekweni zapandle, awenza oweshumi linesine umhla wenyanga yo‐Adari owovuyo nesidlo, nomhla omnandi, nowokutumelana izabelwa.
WAZA u‐Modekai waba̔la ezizinto, wazituma incwadi kuwo onke ama‐Juda abekuwo onke amazwana okumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, lawo akufupi nalawo akude,
ukuze kuqiniswe pezu kwawo, ukuba abambe oweshumi linesine umhla wenyanga yo‐Adari, noweshumi linesihlanu umhla wayo, kuyo yonke iminyaka ngaminye,

njengokuba iyimihla apumla ngayo ama‐Juda ezintshabeni zawo, nenyanga ebekuwaguqulelwa usizi lwaba luvuyo, nolilo lwaba ngumhla omnandi: ukuba ayenze yona imihla yesidlo novuyo, neyokutuma izabelwa omnye komnye, namabaso kumahlwempu.
Aza ama‐Juda avuma ukwenza njengokuqala kwawo, nanjengokuba u‐Modekai ebeba̔lile kuwo;

ngenxa yokuba u‐Hamani unyana ka‐Medata, um‐Hagagi, utshaba lwawo onke ama‐Juda, ebeqingile ngakuwo ama‐Juda ukuwabubisa, nokuba ebewisile i‐Puri, oko kukuti, iqashiso, ukuwatshabalalisa, nokuwabubisa;

kodwa akungena u‐Esetere ebusweni bokumkani, waxela ngencwadi, ukuba iqinga lake elikohlakeleyo, owaliqingayo ngakuwo ama‐Juda, libuyele pezu kweyake intloko, nokuba kuxo̔nywe yena nonyana bake emtini.
Kukona ke kwabizwa imihla le ngokuti yi‐Purime, ngegama le‐Puri. Ngako oko, ngenxa yawo onke amazwi alencwadi, na ngenxa yoko abekubonile ngalondawo, noko obekuwahlele,

aqinisa atabata ama‐Juda pezu kwawo, napezu kwenzalo yawo, napezu kwabo bonke abaya kuzibandakanyela kubo, kuze kungatshitshi, ukuba oyibamba lemihla yomibini, ngokuba̔lwa kwayo, nangomzuzu wayo, kuyo yonke iminyaka ngaminye;

nokuba lemihla ikunjulwe igcinwe kuzo zonke izizukulwana ngazinye, isizalwane ngesizalwane, izwana ngezwana, isixeko ngesixeko; nokuba lemihla ye‐Purime ingatshitshi pakati kwama‐Juda, nenkunjulwa yayo ingapeli kwinzalo yawo.
Wandula waba̔la u‐Esetere ukumkanikazi, intombi ka‐Abihayili, no‐Modekai um‐Juda, ngegunya lonke, ukuqinisa lencwadi yesibini ye‐Purime.
Wazituma ke incwadi kuwo onke ama‐Juda, kuwo amazwana alikulu linamashumi mabini anesixe̔nxe obukumkani buka‐Hasheveroshe, amazwi oxolo nenyaniso:

ukuze kuqiniswe lemihla ye‐Purime ngemizuzu yayo, njengokuba ebeqinisile pezu kwawo u‐Modekai um‐Juda, no‐Esetere ukumkanikazi, nanjengokuba ebeqinisile pezu kwawo wona napezu kwenzalo yawo, indawo zokuzila ukutya nezokukala kwawo.
Ezindawo ze‐Purime ingxelo ka‐Esetere yaziqinisa; yaba̔lwa nasencwadini.
KEKALOKU ukumkani u‐Hasheveroshe wabeka pezu kwelizwe, na pezu kweziqiti zolwandle, ukunikela.

Nazo zonke izenzo zegunya lake nezamandla ake, nesishumayelo sobukulu buka‐Modekai, obo ukumkani wamenza mkulu ngabo, aziba̔lwanga na zona encwadini yemicimbi yemihla ngemihla yokumkani be‐Medi ne‐Peresiya?
Ngokuba u‐Modekai um‐Juda ebengowasemva kwokumkani u‐Hasheveroshe, emkulu pakati kwama‐Juda, ebukekile kwisininzi sabazalwana bake, efuna ubutamsanqa babantu bake, eteta uxolo kuyo yonke inzalo yake.
KWAYE kuko indoda elizweni le‐Hutse, igama layo ngu‐Jobi. Indoda leyo ibiyefezekileyo, nelungisayo, neyoyikayo utixo, nepambukayo enkohlakalweni.
Kwaye kuzalelwe yona onyana abasixe̔nxe nentombi ezintatu:

nemfuyo yayo ibizigusha ezingamawaka asixe̔nxe, nenkamela ezingamawaka matatu, nezibini zenkabi ezingamakulu mahlanu, namaqwaṙashekazi angamakulu mahlanu, nento eninzi kakulu yezicaka: kanjalo indoda leyo ibinkulu kuwo onke amadoda asempumalanga.
Kekaloku onyana bayo bahlala besenza izidlo ezindlwini zabanye ngabanye ngemihla yabo; baza batuma bamema odade babo bobatatu, ukuba beze ukutya nokusela nabo.

Kwaye kute kwakuba kuzungulezisiwe imihla yezidlo ezo, wandula watuma u‐Jobi wabangcwalisa, wavuka kusasa, wanikela amadini okutshiswa ngenani labo bonke; ngokuba ebesiti u‐Jobi: Kungati onyana bam bonile, bamgxeka utixo ezintliziyweni zabo. Wenje njalo u‐Jobi onke amaxesha lawo.
Kwaye kute ngomhla otile, nxa bezayo onyana bakatixo ukuzimisa pambi kwoyehova, weza no‐Satane pakati kwabo.
Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Satane: Uvela pina? Wapendula u‐Satane kuyehova, wati: Ekusukasukeni emhlabeni, nasekuhambahambeni kuwo.
Waza uyehova wati ku‐Satane: Ugqalile na isicaka sam u‐Jobi, ukuba akuko onjengaye emhlabeni, indoda efezekileyo, elungisayo, eyoyikayo utixo, epambukayo enkohlakalweni?
Wapendula u‐Satane kuyehova, wati: Ufumana emoyika utixo na u‐Jobi?
Akubiyanga na ngokumngqonga, nangokungqonga indlu yake, nangokungqonga konke anako, ngamacala onke? Umsebenzi wezandla zake uwutamsanqele, nemfuyo yake yandile emhlabeni.
Uz’ uti ke kodwa wolule isandla sako, upate konke anako, waeya kukugxeka ngasebusweni bako.
Waza uyehova wati kuye u‐Satane: Bona ke, konke anako kusesandleni sako; kupela ungoluli isandla sako pezu kwake. Wasuka wapuma u‐Satane ebusweni bukayehova.
Kwaye kute ngomhla otile, nxa onyana bake nentombi zake babe besitya, besela nokusela iveyine, endlwini yomkuluwe wabo, yowamazibulo,
safika isigidimi ku‐Jobi, sati: Inkabi bezipulusha, namaqwaṙashekazi ebesidla ngecala lazo;
aza ama‐Sheba aziwela, azitimba; nezicaka azibulele ngohlangoti lweṙele; ndikupela mna ndedwa kwosindileyo ukuza kukuxelela.
Sisateta esi, safika nesinye, sati: Umlilo katixo uwile ezulwini, watshisa igusha nezicaka, wazigqibela; ndikupela mna ndedwa kwosindileyo ukuza kukuxelela.
Sisateta esi, safika nesinye, sati: Ama‐Kaledine enza amaqela amatatu, agaleleka pezu kwenkamela, azitimba; nezicaka azibulele ngohlangoti lweṙele; ndikupela mna ndedwa kwosindileyo ukuza kukuxelela.
Sisateta esi, safika nesinye, sati: Onyana bako nentombi zako babe besitya, besela nokusela iveyine, endlwini yomkuluwe wabo, yowamazibulo;
kekaloku bona ke, umoya omkulu wavela pesheya kwentlango, wabeta imbombo zone zendlu, eyawa pezu kwabatsha abo, bada babuba; ndikupela mna ndedwa kwosindileyo ukuza kukuxelela.
Wandula wesuka u‐Jobi, waṙazula ingubo yake, wagugula intloko yake, wawa ngasemhlabeni, wabedesha,
wati: Ndizé ndapuma esizalweni sikama̔, ndizé ndobuyela kona kanjalo: nguyehova obenika, nguyehova ohlutileyo: igama likayehova malibongwe!
Kuko konke oku akona u‐Jobi; akamnika utixo ubudenge kanjalo.
Kwabuya kwati ngomhla otile, nxa bezayo onyana bakatixo ukuzimisa pambi kwoyehova, weza no‐Satane pakati kwabo ukuzimisa pambi kwoyehova.
Wayesiti uyehova ku‐Satane: Uvela pina? Wapendula u‐Satane kuyehova, wati: Ekusukasukeni emhlabeni, nasekuhambahambeni kuwo.

Waza uyehova wati ku‐Satane: Ugqalile na isicaka sam u‐Jobi, ukuba akuko onjengaye emhlabeni, indoda efezekileyo, elungisayo, eyoyikayo utixo, epambukayo enkohlakalweni? osabamba ubunene bake, nangona ubundivusa ngakuye, ukuba ndimtshabalalise kungeko tuba.
Wapendula u‐Satane kuyehova, wati: Intlonze ngenxa yentlonze, ewe, konke umntu anako wokunika ngenxa yobomi bake.
Uz’ uti ke kodwa wolule isandla sako, upate amatambo ake nenyama yake, waeya kukugxeka ngasebusweni bako.
Waza uyehova wati kuye u‐Satane: Bona ke, usesandleni sako; kodwa ubomi bake ubugcine.
Wandul’ ukupuma u‐Satane ebusweni bukayehova, wambeta u‐Jobi ngamatumba amabi, kwa kuwo umzantsi wonyawo lwake kwada kwaselukakayini lwake.
Waza watabata icepe, ukuba aziṙwele ngalo; wabehleli pantsi ke pakati kwotutu.
Wandula umfazi wake wati kuye: Usabamba na ubunene bako? gxeka utixo, ufe ke.
Wayesiti kuye: Uyateta njengelinye lamagezakazi lisenje njalo ukuteta. Kanene, okulungileyo siya kukwamkela kutixo na, nokubi singakwamkeli yinina? Kuko konke oku akona u‐Jobi ngomlomo wake.

Kekaloku abahlobo abatatu baka‐Jobi beva bonke obububi abehlelwe bubo, bavela abanye ngabanye ezindaweni zabo, — u‐Elifazi um‐Temani, no‐Biledadi um‐Shuha, no‐Tsofare um‐Nahama; ngokuba bebevumelene ukuza kumku̔za nokumtutuzela.
Bati bakupakamisa amehlo abo bekude, abamazi; baza bapakamisa ilizwi labo, balila; basuka baṙazula abanye ngabanye ingubo zabo, batshiza utuli pezu kwentloko zabo ngasezulwini.
Bahlala pantsi ke ndawonye naye emhlabeni imini zasixe̔nxe nobusuku basixe̔nxe, kungeko namnye owateta ilizwi kuye; ngokuba bebebona ubuhlungu bake ukuba bukulu kakulu.
EMVENI kwoku wavula u‐Jobi umlomo wake, wawuqalekisa umhla wake.
Waza wapendula u‐Jobi, wati:
Maibube imini bendizalelwa kuyo, nobobusuku kwatiwa: Kumitiwe umntwana oyindoda.
Imini leyo, maibe bubumnyama: maangayikataleli utixo kwa pezulu; nobumhlope mabungakanyi pezu kwayo.
Makuyibange ubumnyama nesitunzi sokufa; makupumle pezu kwayo amafu; intsito zemini maziyoyikise.
Ubusuku obo, isitokotoko masibubambe: mabungabandakanywa nemihla yomnyaka; mabungangeni enanini lazo inyanga.
Bona ke, ubusuku obo, mabube budlolo; ilizwi lokuvuya malingezi kubo.
Mababunywebelele abaqalekisi bemini, abo baqele ukuvusa ileviyatane.
Mazibe mnyama inkwenkwezi zoncwalazi lwabo; mabulinde ukukanya, kungabiko ke; mabungakangeli nenkope zomso:
ngenxa yokuba bungavingcanga ingcango zesizalo esandizalayo, nokuba bungafihlanga lusizi emehlweni am.
Kunganina ukuba bendingafanga kwa sezizalweni, umhlaumbi bendingaqaukanga umxe̔lo ndakupuma esiswini?
Kunganina ukuba andipangela amadolo? kunganina ukuba enje njalo namabele, ukuba ndanye?
Ngokuba ngoku, ngendiba ndilele pantsi, ndonwaba ke; ngendiba ndilele ubutongo, ndandula ukuba nokupumla;
ndawonye nokumkani namapakati omhlaba, ababezakela indawo ezicitakeleyo;
umhlaumbi ndawonye nenkosi ezibe zinegolide, ezazizalisa izindlu zazo ngesilivere:
umhlaumbi, njengesisu sipumayo esiselelweyo, ngendingabi ndiko; njengentsana e zingazanga zibone ukukanya.
Apo, abakohlakeleyo bayayeka ukuxalisa; nalapo, bayapumla abadiniweyo ngamandla:
ababanjwa bayapumla kunye; abasaliva ilizwi lombandezeli.
Abancinane nabakulu bakona; nekonza likululekile enkosini yalo.
Kunganina ukuba kunikwe ukukanya konosizi; nobomi kwabanobuṙaṙa bompefumlo;
abalangazelela ukufa, kanti akuko; abakumbelayo ngapezu kwendyebo eziselelweyo;
abavuya kude kuvuyelelwe, bagcobe, nxa bafumeneyo incw̔aba?
Kunganina kwindoda endlela ifihliweyo, leyo utixo ayibiyeleyo ngokungqonga?
Ngokuba, ebusweni bokutya kwam, kusiza ukugula kwam; zitululwa njengamanzi nembombolozo zam.
Ngokuba bendisoyika ububi, baza bandihlela: noko ndandinkwantya kona, kuze kum.
Bendingenakunqaba, bendingenakwonwaba, bendingenakupumla, saza safika isitukutezi.
WAZA wapendula u‐Elifazi um‐Temani, wati:
Silinga ukuteta nawe, uya kudinwa na? ngubanina pofu ongawabambayo amazwi?
Bona ke, ubalulekile abaninzi, nezandla ezibutataka uzomelezile.
Obeku̔beka amazwi ako ampakamisile, namadolo atobayo uwaqinisile.
Koko kaloku kuze pezu kwako, seucubukile; kufikele kuwe, selutusiwe.
Asi kukwoyika kwako na okuyingqiniso yako, nobunene bemikwa yako obulitemba lako?
Kaukumbule, ngubanina obengenatyala owabubayo? kupina ke babetshatyalaliswa abalungisayo?
Njengoko ndikubonileyo, abalimayo inkohlakalo, nabahlwayela ububi, bayavuna kona.
Ngokupefumla kukatixo bayabuba, nangomoya wempumlo yake bagqityelwe.
Ukukonya kwengonyama, nelizwi lengonyama enomsindo, namazinyo engonyama ezintsha ayapulwa.
Ingonyama enamandla iyabuba ngokuswela into yokuqwenga, namatole engonyamakazi atiwa sa.
Kekaloku ilizwi laziswa kum ngokwalama, yaka yabamba indlebe yam intsebezo kulo.
Pakati kwezicingo zivela emibonisweni yobusuku, kwakuba kusiwa ubutongo obukulu pezu kwabantu,
isoyiko sandihlela, nesingcangcazelo, esadidizisa onke amatambo am.
Wandula ukugqita pambi kwobuso bam umoya; zisuke inwele zenyama yam zapakama:
wema, kodwa bendingaqiqi isimilo sake; umfanekiselo ubungapambi kwamehlo am; nelizwi elizolileyo ndaliva, lisiti:
Into engumntu yoba ilungile pambi kwotixo na? indoda iya kuba ngcwele pambi kwomdali wayo na?
Bona ke, kuzo izicaka zake akatembi; napezu kwengelosi zake uyabeka ubudenge:
kangakananina ngakumbi ke pezu kw abemi bezindlu zodongwe, ezikusekwa kuselutulini! bayancinezelwa njengenundu;
kwa sekuseni kude kube sekuhlweni bacitiwe; bayagqibela ukububa, kungeko ogqalayo.
Ayinduluki na indluliselo yabo ekubo? bayafa, bengesebulumkweni.
Kaubize ke, ukuba kuko oya kusabela kuwe; nakuwupina kwabazingcwele uya kubeka?
Ngokuba olihilihili ingqumbo imbulala, noliyilo umona uyamfisa.
Ndibonile mna ihilihili lisendelisa ingcambo; kodwa ndahla ndaqalekisa ikaya lalo.
Abantwana balo bakude ekwonwabeni; boncinezelwa esangweni, kungeko umhlanguli:
elisivuno olambileyo uya kusidla, esisusa nasemaveni; nobutyebi babo umtiyeli ubunxamele.
Nakuba ububi bungaveli elutulini, nobunzima bungahlumi emhlabeni;
koko uluntu luzalelwayo ubunzima, njengokuba intlantsi zibalekela pezulu;
ngendifuna kutixo mna noko, nakuye utixo ngendibekela indawo yam:
ozenzayo izinto ezinkulu, ezingenakupengululwa; izinto ezimangalisayo, ezingenakubalwa;
onisa imvula pezu kwomhlaba, okupa amanzi pezu kwezindle:
ukuba abeke pezulu abatotyiweyo; bati abalilayo bapakanyiselwe ekwonwabeni.
Uyatshitshisa amaqinga abanamaqokolo, zide izandla zabo zingafezi nanto bayenzayo.
Uyabamba amalumko ngobawo ubuqokolo; necebo labajikayo linxamile.
Emini bayafumanana nobumnyama; nanjengasebusuku, bayaputaputa emini enkulu.
Kodwa uyamsindisa eṙeleni, emlonyeni wabo, nasesandleni sowomeleleyo, osweleyo.
Ngako kuko itemba kwihlwempu, iti inkohlakalo ivingce umlomo wayo.
Bona ke, unetamsanqa umntu owohlwaywa ngutixo; ngako ukubeta kwosomandla ungakudeli.
Ngokuba etutumbisa, abuye abope; uyalimaza, ziti izandla zake zipolise.
Ezimbandezelweni zintandatu uya kukusindisa; nakwezisixe̔nxe ububi abuyi kukupata.
Ekulambeni uya kukukulula ekufeni; nasemfazweni wokukulula emandleni eṙele.
Esibetweni solwimi uya kuzimela; akuyi kwoyika ingcitakaliso yakutika.
Ingcitakaliso nendlala wohleka ngazo; namaṙamncwa omhlaba akuyi kwoyika wona:
ngokuba luya kuba namatye asendle ucebano lwako; nezilo zasendle ziya kuxolana nawe.
Kanjalo uya kukwazi ukuba iseluxolweni intente yako; wauya kubonela kwiṙiwa lako, ungalahleki nto.
Uya kukwazi kanjako ukuba inzalo yako yoba ninzi, nabazukulwana bako njengenca yomhlaba.
Woza unobudala obuzeleyo encw̔abeni, njengokubutwa kwesita senqolowa ngexesha laso.
Bona ke oku, sikupengulule, kunje nje; kuve ke, uzazele wena.
WAZA wapendula u‐Jobi, wati:
Ayaba inkatazo yam yalinganiswa ipela, nelishwa lam lafunqulelwa ezintweni zokulinganisela kwa kunye!
Ngokuba kaloku inge inzima pezu kwentlabati yolwandle: ngako oko amazwi am atetiwe ngokunxama.
Ngokuba intolo zosomandla zipakati kwam, ezibuhlungu bazo bufincayo umoya wam; izoyikiso zikatixo ziyazicwangcisa ngakum.
Iqwaṙa liyakonya na eluhlazeni? Inkabi iyalila na pezu kwokutya kwayo?
Kuyadleka na okungenasongo ingeko ityuwa? kuko ukuvakala na ebumhlotsheni beqanda?
Ezizinto umpefumlo wam walile ukuzipata; zinjengokutya kwam okutyeketyeke.
Sanga singeza isicelo sam, ati utixo anike isilangazelelo sam:
ukuba avume utixo ukundityumza, asombulule isandla sake, anditi nqam!
Oko bekusaya kubako isonwabiso sam; ngendivuyelela ebuhlungwini, nakuba abengenanceba: ngokuba ndingasitelisanga amazwi oyingcwele.
Ayinto nina amandla am, ukuba ndibe netemba? siyinto nina nesipelo sam, ukuba ndolule ubomi bam?
Amandla am angamandla amatye na? inyama yam iyixina na?
Asi kukuba aluko na uncedo lwam pakati kwam, nokuba usizo lugxotiwe kum?
Onosizi ubang’ ububele kumhlobo wake; kanti ukwoyikwa kwosomandla uyakushiya.
Abazalwana bam benze ngenkohliso njengomlanjana; njengomsinga wemilanjana bayadlula;
ebutukutuku ngetuba leliqwa, ekukuyo iyazifihla ingqweqwe:
ngexesha lokutsha kwayo inqamkile; ekufudumaleni kwayo icimekile ezindaweni zayo.
Bayapambuka abahambi bendlela yayo; bayanyukela ebugxwayibeni, babube ke.
Abahambi bakwa‐Tema baqolosela; abaṙatyazi bakwa‐Sheba bayilangazelela.
Badana, ngokuba bebetembile; beza kufika kona, bamatiswa ke.
Ngokuba kaloku niba yinto engento; niyabona isituso, nize noyike.
Kanene kendatsho na ukuti: Ndipeni? nokuti: Ndikupeleni amabaso ebutyebini benu?
nokuti: Ndisindiseni esandleni sotshaba? nokuti: Ndikululeni esandleni sababandezeli?
Ndifundiseni, ndandiya kuti cwaka; nento ndiposisile ngayo ndiqondiseni.
Hai ukuba namandla kweziteto ezifanelekileyo! kodwa kungati nina ukwohlwaya, ukwohlwaya okuvela kuni?
Niyacinga ukwohlwaya amazwi na, zinjengomoya nje iziteto zoncamileyo?
Ewe, niyeyelisa inkedama, nimbele isihlobo senu isihogo.
Kodwa kaloku vumani nibeke ngakum; ngokuba ebusweni benu ndingayi kuxoka.
Buyani ke, makungabiko inkohlakalo; he, buyani kanjako, ubulungisa bam bukona.
Kuko elulwimini lwam na inkohlakalo? ikuhlangubo lam alingeqiqe na ubumenemene?
Akuko na ukulwa emntwini pezu kwomhlaba? nemihla yake ayinjengemihla yomqashwa na?
Njengokuba ikoboka linxamela amatunzi, nanjengokuba umqashwa elinda umvuzo wake;
kwa njalo ndabelwe inyanga zobubi, ndimiselwe ubusuku bendiniso.
Nxa ndilele pantsi, sendisiti: Ndiya kuvuka ninina, bumke ubusuku? kanjalo ndincanyiswa kukuzamazama kude kuse.
Inyama yam yambatiswe impetu namagada otuli; intlonze yam ishwabene, iyanyibilika.
Imihla yam igqitisile ngokubaleka isilukiso somluki; iyapeliswa lingeko itemba.
Kumbula ukuba ubomi bam bungumoya; alisayi kubuya iliso lam libone ukulunga.
Iliso lalowo undikangeleyo alisayi kundibona; awako amehlo oba pezu kwam, koko ndingayi kubako.
Ilifu liyapela, liti shwaka; kwa njalo lowo ohlelayo ehadesi akayi kunyuka kona.
Akasayi kubuyela kanjako endlwini yake; nendawo yake ayisayi kubuya yazane naye.
Noko andiyi kubamba umlomo wam; ndiya kuteta eluxinezekweni lwomoya wam; ndokalaza ebuṙaṙeni bompefumlo wam.
Ndilulwandle, ndingumnenga kusinina, lento ubekileyo pezu kwam umlindo?
Ndakuti: Kwonditutuzela isilili sam, wosidambisa isikalazo sam umandlalo wam;
wandule ukunditusa ngamapupa, nokundoyikisa ngemiboniso:
ude umpefumlo wam uqashe ukuṙwishwa, ewe ukufa ngapezu kwamatambo am.
Ndiwadelile; andiyi kudla ubomi ngonapakade; ndiyeke, ngokuba imihla yam iyinto engendawo.
Uyinto nina umntu, ukuba umenze mkulu, nokuba umbekele intliziyo yako?
ukuba umohlwaye imiso yonke, umlinge amaxanyana onke?
Kwoba kade kangakananina ukuba akuyi kujika kum, nokuba akuyi kundiyeka ndide ndiginye amate am?
Ndonile; ndiyenza nto nina kuwe noko, wena mlindi wabantu? kunganina ukuba undibekile ndibe yinto yokuwelwa kuwe, ndide ndibe ngumtwalo kwa kum?
Kunganina kanjalo ukuba ungaxoleli isigqito sam, uyisuse inkohlakalo yam? ngokuba kaloku ndiya kulala elutulini; wondifuna kusasa, koko ndingayi kubako.
WAZA wapendula u‐Biledadi um‐Shuha, wati:
Kwoda kube ninina uya kuteta ezi zinto, ati amazwi omlomo wako abe ngumoya onamandla?
Utixo wopambukisa ugwebo na? kanjalo usomandla wopambukisa ubulungisa na?
Ukuba abantwana bako bonile ngakuye, waza wabagxota ngako ukugqita kwabo:
ukuba ubufuna ngokutalo kutixo, wataṙuzisa kuye usomandla;
ukuba ubungongcwengekileyo nolungisayo; ngenyaniso kaloku ebeya kuvuka ngenxa yako, atamsanqelekise ikaya lokulunga kwako.
Nakuba ukuqala kwako bekukuncinane, okwasemva kwako bekuya kuba kukulu kunene.
Kodwa kaubuze isizukulwana sapambili, uzibekise ekufuniselweni kwoyise baso:
(ngokuba singabezolo tina, singazi nje; ngokuba isisitunzi imihla yetu emhlabeni:)
abayi kukufundisa bona na, bakutetele, bapumise entliziyweni yabo amazwi? — okuti:
Ingcongolo ingazipakamisa na lungeko udaka? umkanzi ungakula na engeko amanzi?
Nxa usenabo ubuhlaza bawo, ungekasikwa, uyapangela inca zonke ngokubuna.
Zikwa njalo indlela zabo bonke abamlibalayo utixo; netemba lomginwa lona liya kububa:
okukangela kuya kunqanyulwa, nokutembela kwake kwoba yindlu yesigcawo.
Uya kwayama kwindlu yake, kanti ayiyi kuma; uya kubambelela kuyo, kanti ayiyi kuhlala iqinile.
Ucumile ebusweni belanga, nehlumelo lake liyapumela pezu kwesitiya sake.
Pezu kwemfumba ingcambo zake zijijene; indawo yamatye uyayibona.
Nxa atshatyalaliswayo endaweni yake, yoza imkanyele, isiti: Andikubonanga.
Bona ke, olu luvuyo lwendlela yake; bati abanye bahlume elutulini.
Bona ke, utixo akayi kumlahla ofezekileyo; akayi kubamba abenzi bokubi ngesandla kanjalo.
Nxa asazalisa ikuhlangubo lako ngohleko, nomlomo wako ngomemezo lwomgcobo,
abatiyi bako baya kwambatiswa idano: kanti intente yabakohlakeleyo ayiyi kuba iseko.
WAZA wapendula u‐Jobi, wati:
Ngenyaniso ndiyakwazi ukuba kunjalo: kodwa angati nina umntu ukuba nokulunga pambi kwotixo?
Ukuba ebetanda ukupika naye, akangempendulele nto noko inye kweziliwaka.
Ulumkile ngentliziyo, womelele ngamandla: ngubanina oke wazenza lukuni ngakuye, waza watamsanqeleka?
Okwelelisayo intaba, zingazi zona; ozipenulayo ngomsindo wake;
ongcangcazelisa umhlaba usuke endaweni yawo, ziti intsika zawo zididize;
otetayo elangeni, lingapumi ke; ozincamatisela nenkwenkwezi;
otwabululayo amazulu yena yedwa, anyatele pezu kwamapezulu olwandle;
owenzayo u‐Bere, n o‐Oriyone, nesilimela, nenkambili zasesuyide;
owenzayo izinto ezinkulu, ezingenakupengululwa; nemimangaliso, engenakubalwa.
Bona ke, uyadlula ngakum, kanti andimboni; uyagqita nokugqita, kanti andimqiqi.
Bona ke, uti ṙintyi; ngubanina ongamnqandayo? ngubanina oya kutsho kuye ukuti: Wenza nto nina?
Utixo akayi kusonga ingqumbo yake; bayatoba ngapantsi kwayo abancedi abaner̔atshi.
Kukancinane kangakananina ngakumbi endiya kumpendula mna, ndikete amazwi am ngakuye?
Lowo, nakuba bendilungileyo, ngendingampenduli; kuye umgwebi wam ngenditaṙuzisa.
Ukuba bendibizile, waza wandipendula, ngendingakolwa ukuba wolibekela indlebe ilizwi lam:
ngokuba endityumza ngoqwitela, ewandisa amanxeba am kungeko tuba.
Akandivumeli ndipinde ukupefumla kwam, koko endihlutisa ngezinto eziṙaṙa.
Ukuba kutetwa ngamandla, bona ke, unamandla yena; ukuba kutetwa ngokumema, ngubanina oya kundimisela ixesha?
Ukuba nditi ndilungile, owam umlomo wondigweba; ukuba nditi ndifezekile, wobonisa ukuba ndinobugwenxa.
Nakuba bendifezekile, ngendingawazi umpefumlo wam; ngendidela ubomi bam.
Inye into le, kungoko enditshilo: ofezekileyo nokohlakeleyo uyabapelisa.
Nxa isibeto sibaqa ukubulala, uyahleka ilingwa labangenatyala.
Umhlaba uyanikwa esandleni sokohlakeleyo; ubuso babagwebi bawo uyabugqubutela; ukuba akunjalo, ungubanina pofu?
Imihla yam igqitisile isigidimi ngokubaleka: isabile; ayibonanga ubutamsanqa:
igqitile njengemikombe yengcongolo; njengokozi lubalekela kwinto yokutya.
Ukuba nditi: Ndiya kulibala isikalazo sam, ndoshiya usizi lwam, ndizomeleze;
ndiyoyika zonke intlungu zam: ndiyazi ukuba akuyi kundigwebela:
