esiti: Intolongo okunene sayifumana ivaliwe ngokunqaba konke, nabalindi bemi ngapandle pambi kwengcango; kodwa sakuvula, asafumana mntu pakati.
Xeshekweni ke umperisite omkulu nenkosi yetempile nabaperisite abakulu baweva lamazwi, bebexakekile pezu kwawo, ukuba kungada kube yinto nina oku.
Kwaza kwafika umntu wabashumayeza, esiti: Bona ke, lomadoda enawafakayo entolongweni, asetempileni, emi efundisa abantu.
Yandula yemka inkosi yetempile kunye namadindili, yaya yawazisa, inga wazisi ngamandla, ngokuba bebesoyika abantu, ukuze bangagityiselwa ngamatye.
Bati bakuba bewazisile, bawamisa entlanganisweni yamapakati: waza umperisite omkulu wababuza,
esiti: Asaniyalela kunene na ukuba ningafundisi ngeligama? kanti bona ke, niyizalisile i‐Yerusaleme ngemfundiso yenu, nifuna ukunga ningalizisa pezu kwetu igazi lalomntu kanjako.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi n abanye abapostile bapendula bati: Kufanele ukupulapula utixo ngapezu kwabantu.
Utixo wobawo betu wamvusa u‐Yesu, enati nina nambulala nimxo̔mile emtini.
Yena lo utixo umpakamisele kwesokunene sake abe yinkosi nomsindisi, ukuba anike uguquko ko‐Sirayeli noxolelwa lwezono.
Nati singamanqi̔na ake ngezizinto; kwa nomoya oyingcwele kanjalo, ate utixo wamnika kubo abampulapulayo.
Kekaloku bakuva oku, bebecunukile kakulu, banxamela ukubabulala.
Kodwa wesuka wema umfarisi otile entlanganisweni, ogama lalingu‐Gamaliyeli, umfundisimteto obekekileyo pakati kwabo bonke abantu, waxela ukuba abapostile mabapunyiswe kube mzuzwana;
waza wati kubo: Madoda, bo‐Sirayeli! zilumkeleni ukuba niza kwenza nto nina ngendawo yababantu.
Ngokuba pambili kuzo ezintsuku kwesuka u‐Teyuda, esiti ungumntu omkulu, ekwanamatela kuye inani lamadoda anga angamakulu mane; owayebulewe; nabo bonke ababetelela kuye, baci̔teka bati tshabalala.
Emveni kwaló kwesuka u‐Jude um‐Galili, emihleni yesiba̔lelo, waku̔kulisa abantu abaninzi emva kwake; owabuba naye; nabo bonke ababetelela kuye, baci̔twa.
Nokwakaloku nje nditi kuni: Gwegwedani kubo ababantu, nibayeke; ngokuba eliqinga umhlaumbi lomsebenzi ukuba uti ube ngowabantu, uya kutshatyalaliswa;
kodwa ukuba ungo katixo, aningewutshabalalise, hleze nike nifunyanwe nisilwa kwa notixo.
Beyiswa nguye ke: baza bakuba bebebabizile abapostile, babatyabula, babayalela ukuba bangateti ngegama lika‐Yesu, babandulula.
Bati ke ngoko bona bemka bevuya ebusweni bentlanganiso, ngokokuba bebebalwa ngokuba befanele ukupatwa ngokuhlazekileyo ngenxa yegama lake.
Kanjalo ngemihla yonke etempileni nakwizindlu ngezindlu, babengapezi ukufundisa nokushumayela u‐Yesu ongu‐Kristu.
KWEZINTSUKU ke, bakuba bebesanda abadisipile, kwavuka ukuṙoṙa kwaba‐Girike ngakuma‐Hebere, ngokokuba abahlolokazi bakowabo bebelityalwa ekwabiweni kwemihla ngemihla.
Baza abalishumi linababini babiza umhlambi wabadisipile, bati: Akufanelekile kuti, ukuba silishiye ilizwi likatixo, sikonze ezitafileni.
Yitini ngoko, bazalwana! nifune kwa kuni amadoda abe sixe̔nxe anqi̔nelwayo kakuhle, azele ngumoya oyingcwele nabubulumko, esiya kuwamisela pezu kwalomcimbi.
Kodwa tina somana ukuhlala ekutandazeni, nasebukonzini belizwi.

Lati elozwi lakolisa wonke umhlambi: baza banyula u‐Stefane, indoda izele lukolo na ngumoya oyingcwele, no‐Filipi, no‐Pirokoro, no‐Nikanore, no‐Timone, no‐Paramena, no‐Nikolasi, ikolwa lobujuda lase‐Antiyoki;
abati babamisa ebusweni babapostile: baza bakuba bebetandazile babeka izandla pezu kwabo.
Labe ilizwi likatixo likula; laye lisandiswa inani labadisipile e‐Yerusaleme kakulu; nesihlwele esikulu sabaperisite sibe silulamela elukolweni.
Kekaloku u‐Stefane, ezele lukolo nangamandla, ebesenza imimangaliso nemiqondiso emikulu pakati kwabantu.
Kwaza kwesuka abatile babakuyo indlu yentlanganiso e‐kutiwa yeyaba‐Kulule?-?kiswa, neyaba‐Kirene, neyaba‐Aletsandriya, nababo bavela e‐Silisiya nase‐Asiya, bepikisana no‐Stefane.
Baye bekohlwa ke ukumelana nobulumko nomoya abeteta ngawo.
Bandula bancetezisa amadoda esiti: Simvile eteta amazwi okugxeka ngaku‐Mosesi na ngaku ye utixo.
Kanjalo bavuselela abantu, nabadala, nababa̔li, bambaqa, bamqubula, bamr̔olela entlanganisweni yamapakati,
bamisa amanqi̔na abuxoki esiti: Lomntu akapezi ukuteta amazwi okugxeka ngakuyo lendawo engcwele na ngaku wo umteto;
ngokuba simvile esiti: u‐Yesu lowo, um‐Nazarete, uya kuci̔ta indawo le, aguqule amasiko esasinikelwa wona ngu‐Mosesi.
Baza bonke abebehleli entlanganisweni, bejongele kuye, babona ubuso bake njengokungati bubuso bengelosi.
Waza wati umperisite omkulu: Kanene ezizinto zinjalo kusinina?
Waza wati yena: Madoda, bazalwana nobawo! pulapulani. Utixo wobungcwalisa wabonakala kubawo wetu u‐Abrahame, nxa abese‐Mesopotami, engekahlalanga e‐Karane,
wati kuye: Puma elizweni lakowenu, nasezalamaneni zako, uze elizweni endisukuba ndikubonisa lona.
Wandula wapuma elizweni lama‐Kaledine, wahlala e‐Karane. Waza wamsusa kona, emveni kwokufa kwoyise, wamfudusela kwelilizwe enihlala kulo nina ngoku.
Akamnika lifa ke kulo, enga mnikanga nendawo yokunyatelwa kwonyawo: kanti noko wambekela ngedinga lokuba wolinika kuye libe yimfuyo, nakwinzalo yake emva kwake, nxa abengenamntwana.
Waza wateta ngokunje utixo, ukuti: Inzalo yake yopambukela ezweni labasemzini, abaya kuyikonzisa bayipate kakubi iminyaka emakulu mane.
Nesosizwe isukuba ikonza kuso, watsho utixo, ndiya kusigweba; yaiya kuti emveni kwoko ipume, ikonze mna kulendawo.
Kanjako wamnika ucebano lwolwaluko: kwa njalo ke wazala u‐Yisake, wamalusa ngomhla wesibozo; waza u‐Yisake wazala u‐Yakobi, no‐Yakobi wazala oyise abakulu boshumi linababini.
Baza oyise abakulu bezondele u‐Josefe bamtengisela e‐Jipete: kanti utixo ebenaye,
wamhlangula kuzo zonke imbandezelo zake, wamnika ufefe nobulumko ebusweni buka‐Faro ukumkani we‐Jipete, owammisa umpati pezu kwe‐Jipete, na pezu kwayo yonke indlu yake.
Kekaloku kweza indlala pezu kwalo lonke ilizwe le‐Jipete nele‐Kanane, nobunzima obukulu; baye bengafumani kutya obawo betu.
Kodwa akuva u‐Yakobi ukuba iko inqolowa e‐Jipete, watuma obawo betu okwokuqala.
Nangokwesibini u‐Josefe wazazisa kubakuluwe bake, bati abalamane baka‐Josefe bazeka ku‐Faro.
Waza watuma u‐Josefe wambiza uyise u‐Yakobi eze kuye, nazo zonke izalamane zake, ingamashumi asixe̔nxe anamihlanu imipefumlo yonke.
Waza u‐Yakobi wehlela e‐Jipete, wabuba yena, nobawo betu,
basuselwa e‐Shekeme, babekwa encw̔abeni abelitengile u‐Abrahame ngenani lemali elusatsheni luka‐Hamore uyise ka‐Shekeme.
Kodwa njengokuba libe lisondela ixesha ledinga abelifungile utixo ku‐Abrahame, kwa njalo bakula abantu, bandiswa e‐Jipete,
kude kwavuka ukumkani wumbi, obengenakumazi u‐Josefe.
Yena lo wenza ngobuqinga kwisizwe sakowetu, wabapata kakubi obawo betu, kuze kulahlwe intsana zabo, ukuba zingagcinwa zihleli.
Kwelona xesha wazalwa u‐Mosesi, waye emhle kakulu; owondliwa endlwini kayise inyanga zantatu.
Kekaloku akuba ebelahliwe yena, yamcola intombi ka‐Faro, yamondla abe ngunyana kuyo.
Waza u‐Mosesi wafundiswa kubo bonke ubulumko bama‐Jipete; wayenamandla ekuteteni nasekwenzeni kanjako.
Xeshekweni ke bekumzalisekelwa ixesha leminyaka imashumi mane, kwangena entliziyweni yake ukutyelela kubo abazalwana bake usapo luka‐Sirayeli.
Waza akubona omnye obesoniwa, wa m siza, wampindezelela obebandezelwa, wambeta um‐Jipete.
Wayesiba abazalwana bake baya kuqonda ukuba utixo wobanika usindiso ngesandla sake: kodwa bona abaqonda.
Kanjalo ngomhla olandelayo wazibonakalisa kubo besilwa, wazama ukubalamla, esiti: Madoda! ningabazalwana nina: kuyinina ukuba nonane?
Kodwa lowo ubesona ummelwane wake wamtya̔la, esiti: Ngubanina owamisa wena inkosi nomgwebi pezu kwetu?
ufuna ukubulala mna, njengokuba wambulalayo izolo um‐Jipete?
Waza wesaba u‐Mosesi ngesiteto esi, waba ngowasemzini elizweni le‐Midiyane, apo wazalela kona onyana bababini.
Kwaza kwati kwakuzaliseka iminyaka imashumi mane, kwabonakala kuye entlango yasentabeni ye‐Sinai ingelosi yenkosi elangatyeni lomlilo etyolweni.
Wati u‐Mosesi akubona, wasitela nqa isibonakalo eso; naxeshekweni ebesondela ukuza kubonela, kweza ilizwi lenkosi kuye, lisiti:
Mna ndi ngutixo woyihlo bako, utixo ka‐Abrahame, notixo ka‐Yisake, notixo ka‐Yakobi. Waza u‐Mosesi wangcangcazela, wabengenakukalipa kwokubonela.
Yaza yati inkosi kuye: Tula izihlangu zenyawo zako; ngokuba indawo umiyo kuyo ingumhlaba ongcwele.
Ndikolisile ukubona ukupatwa kakubi kwabantu bam abase‐Jipete, nokugula kwabo ndikuvile; ndihle ke ukuba ndibahlangule: yiza ke kaloku, ndokutuma e‐Jipete.
Yena lo u‐Mosesi abamkanyelayo, besiti: Ngubanina owamisa wena inkosi nomgwebi? yena lo utixo wamtuma abe yinkosi nomkululi ngesandla sengelosi eyabibonakala kuye etyolweni.
Nguye lo owabaku̔payo, eyenzile imimangaliso nemiqondiso elizweni le‐Jipete, naselwandle olubomvu, nasentlango iminyaka imashumi mane.
Nguye lo oyena Mosesi owati elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli: Uyehova, utixo wenu, wonivusela umprofite, kubazalwana benu, njengam: yena niya kumva.
Nguye lo owabeko entlanganisweni entlango kunye nengelosi ebiteta kuye entabeni ye‐Sinai, na kunye nobawo betu: owamkela amazwi abubomi ukuba awanike kuti:
ababengavumi obawo betu ukumpulapula, koko bamtya̔layo, bati intliziyo zabo babuyela e‐Jipete,
esiti ku‐Arone: Senzele otixo, abaya kuhamba pambi kwetu; ngokuba u‐Mosesi lo, owasiku̔payo ezweni le‐Jipete, singamazi ukuba uhlelwe yinto nina.
Baza badala itole kwezontsuku, banikela idini kwisitixo eso, bagcoba kuyo imisebenzi yezandla zabo.

Wajika ke utixo, wabayekelela ukuba bawukonze umkosi wezulu; njengokuba kuba̔liwe encwadini yabaprofite, ukuti: Imibingo neminikelo niyinikele na kum, iminyaka yamashumi mane, entlango, ndlu ka‐Sirayeli?
kanti nayifunqula intentana ka‐Moleke, nenkwenkwezi yotixo wenu u‐Remfane, imifanekiso enayenzayo ukuba niyibedeshe: ndandiya kunifudusela ele kwe‐Babilone.
Obawo betu bebenayo intente yesinqi̔no entlango, njengokuba bekumiselwe ngulowo ubeteta ku‐Mosesi ukuba ayenze ngomfanekiselo abewubonile:
abati kanjalo bayingenisa obawo betu kunye no‐Yoshuwa, beyamkele nje ngokulandelana, ekubambeni kwabo ilizwe labaheyideni, ababegxotwa ngutixo ebusweni bobawo betu, kwada kwayimihla ka‐Davide;
owafumana ufefe pambi kwotixo, wazicelela ukuba afumanele utixo ka‐Yakobi itabanakele.
Kodwa u‐Solomone wamakela indlu.
Noko yena opezu konke akahlali ezitempileni ezenziweyo ngezandla; njengokuba esitsho umprofite ukuti:
Izulu liyiterone yam, nomhlaba usisitulo senyawo zam; yindlu enina niya kundakela yona? utsho uyehova; umhlaumbi yeyipina indawo yokupumla kwam?
isandla sam asazenza ezizinto zonke na?
Nina bantamo zilukuni, nabantliziyo nendlebe zingalukanga! niyamelana nomoya oyingcwele ngamaxesha onke; njengokuba bebesenje njalo oyihlo benu, niyenje njalo nani.
Nguwupina wabaprofite ongatshutshiswanga ngoyihlo benu? ewe bafisa abo bakushumayela pambili ukuza kwolungileyo; enisand’ ukumngcatsha nokumbulala:
nina ke eniwamkeleyo umteto ngezimiselo zengelosi, kanti aniwubambanga.
Kekaloku besiva ezizinto, bebecunukile kakulu ezintliziyweni zabo, bamqaqazelela ngamazinyo.
Kodwa yena, ezele ngumoya oyingcwele, wabeka amehlo ngasezulwini, wabona ubungcwalisa bukatixo, no‐Yesu emi ngasekunene kwotixo,
wati: Bona ke, ndiyabona izulu livulekile, nonyana wesintu emi ngasekunene kwotixo.
Baza badanduluka ngelizwi elikulu, baziti vingci indlebe zabo, bati bukuqu ngentliziyo nye pezu kwake,
ba m kupela pandle kwesixeko, ba m gibisela ngamatye: ati amanqi̔na abeka pantsi ingubo zawo ngasezinyaweni zendodana ebibizwa ngo‐Saulusi.
Baza bamgibisela u‐Stefane ngamatye, ebiza kuyo i‐Nkosi, esiti nokuti: Nkosi Yesu! yamkela umoya wam.
Waza waguqa ngamadolo, wadanduluka ngelizwi elikulu, esiti: Nkosi! ungamisi kubo esisono. Wati akuba etshilo walala ubutongo.

Kekaloku u‐Saulusi ebetakazela ukubulawa kwake. Kwasuka kwabako ngeloxesha intshutshiso enkulu ngakuyo iṙemente ebise‐Yerusaleme: baza bonke batiwa sa emazweni ase‐Judeya ne‐Samariya; kwasala abapostile kupela.
Kekaloku amadoda abubedesho amncw̔aba u‐Stefane, enza isijwili esikulu pezu kwake.
Kodwa u‐Saulusi ebeci̔ta iṙemente, engena kwizindlu ngezindlu, er̔ola namadoda namankazana, wawanikela entolongweni.
Bandula abo batiwa sa bacanda indawo zonke, beshumayela ilizwi.
WAZA u‐Filipi wehlela esixekweni sase‐Samariya, wabashumayeza u‐Kristu.
Zaye izihlwele zinyamekela ezonto zibe zitshiwo ngu‐Filipi ngentliziyo nye, zisiva zibona nokubona imiqondiso abeyenza.
Ngokuba omoya abanco̔lileyo, bekala ngelizwi elikulu, bebepuma kwabaninzi abebenabo: kanjako abaninzi ababenesifo sokushwabanisa nabaziziqwala bapiliswa.
Kwaza kwabako uvuyo olukulu kwesosixeko.
Kwaye kuko indoda etile, egama lalingu‐Simone, ebifudula isenza ngobugqi kwesosixeko, imangalisa abantu base‐Samariya, isiti ingumntu omkulu bo:
ababebambelela kuyo bonke, kwa kuye omncinane kwada kwakuye omkulu, besiti: Le ndoda ingamandla amakulu katixo.
Babebambelela kuyo ke, ngenxa yokuba bekukade ibamangalisile ngezinto zayo zobugqi.
Kodwa xeshekweni bakolwayo ngu‐Filipi, eshumayela izinto ezingabo ubukumkani bukatixo na ngalo igama lika‐Yesu Kristu, bebebapitizeshwa, kwa namadoda namankazana.
Kanjalo u‐Simone wakolwa naye, wati akuba ebapitizeshiwe waman’ ukubako no‐Filipi; waza ebona imiqondiso nemimangaliso emikulu ebisenziwa, wati nqa.
Kekaloku kwakuviwa ngabapostile abebese‐Yerusaleme, ukuba i‐Samariya ilamkele ilizwi likatixo, batuma kubo u‐Petrosi no‐Johane:
abati, bakuba behlele kona, babatandazela, ukuze bamkele umoya oyingcwele:
(ngokuba ebengekabawelanga kwa namnye; koko babe bebapitizeshelwe egameni lenkosi u‐Yesu kodwa.)
Bandula babeka izandla pezu kwabo, baza bamkela umoya oyingcwele.
Wati kekaloku u‐Simone, ebonile okokuba umoya oyingcwele uyanikwa ngokubekwa kwezandla zabapostile, wafuna ukubanikela imali,
esiti: Ndipeni nam igunya eli, lokuba lowo ndisukuba ndibeka izandla pezu kwake amkele umoya oyingcwele.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi wati kuye: Maiti imali yako kunye nawe ibe yinto yokutshatyalaliswa, ngokokuba isipo sikatixo ubusiba wosizuza ngemali.
Akunasahlulo nasabiwo kulendawo: ngokuba intliziyo yako ingalungile ebusweni bukatixo.
Guquka ngoko kubo obububi bako, ukunge utixo, ukuba umhlaumbi woyixolelwa inkumbulo yentliziyo yako.
Ngokuba ndibona ukuba usenyongweni yobuṙaṙa nasekubanjweni kwenkohlakalo.
Waza wapendula u‐Simone wati: Ndikungeleni nina enkosini ukuze kungandihleli nanye yezozinto nitetile ngazo.
Bandula bona, bakuba benqi̔nisile bateta ilizwi lenkosi, babuyela e‐Yerusaleme, bashumayela ivangeli emizini emininzi yama‐Samariya.
Yati kekaloku ingelosi yenkosi yateta ku‐Filipi, isiti: Suka, uhambele ngasesuyide, ngendlela ehlayo e‐Yerusaleme iye e‐Gaza, leyo ilubala.
Wesuka ke wahamba: kekaloku bona ke, umntu wase‐Tiyopiya, umbusi omkulu ka‐Kandase ukumkanikazi wama‐Tiyopiya, obepezu kwayo yonke indyebo yake, obezile e‐Yerusaleme ukuza kubedesha,
wabebuya, wati ehleli enqwelweni yake walesesha incwadi yomprofite u‐Yisaya.
Waza wati umoya ku‐Filipi: Sondela, uhlangane nalenqwelo.
Waza u‐Filipi wagidimela kona, wamva elesesha incwadi yomprofite u‐Yisaya, wati: Uqonda ke na oko ukuleseshayo?
Wati yena: Ndingati nina ukuqonda pofu, ukuba akuko mntu ondikapayo? Waza wambongoza u‐Filipi ukuba akwele ahlale naye.
Kekaloku indawo yesiba̔lo abeyilesesha, ibiyilé yokuti: War̔olwa njengegusha isiya ekuxe̔lweni, nanjengokuba imvana ebusweni boyigugulayo isidenge, kwa njalo akavuli umlomo wake:
ebupantsini bake ukugwetyelwa kwake kwasuswa; nesizukulwana sake ngubanina oya kusixela? ngokuba bususwa emhlabeni ubomi bake.
Wapendula ke umbusi lowo ku‐Filipi, wati: Ndiyakukunga, umprofite utsho oku ngobanina? ngokwake, ngomntu wumbi, kusinina?
Waza u‐Filipi wavula umlomo wake, waqala kwa kuso isiba̔lo esi, wamshumayeza u‐Yesu.
Kekaloku nxa bebehamba endleleni, bafika ngasemanzini atile: waza wati umbusi: Nanga amanzi; ndixakwa yinto nina ukubapitizeshwa?
Wayesiti u‐Filipi: Ukuba uyakolwa ngayo yonke intliziyo yako, kungenzwa. Wayependula wati: Ndiyakolwa ukuba u‐Yesu Kristu unguye unyana katixo.
Waza waxela ukuba inqwelo ime: baza bobabini behlela emanzini, kwa no‐Filipi nombusi; wambapitizesha ke.
Kekaloku okuya bebenyuke emanzini, umoya wenkosi wamsusa u‐Filipi, wati umbusi akabi sambona: ngokuba ebehamba indlela yake evuya.
Kodwa u‐Filipi wafunyanwa e‐Azote: waza ecanda ilizwe washumayela ivangeli kuzo zonke izixeko, wada wafika e‐Kesareya.
KEKALOKU u‐Saulusi esapefumla ukusongela nokubulala ngakubo abadisipile benkosi, waya kumperisite omkulu,
wacela kuye incwadi zokuya e‐Damakusi, ziba̔l elwa intlanganiso zakona, ukuze ati, ukuba uyafumana abatile abebengabendlela leyo, kwa namadoda namankazana, abazise benxityiwe e‐Yerusaleme.
Kekaloku ekuhambeni kwake, kwaye kute nxa ebesoudela e‐Damakusi, kwandula ukuti benge ngakuye ngokwalama inkanyiso ivela ezulwini.
Waza ewile ngasemhlabeni weva ilizwi lisiti kuye: Saulusi, Saulusi! unditshutshisela nina?
Wayesiti: Ungubanina, Nkosi? Yayisiti inkosi: Mna ndingu‐Yesu, lowo umtshutshisayo: kunzima kuwe ukukaba ngasezihlabeni.
Waza engcangcazela enokuti nqa wati: Nkosi! ufuna ukuba ndenze nto nina? Yaza inkosi yati kuye: Suka, ungene esixekweni; wauya kutyelwa oko ufanele ukukwenza.
Kekaloku amadoda abehamba naye ebemi engenakuteta, esiva okunene ilizwi, engaboni mntu kodwa.
Waza wesuka u‐Saulusi emhlabeni; kwati kwakuvulwa amehlo ake, akabona mntu; aza emtundeza ngesandla amngenisa e‐Damakusi.
Wayentsuku ntatu engenakubona; akadla ke, akasela kanjako.
Kwabekuko umdisipile otile e‐Damakusi ogama lalingu‐Hananiya; yaza yati kuye inkosi embonisweni: Hananiya! Wati yena: Nanku mna, Nkosi!
Yati inkosi kuye: Suka, uye esitarateni esibizwa ngokuti Sesite‐ntse, ubuzele endlwini ka‐Jude umntu ogama lingu‐Saulusi, um‐Tarese; ngokuba, bona ke, etandaza;
oyibonileyo embonisweni indoda egama lingu‐Hananiya ukuba yangena yabeka isandla pezu kwake, ukuze abuye abone.
Waza wati u‐Hananiya ukupendula: Nkosi! ndivile kwabaninzi ngayo indoda le, ukuba zingakanana izinto zobubi izenzileyo kubo abangcwele bako e‐Yerusaleme;
nalapa inalo igunya livela kubaperisite abakulu, lokuba inxibe bonke ababiza egameni lako.
Kodwa inkosi yati kuye: Hamba; ngokuba lo eyimpahla enyuliweyo kum, yokupata igama lam pambi kwabaheyideni, nokumkani, nosapo luka‐Sirayeli;
ngokuba ndiya kumbonisa ukuba zizinto ezingakanana afanele ukuziva ngenxa yegama lam.

Wemka ke u‐Hananiya, waya wangena endlwini leyo; waza wabeka izandla pezu kwake, wati: Mzalwana Saulusi! inkosi inditumile, kwa u‐Yesu owabonakala kuwe endleleni ubusiza ngayo, ukuze ubuye ubone, nokuba uzaliswe ngumoya oyingcwele.
Kwandula kwa oko kwawa emehlweni ake zanga zinkwetu, waselekwamkela ukubona ke, wesuka wabapitizeshwa:
waza akuba etabatile ukutya womelezwa. Kekaloku u‐Saulusi wayeko nabadisipile abebese‐Damakusi intsuku ezitile.
Waza waseleshumayela u‐Kristu ezindlwini zentlanganiso, ukuba lo unguye unyana katixo.
Koko bamangaliswayo bonke ababesiva, bati: Lo asi nguye na owaci̔ta abo babebiza kweligama e‐Yerusaleme, nobezele oku kwa lapa, ukuba abazise benxityiwe pambi kwabaperisite abakulu?
Kodwa u‐Saulusi womelezeka ngakumbi, wawati piti ama‐Juda abehlala e‐Damakusi, eqinisa ngezizatu ukuba lo unguye u‐Kristu.
Kwati kwakuzaliseka imihla yamininzi, acebisana ama‐Juda ukuba ambulale:
kodwa ingcebo yawo yazeka ku‐Saulusi. Aza alalela amasango nasemini nasebusuku, ukuze ambulale.
Kodwa abadisipile bamtabata ebusuku, ba m hlisela pantsi ngodonga, be m hlisile engobozini.
Kekaloku akuba u‐Saulusi ebefikile e‐Yerusaleme, wabelinga ukukolana nabadisipile: kanti bonke bebemoyika, bengakolwa ukuba ungumdisipile.
Kodwa u‐Banabasi wamtabata naye, wamzisa kubapostile, wababalisela okokuba ebebonile inkosi endleleni, nokuba yateta kuye; nokokuba ebetetile ngokukalipa egameni lika‐Yesu e‐Damakusi.
Waye eko nabo e‐Yerusaleme engena epuma nokupuma,
eteta ngokukalipa egameni lenkosi u‐Yesu: kanjalo wateta wabuzisana naba‐Girike; koko bona bebelinga ukumbulala.
Kodwa abazalwana, bakwazi oku, bamkapela e‐Kesareya, bamsusa ukuya e‐Tarese.
Zandula zati ke iṙemente kuyo yonke i‐Judeya, ne‐Galili, ne‐Samariya, zanoxolo, zakiwa; zaza zihamba ekwoyikeni inkosi, naselwonwabisweni lwo?-? moya oyingcwele, zandiswa.
KWAYE kute, akuba u‐Petrosi ebecanda kuzo zonke indawo wehlela nakubo abangcwele abebehlala e‐Luda.
Kekaloku wafumana apo umntu otile ogama lingu‐Eneya, obelele eluku̔kweni iminyaka yasibozo, obenesifo sokushwabanisa.
Waza u‐Petrosi wati kuye: Eneya! u‐Yesu ongu‐Kristu uyakupilisa; suka, uzandlalele. Waselesuka kwa oko.
Baza bambona bonke abebehlala e‐Luda nase‐Sharone, abati baguqukela kwinkosi.
Kekaloku bekuko e‐Jopa umdisipilekazi otile ogama lingu‐Tabita, o‐kutiwa ngokukunyushwa ngu‐Dokasi: yena lo ebezele yimisebenzi elungileyo nemilizo abeyenza.
Kwaye kute kwezontsuku ke, wabesifa, wabuba: bati bakuba bemhlambile, bambeka enkambilini yapezulu.
Kekaloku i‐Luda ikufupi nje ne‐Jopa, bati abadisipile bakuva ukuba u‐Petrosi ukona, batuma amadoda amabini kuye, be m bongoza ukuba makanganqeni ukuza kwa kubo.
Wesuka ke u‐Petrosi waya nawo. Oyena akuba efikile bamnyusela kulonkambili yapezulu: baza bema ngakuye bonke abahlolokazi belila, bebonakalisa izivato nengubo abezenza u‐Dokasi, nxa ebesenabo.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi wabaku̔pela pandle bonke, waguqa ngamadolo, watandaza; waza wajikela ngasemzimbeni, wati: Tabita! suka. Wawavula ke amehlo ake: wati akubona u‐Petrosi, wesuka wahlala.
Waza wamnikela isandla, wamsukisa; wati akuba ebabizile abangcwele nabahlolokazi, wammisa ebusweni babo ehleli.
Kwati ke oku kwazeka kuyo yonke i‐Jopa; baza abaninzi bakolwa enkosini.
Kwaye kute kekaloku wahlala imihla yamininzi e‐Jopa ku‐Simone otile umsuki wezikumba.
Kwabekuko indoda etile e‐Kesareya egama lalingu‐Koroneli, inkosikulu yasebandleni elibizwa ngokuti lelase‐Yitaliya,
ebingobedeshekileyo, ebisoyika utixo kunye nendlu yayo yonke, eyabenzela abantu amalizo amaninzi, yatandaza kutixo futi.
Lomntu wabona embonisweni kwa sekuhleni, yanga yayiyure yesitoba yemini, ingelosi katixo ukuba yangena kuye, yati kuye: Koroneli!
Waza yena ewabeka amehlo pezu kwayo, esoyika nokwoyika, wati: Yinto nina, Nkosi! Yayisiti kuye: Imitandazo yako nemilizo yako inyukele ibe yinkumbuzo ebusweni bukatixo:
nakaloku watume amadoda e‐Jopa, umeme u‐Simone obizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Petrosi:
lo uyahlala ku‐Simone otile umsuki wezikumba, ondlu ingaselwandle: lo wokutyela into ufanele ukuyenza.
Kekaloku xeshekweni yemkayo ingelosi ebiteta ku‐Koroneli, wabiza isibini sezicaka zake, nesodati elibedeshekileyo lakuwo abemana enaye:
waza wati, akuba ebatyele kwa konke, wabatuma e‐Jopa.
Kekaloku ngomnye umhla, nxa bebehamba abo, besondela esixekweni, wenyukela u‐Petrosi pezu kwentungo yendlu ukutandaza, ngeyure yesitandatu.
Waza walamba kakulu, wanga angatya; kodwa nxa bebelungisa bona, wawelwa lipupaṙa,
wabona izulu livulekile, nempahla etile njengeqiya enkulu isihla ngakuye, ibotshelelwe ngamancam omane, ihliselwa pantsi emhlabeni;
ekube kuko pakati kwayo zonke izilo zomhlaba ezinyawo zine, namar̔amncwa, nento ezinambuzelayo, nentaka zezulu.
Kwaza kweza ilizwi kuye, lisiti: Suka, Petrosi! xe̔la utye.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi wati: Nakanye, Nkosi! ngokuba ndingazanga nditye nanye into engengcwele nenco̔lileyo.
Kwabuya kweza ilizwi kuye ngokwesibini, lisiti: Oko akuhlanzileyo utixo, ungakwenzi okungengcwele wena.
Oku ke kwenziwa katatu: yaza impahla leyo yabuya yenyuselwa ezulwini.
Kekaloku nxa u‐Petrosi ebexakekile pakati kwake, ukuba ungaba yinto nina lomboniso awubonileyo, bona ke, lomadoda abesusiwe ku‐Koroneli, eyifumene ngokubuza indlu ka‐Simone, ema ngapambi kwesango,
abiza ke, abuza ukuba u‐Simone obizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Petrosi uyahlala kona na.
Esacingela umboniso lowo u‐Petrosi, wati umoya kuye: Bona ke, amadoda amatatu ayafuna wena:
uz’ usuke ngoko, uhle, uye nawo, ungatandabuzi nto; ngokuba ndiwatumile mna.
Waza wehla u‐Petrosi waya kulomadoda abesusiwe ku‐Koroneli ukuza kuye, wati: Bona ke, ndinguye enimfunayo; liyinina ituba enilapa ngenxa yalo?

Ati ke wona: u‐Koroneli inkosikulu, indoda elungileyo, emoyikayo utixo, enqi̔nelwayo kakuhle lulo lwonke uhlanga lwama‐Juda kanjalo, wayalwa ngutixo ngengelosi engcwele, ukuba akumemele endlwini yake, nokuba eve amazwi kuwe.
Wandula wawabizela pakati, wawamkela endlwini. Waza ngomnye umhla u‐Petrosi wemka nawo, nabatile bakubo abazalwana base‐Jopa bampeleka.
Nangomhla olandelayo bangena e‐Kesareya. Waye u‐Koroneli ebalinda, ezibizele ndawonye kuye izalamane zake nezihlobo ezitandekileyo.
Kwaza kwati kwakungena u‐Petrosi, u‐Koroneli wamkaulela, wawa pantsi ngasezinyaweni zake, wabedesha.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi wampakamisa, esiti: Suka ume; ndikwa ngumntu nam.
Wati encokola naye wangena, wafumana abaninzi bebutene ndawonye.

Waza wati kubo: Niyazi kakulu nina okokuba kuyinto engafanelekileyo kumntu ongum‐Juda ukukolana nokudlelana nowesinye isizwe: kanti utixo undibonisile ukuba ndingabizi namnye umntu ngokungengcwele nangokunco̔lileyo.
Ndeza ngoko ndakumenywa, ndingapikanga ke: ndiyabuza ngako, ukuba yindawo nina nandimemela yona?
Waza u‐Koroneli wati: Sekuntsuku zine ndibe ndizila ukutya kwada kwayileyure; nangeyure yesitoba benditandaza endlwini yam; yaza, bona ke, indoda yema ebusweni bam inesivato esikazimlayo,
yati: Koroneli! umtandazo wako uviwe, namalizo ako akunjulwe ebusweni bukatixo:
tuma ngoko e‐Jopa, umeme u‐Simone obizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Petrosi; lo uyahlala endlwini ka‐Simone umsuki wezikumba ngaselwandle, oya kuti akufika atete kuwe.
Ndasendisiti ke kwa oko ndatuma kuwe; nawe ulungisile ukuba ufikile. Kaloku ngoko silapa tina sonke ebusweni bukatixo, ukuva zonke izinto uziyalelweyo ngutixo.
Waza u‐Petrosi wavula umlomo, wati: Ngokwenyaniso ndiyaqiqa okokuba utixo akanguye oketa abantu;
koko oti kuzo zonke intlanga amoyike, enze ubulungisa, ukolekile kuye.
Elozwi walitumayo elusatsheni luka‐Sirayeli, eshumayela uxolo ngo‐Yesu Kristu, (lo u yinkosi yabo bonke,)
niyalazi: e lendawo eyenzekayo kuyo yonke i‐Judeya, iqalwe e‐Galili, emveni kwalo ubapitizesho olwashunyayelwayo ngu‐Johane:
elingaye u‐Yesu wase‐Nazarete, okokuba utixo wamtambisa ngomoya oyingcwele nangamandla; owacanda ilizwe esenza okulungileyo, epilisa bonke ababebandezelwa ngu‐Satane; ngokuba utixo ebenaye.
Nati ke singamanqi̔na ento zonke wazenzayo nasezweni lama‐Juda nase‐Yerusaleme; ate wona ambulala emxo̔mile emtini.
Yena lo utixo wamvusa ngowesitatu umhla, wambonakalisa ekuhleni:
bekungekubo bonke abantu, bekukuwo amanqi̔na abebalulwe pambili ngutixo, kuti tina, esatyayo sasela ndawonye naye emveni kwokuvuka kwake ekufeni.
Owasiyalezela ukuba sishumayele ebantwini, nokuba sinqi̔nise okokuba unguye obemisiwe ngutixo abe ngumgwebi wabahleliyo nabafileyo.
Yena lo bonke abaprofite bayamnqi̔nela, ukuba bonke abakolwayo kuye baya kwamkela ukuxolelwa kwezono ngalo igama lake.
Esateta u‐Petrosi amazwi la, umoya oyingcwele wawela bonke ababesiva ilizwi.
Baza bamangaliswa abo bakulo ulwaluko abakoliweyo, bonke abebezile no‐Petrosi, ukuba isipiwo somoya oyingcwele sigalelwe napezu kwabaheyideni.
Ngokuba bebebeva beteta nge zinye inteto, bezukisa utixo.
Wandula wapendula u‐Petrosi, wati: Kuko ongala amanzi na, ukuze aba bangabapitizeshwa, abamamkeleyo umoya oyingcwele njengokuba simamkele nati?
Waza wayalela ukuba babapitizeshwe egameni lenkosi. Bandula bamtandaza ukuba makalibale kona imihla etile.
Kekaloku abapostile, nabazalwana abebese‐Judeya, beva ukuba nabaheyideni bebelamkele ilizwi likatixo.
Baza bati, xeshekweni u‐Petrosi ebenyukele e‐Yerusaleme, abo bakulo ulwaluko bapika naye,
besiti: Wabungena kumadoda angalukanga, watya ndawonye nawo.
Kodwa waqala u‐Petrosi wabaca̔zela indawo ngendawo, esiti:
Ndibe ndisesixekweni se‐Jopa nditandaza; ndaza ndabona ndikulo ipupaṙa umboniso, impahla etile njengeqiya enkulu isihla, ihliswa ezulwini ngamancam omane, yada yafika kwa kum;
endati ndakubeka amehlo pezu kwayo ndagqala, ndabona izilo zomhlaba ezinyawo zine, namar̔amncwa, nento ezinambuzelayo, nentaka zezulu.
Ndaza ndeva ilizwi lisiti kum: Suka, Petrosi! xe̔la utye.
Kodwa ndati: Nakanye, Nkosi! ngokuba kungazanga kungene emlonyeni wam nanye into engengcwele nenco̔lileyo.
Koko kwandipendula ilizwi ngokwesibini livela ezulwini, lisiti: Oko akuhlanzileyo utixo, ungakwenzi okungengcwele wena.
Oku ke kwenziwa katatu: zaza zonke ezonto zabuya zanyuselwa ezulwini.
Kwasuka, bona ke, kwa oko kwema amadoda amatatu pambi kwendlu endandikuyo, esusiwe e‐Kesareya ukuza kum.
Waza umoya wandixelela ukuba ndiye nawo, ndingatandabuzi nto. Kanjako bandipeleka nabazalwana aba abatandatu, saza sangena endlwini yendoda leyo;
eyasishumayeza okokuba ibibonile ingelosi endlwini yayo, eyema yati kuyo: Tuma amadoda e‐Jopa, umeme u‐Simone obizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Petrosi;
oya kukutyela amazwi, oya kusindiswa ngawo wena, nayo yonke indlu yako.
Kekaloku ndakuqala ukuteta, umoya oyingcwele wabawela, njengokuba wabesiw ela nati ekuqaleni.
Ndaza ndakumbula ilizwi lenkosi, lokokuba yabisiti: u‐Johane okunene wabapitizesha ngamanzi; kodwa nina nobapitizeshwa ngomoya oyingcwele.
Ukuba ngoko utixo wanika kubo isipo esilingana neso wasinika nakuti, bakukolwa kwinkosi u‐Yesu Kristu, bendingubanina pofu mna, ukuba ndibe nako ukumalela utixo?
Bati bakuva ezizinto bayeka, badumisa utixo, besiti: Kwa nje ke nakubo abaheyideni utixo ulunikile uguquko bube bubomi.
KEKALOKU abo ke ababetiwe sa ngayo imbandezelo eyabako pezu kwo‐Stefane, bahambela kwa se‐Fenisi, nase‐Kiperusi, nase‐Antiyoki, beteta ilizwi kuma‐Juda odwa kupela.
Baye inxenye kubo bengamadoda ase‐Kiperusi nawase‐Kirene, abati bakufika e‐Antiyoki, bateta kuba‐Girike, beshumayela inkosi u‐Yesu.
Saye sinabo isandla senkosi; laza inani elikulu lakolwa, laguqukela enkosini.
Kwaye kuvakala indaba ezindlebeni zeṙemente ebise‐Yerusaleme ngazo ezizinto: baza basusa u‐Banabasi ukuya kuhambela kwa se‐Antiyoki:
owati efikile nje, nofefe lukatixo elubonile, wavuya, wabayala bonke ukuba mabati ngemvume yentliziyo banamatele kwinkosi.
Ngokuba ebeyindoda elungileyo, ezele ngumoya oyingcwele nalukolo. Saza isihlwele esikulu songezelelwa kwinkosi.
Waza u‐Banabasi wemkela e‐Tarese ukuya kufuna u‐Saulusi;
owati akuba emfumene, wamzisa e‐Antiyoki. Kwaza kwati, bahlanganisana neṙemente umnyaka upela, bafundisa isihlwele esikulu: kanjako abadisipile baqala e‐Antiyoki ukubizwa ngegama laba‐Kristu.
Kwezintsuku ke kwehla abaprofite e‐Yerusaleme beza e‐Antiyoki.
Waza wesuka omnye kubo, ogama lalingu‐Agabusi, waqondisa ngomoya ukuba indlala enkulu iza kubako kulo lonke ilizwe; eyehlayo kanjalo emihleni ka‐Kilodiyusi Kesare.
Baza bati abadi sipile, njengokuba umntu ebenamandla, bazimisela abanye ngabanye ukuba batume usizo kubazalwana ababehlala e‐Judeya:
abati oko kanjalo bakwenza, belutumile kubadala ngesandla so‐Banabasi no‐Saulusi.
Kekaloku ngalo eloxesha u‐Herodi ukumkani wabeka izandla pezu kwabatile baseṙementeni ukubapata kakubi.
Waza wabulala u‐Yakobi umkuluwe ka‐Johane ngesiṙele.
Wati akubona ukuba oko kwakolisa ama‐Juda, walekela ukumbamba no‐Petrosi. (Ibiyimihla yezonka ezingenagwele leyo.)
Wati kanjalo akuba embambile, wamfaka entolongweni, wamnikela kwamaqelana amane amasodati amane ukuba amlinde, efuna ukuti emveni kwepasika amr̔olele ebantwini.
Kwa njalo ke u‐Petrosi ebegcinwa entolongweni: kodwa utandazo olwomeleleyo belumenzelwa yiṙemente kutixo.

Kekaloku xeshekweni u‐Herodi ebeza kumvelisa, kwa ngobobusuku u‐Petrosi ebelele ubutongo pakati kwamasodati amabini, enxityelelwe ngemixokelelwane emibini; nabalindi pambi kwocango bebegcina intolongo.
Yaza, bona ke, ingelosi yenkosi yema ngaku ye, nenkanyiso yakanya entolongweni. Yati yona yabambata icala lika‐Petrosi, yamvusa, isiti: Suka ngobunxamo. Yaza imixokelelwane yake yawa ezandleni zake.
Yati kanjalo ingelosi kuye: Binqa, ufake izihlangu zako. Wenje njalo ke. Yaza yati kuye: Yiti tyu ingubo yako, undilandele.
Wapuma ke, wayilandela; kanti ebengazi ukuba yinyaniso into eyenziwayo yingelosi, kodwa ebeba uyabona umboniso.

Bati bakuba bedlulile elokuqala iqela labalindi nelesibini, beza esangweni lentsimbi, elisingela esixekweni, elati lavuleka kubo ngokwalo: baza bapuma, bacanda isitarate sasinye; yandula yaselisimka ingelosi kuye.
Waza u‐Petrosi akubuya waziqonda, wati: Kaloku ndiyazi ngenyaniso, ukuba inkosi yatuma ingelosi yayo, yandihlangula esandleni sika‐Herodi, na kuko konke ukukangela kwabantu bama‐Juda.
Waza wati akutelekelela, weza endlwini ka‐Mariya unina ka‐Johane, obebizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Maraki, apo abaninzi babe bebutene ndawonye kona betandaza.
Kekaloku akuba u‐Petrosi ebeqongqotile elucangweni lwesango, kweza isicakazana ukuza kupulapula, esigama lalingu‐Roda:
esati sakulazi ilizwi lika‐Petrosi, asavula isango ngenxa yovuyo, sangena ngokubaleka, satyela ukuba u‐Petrosi umi pambi kwesango.
Bati ke bona kuso: Uyageza. Koko sona sibe siqinisa ukutshoza ukuba kunjalo. Baza bati: Yingelosi yake.
Kodwa u‐Petrosi ebemana eqongqota: bati bakuvula, bambona, bamangaliswa ke.

Koko yena ebakobele ngesandla ukuba bati tu, wababalisela okokuba yati nina inkosi ukumku̔pa entolongweni. Waza wati: Shumayelani ezizinto ku‐Yakobi, nakubo abazalwana. Waza wemka, waya kwenye indawo.
Kekaloku kwakuba kusile, bekuko isipitipiti esingencinane pakati kwamasodati, sokuba u‐Petrosi uhlelwe yinto nina ke.
Wati u‐Herodi akuba ebemfunile, engamfumananga nje, wabuza abalindi, waxela ukuba bafiswe. Waza wehla e‐Judeya waya e‐Kesareya, wahlala kona.

Waye u‐Herodi ebejalile ngakuwo ama‐Tire nama‐Tsidone: kodwa eza kuye ngentliziyo nye; ati etomalalisile u‐Balastusi obepezu kwenkambili yokumkani, acela uxolo; ngenxa yokuba ilizwe lawo belizuza ukutya kwelokumkani.
Waza u‐Herodi ngemini emiselweyo, esambete isivato sobukumkani, wahlala pantsi esihlalweni esipakamileyo, wenza isiteto kuwo.
Bandula abantu bamemeza, besiti: Lilizwi lotixo, asi lelomntu.
Yaselimbeta kwa oko ingelosi yenkosi, ngenxa yokokuba akamnika utixo udumo: waza wadliwa zimpetu, wapuma umpefumlo.
Kodwa ilizwi likatixo lalikula, lalisandiswa.
Bati ke u‐Banabasi no‐Saulusi babuya e‐Yerusaleme, bakuba bebezalisekisile ukonzo lwabo, batabata nabo no‐Johane, owabizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Maraki.

KWAYE kube kuko abatile e‐Antiyoki, eṙementeni yakona, abaprofite nabafundisi; kwa u‐Banabasi, no‐Simone, obebizwa ngo‐Nigere, no‐Lukusi wase‐Kirene, no‐Manahene, obesondliwa ndawonye no‐Herodi inkosi, no‐Saulusi.
Kekaloku nxa bebesenza isikonzo kwinkosi, bezila ukutya kanjalo, wati umoya oyingcwele: Ndahluleleni ke u‐Banabasi no‐Saulusi kulomsebenzi endibabizeleyo kuwo.
Bandula bati, bakuba bezilile ukutya, betandazile nokutandaza, bebekile izandla pezu kwabo babandulula.
Aba ke ngoko, betunyiwe ngumoya oyingcwele, behlela e‐Selusiya, besuka kona baselishela e‐Kiperusi.
Bati bakuba bebefikile e‐Salamise, bashumayela ilizwi likatixo ezindlwini zentlanganiso zama‐Juda: babe kanjalo beno‐Johane engumkonzi.
Baza becandile isiqiti kwada kwase‐Pafosi, bafumana isanuse esitile, umprofite obuxoki, um‐Juda, ogama lalingu‐Bara‐yesu,
esibe sinaye umgwebi welozwe, u‐Seregiyo Paulusi, umntu osisazi: yena lo ebabizile u‐Banabasi no‐Saulusi, wanxamela ukuva ilizwi likatixo:
kodwa u‐Elimasi, isanuse, (ngokuba linjalo igama lake ngokukunyushwa,) wamelana nabo, efuna ukumpambukisa umgwebi elukolweni.
Waza u‐Saulusi, (o bizwa nango‐Paulusi,) ezalisiwe ngumoya oyingcwele, wabeka amehlo pezu kwake,
wati: Wena uzele yiyo yonke inkohliso nabubo bonke ubunginingini, mntwana ka‐Satane, lutshaba lwabo bonke ubulungisa! akuyi kupeza na ukupambukisa indlela ezilungileyo zenkosi?

Nakaloku, bona ke, isandla senkosi sipezu kwako, wauya kuba yimfama, ungaboni ilanga kube mzuzu. Kwasekusiwa pezu kwake kwa oko ubunkungu nobumnyama; waza efumfutisela wafuna abantu bokumtundeza ngesandla.
Wandula umgwebi akubona oko kwenzekileyo wakolwa, emangaliswa pezu kwofundiso lwenkosi.
Kekaloku nxa o‐Paulusi bandulukayo e‐Pafosi, beza e‐Perega yase‐Pamfiliya. Waza u‐Johane wemka kubo, wabuyela e‐Yerusaleme.
Kodwa bona besukile e‐Perega bacanda ilizwe, bafika e‐Antiyoki yase‐Pisidiya, bangena endlwini yentlanganiso ngomhla wesabata, bahlala pantsi.
Bati ke emveni kwokuleseshwa kwomteto nabaprofite abapati bendlu yentlanganiso batuma kubo, besiti: Madoda, bazalwana! ukuba ninalo ilizwi lokuyala ukuliteta ebantwini, tetani.
Wasuka wema u‐Paulusi, wakoba ngesandla, wati: Madoda, bo‐Sirayeli, nani boyikayo utixo! pulapulani.
Utixo wababantu o‐Sirayeli wabaqasha obawo betu; nabantu abo wabapakamisa bakuhlala njengabasemzini ezweni le‐Jipete, wabaku̔pa kulo ngengalo epakamileyo.
Wati ixesha langa layiminyaka emashumi mane wanyamezela imikwa yabo entlango.
Waza ezici̔tile intlanga ezisixe̔nxe ezweni le‐Kanane, wababela umhlaba wazo ngeqashiso.
Nasemveni kwoku wa ba nika abagwebi iminyaka yanga yamakulu mane anamashumi mahlanu, kwada kwako u‐Samyali umprofite.
Bati kamva bacela ukumkani; waza utixo wabanika u‐Saule unyana ka‐Kishe, indoda yakwisizwe sika‐Benjamine, iminyaka yamashumi mane.
Waza emshenxisile yena, wabavusela u‐Davide abe ngukumkani; owamnqi̔nelayo kanjalo, wati: Ndimfumene u‐Davide unyana ka‐Jese, indoda njengokweyam intliziyo, oya kukwenza konke ukutanda kwam.
Kwinzalo yaló utixo njengokwesibambiso wavusela o‐Sirayeli umsindisi, u‐Yesu;
akuba u‐Johane ebeshumayele pambili ubapitizesho lwoguquko kubo bonke abantu bakwa‐Sirayeli, engekafiki yena.
Naxeshekweni u‐Johane ebegqibela uhambo lwake, wayesiti: Nizindla ukuba ndingubanina? andinguye; koko, bona ke, kusiza emva kwam ozihlangu zenyawo ndingafanele mna ukuzitukulula.
Madoda, bazalwana, lusapo lwesizalwane sika‐Abrahame, nabo pakati kwenu abamoyikayo utixo! litunyiwe kuni ilizwi losindiso olu.
Ngokuba abo bemiyo e‐Yerusaleme, nabapati babo, bengamazanga yena lowo, nawo amazwi abaprofite, aleseshwayo ngesabata zonke, ba wa zalisekisile ngoku m gweba.
Kanjako bakuba bengafumananga tyala elibang’ ukufa, bacela ku‐Pilati ukuba makabulawe.
Naxeshekweni babefezile zonke izinto eziba̔liweyo ngaye, ba m tula emtini, bambeka encw̔abeni.
Kodwa utixo wamvusa ekufeni;
owabonakala ngemihla emininzi kwabo babenyukile naye e‐Galili nkuza e‐Yerusaleme, abangamanqi̔na ake ebantwini.
Natitina siyanishumayeza isibambiso esenzelwa obawo betu,
okokuba esi utixo usizalisekisile kuti lusapo lwabo, emvusile nje u‐Yesu; njengokuba kanjalo kuba̔liwe eculweni lesibini ukuti: Ungunyana wam wena, ndikuzele namhla nje.
Nokokuba wamvusa ekufeni, angabi saya kubuyela ekuboleni, utshilo ukuti: Ndiya kunipa izibele zika‐Davide eziqinisekileyo.
Utingoko nakwelinye iculo: Akuyi kuyekelela oyingcwele yako abone ukubola.
Ngokuba ke u‐Davide, akuba ebekonzile isizukulwana sake ngemvume katixo, walala ubutongo, wabekelwa koyise bake, wabona ukubola:
kodwa lowo utixo wamvusayo, akabona kubola.
Makwazeke kuni ngoko, madoda, bazalwana! ukuba ngaye lo kuyashunyayelwa kuni ukuxolelwa kwezono:
nokuba ngaye lo osukuba ekolwa uyakululwa kuzo zonke izinto, enibe nikohliwe kukukululwa kuzo ngomteto ka‐Mosesi.
Lumkani ngoko, kuze kunganihleli oko kutetiweyo ebaprofiteni ukuti:
Kangelani, nina badeli! niti nqa, niti shwaqe; ngokuba umsebenzi ndiwusebenza emihleni yenu, umsebenzi eningasayi kukolwa nguwo, nakuba umntu ewushumayela kuni.
Kekaloku akuba ama‐Juda ebepuma endlwini yentlanganiso, babebongoza abaheyideni ukuba lamazwi atetwe kubo ngesabata yasemva.
Kwati kwakuba kundulukile intlanganiso, abaninzi bama‐Juda nababangene ebujudeni ababedeshayo balandela u‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi; abati beteta kubo, babacenga ukuba bamane ukuma elufefeni lukatixo.
Kekaloku ngesabata elandelayo, saza kuba sonke isixeko sihlanganisene ukuva ilizwi likatixo.
Kodwa ama‐Juda akuzibona izihlwele, azaliswa luzondo, apika ezonto zibe zitetwa ngu‐Paulusi, epika, egxeka nokugxeka.

Baza bakalipa u‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi, bati: Bekufanelekile ukuba ilizwi likatixo litetwe kuni ukuqala: kodwa ekubeni nililahlayo, nizigweba nje ukuba anifanele ubomi obungunapakade, bona ke, siyajikela kubaheyideni:
ngokuba inkosi isiyalele ngokunjalo, isiti: Ndikubekele ukuba lukanyiso lwabaheyideni, ukuze ube ngowosindiso kude kube sekupeleni kwomhlaba.
Bati abaheyideni besiva ezizinto bavuya, badumisa ilizwi lenkosi: baza bakolwa bonke ababe bemiselwe ubomi obungunapakade.
Laye ilizwi lenkosi libe lihanjiswa kulo lonke elozwe.
Kodwa ama‐Juda atelekisa amankazana abedeshayo nadumileyo n amadoda amakulu asesixekweni, avusa intshutshiso ngaku‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi, abagxota emideni yawo.
Koko bavutululayo utuli lwenyawo zabo ngakuwo, beza e‐Koniyume.
Baye abadisipile bezaliswa luvuyo na ngumoya oyingcwele.
KWAYE kute e‐Koniyume, bangena kunye endlwini yentlanganiso yama‐Juda, benje njalo ukuteta, ukuba kwakolwa umhlambi omkulu nowama‐Juda nowama‐Girike.
Kodwa ama‐Juda abengakolwa avuselela abaheyideni, acapukisa imipefumlo yabo ngakubo abazalwana.
Kwa njalo ke bahlala kona ixesha elikulu, beteta ngokukalipa enkosini, ebinqi̔nela ilizwi lofefe lwayo, yanika ukuba imiqondiso nemimangaliso yenziwe ngezandla zabo.
Kodwa umhlambi wesixeko wahluleka: baye ke inxenye bengecala lama‐Juda, nenxenye ngecala labapostile.
Naxeshekweni kwesuka imvukelo yabaheyideni nama‐Juda kunye, ndawonye nabagwebi babo, ukubapata kakubi nokubagibisela ngamatye,
bati bakutelekelela, besabela e‐Lisitira nase‐Derebe, izixeko zase‐Likayoniya, nasezweni langakona;
baye belapo beshumayela ivangeli.
Kekaloku indoda etile e‐Lisitira ebingenamandla ezinyaweni zayo yabihleli, ebisisiqwala kwa sesizalweni sonina, ebingazanga ihambe:
yona le yabisiva u‐Paulusi eteta; owabeka amehlo pezu kwayo, waza akubona ukuba inokolo lwokupiliswa,
wati ngelizwi elikulu: Suka ume ngenyawo zako upakamile. Yaza yatsiba yahamba.
Zati izihlwele zakubona oko abekwenzile u‐Paulusi, zapakamisa ilizwi lazo, zisiti ngokwama‐Likayoniya: Otixo bahlikele kuti befana nabantu.
Zaye zibiza ke u‐Banabasi ngo‐Jupitere; no‐Paulusi ngo‐Merekuri, ngokokuba yena ebenguye umteti omkulu.
Waza umperisite wo‐Jupitere, obepambi kwesixeko sazo, wazisa inkabi nezitsaba zentyatyambo emasangweni, wafuna ukwenza idini kunye nabantu.
Kodwa abapostile, u‐Banabasi no‐Paulusi, bakuva oko, baṙazula izivato zabo, babalekela pakati kwesihlwele, bedanduluka,

besiti nokuti: Madoda! yinina ukuba nenze ezizinto? nati singabantu abamilo ifana neyenu, sishumayela kuni ukuba maniguquke kwezizinto ezingendawo niguqukele kuye utixo ohleliyo, owenza izulu, nomhlaba, nolwandle, nento zonke ezikuzo:
owati emaxesheni agqitileyo wayeka intlanga zonke zihambe ngezazo indlela.
Kanti ke noko akazishiya engenakunqi̔nelwa, esenza okulungileyo, esinika imvula ivela ezulwini namaxesha acu̔mileyo, ezalisa intliziyo zetu ngokutya nangovuyo.
Bati nangokutsho cebetshu bakohlwa ukuyekisa izihlwele, ukuba zingabenzeli idini.
Kwaza kwafika ama‐Juda evela e‐Antiyoki nase‐Koniyume, azihenda izihlwele, amgibisela u‐Paulusi ngamatye, amr̔ola ngapandle kwesixeko, esiba ufile.
Kodwa nxa abadisipile babemngqongile, wesuka, wangena esixekweni. Waza ngomnye umhla wapuma no‐Banabasi waya e‐Derebe.
Bati bakuba beshumayele ivangeli kwesosixeko, bebenzile abadisipile abaninzi kanjalo, babuyela e‐Lisitira, nase‐Koniyume, nase‐Antiyoki:
besomeleza imipefumlo yabadisipile, bebayala ukuba bahlale elukolweni, — nokuba kungazo imbandezelo ezininzi esifanele ukungena ebukumkanini bukatixo.
Kekaloku bebabalulele abadala iṙemente ngeṙemente, betandazile kunye nokuzila ukutya, bababekela enkosini abebekoliwe kuyo.
Bati bakuba bebecandile i‐Pisidiya, beza e‐Pamfiliya:
baza betetile ilizwi e‐Perega, behlela e‐Ataliya:
baza besuka kona baselishela e‐Antiyoki, apo abebenikelwe elufefeni lukatixo kona ngenxa yomsebenzi ababewufezile.
Bati bakufika, behlanganisile iṙemente, baxela konke abekwenzile ngabo utixo, nokokuba ebevulele abaheyideni ucango lwokolo.
Baza bahlala kona ixesha elingencinane ndawonye nabadisipile.
KEKALOKU abatile abebehlile e‐Judeya, bebefundisa abazalwana, besiti: Ukuba analuki ngesiko lika‐Mosesi, aningesindiswe.

Ngako xeshekweni u‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi babenongxolisano nopikisano olungencinane nabo, bamisela ukuba u‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi, nabanye abatile bakubo, banyukele e‐Yerusaleme kubo abapostile nabadala pezu kwalombuzo.
Bandula bona, bepelekelelwe yiṙemente, bacanda i‐Fenisi ne‐Samariya, beshumayela ukuguquka kwabaheyideni: baye besenzela bonke abazalwana uvuyo olukulu.
Bati bakufika e‐Yerusaleme, bamkelwa ngembuko yiṙemente nabapostile nabadala, baxela konke abekwenzile ngabo utixo.
Kodwa kwesuka kwema abatile bakulo uhlobo lwabafarisi abakoliweyo, besiti: Kufanele ukuba baluke, nokuba bayalezelwe ukugcina umteto ka‐Mosesi.
Baza bahlanganisana abapostile nabadala ukuba baqonde lendawo.

Kekaloku lwakubako upikisano olukulu, wesuka u‐Petrosi, wati kubo: Madoda, bazalwana! niyazi kakulu nina ukuba kuse kukade wa ndi nyulayo utixo pakati kwetu, ukuba abaheyideni beve ngomlomo wam ilizwi levangeli, bakolwe.
Kanjako utixo ozaziyo intliziyo wabanqi̔nela, enikile kubo umoya oyingcwele, njengokuba ebemnikile nakuti;
engenzanga kwahluka pakati kwetu nabo, ehlambulule intliziyo zabo ngokolo.
Ngako kaloku yinina ukuba nimlinge utixo, ngokubeka iyokwe pezu kwentamo yabadisipile, abangabanga namandla kwa nobawo nati ukuyitwala?
Koko kungalo ufefe lwenkosi u‐Yesu Kristu esikolwa ukuba siya kusindiswa, kwa ngendawo a baya kusindiswa ngayo bona nabo.
Waza wonke umhlambi wati cwaka, wapulapula ku‐Banabasi naku‐Paulusi, betyela leyo imiqondiso nemimangaliso emikulu abeyenzile utixo pakati kwabaheyideni ngabo.
Nasemveni kwokuba bebete cwaka bona, wapendula u‐Yakobi, esiti: Madoda, bazalwana! ndipulapuleni.
U‐Simone utyele indawo waqala ngayo utixo ukutyelela kubaheyideni, ukuba atabatele igama lake abantu kubo.
Kanjako ayalungelelana noku amazwi abaprofite; njengokuba kuba̔liwe ukuti:
Emveni kwoku ndiya kubuya, ndandiya kubuya ndilake ipempe lika‐Davide eliwileyo; nengci̔takalo zalo ndobuya ndizake, ndilimise kanjako:
ukuze isisalela sabantu sibe sifuna inkosi, nabo bonke abaheyideni ekubizwe pezu kwabo igama lam, utsho uyehova okwenzayo oku konke.
Yaziwa ngutixo yonke imisebenzi yake kwa sekuqalekeni kwexesha.
Nditi ngoko ukugweba kwam, masingabakatazi abo bakubo abaheyideni abaguqukela kutixo;
masiba̔le kubo ukuba bazile izinto ezinco̔lisekileyo zezitixo, nombulo, nokuṙwishiweyo, negazi.
Ngokuba u‐Mosesi kutabata emaxesheni akudala enabo kuzo zonke izixeko abamshumayelayo, eleseshwa ezindlwini zentlanganiso ngesabata zonke.

Kwandula kwanga kulungile kubapostile, nakubadala, kunye nayo yonke iṙemente, ukunyula amadoda kwababo, bawatume e‐Antiyoki kunye no‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi; kwa u‐Jude, obebizwa ngelinye igama elingu‐Barasaba, no‐Silasi, amadoda amakulu pakati kwabazalwana;
beba̔lile ngabo ezizinto zokuti: Abapostile, nabadala, nabazalwana, kubo abazalwana abangabakubo abaheyideni abase‐Antiyoki, nase‐Siriya, nase‐Silisiya, bebulisa.
Ngokokuba sivile ukuba abatile abapuma kuti banipitizelisa ngamazwi, bexalisa imipefumlo yenu, besiti nifanele ukwaluka nokugcina umteto, esibe singabanikanga umyalezo wokutsho:
kwanga kulungile kuti, sihlangene nje ngentliziyo nye, ukunyula amadoda atile, siwatume kuni, kunye nabatandwa betu u‐Banabasi no‐Paulusi,
abantu abancamileyo ubomi babo ngenxa yegama lenkosi yetu u‐Yesu Kristu.
Sibatumile ngoko u‐Jude no‐Silasi, abaya kuti bona ngokwabo ba ni tyele kwa ezizinto ngomlomo.
Ngokuba kube kunga kulungile kumoya oyingcwele nakuti, ukuba singabeki pezu kwenu namnye umtwalo omkulu kwezizinto ezifanelekileyo:
Zokuba nizile izinto ezibingelwe izitixo, negazi, nokuṙwishiweyo, nombulo: eniya kuti nizigcina ningazenzi nilungise. Hlalani kakuhle.
Bandula bona bakuba bendululwe beza e‐Antiyoki: baza bewuhlanganisile umhlambi, banikela incwadi;
a bati baku yi lesesha, bavuya ngenxa yonwabiso.
Baza u‐Jude no‐Silasi, bengabaprofite bona nabo, bayala abazalwana ngokuteta okuninzi, babomeleza.
Bati bakuba bebenzile umzuzu, bandululwa ngoxolo kubazalwana ukuya kubapostile.
Kodwa kwanga kulungile ku‐Silasi ukuba alibale kona.
Kanjalo u‐Paulusi no‐Banabasi bebehlala e‐Antiyoki, befundisa beshumayela nokushumayela ilizwi lenkosi, ndawonye nabo nabanye abaninzi.
KEKALOKU emveni kwemihla etile wati u‐Paulusi ku‐Banabasi: Makesibuye siye sityelele kubazalwana betu kuzo zonke izixeko, apo silishumayele kona ilizwi lenkosi, sibone ukuba banjanina.
Waza u‐Banabasi wanxamela ukutabata nabo u‐Johane obebizwa ngo‐Maraki.
Kodwa u‐Paulusi ebeba akufanelekile ukumtabata nabo yena lo, owesuka kubo e‐Pamfiliya, engayanga nabo emsebenzini.
Kwabako ngoko ubambano olubukali, bada bahlukana omnye nomnye, wati u‐Banabasi wamtabata u‐Maraki, waselishela e‐Kiperusi.
Kodwa u‐Paulusi waqasha u‐Silasi, wemka, enikelwe elufefeni lukatixo ngabazalwana.
Waza wacanda i‐Siriya ne‐Silisiya, ezomeleza iṙemente.
Waza wafika e‐Derebe nase‐Lisitira: kekaloku bona ke, umdisipile otile ebekona, ogama lingu‐Timote, unyana womfazi otile obengum‐Judakazi okoliweyo, nowoyise obengum‐Girike;
obenqi̔nelwa kakuhle ngabazalwana abebese‐Lisitira nase‐Koniyume.
Yena lo u‐Paulusi watanda ukuba apume aye naye; waza wamtabata wamalusa, ngenxa yama‐Juda abekuzo ezondawo; ngokuba onke ebemazi uyise ukuba ungum‐Girike.
Bati ke nxa bebezicanda izixeko, babanikela imiteto ebekugwetyiwe ngayo ngabapostile nabadala abebese‐Yerusaleme, ukuba bayibambe.
Kwa nje ke iṙemente zibe ziqiniswa elukolweni, zamana zisanda inani lazo imihla ngemihla.
Kekaloku bakuba bebecandile i‐Firijiya nelizwe le‐Galati, besalelwa ngumoya oyingcwele ukuteta ilizwi e‐Asiya,
bati bakufika e‐Misiya, balinga ukuya e‐Bitiniya; kanti umoya akabavumela.
Baza bedlula e‐Misiya behla beza e‐Tirowa.
Kwaza kwabonakala umboniso ku‐Paulusi ebusuku: Kwaye kumi indoda etile yase‐Masedoniya, imbongoza, isiti nokuti: Wela uze e‐Masedoniya, usisize.
Xeshekweni ke abebonile umboniso lowo, sati kwa oko safuna ukumka siye e‐Masedoniya, siqonda ngawo ukuba inkosi isibizele ukushumayela ivangeli kubo.
Ngako sindulukile nje e‐Tirowa, sati ngqo ukuselishela e‐Samotirase, na ngomhla olandelayo e‐Neyapolise.
Saza sisuka kona saya e‐Filipi, esisixeko esikulu sesosahlulo sase‐Masedoniya, siyikoloni. Saye sibe sihlala kwesisixeko imihla etile:
sati ke ngomhla wesabata sapuma saya pandle kwesixeko ngasemlanjeni, apo bekulisiko ukuba kutandazwe kona; saza sahlala pantsi, sateta kuwo amankazana abebutene ndawonye.

Kwaye kusiva inkazana etile egama lingu‐Lidiya, umtengisikazi w ezivato ezibomvu wasesixekweni se‐Tiyatira, ebibedesha utixo; entliziyo yayivulayo inkosi, ukuba inyamekele izinto ezibe zitetwa ngu‐Paulusi.
Yati yona yakuba ibapitizeshiwe, nendlu yayo, yasibongoza, isiti: Ukuba nigwebile ukuti ndinyanisekile kwinkosi, ngenani endlwini yam, nihlale kona. Yaza yasiqu̔ba.
Kwaye kute, nxa sibe sisiya endaweni yokutandaza, isicakazana esitile sinomoya wokulaula sasikaulela, esasisenzela inkosi zaso inzuzo enkulu ngokulaula.
Sona salandela u‐Paulusi nati, sadanduluka, sisiti: Ababantu bazizicaka zikatixo opezu konke, ezisishumayezayo indlela yosindiso.
Oku ke sasikwenza imihla yamininzi. Kodwa u‐Paulusi, ebindekile nje, wajika wati kumoya lowo: Ndiyakuyalela egameni lika‐Yesu Kristu ukuba upume kuso. Waza wapuma kwa ngeloxeshana.
Kekaloku inkosi zaso zakubona ukuba itemba lenzuzo yazo limkile, zabamba u‐Paulusi no‐Silasi, zabar̔olela endaweni yentengo pambi kwabapati.
Zaza zibangenisile emagoseni zati: Ababantu bayakataza isixeko setu kakulu, bengama‐Juda nje;
abati bashumayele amasiko ekungavunyelwa tina ukuba siwamkele nokuba siwenze, singama‐Roma nje.
Saza isihlwele sabasukela kunye; ati amagosa ebahlutile ingubo ngokuṙazula, axela ukuba mababetwe ngentonga.
Baza bakuba bebenzele imivimbo emininzi ba ba posela entolongweni, bayalela umlindi wentolongo ukuba abagcine ngokuqinisekileyo:
owati esamkele isiyalelo esinjalo, wabaposela entolongweni yapakati, waqinisa inyawo zabo emtini.
Kekaloku pakati kwobusuku u‐Paulusi no‐Silasi bebetandaza, bavuma amaculo kutixo: baye ke ababanjwa bebapulapula.
Kwaza kwabako ngokwalama isingcangcazelo somhlaba esikulu, yada yazanyazanyiswa imisekelo yentolongo: zasuka zavuleka ingcango kwa oko zonke, nezinxibo zabo bonke zatukululeka.
Wati umlindi wentolongo evukile ebutongweni bake, ebona ukuba ingcango zentolongo zivulekile, war̔ola isiṙele, waza kuzibulala, eba ababanjwa besabile.
Kodwa u‐Paulusi wamemeza ngelizwi elikulu, esiti: Ungazenzakalisi; ngokuba silapa kwa sonke.
Waza wabiza isibane, watsibela pakati, waba engcangcazela, wawa pantsi pambi kwo‐Paulusi no‐Silasi,
wabakokela ngapandle, wati: Zinkosi! ndifanele ukwenza nto nina ukuze ndisindiswe?
Bati ke bona: Kolwa kuyo inkosi u‐Yesu Kristu, wauya kusindiswa wena nendlu yako.
Baza bateta kuye ilizwi lenkosi, nakubo bonke abebesendlwini yake.
Waza wabatabata naye ngelona ixeshana lobusuku, wahlanza imivimbo yabo, wabapitizeshwa yena nabo bonke abake kwa oko.
Wati kanjalo akuba ebanyusele endlwini yake, wababekela ukutya, wagcoba ukuba ekoliwe kutixo, kunye nayo yonke indlu yake.
Kekaloku kwakuba kusile, amagosa lawo atuma imisila, esiti: Bakulule abantu abo.
Waza umlindi wentolongo wamtyela u‐Paulusi lamazwi, wati: Amagosa atumile ukuti manikululwe; ngako kaloku pumani, nihambe ngoxolo.

Kodwa u‐Paulusi wati kuyo: Asityabula ekuhleni singagwetywanga, singabantu abangama‐Roma, asiposela entolongweni: kekaloku ngoku ayasiku̔pa ngasese na? hai kambe; makeze wona ngokwawo asikapele ngapandle.
Yati imisila yaxela lamazwi kumagosa: aza oyika akuva ukuba bangama‐Roma,
eza ababongoza, abakapela ngapandle, abatandaza ukuba mabemke esixekweni.
Bapuma ke entolongweni, baza bangena endlwini ka‐Lidiya: baza bakuba bebebonile abazalwana, babonwabisa, bemka.
KEKALOKU bakuba bebecandile i‐Amfipolisi ne‐Apoloniya, beza e‐Tesalonika, apo ibikona indlu yentlanganiso yama‐Juda.
Waza u‐Paulusi, njengokuba belinjalo isiko lake, wangena kuwo, wati ngesabata zantatu wateta nawo eziba̔lweni,
e z aneka, ebeka pambi kwawo ukuba u‐Kristu ebefanele ukuva intlungu nokuvuka ekufeni, nokuba lo unguye u‐Kristu, u‐Yesu enditi, watsho, ndimshumayele kuni.
Aza inxenye kuwo akolwa, adlelana no‐Paulusi no‐Silasi; kwa nomhlambi omkulu wama‐Girike abedeshayo, nenani lamankazana amakulu elingelincinane.

Kodwa ama‐Juda angakolwayo eba nozondo, atabatela kuwo amadoda atile azincwangu kumadungudwane asezinkundleni, enza imbutumbutu, apitizelisa isixeko, aṙaula indlu ka‐Yasone, afuna ukubaku̔pela ebantwini.
Ati ke engabafumananga, ar̔ola u‐Yasone nabazalwana abatile pambi kwabagwebi besixeko, ememeza ukuti: Aba, abalipitizileyo ilizwe, bafikile nalapa;
ate u‐Yasone ubamkele endlwini: kanjako aba bonke bayenza ngokumelana nemiteto ka‐Kesare, besiti kuko ukumkani wumbi, u‐Yesu.
Axalisa isihlwele ke, nabagwebi besixeko, besiva ezizinto.
Baza bakuba betabatile isibambiselo ku‐Yasone nakwabanye, babandulula.
Bati abazalwana kwa oko batuma u‐Paulusi no‐Silasi ebusuku ukuya e‐Bereya; abati bakufika, baya bangena endlwini yentlanganiso yama‐Juda.
Wona la ebegqitisile ngesimo sawo kwawase‐Tesalonika, ekubeni alamkelayo ilizwi ngako konke ukuvuma kwentliziyo, ezibenca iziba̔lo imihla ngemihla, ukuba ezizinto zinjalo kusinina.
Ngako ke abaninzi bakuwo bakolwa, nenani lamankazana adumileyo angama‐Girikekazi nelamadoda elingelincinane.
Kodwa ama‐Juda ase‐Tesalonika, xeshekweni abesazi ukuba ilizwi likatixo lashunyayelwa ngu‐Paulusi nase‐Bereya, eza nakona evuselela izihlwele.
Bandula abazalwana kwa oko bamsusa u‐Paulusi ukuya njengokuba kuyiwa elwandle; kodwa u‐Silasi no‐Timote basala kona.
Bati abo bamkapayo u‐Paulusi bamsa e‐Atenesi; baza besamkele isiyalezelo ku‐Silasi no‐Timote, sokuba beze kuye ngokukauleza kakulu, bemka.
Kekaloku nxa u‐Paulusi ebebalinda e‐Atenesi, umoya wake ubucapukiswa pakati kwake, ebona isixeko ukuba sizele zizitixo.
Ngako ke wabeteta endlwini yentlanganiso kuma‐Juda nakwababedeshayo, nasendaweni yentengo ngemihla yonke wabepikisana nabo bafumanana naye.

Baza abafilosofe abatile bakwaba‐Epikure nabakwa‐Stoyike bapika naye. Babesiti ke inxenye: Singafun’ ukuti nina isitetateti esi? kodwa babesiti abanye: Unga ungumshumayeli wotixo basemzini; ngokuba ebeshumayela kubo u‐Yesu novuko lwabafileyo.
Baza bamtabata nabo, bamsa kuyo indawo e‐kutiwa yi‐Aripago, besiti: Singaba sisazi na, lolwanina olufundiso olutsha olutetwa nguwe?
ngokuba uzingenisa ezindlebeni zetu izinto ezitile ezimangalisayo: singa singazi ngoko, zingafun’ ukuti nina ezizinto.
(Kekaloku bonke abase‐Atenesi, nabasemzini abebeṙanukele kona, bebedlulisa ixesha labo ngokuxela nangokupulapula indaba ezintsha kwapela.)
Waza u‐Paulusi wema pakati kwayo indawo e‐kutiwa yi‐Aripago, wati: Madoda ase‐Atenesi! nditi ngendawo zonke ndibone okokuba nigqitisile ngokuhlonela otixo.
Ngokuba ekudluleni, nasekugqaleni izibedeshelo zenu, ndafumana nesibingelo ebekuba̔liwe pezu kwaso ukuti: Kongaziwayo utixo. Oyena ngoko enimbedeshayo ninga m azi, lo ndiyamshumayela kuni.
Utixo owenza ilizwe nento zonke ezikulo, lo, eyinkosi yezulu nomhlaba nje, akahlali ezitempileni ezenziweyo ngezandla;
akakonzwa zizandla zabantu kanjako, njengokungati ebeswela into, enguye ngokwake obapa bonke ubomi, nompefumlo, nento zonke;
ote kanjalo wazenza ngegazi linye zonke intlanga zabantu, ukuba bahlale pezu kwobuso bonke bomhlaba, ebalule amaxesha amiselweyo pambili nemida yentlalo yabo;
ukuze bafune inkosi, ukuba ngaba bangati bayiputaputele bayifumane, nakuba ingekude kuti sonke;
ngokuba kukuyo sihleli, sishukuma, sibako, njengokuba nentlabeli ezitile zakowenu zitshilo ukuti: Ngokuba siyinzalo yake nati.
Ngako siyinzalo katixo nje, asifanele ukuti oku butixo kunjengegolide, nesilivere, nelitye, into eziqingqiweyo ngobuncibi nangeqinga labantu.
Lomaxesha okungazi ke utixo ewanyamezele nje, uti kaloku ayalele bonke abantu kuzo zonke indawo ukuba baguquke.
Ngokokuba emisile umhla, okungawo uya kugweba ilizwe ngobulungisa, ngendoda ayibaluleyo, ebenzele bonke isiqiniso ngokuyivusa kwabafileyo.
Kekaloku bakuva ngako ukuvuka kwabafileyo, abanye babehleka; kodwa abanye bati: Sobuya sikuve ngale ndawo.
Ngokunjalo ke wemka u‐Paulusi pakati kwabo.
Kodwa amadoda atile anamatela kuye, akolwa; ekwako pakati kwawo u‐Diyonisi um‐Aripago, nomfazi ogama lingu‐Damarise, nabanye kunye nabo.
EMVENI kwezizinto ke, wemka u‐Paulusi e‐Atenesi, weza e‐Korinte;

wafumana kona um‐Juda otile ogama lingu‐Akwila, owase‐Pontusi ngokuzalwa, esand’ ukuvela e‐Yitaliya, no‐Pirisila umfazi wake, (ngenxa yokuba bekuyalelwe ngu‐Kilodiyusi ukuba onke ama‐Juda emke e‐Roma,) waya kubo;
nangenxa yokuba ubuncibi bake bebunjengobabo, wahlala kubo, wasebenza: ngokuba bebengabenzi bentente ubuncibi babo.
Waza wapikisa endlwini yentlanganiso ngesabata zonke, weyisa ama‐Juda nama‐Girike.
Naxeshekweni u‐Silasi no‐Timote bebehlile e‐Masedoniya, u‐Paulusi ebenyanzelwa emoyeni wake, enqi̔nisela ama‐Juda ukuba u‐Yesu unguye u‐Kristu.
Kodwa eca̔sa wona, egxeka nokugxeka, wavutulula izivato zake, wati kuwo: Igazi lenu malibe pezu kwezenu intloko; ndimsulwa mna; ndoti emveni kwakaloku nje ndiye kubaheyideni.
Waza wesuka kona, waya wangena endlwini y omntu otile ogama lingu‐Yusitusi, obebedesha utixo, ondlu ibibandakanyene nendlu yentlanganiso.
Wati ke u‐Krisipo, umpati wendlu yentlanganiso, wakolwa kwinkosi kunye nayo yonke indlu yake; nabaninzi bakuwo ama‐Korinte besiva babekolwa, babapitizeshwa.
Yaza yati inkosi ku‐Paulusi ngomboniso ebusuku: Ungoyiki, uz’ utete, ungati cwaka:
ngokuba ndinawe mna, kwaye kungayi kuwelana nawe namnye ukuze akwenzakalise; ngokuba ndinabantu abaninzi kwesisixeko.
Wahlala kona ke umnyaka mnye unenyanga ezintandatu, efundisa pakati kwabo ilizwi likatixo.
Kekaloku nxa u‐Galiyone ebengumgwebi pezu kwe‐Akaiya, ati ama‐Juda ngentliziyo nye asukela ngaku‐Paulusi, amsa pambi kwesihlalo sokugweba,
esiti: Lo uyahenda abantu ukuba babedeshe utixo ngokungalungelene nomteto.
Esaza kuvula umlomo u‐Paulusi, wati u‐Galiyone kuma‐Juda: Ukuba kambe ibiyinto esisenzo esingalungileyo umhlaumbi esesobunginingini obukohlakeleyo, nina ma‐Juda! ngekufanelekile ukuba ndininyamezele;
kodwa ukuba ngumbuzo ngawo amazwi, nangamagama, nangomteto wakowenu, wukangeleni ngokwenu; ngokuba ndingafuni ukuba ngumgwebi wezizinto.
Waza wawagxota esihlalweni sokugweba.
Asuka onke ama‐Girike ambamba u‐Sositene, umpati wendlu yentlanganiso, ambeta ebusweni besihlalo sokugweba: kanti u‐Galiyone ebengakataleli nanye yezizinto.
KEKALOKU u‐Paulusi akuba ebesahleli kona imihla yamininzi, wabulisa abazalwana, waselishela e‐Siriya, benaye u‐Pirisila no‐Akwila, egugule intloko yake e‐Kenkriya; ngokuba ebesenzile isibambiso.
Waza wafika e‐Efese, wabashiya abo kona. Kodwa yena ngokwake wangena endlwini yentlanganiso, wateta kuma‐Juda.
Wati akutandazwa ngawo ukuba alibale ngakumbi kuwo, akavuma;
koko wawabulisayo, wati: Ndifanele kunene ukuba ndiwubambe umtendeleko ozayo e‐Yerusaleme; kodwa ndobuya ndize kuni, evuma utixo. Waza wanduluka e‐Efese.
Wati akuba ebefikele e‐Kesareya, wenyuka, wabulisa iṙemente, wehla waya e‐Antiyoki.
Waza elenzile ixesha elitile kona, wemka, ecanda ilizwe le‐Galati ne‐Firijiya indawo ngendawo, esomeleza bonke abadisipile.
KEKALOKU um‐Juda otile ogama lingu‐Apolosi, owase‐Aletsandriya ngokuzalwa, iciko lokuteta, obenamandla eziba̔lweni, wafika e‐Efese.
Yena lo wayefundisiwe indlela yenkosi; owabesiti ezondelele emoyeni, wateta wafundisa ngokuku̔tala izinto ezingayo inkosi, esazana nobapitizesho luka‐Johane lodwa.
Wati lo kanjalo waqala ukuteta ngokukalipa endlwini yentlanganise: abati bakuba bebemvile u‐Akwila no‐Pirisila, bamtabatela kubo, bamca̔zela indlela katixo ngokukolisekileyo ngakumbi.
Naxeshekweni ebefuna ukuhambela e‐Akaiya, abazalwana baba̔la kubadisipile bakona, ba ba yala ukuba mabamamkele ngembuko: owati akufika, wabanceda kakulu abo bakoliweyo ngalo ufefe:
ngokuba ebewanyela ama‐Juda ngamandla ekuhleni, ebonakalisa ngeziba̔lo ukuba u‐Yesu unguye u‐Kristu.
KWAYE kute nxa u‐Apolosi ebeko e‐Korinte, wati u‐Paulusi ecandile izahlulo zasentla, weza e‐Efese: waza efumene kona abadisipile abatile,
wati kubo: Namkela umoya oyingcwele nakukolwa kusinina? Bati bona kuye: Aseva nokuba umoya oyingcwele uko na.
Waza wati kubo: Nabapitizeshelwa kwinto nina pofu? Bati bona: Kulo ubapitizesho luka‐Johane.
Wati ke u‐Paulusi: u‐Johane okunene wabapitizesha ngobapitizesho lwoguquko, esiti ebantwini, mabakolwe kulowo ozayo emva kwake, oko kukuti, ku‐Yesu ongu‐Kristu.
Bati bakuva oku babapitizeshelwa egameni lenkosi u‐Yesu.
Waza akuba u‐Paulusi ebebekile pezu kwabo izandla zake, weza umoya oyingcwele pezu kwabo; baza bateta ng ezinye inteto, baprofitesha.
Abe ke amadoda lawo inani lonke engati alishumi linamabini.
Waza wangena endlwini yentlanganiso, wateta ngokukalipa, inyanga zazintatu, epikisa ecenga ngezinto ezingabo ubukumkani bukatixo.
Kodwa xeshekweni abatile baba lukuni, bengakolwa, beteta kakubi ngendlela leyo ebusweni bomhlambi, wemka kubo, wahlula abadisipile, epikisa imihla ngemihla esikolweni somntu ongu‐Tirano.
Kwaye kusenziwa oku iminyaka yamibini, bada bonke ababemi e‐Asiya beva ilizwi lenkosi u‐Yesu, kwa nama‐Juda nama‐Girike.
Kanjako izenzo zamandla ezingenziwa futi wabezenza utixo ngezandla zika‐Paulusi;
kwada kwasiwa kwabafayo iqiya nezikaka zivela emzimbeni wake, zaza izifo zesuka kubo, nomoya abakohlakeleyo bapuma kubo.

Bati kekaloku abatile bakuwo ama‐Juda azincibi zokufungisa ezihambahambayo, balinga ukubiza igama lenkosi u‐Yesu pezu kwabo babenomoya abakohlakeleyo, besiti: Siyanifungisa u‐Yesu, lowo u‐Paulusi amshumayelayo.
Kwabekuko abatile, onyana baka‐Sikeva, um‐Juda, umperisite omkulu, ababekwenza oku.
Kodwa wapendula umoya okohlakeleyo wati: u‐Yesu ndiyamazi, no‐Paulusi ndiyamazi kakulu; kodwa nina, ningobanina?
Waza umntu abekuye umoya okohlakeleyo watsibela pezu kwabo, wenza ngamandla kubo, waboyisa, bada besaba kuleyondlu bezé belinyaziwe.
Lento ke yazeka kubo bonke ababemi e‐Efese, nakuma‐Juda, nakuma‐Girike; kwaza kwawa ukwoyika pezu kwabo bonke, laye igama lenkosi u‐Yesu belizukiswa.
Kanjalo abaninzi babakoliweyo babesiza bevuma betyela izenzo zabo.
Bati nento eninzi yabo bazenza izenzo zokunyanga baqokelela incwadi zabo, bazitshisa ebusweni babo bonke: baza babala amanani azo, bafumana ukuba a ngamaqosha esilivere angamawaka amashumi mahlanu.
Bekunjalo lakulayo ilizwi lenkosi ngamandla, loyisa.
Xeshekweni ke bekugqityelwe ezizinto, wacinga u‐Paulusi emoyeni wake, ukuba woti, akuba ecandile i‐Masedoniya ne‐Akaiya, aye e‐Yerusaleme, esiti: Emveni kwokuba ndiye kona, ndifanele ukubona ne‐Roma.
Waza watuma e‐Masedoniya ababini bakubo ababemkonza, u‐Timote no‐Erastusi, walibala yena ngokwake umzuzu e‐Asiya.
Kodwa kwesuka ngeloxesha isipitipiti esingencinane ngayo indlela leyo.
Ngokuba umntu otile ogama lalingu‐Demetriyusi, umkandi wesilivere, obezenza itempilana zesilivere zo‐Diyana, wabezenzela incibi inzuzo engencinane;
owazibutela ndawonye, nabasebenzi bezinto ezinjalo, wati: Madoda! niyazi kakulu ukuba kungobuncibi obu esinabo ubutyebi betu.
Kanjako niyabona, niyeva nokuva, ukuba akukuyo i‐Efese yodwa, kuza kuba kuyo yonke i‐Asiya, u‐Paulusi lo upambukisile abantu abaninzi ngokucenga kwake, esiti abangotixo abo benzwayo ngezandla:

kuze kungabi kukuba lomsebenzi wetu usemgcipekweni ukuza kwaliwa kodwa, koko kanjalo itempile yotixokazi omkulu u‐Diyana isemgcipekweni ukubalwa ngokuba yinto enganto, buti nobukulu bake buze kuci̔twa, lowo yonke i‐Asiya nelizwe limbedeshayo.
Kekaloku bakuva oku baba bezele ngumsindo, badanduluka, besiti: Umkulu u‐Diyana wama‐Efese!
Saza isixeko sonke sazaliswa yimpitizelo; basuka bagalelekela endaweni yokubonela ngentliziyo nye, bebate ṙintyi u‐Gayusi no‐Aristariko, ama‐Masedoniya, abapeleki baka‐Paulusi ekuhambeni.
Naxeshekweni u‐Paulusi ebenga angangena ebantwini, abadisipile babengamvumeli.
Kanjalo nabatile bakubo abapati base‐Asiya, bengabahlobo bake, batuma kuye, bambongoza ukuba makangazilahleli endaweni yokubonela.
Kwa njalo ke abanye bebedanduluka ngento etile, nabanye ngento yimbi: ngokuba intlanganiso ibipitizele; baye abaninzi kubo bebengazi ukuba bebebutene ngenxa yanto nina.
Bati inxenye bampumisa u‐Aletsandere esihlweleni, emtya̔lela pambili ama‐Juda. Waza u‐Aletsandere wakoba ngesandla, wafuna ukuzitetelela ebantwini.
Kodwa bakunakana ukuba ungum‐Juda, kwesuka izwi nye kubo bonke, bedanduluka iyure zanga zambini, besiti: Umkulu u‐Diyana wama‐Efese!

Waza umba̔li wesixeko, akuba esitutuzele isihlwele, wati: Madoda ase‐Efese! nguwupina umntu pofu ongaziyo ukuba isixeko sama‐Efese singumbedeshi wotixokazi omkulu u‐Diyana, now omfanekiso owileyo ezulwini?
Ngako ezizinto zingenakukanyezwa nje, kufanelekile kuni ukuba niti tu, nokuba ningenzi luto ngokunxama kakulu.
Ngokuba niwazisile apa amadoda la, engengabo abapangi betempile, engengabo nabagxeki botixokazi wenu.
Ukuba ke ngoko u‐Demetriyusi, nencibi ezinaye, banendawo ngakuye umntu, kubanjwa imihla yamatyala, kuko nabagwebi; mabamemane.
Kodwa ukuba niyabuza into ngazo zimbi indawo, ziya kulungiswa entlanganisweni elungelene nomteto.
Ngokuba sinengozi yokokuba sonikwa ityala ngayo impitimpiti yanamhla, kungeko tuba nje esingati ngalo sipendulele lembutumbutu.
Waza etshilo oku wandulula intlanganiso.
KEKALOKU emveni kwokuba bekupelile isipitipiti eso, u‐Paulusi wabizela kuye abadisipile, wababulisa, wemka ukuya kuhambela e‐Masedoniya.
Wati ezicandile izahlulo ezo, ebayalile ngokuteta okuninzi kanjalo, weza e‐Girike.
Kwati akuba efezile inyanga ezintatu kona, enzelwe ingcebo ngama‐Juda nxa abehlalela ukuselishela e‐Siriya, kwavuka iqinga lokuba wobuya nge‐Masedoniya.
Kwaye kumpeleka kwada kwase‐Asiya u‐Sopatere wase‐Bereya; nakuma‐Tesalonika, u‐Aristariko no‐Sekondu; no‐Gayusi wase‐Derebe, no‐Timote; nabase‐Asiya, u‐Tikikusi no‐Trofimo.
Aba besandulela basilinda e‐Tirowa.
Saza tina saselisha e‐Filipi emveni kwemihla yezonka ezingenagwele, seza kubo e‐Tirowa ngentsuku zantlanu; apo sahlala kona intsuku zasixe̔nxe.
Kekaloku ngolwokuqala usuku lweveki, nxa abadisipile bebehlanganisene ukuqezula isonka, u‐Paulusi wateta kubo, ehlalela ukusuka ngomso; wabehambisa isiteto sake kwada kwapakati kwobusuku.
Kwaye kuko izibane ezininzi enkambilini yapezulu apo bebehlanganisene kona.
Yati indodana etile egama lingu‐Yutikusi ebihlala efenstileni, iwelwa butongo obukulu, nxa u‐Paulusi ebeteta kade, yatoba ngobutongo, yawa pantsi kweyesitatu indawo yapezulu, yacolwa ifile.
Kodwa ehlile u‐Paulusi, wawa pezu kwayo, wayibamba ngento engqongayo, wati: Ningenzi ingxolo; ngokuba umpefumlo wayo ukuyo.
Waza enyukile, eqezule isonka, etyile, encokolile kade kwada kwati qi̔p’ ukusa, wemka ngokunjalo ke.
Bati umfana bamzisa ehleli, bonwatyisiwe kakulu.
Kodwa tina sandulela saya enqanaweni, saselishela e‐Asosi, apo besifuna ukumtabata u‐Paulusi kona; ngokuba ebezimisele njalo, etanda ngokwake ukuhamba ngenyawo.
Naxeshekweni ebehlangene nati e‐Asosi, samtabata seza e‐Mitilene.
Saselisha kona ke, saza ng omhla olandelayo safikela malungana ne‐Kiyo, nangomnye umhla safika e‐Samo; sati silibele e‐Tirogiliyone, seza ng omhla olandelayo e‐Milito.
Ngokuba u‐Paulusi ebegwebile ukuselisha ngokudlula e‐Efese, ukuze angabi nakuci̔ta ixesha e‐Asiya; ngokuba ebenxama ukuti, ukuba bekusenzeka kuye, abeko e‐Yerusaleme ngomhla wepentekoste.
Wati kekaloku e‐Milito watuma e‐Efese, wabiza abadala beṙemente beze kuye.
Naxeshekweni babefikile kuye, wati kubo: Niyazi kakulu nina, kutabata kowokuqala umhla endafika ngawo e‐Asiya, ukuba ndati nina ukubako nani lonke eloxesha;
ndikonza inkosi ndinako konke ukutobeka kwentliziyo, nenyembezi ezininzi, namalingwa, lawo ndehlelwa ngawo ngengcebo zama‐Juda:
okokuba andibambanga mva nanye yezozinto ezilungele ukunceda, koko ndishumayele kuni, ndanifundisa, ekuhleni nangezindlu ngezindlu,
ndinqi̔nisa nakuma‐Juda nakuma‐Girike, uguquko olungakuye utixo, nokolo olungakuyo inkosi yetu u‐Yesu Kristu.
Nakaloku, bona ke, nditi ndibotshiwe emoyeni wam ndiye e‐Yerusaleme, ndingazi izinto eziya kundifikela kona;
ndisazi kupela ukuba umoya oyingcwele kuzo zonke izixeko uyanqi̔nisa, esiti izinxibo nembandezelo ziyandilinda.

Koko ndingakatali zezizinto nanye, kanjako andibali ubomi bam ngokuba bunqabile kum, ukuze ndifeze uhambo lwam ngovuyo, nobukonzi endabamkelayo kwinkosi u‐Yesu, ukuba ndinqi̔nise ivangeli yofefe lukatixo.
Nakaloku, bona ke, ndiyazi ukuba nina nonke, endahambayo pakati kwenu ndishumayela ubukumkani bukatiko, aniyi kubuya nibone ubuso bam.
Ngako ndiyaninqi̔nela kulemini yanamhla, ukuba ndimsulwa kulo igazi labo bonke:
ngokuba ndingabambanga mva nanto, ukuba ndibe ndinganishumayezanga lonke icebo likatixo.
Zilumkeleni ngoko, kwa nawo wonke umhlambi enimisiweyo abalindi kuwo ngumoya oyingcwele, ukuba niyaluse iṙemente katixo, ayizuzileyo ngelake igazi.
Ngokuba ndikwazi oku mna, ukuba kwoti emveni kwokumka kwam kungene incu̔ka ezinzima pakati kwenu, zingayeki umhlambi.
Nakuni ngokwenu kwovuka amadoda eteta izinto ezigwenxa, ukuze ar̔ole abadisipile baye emva kwawo.
Ngako oko lindani, nikumbule ukuba iminyaka yamitatu, ebusuku nasemini, andapeza ukuyala bonke ngabanye ndinenyembezi.
Nokwakaloku nje, bazalwana! ndiyanibekela kutixo nakwilizwi lofefe lwake, konamandla oku n aka, nokunipa ilifa pakati kwabo bonke abenziwe ngcwele.
Andinqwenelanga isilivere, negolide, nesivato samntu.
Nani ngokwenu niyazi ukuba izandla ezi zikonzile kuzo intswelo zam, nakubo abebenam.
Ndinibonisile zonke izinto, ukuba nisebenza ngokunjalo nifanele ukubaxasa abayimilwelwe, nokuwakumbula amazwi enkosi u‐Yesu, ukuba yena wati: Ukupa kutamsanqelekile ngapezu kwokwamkela.
Waza akuba ebetshilo oku, waguqa ngamadolo, watandaza kunye nabo bonke.
Kwasuka kwabako ukulila okukulu pakati kwabo bonke; baza bawa pezu kwentamo ka‐Paulusi, bamanga,
bedandatekile ngokukodwa pezu kwelozwi abelitshilo ukuti, abayi kubuya babone ubuso bake. Bampelekelela ke enqanaweni.
Naxeshekweni bekute ukuba sahlukana nabo sanduluka, sati ngqo ukuselisha seza e‐Kose, na ngomhla olandelayo e‐Rodo, sati sisuka kona seza e‐Patara.
Saza sifumene inqanawa iwela ukuya e‐Fenisi, sangena sanduluka.
Kekaloku kwakubonakala i‐Kiperusi, sayishiya ngasekohlo, saselishela e‐Siriya, safikela emhlabeni e‐Tire: ngokuba bekulapo inqanawa ibiya kutula umtwalo wayo.
Saza sakuba sibafumene abadisipile, salibala kona intsuku zasixe̔nxe; ababesiti ku‐Paulusi ngomoya, makanganyukeli e‐Yerusaleme.
Sati okuya bekute ukuba sagqibela ukufeza ezontsuku, semka sahamba, besipelekelela bonke, kunye nabafazi nabantwana, kude kwangapandle kwesixeko; saza saguqa ngamadolo elunxwemeni, satandaza.
Saza sakuba sibulisene, saya sangena enqanaweni; bati bona babuyela emakayeni abo.
Sati ke tina siyigqibele intselisho yetu sivela e‐Tire, seza kufika e‐Tolemayi; saza sibabulisile abazalwana, sahlala kubo umhla wamnye.
Nangomnye umhla u‐Paulusi nati babenaye semka seza e‐Kesareya, sangena endlwini ka‐Filipi umvangeli, obengowabasixe̔nxe, sahlala kuye.
Yena ke lo ebenentombi zazine, zizintombi zipela, ezaziprofitesha.
Kekaloku nxa sibe silibala kona imihla yamininzi, kwehla e‐Judeya umprofite otile ogama lalingu‐Agabusi;

weza ke kuti, watabata umbinqo ka‐Paulusi, wabopa ezake izandla nenyawo, wati: Utsho umoya oyingcwele ukuti: Londoda umbinqo lo ungowayo, ama‐Juda aya kwenje njalo ukuyibopa e‐Yerusaleme, aeya kuyinikela ezandleni zabaheyideni.
Naxeshekweni sevayo ezizinto, sambongoza tina, kwa nabo balondawo ukuba, makanganyukeli e‐Yerusaleme.
Kodwa u‐Paulusi wati ukupendula: Nenza nina nilila nidanisa intliziyo yam? ngokuba mna sendihlalele ukuba ndingabotshwa kodwa, koko nokuba ndifele e‐Yerusaleme, ngenxa yegama lenkosi u‐Yesu.
Kekaloku nxa ebengenakweyiswa, sayeka, sisiti: Intando yenkosi mayenziwe.
Sati emveni kwezontsuku sabopa impahla yetu, senyukela e‐Yerusaleme.
Kwaya n abatile bakubo abadisipile base‐Kesareya kunye nati, bezisa umntu otile, u‐Mnasone wase‐Kiperusi, obekade engumdisipile, ebesiya kuhlala kuye.
KEKALOKU sakufika e‐Yerusaleme, abadisipile basamkela ngovuyo.
Wati ng omhla olandelayo wangena u‐Paulusi kunye nati ku‐Yakobi; bebeko bonke abadala nabo.
Waza akuba ebabulisile, wabalisa ezozinto utixo ubezenzile pakati kwabaheyideni ngobukonzi bake ezinye ngezinye.
Bati bona bakuva, bayidumisa inkosi; baza batsho kuye ukuti: Uyabona, mzalwana! ukuba mangapina amawaka ama‐Juda akoliweyo; kanjako onke ayazondelela umteto:
kekaloku atyelwe ngawe ukuba onke ama‐Juda apakati kwabaheyideni uyawafundisa ukupambuka ku‐Mosesi, usiti makangalusi abantwana bawo, makangahambi ngamasiko kanjalo.
Kwotiwa nina ngoko? umhlambi ufanele kunene ukuba ubutane; ngokuba beya kuva ukuba ufikile.
Yenza ngoko oku sikutsho kuwe: Kuko kuti amadoda amane enesibambiso pezu kwawo;

wona la watabate nawe, uzicokise kunye nawo, uwenzelelele ekunikeleni, ukuze azigugule intloko; baze bonke bazi ukuba ezonto batyelwe zona ngawe aziluto, koko ukuba nawe ngokwako uyahamba ngokubamba umteto.
Kodwa abaheyideni abakoliweyo sagweba saba̔la ngabo ukuba bangayigcini into enjalo, kupela ukuba balumkele okubingelwe izitixo, negazi, nokuṙwishiweyo, nombulo.

Wandula u‐Paulusi wawatabata na ye amadoda lawo, wati ngomhla olandelayo, akuba ezicokisile kunye nawo, wangena etempileni, esazisa ukuzaliseka kwemihla yokucokisa, kwada kwanikelwa umnikelo ngenxa yawo amanye ngamanye.
Kekaloku xeshekweni leyomihla isixe̔nxe ibiza kupela, ati ama‐Juda ase‐Asiya, akumbona etempileni, apitizelisa sonke isihlwele, abeka izandla pezu kwake,

edanduluka ngokuti: Madoda, bo‐Sirayeli! ncedani. Nguye lo umntu ofundisayo bonke kuzo zonke indawo ngakubo abantu, nomteto, nalendawo; ote nakanjako wangenisa nama‐Girike etempileni, enco̔lisile lendawo engcwele.
(Ngokuba ebesel’ ebonile u‐Trofimo um‐Efese esixekweni kunye naye, abebeba u‐Paulusi wamngenisa etempileni.)
Saza savuselelwa isixeko sonke, kwasuka kwabako imbutumbutu yabantu; baza bambamba u‐Paulusi, bamr̔olela pandle kwetempile; zasezivalwa ke ingcango.
Kekaloku nxa bebefuna ukumbulala, zafika indaba kwinkosiwaka yebandla, zokuba i‐Yerusaleme yonke ipitizele:
eyati kwa oko yatabata nayo amasodati nenkosikulu, yehla yaya kubo ngokubaleka. Bati bona bakubona inkosiwaka namasodati, bayeka ukubeta u‐Paulusi.
Yandula yasondela inkosiwaka yambamba, yaxela ukuba anxitywe ngemixokelelwane emibini; yaza yabuza ukuba angaba ngubanina, nokuba yinto nina ayenzileyo.
Kodwa abanye bebememeza ngento etile, nabanye ngento yimbi, pakati kwesihlwele: yaza yakukohlwa kuyazi inyaniso yendawo ngenxa yesipitipiti, yaxela ukuba asiwe elalini yamasodati.
Kwaza kwati, xeshekweni wafika pezu kwezinyukelo, watwalwa ngamasodati ngenxa yokunyanzela kwesihlwele:
ngokuba umhlambi wabantu ubulandela, udanduluka ngokuti: Msuse yena!
Waza u‐Paulusi esakungeniswa elalini yamasodati wati kwinkosiwaka: Ndingateta into kuwe kusinina? Yati ke yona: Uyakwazi ukuteta ngesi‐Girike na?
akunguye na kambe lowam‐Jipete owati ngapambili kwezintsuku wenza impitimpiti, wakokela ngasentlango lomadoda amawaka mane abengabagwazi?
Kodwa wati u‐Paulusi: Mna ndingumntu ongum‐Juda, um‐Tarese, umhlali wesixeko esingesesingenaludumo sase‐Silisiya: ndiyakukunga ke, ndivumele ukuba nditete kubo abantu.
Kekaloku yakuba imvumele, u‐Paulusi, emi pezu kwezinyukelo, wakoba ngesandla ebantwini. Kwati kwakutwa cwaka kakulu, wateta kubo ngokuteta kwama‐Hebere, esiti:
Madoda, bazalwana nobawo! yivani ukuzitetelela kwam endikuteta kuni ngoku.
(Babesitike bakuva ukuba uyateta kubo ngokuteta kwama‐Hebere, bati tu ngakumbi; waza wati:)

Mna ke ndiyindoda engum‐Juda, ndizalelwe e‐Tarese yase‐Silisiya, kodwa ndondlelwe kwisixeko esi ngasezinyaweni zika‐Gamaliyeli, ndifundiswe ngesiko elizalisekileyo lomteto wobawo betu, ndizondelela utixo, njengokuba nina nonke ninjalo namhla:
endite lendlela ndayitshutshisa kwada kwasekufeni, ndinxiba ndinikela ezintolongweni namadoda namankazana;

njengokuba nomperisite omkulu endinqi̔nela, nayo yonke intlanganiso yabadala; endandisamkela kubo nencwadi ziba̔l elwe abazalwana, ndahambela e‐Damakusi, ukuya kuzisa nabo abebekona benxityiwe e‐Yerusaleme, ukuze babetwe.
Kwaye kute, nxa ndibe ndihamba, ndisondela e‐Damakusi ngasemini enkulu, kwati benge ngokwalama inkanyiso enkulu ivela ezulwini indingqonga.
Ndaza ndawa ngasemhlabeni, ndeva ilizwi lisiti kum: Saulusi, Saulusi! uyanditshutshisela nina?
Ndati ke mna ukupendula: Ungubanina, Nkosi? Yaza yati kum: Mna ndingu‐Yesu um‐Nazarete, lowo umtshutshisayo.
Kekaloku abo babenam bayibona okunene inkanyiso, boyika ke; kodwa ilizwi lalowo ubeteta kum abaliva.
Ndaza ndati: Ndiya kwenza nto nina, Nkosi? Yayisiti inkosi kum: Suka, uye e‐Damakusi; wauya kutyelwa apo ngazo zonke ezonto umiselwe ukuzenza.
Naxeshekweni bendingenakubona ngenxa yobungcwalisa benkanyiso leyo, ndati nditundezwa ngesandla ngabo ababeko nam, ndeza e‐Damakusi.
Waza u‐Hananiya otile, indoda ebedeshekileyo ngokwomteto, inqi̔nelwa kakuhle ngawo onke ama‐Juda abehlala kona,
weza kum, wema kufupi, wati kum: Mzalwana Saulusi! yamkela ukubona kwako. Ndaza ndati kwa ngeloxeshana ndakangela ngakuye.
Waza wati yena: Utixo wobawo betu wamisela wena pambili ukuyazi intando yake, nokumbona olungileyo, nokuliva ilizwi livela emlonyeni wake:
ngokuba uya kuba linqi̔na lake kubo bonke abantu, ngezozinto uzibonileyo nozivileyo.
Nakaloku ulibala nganina? suka, ubapitizeshwe, uhlanzwe ezonweni zako, ubiza egameni lenkosi.
Kwaza kwati, ndakuba ndibuye ndeza e‐Yerusaleme, nanxa benditandaza etempileni, ndandikulo ipupaṙa,
ndabona yona isiti kum: Nxama, upume kamsinya e‐Yerusaleme; ngokuba bengayi kwamkela ukunqi̔na kwako ngam.
Ndati ke mna: Nkosi! bayazi bona kakulu ukuba ndibe ndibafaka entolongweni, ndabatyabula kuzo zonke izindlu zentlanganiso, abo babekolwa kuwe:
naxeshekweni belipalazwa igazi lika‐Stefane inqi̔na lako, ndibe ndimi kona kwa nam, ndatakazela ukubulawa kwake, ndazigcina ingubo zabo ababembulala.
Yaza yati kum: Hamba; ngokuba ndiya kukutuma kude, ukuya kubaheyideni.
Kekaloku bebempulapula kwada kwalelilizwi; baza bapakamisa ilizwi labo, besiti: Msuse emhlabeni onjalo! ngokuba kungafanelekile ukuba adle ubomi.
Nxa ke bebedanduluka, belahla ingubo zabo, beposa utuli ngasesibakabakeni,
yaxela inkosiwaka ukuba angeniswe elalini yamasodati, yati makaṙoṙonywe ngokubetwa, ukuze iqonde ituba ababememeza kangaka ngakuye ngenxa yalo.
Kodwa bakumolulela pambili ngentambo, wati u‐Paulusi kwi nkosikulu ebimi kona: Umntu ongum‐Roma, ongagwetywanga kanjalo, nivunyelwa ukumbeta kusinina?
Yati inkosikulu yakuva oko, yaya yashumayela kwinkosiwaka, isiti: Lumka into uza kuyenza; ngokuba umntu lo engum‐Roma.
Yasuka yeza inkosiwaka yati kuye: Ndixelele, ungum‐Roma kusinina? Wati yena: Ewe.
Yaza yati inkosiwaka ukupendula: Mna ubuzwe obu ndabuzuza ngenani elikulu lemali. Wati u‐Paulusi: Kodwa mna ndizelwe ndikwa nabo.
