Kanjalo ilizwi lababeti begitare, nelabaculi, nelabagwali, nelabahlokomisa amaxilongo, alisayi kuba saviwa pakati kwako; nenci̔bi, noke ubunci̔bi bazo bunjanina, ayisayi kuba safunyanwa nanye pakati kwako; nentlokoma yelitye lokusila ayisayi kuba safunyanwa pakati kwako;

nokukanya kwesibane akusayi kuba sabonakala pakati kwako; nelizwi lomyeni nelomtshakazi alisayi kuba saviwa pakati kwako: ngokuba abatengi bako bebeyimiduna yomhlaba; ngokuba ngokutakata kwako zalahlekiswa intlanga zonke.
Kwaza kwafunyanwa kuyo igazi labaprofite nelabangcwele, nelabo bonke ababuleweyo pezu kwomhlaba.
NASEMVENI kwezizinto ndeva ilizwi elikulu lesihlwele esikulu ezulwini, sisiti: Haleluya! Usindiso, nobungcwalisa, nembeko, namandla, kuyo inkosi utixo wetu!
kuba iyinyaniso ilungile imigwebo yayo; kuba imgwebile umpinyiswa omkulu, lowo wawonakalisayo umhlaba ngombulo wake, yapindezela igazi lezicaka zayo kaso isandla sake.
Batsho ke ngokwesibini ukuti: Haleluya! Uti kekaloku umsi wake unyuke kude kube ngunapakade kanapakade.
Baza abadala bomashumi mabini anabane, nezidalwa ezipilileyo zozine, bawa pantsi babedesha utixo ohleli pezu kwayo iterone, besiti: Amene; Haleluya!
Kanjako lapuma ilizwi eteroneni, lisiti: Dumisani utixo wetu, nonke nina zicaka zake, nani nimoyikayo, nabancinane nabakulu!
Ndaza ndeva okungati lilizwi lesihlwele esikulu, nokungati lilizwi lamanzi amaninzi, nokungati lilizwi lendudumo ezinamandla, besiti: Haleluya! kuba ipete ngobukumkani inkosi, utixo ongusomandla
Masiti sivuye, sigcobe, siyinike udumo; ukuba ufikile umtshato wemvana, nokuba umfazi wayo ezilungisile.
Kwaye kunikwa kuye ukuba ambeswe ngeqiya eshiceneyo, emsulwa, ekazimlayo: ngokuba leqiya eshiceneyo izizenzo ezilungileyo zabangcwele.
Yayisiti kum: Ba̔la ukuti: Banetamsanqa abo bamenyelwayo esidlweni somtshato wayo imvana. Yayisiti kum: Wona la angawo amazwi ayinyaniso katixo.

Ndaza ndawa pambi kwenyawo zayo ukuba ndiyibedeshe. Yayisiti kum: Lumka ungenje njalo: ndisisicaka kunye nawe nakunye nabazalwana bako abanabo ubunqi̔na buka‐Yesu; mbedeshe utixo: ngokuba ubunqi̔na buka‐Yesu bungumoya wobuprofitesho.
NDAZA ndabona izulu livulekile; kekaloku bona ke, ihashe elimhlope, nalowo uhleli pezu kwalo, ebizwa ngobunene nangobunyaniso, oti agwebe enze imfazwe ebulungiseni.
Aye amehlo ake enjengelangatye lomlilo, napezu kwentloko yake bekuko ikrone ezininzi; ebenegama liba̔liwe, ekungeko namnye olaziyo, kupela nguye ngokwake.
Waye eyambete ingubo isindiwe ngegazi; negama lake libizwa ngokuti lilizwi likatixo.
Kanjalo imikosi yasezulwini ibimlandela ipezu kwamahashe amhlope, bevete iqiya eshiceneyo, emhlope, emsulwa.

Nakuwo umlomo wake kupuma iṙele elibukali, ukuze ati ngalo azibete intlanga: enguye oya kuzipata ngentonga yesincete: enguye osixovula isincinezelo seveyine sayo iveyine yomsindo neyoqumbo lukatixo usomandla.
Kanjalo unalo pezu kwengubo yake napezu kwetanga lake igama lake liba̔liwe lokuti: Ukumkani kakumkani nenkosi kankosi.
Ndaza ndabona ingelosi etile imi elangeni; yaza yadanduluka ngelizwi elikulu, isitsho kuzo zonke intaka ezibalekayo ngamapiko pakati kwezulu ukuti: Yizani nizihlanganisele esidlweni sotixo omkulu;
ukuze niyidle inyama yokumkani, nenyama yenkosiwaka, nenyama yamaṙoti, nenyama yamahashe neyabo bahleli pezu kwawo, nenyama yabo bonke, abakululekileyo namakonza, nabancinane nabakulu.
Ndaza ndabona ir̔amnco elo, nokumkani bomhlaba, nemikosi yabo ihlanganisene ukwenza imfazwe ngakuye lowo uhleli pezu kwehashe, nangakuwo umkosi wake.

Kwaza kwabanjwa ir̔amnco elo, nomprofite obuxoki ndawonye nalo, lowo owenza imiqondiso ebusweni balo, abete ngayo wabakohlisa abo balwamkelayo upa̔u lwer̔amnco, nabo bawubedeshayo umfanekiso walo. Aba bobabini baposwa bepilile ecibini lomlilo elivutayo ngesufure.
Nabo abaseleyo babulawa ngalo iṙele lalowo uhleli pezu kwehashe, eloṙ ele lipumayo emlonyeni wake: zaza intaka zonke zadikwa yinyama yabo.
Ndaza ndabona ingelosi isihla ezulwini, ipete isilotile sesinzulu nomxokelelwane omkulu esandleni sayo.
Yaza yayibamba inamba, lonyoka yakudala, enguye u‐Mncetezi no‐Satane, yayinxibela iwaka leminyaka,
yayiposela esinzulwini, yayivalela, yabeka isincamatiselo pezu kwayo, ukuze ingabi sazikohlisa intlanga, lide lifezwe elowaka leminyaka: nasemveni kwoko ifanele ukukululwa ixesha elincinane.

Ndaza ndazibona iterone, bati bahlala pezu kwazo, banikwa ukugweba: ndabona nemipefumlo yabebenqunyulwe intloko ngezembe ngenxa yobunqi̔na buka‐Yesu, nangenxa yelizwi likatixo, nabo basukuba bengalibedeshanga ir̔amnco, kwa nomfanekiso walo, ababengalwamkelanga kanjalo upa̔u lwalo pezu kwebunzi labo napezu kwesandla sabo; baza bapila bapata ubukumkani ndawonye no‐Kristu iwaka leminyaka.
Kodwa abanye abafileyo ababuya bapile lide lafezwa elowaka leminyaka. Lulo olu uvuko lwokuqala.

Unetamsanqa uyingcwele lowo unesabiwo eluvukweni lwokuqala: abanjalo ukufa kwesibini akunagunya pezu kwabo, koko beya kuba ngabaperisite bakatixo nabaka‐Kristu, bapate ubukumkani ndawonye naye iwaka leminyaka.
Kekaloku nxa lifezwe elowaka leminyaka, u‐Satane wokululwa entolongweni yake,
waeya kupuma ukuya kukohlisa intlanga ezisemagumbini omane omhlaba, u‐Goge no‐Magoge, ukubahlanganisela emfazweni; abanani lingangentlabati yolwandle.
Bati banyukela pezu kwobubanzi bomhlaba, baṙaula umnquba wabangcwele, nesixeko esitandiweyo: kwaza kwehla umlilo kutixo uvela ezulwini, wabagqibela.
Kanjako u‐Satane obebakohlisa waposelwa ecibini lomlilo nesufure, apo kukona iṙamnco nomprofite obuxoki; babeya kumbelwa emini nasebusuku kude kube ngunapakade kanapakade.
Ndaza ndabona iterone emhlope enkulu, nalowo uhleli pezu kwayo, ezati umhlaba nezulu zabaleka ebusweni bake: kwaza akwafunyanelwa zona indawo.

Ndabona kanjalo abafileyo, abancinane nabakulu, bemi pambi kwotixo; zaza zavulwa incwadi: kwavulwa nenye incwadi, eyeyobomi: bati abafileyo bagwetywa ngezozinto ezibe ziba̔liwe ezincwadini ezo, ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
Lwaza ulwandle lwanikela abafileyo abebekulo; kanjalo ukufa nehadesi zanikela abafileyo abebekuzo: bagwetywa ke bonke ngabanye ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
Kwaza kwaposwa ukufa nehadesi ecibini lomlilo. Kuko oku okwesibini ukufa.
Nosukuba engafunyanwanga eba̔liwe encwadini yobomi waposelwa ecibini lomlilo.
NDAZA ndabona izulu elitsha nomhlaba omtsha; ngokuba elokuqala izulu nowokuqala umhlaba ubudlulile; nolwandle aluseko.
Ndaza mna Johane ndasibona isixeko esiyingcwele, i‐Yerusaleme entsha, sisihla kutixo sivela ezulwini, silungisiwe njengomtshakazi ehonjelwe indoda yake.
Ndaza ndeva ilizwi elikulu livela ezulwini, lisiti: Bona ke, itabanakele katixo inabantu, waeya kuhlala nabo; bona boba ngabantu bake, naye utixo ngokwake woba nabo, e ngutixo wabo.
Kanjalo utixo uya kusula zonke inyembezi emehlweni abo: nokufa akuyi kuba seko; nosizi, nokulila, nobuhlungu abuyi kuba seko: ngokuba izinto zokuqala zimkile.
Waza watsho lowo uhleli pezu kwayo iterone ukuti: Bona ke, ndizenza ntsha zonke izinto. Wayesiti kum: Ba̔la; kuba lamazwi eyinyaniso eyinene.
Waza watsho kum ukuti: Kwenzekile. Mna ndingu‐Alefa no‐Omega, isiqalo nesipelo. Lowo onxanwayo ndompa mna kuwo umtombo wamanzi obomi ngesisa.
Owoyisayo wolidla ilifa lento zonke; ndandiya kuba ngutixo wake, naye yena woba ngunyana wam.

Kodwa abanobugwala, nabangakolwayo, nabatiyekileyo, nababulali, nabapimisi, nabatakati, nabakonzi bezitixo, nawo onke amaxoki, bona boba nesabiwo sabo ecibini elivutayo ngomlilo nangesufure; okukuko okwesibini ukufa.
Kwaza kweza kum enye yengelosi zosixe̔nxe ezibe zinazo ifiyali zosixe̔nxe ezibe zizele zizibeto zosixe̔nxe zokugqibela, yateta nam, isiti: Yiza apa; ndokubonisa umtshakazi, umfazi wayo imvana
Yaza yandisa emoyeni kuyo intaba enkulu ende, yandibonisa esosixeko esikulu, i‐Yerusaleme eyingcwele, sisihla ezulwini kutixo,
sinabo ubungcwalisa bukatixo: nesikanyiso saso sibe sifana nalo ilitye elinqabileyo kakulu, njengalo ilitye lejasipidi libengezela njengekrisitale:

sinalo kanjalo udonga olukulu olude; sinawo amasango alishumi linamabini, nengelosi ezilishumi linambini ngakuwo amasango lawo, namagama eba̔liwe pezu kwawo, angawo awezizwe ezilishumi linazibini zosapo luka‐Sirayeli;
engasempumalanga amasango matatu, engasenode amasango matatu, engasesuyide amasango matatu, engasentshonalanga amasango matatu.
Kanjako lona udonga lwesixeko belunemisekelo elishumi linamibini, nakuyo yona bekuko amagama abapostile abalishumi linababini bayo imvana.
Kekaloku lowo ubeteta nam ebenayo ingcongolo yegolide, ukuze asilinganise isixeko, namasango aso, nodonga lwaso.

Sona isixeko simi sinamacala mane; nobude baso bungaka njengokuba bunjalo ububanzi baso: waza wasilinganisa isixeko ngengcongolo leyo kude kwazizitadiya ezingamawaka alishumi linesibini: ubude nobubanzi nobupakamo baso buyalingana.
Waza walulinganisa udonga lwaso, ikubite zalikulu linamashumi mane anane, ngomlinganiso womntu, onguwo owengelosi.
Nesakiwo sodonga lwaso sibe siyijasipidi: nesixeko sona besiyigolide engcwele, sifana neglasi engcwele.
Nemisekelo yodonga lwesixeko ibihonjiwe ngamatye anqabileyo intlobo zonke: umsekelo wokuqala ubuyijasipidi; owesibini ubuyisafire; owesitatu ubuyikalekidone; owesine ubuyisamagide;

owesihlanu ubuyisadonutse: owesitandatu ubuyirubi; owesixe̔nxe ubuyikrusolite; owesibozo ubuyiberule; owesitoba ubuyitopaze; oweshumi ubuyikrisoprase; oweshumi linesinye ubuyiyasinte; oweshumi linesibini ubuyiyametisite.
Namasango olishumi linamabini ebeziperule ezilishumi linambini; onke amasango elinye ngelinye lali senziwa ngeperule yanye: nesitarate sesixeko besiyigolide engcwele, engati yiglasi ekanyisekayo.
Kekaloku andabona tempile pakati kwaso: ngokuba inkosi utixo usomandla iyitempile yaso, nayo imvana.
Kanjako isixeko eso asifuni ilanga, kwa nenyanga, ukuze zikanye pakati kwaso: ngokuba ubungcwalisa bukatixo bebusikanyisa, nayo imvana isisibane saso.
Zaye intlanga zabasindiswayo ziya kuhamba ekukanyeni kwaso; nokumkani bomhlaba bayazisela kuso ubungcwalisa babo nodumo lwabo.
Ati amasango aso angaki avalwe emini: ngokuba kungayi kubako busuku kona.
Kwaye kuziselwa kuso ubungcwalisa nodumo lwentlanga.
Kuti kanjalo kungaki kungene kuso nanye into enco̔lisayo, neyenzayo okubuntshontsho nokubuxoki; kupela ngabo bodwa ababa̔liweyo encwadini yobomi yemvana.
Waza wandibonisa umlambo ongcwele wamanzi obomi, okazimlayo njengekrisitale, upuma kuyo iterone katixo ne yemvana.

Pakati kwesitarate saso, nangelicala nangeliya lomlambo, bekuko umti wobomi, uhlanza intlobo ezilishumi linambini zeziqa̔mo, unika ukuqa̔ma kwawo inyanga ngenyanga: namagqabi awo umti lowo abengawokupiliswa kwentlanga.
Kwaye kungayi kuba seko isiqalekiso: kanjalo iterone katixo ne yemvana yoba kuso: nezicaka zake ziya kumkonza:
zaziya kubona ubuso bake; negama lake loba pezu kwamabunzi azo.
Akuyi kubako busuku kona kanjako; abafuni ke isibane nokukanya kwelanga; kuba inkosi utixo ibakanyisele: babeya kupata ngobukumkani kude kube ngunapakade kanapakade.
WAZA wati kum: Lamazwi ayinene ayinyaniso: kanjalo inkosi, utixo wabaprofite abangcwele, itumile ingelosi yayo ukuza kubonisa izicaka zayo izinto ezifanele ukubako kamsinya.
Bona ke, ndiyeza msinya. Unetamsanqa lowo uwagcinayo amazwi aso isiprofitesho salencwadi.
Nam Johane ndinguye obezibona ezizinto waziva. Ndite ndakuba ndivile ndabona, ndawa pantsi ukuba ndibedeshe pambi kwenyawo zengelosi ebindibonisa ezizinto.
Yayisiti kum: Lumka ungenje njalo: ngokuba ndisisicaka kunye nawe, nakunye nabazalwana bako abaprofite, nakunye nabawagcinayo amazwi alencwadi: mbedeshe utixo.
Yayisiti kum: Ungawancamatiseli amazwi aso isiprofitesho salencwadi; ngokuba ixesha lawo likufupi.
Yena owenza okungalungileyo, makabe esakwenza okungalungileyo; naye onco̔lileyo, makabe esanco̔lile; naye olungileyo, makabe esalungile; naye ongcwele, makabe esangcwaliswa.
Bona ke, ndiyeza msinya; nomvuzo wam unam, ukuba ndivuze bonke ngabanye njengokuba umsebenzi wabo uya kuba njalo.
Mna ndingu‐Alefa no‐Omega, isiqalo nesipelo, owokuqala nowokugqibela.
Banetamsanqa abayenzayo imiyalelo yake, ukuze babe negunya pezu kwawo umti wobomi, baze bati ngamasango aso bangene esixekweni.
Kodwa ngapandle kuko abazinja, nabatakati, nabapimisi, nababulali, nabakonzi bezitixo, nosukuba etanda esenza ubuxoki.
Mna Yesu nditumile ingelosi yam ukuza kunqi̔na ezizinto kuni ngazo iṙemente. Mna ndiyingcambo nenzalo ka‐Davide, ikw̔ezi lomso elikazimlayo.
Batsho nomoya nomtshakazi ukuti: Yiza. Naye ovayo makati: Yiza. Naye onxanwayo makeze. Naye otandayo makatabate amanzi obomi ngesisa.
Ngokuba ndinqi̔na mna kubo bonke abevayo amazwi aso isiprofitesho salencwadi: Ukuba umntu uti ongeze kuzo ezizinto, utixo uya kwongeza kuye izibeto eziba̔liweyo kulencwadi;
nokuba umntu uti asuse kuwo amazwi ayo incwadi yesiprofitesho esi, utixo uya kususa isabiwo sake kuwo umti wobomi, nakuso isixeko esiyingcwele, nakwezozinto ziba̔liweyo kulencwadi.
Uti lowo unqi̔nayo ezizinto: Ewe, ndiyeza msinya. Amene. Ewe, yiza, Nkosi Yesu.
Ufefe lwenkosi yetu u‐Yesu Kristu malube nani nonke. Amene. Isipeklo Setestamente Entsha.
